properties.title: Plastics Initiative
properties.description: Our Plastics Initiative is working to influence sustainable plastics production and consumption, to achieve a truly circular economy.

properties.title: Blue Resilience Initiative
properties.description: The Ocean Foundation’s Blue Resilience Initiative works to support coastal community resilience by restoring and conserving coastal habitats.

properties.title: RISE UP - The Ocean Foundation
properties.description: RISE UP is a global network of over 750 organisations from more than 67 countries, working to ensure that ocean decision-making processes and policies are shaped by the communities most affected by them. We unite diverse voices to influence and stren

properties.title: Race to Zero - The Ocean Foundation
properties.description: “Race to Zero” is a feature documentary film project that delves into the world of marine carbon dioxide removal, following ocean scientists and engineers as they conduct experiments at sea to better understand the ocean’s power to pull carbon from t

properties.title: Ocean Science Equity - The Ocean Foundation
properties.description: TOF’s Ocean Science Equity Initiative works to ensure that all countries and communities can monitor and respond to changing ocean conditions.

properties.title: Ocean Heritage Initiative
properties.description: The Ocean Foundation’s Ocean Heritage Initiative addresses challenges facing both the natural and cultural heritage associated with marine environments through marine spatial planning, ecosystem protection, and sustainable development.

properties.title: Friends of SpeSeas
properties.description: Focuses on ocean policy, international agreements, and the protection of known and potential submerged cultural resources based on decades of marine conservation experience.

properties.title: Organizacion SyCOMA
properties.description: Promoting environmental conservation throughout Mexico via habitat protection, ecosystem restoration, research, environmental education, community involvement, and public policy creation.
properties.location: Los Cabos, Baja California Sur, Mexico

properties.title: Friends of Lokahi Ocean Science
properties.description: Focuses on ocean policy, submerged cultural resources, and international agreements to advocate for marine conservation and heritage protection.

properties.title: Básico Carbon
properties.description: Focuses on analyzing ocean policy, international agreements, and existing laws to protect known and potential submerged cultural resources and support sustainable marine environments.

properties.title: The Oregon Kelp Alliance
properties.description: Surveying, monitoring, and restoring kelp forests to increase their resiliency against future threats. Efforts include experimental restoration projects and training specialists to protect these vital marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Cresta Coastal Network
properties.description: Collaborates with coastal communities to restore coral, mangroves, dunes, and seagrass habitats. Protects endangered marine species and develops alternative livelihoods to improve ecosystem health, community well-being, and local economies.

properties.title: Climate Sealutions Initiative
properties.description: Advances ocean-related climate solutions through strategic research, accessible screening tools, policy integration, and youth engagement to enable a sustainable transition and foster accessible climate solution intelligence.

properties.title: California Channel Islands Marine Mammal Initiative (CCIMMI)
properties.description: Supports population biology and ecological studies of pinnipeds to monitor ecosystem health and climate change impacts. Initiatives include demographic tracking, marine debris disentanglement, disease/toxin assessments, and foraging ecology.

properties.title: Friends of Nauco
properties.description: Advocates for the protection of submerged cultural resources and marine heritage through the application of existing laws, policies, and international agreements drawn from extensive ocean policy experience.

properties.title: Friends of Geo Blue Planet
properties.description: A global network ensuring the sustained development and use of ocean and coastal observational data for policy. It works with stakeholders to co-design responsive tools, build capacity, and raise awareness of ocean observation benefits.

properties.title: Friends of Por el Mar
properties.description: Safeguards the kelp forest ecosystems of Patagonia Argentina, drives the creation of marine protected areas, and opposes open-net salmon farming through science, advocacy, and community stewardship to restore marine life.

properties.title: Friends of Oceanswell
properties.description: Focuses on the protection of submerged cultural resources and the advancement of ocean policies and international agreements to support marine conservation efforts.

properties.title: Supported Organizations
properties.description: Provides fiscal sponsorship and services to marine conservation organizations globally, supporting capacity building, habitat conservation, ocean literacy, and the protection of vulnerable marine species like sea turtles and sawfish.

properties.title: Supporting Barbados with ocean protection
properties.description: Supports Barbados in protecting 30% of its waters following a debt-for-nature swap by developing the island's first Marine Spatial Plan and natural capital account. This enables tracking marine biodiversity and measuring ecosystem benefits.

properties.title: 15,000 km of coastline to protect
properties.description: Establishing marine protected areas across Greece, including community-led fishing bans in Amorgos and a sanctuary for endangered monk seals around Formicula Island, to recover fish stocks and safeguard vital coastal habitats.

properties.title: Solent Seascape Project
properties.description: Restoring marine and coastal habitats across the Solent, including planting seagrass, re-establishing native oyster populations in the Hamble river, and creating saltmarsh to support breeding seabirds, waders, and local biodiversity.

properties.title: Creating the largest marine park in Brazil
properties.description: Secured the designation of the 16,000 sq km Albardão National Park and Environmental Protection Area in Brazil, providing long-term protection for vital marine ecosystems and establishing the country's largest marine park.

properties.title: Sussex Kelp Recovery Project
properties.description: Monitoring habitats and species using BRUV surveys to restore Sussex kelp forests. The project tackles human pressures like sediment run-off and supports trawling bans in the Beachy Head East Marine Conservation Zone to allow kelp to thrive.
properties.funder: Sussex Kelp Recovery Project (partner), Blue Marine Foundation
properties.location: Beachy Head East Marine Conservation Zone, Sussex, UK

properties.title: Convex Seascape Survey
properties.description: Investigating the role of marine life, whales, and seaweed in ocean carbon storage, and assessing the impact of human activities like bottom trawling to inform global marine protection.

properties.title: Solent Oyster Restoration Project
properties.description: Restoring native flat oyster populations in the Solent through high-density brood stock cages and seabed re-seeding to enhance biodiversity, promote natural recruitment, and create large-scale sanctuary sites closed to commercial fishing.

properties.title: Revitalising wetlands in Greece
properties.description: Restoring the 400 sq km Amvrakikos Gulf ecosystem by reviving fan mussel and seabird habitats, reducing pollution and illegal fishing, and engaging communities to protect endangered marine life and improve long-term sustainability.

properties.title: Protection for Italy's Aeolians Islands
properties.description: Facilitating the official designation of a Marine Protected Area in the Aeolian Islands through political dialogue and community engagement, promoting sustainable small-scale fishing and marine ecosystem recovery.

properties.title: Sustainable aquaculture
properties.description: Promoting sustainable aquaculture by trialing alternative proteins for fish feed, campaigning to regulate the UK wrasse fishery, and restoring filter-feeding shellfish to create healthy, climate-resilient marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Nurturing kelp forests in Argentina
properties.description: Established the 295,135-hectare Patagonia Azul Provincial Park in Chubut to safeguard migratory routes for whales, seabird feeding grounds, and fur seals, while securing legal protection for seven vulnerable marine species.
properties.location: Patagonia Azul Provincial Park, Chubut, Argentina

properties.title: Seagrass in the Balearic Islands
properties.description: Restoring and monitoring Posidonia seagrass meadows while gathering critical growth data. It supports the Reserva 30 campaign to protect 30% of the Spanish Mediterranean, conserving vital ecosystems, local fisheries, and the tourism industry.

properties.title: Saving the Caspian Sea sturgeon
properties.description: Protecting endemic migratory species like sturgeon and salmon from the devastating impacts of oil and gas extraction, river dams, systematic poaching, pollution, and climate change in the Caspian Sea's fragile environment.

properties.title: Ascension Island Marine Protected Area
properties.description: Establishes a massive marine sanctuary to safeguard a mid-Atlantic Ridge ecosystem from long-line fishing. This biological oasis provides a critical breeding ground for sharks, marlin, and the Atlantic's largest green turtle population.

properties.title: Our blueprint for a marine protected area
properties.description: Establishing and effectively managing marine protected areas (MPAs) globally to restrict extractive activities like fishing. The initiative aims to protect at least 30 percent of the global ocean by 2030, safeguarding vital marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Rewilding fjords in Patagonian Chile
properties.description: Campaigning to expand the Diego Ramirez-Drake Passage MPA, close salmon farms in protected areas, and monitor cetaceans to safeguard marine ecosystems from aquaculture pollution and industrial activity.

properties.title: Cyprus proposal for an MPA at a UK Sovereign Base
properties.description: Proposing a new Marine Protected Area in Akrotiri, Cyprus, to protect vulnerable habitats, mobula rays, and underwater coral caves. The project aims to achieve official designation, implement sustainable financing, and improve local livelihoods.

properties.title: Whale Shark Protection in the Dutch Caribbean
properties.description: Protecting the 81,000 sq km EEZs of the six Dutch Caribbean islands, a vital migratory stopover with healthy coral reefs, to safeguard its sharks, whales, and biodiversity from the severe threats of climate change and ocean warming.

properties.title: Éduquer et sensibiliser à l'Océan
properties.description: Développement et mise à disposition de ressources pédagogiques gratuites pour les élèves et enseignants français afin de sensibiliser aux enjeux marins, au rôle de l'Océan et à la lutte contre la pollution plastique.

properties.title: Protéger la Biodiversité Marine
properties.description: Initiative to protect and restore marine ecosystems, combating overfishing and pollution. Includes funding for species conservation (cetaceans, turtles, sharks) and specific programs like SOS Corail for reefs, mangroves, and seagrasses.

properties.title: Soutenir la recherche
properties.description: Programme de soutien à la recherche océanographique finançant des bourses de thèse, des prix de publications scientifiques et des projets d'innovation bio-inspirés pour mieux comprendre et protéger la biodiversité marine.

properties.title: Lutter Contre la Pollution Plastique des Océans
properties.description: Fights marine plastic pollution to protect biodiversity from entanglement and microplastics. Initiatives include coastal waste collections, plastic upcycling, and marine debris recovery in collaboration with the French fishing industry.

properties.title: Projeto Pinípedes do Sul
properties.description: Reduces threats to pinnipeds and sea turtles in southern Brazil by increasing protection in marine refuges and developing environmental education and responsible fishing practices with coastal communities.
properties.funder: Núcleo de Educação e Monitoramento Ambiental (NEMA) (partner)
properties.location: Rio Grande do Sul and Santa Catarina, Brazil

properties.title: Nos projets - Pure Ocean
properties.description: Comprendre et combattre la pollution marine à la source, protéger la biodiversité, restaurer les écosystèmes et favoriser la résilience des systèmes marins et des populations dépendantes en améliorant la connaissance de l'océan.

properties.title: Pure Ocean Scientific Committee
properties.description: An independent, international scientific committee that defines the axes for Pure Ocean's calls for projects and selects marine conservation initiatives to support, focusing on ocean biodiversity, pollution, and climate resilience.

properties.title: ALT-Waste
properties.description: Mapping underwater textile pollution in Accra's Korle lagoon using an autonomous robot. The project assesses the impacts of fast-fashion waste on marine ecosystems, particularly turtle habitats and local subsistence fishing, to inform policy.

properties.title: Pure Ocean Foundation
properties.description: Mobilizes civil society to fund innovative scientific projects for the protection of fragile marine ecosystems and biodiversity. Supports international initiatives on marine pollution, climate resilience, and oceanographic knowledge.

properties.title: Bioplastics From The Deep
properties.description: Development of a biodegradable bioplastic inspired by the SRT18 protein from the European squid's jaw using biotechnology. This aims to reduce marine plastic pollution and reliance on fossil-based plastics without harming biodiversity.

properties.title: NatureWomen Challenge
properties.description: A 1200km non-stop relay triathlon from the English Channel to the Mediterranean Sea by four athletes to raise awareness and funds for ocean conservation.

properties.title: RimiOmics
properties.description: Assessing the ecotoxicological impacts of deep-sea mining on abyssal shrimp (Rimicaris exoculata) and their symbiotic bacteria at hydrothermal vents. The study uses genomics to evaluate pollution risks from sediment plumes in the Atlantic.

properties.title: PLUME
properties.description: Quantifying pollutant, water, and sediment fluxes in three Vietnamese estuaries to understand estuarine ecosystem resilience against anthropogenic pressures and assess socio-ecological impacts on local populations and marine resources.

properties.title: SOSOCEANOS
properties.description: Promotes the protection of interrelated global ecosystems by advocating for environments free of harmful elements to sustain all marine, terrestrial, and aerial species.

properties.title: SOS Oceano Programs
properties.description: General initiative promoting global ocean health to protect coasts, marine wildlife, and essential planetary resources including food, water, and air, emphasizing the fundamental connection between ocean health and human survival.

properties.title: Missions du Shom
properties.description: Production d'informations géographiques maritimes de référence pour décrire l'environnement physique marin, des fonds marins à l'atmosphère, prévoir son évolution et assurer la diffusion de ces données environnementales.

properties.title: The Polar Initiative
properties.description: A programmatic effort (2022-2025) to protect fragile polar ecosystems through science, policy, and capacity building. It addresses climate-induced changes in the cryosphere and their widespread impacts on global environmental and social systems.

properties.title: Monk Seal Alliance
properties.description: A joint initiative by donor organizations to protect the endangered Mediterranean monk seal. It expands regional conservation efforts, supports marine protected areas, and engages fishing communities to ensure the recovery of this iconic species.

properties.title: The Pelagos initiative
properties.description: Funding and collaborative action by civil society to protect, conserve, and promote the Pelagos Sanctuary. This 87,500 km2 cross-border Mediterranean area aims to safeguard marine mammals, threatened species, and remarkable biodiversity.

properties.title: The MedFund
properties.description: An environmental trust fund providing long-term financial support to improve the management effectiveness of marine protected areas across the Mediterranean Basin, safeguarding coastal and marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Beyond Plastic Med: BeMed
properties.description: A collaborative initiative combatting plastic and microplastic pollution in the Mediterranean Sea to prevent ecological disasters, protect marine species from suffocation, and safeguard the food chain and human health.

properties.title: Global Fund for Coral Reefs
properties.description: A global blended finance initiative leveraging public-private partnerships to safeguard coral reef ecosystems and support dependent communities by mobilizing significant grants and investments for sustainable conservation.

properties.title: Ocean Acidification and other ocean Changes - Impacts and Solutions (OACIS)
properties.description: Studies climate change impacts like acidification, warming, and oxygen loss on marine ecosystems and organisms. Develops and assesses potential solutions to mitigate these threats to coral reefs, fisheries, and vulnerable coastal habitats.

properties.title: Protecting Seas in the European Union
properties.description: EU policy advocacy to end overfishing, establish 30% MPA coverage with 10% strict protection, and eliminate harmful fisheries subsidies. Legal challenges against bottom-trawling in MPAs across member states since 2024.

properties.title: Guernsey Marine Protection in the Channel Islands
properties.description: Protecting Guernsey's coastal biodiversity through MPAs, sustainable fisheries, and community engagement. Safeguarding seagrass, kelp forests, maerl beds. Supporting 30x30 initiative and climate adaptation via blue carbon.

properties.title: Restoring Native Oysters in Essex
properties.description: Restoring native oyster populations in Blackwater Estuary, Essex. Creating oyster reefs with cultch and broodstock to recover Europe's most threatened marine habitat, depleted to <5% historic levels by overharvesting and disease.

properties.title: Mapping Whale and Turtle Pathways in the Dominican Republic
properties.description: Research expeditions documented biodiversity at Beata Ridge, Silver & Navidad Banks, revealing crucial migratory corridors for humpback whales & turtles. Led to designation of 119,373 sq km MPAs covering 30% of EEZ.

properties.title: High Seas: New Hope Beyond National Boundaries
properties.description: Safeguarding Walvis Ridge, a 3,000km submarine mountain chain in Southern Atlantic off West Africa. Creating transformative MPAs under new High Seas Treaty (BBNJ) effective Jan 2026. Partnering with Namibia Nature Foundation.

properties.title: Italy - A Mosaic of Seven Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: Blue Marine works with local stakeholders across 7 Italian MPAs to protect Mediterranean biodiversity, restore seagrass/coralligenous habitats, remove ghost nets, protect monk seals, sharks, and sea turtles through anti-trawling devices and sustainab

properties.title: The Ocean Awards
properties.description: Annual awards celebrating individuals/orgs solving marine crises. 6 categories: Local Hero, Science, Innovation, Public Awareness, Lifetime Achievement, Young Initiative. Raises awareness, increases media attention (89%), stakeholder engagement.
properties.funder: Blue Marine Foundation, BOAT International, Nekton

properties.title: A Marine Park for Jersey
properties.description: Campaign to protect Jersey's waters through MPAs covering 552 sq km, closing areas to dredging/trawling while supporting low-impact fishing. Includes education program reaching 80% of schools and Jersey Ocean Observatory portal.

properties.title: The Move Away from Destructive Fishing Must Be a Just Transition
properties.description: Campaigning to ban bottom-trawling in UK MPAs while ensuring fair transition for fishing communities. Developed Just Transition Analysis Framework presented at World Fisheries Congress 2024 to assess impacts.

properties.title: A Plan to Protect 200,000 sq km in Mexico
properties.description: Creating MPA in Baja California's Dos Mares to protect tuna, sharks, marlin. Partners collect data, engage 1M+ locals, transition fishers to tourism. 450+ shark samples, 32 species ID'd, 50+ trainings. Ongoing govt negotiations.

properties.title: Saving the Sharks of the Mediterranean
properties.description: Protecting overfished sharks/rays in Mediterranean via monitoring landings in Tunisia/Libya, researching habitats in Strait of Sicily, improving compliance with 2012 fishing ban. Started 2024, expanding across North Africa.

properties.title: Campaign for National Marine Parks in Britain
properties.description: Blue Marine leads campaign since 2018 to create UK's first National Marine Parks. Promotes ocean access, protects seascapes, supports local economies. Plymouth Sound declared first marine park 2019. Framework endorsed 2023.

properties.title: Menorca: Protecting a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve
properties.description: Protecting Menorca's marine habitats from unregulated fishing and tourism. Patrol boat monitors Isla del Aire MPA, ghost nets removed, eco-moorings planned to protect seagrass. Biosphere reserve expanded by 443,000 hectares since 1993.
properties.funder: Blue Marine Foundation, Menorca Preservation Fund

properties.title: Rare Species Protection in a Pacific Archipelago
properties.description: Protecting endemic species in Juan Fernández islands, Chile, by expanding MPAs to 899,268 sq km. Safeguards fur seals, petrels, shearwaters, and fish from illegal fishing. Achieved March 2026, creating world's 3rd largest no-take zone.

properties.title: Aquaculture and Sustainable Fishing in Mozambique
properties.description: Monitoring sharks, rays & whales in Jangamo Bay to inform MPA designation. Supporting sustainable aquaculture & transitioning fishers from damaging nets to kayak fishing. Empowering women through mussel farming micro-businesses.

properties.title: Protecting Manatees in Panama and Costa Rica
properties.description: Protecting manatees along Caribbean coasts of Panama & Costa Rica. Assessing populations, designating MPAs including Changuinola reserve, creating 500-mile bi-national corridor & seeking IMMA status for critical habitat.

properties.title: Mangrove Restoration in the Philippines
properties.description: Restoring 10ha of abandoned aquaculture ponds to mangrove forests in Surigao del Sur & La Union. Planting 25,000 trees, training 68 community members. Launched 2023 to recover biodiversity & support coastal livelihoods.

properties.title: Namibia: Rebooting Africa's Second-Largest MPA
properties.description: Supporting effective management of Namibian Islands MPA (NIMPA) threatened by overfishing, mining, pollution. Training government staff, developing sustainable finance plans, Ocean Literacy Toolkit, expanding to 10% EEZ protection.

properties.title: Migratory Pathways of Whales
properties.description: Preventing whale strikes by rerouting ships around seasonal aggregation areas. Partners with Whale Guardians, ports in Brazil, Mexico, South Africa, Chile. Uses AIS data and fishermen reports to create safer shipping routes.

properties.title: Reefs of the Maldives
properties.description: Protecting Maldivian coral reefs through MPAs, sustainable fisheries, seagrass conservation, and community engagement. Prevented longlining licenses, trained 50+ citizen scientists, secured resort commitments to protect 830,000 sq m seagrass.

properties.title: Lyme Bay - Our Model for Sustainable Fishing
properties.description: Protecting 236 sq km of English Channel from trawling since 2008, preserving rocky reefs and pink sea fans. Collaborative management with fishers, scientists, NGOs achieves sustainable fishing and conservation coexistence.

properties.title: Sustainable Management in St Vincent & the Grenadines
properties.description: Protecting 36,000 sq km of Caribbean waters through community-led conservation. Conch closed seasons, nursery zones, fisher training, and orca protection established via collaboration with government and local communities since 2022.

properties.title: Scoping Marine Megafauna in São Tomé and Príncipe
properties.description: Protecting whale sharks in Gulf of Guinea through monitoring, fisher education, and policy advocacy. 80+ observations recorded, 6 sharks tagged, 3,000+ fishers engaged. New protection decrees await approval.

properties.title: St Helena: Key Notch in the UK's Blue Belt
properties.description: Protecting 444,916 sq km MPA through sustainable pole-and-line fishing, dive scholarships for youth, whale shark conservation, and beach cleans. Part of UK Blue Belt Programme supporting local livelihoods and biodiversity.

properties.title: Protecting Raja Ampat: The Most Biodiverse Place on Earth
properties.description: Protecting Raja Ampat's Dampier Strait MPA from illegal fishing & destructive tourism. Training rangers, building patrol boats, establishing sustainable fishing & tourism frameworks with local communities & resorts since 2025.

properties.title: Conch Surveying in St Kitts & Nevis
properties.description: Protecting 30% of St Kitts & Nevis EEZ and 417 sq km nearshore waters through Marine Managed Area designation. Addressing coral loss, declining fish populations, and macroalgal growth. Partnership with Blue Conscience since 2024.

properties.title: Regulatory Framework Analysis for Migrant Workers on South Korean Distant Water Fishing Fleets
properties.description: Creating regulatory framework analysis and recommendations to address human rights harms of migrant workers on South Korean distant water fishing fleets. Focuses on labor rights and fishing industry reform.

properties.title: An MPA Template for Scotland
properties.description: Protecting Scotland's MPAs from overfishing & bottom trawling. Focus on Berwickshire MPA with community engagement, policy advocacy, & ocean observatory. Aims to enhance marine health & sustainable small-scale fisheries.

properties.title: AFFTA Fisheries Fund
properties.description: Core support for fisheries conservation. Packard Foundation grant for ocean and environment initiatives. $150k over 35 months starting 2023.
properties.funder: The David and Lucile Packard Foundation

properties.title: UK Restoration: The Wild Oysters Project
properties.description: Restoring native oyster populations in UK waters. Established community hubs in Firth of Clyde, Conwy Bay, and Tyne/Wear with nurseries and seabed restoration. Launched 2021 with ZSL and British Marine.

properties.title: Marine Protection in South Georgia & South Sandwich Islands
properties.description: Expanded no-take MPA by 166,000 sq km in 2024 to protect whales, penguins, seabirds from krill fishing pressure. Blue Marine led scientific advocacy through Great Blue Ocean coalition with UK government.

properties.title: We took the UK government to court for overfishing
properties.description: Legal action against UK govt for setting fishing quotas above scientific advice, threatening cod, whiting, pollack stocks. Case lost 2025, appeal planned. Aims to enforce Fisheries Act 2020 sustainability objectives.

properties.title: Turkey Support for a Conservation Leader
properties.description: Network of 6 MPAs in Turkey's Gökova Bay region combating overfishing, invasive species & IUU fishing. 1,400 patrols, 268 illegal incidents detected, 4.5t invasive fish removed. 600% income increase for fishers, monk seals quadrupled.

properties.title: Certification and Ratings Collaboration
properties.description: Support for Aquaculture Stewardship Council's certification and ratings collaboration to improve sustainable aquaculture practices globally through standardized assessment and certification systems.

properties.title: Tristan da Cunha - A Remote Island Protecting the Ocean
properties.description: Supporting Tristan da Cunha's 687,000 sq km MPA in South Atlantic, protecting seabirds, penguins, seals, tuna. Largest Atlantic Ocean protection zone. Community support for remote island lacking tourism revenue. Started 2020.

properties.title: Marine and Coastal Conservation Funding Landscape Analysis - Mexico
properties.description: Develop funding landscape analysis and toolkit, engage funders and grantee partners in Mexico to support synergies and fundraising for marine/coastal conservation, human rights, climate change. 25-month term starting 2023.

properties.title: Can we persuade Uruguay's shark fishers to diversify?
properties.description: Protecting Uruguay's sharks & rays from unsustainable fishing. Identifying key habitats, training naval personnel in monitoring, creating MPAs. Goal: 30% protection by 2030 in Rio de la Plata region.

properties.title: Shell-to-Shore: Restaurants Help Us to Restore Oysters
properties.description: Collects waste oyster shells from London restaurants to provide substrate for oyster reef restoration. Diverted 1,500kg from landfill in 10 weeks. Restores European flat oyster populations, enhances habitats, water quality.

properties.title: Strengthening Worker Participation and Rights in Fisheries
properties.description: Connects global and local approaches to strengthen worker participation and worker-driven solutions protecting rights of fishers and fishery workers through collaborative advocacy and policy development.

properties.title: BirdLife International Marine Conservation Programs
properties.description: Protecting marine birds, oceans & sustainable fisheries through bycatch reduction in global fisheries & Pacific island ecosystem restoration for seabirds, biodiversity & communities. Ongoing multi-year programs 2023-2027.

properties.title: Global Tuna Sustainability Coalition Support
properties.description: Core support to convene NGOs and organizations working on global tuna sustainability. Coordinates comprehensive efforts across international stakeholders to address tuna conservation challenges worldwide.

properties.title: Indigenous-led integral restoration strategy for marine-coastal territory Lafken-mapu
properties.description: Indigenous-led restoration of Lafken-mapu marine-coastal territory. Integral strategy combining traditional knowledge with conservation to restore coastal ecosystems and marine resources in Chile's Budi Lake region.

properties.title: Southeast Asia 30x30 Fund for Community-Led Marine Conservation
properties.description: Regional fund supporting community-led Protected and Conserved Areas and OECMs in Southeast Asia through re-granting mechanism, advancing 30x30 conservation goals across maritime regions.

properties.title: Beijing Chaoyang District Yongxu Global Environmental Institute - Marine Conservation Regranting Program
properties.description: Core support for GEI's regranting to Chinese civil society organizations for coastal ecosystem conservation and capacity building to enhance marine conservation efforts in China

properties.title: Black in Marine Science
properties.description: General support for Black in Marine Science organization promoting diversity and inclusion in marine science fields. Funded by Packard Foundation in 2025 for 24 months with $300,000 grant.
properties.funder: The David and Lucile Packard Foundation

properties.title: Seafood Climate Impact Program Publication
properties.description: Publishing Blueyou's insights from Seafood Climate Impact Program, including carbon footprint methodology and toolbox for sustainable seafood movement. 2023, 12-month term, $97,840 grant.

properties.title: Blue Ventures Conservation - Community-led Marine Management in Maluku Province
properties.description: Strengthening local civil society to establish community-led marine management, improve fisheries, and secure food security in Maluku Province, Indonesia through capacity building and sustainable practices.

properties.title: Ocean Progress Initiative
properties.description: Core support for CAP's Ocean Progress initiative advancing ocean conservation policy through progressive ideas and leadership in the United States. 24-month term starting 2025 with $400,000 funding.

properties.title: Centro de Incidencia Ambiental de Panama - Marine Conservation
properties.description: General support for ocean conservation work in Panama. Two grants totaling $360,000 over 2023-2025 for environmental advocacy and marine protection initiatives in Panamanian coastal waters.

properties.title: Centro Mexicano para la Defensa del Medio Ambiente A.C.
properties.description: Mexican environmental defense center receiving general support for ocean conservation work. $262.5K total funding (2023-2024) for marine environment protection and civil society leadership development.

properties.title: Centro de Estudio y Conservación del Patrimonio Natural - Marine Spatial Planning
properties.description: Spatial Planning Area program in Quinchao for marine conservation. General operating support for ocean protection initiatives. Ongoing organizational strengthening with capacity coaching. Chilean coastal marine planning.

properties.title: Causa Natura A.C. - Marine Conservation and Sustainability
properties.description: General support for ocean conservation work and development of comprehensive sustainability model and strategy for marine environmental protection in Mexico's coastal regions.

properties.title: Centro Mexicano de Derecho Ambiental, A.C.
properties.description: General support for Mexican environmental law center. Ocean conservation work in Mexico. $200k grant for 24-month term starting 2024. Focus on environmental and ocean protection through legal advocacy.
properties.funder: The David and Lucile Packard Foundation

properties.title: Benthic Resources Exploitation and Management Areas (AMERBs) Climate Vulnerability Outreach Campaign
properties.description: Outreach campaign sharing climate vulnerability evaluation results of AMERBs with Chilean fishing communities and authorities to improve benthic resource management under climate change impacts.

properties.title: Centro para el Desarrollo Social y la Sustentabilidad Nuiwari, A.C.
properties.description: Ocean conservation and social sustainability project in Mexico. General support grant for marine environmental protection and community development initiatives. 48-month term funded by Packard Foundation.
properties.funder: The David and Lucile Packard Foundation

properties.title: China NGOs for Marine Environmental Protection
properties.description: Supporting Chinese NGOs in marine environmental protection efforts. Focuses on building capacity of local organizations to address ocean conservation challenges in China's coastal waters.

properties.title: Seafood and Gender Equality & Gender Dialogues
properties.description: Core support for Seafood and Gender Equality program uplifting, amplifying, and integrating diverse voices in the global seafood sector through Gender Dialogues initiative.

properties.title: Advancing Strategic Ocean Communication
properties.description: Core support for development and rollout of strategic ocean communication project. Aims to advance ocean conservation through strategic communications initiatives and related activities over 36-month period.

properties.title: Comunidad y Biodiversidad, A.C.
properties.description: General support for marine conservation and ocean biodiversity work in Mexico. $400K grant from Packard Foundation for 24-month term starting 2023.
properties.funder: The David and Lucile Packard Foundation

properties.title: Chumash Heritage Foundation - Tribal Marine Stewards Network
properties.description: Research, monitoring, community engagement supporting Tribal Marine Stewards Network. Chumash-led marine conservation integrating indigenous knowledge with coastal ecosystem protection.

properties.title: Blue Communities Program Core Support
properties.description: Core support for Blue Communities Program promoting sustainable small-scale fisheries and human rights-based approaches globally, including ocean conservation policy expertise at White House OSTP.

properties.title: Costa Humboldt Marine Conservation
properties.description: Enhancing conservation strategies for unique marine ecosystems; catalyzing collaboration among Marine and Coastal Marine Areas for Indigenous People; strengthening community-led conservation and fisheries management in Chilean coastal regions

properties.title: Conselva, Costas, y Comunidades, A.C.
properties.description: General support for coastal and marine conservation work in Mexico. Organization focuses on coasts and communities, working on ocean conservation initiatives.
properties.funder: The David and Lucile Packard Foundation

properties.title: Women of the Sea Program - Strengthening Artisanal Fishing in Chile
properties.description: Core support for Women of the Sea program strengthening artisanal fishing and related activities in Chile. Develops organizational structure, profiles women fishers, builds member capabilities, establishes action plans.

properties.title: Youth Engagement in Ocean Protection in the United States
properties.description: Youth engagement program for ocean protection across the United States. Empowers young people to participate in marine conservation through education and action. 2025 initiative by Earth Echo International.

properties.title: Fish On - Conservation-Minded Anglers Ocean Policy Engagement
properties.description: Fish On project engages conservation-minded anglers and spearfishers in ocean policy advocacy. Supports recreational fishing community participation in marine conservation decisions and policy development.

properties.title: Creation Justice Ministries - Area-Based Marine Conservation
properties.description: Core support for Creation Justice Ministries' area-based marine conservation work in the United States and transitioning past ocean work. Faith-based organization working on ocean conservation initiatives.
