properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Assessing the Affect of Spotted Spiny Lobster Densities on Coral Rehabilitation (FL)
properties.description: Study examining how spotted spiny lobster populations impact coral rehabilitation efforts in Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary. Research conducted to understand lobster-coral interactions for reef restoration.

properties.title: Explore New Coral Engineering Methods to Enhance Coral Reef Restoration in Guam
properties.description: Coral engineering research to enhance reef restoration in Guam's Apra Harbor, Cocos, and Piti Bomb Holes. University of Guam develops innovative methods for coral reef conservation and restoration.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Evaluating Success of Land-based Pollution Management for Coral Habitat (PR)
properties.description: Evaluates land-based pollution management effectiveness for coral reef protection in Culebra Island, Puerto Rico. Focuses on Dátiles and Sardinas subwatersheds to reduce terrestrial runoff impacts on coral habitats.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Building Ungulate Excluding Fencing to Reduce Sediment Loading to Coral Reefs in West Maui (HI)
properties.description: Fencing in Olowalu, Launiupoko, and Kaua'ula watersheds to exclude ungulates, reducing sediment runoff to protect West Maui coral reefs. Lahaina, Maui County, Hawaii.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Socioeconomic Monitoring Team and Data Compilation for Micronesia
properties.description: Coral reef conservation through socioeconomic monitoring and data compilation across Micronesian islands (Palau, Marshall Islands, FSM) to support marine resource management and community-based conservation efforts.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Building Management Capacity in Taka Bonerate Marine National Park (Indonesia)
properties.description: Coral reef conservation project building management capacity in Taka Bonerate Marine National Park, Sulawesi, Indonesia through Wildlife Conservation Society.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Digital Deck Expansion for Fisheries Data Reporting (PR)
properties.description: Expanding digital fisheries data reporting system in Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands to improve coral reef conservation through better fisheries management and data collection.

properties.title: Education and Clean-Up at Punta Ballenas, Puerto Rico
properties.description: Clean-up and education project at Punta Ballenas in Guanica watershed, covering 172.7 acres of dry forest, mangroves, lagoons and beach managed by PR Conservation Trust.

properties.title: Educational Products in Support of Culebra's No Take Marine Protected Area in Puerto Rico
properties.description: Educational products supporting Culebra's no-take marine protected area in Puerto Rico's Eastern Caribbean archipelago to promote coral reef conservation and marine ecosystem protection.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Building Capacity for Management of Invasive Lionfish in the Caribbean
properties.description: Training workshops and distribution of Best Practices Manual to manage invasive lionfish across the Caribbean region, including Bahamas, Mexico and US coastal areas.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Improved Reserve Management through Community Participation (PR)
properties.description: Community-based management of Tres Palmas Marine Reserve (204 acres) in Rincón, Puerto Rico through local participation to enhance coral reef conservation and reserve effectiveness.

properties.title: Socioeconomic Monitoring in Verde Island Passage, Philippines
properties.description: Socioeconomic monitoring project in Verde Island Passage, Coral Triangle - world's marine biodiversity center in northern Philippines. Supports coral reef conservation through community assessment.

properties.title: Coral Reef Recovery Team for Maui, Hawaii
properties.description: Coral reef conservation in Maui County waters, focusing on Maui Island with secondary efforts on Molokai and Lanai. Recovery team initiative funded through Coral Reef Conservation Fund.

properties.title: Developing a Watershed Action Plan for Cabo Rojo, Puerto Rico
properties.description: Watershed action plan for Cabo Rojo, SW Puerto Rico, addressing agriculture, urban & forested areas to protect coral reefs through watershed management
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Reef Ecosystems Improvement through Effective Fisheries Governance
properties.description: Improving coral reef ecosystems through fisheries governance in 17 MPAs (406 ha) across Far Northern Cebu municipalities: Medellin, San Remigio, Tabuelan, Tuburan, Philippines.

properties.title: Initiating a Marine Protected Area Effectiveness System in Indonesia
properties.description: Establishing MPA effectiveness monitoring system at Wakatobi National Park, Sulawesi, and working with Indonesian national government to improve MPA management policies and practices.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Río Loco/Guánica Bay Watershed Educational Video (PR)
properties.description: Educational video documenting conservation projects in Guanica/Rio Loco watershed, Guanica Bay and nearshore reefs in Puerto Rico to raise awareness of coastal and marine ecosystem protection efforts.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Threshold and Reduction Targets for Land-based Stressors to Coral Reefs (HI, AS)
properties.description: Research project determining threshold levels and reduction targets for land-based pollutants affecting coral reefs. Lab work conducted on coral species from Hawaii, Florida, and Puerto Rico to establish stressor limits.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Enhancing Management of Herbivorous Fish in Pohnpei
properties.description: Coral reef conservation project enhancing herbivorous fish management in Pohnpei, Micronesia through community-based approaches in Metipw, Dolopwail villages and Nett, Kitti municipalities to protect reef ecosystems.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Coffee Pulp Composting Demonstration and Utilization
properties.description: Coral reef conservation through coffee pulp composting in Maricao, PR. Lectures and demonstrations at local facilities, building composts at participant locations, applying compost to reduce agricultural runoff impacting reefs.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Payment for Ecosystem Services to Finance Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: Financing marine protected areas through payment for ecosystem services in Seaflower MPA, Caribbean's largest MPA and coral reef biodiversity hotspot in San Andres Archipelago, Colombia.

properties.title: Economic Valuation of Coral Reef Ecosystems in the U.S. Virgin Islands
properties.description: Economic valuation study of coral reef ecosystems in U.S. Virgin Islands to assess ecosystem services and support conservation planning through quantifying reef benefits.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Nutrient Pollution Reduction in American Samoa
properties.description: Coral reef conservation project reducing nutrient pollution in American Samoa's South Pacific waters through the Coral Reef Conservation Fund, implemented by Coalition of Reef Lovers.

properties.title: Techniques to Reduce Farm Soil and Nutrient Run-off (PR)
properties.description: Reducing agricultural soil erosion and nutrient runoff from steep slopes in Guanica watershed, Maricao, PR to protect downstream coral reefs and marine ecosystems from sedimentation and pollution.
properties.funder: National Fish and Wildlife Foundation - Coral Reef Conservation Fund

properties.title: Reef Resilience and Climate Change Workshop for Reef Manager
properties.description: Workshop training reef managers on climate change resilience strategies for coral reef conservation in Bonaire, Netherland Antilles through the Coral Reef Conservation Fund.

properties.title: Climate Change Implications for the Coral Triangle
properties.description: Report analyzing climate change impacts on Coral Triangle coral reefs across 6 countries (Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands, Timor-Leste) to inform conservation strategies.

properties.title: WWF Belize Marine Conservation Project
properties.description: Marine conservation initiative in Belize coastal waters. Focuses on protecting marine ecosystems and biodiversity through community engagement and sustainable management practices.

properties.title: Marine Conservation in Berau, East Kalimantan
properties.description: Protecting coral reefs & marine biodiversity in Berau through sustainable fisheries, MPA management & community engagement. Supports local livelihoods while conserving critical coastal ecosystems in Indonesia.

properties.title: WCS Tanzania Marine Conservation Project
properties.description: Wildlife Conservation Society project in Tanzania focused on marine ecosystem protection and coastal community engagement. Supports sustainable fisheries management and marine biodiversity conservation along Tanzania's coast.

properties.title: Quirimbas National Park Marine Conservation Project
properties.description: WWF-DE marine conservation in Quirimbas National Park, Mozambique. Protects coastal ecosystems, supports sustainable fisheries, strengthens community management. Funded by Blue Action Fund for biodiversity and livelihoods.

properties.title: Rare Honduras Marine Conservation Project
properties.description: Marine conservation project in Honduras supported by Blue Action Fund and Rare. Focuses on coastal ecosystem protection and sustainable fisheries management in Honduran waters.

properties.title: Coral Triangle Marine Conservation Project - Indonesia
properties.description: Marine conservation in Indonesia's Coral Triangle region. Protects coral reefs, marine biodiversity through community engagement, sustainable fisheries, habitat restoration. 2025-2030 implementation period.

properties.title: Coral Reef Fish Spawning Aggregation Research in the Florida Keys
properties.description: Research coral reef fish spawning aggregations in Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary waters to support conservation of reef fish populations and coral reef ecosystem health.

properties.title: Coral Reef Investigation Workshop in Guam
properties.description: Workshop in Guam focused on coral reef investigation and conservation monitoring. Part of the Coral Reef Conservation Fund program to enhance reef protection and research capacity in the Pacific territory.

properties.title: Blue Ventures Indonesia Marine Conservation Project
properties.description: Community-based marine conservation in Indonesia supporting sustainable fisheries and coastal ecosystem protection through local management initiatives.

properties.title: Galapagos-Cocos Marine Conservation Corridor
properties.description: Marine corridor project connecting Galapagos and Cocos Island ecosystems. Protects migratory routes for sharks, rays, turtles. Implements monitoring, enforcement, community engagement. 2021-2025.

properties.title: Melanesia Marine Conservation Project
properties.description: WCS Melanesia marine conservation initiative protecting coastal ecosystems and biodiversity in the Pacific region through community engagement and sustainable resource management from 2018-2021.

properties.title: Rare Mozambique Marine Conservation Project
properties.description: Marine conservation initiative in Mozambique focused on coastal community engagement and sustainable fisheries management through behavior change programs and local capacity building.

properties.title: Marine Conservation at Cocos Island National Park
properties.description: MarViva protects Cocos Island marine biodiversity through enforcement, sustainable fishing, community engagement. Strengthens Costa Rica's marine protected area management and regional conservation.

properties.title: Primeiras e Segundas Ilhas Environmental Protected Area (PSEPA) Project
properties.description: Marine conservation in Mozambique's Primeiras e Segundas archipelago. Strengthened MPA management, community engagement, sustainable fisheries, and biodiversity protection. 2018-2022.

properties.title: Community Conservation of Marine Biodiversity on the Island of São Tomé
properties.description: Protects 5 sea turtle species through community-led monitoring, former poacher employment, ecotourism, and coastal habitat protection. Addresses threats from fishing, pollution, urbanization on São Tomé Island.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Renforcer la résilience des systèmes écologiques et sociaux côtiers du Pakistan
properties.description: Conserve coastal ecosystems & livelihoods in Indus Delta & Balochistan coast. Strengthen governance, halt mangrove degradation, protect fisheries. Focus on poverty reduction & women. Integrated coastal management approach.

properties.title: Socio-ecological Resilience of Mangroves
properties.description: Improve well-being of communities near mangroves in southern Benin. Restore ecosystems lost to fishing/salt production. Enhance governance, rights, awareness. Build local capacity for conservation through community action and best practices.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: CORVI Project: Priority on Climate Action in Toamasina
properties.description: Training WIOMSA & Madagascar's Ministry on CORVI tool to assess climate risks in Toamasina coastal city. Addresses cyclones, sea level rise, urbanization impacts on blue economy & marine ecosystems to build resilience.
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Conserving Healthy Populations of Large Pelagic Fish in the Mediterranean Sea
properties.description: Rebuild bluefin tuna, albacore, swordfish populations and protect pelagic sharks through sustainable fishery management and bycatch reduction. Monitor recovery plans via ICCAT, promote sustainable sources, test best practices for shark survival.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Green Light for Coastal Wetlands in the Mediterranean
properties.description: Why: Mediterranean wetlands face overexploitation, habitat destruction, rising seas. What: Protect/restore coastal wetlands as climate solutions. How: Scientific reporting, mapping restoration sites, pilot restoration with local CSOs. When: 2023-2025
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Western Indian Ocean Marine Conservation
properties.description: WCS marine conservation across Tanzania, Kenya, Madagascar. Protects coastal ecosystems, fisheries, biodiversity in Western Indian Ocean. Community-based management, sustainable fishing practices.

properties.title: Safeguarding Ocean Resources in Bangladesh
properties.description: Creating and strengthening Marine Protected Areas in Bangladesh to protect endangered species, mangrove forests, and coastal habitats. Reduces fishing pressures, maintains ecosystems, builds climate resilience for 50M coastal residents.

properties.title: Tsara Kobaby
properties.description: Protecting Sainte Marie Island's marine & terrestrial biodiversity (800ha rainforest, humpback whales) by establishing community-managed protected area, promoting inclusive ecotourism & income generation for vulnerable communities dependent on fishin
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Siren Song: Knowledge and Protection of the Sirenians
properties.description: Acoustic monitoring of dugongs & manatees in Vanuatu & Belize to protect vulnerable marine herbivores. Passive listening stations track behavior, habitat use, feeding patterns to establish conservation measures for declining populations.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: The Sound of the Gorgonian Forests
properties.description: Why: Gorgonian forests face mass mortality from warming. What: Acoustic monitoring of coral biodiversity. How: Hydrophones measure sound fingerprints at varying forest densities. When: Oct 2022-Dec 2024. Where: 3 MPAs in France/Italy
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Benthic Organisms and Communities in a Changing Arctic Ocean (ORCA)
properties.description: Studies Arctic benthic ecosystems (macroalgae, organisms) response to climate change via lab experiments and in-situ metabolism monitoring. Addresses temperature, pH, light impacts on coastal biodiversity and carbon balance.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Sustainable Development of Mangrove Agriculture (DEDURAM)
properties.description: Promotes solar salt farming & improved water management in mangrove rice fields in Oio region, Guinea-Bissau. Uses Guérande expertise to improve producer livelihoods while preserving mangrove ecosystems & limiting climate change impacts.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Malizia Ocean Challenge
properties.description: Educational program teaching children about ocean-climate interconnection. Racing yacht Malizia III measures CO2 and ocean variables during global races (2022-2025), covering 70,000 nautical miles, contributing to carbon cycle research.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Building SeaBase: A Bioinformatic Infrastructure for Marine Genomes
properties.description: Creating SeaBase, an open bioinformatics platform integrating genome, transcriptome, and microbiome data for marine species to monitor ocean health and biodiversity through molecular analysis of organisms like coral, sponges, and fish.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Satellite Monitoring of High Sea Fisheries
properties.description: Satellite monitoring of tuna fisheries in high seas to assess closure impacts on stocks, legal framework for satellite data use in maritime law, and develop global monitoring model to combat illegal fishing and rebuild ocean ecosystems.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Restoration Techniques for Mediterranean Red Coral
properties.description: Developing red coral restoration protocol using sexual reproduction in artificial underwater caves at 30-40m depth. Testing larval settlement conditions in aquariums to counter IUCN-listed species decline in Mediterranean.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: ACCOBAMS Survey Initiative
properties.description: Pilot initiative establishing integrated monitoring of cetacean populations across Mediterranean/Black Sea. Synoptic survey combining visual observation and acoustic monitoring to improve conservation, create MPAs, integrate fishing activities.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Tracking the movements and status of marine top predators in the Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea
properties.description: Advancing ecological knowledge on elasmobranchs and seabirds to document conservation strategies. Tracking migration corridors, breeding and feeding areas of threatened species in Mediterranean and Black Sea.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Sustainable Seas in Mozambique
properties.description: Protecting whale sharks & manta rays in Inhambane Province through sustainable fishing practices & marine protected areas. Addresses 98% decline in manta sightings while ensuring livelihoods for local communities in biodiversity hotspot.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Dissemination of Innovative Experiences: Mangroves and Territories
properties.description: Builds capacity for sustainable mangrove management in Senegal, Guinea Bissau & Guinea through local governance, product valorization & conservation. Addresses deforestation via community engagement & transboundary cooperation.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Sea'ties
properties.description: Facilitates public policies & adaptation solutions for coastal cities threatened by rising sea levels. Analyzes responses across France, Pacific, West Africa, USA through regional workshops & stakeholder feedback (2021-2023).
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Conservation of the Mediterranean Monk Seal at the Wider Area of the National Marine Park of Alonissos Northern Sporades (NMPANS)
properties.description: Protecting endangered monk seals in NMPANS Greece through awareness campaigns, volunteer schemes, eco-friendly fishing tourism, scientific monitoring, and conservation measures to promote human-seal coexistence.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Creation and Management of the First Marine Protected Areas Network in Cambodia
properties.description: Creating Cambodia's first MPA network across Koh Rong, Koh Sdach & Northern Koh Kong. Protecting 68,485 ha of coral reefs, seagrass & mangroves through participatory management with local fishing communities by 2025.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: STOECHAS Project: Improving Knowledge of the Biodiversity of the Port-Cros National Park to Optimise its Management
properties.description: Biodiversity inventory of Port-Cros National Park's expanded territory (2012). Taxonomic surveys produce management recommendations for preservation, feeding national databases and awareness tools. 2021-2026.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Mediterranean Monk Seal Conservation Program at Cap Blanc
properties.description: Improving conservation status of endangered Mediterranean monk seals at Cabo Blanco peninsula, Mauritania through monitoring and protection efforts.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation - Monaco Branch

properties.title: Sustainable Management of Tuna Fisheries in the Solomon Islands
properties.description: Improving tuna fishery sustainability in Solomon Islands through fleet compliance monitoring, bycatch reduction training for fishermen, and technology-based data analysis to protect sea turtles, sharks, rays and marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Multiannual Monitoring of 3D Printed Artificial Reefs in the Marine Protected Area of the Larvotto
properties.description: 3D-printed Dolomite reefs immersed in Larvotto MPA (2017) to mimic natural habitats. 4-year study using hyperspectral camera monitored benthos colonization, comparing eco-material to concrete. Results showed colonization comparable to natural rock.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Hammerhead Shark (Sphyrna lewini) Nursery Areas in the Colombian Pacific Coast
properties.description: Protecting critically endangered hammerhead sharks by identifying nursery areas in Tribugá Gulf using acoustic telemetry, installing 4 receivers, and tagging 20 juvenile sharks to establish conservation strategies.

properties.title: Conservation of Monk Seal and its Habitats along Mugla and Antalya Provincial Coasts in Turkey
properties.description: Enhances AFBIKA coastal network for monk seal protection in Turkey. Monitors seal sightings, prevents illegal cave penetrations, mitigates human-seal interactions. Unites stakeholders for endangered species conservation along Mugla-Antalya coasts.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Creating a Protected Swimway for the Endangered Sharks of Galapagos
properties.description: Protecting migratory sharks & sea turtles between Galapagos & Cocos Islands through tagging studies & advocacy. Tagged 33 species to map migration routes. Led to Ecuador expanding marine reserve by 60,000 km² at COP26.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Survey of the Antarctic Ice Sheet Grounding Line
properties.description: Mapping Antarctic grounding line retreat via satellite to track ice loss & sea level rise. First comprehensive survey in 15 years of where land ice detaches into ocean, providing vital climate change data.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Local Community Involvement in Coral Reefs Reforestation in the Barú Peninsula Colombian Caribbean National Park
properties.description: Training local fishermen in coral restoration & ecotourism at Barú Peninsula to restore degraded reefs, reduce harmful fishing practices, create sustainable income through certified guide work with ecohotel partnership.
properties.funder: Fondation Prince Albert II de Monaco

properties.title: Ocean Acidification and Hypoxia Impacts on High Latitude Marine Coastal Ecosystems: The Case of the Beagle Channel
properties.description: Studies how glacier melt & CO2 cause acidification & hypoxia in Beagle Channel, affecting calcifiers & fish. Field/lab experiments + long-term monitoring system. Argentina-Chile collaboration on artisanal fisheries species.
properties.funder: Government Secretariat of Science, Technology and Productive Innovation - Argentina

properties.title: Edinburgh Ocean Leaders Program
properties.description: Why: Ocean at risk from extractive industries, pollution, overfishing. What: Leadership program for young professionals. How: Connect global young leaders with expert mentors. When: 2020-2022. Where: University of Edinburgh, UK

properties.title: Addressing the Shark Crisis: Reducing Demand for Shark Fin in Asian Market
properties.description: WWF expands shark fin demand reduction program to China & Thailand. Engages hotels, restaurants, e-commerce platforms using behavioral study. Tackles illegal trade, tourist consumption. 160+ venues banned shark fin since 2007.

properties.title: Supporting Research and Strengthening Knowledge of the Port-Cros National Park and Pelagos Sanctuary Territory
properties.description: Port-Cros National Park supports doctoral research to strengthen biodiversity knowledge across expanded marine/land territory (11 communes) and coordinates French Pelagos Sanctuary. Aims to boost fundamental/applied research.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Narwhal Translational Technologies Expedition
properties.description: Studies narwhal sensory abilities, especially electric field detection, in Arctic Canada. Combines scientific research with Inuit traditional knowledge to understand tusk function and climate adaptation.

properties.title: Securing Gyaros MPA Sustainability Through Pioneer Remote Surveillance System
properties.description: Protects Mediterranean Monk seal habitat on Gyaros island, Greece through remote surveillance system preventing illegal activities. Monitors breeding sites, posidonia beds, coralligenous formations. Builds on CYCLADES project since 2013.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Health Status for Saint-Laurent's Belugas
properties.description: GREMM studies St. Lawrence belugas via drone photogrammetry & necropsy to understand behavior, habitat, health. Aims to rescue stranded whales, identify threats, prevent extinction through public awareness & adoption program.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Preventing the Extinction of Penguins
properties.description: 18-month project across Southern Hemisphere (Antarctica, Falklands, South Africa, NZ) to track penguin populations, identify 12 new IBAs, restore habitat for Cape & antipode penguins, expand protected zones by 30km.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Académie de la Mer for a Sustainable Development of the Shark Fin Bay Coral Triangle
properties.description: Restoring biodiversity in Coral Triangle, Palawan Philippines through community marine protected areas, ending unsustainable fishing, physical reef restoration. Located in world's richest reef area with 80% coral species.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation - Monaco Branch

properties.title: From Science to Solutions: Ocean Acidification Impacts on Ecosystem Services - Case Studies on Coral Reefs
properties.description: Workshop bringing together natural & social scientists to study ocean acidification impacts on coral reef ecosystem services. Organized by CSM & IAEA, producing policy recommendations presented to Prince of Monaco.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Call for Small Projects geared towards Mediterranean MPAs
properties.description: MedPAN supports Mediterranean MPA managers with funding for 20 field projects (2017-2019). Focus: integrated coastal management, sustainable funding, climate change adaptation, sustainable tourism/fishing. Priority to replicable multi-MPA initiatives
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Building Resilience of Cambodia's Marine Resources and Coastal Communities
properties.description: Supports Cambodia's first Marine Fisheries Management Area in Koh Rong & Koh Sdach archipelagos. Implements IUU fishing surveillance, sustainable financing, climate adaptation for communities. Protects coral reefs, mangroves, seagrass.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: ACCOBAMS Survey Initiative - Cetacean Monitoring
properties.description: Establishes integrated monitoring of cetacean populations across Mediterranean/Black Sea. Synoptic surveys using ships, aircraft, passive acoustics. Improves conservation via MPAs, fishing integration. 2017-2022.
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Launching SIKU across the Canadian Arctic: An Inuit-driven platform for climate change resiliency and self-determination
properties.description: Inuit-led app/platform for Arctic communities to share environmental observations (ice thickness, tides, satellite data) for climate resilience. Co-developed by Arctic Eider Society with northern communities. Jan 2000, Canadian Arctic.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Mapping & Assessing Global Biodiversity Threats from Climate-Driven Sea Level Rise
properties.description: Assesses global threats to IUCN Red List species from sea level rise & coastal flooding through habitat submergence & human displacement. Improves elevation data, maps exposed areas under emission scenarios, calculates species range impacts.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Advancing a Network of Marine Protected Areas in the Arctic
properties.description: Advancing ecologically connected MPAs in Arctic Ocean. Bolstering resilience against warming, sea ice loss, ocean chemistry changes. Leveraging Arctic Council momentum, US/Canada commitments, Russian MPAs, high seas fishing agreement.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Bluefin Tuna in the Mediterranean Sea: Stock Management, Market Supply and Consumer Behaviour
properties.description: WWF project ensuring sustainable bluefin tuna management at MSY levels, promoting MSC certification for Mediterranean fisheries, improving supply chain traceability, and influencing consumer behavior in European and Japanese markets.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Satellite Monitoring of High Seas Fisheries
properties.description: Satellite surveillance study examining tuna fishery response to spatial closures in high seas. Legal assessment of satellite data for marine enforcement. Collaboration between Oxford Martin School and OceanMind to monitor MPAs.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Management of the Marine Protected Area of Mohéli
properties.description: Mohéli National Park protects marine & terrestrial habitats. Monitors marine life, establishes reserves, eliminates destructive fishing, implements sustainable fisheries, tracks climate impacts. 12 coastal villages participate.

properties.title: High-level Event on Climate-Induced Migration
properties.description: Oct 2015 conference in Kiribati with leaders from Kiribati, Tuvalu, Tokelau, Monaco. Signed joint environmental protection agreement. Focused on climate migration solutions, calling for global warming action & support for climate refugees.
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Monitoring of the Posidonia Meadow in Corsica
properties.description: Monitoring Posidonia seagrass meadows (55,230 ha) across 6 sites in Corsica using RSP and TEMPO networks. Tracks vitality, conservation status every 3 years. Assesses impacts from anchoring, trawling, piling.

properties.title: Aquaculture Sustainable Development in Madagascar
properties.description: Integrating community-based seaweed & sea cucumber aquaculture with locally-managed marine areas to reduce fishing pressure, enhance food security & protect coastal ecosystems in Madagascar through Blue Ventures-University partnership.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Expedition on the Step of Captain G. de Long in the Russian Arctic
properties.description: Eco-scientific Arctic expedition documenting climate change, following historic explorers' routes. Scientists & artists film rarely visited regions, dive on 1881 Jeannette shipwreck. Sep-Oct 2017.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Revue Marine et Océans
properties.description: Quarterly publication featuring Prince Albert II Foundation's ocean protection actions in 'Cahier de l'Environnement' section. Digital archives available on Foundation website.
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: WCRP-FPA2 Polar Challenge
properties.description: Deploy underwater gliders 2000km+ beneath Arctic/Antarctic ice to measure temperature, salinity, ice thickness. Revolutionize polar ocean observation for climate research, environmental protection, biodiversity, safety.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Coverage of the Second Preparatory Session on BBNJ
properties.description: UN PrepCom2 on marine biodiversity beyond national jurisdiction, Aug-Sep 2016, NYC. IISD provided information service to raise awareness of outcomes, ensuring transparent access to negotiations on conservation & sustainable use.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Vendicari Nature Reserve
properties.description: Establishing marine protected area in Sicily's Vendicari Reserve. Ship patrols prevent illegal fishing, pollution, turtle nest disturbance. Educational programs engage residents/tourists in coastal biodiversity conservation.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Proposed Introduction of Seahorses
properties.description: Institut Paul Ricard reintroduces 2 seahorse species (H. guttulatus & H. hippocampus) into Larvotto Reserve, Monaco. 10-month-old captive-bred seahorses released at 5-15m depth in Posidonia/Cymodocea beds. Monitoring tracks adaptation & offspring.

properties.title: 2016 Forum of Mediterranean MPAs
properties.description: Forum held Nov-Dec 2016 in Tangier, Morocco with 300 delegates from 35 countries. Reviewed MPA progress, updated roadmap to protect 10% of Mediterranean by 2020, produced Tangier Declaration addressing climate change and sustainable development.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Development and Management of Ponta do Ouro Partial Marine Reserve
properties.description: Protects turtles & marine resources in Ponta do Ouro reserve through sustainable management, research, community development, eco-tourism & UNESCO World Heritage nomination. Boosts resources, monitoring & local self-sufficiency.

properties.title: Advancing Conservation of the Arctic Marine
properties.description: NRDC develops international Arctic MPA network via Arctic Council. Enriches scientific data on biologically active areas, updates species maps, seeks UNESCO World Heritage nomination to protect Arctic marine ecosystems.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Investigation, Protection and Potential Growing of the Shellfish Palasture
properties.description: Study & protect Pinna Nobilis (fan mussel) in Kotor estuary, Montenegro. Research population in Posidonia meadows, develop conservation regulations, conduct comparative studies in Monaco/France/Spain, raise public awareness.

properties.title: Wild Touch Expeditions Antarctica
properties.description: Artists & scientists documented Antarctica's biodiversity & climate change impacts through films, exhibitions, books & e-learning. Laurent Ballesta, Vincent Munier & Christophe Barbraud created multimedia to educate public on polar threats.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: MPAs and Climate Change Island Adaptation
properties.description: IUCN develops adaptation reports for island territories to manage marine protected areas effectively against climate change impacts, analyzing current knowledge, future scenarios, and recommended MPA management procedures.
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Solar Arctic Passage
properties.description: First Northwest Passage crossing attempt using solar-powered kayaks. 3,000km expedition by Raphaël Domjan & Anne Quéméré to demonstrate solar energy potential in polar regions despite adverse weather.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: The Map to Paradise
properties.description: Documentary by Danielle Bryan & James Sherwood exploring underwater paradise, encouraging ocean protection. Features personalities protecting oceans, landscapes reviving hope through unparalleled images & stories. Mar-Dec 2017.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Are Mediterranean MPA efficient against warming effects
properties.description: Multidisciplinary study of coral species in 3 Mediterranean MPAs (Medes, Scandola, Zembra) developing innovative management methods based on genetics, physiology & positioning to improve conservation of corallogenic species against climate change
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Whale Shark Tagging with Satellite Telemetry in the Santuario de Fauna y Flora Malpelo
properties.description: Tagged 10 whale sharks with satellite trackers in Malpelo Sanctuary, Colombia to study migratory routes and congregation areas, generating data for national/international conservation measures in the Pacific.
properties.funder: Presidential Agency for International cooperation of Colombia

properties.title: The Ocean Solutions Initiative
properties.description: Evaluates solutions to mitigate climate change & ocean acidification impacts. Creates comprehensive list of mitigation, protection, adaptation & repair solutions with implementation procedures for scientists & climate negotiators.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Tara Corail - Coral Reefs Facing Global Changes
properties.description: Scientific expedition across Pacific coral reefs studying biodiversity, health, and resilience to climate change from genes to ecosystems, exploring resistance and adaptation of reefs remote from human disturbance.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Sanctuaire Marin National des Palaos
properties.description: Supporting Palau government to create large-scale marine sanctuary protecting tuna schools and 10% of ocean/coastal areas by 2020. Builds on existing 21 protected sanctuaries and shark sanctuary network.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Pirates des Abysses
properties.description: Transmedia environmental awareness project using app, comic & series to educate youth on ocean conservation & human impact on marine environment through digital media & fictional storytelling in Monaco
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: The Oceans 2015 Initiative: An Impact Scenario for COP 21
properties.description: Expert group translating GHG emissions trajectories into ocean impact scenarios for COP21 Paris. Assessed acidification & warming effects on marine ecosystems to inform climate negotiations & raise awareness.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation - Monaco Branch

properties.title: Operation Basking Shark
properties.description: Public observation program collecting sightings, photos from coast guards, fishermen to improve scientific knowledge of endangered basking shark distribution in Mediterranean Sea and implement conservation practices. Oct 2011-Jun 2015.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Organisation of a Conference on Aquatic Waste
properties.description: Conference on plastic pollution in Mediterranean (March 2015, Monaco). 200+ participants from 10 countries discussed solutions, leading to Monaco Declaration & BeMed Task Force creation for awareness & field actions.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Integrated and sustainable management of water resources

properties.title: Identifying Candidate Marine World Heritage Sites in the Arctic
properties.description: IUCN & partners evaluate Arctic ecologically significant areas against World Heritage criteria to identify candidate marine sites for enhanced protection, encouraging States to nominate them for formal designation.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Improving the performance of Mediterranean marine protected areas
properties.description: Why: gaps in MPA performance. What: quantitative synthesis of 20 Mediterranean MPAs. How: questionnaires, site visits analyzing organizational features. When: 2015-2017. Where: Mediterranean Sea
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Predicting Human Vulnerability to Ocean Acidification
properties.description: Integrated spatial assessment identifying global ocean acidification hotspots & vulnerable communities. Maps critical points where OA chemistry is extreme, organisms sensitive, or coastal communities dependent on marine resources.
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Towards International Regulation of the Exploitation of Off-Shore Energy
properties.description: Why: offshore oil accidents threaten marine environment. What: regulatory framework study. How: expert committee producing technical/legal report. When: 2012. Where: global focus, Arctic & West Africa regions.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Smithsonian Deep Reef Observation Project (DROP)
properties.description: Explores Caribbean coral reefs to 300m depth using manned submersible. Discovered 30+ new species of fish/invertebrates. Monitors temperature changes and reef sediments. Aims to document deep reef biodiversity comprehensively.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Marine Protected Areas: Understanding How Levels of Protection Mediate the Flow of Marine Ecosystem Services
properties.description: Study examining UK Marine Protected Areas protection levels, assessing ecosystem services flows, analyzing interdependence, determining benefits, and studying service supply across MPA networks to conserve habitats and species.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Publication of the Photographic Book on Mediterranean Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: 272-page photographic book promoting Mediterranean Marine Protected Areas across 15 countries. Showcases MPAs and historic sites to raise public awareness of their role in marine biodiversity conservation and sustainable resource management.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Promoting a High Seas Legal Regime for the Conservation of Biodiversity
properties.description: Campaign to ensure UN initiates negotiations for international legal instrument under UNCLOS enabling Marine Protected Areas on High Seas, following Rio+20 commitment. Coalition of 27 organizations targeting decision by Sept 2015.

properties.title: Which Aquaculture for Which Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: Why: Analyze aquaculture-MPA coexistence. What: Study relationship between aquaculture types (fish, molluscs, algae) and MPA categories. How: Analysis per IUCN management objectives. When: 2015-2016. Where: Worldwide MPAs.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: An alternative way of discovering the underwater fauna and flora of the Mediterranean
properties.description: Augmented reality guidebook for Mediterranean marine species. 150 species with 3D images via smartphone app. Interactive tool for citizen science data collection on marine biodiversity. Monaco-based project.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Develop and implement a responsible tourism campaign to protect Palau's extraordinary biodiversity
properties.description: Sustainable tourism campaign in Palau archipelago raising awareness about biodiversity fragility, minimizing environmental impact, monitoring tourism development, guaranteeing customer experience while maximizing benefits for local communities.

properties.title: Creating Cambodia's First Marine Fisheries Managed Area
properties.description: Establishing Cambodia's first Marine Fisheries Management Area in Koh Rong Archipelago to protect coral reefs, mangroves, and marine life while supporting sustainable livelihoods through capacity building and community engagement.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Tara Méditerranée
properties.description: Tara expedition studying plastic pollution impact in Mediterranean Sea (May-Nov 2014). Scientific research, public awareness, school visits, artist residencies. Promotes Marine Protected Areas development.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: The Crown Jewels
properties.description: Arctic Ocean ecosystem management project identifying biodiversity-rich areas, ensuring fishing compliance with protective measures, and fostering international scientific cooperation to establish marine protected area networks during critical Arctic
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Advancing Conservation of the Arctic Marine Environment
properties.description: NRDC advances Arctic marine protected areas network during US-Finland Arctic Council chairmanships (2015-2019). Ecosystem-based management to protect Arctic biodiversity facing climate change. Only tiny fraction protected.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Reducing vulnerability of coastal communities in northwestern Madagascar through the creation of marine protected areas
properties.description: Creating 2 MPAs covering 370,000ha in Nosy Be to protect marine ecosystems & support 4,000 people through sustainable livelihoods & community resource management against climate change impacts.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Call for Small Projects from MedPAN to Support Marine Protected Areas in the Mediterranean
properties.description: MedPAN supports Mediterranean MPA managers with funding for field projects. Why: improve MPA management. What: small grants for 28 projects. How: financial/technical support. When: 2011-2016. Where: Mediterranean Basin MPAs.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Deep-Sea Trench Landers
properties.description: Building autonomous underwater vehicles to explore hadal/abyssal zones in Western Pacific trenches. Collecting samples and photos of deep-sea biodiversity. First DOV completed Sept 2012, tested Oct 2012.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Phoenix Islands Protected Area
properties.description: Research expedition analyzing climate change effects on coral reef biodiversity in PIPA's remote reefs. Studies coral bleaching through sample analysis from 2012 expedition, marking start of 10-year research program in pristine area.

properties.title: Film: Une réserve, des hommes: quel avenir pour Scandola?
properties.description: Documentary film highlighting threats to Scandola Reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage marine protected area in Corsica created in 1975, now jeopardized by excessive media coverage and tourism pressure.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Book Atlas des pêcheries du monde
properties.description: Atlas documenting global marine fish catches, correcting flawed FAO data. Addresses fisheries crisis, food security & overfishing. Research by Sea Around Us project at UBC over 10 years.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Protection of Sea Turtles in the Ponta Ouro Partial Reserve
properties.description: Protecting endangered sea turtles in Ponta do Ouro Marine Protected Area, Mozambique. Combating population decline from pollution and illegal hunting. Supporting MPA development and UNESCO World Heritage candidacy for Lubombo reserve.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Sea Turtle Release Programme and Community Income Generating Activity (CIGA) for Coastal Villages
properties.description: Fishermen release accidentally caught sea turtles in exchange for net repair equipment, saving 1,500+ turtles/year. Eco-tourism funds community projects. Testing new nets to reduce bycatch in Kouilou Region, DR Congo.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation - Monaco Branch

properties.title: Ocean Acidification International Reference User Group
properties.description: Develop IOA-RUG to coordinate international ocean acidification research, capitalize on national programs, and communicate scientific progress to private sector. Based in Monaco under Ocean Acidification Association.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Dispersion, Migration and Connectivity of Osprey Populations
properties.description: Study osprey migration/dispersion in Mediterranean to assess connectivity between critically endangered populations (Corsica, Balearics, Morocco, Algeria). Track movements to inform conservation measures for this aquatic bird of prey.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Students on Ice
properties.description: Annual educational expedition to Arctic/Antarctic for Monaco students. Winners of photography/writing competition join 15-day polar trip with scientists to learn about climate change impacts on vulnerable polar ecosystems.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II Foundation, Monaco National Youth Education and Sports
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Time bombs beneath the sea
properties.description: Documentary on 1M tonnes of chemical weapons (mustard gas, nerve agents) dumped in oceans 1912-1972 by industrial/military regimes. Examines current dangers to ecosystem and human health from WWI, WWII, Cold War ammunition.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Integrated and sustainable management of water resources

properties.title: Arctic Regional Management Approaches
properties.description: International workshop uniting economic & scientific experts to identify sustainable management measures for Antarctic ecosystems, determine ecologically important areas, and provide policy recommendations.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: State and Trends of the Mediterranean Marine Protected Areas System
properties.description: Study assessing state and trends of Mediterranean MPA system in 2012. MedPAN network promotes exchange between Mediterranean MPAs to improve management efficiency across the region.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Exhibition Méditerranée: Splendide, Fragile, Vivante
properties.description: Exhibition showcasing Mediterranean biodiversity (10% of marine species in <1% ocean surface) & threats: pollution, overfishing, coastal development. Raises awareness of this fragile sea's exceptional fauna/flora.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: The Polar Bear
properties.description: Scientific symposium & exhibition on polar bears, Arctic sea ice loss & climate change impacts. Experts assessed species status, habitat threats & human interactions. Public awareness event in Monaco opened by Prince Albert II.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Ocean North Campaign: Protecting the Arctic
properties.description: Campaign to designate Lancaster Sound as National Marine Conservation Area, prohibiting undersea mining, offshore oil, limiting industrial fishing. Protects narwhals, belugas, bowhead whales in nutrient-rich Arctic waters.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Mediterranean Coral Response to Global Change (MEDCORAL)
properties.description: Study of ocean acidification and warming effects on deep-water Mediterranean corals. Research on unique deep-sea ecosystems to predict environmental changes and propose preservation solutions for fragile coral habitats.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Community Marine Protected Area at Helen Reef: Designing a Long-term Sustainable Financing Mechanism
properties.description: CI supports Hatohobei community in managing Helen Reef atoll as MPA through marine conservation agreement with direct incentives. Designing trust fund mechanism within Micronesia Conservation Trust for long-term financing.

properties.title: Tara Ocean Polar Circle
properties.description: Study Arctic marine ecosystems & climate change impacts. Tara ship sailed Arctic Ocean May-Nov 2013, researching polar biodiversity, plastic pollution, & pollutants. Identified fragile areas, promoted protective measures for fishing.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Monk Seal Conservation Promoted Through the Participatory Ecosystem-Based Management in the Aegean Sea
properties.description: Protecting Mediterranean monk seals (450-510 remaining) at Gyaros Island through Marine Protected Area establishment, ecosystem-based management, and fishermen engagement to reduce threats from fishing interactions and habitat degradation.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Kalabia Initiative on Environmental Education
properties.description: Floating educational centre 'Kalabia' sails to 100+ villages in Raja Ampat to teach marine conservation to children and young adults, rallying local population to preserve their environment through educational programmes.

properties.title: Ross Sea Creation of a Marine Protected Area
properties.description: Lobbying CCAMLR to establish MPA covering Ross Sea continental shelf/slope (2% Southern Ocean). Multi-channel campaign targeting resistant countries (Russia, China) to protect biodiversity-rich Antarctic waters.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Tara Oceans
properties.description: French expedition analyzing diversity of coral ecosystems & marine plankton (viruses to metazoans) across global oceans. International team of oceanographers, biologists, ecologists studying marine biodiversity since 2009.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Identifying Potential Marine Protected Areas in South Georgia
properties.description: Using birds & marine predators as indicators to identify & classify biodiversity hotspots in South Georgia & Scotia Sea waters to define management approaches for future marine protected areas in Southern Ocean.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Tropicalization of the Mediterranean Sea
properties.description: Why: Track climate warming effects. What: Monitor warm/cold water species, mass mortalities. How: 20+ research teams, satellite data, temperature loggers. When: 2008-2014. Where: Mediterranean basin-wide.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: Evaluation of the impact of climate change on king penguins by a biologging system
properties.description: Why: Monitor climate change effects on penguins. What: GPS/biologgers on king penguins. How: Non-disruptive tracking of seasonal/inter-annual environmental variations. When: Jun 2009-Apr 2012. Where: Crozet, sub-Antarctica
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation
properties.category: Study on climate change and its effects

properties.title: The Protection of Endangered Albatross and Petrel Species in the South Indian Ocean
properties.description: Modeling albatross/petrel sensitivity to climate change & fisheries in Southern Ocean. Analyzing distribution data to suggest offshore conservation measures & marine protected areas for critically endangered seabirds.

properties.title: Conservation of the Toliara Reef Complex
properties.description: WWF project to establish marine protected area in Toliara Reef Complex, Madagascar. Protects barrier reefs, mangroves, lagoons. Addresses local socio-economic pressures. Builds on 2005 initiatives for sustainable marine resource use.

properties.title: The Bluefin Tuna - Save the Mediterranean Bluefin Tuna from Ecological Extinction
properties.description: Protecting endangered Mediterranean bluefin tuna through sustainable fishing, DNA labeling, tagging research, establishing high seas sanctuaries, and working with ICCAR for quota compliance. Location: Mediterranean Basin & East Atlantic.
properties.funder: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: 800 young people from Marseilles social centers will discover marine environment
properties.description: CMA CGM initiative enabling 800 youth from Marseilles social centers to discover and learn about the marine environment through educational programs in the Mediterranean coastal city.

properties.title: Ending Illegal Fishing Project
properties.description: Pew worked 12+ years building global systems to combat illegal fishing through government partnerships, enforcement, and international agreements. Addressed unreported catches, illegal gear, unlicensed fishing. Merged 2019.

properties.title: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - Kermadec Islands
properties.description: Establishing large-scale MPA around Kermadec Rangitāhua region (1,000km NE of New Zealand) to protect unique underwater volcanoes, ocean trench, marine life & honor Maori cultural significance. Awaiting Parliamentary debate since 2010s.
properties.funder: The Pew Charitable Trusts and Dona Bertarelli

properties.title: Conserving Life in Canada's Oceans
properties.description: Protected Canada's Atlantic, Pacific, Arctic ocean biodiversity through marine protected areas, Arctic safeguards, fisheries conservation. Partnered with Indigenous communities, scientists, government. Ended 2023, continued as Conservation Canada.

properties.title: South Georgia and South Sandwich Islands Marine Protection
properties.description: Enhancing marine protections around South Georgia & South Sandwich Islands to protect world's largest concentration of marine species, including 95% of Antarctic fur seals, 100M seabirds, whales in nutrient-rich Antarctic waters.

properties.title: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - Eastern Tropical Pacific Marine Corridor
properties.description: Supporting transboundary marine protections across Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Panama. Creating 500,000 sq km biosphere reserve connecting MPAs to protect migratory species, sharks, turtles, whales in biodiversity hotspot.
properties.funder: The Pew Charitable Trusts and Dona Bertarelli

properties.title: Arctic Ocean International
properties.description: Treaty closing Central Arctic Ocean to commercial fishing for 16+ years. Protects ecosystem while scientists study changing environment and marine life to determine if sustainable fishing possible. Signed 2018, enforced 2021.

properties.title: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - Revillagigedo
properties.description: Created 148,087 km² Revillagigedo Archipelago National Park off Mexico in 2017. Protected 4 volcanic islands with 366 fish species, 28 shark species, sea turtles, whales. Provided technical support for reserve establishment.
properties.funder: The Pew Charitable Trusts and Dona Bertarelli

properties.title: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - French Southern Lands and Antarctic Territories
properties.description: Supporting expansion of marine protections in TAAF to preserve wilderness areas hosting largest concentrations of marine birds/mammals including albatross, bigeye tuna, sharks, whales, penguins in Indian and Southern oceans.
properties.funder: The Pew Charitable Trusts and Dona Bertarelli

properties.title: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - Ascension Island
properties.description: Protecting 443,000 sq km of Ascension Island's waters in South Atlantic. Safeguards endemic species, green turtles, seabirds. UK committed to MPA designation March 2019. Supports fisheries and tourism.
properties.funder: The Pew Charitable Trusts and Dona Bertarelli

properties.title: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy Northern Mariana Islands
properties.description: Working with Northern Mariana communities to improve management and enhance protections for Mariana Trench Marine National Monument, established 2009. Includes Islands, Volcanic, and Trench units protecting rare marine life.
properties.funder: The Pew Charitable Trusts and Bertarelli Foundation

properties.title: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy French Polynesia
properties.description: Collaborated with Austral & Marquesas Islands communities to establish large-scale marine reserves in French Polynesia's 5M km² EEZ. Proposed 1M km² Austral reserve & 430K km² Marquesas reserve, working with locals, scientists & govt since 2013.
properties.funder: The Pew Charitable Trusts and Dona Bertarelli

properties.title: Protecting Antarctica's Southern Ocean
properties.description: Establishing large-scale marine protected areas around Antarctica through CCAMLR to protect unique species and ecosystems threatened by climate change. Network of MPAs to safeguard penguins, krill, and endemic wildlife.

properties.title: Pew Marine Fellows Program
properties.description: Global fellowship supporting 7 leading scientists in marine conservation research. Projects span coral restoration, fisheries management, plastic pollution, kelp forests, harmful algal blooms, seafood traceability, and international fisheries law.

properties.title: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy New Caledonia
properties.description: Advocating for highly protected marine reserve in New Caledonia's Natural Park of the Coral Sea to preserve 1.3M km² EEZ with 1,700+ fish species and 473 coral species for future generations.
properties.funder: The Pew Charitable Trusts and Dona Bertarelli

properties.title: Conservation Canada
properties.description: Pew works with Indigenous leaders and policymakers to conserve ocean areas and boreal forest in Canada, protecting marine and terrestrial habitats through partnerships like Enduring Earth and Blue Nature Alliance.

properties.title: Reducing Harmful Fisheries Subsidies
properties.description: Advocates for WTO fisheries subsidies agreement ratification to reduce $22B annual harmful subsidies promoting overfishing. Works with members, scientists to reform payments enabling unsustainable industrial fishing globally.

properties.title: Seabed Mining Project
properties.description: Advocates for environmental safeguards to protect deep ocean ecosystems from seabed mining. Focuses on International Seabed Authority regulations for mining beyond national jurisdiction. Protects biodiversity in deep-sea habitats.

properties.title: Ocean Governance
properties.description: Pew works with governments and stakeholders to develop global ocean policies addressing fisheries subsidies, high seas protection, 30x30 biodiversity targets, and deep-sea mining regulation through international cooperation.

properties.title: International Fisheries
properties.description: Combating overfishing and IUU fishing globally. Works with governments, RFMOs, and partners to improve fisheries management, protect marine biodiversity, and ensure sustainable fishing through science-based strategies.

properties.title: Orpheus: The First Steps Towards Exploring Ocean Worlds
properties.description: Deep sea vehicle deployment to Northeast Canyons and Seamounts Marine National Monument. Testing otherworldly exploration technology for ocean floor research in Fall 2018.

properties.title: Protecting Ocean Life on the High Seas
properties.description: UN treaty adopted June 2023 to create high seas marine protected areas network. Pew partners with governments, scientists to implement treaty, establish first MPAs by 2030, protect biodiversity, combat climate change and overfishing.

properties.title: Hunting for the Humboldt Squid
properties.description: Marine expedition tracking Humboldt squid behavior and distribution in Chilean waters to understand their ecology and role in ocean ecosystems through scientific observation and documentation.

properties.title: Mission Antarctica
properties.description: Antarctic marine research expedition exploring ocean ecosystems, marine life, and environmental conditions in Antarctic waters through scientific investigation and storytelling to drive ocean conservation.

properties.title: The Maiden Voyage: Illuminating The Red Sea
properties.description: OceanX's maiden mission investigating how species in the Red Sea thrive in extreme conditions where others would die. Oceanographers and scientists explored unique marine adaptations in this challenging environment.
properties.funder: Bloomberg Philanthropies' Vibrant Oceans Initiative, Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Mission: Galapagos
properties.description: OceanX reveals the Galapagos Archipelago to the world over a century after Darwin's Beagle journey. Partnership with WHOI and Atlantic Productions to explore and document marine ecosystems.

properties.title: United Arab Emirates (UAE) 2023
properties.description: Multidisciplinary survey of UAE waters using eDNA, seafloor mapping, and submersibles to establish biodiversity baselines for MPA design and sustainable fisheries management in Abu Dhabi and Fujairah.

properties.title: Azores 2023
properties.description: OceanX explored Azores seamounts, mapped 5,000 sq km seafloor, conducted 46 ROV dives, collected 38 eDNA samples. Data informed 3 MPA designations (Princess Alice Bank, Dom João de Castro, Pico Island) in Oct 2024, protecting 287,000 sq km.

properties.title: Environmental DNA in Ocean Exploration
properties.description: Using DNA to crack the case of the deep sea. Partnership with Gloucester Marine Genomics Institute to analyze environmental DNA samples for ocean exploration and marine life detection in Massachusetts waters.

properties.title: New Depths, New Discoveries - 2024 Annual Report
properties.description: OceanX 2024 exploration missions across Indonesia, Malaysia, Seychelles, and Singapore. Marine research and discovery expeditions documenting ocean life and ecosystems through science and storytelling.

properties.title: Tagging a Bluntnose Six-Gill Shark
properties.description: Deep-sea shark tagging project to study bluntnose six-gill shark behavior and movement patterns through scientific tracking technology in ocean environments.

properties.title: Brine Pools
properties.description: Exploring underwater brine pools - unique extreme environments on the ocean floor that host specialized marine life and provide insights into deep-sea ecosystems and astrobiology research.

properties.title: Red Sea 2022 Expedition
properties.description: OceanX explored Red Sea mesophotic reefs, brine pools, canyons. Discovered new species, shark behaviors, coral-algae symbiosis. Mapped 69,254 sq km seafloor. Partnered with Saudi researchers to inform conservation and fisheries.

properties.title: Seychelles 2024 Deep-Sea Exploration and Marine Conservation
properties.description: Deep-sea mapping & biodiversity research in Seychelles using ROVs, submersibles, BRUVS, eDNA. Mapped 22,555 km² seafloor, conducted deepest dives (4,603m), trained local scientists. Supports MPA planning & fisheries management. Jan-Feb 2024.

properties.title: Search For The Giant Squid
properties.description: Expert team captures first live images of giant squid in deep waters off Japan's Ogasawara Archipelago. Partnership with Japan's National Museum of Nature and Science to document this elusive deep-sea species.

properties.title: Coral Core Drilling
properties.description: Mission to understand climate change impact on coral reef ecosystems in Western Pacific Warm Pool through core drilling. Partnership with WHOI in Micronesia, Fall 2012.

properties.title: Sperm Whale Research
properties.description: Groundbreaking complete study of Kaikoura sperm whales. Partnership with Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution to research sperm whale populations and behavior in New Zealand coastal waters.

properties.title: Creatures of Light: Biofluorescence
properties.description: Marine biofluorescence research project studying light-emitting organisms. OceanX explores ocean creatures that glow, documenting and analyzing biofluorescent marine life to advance scientific understanding.

properties.title: Indonesian Coastal Communities Lead Efforts to Protect Thriving Oceans
properties.description: West Papua communities establish marine protected areas, seasonal closures, and local patrols to protect coral reefs and fisheries. Women's groups manage resources, earning funds for education while preserving traditional fishing grounds.

properties.title: New Marine Sanctuary in Galapagos Islands
properties.description: 39,000 sq km no-take zone around Darwin & Wolf islands protects world's highest shark concentrations, sea turtles, whales. Supports dive tourism. Created 2016 with CI technical assistance after decade of Foundation support.

properties.title: Gulf of California Fishing Refuges Network
properties.description: Niparajá creates no-take fishing refuges with local fishermen in Gulf of California. 30% more biomass in refuges after 5 years. Expanding model nationally through policy development. Protects small-scale fisheries and communities.

properties.title: Protect Habitat
properties.description: Oceana campaigns to protect ocean habitats from destructive fishing like bottom trawling. Works toward 30% ocean protection by 2030. Has protected 4M+ sq miles of habitat across coastal ecosystems globally.

properties.title: Transparency in Fisheries - Combating Illegal Fishing
properties.description: Global campaign to stop illegal, unreported, unregulated fishing through transparency & traceability. Launched Global Fishing Watch in 2016 to track 80,000 vessels in near-real time, deterring illegal activity worldwide.

properties.title: Responsible Aquaculture Campaign
properties.description: Campaign to ensure responsible ocean-based fish farming globally. Addresses seafloor habitat damage, pollution from pesticides/waste, harmful algal blooms, fish escapes, and sea lice outbreaks documented since 2000.

properties.title: Responsible Fishing Campaign
properties.description: Oceana campaigns for science-based policies to stop overfishing in countries controlling 25% of global wild fish catch. Works to increase fisheries with management plans and catch limits to rebuild ocean abundance.

properties.title: Feed the World
properties.description: Oceana partners with small-scale fishing communities to protect livelihoods, increase local fish access, and amplify their voices in policy. Addresses illegal fishing, limited management, and climate impacts on fisheries.

properties.title: Climate and Energy - Protecting Oceans from Offshore Drilling
properties.description: Oceana campaigns to stop offshore drilling expansion, protect 75,000 miles of US & Belize coastline, promote offshore wind, rebuild fisheries, reduce single-use plastics. Targets 30% of oil/gas production from offshore areas.

properties.title: Deep-Sea Coral Gardens Protected in U.S. State of California
properties.description: Sur Ridge off Monterey, CA protected from bottom fishing. Home to deep-sea corals, rockfish, sea stars. New regulations support coral research and restoration. Victory achieved Dec 2025 via Oceana campaign.

properties.title: Deep-Sea Mining Moratorium and Ban Campaign
properties.description: Oceana advocates for complete ban on mining hydrothermal vents/cobalt crusts and moratorium on polymetallic nodule mining until robust regulations exist. Protects fragile deep-sea ecosystems from irreparable damage in high seas areas.

properties.title: Oceana Plastics Campaign - Reducing Single-Use Plastic Pollution
properties.description: Oceana campaigns to reduce 33B lbs annual ocean plastic by passing policies eliminating 1.46M metric tons single-use plastics by 2033, targeting production at source through refillable systems globally.

properties.title: Refillables Campaign
properties.description: Oceana campaigns for major beverage companies to increase refillable bottles to combat ocean plastic pollution. 21-34B plastic bottles enter oceans yearly. 10% increase in refillables by 2030 could eliminate 1T single-use bottles.

properties.title: U.S. State of California Approves Pop-Up Gear to Reduce Whale Entanglements
properties.description: California approved ropeless pop-up gear for Dungeness crab fishing (Apr 1-Jul 15) to protect humpback whales from entanglement. Oceana campaigned for years, testing whale-safe alternatives to conventional vertical line gear.

properties.title: Protect Species - Reduce Bycatch and Save Endangered Ocean Wildlife
properties.description: Oceana campaigns to protect endangered ocean species by reducing bycatch from fishing gear. Banned shark fin trade in US/Canada. Protects whales, dolphins, sea turtles, sharks. 75+ victories won globally.

properties.title: Amazon Plastic Packaging Reduction Campaign
