properties.title: Le Guide des Coraux de Guadeloupe
properties.description: Coral reef awareness guide for Guadeloupe. 24-page publication on coral ecology, threats, protection. 20,000 copies distributed to 110 local businesses. 85% of reefs degraded. Includes species ID sheets.

properties.title: Les Iles Éparses, sentinelles de l'évolution de l'océan (ISEO)
properties.description: Study & protect Iles Eparses ecosystems (reefs, mangroves, seagrass) via sentinel stations. Monitor climate change impacts on 800km² reefs, 725ha mangroves, 40km² seagrass. Partners: CNRS, Ifremer, CEDRE.

properties.title: Un Œil sur le Corail
properties.description: Citizen science network monitoring coral bleaching in French Polynesia. Trains locals (fishers, tourism workers) to detect bleaching, diseases, invasive species. 3 annual trainings, web/app development, data analysis.

properties.title: A la découverte des mangroves calédoniennes
properties.description: Improve educational trail in Touho mangrove, New Caledonia. Install walkways, communication tools, visitor exchange space. Protect 11 mangrove species across 1km trail. Preserve UNESCO heritage coastal ecosystem.

properties.title: Préservons la Mangrove de Guyane
properties.description: Protect French Guiana's mangroves through education. 30 classes, 12 guided nature tours, 3 teacher trainings. Shares scientific knowledge on mangrove ecosystems and carbon balance to students and public.

properties.title: Act4Reefs - Super Coraux
properties.description: Developing climate-resistant 'super corals' via asexual reproduction in nurseries at Moorea, French Polynesia. Creating cryo-preserved coral bank. 1500 cuttings, 2 nurseries installed, 15 people trained.

properties.title: Ensemble pour la mangrove de Mayotte
properties.description: Mangrove conservation in Majicavo Koropa, Koungou. Cleanup operations, waste monitoring, ecological health studies. 13.5 ha cleaned, 400 people involved, 6 cleanups, 3 crab burrow surveys. Local community engagement.

properties.title: Programme Animlagon en Nouvelle-Calédonie
properties.description: Educational program for New Caledonia youth about UNESCO-listed coral reefs. Scientists & teachers deliver 2-hour sessions on reef biodiversity & conservation. 50 animations reached 1,500 students in 9 months since 2008.

properties.title: Jeu Pictum - Educational Marine Species Recognition Game
properties.description: Interactive AI game for identifying 2328 marine species in New Caledonia. Includes underwater photography, app development, 65 school interventions across 3 provinces, and aquarium deployment to educate 1300+ people.

properties.title: Coup de pousse pour la mangrove martiniquaise
properties.description: Restore 5,448m² of degraded mangroves in Martinique by planting 6,000 mangrove trees (4 species). Includes environmental study, local training, and awareness campaigns to protect associated ecosystems (seagrass, reefs).

properties.title: Merci-cor
properties.description: Digital tool to quantify ecological impacts of coastal developments on coral reefs. Helps project developers avoid, reduce, compensate losses. Developed by Montpellier University. Applied in Mayotte airport extension.

properties.title: 10 000 enfants pour les coraux
properties.description: Traveling coral reef exhibition across New Caledonia to educate 10,000 children and communities about coral biodiversity. Reaches remote tribes, collects citizen proposals for reef preservation. Operated by Pala Dalik association.

properties.title: Formation des animateurs terrain
properties.description: Training program for New Caledonia volunteers in environmental education. 36h core curriculum + thematic modules on reefs, forests, invasive species. Equips 12 people/year to preserve exceptional ecosystems.

properties.title: Des Récifs et des Hommes
properties.description: Citizen science monitoring of 9 coral reefs in New Caledonia's Grand Sud. Trained volunteers use standardized protocols to assess reef health, tracking target species. Engages local communities since 2013.

properties.title: Zones Humides Educatives
properties.description: Students manage wetlands in French overseas territories (Guadeloupe, Martinique, Mayotte, Réunion) through field trips, cleanups, and awareness events to protect mangroves and tropical biodiversity.
properties.funder: Fondation de la Mer / Pôle-Relais Zones Humides Tropicales

properties.title: Réseau d'Observation des Mangroves (ROM)
properties.description: Citizen science mobile app to protect mangroves in French overseas territories. Users report threats, observe species, provide data to managers. Training, awareness, app development. Covers Antilles, Guyana, Mayotte, New Caledonia, Wallis-Futuna, Pol

properties.title: Protégeons la mangrove de Guyane
properties.description: Protect French Guiana mangroves through education, training, monitoring. Targets students, managers, volunteers. Uses ROM app for participatory surveillance. 53,347 ha mangroves, 650 mobilized, nursery for marine life.

properties.title: Mangroves Urbaines Oasis de Biodiversité
properties.description: Restoring 500m of mangroves along Rivière Monsieur in Volga-Plage, Martinique. Combines ecological restoration, community education, and social inclusion through cleanup, replanting, and eco-tours.

properties.title: Restaurer les coraux préférés des poissons-demoiselles Année 1
properties.description: Restoring Acropora cervicornis coral in Martinique via coral gardening. Underwater nurseries with dome structures. Protects juvenile fish, coastlines. Started 2015. 40km² repopulated, 9 nursery domes created.

properties.title: Investing in Coral Reef and the Blue Economy (ICRBE) - Fiji
properties.description: Catalyzing change in Fijian coral reefs through private/public investment, developing bankable projects with grants and capital. Targets 45K ha reef conservation, $50M+ investment, benefiting 70K community members.
properties.funder: Global Fund for Coral Reefs, UN Joint SDG Fund

properties.title: CONNECT'Iles - CONstructioN Eclairée et Concertée de la gesTion des Iles
properties.description: Protects 7 islets near Nouméa from human impact through participatory management: vegetation restoration, waste collection, ecological monitoring, and user awareness. 56ha with 20km reefs, 50+ native plants, 10+ seabird species.

properties.title: Restaurons les mangroves - Phase 2
properties.description: Mangrove restoration in Mayotte & Madagascar. Replanting, training volunteers, waste management, erosion prevention. Involves local communities for sustainable coastal protection & biodiversity. 15 Ha protected.

properties.title: Cool the Reef
properties.description: Cooling coral reefs in French Polynesia using deep-sea water (900m depth) at 14°C from hotel SWAC systems. Pilot at The Brando Hotel, Tetiaroa atoll. Creates biodiversity conservation zones. Studies thermodynamics & ecosystem impact.

properties.title: Gulf of Aqaba Resilient Reefs Programme
properties.description: Catalyze private investment in reef-positive enterprises to protect Aqaba's climate-resilient coral reefs through blended finance, sustainable management, and blue economy innovation in ecotourism and aquaculture.

properties.title: Indonesia Coral Reef Conservation Programme
properties.description: TeKSI & KORALESTARI programmes protect 408K ha of coral reefs in Coral Triangle through MPA financing, sustainable tourism, seaweed mariculture, reef-positive enterprises. Targets $128M+ investment, benefits 110K people by 2030.

properties.title: Maldives Coral Reef Conservation
properties.description: Coral reef conservation in Addu & Fuvahmulah Atolls UNESCO Biosphere Reserves. UNDP convenes with Ministry of Tourism/Environment, local councils, marine research institutes for reef protection & sustainable development.

properties.title: Kenya and Tanzania Coral Reef Conservation
properties.description: Miamba Yetu programme protects climate-resilient coral reefs in Kenya-Tanzania TBCA through reef-positive businesses, ecotourism, sustainable fisheries. Targets 104K+ ha coral conservation, $70M investment, 51K beneficiaries by 2030.

properties.title: Parley for the Oceans - Global Ocean Plastic Upcycling
properties.description: Global network removing 1M+ kg marine plastic annually from coral reef areas, upcycling debris into premium materials. Partners with communities, brands to end ocean plastic pollution cycle.

properties.title: Mesoamerican Reef Region
properties.description: MAR+Invest programme launched 2022 to develop enterprises protecting 60+ coral species. GFCR invests in Carbonwave to transform sargassum into biomaterials, restoring ocean health in Caribbean reef region.

properties.title: Micronesia Region Coral Reef Conservation Programme
properties.description: Sustainable blue economy investments supporting 50% marine resource management across FSM, RMI, and Palau. Focuses on ecotourism, sustainable fisheries, aquaculture, waste/water management. Builds on Micronesia Challenge foundation.

properties.title: Mamuhunan sa mga MPAs programme (Responsible Investment in MPAs)
properties.description: 8-year project enhancing 80+ MPAs financial sustainability through reef-positive businesses (ecotourism, aquaculture, blue carbon). Regenerates 1.5M ha coral reefs in North Mindoro & NE Palawan, impacting 250k fishers. 2022-2030.

properties.title: Coral Vita Restoration as a Service (RaaS) - Ecotourism-Based Coral Farming
properties.description: Land-based coral farm in Freeport grows climate-resilient corals for reef restoration. Revenue via RaaS, ecotourism, sponsorships. Uses microfragmentation, assisted evolution, BrainCoral tech for tourism, fisheries, coastal protection.

properties.title: Gutpela Solwara, Gutpela Bisnis - Papua New Guinea Blue Economy
properties.description: Develops Blue Investment Strategy & Enterprise Incubation Facility in Kimbe Bay & Louisiade Archipelago to create sustainable livelihoods, protect Coral Triangle reefs, and empower women-led SMEs in marine conservation.

properties.title: Elizabeth Harbour Conservation Partnership (EHCP)
properties.description: Eco-friendly mooring field in Elizabeth Harbour, Bahamas protecting seagrass & coral from anchor damage. 64 moorings installed, expanding by 40 more. Generates revenue through fees, transitioning to hybrid finance model.

properties.title: Fundación Faro Nautilus
properties.description: Converts sargassum & organic waste into biofertilizer using biological chambers. Prevents beach pollution, reduces emissions. Partners with hotels, communities. Creates jobs, supports women entrepreneurs in MAR region.

properties.title: ASH Limited - Reef-Safe Cosmetics Production
properties.description: Belizean social enterprise producing reef-safe cosmetics from organic aloe vera to prevent coral bleaching from harmful chemicals in imported sunscreens. Addresses marine conservation through sustainable alternatives.

properties.title: Empowering Women in Reef-Dependent Communities through Seaweed Culture in the Bar Reef Seascape of Sri Lanka
properties.description: Seaweed farming empowers women in Sri Lanka's Bar Reef area, reducing fishing pressure on coral reefs. Kappaphycus cultivation provides income in 45-50 days, linking communities to carrageenan markets while supporting reef conservation.

properties.title: Kunawa Getaway Beach Site
properties.description: Community eco-tourism at Lelehudi's Kunawa Point funding reef stewardship, mangrove restoration & monitoring through visitor revenue. Upgrading infrastructure, nursery & monitoring kits via US$46,866 grant.

properties.title: Ocean Gardener
properties.description: Indonesia-based NGO founded 2016, operates first legal commercial coral mariculture farm. Educates communities, protects & restores reefs via farming. 7 farms in Bali, Sumbawa, Madura, Java. CITES-certified sustainable coral trade.

properties.title: King Crab Restorative Mariaculture
properties.description: Caribbean King Crab mariaculture to control macroalgae overgrowth on Mesoamerican Reef while generating income for fishers and MPAs. Integrates crabs into coral restoration programs across Mexico, Belize, and Honduras.

properties.title: Bayside Cooperative Society
properties.description: Solar cold-storage & ice facility in Milne Bay cuts fish spoilage, stabilizes prices, raises fisher incomes, eases reef pressure through order-based sales. Women participate in processing/sales.

properties.title: Connas Trading
properties.description: Solar cold storage & ice-making in Kimbe Bay strengthens fisheries, cuts spoilage, trains 10 fishers in sustainable practices across 4 villages. Woman co-founded, supports 14 jobs, reduces reef pressure through better value chain.

properties.title: Biorock Indonesia
properties.description: Coral reef rehabilitation using Biorock technology across 16 sites in 8 Indonesian provinces. Programs include Scholar Reef for students, public tours, and shore protection. Restored 200km² coral and 5km beach since 2015.

properties.title: Nuli Sapi Retreat
properties.description: Community eco-lodge on Logea Island channeling tourism into marine stewardship. US$47,705 grant funds kitchen, bungalow & training in eco-hospitality & reef-safe fishing. Exploring formal LMMA in gwala no-take area.

properties.title: Sea2Carbon
properties.description: Climate-tech venture transforming invasive sargassum seaweed into biostimulants, carbon-rich materials & clean water via portable biorefineries. Targets Caribbean sargassum blooms, creating economic opportunities for coastal communities.

properties.title: Ocean World of Sound
properties.description: WOS Solutions uses passive acoustic monitoring, scientific communication, and sustainable tourism to generate accessible reef health data while engaging communities in marine-coastal ecosystem protection.

properties.title: Del Puerto al Huerto
properties.description: Transforms fish waste from coastal communities into organic fertilizers. Promotes circular economy, reduces overfishing impacts, supports coastal restoration. Community gardens create alternative livelihoods through vegetable sales.

properties.title: Saving Our Sharks
properties.description: Fishers' cooperative in Isla Mujeres transitioning from shark fishing to sustainable tourism. Offers snorkeling, diving, photo safaris & education. MAR+Invest 2025 program participant.

properties.title: tideMéxico
properties.description: Circular economy initiative collecting marine plastic for reusable products, operating coastal Eco-Hubs with waste collection, clean-ups, and H2OLA Water stations addressing pollution and water scarcity in Mexico.

properties.title: Caribbean Reef Guardians
properties.description: Coral reef restoration in Roatán, Honduras via nurseries, biobank, education center. Hybrid funding: adoptions, eco-tourism, courses, grants. Trains divers/youth, partners schools/dive centers for community-led conservation.

properties.title: MAR Wisdom Center (CEMarin)
properties.description: Blue economy hub at Mesoamerican Reef combining coral/mangrove nurseries, community tourism at Río Dulce, and regenerative business incubation. Delivers reef restoration, coastal protection, biodiversity conservation.

properties.title: CORUA Reef-Safe Sunscreen
properties.description: Mexican company producing reef-safe sunscreen to protect coral reefs. Manufactures biodegradable products, distributes in coastal communities, and runs educational campaigns with NGOs and schools.

properties.title: Implementation of a Material Recovery and Recycling Center in Providencia and Santa Catalina Islands
properties.description: Waste management project preventing marine pollution through recycling center, collection routes, and education in Providencia. Protects coral reefs, creates jobs, supports circular economy and eco-tourism.

properties.title: LionFish Gem
properties.description: Raizal enterprise transforms invasive lionfish into artisanal jewelry in San Andrés, Colombia. Empowers women as producers while protecting coral reefs through increased lionfish harvesting and circular economy principles.

properties.title: Plastic Waste Transformation for Coral Reef Conservation and Community Capacity Building in San Andrés Island
properties.description: Transforms plastic waste into coral reef conservation tools through circular economy. Strengthens waste management, creates recycling value chains, trains Raizal women/youth in sustainable practices on San Andrés Island.

properties.title: Village-Based Ecotourism Business in MPA Bomberai
properties.description: Community-owned dive tourism in Bird's Head Seascape MPA Bomberai. Creates jobs in guiding, boats, hospitality. Links local income to healthy reefs, embedding conservation into coastal economies.

properties.title: Six Senses Grand Bahama
properties.description: Ecotourism resort in Grand Bahama boosting local tourism, creating jobs, and promoting marine & terrestrial sustainability through regenerative activities while protecting adjacent oceans for future generations.

properties.title: Local Seaweed Hatchery Business in East Sumba
properties.description: Reef-positive seaweed seedling hatchery in Kaliuda village, East Sumba, Indonesia. Develops climate-resilient seed varieties with UNRAM and BRIN to strengthen sustainable seaweed production and enhance coastal livelihoods.

properties.title: Blueyou Indonesia Sustainable Seafood and Fisheries Improvement
properties.description: Blueyou Indonesia supports sustainable seafood sourcing, fisheries improvement projects, and aquaculture certification in Indonesia, connecting local producers to premium markets through eco-labeling and traceability.

properties.title: Parley for the Oceans
properties.description: Global network addressing ocean pollution via AIR Strategy (Avoid, Intercept, Redesign). Creates Ocean Plastic® from upcycled marine debris, supports coastal communities, develops biofabricated materials since 2012.

properties.title: BLUD Establishment and Surf Fee Enablement in FMA 572
properties.description: Establishes BLUD (Regional Public Service Agency) for MPA management in Indonesia's FMA 572, enabling surf fee collection to fund sustainable coral reef protection and production-protection strategies in Eastern Indian Ocean.

properties.title: Water Offsets - Circular Water Management for Marine Protection
properties.description: WaterTECH company using nanomaterials, AI & onsite treatment to cut wastewater discharge, achieve water neutrality & protect coral reefs/coastal ecosystems. 4,000+ water-neutral homes delivered in UK since 2020.

properties.title: Dumpsite Remediation Western Sanitary Landfill Project
properties.description: Fiji waste mgmt project converting dumpsite to Material Recycling Facility via PPP model. Stops leachate entering rivers/coast, protecting Mamanuca, Yasawa reefs, Nadi Bay, Great Sea Reef. Blended finance model.

properties.title: Community-Led Seaweed First Handling Facilities
properties.description: Establishes community seaweed processing unit in Indonesia's Lesser Sunda to improve drying/storage techniques, increase farmer income, create jobs, and ensure sustainable reef-positive seaweed production practices.

properties.title: Symbiotic Tourism: A Business Model Linking Star-Class Hotels and Local Communities in Kayankerni
properties.description: Links fishing communities with hotels for eco-tourism (snorkeling, cultural tours). Revenue funds Conservation Trust for reef restoration. Provides alternative income, reduces fishing pressure, promotes coral conservation in Kayankerni.

properties.title: Oceanpick Sustainable Aquaculture
properties.description: GFCR invests in Sri Lanka's offshore barramundi farm to scale sustainable aquaculture, protect coral reefs from blast fishing, create local jobs, and reduce carbon footprint through best practices in Trincomalee.

properties.title: Living Seas Aquafeed
properties.description: Indonesia-based company produces sustainable crustacean feed from mangrove leaf extract and seaweed, reducing conventional feed needs while enhancing shrimp health at Living Seas Lab in Northern Lombok.

properties.title: Birufinery
properties.description: Indonesian blue economy startup upcycling seaweed & ocean biomass into biodegradable packaging & skincare. Empowers coastal communities through fair trade while reducing marine waste via circular economy principles.

properties.title: Entrance Fee Implementation in Bomberai MPA
properties.description: Tourist vehicle entrance fee for Bomberai MPA supporting administrative management, biodiversity monitoring, and local livelihoods. Part of Indonesia's Healthy Coral Reefs program in Bird's Head Seascape.

properties.title: Business and Technology Incubator (BTI) - Seychelles
properties.description: SeyCCAT's BTI supports coral-positive businesses in Seychelles through business model refinement, funding access, partnerships & technical skills to expand investment-ready coral reef initiatives.

properties.title: Coral Positive Ecotourism Growth in Seychelles
properties.description: Eco-mooring strategy in Sainte Anne Marine Park to prevent coral damage from anchoring. Installs eco-friendly buoys, educates tourists/operators, implements mooring fees for sustainable reef conservation funding.

properties.title: Seychelles Coral Reef Parametric Insurance
properties.description: Parametric insurance for Seychelles coral reefs triggered by ocean temperature thresholds. Enables rapid response funding for reef recovery and conservation measures managed by SeyCCAT.

properties.title: Blue Investment Arc Expansion
properties.description: SeyCCAT expands blue financing in Seychelles to support SMEs addressing coral reef degradation through fisheries, tourism, waste management. Provides financial/technical support via Business & Technology Incubator and Blue Enterprise Fund.
properties.funder: Seychelles Conservation and Climate Adaptation Trust (SeyCCAT)

properties.title: Coral Reef Funding Facility (CRFF)
properties.description: Deploys grants and recoverable grants into reef-positive businesses to build sustainable enterprises and leverage philanthropic capital for coral reef conservation globally.

properties.title: Eco-Label Membership in Kupang and Sumba FMA 573
properties.description: Secures resource access for small-scale fishers in Savu Sea. Ensures sustainability standards for snapper/grouper fisheries. Develops co-management framework with local authorities, communities, private sector.

properties.title: Seaflower Fund
properties.description: Dual-fund mechanism (sinking+endowment) for Colombia's Seaflower Biosphere Reserve. Targets US$5M endowment to close 72% MPA financing gap. Supports biodiversity, restoration, livelihoods. Launched COP16, managed by Fondo Acción.

properties.title: Module for the Establishment and Strengthening of Conservation Area Management Institutions
properties.description: YKAN develops learning module & certification for MPA management units as BLUD in Indonesia, supporting government's 30x45 vision of 100M hectares MPA by 2045. Based on successful Raja Ampat model.

properties.title: Agrata Sustainable Mud Crab Aquaculture
properties.description: Pioneering sustainable mud crab aquaculture via world's first RAS hatchery. Transitions production from wild catch to industrial aquaculture, equipping SE Asian farmers with tech & skills for profitable, eco-friendly operations.

properties.title: Fi Wi Riif Blue Carbon Projects
properties.description: Restores coastal/marine ecosystems in Seaflower Biosphere Reserve, Colombia. Develops blue carbon projects to generate credits funding MPA conservation and reef-positive businesses. Phase I: consultations. Next: feasibility studies.

properties.title: Fi Wi Riif Investment Account
properties.description: Blended finance mechanism in Colombia promoting reef-positive businesses through grants, technical assistance, and investment de-risking for enterprises supporting coral reef conservation in San Andrés and Providencia.

properties.title: Great Fringing Reef Mooring Systems Upgrade
properties.description: Installing mooring infrastructure at Egypt's Red Sea priority sites to reduce anchor damage from tourism. Expands HEPCA's existing systems to protect the Great Fringing Reef while maintaining tourism access.

properties.title: Organic Waste Upcycling for Urban Farming
properties.description: Hurghada waste mgmt project converting organic waste to compost for urban farming, reducing nutrient runoff & marine pollution affecting Red Sea coral reefs. Partners with HEPCA for waste collection & upcycling.

properties.title: Egyptian Coral Reef Fund
properties.description: Blended finance mechanism mobilizing public/private capital for Red Sea coral reef protection via sustainable tourism, waste management, and aquaculture. Addresses financing gaps and builds reef-positive investments.

properties.title: Innovative Risk Financing
properties.description: Parametric insurance in Colombia pays out when hurricanes hit reef sites, enabling rapid coral recovery by organized brigades. Benefits coastal communities dependent on reefs in San Andres & Providencia.

properties.title: Facilitated Finance for a Sustainable Fishing Fleet
properties.description: Blended finance rebuilds fishing fleet in Providencia & Santa Catalina Islands post-Hurricane Iota. US$220k loan + US$100k debt relief funds sustainable vessels, no-take zones, responsible fishing practices to restore coral reefs.

properties.title: Sustainable Community Ecotourism in and around Wadi El Gemal
properties.description: Develops community ecotourism in Wadi El Gemal, Egypt, shifting from reef-dependent to desert/cultural tourism. Builds local partnerships, creates alternative experiences, reduces coral reef pressure while increasing community benefits.

properties.title: Beqa Adventure Divers: Shark Reef Marine Reserve
properties.description: Fiji's first National Marine Park combining shark conservation, sustainable dive tourism, and community engagement. Includes anti-poaching patrols, coral farming, mangrove restoration, and marine research at patch reef off Viti Levu.
properties.funder: Global Fund for Coral Reefs (GFCR) and Joint SDG Fund (JSDG)

properties.title: Escuela del Mar
properties.description: Educational & cultural centre in Isla Fuerte, Colombia for community engagement & environmental education addressing unsustainable tourism. Part of Fi Wi Riif (Our Reef) programme. Concept/design stage.

properties.title: Investing in Fiji's Blue Future: Financing the Protection of Coral Reefs and Coastal Livelihoods
properties.description: Blended finance facility mobilizing USD 920K credit guarantee to support 10 reef-positive enterprises in Fiji's LMMAs through sustainable fisheries, eco-tourism, aquaculture & reef restoration loans up to USD 200K each.
properties.funder: UNDP, UNCDF, UNEP, Fiji Development Bank, JSDG Fund

properties.title: Oceanworks
properties.description: Oceanworks ethically harvests coastal plastic waste, preventing ocean pollution. Creates jobs in underserved communities while providing 100% recycled ocean plastic to brands. Tracks chain of custody from collection to product.

properties.title: Coral Reef Business Incubator
properties.description: Incubator supporting reef-positive enterprises in Egypt's Red Sea through technical assistance and business development in sustainable tourism, waste management, and aquaculture to unlock investment and strengthen coastal livelihoods.

properties.title: Seaweed Carbon Farming
properties.description: Developing carbon offset methodology for seaweed farms across 5 continents. 15-month study quantifying CO2 sequestration at 19 farms in 12 countries to create voluntary carbon protocol, enabling farmers to monetize climate impact.
properties.funder: ClimateWorks Foundation and Jeremy and Hannelore Grantham Environmental Trust

properties.title: Reef Credit Initiative
properties.description: Environmental market paying landholders for reducing pollutants (nutrients, pesticides, sediment) entering Great Barrier Reef. Tradable credits fund water quality improvements while maintaining farm productivity.

properties.title: Blue Barriers - SEADS Sea Defence Solutions
properties.description: Recycled polyethylene barriers collect plastic & microplastics in rivers before reaching oceans. Pilot on Lamone River, Italy (2019). Partnerships with universities. Seeking partners to upscale technology.

properties.title: Ocean Outcomes Triple Impact Fisheries
properties.description: Business-driven approach for small-scale fishers in Latin America (Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Costa Rica, Mexico) using Environmental, Social & Financial assessment tools to improve livelihoods, ecosystem health & seafood supply.

properties.title: Coral Husbandry Automated Raceway Machine (CHARM)
properties.description: Automated coral farming robot by Beyond Coral Foundation reduces costs & labor for reef restoration. Uses AI camera, brush & software to clean, cultivate & catalog corals in aquaculture raceways globally.

properties.title: Terra Conscious
properties.description: Marine conservation social enterprise in North Goa offering sustainable tourism: ethical dolphin watching, mangrove kayaking, capacity building for operators. Promotes zero-waste experiences, protects biodiversity since 2017.

properties.title: Coral Reef Aquaculture for Resilience and Aquarium Trade
properties.description: Expands reef aquaculture in Port Ghalib, Egypt cultivating corals & sea cucumbers for restoration & sustainable aquarium trade, reducing wild harvest pressure while creating local economic opportunities.

properties.title: Aquahub Mangrove Crab Tanzania
properties.description: Vertically integrated mangrove crab aquaculture in Tanzania. Breeds crablets in hatchery, partners with local farmers for grow-out in fishponds. Reduces wild crab fishing pressure, supports livelihoods.

properties.title: AquaVitae
properties.description: Consortium of 35+ partners developing sustainable Atlantic aquaculture for low-trophic species (macroalgae, mussels, sea cucumbers, oysters, abalone). Launched prototypes May 2020. EU Horizon 2020 funded.
properties.funder: European Union Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation Programme

properties.title: IntelliReefs
properties.description: Bio-inspired artificial reef structures using Oceanite mineral matrix for coral restoration. Pilot in St. Maarten showed more biodiversity than natural reefs in 14 months. Scalable, customizable to nanoscale for species-specific goals.

properties.title: Cellana
properties.description: Hawaii-based algae biorefinery developing Omega-3 oils, animal feed, and biofuel from marine microalgae using patented ALDUO photosynthetic production system combining photobioreactors with open ponds.

properties.title: Reefy Netherlands
properties.description: Startup restoring marine habitats using modular artificial reef blocks. Boosts biodiversity, protects coastlines from erosion/flooding. Built from local/recycled sediments. Adaptable from North Sea to Caribbean waters.

properties.title: Blue Economy Guarantee Facility
properties.description: Risk guarantee facility for coral reef-positive MSMEs. USD 1M guarantee leverages USD 4M in microfinance loans. Includes technical assistance for funding access and sustainability.

properties.title: ProCoReef
properties.description: Ecotourism-based coral reef restoration in Colombian Caribbean. Enables individuals/companies to finance reef restoration through tourism activities. Developing Blue Fund & blue carbon credits. Pilot in Isla Fuerte.

properties.title: BIOCEANOR Underwater Monitoring System
properties.description: IoT underwater weather station monitoring 15+ water parameters in real-time. Deployed in Moorea with CRIOBE for coral monitoring. Predicts water quality changes to protect reefs and marine biodiversity.

properties.title: Reef Cubes®
properties.description: Eco-friendly concrete blocks mimicking natural reefs. Stackable cubes create marine habitats for biodiversity, coastal defense, offshore infrastructure. Made from low-carbon cement, recycled materials. Global application.

properties.title: NEMO - Coral Restoration System
properties.description: 360° coral restoration system using drone tech, transport boxes & interactive network to help municipalities restore reefs efficiently at scale. Transports 100 corals, 3D scans reefs, made from recycled materials.

properties.title: Seaboost
properties.description: French company rehabilitating marine biodiversity through bio-inspired structures, artificial reefs, and coastal defense systems. Provides ecological audits, R&D, and customized solutions for marine ecosystems in maritime infrastructures.

properties.title: ReefSystems
properties.description: Modular systems (MOSES & SPECTER) restore marine ecosystems & boost biodiversity. Projects in Panama, Netherlands, Kenya restore coral reefs damaged by dynamite fishing. Installed in waterways & oceans as habitat.

properties.title: Sea Green
properties.description: Enhances seaweed aquaculture value chains in Southeast Asia through digital platform, blockchain traceability, and microfinance. Empowers coastal communities with capacity building, economic growth, and climate resilience.

properties.title: SeaAhead
properties.description: Benefit Corp supporting bluetech startups at innovation+sustainability+oceans intersection. Identified 850+ ventures in sustainable food, low-carbon shipping, renewable energy, marine debris, resilient waterfronts via BlueSwell Incubator.

properties.title: Ocean Purpose Project (OPP)
properties.description: Singapore-based initiative converting ocean plastics to fuel via innovative tech, cultivating seaweed/mussels for bioplastics, conducting coral reforestation, beach cleanups & community education across SE Asia
properties.category: Plastic pollution prevention, coral restoration, blue carbon

properties.title: ReShore - Floating Living Breakwater
properties.description: Netherlands startup developing floating breakwaters combining mussel/kelp cultivation with traditional technology. Reduces wave energy, prevents erosion, builds habitats, removes pollutants. Targets ports, marinas, fish farms.

properties.title: Coastruction Innovation
properties.description: Netherlands-based 3D concrete printing system using powder bed tech to create zero-waste biomimetic coral reefs on-site with natural materials, reducing carbon footprint for remote reef restoration.

properties.title: Earthjustice: Stop the USA's Largest Factory-Farm Aquaculture Project
properties.description: Legal research to counter Rose Canyon Fisheries aquaculture factory-farm off San Diego. Addresses regulatory gaps, pollution discharge, endangered species impacts. First major offshore finfish project in West Coast federal waters.

properties.title: MARI Oceans
properties.description: Community seaweed farming in Indonesia using sustainable harvesting, blockchain traceability, farmer training, and hatchery services. Provides superior seeds, technical assistance, and business support for coastal communities.

properties.title: Ocean Farmers
properties.description: Sustainable seaweed aquaculture in Madagascar providing alternative livelihoods to 3,000 coastal households, reducing destructive fishing while restoring coral reefs and seagrass beds through community-based farming model.

properties.title: Water Insight
properties.description: Satellite remote sensing platform monitoring coastal waters: eutrophication, turbidity, seagrass, algae, phytoplankton. Supports aquaculture, dredging, harmful algal bloom detection with real-time reporting.

properties.title: Ocean Scientific International - Marine Environmental Monitoring Systems
properties.description: UK company manufactures integrated systems for real-time marine monitoring: data buoys, sensors, oil spill detection, salinometers. Deployed globally in coastal regions including India, USA, UK, Saudi Arabia for water quality analysis.

properties.title: Chicago Zoological Society: Assessment of Fur Seals and Sea Lions
properties.description: Community engagement at Punta San Juan reserve, Peru. Protects endangered fur seals, sea lions, Humboldt penguins. Monthly tours, teen guide training, events develop local conservation leaders, connect residents with wildlife.

properties.title: Association for Animal Protection and Inventory: 1st MPAs in Bosnia
properties.description: Establishing 3 MPAs in Bosnia-Herzegovina waters to protect skates, rays & spawning sites. Field studies provide scientific data for MPA designation, published in journals & discussed with Ministry/stakeholders.

properties.title: IPNLF: Mapping the Roles of Women in the Maldives Tuna Fishery
properties.description: Research mapping women's roles in Maldives tuna supply chains, developing gender indicators for social/economic monitoring. Addresses data gaps on female seafood workers to improve small-scale fisheries management.

properties.title: AIDA: Protecting Magellanes Environment from Salmon Aquaculture
properties.description: AIDA combats destructive salmon aquaculture in Magallanes, Chile through scientific reports, media advocacy, and legal complaints to protect pristine Patagonian waters from pollution and ecosystem collapse.

properties.title: Los Cabos Coastkeeper: Flora and Fauna Protection Area
properties.description: Cabo San Lucas Flora & Fauna Protection Area lacks management plan despite 1974 establishment. LCCK completes critical steps for drafting plan to address overfishing, habitat destruction, pollution, ensuring sustainable fisheries & tourism.

properties.title: Sea Shepherd: Vaquita Protection and Removal of Illegal Fishing Gear
properties.description: Protecting vaquita porpoises from extinction in Gulf of California by removing illegal gillnets and longlines. Partnership with Mexican Navy removed 42 gillnets, 16 longlines during Operation Milagro II (Nov 2015-May 2016).

properties.title: Provita: The Venezuelan Coral Reef Monitoring Network
properties.description: Monitors Venezuelan coral reefs across 3 MPAs (21 sites) to assess health, track climate impacts, engage communities, and inform conservation. Collects baseline data on coral/fish communities annually for 3 years, contributing to GCRMN.

properties.title: Sea Shepherd Legal: Fighting Against IUU Fishing in Peru
properties.description: Training Peru's prosecutors, judges & enforcement personnel to combat illegal fishing in biodiversity hotspot waters. Builds government capacity to address IUU fishing & prepare for marine protected areas.

properties.title: MARE: Performance of MPAs in Portugal
properties.description: Evaluates Portuguese MPA performance via new classification system. Creates inventory, assesses management effectiveness, develops performance index. Provides guidelines to managers and global conservation community.

properties.title: Organization for the Conservation of Cetaceans
properties.description: OCC-Uruguay protects marine life along Uruguay's Atlantic coast through the Whale & Dolphin Sanctuary. #OceanoSanos campaign addresses threats: Chinese mega-port, illegal fishing, pollution, by-catch. Uses legal action & public awareness.

properties.title: CUNY Brooklyn College: Population Collapse and Coastal Warming
properties.description: Studying 95% seahorse decline in Ria Formosa using genetic analysis of archived material to track demographic changes during coastal warming and evaluate census data accuracy for marine protected area monitoring.

properties.title: Wild Me: Wildbook-Computer Vision for Dolphins
properties.description: Develops AI software to identify individual dolphins from dorsal fin photos. Uses computer vision to track US bottlenose & NZ common dolphins. Open-source platform integrates citizen science data for population monitoring.

properties.title: Ocean Alliance: SnotBot, Drones for Whale Research
properties.description: Drone-based whale research collecting respiratory samples, photo-ID, photogrammetry from humpback whales in SE Alaska (2017). Non-invasive data collection to advance whale conservation globally.

properties.title: Mision Tiburon: Scalloped Hammerhead Shark Conservation
properties.description: Protecting endangered scalloped hammerhead sharks in Golfo Dulce, Costa Rica (700km2 nursery). Training fishermen in better practices, implementing fishing management actions with local stakeholders and government.

properties.title: Expedition surveying coastal marine habitats in Tongan waters
properties.description: Scientists survey coral reefs & fisheries in Tongatapu, 'Eua, Ha'apai & Vava'u to assess impacts from Jan 2022 volcanic eruption. Support recovery, evaluate Special Management Areas, inform 30% ocean protection plan.

properties.title: Marine Megafauna Foundation: Genomic tools for Yellowfin Tuna
properties.description: Genomic study using SNPs to assess yellowfin tuna population structure in eastern Pacific. Compares microsatellite vs SNP analysis to inform management strategies for this near-threatened, heavily traded species.

properties.title: CCRD: Improve the Fisheries Protected Areas in Vietnam
properties.description: Training for 23 community fisheries protected areas in Tam Giang lagoon, Vietnam. Builds capacity for adaptive management, fishery protection, and conservation through participatory learning to maintain nursery grounds.

properties.title: Bahamas National Trust: Sustainability of the Queen Conch Fishery
properties.description: Conchservation Campaign improves Queen Conch fishery sustainability in Bahamas through awareness, behavioral change, engaging fishermen/restaurants/policymakers via music video PSA, petition for juvenile protection legislation.

properties.title: University of Cape Town: ABALOBI – Small-Scale Fisheries
properties.description: Mobile app empowering 150K South African small-scale fishers with catch monitoring, traceability, and co-management tools. Promotes social justice, poverty alleviation, and marine stewardship through user-generated data.

properties.title: University of Miami: Hurricane Matthew Impacts on The Bahamas
properties.description: 8-month study documenting Hurricane Matthew impacts on New Providence coral reefs, mangroves & coastal resources. High school students assess erosion, water quality & biodiversity in/outside protected areas to improve storm resilience.

properties.title: IUCN: Debt for Adaptation Swap Expansion
properties.description: Debt restructuring mechanism financing marine spatial plans & MPAs in Small Island Developing States. Seychelles pilot: USD21.6m swap protecting 400,000 km2. Expanding to Palau, Marshall Islands, Jamaica, Grenada, FSM.

properties.title: EcoViva: Coastal Resources Management in El Salvador's Mangroves
properties.description: Protects Bay of Jiquilisco mangroves through community-based management. Expands Local Sustainable Resource Use Plans for 4,000 acres. Supports local livelihoods, fisheries, sea turtles. Ongoing project in El Salvador.

properties.title: MarViva: Public Policy of the High Seas in the Costa Rica Dome
properties.description: Protecting Costa Rica Dome biodiversity through marine spatial planning with Central American governments. Awareness campaign for high seas governance, fisheries & traffic regulations to protect whales, turtles, sharks in critical habitat.

properties.title: VEPA: Conservation Monitoring and Assessment in Tonga
properties.description: Monitoring zooplankton, cryptobenthic fish, coral in Vava'u Archipelago SMAs. Develops baseline data & training manuals for Tongan Ministry of Fisheries & VEPA to assess reef ecosystem health & support marine spatial planning.

properties.title: Island Reach: Developing the MPA Network in Makelula, Vanuatu
properties.description: Supporting 6 villages in SW Bay, Malekula to create community-managed MPA network. Training in monitoring, building floats/signage, applying biophysical principles for effective design to protect declining fish stocks & reefs.

properties.title: Seacology: Drafting a Management Plan for an MPA in Chile
properties.description: Communities develop management plan for 12,630-acre MPA near Koldita Island. Seacology funds experts and surveillance equipment. Communities monitor reserve, protect traditional fisheries, dolphins, and marine otters by Dec 2017.

properties.title: Maldives Expedition 2021
properties.description: Jan 2020 expedition surveyed coral reef health, fish/benthic populations, water quality across 16 Maldives atolls over 26 days. Led by MMRI, Waitt Institute, Scripps. Data informs Marine Spatial Plan for ocean protection.

properties.title: Pacific Wild Alliance: Herring Recovery in British Columbia
properties.description: Supporting Heiltsuk Nation's co-management of Pacific Herring fishery on BC's central coast through monitoring, media coverage, and communications to promote sustainable herring stock recovery and cultural preservation.

properties.title: Lesser Antilles Expedition
properties.description: Nov 2016 rapid coral reef assessment across Sint Maarten, Sint Eustatius, Saba, Redonda & Saba Bank. 65 sites surveyed, 325 fish/benthic transects, 38 photomosaics. Partnership with Scripps & regional governments.

properties.title: Palau Expedition
properties.description: Marine expedition in Palau, Micronesia (Jan-Feb 2022) partnering with One Reef and Scripps to study 300+ limestone islands. Supports traditional 'bul' fishing closures for habitat regeneration and food security.

properties.title: Great Barrier Reef Expedition
properties.description: Surveyed Great Barrier Reef using 360° photography & camera sleds. Partnered with U of Queensland & Catlin Seaview Survey. Monitored coral health, retrieved loggers. Data contributed to Netflix's Chasing Coral.

properties.title: Curaçao Blue Halo Initiative Expedition
properties.description: Nov 2015: Waitt Foundation marine survey expedition in Curaçao, Lesser Antilles. 475 dives around island with international scientists to assess coastal ecosystems for Blue Halo marine protection program.

properties.title: Tonga Expedition
properties.description: June 2017 expedition to Tonga's Vava'u archipelago. Scientific dive surveys collected baseline reef data for Marine Protected Areas. Partnership with Tongan Government & VEPA. 3D photographic reef mosaics created.

properties.title: Fiji Vatu-i-Ra Expedition
properties.description: Marine research expedition in Vatu-i-Ra Seascape, Fiji (March 2014) with Wildlife Conservation Society. Studied seascape ecology, culminating multi-year research efforts in the region.

properties.title: Galápagos to Cocos Island Expedition
properties.description: Study of high seas zone between Galápagos & Cocos Island using BRUVs to understand marine connectivity. Deployed baited cameras at depths, recorded hammerhead sharks. Ecuador & Costa Rica signed protection agreement.

properties.title: Solomon Islands Marine Scientific Assessment Expedition
properties.description: Scientific marine assessments in Western Province, Solomon Islands. Partnership with local conservation groups and Scripps Institute. Results delivered to Ministry of Fisheries for resource management.

properties.title: Santa Elena Expedition
properties.description: May 2018 marine survey in Santa Elena Bay, Costa Rica to support protection gaps in Nature Preserves. 302 species documented via 25 dives, turtle/shark tagging, DNA sampling. Partnership with Mar Viva & UCR.

properties.title: Selvagens Islands Expedition
properties.description: 10-day expedition to Selvagens Islands, south of Madeira, conducting first underwater ecosystem surveys from shallow to deep waters. Results advise Portuguese government on expanding Marine Protected Area beyond 200m depth.

properties.title: Cashes Ledge Expedition
properties.description: June 2016 Blue Parks expedition documenting Cashes Ledge in Gulf of Maine. Scientists & photographer Brian Skerry collected visual & scientific evidence of this ecologically significant habitat to advocate for marine protections.

properties.title: Vava'u Tonga Expedition
properties.description: BIORAP scientific surveys of Vava'u island group, Tonga. Ship & land-based teams conducted marine biodiversity assessments with SPREP. Led to ongoing conservation talks with Kingdom of Tonga.

properties.title: Seychelles Expedition
properties.description: March 2015 expedition to Seychelles outer islands (Aldabra, Assumption, Cosmoledo). Scientists & filmmakers surveyed & explored ocean environments, documenting biodiversity & ecosystem health over 2 weeks.

properties.title: Pulley Ridge Expedition
properties.description: ROV expedition documenting deep-sea fauna/flora near Dry Tortugas, Florida Keys to support marine protection recommendations. Science team from FSU and Harbor Branch with National Geographic photographer.

properties.title: Researchers Return from 8 Day Expedition to Study Samoa's Marine Life
properties.description: 8-day expedition studying Samoa's coral reefs. Local & international researchers surveyed marine biodiversity. Completed Sept 2022. Supports marine conservation planning in Samoan waters.

properties.title: Montserrat Expedition
properties.description: Oct 2015 marine expedition to Montserrat for Blue Halo Initiative. 600 dives, 44k fish counted, 188 species, 43 coral species. Scientific assessment around entire island to support marine conservation planning.

properties.title: Andaman Sea Expedition
properties.description: Jan 2015: Waitt Foundation & Wildlife Conservation Society trained local teams in Myanmar's Andaman Sea on science diving, survey methods & BRUV construction to establish baseline marine data collection & build capacity.

properties.title: Albania Marine Baseline Survey Expedition
properties.description: June 2015 dive surveys along Albanian coast to collect baseline data for Marine Protected Area creation. Led by U. Tirane & Centre d'Estudis Avançats de Blanes, presented to local stakeholders.

properties.title: Fiji Sharks Expedition
properties.description: April 2014 shark research expedition in Fiji deploying cameras and satellite transponders to study local shark populations, ecology, and movement patterns. Led by Jessica Cramp with Dr. Demian Chapman.

properties.title: Applying Science to Improve MPA Management
properties.description: Bertarelli Programme supports BIOT MPA management through research on IUU fishing, compliance improvement, and global collaboration on marine reserve best practices and enforcement.

properties.title: Pitcairn Islands Marine Protected Area
properties.description: 850,000 km² MPA in central South Pacific protecting pristine coral reefs, seamounts, endangered whales. 99.5% no-take zone with community-led monitoring. Established to preserve near-pristine ecosystems and climate refugia.

properties.title: French Polynesia Marine Protection
properties.description: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy collaborates with Austral & Marquesas Islands communities to create 1.7M km² marine reserves protecting sharks, coral, tuna in French Polynesia's EEZ, respecting traditional rāhui practices. Started 2014.

properties.title: Kermadec Islands Marine Protection
properties.description: Advocacy for highly protected marine reserve in Kermadec Islands, safeguarding biodiversity along 2,500km underwater volcanic arc, respecting Maori cultural heritage, and building climate resilience in temperate-tropical waters.

properties.title: Bertarelli Programme in Marine Science - Communicating Marine Science
properties.description: Makes marine conservation mainstream through public platform sharing MPA research, annual symposiums presenting findings, and building ocean-friendly society awareness globally.

properties.title: Sea of Cortez Marine Protection
properties.description: Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy & Beta Diversidad work with communities to create MPA in Sea of Cortez & Pacific off Baja California, protecting sharks, whales, turtles, dolphins & 900 fish species in Cousteau's 'world's aquarium'

properties.title: Coral Reef Resilience in British Indian Ocean Territory
properties.description: Monitoring coral reef recovery after 2015-16 bleaching in BIOT. Studies coral biology, reef structure, biodiversity, fish communities, and disease resilience over 4 years in near-pristine conditions.

properties.title: British Indian Ocean Territory Marine Protected Area
properties.description: 640,000km2 no-take MPA in Chagos Archipelago protecting coral atolls, pelagic species. Partnership since 2010 supports enforcement, scientific research on reef and migratory species to improve ocean sanctuary management.

properties.title: Easter Island (Rapa Nui) Marine Protection
properties.description: 720,000km² marine park protecting 142 unique species, hydrothermal vents. Scientific assessment, illegal fishing monitoring, community education. Rapa Nui Rāhui decree signed Feb 2018, preserving indigenous fishing traditions.

properties.title: Natural Park of the Coral Sea - New Caledonia
properties.description: Creating highly protected marine reserves within New Caledonia's 1.3M km² EEZ. Protecting pristine ecosystems, 1,700+ fish species, coral reefs, and deep-sea habitats. Partnership advocacy since 2014, MPAs established 2018.

properties.title: High Seas Marine Protection
properties.description: Partnership with governments to protect waters beyond national jurisdiction (2/3 of ocean). Supports UN process for international MPAs to preserve biodiversity, protect whales, tuna, sharks, corals from fishing impact.

properties.title: Sentinel Species - Bertarelli Programme in Marine Science
properties.description: Studies top predators & mobile species in BIOT marine reserve: turtles, seabirds, reef sharks, manta rays, tunas. Tagging & acoustic monitoring reveal habitat use, connectivity, ecosystem links across Indian Ocean.

properties.title: Revillagigedo Archipelago National Marine Park
properties.description: Mexico's largest fully protected marine reserve (148,087 km²) off Pacific coast. Protects 366 fish species, 37 shark/ray species, sea turtles. Designated Nov 2017. Supports migration, breeding of whales, dolphins, tuna.

properties.title: Ascension Island Marine Protected Area
properties.description: 443,000 km² MPA in South Atlantic protecting endemic species, green turtles, seabirds. Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy supports designation of entire EEZ. UK Government committed March 2019 to safeguard marine life, improve fisheries, create tourism.

properties.title: Turneffe Atoll Marine Reserve
properties.description: Bertarelli Foundation partnered with Belize to create 1,300km2 reserve protecting nursery habitat for 30+ species. Supports sustainable fishing and tourism for local communities while protecting marine ecosystem.

properties.title: South Sandwich Islands Marine Protection
properties.description: Protecting 529,000 km2 marine reserve around South Sandwich Islands. Home to penguins, whales, seals, albatrosses. Study climate impact at biogeographic boundary. Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy supports full protection from fishing.

properties.title: Tristan da Cunha Marine Protection Zone
properties.description: 687,000 km² marine reserve protecting 91% of Tristan da Cunha's waters. Safeguards endangered penguins, albatrosses, seals in South Atlantic. Designated Nov 2020, legislation 2021. 4th largest fully protected reserve globally.

properties.title: Shipbuilding Loan Program - Supporting Japan's Maritime Industry
properties.description: Long-term, low-interest financing for shipbuilding and related industries to strengthen operational foundations. Supports equipment modernization, working capital, and zero-emission vessel construction using LNG/ammonia/hydrogen fuel.

properties.title: 海と日本PROJECT ~CHANGE FOR THE BLUE~
properties.description: Marine debris reduction project addressing plastic pollution. Partners across sectors develop evidence-based model solutions for ocean waste management, raising public awareness through nationwide cleanup campaigns (May-June, Sept). Japan-wide initia

properties.title: 海のそなえプロジェクト (Umi no Sonae Project)
properties.description: Aims to reduce annual water accidents in Japan through new safety knowledge and measures. Consortium led by Nippon Foundation with Japan Lifesaving Association, Japan Water Rescue Association, and Umirai Environmental Foundation since 2024.

properties.title: Ocean Acidification Adaptation Project
properties.description: Monitors ocean acidification in Japanese coastal waters since 2020. Observes oyster larvae, water quality at multiple sites. Collaborates with universities, fisheries to predict impacts, develop mitigation strategies for shellfish aquaculture.

properties.title: Zero Emission Ship Project 2050
properties.description: Developing hydrogen-fueled ships to achieve carbon neutrality in domestic shipping by 2050. Three consortia building fuel cell offshore wind vessels and hydrogen engine ships for world-first demonstrations in 2024-2026.

properties.title: The Nippon Foundation-Nekton Ocean Census
properties.description: Global initiative to discover 100,000 new marine species in 10 years. Explores biodiversity hotspots worldwide using advanced tech, analyzes samples at centers globally, shares open-source data for scientists and public.

properties.title: Ocean Innovation Consortium - Marine Technology Development
properties.description: Platform to train 10,000 ocean development engineers by 2030. Supports university students in offshore oil/gas, renewable energy, methane hydrate development. Established 2016, involves 22 companies, 27 universities, 6 institutions.

properties.title: SPOGOMI World Cup
properties.description: Global competition of SPOGOMI (sport trash pickup) to reduce marine debris. 80% of ocean waste originates from land. 21 countries participated in 2023, collecting 9,000kg. Promotes ocean conservation through competitive cleanup events.

properties.title: Nippon Foundation-GEBCO Seabed 2030 Project
properties.description: Global project to complete 100% accurate seabed mapping by 2030. Collects bathymetric data from governments/companies, supports mapping technology research. Contributes to UN Ocean Decade. Started 2018, increased coverage from 6% to 19%.

properties.title: Back to Blue
properties.description: Nippon Foundation & Economist Impact collaboration addressing ocean plastic, chemical pollution, acidification. Publishes country rankings, white papers, hosts international conferences. Launched 2021, covers 25 countries globally.

properties.title: 洋上風力人材育成プロジェクト
properties.description: Japan's offshore wind power sector faces severe workforce shortage. Nippon Foundation supports training centers in Nagasaki for technicians and engineers to meet 2030 target of 15,700 personnel for renewable energy development.

properties.title: Global Marine Human Resource Development Program
properties.description: Nippon Foundation provides scholarships to develop global marine professionals addressing ocean issues. Programs train maritime administrators, ocean law experts, seafloor mapping technicians, and marine observation specialists worldwide since 1988.

properties.title: 海の地図プロジェクト (Sea Map Project)
properties.description: 10-year aerial survey mapping 90% of Japan's 35,000km coastal shallow waters (0-20m depth) using ALB technology. Aims to prevent water accidents, support tsunami preparedness, ecosystem monitoring. 2B yen budget, 25% complete as of Jan 2025.

properties.title: 海と日本PROJECT
properties.description: Why: 40% of Japanese teens lack ocean connection. What: All-Japan initiative raising ocean awareness. How: Educational programs, cleanup campaigns, surveys. When: Ongoing since 2016. Where: Nationwide Japan coastal areas.

properties.title: 海洋環境変化対応プロジェクト
properties.description: Japanese coastal ocean monitoring project. Fishers collect data (water temp, unusual catches) at 13 sites nationwide. Tokyo Univ analyzes data to understand environmental changes & develop responses. Started 2025.

properties.title: 日本財団・瀬戸内オーシャンズX
properties.description: Setouchi Sea marine debris reduction project by 4 prefectures & Nippon Foundation. Aims 70% reduction in new debris inflow, 10% increase in recovery by 2025. Includes research, corporate partnerships, education, policy formation.

properties.title: 渚の交番プロジェクト (Nagisa no Koban Project)
properties.description: Network of 18 coastal hubs across Japan promoting marine safety, environmental conservation, ocean education, and community engagement. Provides marine activities, lifesaving, beach management, and cross-sector collaboration since 2009.

properties.title: 無人運航船プロジェクト「MEGURI2040」
properties.description: Autonomous ship project addressing maritime labor shortage, aging workforce, and safety. Developing unmanned navigation systems for container ships, ferries, and island routes. Aims for 50% unmanned ships by 2040,実用化 by 2025.

properties.title: Reef Reborn
properties.description: Lipid nanoparticle cocktail to boost coral larvae survival on Great Barrier Reef. Lab & in-situ trials adapting feeding to water temp. Aims genetic renewal vs adult fragmentation for climate resilience 2022-2024.

properties.title: SYMBIOSWAP
properties.description: Transplanting symbiotic algae between Mediterranean and tropical corals (2025-2027) to study their role in resistance to water warming and coral bleaching. Novel approach for assisted acclimatation.

properties.title: SYNSEN - Plasticose Impact on Seabird DNA
properties.description: Study characterizing consequences of plasticose (disease from microplastic ingestion) on seabird DNA. Research on marine pollution impact on wildlife health. 2024-2026.

properties.title: Une aquaculture terrestre durable pour préserver la biodiversité
properties.description: Develop land-based Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture (IMTA) in Yucatan using underground saltwater to protect Caribbean marine ecosystems (mangroves, coral reefs, seagrass) from traditional aquaculture impacts.

properties.title: AQUAMAP
properties.description: Restoring Sundarbans mangroves (India/Bangladesh) using bio-inspired sediment capture and silvopisciculture to combat sea-level rise and erosion, protecting biodiversity and local communities (2025-2027).

properties.title: Bycatch Beyond
properties.description: Bangladesh artisanal fishers monitor ray/shark bycatch using low-tech radio-GPS devices to quantify accidental catches and better protect threatened species. 2024-2027.

properties.title: Protection Aegean Coralligenous
properties.description: Map & monitor coralligenous reefs in Aegean Sea using multibeam sonar, ROV & biomass scanner. Scientific expedition around Fourni Island involving local fishers to enforce trawling ban on biodiversity hotspots. 2021-2023

properties.title: Buffer
properties.description: Genetic study of heat-resistant gorgonian colonies to restore marine ecosystems in Parc National des Calanques. Combines genetics with symbiotic microorganism research for innovative marine habitat protection, 2024-2026.

properties.title: PANTHER
properties.description: Restoring degraded marine habitats on a Mediterranean island through collaborative approach with fishermen and researchers. Uses 3D photogrammetry to measure restoration impacts and reintroduce key ecosystem engineer species.

properties.title: Plastidrugs
properties.description: Study microplastics as pollutant carriers in marine environments. Research how plastic particles exchange pollutants, forming toxic rafts that accumulate in organisms. Aims to provide recommendations to combat microplastic pollution 2023-2026.

properties.title: Etude des mouvements des raies manta et des pressions de pêche au Mozambique
properties.description: Satellite tracking of manta rays in Mozambique to identify overlap with industrial fishing, evaluate marine protected area effectiveness, and study illegal fishing through citizen science and artisanal fisher observations.

properties.title: Floating Reef
properties.description: Artificial floating reef project in Frioul archipelago, Marseille, Calanques National Park. Testing buoy models in various coastal environments to study wave/current impacts and marine habitat development for biodiversity.

properties.title: Unknown
MicroPOW
properties.description: Study microplastic ingestion impact on seabird organs, tissues, cells in Australia. Links plastic pollution to cellular mechanisms and wildlife health using biomedical and field ecology tools (2021-2023).

properties.title: BIOSSA
properties.description: Study marine noise pollution impact on whales & dolphins. Analyze how human activities (motors, sonars, cables) interfere with cetacean communication & navigation, causing strandings. Develop recommendations 2023-2025.

properties.title: Regen Ocean Farms
properties.description: Revitalizing traditional Brazilian seaweed farming with modern biotech to restore coastal ecosystems. 4 new cultivation sites opened in northern Brazil, balancing economic development with marine conservation.

properties.title: Birds on Sticks
properties.description: Installing secure offshore nesting boxes to attract seabirds back to atolls. Bird droppings provide nutrients to restore coral reef resilience against marine heatwaves. Natural, cost-effective ecosystem restoration 2025-2027.

properties.title: Yaf Keru
properties.description: Coral reef restoration in Raja Ampat combining ecological monitoring, fishermen collaboration & socio-economic surveys. Protects 1/4 marine biodiversity & local food security through community management 2023-2025

properties.title: Fish on the Move
properties.description: Models fish egg/larva dispersion using ocean currents and fisher knowledge to map migration corridors and optimize marine protected areas by connecting juvenile and adult habitats for effective conservation (2025-2027).

properties.title: POLARIS - Plateforme d'Observation du Littoral Appliquée à la Recherche, à l'Information et à la Sensibilisation
properties.description: Mobile app for amateur divers to collect marine biodiversity data in Mediterranean Sea. Links citizen science with climate research. Marseille-based collaborative platform for marine ecosystem protection.

properties.title: Le ferry scientifique des Inuits, sentinelle du changement climatique
properties.description: Installing sensors on Inuit ferry to monitor ocean changes (temperature, chlorophyll, oxygen, salinity, CO2, pH) across Arctic-Atlantic transition zone. Supports climate adaptation strategy for Nunatsiavut communities facing rapid warming.

properties.title: MICROCEAN
properties.description: Sequencing plankton genomes to understand biological carbon pump. Explores molecular links between plankton species and their role in climate regulation and deep ocean preservation. 2024-2026.

properties.title: Un robot pour comprendre la biodiversité des monts sous marins
properties.description: MECOPO studies benthic mesophotic communities (60-350m depth) on seamounts and oceanic islands in SE Pacific using ROV. Creates species database to understand biological links and identify vulnerable zones for marine protection.

properties.title: IDEFIX
properties.description: Study nitrogen fixation dynamics during monsoon seasons in Indian Ocean. Combines oceanographic campaigns, biogeochemical analyses, and microbiology to link diazotroph activity to climate conditions and discover new species.

properties.title: Citizen into Science
properties.description: Collecting high-sea microclimate and current data via pleasure boats (14,000/year vs 100 scientific campaigns). Data shared with GOOS international databases. Engages recreational sailors in ocean science. 2023-2025.

properties.title: 3D-4-SEAC
properties.description: 3D photogrammetry mapping of Mediterranean key habitats (Posidonia, coralligenous, hermelles) in Latium coast & Tuscan archipelago, Italy. Creates high-res 3D models to monitor vulnerable ecosystems. 2022-2024.

properties.title: SHAMA
properties.description: Bottom-up coral reef monitoring in Shark Fin Bay, Philippines. Local fishers trained in scientific surveys, creating inclusive research structure with NGOs, researchers, authorities to develop adapted management decisions (2022-2024).

properties.title: GENESIS
properties.description: Study marine animal forests (sponges) along North-South transect from Svalbard to Caribbean via deep dives. Create first global DNA map of sponges for bio-inspired medicine and green chemistry. 2023-2025.

properties.title: Coastal Ocean Watch
properties.description: Evaluates European coastal water quality using satellite remote sensing. Analyzes 20-year trends in biogeochemical parameters to inform biodiversity conservation decisions. European coasts.

properties.title: Antarctic Biolum
properties.description: Study deep Antarctic macrofauna evolution using innovative 360° bioluminescence emission/detection technology in deep-sea environments. Research focuses on documenting bioluminescent organisms in Antarctic waters.

properties.title: Oceana Global Ocean Conservation Partnership
properties.description: Oak Foundation's 21-year partnership with Oceana supporting global ocean conservation. Transformed Oceana from startup to global powerhouse protecting marine ecosystems worldwide through advocacy and policy.

properties.title: Quantifying small-scale fisheries for policy and planning
properties.description: Free online training course teaching policymakers to collect data on small-scale fisheries' contributions to sustainable development, food security, and livelihoods. Developed by Duke Marine Lab and WorldFish.

properties.title: Protecting small-scale fishers to sustain food, livelihoods, and marine nature
properties.description: Oak Foundation supports 108M small-scale fishers globally through orgs like CAOPA, GNCFC, HOMEF. Fights industrial trawling, saiko trade, promotes sustainable fishing, women's empowerment, food security in coastal communities.

properties.title: Securing marine biodiversity in the high seas through a global treaty
properties.description: Supporting High Seas Alliance & Oceans 5 to establish UN High Seas Treaty protecting marine biodiversity beyond national waters. Aims for 30% ocean protection by 2030 through MPAs, regulating overfishing & deep-sea mining.

properties.title: East Maui communities protecting coastline and restoring marine life
properties.description: Nā Mamo O Mū'olea manages 70 acres at Mū'olea Point, East Maui. Created Hawaii's first limpet rest area, hosts annual Hāna Limu Festival since 2009. 2-year grant from HCF Marine 30x30 Fund supports nearshore ecosystem restoration.
properties.funder: Oak Foundation, Hawai'i Community Foundation Marine 30×30 Pooled Fund

properties.title: One Billion Oyster Project and One Million New Yorkers
properties.description: Restoring NY Harbor's oyster reefs to clean water, support biodiversity, protect shorelines. Goal: 1B oysters by 2035 via artificial reefs from recycled shells, engaging 1M New Yorkers through education & volunteering.

properties.title: Indonesia's Seagrass and Coral Nursery
properties.description: Coral & seagrass restoration in Balabalakang Archipelago, West Sulawesi to protect sea turtles. Transplanting coral (13%→43% coverage) & seagrass (26→30 hectares), training locals in monitoring, establishing MPA 650km N of Bali.

properties.title: Saving the Spotted Greenshank
properties.description: Protecting wintering Spotted Greenshank in Thailand's coastal mudflats through surveys, habitat management with local stakeholders, and community education. Focus on Inner Gulf of Thailand and Peninsular coast.

properties.title: Community Conservation of Sea Turtles
properties.description: Protects endangered Hawksbill, Green & Olive Ridley turtles on Katrack Island, Guinea. Community-led nest protection, anti-poaching patrols, DNA analysis. Supports local school & dispensary. 20km beach hotspot.

properties.title: Dolphin Quest Guinea
properties.description: Assessing Atlantic humpback dolphin distribution, habitat, and abundance in Guinea's coastal waters through boat surveys and community collaboration to reduce bycatch threats and protect this critically endangered species.

properties.title: Oceans Collaborative
properties.description: Supporting Oceans Collaborative durability through environmental conservation funding. Multi-year initiative focused on ocean sustainability and collaborative marine conservation efforts. Oct 2024-Oct 2026.

properties.title: Ocean Protection
properties.description: $3M grant for ocean protection over 36 months. Moore Foundation Environmental Conservation funding. Nov 2025-Nov 2028. Global ocean conservation initiative. Limited details on specific interventions or geography.

properties.title: Ocean Conservation Storytelling

properties.description: Developing innovative ocean systems exhibits for new Observatory and Life Sciences galleries at Exploratorium, plus public programs to raise awareness of oceans and San Francisco Bay science.

properties.description: Support bi-partisan Oceans Caucus creation and educational activities for marine policy advocacy in US Congress. Nov 2011-Jan 2014, $250k grant.

properties.title: Ocean Acidification/Marine Microbes Workshop
properties.description: Workshop convening scientific experts to discuss ocean acidification effects on marine microbes. Develops white paper identifying research priorities to advance understanding of acidification impacts on marine microorganisms.

properties.title: Conservación ConCiencia
properties.description: Science-based conservation in Puerto Rico & Cuba: shark research with seafood industry, parrotfish supply chain analysis, fisheries management exchange. Promotes sustainable development through community collaboration.

properties.title: SeaGrass Grow

properties.title: The Live Blue Foundation
properties.description: Supports Blue Mind Movement connecting people with water for wellness. Provides tools to organizations worldwide that reconnect people with water throughout their lives based on two decades of research.

properties.title: Friends of Sawfish Conservation Society
properties.description: Global sawfish conservation through collaboration. Provides education, research tools, and policy enforcement support for threatened sawfish species worldwide. Connects researchers, policymakers, and enthusiasts.

properties.title: SEVENSEAS

properties.title: Tourism Action Coalition for a Sustainable Ocean

properties.description: Conservation in Los Cabos & Mexico through sea turtle/tern protection, habitat restoration, research, education & community involvement. Founded 2015, operates in Baja California Sur, Veracruz, Oaxaca, Cozumel promoting sustainability.

properties.title: Georgia Strait Alliance
properties.description: Protecting Strait of Georgia/Salish Sea through advocacy, stewardship & legal action. Focuses on water quality, species protection, community empowerment & climate action in BC's biologically rich marine ecosystem.

properties.title: Pro Esteros

properties.title: Friends of Bello Mundo
properties.description: Advocacy collective advancing global ocean conservation. Works with governments, scientists, and stakeholders to protect 30% of oceans by 2030 through marine protected areas, halt biodiversity loss, and rebuild marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Boyd Lyon Sea Turtle Fund

properties.title: earthDECKS.org Ocean Network

properties.title: Redfish Rocks Community Team
properties.description: Community team supporting Redfish Rocks Marine Reserve through research, engagement, and partnerships with Oregon Dept of Fish Wildlife. Develops management recommendations, evaluates reserve success, and serves as liaison.

properties.description: Annual awareness campaign on Jan 8th educating public on ocean acidification (pH 8.1). Interactive website forecasts impacts on tourism, fisheries, biodiversity. Launched 2019 by The Ocean Foundation.

properties.title: Friends of Havenworth Coastal Conservation
properties.description: Conservation research of endangered smalltooth sawfish, sharks, and rays in Tampa Bay, Florida. Studies occurrence, distribution, habitat use, movements through research and public outreach since 2010.

properties.description: Research on environmental toxicants affecting marine animals. Collects samples, conducts toxicology studies, establishes cell cultures, investigates contaminant impacts on endangered species & invertebrates, creates tissue repository.

properties.title: Grupo Tortuguero
properties.description: Works with local communities to recover migratory sea turtles. Builds conservation networks, studies human-caused threats, develops solutions, and promotes turtle conservation throughout the region.

properties.title: Deep Green Wilderness
properties.description: Sailboat-based education program using historic vessel Orion as floating classroom. Students explore estuarine ecosystems under sail, learning critical thinking, problem solving, and stewardship through hands-on marine curriculum.

properties.title: The Ocean Project
properties.description: Catalyzes collective action for ocean health and climate stability by collaborating with youth, zoos, aquariums, museums to grow a global network that engages public, informs policymakers, and protects the ocean.

properties.title: SURMAR/ASIMAR
properties.description: Understanding natural processes in central Gulf of California to conserve resources. Research on marine ecology, education with ITESME students, monitoring rocky intertidal invertebrates, reef fishes, jumbo squid. Since 2011.

properties.title: World Ocean Day
properties.description: Annual global event on June 8 raising ocean conservation awareness. The Ocean Project coordinates worldwide network supporting youth engagement, leadership, and advocacy for ocean protection year-round.

properties.title: Shark Advocates International
properties.description: Conserves vulnerable sharks/rays through science-based policies. Limits fishing/trade, strengthens finning bans globally. Builds stakeholder coalitions, advocates to governments. Nearly 2 decades of achievement.

properties.title: New Central Arctic Ocean Protections
properties.description: Establishing moratoriums on deep-sea mining and transpolar shipping in the 1.1M sq mile Central Arctic Ocean high seas area. Building on 2021 fishing agreement to protect climate regulation and ecosystems.

properties.title: Blue Climate Solutions

properties.title: Eastern Pacific Hawksbill Initiative (ICAPO)
properties.description: Promotes hawksbill turtle recovery in eastern Pacific through research, conservation, awareness. Collaborates with fishermen, scientists, policymakers from US to Peru. Established 2008.
