properties.description: Global tool tracking marine protected areas effectiveness and progress toward 30% ocean protection by 2030. Publishes Marine Protection Atlas, assesses MPAs against MPA Guide framework, monitors nations' 30x30 targets.

properties.title: Deep Sea Mining Campaign
properties.description: NGOs and citizens from Australia, PNG, and Canada working to protect marine ecosystems from deep sea mining impacts. Seeks informed consent from communities and precautionary approach to DSM in Pacific region.

properties.title: Tag-A-Giant Fund (TAG)
properties.description: Electronic tagging of 1,800 bluefin tuna to study migration, habitat, behavior. Scientists, policymakers, fishermen collaborate to rebuild Atlantic & Pacific populations through research-informed conservation policy.

properties.title: The Science Exchange
properties.description: Two-month hands-on field research internships training next generation in sea turtle conservation at Latin America and Caribbean sites. Released 250,000 hatchlings, removed 18,000+ trash pieces from beaches.

properties.title: Ocean Revolution
properties.description: Multi-cultural global initiative mentoring Indigenous communities and youth to protect oceans. Combines ancient knowledge with modern science, providing funding skills and infrastructure for marine justice and sustainable ocean use.

properties.title: High Seas Alliance
properties.description: Alliance of 40+ NGOs working to protect high seas biodiversity beyond national jurisdiction. Advocating for UN treaty (2018-2020) to establish marine protected areas and environmental impact assessments for threatened ecosystems.

properties.title: Coastal Coordination

properties.title: Inland Ocean Coalition
properties.description: Building land-to-sea stewardship across inland North America. Engaging communities in IL, AZ, UT, CO, MI, NY, Manitoba on ocean/watershed conservation through education and activism, connecting inland actions to ocean health.

properties.title: International Fisheries Conservation Program
properties.description: Catalyzes sustainable global fisheries management through science-based harvest strategies, enforcement systems, and protection of vulnerable species like sharks and sea turtles across Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans since 2019.

properties.title: Gray Whale Research in Mexico
properties.description: Monitoring gray whales in Laguna San Ignacio & Bahia Magdalena, Baja California Sur. Studies breeding/calving whales, dolphins, sea turtles, sea lions, fish, shellfish & migratory birds. Trains future marine biologists.

properties.title: St. Croix Leatherback Project

properties.title: Ocean Connectors

properties.title: Removing Barriers to Effective Fisheries Transparency in the EU and Beyond
properties.description: EU IUU Coalition campaigns to improve EU fleet transparency, minimize flags of convenience impacts, and raise international fisheries standards through cooperation with NGOs in Brussels, USA, and Japan.

properties.title: Australia and Southern Ocean Protected Areas
properties.description: Expanding Australia's marine sanctuary protection to 30% of EEZ by 2030 through marine park reviews and network expansion, leveraging political momentum and scientific standards for habitat protection.

properties.title: Establishing the Joint Analytical Cell
properties.description: TMT, GFW & IMCSN collaborate to detect/deter IUU fishing, increase transparency, build MCS capacity in developing countries, and support global fisheries policy through shared intelligence tools and databases.

properties.title: Improving Fisheries Transparency in Fiji

properties.title: Improving Transparency and Accountability at RFMOs

properties.title: Fisheries Transparency in the Mediterranean
properties.description: Med Sea Alliance works with EU & non-EU states to increase transparency & anti-IUU measures in Mediterranean fisheries through GFCM, partnering with Morocco, Tunisia, Turkey, Albania, Egypt to improve implementation.

properties.title: Future of European Fisheries

properties.title: Republic of Ireland Protected Areas

properties.title: Small Grant Supporting Indonesian Fisheries Reform
properties.description: Indonesian think tank supports government with evidence-based fisheries policy, combating IUU fishing, harmful gear, and modern slavery while strengthening small-scale fishing communities through 2024.

properties.title: Improving Human Rights in Indonesia and Taiwan

properties.title: Reducing IUU Fishing in Cambodia and Vietnam

properties.title: Protected Areas and OECMs in Japan
properties.description: Expanding Japan's MPAs to 30% by 2030 through effective biodiversity conservation, monitoring, and stakeholder engagement with fishermen and citizens in model areas across Japan's EEZ.

properties.title: Strengthening Partnerships Towards Philippines National 30x30
properties.description: Multi-NGO partnership supporting Philippines' 30x30 conservation target. Develops roadmap with Biodiversity Management Bureau to set national targets and identify priority marine areas through participatory approach.

properties.title: Combating IUU in Indonesia

properties.title: Advancing Yellow Sea Conservation Efforts and Creating an MPA Network in China

properties.title: Improving Transparency and Fisheries Reform in Taiwan

properties.title: Building a National Alliance of Fishers for Policy Advocacy on Sustainable Fisheries and Livelihoods
properties.description: 18-month project uniting small-scale fishers across Philippines to combat illegal fishing & advocate policy reform. Builds national alliance through consultations, creating unified agenda against IUUF threatening $1.3B annually.

properties.description: Protect 10km2 Daejung coastal area as Marine Life Protected Area for Indo-Pacific Bottlenose Dolphins through government advocacy, expert workshops, community engagement, and public campaigns by end of 2023.

properties.title: Sustainable Fisheries and Protected Areas in Sri Lanka

properties.title: Improving South Korea's Marine Conservation

properties.title: Combatting Illegal Unregulated Squid Fisheries

properties.title: Timor-Leste 30x30 Strategy
properties.description: Supporting Timor-Leste to protect 30% of marine waters by 2030 through MPA network expansion, management effectiveness tools, capacity building, and science-based policies integrating traditional Tara Bandu practices.

properties.description: Develops standardized tools to estimate, monitor IUU fishing in Chile's small-scale fisheries. Co-designed with government to improve enforcement and guide policy for new fisheries law, transferable to Latin America.

properties.title: Small-Scale Fisheries in South Africa
properties.description: Improving sustainability of small-scale fisheries in South Africa while building positive relationships between MPAs and vulnerable rural fishers dependent on marine resources for livelihoods and food security.

properties.title: Combatting IUU Fishing in Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana (The Guianas)

properties.title: Bermuda Ocean Prosperity Programme - Protected Areas

properties.title: Partnering to Advance Hawaii's Marine 30x30 Initiative
properties.description: Supporting Hawaii to effectively manage 30% of nearshore waters as marine management areas by 2030 through community stewardship, science, and governance to restore abundance and protect marine resources.

properties.title: The Bahamas Offshore Drilling Campaign Phase Two
properties.description: Coalition educates Bahamians on offshore oil drilling impacts. Launched Apr 2020 by Waterkeepers Bahamas & BREEF. Pressures government through advocacy, petitions, stakeholder engagement to prevent drilling in Bahamas waters.

properties.title: Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary Designation Campaign
properties.description: Indigenous-led campaign to designate 150-mile sanctuary off California coast protecting kelp, marine life, cultural sites from oil/gas extraction. NOAA review launched 2021, completion expected 2023 in San Luis Obispo-Santa Barbara.

properties.title: Supporting Marine Spatial Planning under the Bermuda Ocean Prosperity Programme
properties.description: Bermuda govt, Waitt Institute & BIOS collaborate on Blue Economy via Marine Spatial Planning. Stakeholder-led process to optimize marine industries, protect 20% of 465,000 km² EEZ through science & public input.

properties.title: Cayman Crown: The Jewel of the Mesoamerican Reef
properties.description: Protecting Cayman Crown reef on Guatemala-Belize border as no-take zone. Establishes legal protection, monitors fish spawning aggregations, strengthens sustainable finance. Aims to replenish commercial fish stocks across MAR.

properties.title: Fisheries Subsidies in Latin America
properties.description: AIDA advocates for reforming harmful fisheries subsidies in Latin America through governance and policy work to protect depleted fisheries, promote coastal livelihoods, and conserve marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Rebuilding Cuban Fisheries
properties.description: Why: Overfishing threatens coral reefs & fish populations. What: Science-based fishery management. How: Build capacity, strengthen institutions, policy reform, integrate MPAs. Where: Cuba. When: Ongoing

properties.title: Strengthening & Expanding Protected Areas in Canada
properties.description: SeaBlue Canada coalition works to protect 25% of Canada's ocean by 2025, 30% by 2030 across all three coasts through science-based marine protection, Indigenous partnerships, and community engagement.

properties.title: Cape Verde Marine Protected Areas Network
properties.description: Strengthening Cape Verde's MPA network to protect migrant megafauna (whales, sharks, turtles) and local species from fishing pressure. Creating safe corridors with participatory management involving local communities.

properties.title: Improving Fisheries Governance in Ghana and the Wider Sub-Region
properties.description: Strengthens fisheries governance in Ghana & West Africa through transparency, law enforcement & collaborative management to combat illegal fishing & prevent collapse of small pelagic fisheries critical to 2.7M livelihoods.

properties.title: Fish Meal Plants in West Africa
properties.description: Prevent fishmeal/fish oil industry from destroying West African fish stocks via 3-year research, investigation & advocacy program. Secure legislative changes to protect ecosystems & food sovereignty through civil society engagement.

properties.title: New Regional Transparency Policy in Southern Africa
properties.description: Reduce illegal fishing in SADC region by developing regional transparency policy aligned with Global Charter. Demonstrate benefits through vessel assessment/inspection, gain support for SADC fishing vessel register standards.

properties.title: Strait of Magellan Marine Reserves
properties.description: Rewilding Chile creates marine parks in Chilean Patagonia, removing salmon farms from protected waters. Aims to increase coastal protection from <1% to 10% through no-take zones in the Route of Parks.

properties.title: Scaling Community-Based Fisheries Management in Mozambique
properties.description: Rare's Fish Forever program establishes managed access areas and no-take marine reserves in 6 coastal communities, reaching 8,000 fishers to combat overfishing and protect biodiversity through community-led management.

properties.title: Marine Biodiversity Protection in Mozambique and Tanzania
properties.description: WCS enhances protection of Western Indian Ocean biodiversity hotspots (mangroves, coral reefs, seagrass) through community-based MPA design in Mozambique and Tanzania, addressing threats from unregulated fishing and development.

properties.title: Sustainability and traceability of small-scale fisheries in São Paulo, Brazil
properties.description: Establishes market incentives for sustainable fishing in North Coast MPA, São Paulo. Uses traceability tech on vessels to track catch origin, gear, practices. Connects fishers to restaurants via QR codes, rewarding sustainability.

properties.title: Ending Destructive Industrial Fishing in Madagascar and the Western Indian Ocean
properties.description: Blue Ventures combats IUU fishing in Madagascar's waters, supporting authorities to monitor fisheries, improve transparency, and protect small-scale fisher rights. Addresses $80M annual losses from illegal industrial fleets.

properties.title: Small Grant MPA Workshop to Aid the Establishment of a New Large MPA in the Dutch Caribbean
properties.description: Workshop in Aruba bringing Dutch Caribbean islands together to share MPA best practices, explore management options, and expand MPA network across the region with government officials, NGOs, and international experts.

properties.title: Improving Fishery Management and Stopping IUU Fishing in Cameroon
properties.description: Combat illegal fishing in Cameroon by strengthening governance, legal frameworks, and monitoring systems. Revise legislation, enhance control systems, and develop fishery management plans. Started March 2022 for 3 years.

properties.title: An NGO Alliance to Protect and Extend European MPAs
properties.description: 4-year project by Oceana & Seas At Risk to protect European MPAs from destructive fishing, establish EU restoration law targets (10% strict protection, 15% restoration), and create no-take zones in 4+ countries.

properties.title: Protected Areas and Transparency in Cameroon
properties.description: Supports Douala-Edea MPA management covering 10% EEZ, combats illegal industrial fishing in mangroves/territorial waters, strengthens community surveillance and advocacy to protect endangered species and artisanal fisheries.

properties.title: Effective Management of the Marine Protected Areas of the Comoros Archipelago
properties.description: Strengthens management of 4 coastal MPAs in Comoros to protect marine biodiversity, restore fisheries, support Blue Economy Plan. Enhances resilience of coastal communities dependent on ocean assets in Western Indian Ocean.

properties.title: Namibia Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: Supporting Namibia's NIMPA (10,000km² MPA) management plan development and future MPA designation to reach 10% EEZ protection. Addressing lack of enforcement, regulations for Africa's 2nd largest MPA along Benguela Current.

properties.title: Protecting the Sea of Okhotsk and Northern Kuril Islands
properties.description: Building on WWF Russia's conservation planning to protect bowhead whales and sea otters in the Sea of Okhotsk through creating a conservation action plan and supporting MPA designation in priority biodiversity areas.

properties.title: Reinforcing Fisheries Governance in Guinea
properties.description: Combats illegal fishing in Guinea through policy reform, transparency improvement, and technical capacity building. Strengthens fisheries governance and sustainable management of marine resources along Guinea's coast.

properties.title: New Policies to Combat IUU Fishing in Taiwan
properties.description: Shaping Taiwan's fishing industry from within by promoting transparency, legal enforcement & self-discipline measures as indicators toward sustainable fisheries, exploring alternatives to surface-level policy demands.

properties.title: Reinforcing the Fight Against IUU Fishing in Senegal
properties.description: Combats illegal fishing in Senegal through improved governance, transparency, and enforcement. Strengthens fisheries management, builds stakeholder capacity, implements FiTI standards, and enhances regional cooperation to protect overexploited stocks

properties.title: Protect the Protected Area of Baía do Inferno, Cabo Verde
properties.description: Protecting seabird colonies & marine biodiversity in Baía do Inferno MPA through management plan development, sustainable fishing practices, community engagement with fishermen, and conservation of sea turtles, sharks & endemic species.

properties.title: Transparency in New Zealand Fisheries
properties.description: WWF NZ designs full transparency model to eliminate illegal/unethical fishing in NZ waters. Partners with industry/government to shift fisheries policy, enable traceability, create global benchmark for sustainable practices.

properties.title: Korea Coalition Against IUU: Towards Sustainable and Ethical Fisheries in Korea
properties.description: Coalition addresses IUU fishing in Korea through legal reform, labor rights protection, port/flag state compliance with international standards, and public education to transform fisheries practices.

properties.title: Africa-China Distant Water Fishing Transparency Track II Dialogue
properties.description: Track II dialogue between West African states and China to increase transparency in distant water fishing, combat IUU fishing, and develop recommendations for better fisheries management in West Africa.

properties.title: Indonesia Ocean Justice Initiative
properties.description: Policy advocacy promoting sustainable ocean governance in Indonesia through enforcement support, international advocacy, policy reform & access to justice. Addresses plastic pollution, illegal fishing & climate impacts.

properties.title: EU Transparency and Control Regulation
properties.description: Coalition strengthening EU fisheries Control Regulation through Remote Electronic Monitoring, electronic reporting for all vessels, and transparency requirements to ensure compliance and sustainable fisheries across EU waters.

properties.title: Advancing Effective Co-Management of Marine Ecosystems in Cambodia's Kampot and Kep Provinces
properties.description: Protecting Cambodia's coral reefs, seagrass meadows & marine life through co-management. Creating new MPA in Kampot & operationalizing Kep MFMA to combat destructive fishing & coastal development threats.

properties.title: Our Islands, Our Future
properties.description: Coalition campaign to stop Bahamas Petroleum Company offshore drilling through advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and litigation. Aims to protect Bahamas' tourism and fisheries from oil pollution risks.

properties.title: Who Stole Our Oceans: Empowering Local Communities to Protect Our Oceans
properties.description: Empowers South African coastal communities to protect ocean ecosystems through skills training and network building. Addresses overfishing, climate change, and oil/gas threats while advocating for MPAs and sustainable livelihoods.

properties.title: Advocating for the passing of shark conservation policies and preparation for their implementation
properties.description: Establish legal frameworks for shark conservation in Philippines, support CITES listings for threatened shark/ray species, promote sustainable fisheries and protect marine biodiversity through policy advocacy.

properties.title: Standard for Ultimate Beneficial Ownership Reporting
properties.description: Establishing global standard for beneficial ownership reporting in fishing industry to combat IUU fishing. C4ADS, Pew & TMT define UBO, analyze fleet ownership networks to enable better regulation & enforcement.

properties.title: Technological Tools and Policy Innovation as a Tool to Eliminate and Prevent IUU Fishing
properties.description: Colombia combats illegal fishing through vessel registry platform, environmental jurisdiction, judicial capacity building for Port State Measures Agreement compliance and sustainable fisheries.

properties.title: MPA Guide - CBD Post-2020 Ocean Protection Campaign
properties.description: Coordinates grantees to secure 30% ocean protection by 2030 through CBD negotiations. Partners with UN agencies, scientists, NGOs via OneOcean flotilla. Targets quantitative/qualitative MPA goals in post-2020 agenda. March 2020-2021.

properties.title: Joint Campaign on IUU Fishing Transparency and Human Rights
properties.description: Oceana, WWF, CSIS combat illegal fishing in US seafood imports via trade sanctions, supply chain reform, AIS transparency, and linking IUU fishing to human rights abuses. Targets $1B annual illegal catch.

properties.title: Protecting Japan's Seafood Market from IUU Fish: Establishing Traceability and Transparency Systems
properties.description: Anti-IUU Forum Japan works to eliminate illegal seafood from Japanese markets through import controls, catch documentation, and transparency in fishery management. Builds on 2016-2019 momentum to transform systems.

properties.title: Arctic Ocean Protection in Canada
properties.description: Protecting Canadian Arctic marine ecosystems threatened by industrial development and climate change through Indigenous partnerships, research, and policy to ensure resilient oceans for future generations.

properties.title: Charting a Course to Sustainable Fisheries Post-Brexit
properties.description: RSPB, MCS & WWF-UK collaborate to influence UK post-Brexit fisheries legislation for sustainable, climate-positive regulations. Advocacy for binding commitments: 30% protected seas by 2030, end overfishing, REM on vessels, net zero strategy.

properties.title: Taiwan Flags of Convenience
properties.description: Supports Taiwan's control of foreign-flagged vessels with Taiwanese ownership to combat IUU fishing and labor abuses. Partners provide data tools, intelligence, and global cooperation to implement Taiwan's FOC vessel governance act.

properties.title: Combating IUU Fishing in South American Squid Fisheries
properties.description: Engaging Latin American producers and global supply chains to combat illegal fishing in jumbo flying squid and Argentine shortfin squid fisheries through transparency tools and market-based approaches.

properties.title: Increasing Transparency and Accountability in the EU
properties.description: ClientEarth holds EU accountable to end overfishing by securing sustainable catch limits, enforcing no-discards rule, closing subsidy loopholes, and preventing weakening of Common Fisheries Policy across 27 member states.

properties.title: Supporting Vietnamese Fisheries Reform
properties.description: Builds on Vietnam's revised fisheries law to scale co-management practices across 6 coastal sites in Binh Dinh, Quang Nam & Khanh Hoa provinces, developing national guidelines & training 35 champions for sustainable fisheries.

properties.title: To Support Establishment of MPAs in Antarctic Waters
properties.description: Campaign to establish marine protected areas in Antarctic waters through CCAMLR. Built international coalition to advocate for conservation, resulting in creation of Ross Sea MPA, the largest on Earth.

properties.title: To Support New MPA Policies from Arctic Council
properties.description: Coalition developing interconnected MPA network across circumpolar Arctic. Addresses climate change impacts & human activity threats. Leverages Arctic Council meetings to establish ecologically significant protection network.

properties.title: Improving Traceability Policy Work in Japan
properties.description: Seafood Legacy designs traceability models for imported & domestic seafood in Japan to combat IUU fishing, working with NGOs & industry. CEO advises Cabinet Office on robust regulation & transparent supply chains.

properties.title: Support Establishment of Seafood Traceability Regulations
properties.description: Combat illegal fishing by developing US regulations ensuring all seafood is legally sourced and traceable from bait to plate, closing major market to illegal imports and driving global traceability standards.

properties.title: Curbing Destructive Fishing in Nicaragua
properties.description: Eliminated blast-fishing & bottom trawling on Nicaragua's Pacific coast to protect sea turtles (Olive Ridley, Hawksbill, Leatherback). Established MPAs, strengthened fisheries compliance, enabled sustainable artisanal fishing & tourism.

properties.title: Transparency and Fish Refuges in Mexico
properties.description: COBI creates science-based fish refuges through community participation while Causa Natura uses data platforms to increase transparency in fisheries policy, subsidies, and combating illegal fishing across Mexico's waters.

properties.title: National Marine Monument Coalition
properties.description: Coalition of 30+ NGOs coordinated advocacy for U.S. marine monument designations. Resulted in Papahanaumokuakea expansion (2016) and Northeast Canyons monument creation, protecting 2.1M km² of ocean.

properties.title: Protecting Russia's Arctic
properties.description: WWF Russia works to establish 6 new Arctic marine reserves from Beringia to Victoria Island through scientific assessments and community consultations, building on Putin's 2013 commitment to expand conservation areas.

properties.title: Advancing Marine Protected Areas in The Bahamas
properties.description: Expanding Bahamas MPA network from 10% to 20% by 2020 across 700 islands. Developing management plans, by-laws, and sustainable finance for protected areas covering nearshore and deep ocean habitats.

properties.title: To Strengthen Fisheries Enforcement in Eastern Tropical Pacific Ocean
properties.description: Combat IUU fishing in Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador marine reserves (Cocos, Coiba, Malpelo, Galapagos). Strengthen enforcement, radar facility, vessel registries, Port State Measures Agreement. 2012-2015.

properties.title: Improving Fisheries in the Mesoamerican Reef
properties.description: Improves fisheries data collection and marine surveillance in Honduras and Belize through electronic licensing, vessel tracking, and catch documentation systems to enhance sustainable fisheries management in the Mesoamerican Reef.

properties.title: Electronic Monitoring for Pacific Tuna
properties.description: TNC assists Pacific Island govts to deploy video cameras, sensors & GPS on longline tuna vessels in Western & Central Pacific Ocean to combat illegal fishing that costs $7B annually & threatens sustainability

properties.title: Expanding Pacific Remote Islands Monument
properties.description: Expanded Pacific Remote Islands Marine Monument from 225,000 to 1.2M sq km, protecting pristine tropical marine environments around 7 islands. Built public support through advocacy. Completed Sept 2014.

properties.title: Establishing an MPA Network in South Africa
properties.description: Building public support for MPAs to achieve 10% ocean protection by 2020. 20 new/expanded MPAs approved (50,000 km2, 5% EEZ). Countering oil/mining threats, promoting ecosystem services, food security, climate resilience.

properties.title: Protecting the Phoenix Islands
properties.description: Supporting implementation of Phoenix Islands Protected Area (PIPA), 400,000 km² marine reserve in Kiribati. Fully protected since Jan 2015. Funds support management, surveillance, enforcement of pristine Pacific waters.

properties.title: Coordinating Compliance Management in the Central ETP
properties.description: PACIFICO supports ministers to develop Regional Marine Strategy for compliance management across 2.15M km² Central Eastern Tropical Pacific, coordinating Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Panama via data sharing & transparency.

properties.title: Marine Spatial Planning in the Eastern Caribbean
properties.description: Debt-for-nature swap enabling Grenada, Dominica & Saint Lucia to create 22,000 km² marine managed areas & no-take zones through marine spatial planning, addressing conservation & climate adaptation needs.

properties.title: Northern Bering Sea Protected Area
properties.description: Bering Sea Elders Group protects northern Bering Sea ecosystem & tribal culture. Addresses climate change, sea ice loss, increased shipping/fishing. Builds community resilience, ensures food security for 60+ tribes.

properties.title: Improving China's Domestic Fisheries
properties.description: NRDC provides legal/technical support for China's fisheries law revision (first since 2000). Promotes sustainable management, catch monitoring systems to restore depleted species and reduce distant water fishing pressure.

properties.title: Controlling Illegal Fishing in Europe
properties.description: Advocacy campaign to improve EU IUU Regulation implementation, combating illegal fishing through transparency in seafood supply chains. Four NGOs work in Brussels and EU states to protect marine biodiversity and legal fishers.

properties.title: Expanding the Ring of Life for the Russian Marine Arctic
properties.description: WWF-Russia expands marine protected areas in Russian Arctic since 2014. Protects biodiversity from shipping, unsustainable fishing. New Siberian Islands designated as largest reserve, 4 more MPAs pending approval.

properties.title: Support Identification of Beneficial Owners of Purse Seine Fleet
properties.description: C4ADS maps ownership of global tuna purse seine vessels using open-source data and corporate network analysis to identify beneficial owners, increasing transparency to combat IUU fishing and support industry accountability.

properties.title: Shark Conservation Fund
properties.description: Halts overexploitation of sharks and rays globally through trade regulation, legal protections, and sustainable fishing measures. Focuses on CITES listings, preventing extinctions, and policy advocacy.

properties.title: Protecting and Financing Cuba's Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: WCS strengthens Cuba's MPA system covering 15,000 km2 (21.5% territorial waters). Focus on Gardens of the Queen, Zapata Swamp, and Los Colorados. Develops sustainable financing and protection mechanisms.

properties.title: Evaluating Distant Water Fishing Fleets
properties.description: Research by Stimson Center mapping top 10 distant water fishing fleets globally, analyzing their geostrategic impacts, operations, hotspots, and role in food/economic/geopolitical security and international tensions.

properties.title: Increasing Fishing Transparency and Combating IUU Fishing in West Africa
properties.description: TMT & Global Fishing Watch track industrial fishing in West African waters, expose illegal operations, strengthen regional enforcement capacity, and improve fisheries intelligence sharing to combat IUU fishing.

properties.title: Combatting IUU Fishing in Japan
properties.description: Combat illegal fishing in Japan (13-31% of catches). Research economic impacts of IUU imports, engage government & industry stakeholders to accelerate Japan's fight against IUU fishing & protect depleted fish stocks.

properties.title: Accelerating Marine Reserves
properties.description: Compiling lessons learned and analyzing challenges in establishing marine reserves globally. Aims to accelerate protection toward 30% ocean coverage through expert consultation and identifying opportunities for effective no-take zones.

properties.title: Protecting the Seychelles
properties.description: Debt-for-nature swap creating Indian Ocean's 2nd largest marine reserve & climate resilience trust fund in Seychelles archipelago. TNC & Island Conservation Society work with govt on science-based conservation.

properties.title: Support Establishment of Cook Islands Marine Park
properties.description: Supporting traditional Maori leaders & local groups to create 1.1M km² marine park in Southern Cook Islands through community consultations, legal frameworks & communications. Started 2013, 3-year funding.

properties.title: Protecting the South Atlantic from IUU Fishing and Human Rights Abuses
properties.description: Combat illegal fishing & human rights abuses in Southwest Atlantic via Port of Montevideo controls, dialogue, sustainable fishing promotion & youth awareness in Uruguay's rich marine environment.

properties.title: To Establish Marine Reserves in the UK Overseas Territories
properties.description: Great British Oceans campaign calling for UK to protect 1.75M km² across Pitcairn, Ascension, South Georgia & South Sandwich Islands. Safeguards penguins, whales, turtles, sharks in pristine waters.

properties.title: Transforming Tonga's Ocean Management
properties.description: Supporting Tonga's first marine spatial plan covering 700,000 km2 with 30% MPA network. Includes national consultations, awareness programs, and regulatory implementation by 2020 for sustainable ocean development.

properties.title: Protecting the Adriatic Sea
properties.description: Limiting overfishing and protecting habitat in the Adriatic Sea through Fisheries Restricted Areas, vessel tracking, and fishing capacity controls. Targets bottom-dwelling species recovery in Mediterranean's most productive area.

properties.title: Transshipment Governance in the Western and Central Pacific Ocean
properties.description: Reform transshipment governance in WCPO to combat $142M annual IUU fishing. Pew, WWF, ANCORS & FFA review monitoring gaps, develop standards for tuna transfer oversight at sea and in port across Pacific nations. 2017-2020.

properties.title: To Support Establishment of MPAs in Antarctica
properties.description: Supporting Antarctic and Southern Ocean Coalition to create marine protected areas in East Antarctic, Weddell Sea, and Antarctic Peninsula by 2020, protecting penguins, whales, seals through CCAMLR consensus-building.

properties.title: Protecting Canada's Marine and Coastal Environment
properties.description: Collaborative project to achieve 10% marine protection by 2020 in Canada's Pacific/Atlantic coasts. Focuses on high biodiversity areas, Indigenous Protected Areas, improving Oceans Act processes, engaging stakeholders.

properties.title: To Support Development of Protective Deep Sea Mining Regulations
properties.description: 3-year project to enhance transparency and regulate deep sea mining through ISA. Strengthens seabed mining regulations, improves ISA decision-making, secures no-take areas to protect deep sea biodiversity hotspots.

properties.title: To Support Listing of Shark Species at CITES
properties.description: Coalition secured CITES Appendix II listing for 5 threatened shark species (porbeagle, oceanic whitetip, 3 hammerheads) at 2013 meeting through research, advocacy. Makes trade sustainable, legal, transparent via export permits.

properties.title: Improving Transparency in South Korea and Taiwan
properties.description: Coalition addressing IUU fishing in South Korea through legal reforms, transparency improvements in distant water/domestic fleets, labor rights protection, and industry due diligence on fishing practices.

properties.title: Restoring Seagrass to Protect from Coastal Erosion
properties.description: Why: Protect village from coastal erosion. What: Seagrass replanting. How: Local teenagers led by resident & marine scientist. Where: West Yensawai, Raja Ampat, Indonesia. When: 2022

properties.title: Aqaba Marine Park Project
properties.description: Jordan's first marine reserve in Gulf of Aqaba to protect unique heat-resistant coral reefs, establish marine biology research center, and promote ecotourism. Launched 2021 with international advisory board.

properties.title: Kuriat Islands Tunisia - Environmental Police Training
properties.description: Notre Grand Bleu trained environmental police on Kuriat Islands, Tunisia (April 2019) to strengthen capacity for preserving the marine environment and protected island ecosystem.

properties.title: Sandy Island Oyster Bed Marine Protected Area
properties.description: 787-hectare MPA in Carriacou protecting coral reefs, mangroves, seagrass beds. Launched after 10 years of community consultation. Co-managed to balance conservation with local fishing, employs community wardens, installed moorings.
properties.funder: The Nature Conservancy, USAID, CREP, Sustainable Grenadines Project

properties.title: Karaburun-Sazan Marine Protected Area Surveillance
properties.description: RAPA Vlora team increased patrolling by 50% in Karaburun-Sazan, Albania to control illegal fishing and raise awareness about marine protection rules since 2017.

properties.title: BULA Reef
properties.description: World's largest underwater coral nursery (16x45m) transplanting 1000+ heat-resistant coral colonies rescued from stressed areas. Part of UNESCO-endorsed Reefs of Hope program to prevent coral extinction and reef collapse in Fiji.
properties.funder: Plantation Island Resort, Corals for Conservation (C4C)

properties.title: Lancement d'un nouveau partenariat de cogestion de cinq ans pour l'AMP de Ras Rmel en Tunisie
properties.description: 5-year co-management partnership for Djerba Ras Rmel MPA. $287k funding for governance, stakeholder engagement, scientific monitoring, gender equality & sustainable economic activities. APAL, Jlij NGO & MedFund collaboration.

properties.title: Alonissos Marine Protected Area Conservation
properties.description: MedFund supports Alonissos-Northern Sporades National Marine Park (2300 km²) protecting Mediterranean monk seals through scientific monitoring, surveillance, stakeholder engagement. Oct 2025, Greece.
properties.funder: The MedFund, MAVA Foundation, PBOL Initiative

properties.title: Connected by the Reef – Te firi a'au
properties.description: Global observation of Porites rus coral spawning to determine reef connectivity. 426 observations across 18 islands show synchronized spawning from French Polynesia to La Réunion. Mobilizing observers in 47+ countries.

properties.title: Stari Ulcinj Marine Protected Area Support
properties.description: Why: Protect marine biodiversity. What: 9.29 km² MPA. How: $287k over 5 years for management, monitoring, awareness. When: April 2024-2029. Where: Stari Ulcinj, Montenegro coast.

properties.title: Suivis scientifiques à Karaburun-Sazan, Albanie
properties.description: Long-term scientific monitoring in Albania's first marine park. Mapping seagrass, water quality tests, tracking Cystoseira algae, Posidonia meadows, lithophyllum formations. Training local teams for autonomous monitoring.

properties.title: Karaburun Sazan Marine Protected Area Surveillance
properties.description: Flag Pine & RAPA Vlore increased patrols by 50% at Karaburun Sazan MPA in Albania to control illegal fishing and raise awareness of regulations among users.

properties.title: Exploration d'un nouveau partenariat avec l'Égypte pour la conservation de la mer Méditerranée
properties.description: MedFund explores partnership with Egypt's EEAA to support Mediterranean MPAs. Goal: 40 MPAs in 10 countries by 2030. Discussions at COP24 Cairo on Egypt's coastal MPA network expansion and governance models.

properties.title: Automating Coral Reef Transect Analysis
properties.description: Developing automated analysis methods for coral reef transect data collected during the Global Reef Expedition to improve efficiency and accuracy of reef monitoring and assessment.
properties.funder: Khaled bin Sultan Living Oceans Foundation

properties.title: Creation of a New Protected Area in Southwestern Haiti
properties.description: Haiti created Protected Area of Natural Resources Management of Port Salut/Aquin in Aug 2013, covering 150,000 hectares of mixed marine/terrestrial sites in southwestern Haiti to protect coastal and marine resources.

properties.title: Iles Kuriat – Tunisie
properties.description: Training for environmental police to strengthen capacity for environmental preservation in Kuriat Islands, Tunisia. Organized by Notre Grand Bleu on April 3-4, 2019.

properties.title: At the Water's Edge (AWE) - Grenada Coral Reef Restoration
properties.description: Hybrid submerged breakwater with coral restoration in Grenville Bay to reduce coastal erosion and flooding. Combines engineering with reef ecology to protect communities from climate impacts.

properties.title: Coral Reef Ecology Curriculum
properties.description: Free online educational platform with 14 units on coral reef ecology, quizzes, videos, and lesson plans for global STEAM education. Expanding to Living Oceans Academy covering reefs, mangroves, and seagrass.

properties.title: Assessing Coral Reef Health and Resiliency
properties.description: Global coral reef survey mapping health & resilience. Uses satellites, field data to assess biodiversity, bleaching, stressors. Covers Pacific, Indian Ocean, Red Sea reefs. Informs conservation strategies.
properties.funder: Khaled bin Sultan Living Oceans Foundation

properties.title: J.A.M.I.N. - Jamaica Awareness of Mangroves in Nature
properties.description: 10-year mangrove education program empowering Jamaican students through hands-on restoration. Students propagate & plant thousands of seedlings, collect data, learn coastal protection & biodiversity value at sites like Jobson Bay.
properties.funder: Khaled bin Sultan Living Oceans Foundation

properties.title: Reefs at Risk Activity and Coloring Book
properties.description: Educational coloring book teaching children about coral reef ecosystems, threats from climate change, overfishing & pollution through interactive STEAM activities. Aims to inspire understanding of reef conservation.

properties.title: Philanthropie bleue : protéger les mers et les océans
properties.description: Multi-foundation initiative supporting ocean conservation: depollution (Wings of Ocean), biodiversity (coral reefs), research (Tara Ocean), coastal adaptation. French coasts & global. 2018-ongoing. Collective action model.

properties.title: Mapping the World's Coral Reefs
properties.description: Global coral reef mapping using satellites & field surveys. Created 65,000+ km² high-res habitat maps via Global Reef Expedition (2011-ongoing). Assesses reef health, biodiversity & resilience worldwide.
properties.funder: Khaled bin Sultan Living Oceans Foundation

properties.title: Science Without Borders®: Conserving the Tropics
properties.description: UN-endorsed project addressing ocean stressors on tropical ecosystems. Combines research, community engagement, and monitoring in Pacific regions like Fiji's Beqa Lagoon to protect coral reefs from bleaching and cyclones.
properties.funder: Khaled bin Sultan Living Oceans Foundation

properties.title: Ocean Action 2030 - Sustainable Ocean Plans
properties.description: Global initiative supporting coastal nations in developing Sustainable Ocean Plans for 100% marine area management by 2030. Combines research, policy, public-private partnerships for ocean conservation and sustainable blue economy.

properties.title: Littoral & mer - Programme pionnier pour des territoires résilients et solidaires
properties.description: 15-year program (2011-2024) supporting 226 coastal/marine projects across France & overseas territories. Focus: climate adaptation, ecosystem restoration, participatory governance, coastal erosion prevention. €23M invested.

properties.title: Créer du lien pour une pêche locale durable
properties.description: Pleine Mer links artisan fishers with consumers via participatory map (530 points, 1M+ uses). Launches 'Mer de Liens' solidarity fund to buy boats/quotas for young fishers. Advocacy against industrial fishing.

properties.title: Science Without Borders
properties.description: Financial sponsorship of marine conservation programs and scientific research to promote public awareness of preserving, protecting, and restoring the world's oceans and aquatic resources globally.

properties.title: Agir ensemble pour l'océan
properties.description: Collective call to protect ocean & coastal biodiversity, sustainable fishing, marine pollution reduction. 220+ participatory research projects funded since 2011. Launched for UN Ocean Conference 2025 in Nice.

properties.title: Red Sea Coral Reef Conservation and Mapping
properties.description: KSLOF maps & assesses Red Sea coral reefs, partners with Saudi authorities on restoration, COTS management & blue hole research. Ongoing since 2005 across Saudi Arabian Red Sea to protect heat-tolerant reefs.
properties.funder: Khaled bin Sultan Living Oceans Foundation

properties.title: Océan 2025
properties.description: Why: Oceans threatened by climate change, pollution, overfishing. What: Fund marine conservation projects. How: Grants to NGOs (Surfrider, SMILO), nature-based solutions, sustainable fishing. When: 2025. Where: France coastal & overseas

properties.title: Sea'ties - Aider les villes du littoral à s'adapter à l'élévation du niveau de la mer
properties.description: International program helping 40 coastal cities adapt to sea level rise through sharing scientific data and best practices. Covers protection, accommodation and relocation strategies across 6 global regions.

properties.title: Global Reef Expedition
properties.description: Worldwide coral reef mapping & characterization to assess health, resiliency, threats. Data shared with communities to inspire conservation. Examines coral resistance to disturbances.
properties.funder: Khaled bin Sultan Living Oceans Foundation

properties.title: Dastum - Interactive Coastal Plastic Collection App
properties.description: Mobile app for interactive coastal walks combining environmental awareness and plastic waste collection on Brittany coastlines. Free download, gamified cleanup experience, expanding to new coastal sites.

properties.title: Océan mon amour ! - Protection des fonds marins
properties.description: Fondation Léa Nature/Jardin BiO' funds marine conservation projects protecting seabeds through citizen campaigns. 2015-2017 call for projects supporting associations in ocean floor protection, based in La Rochelle.

properties.title: Journées Littoral et Mer 2022
properties.description: Conference in La Rochelle (June 9-10, 2022) bringing together 130+ stakeholders to share best practices on coastal adaptation to climate change, erosion, and sea level rise through science-society partnerships.

properties.title: Islands Environmental and Social Challenges Program
properties.description: Multi-island program addressing climate change impacts, water scarcity, biodiversity preservation, sustainable fishing, and economic development across French islands from Brittany to Polynesia through community participation

properties.title: Programme Littoral et Mer - Adaptation des territoires côtiers au changement climatique
properties.description: Program supporting coastal adaptation projects through participatory research, ecological restoration, nature-based solutions, and citizen mobilization. 2022 edition in La Rochelle focused on sea level rise, erosion, and climate resilience.

properties.title: PALIMMA - Patrimoine Lié à la Mer aux Marquises
properties.description: Marquesas Islands UNESCO bid: 50 workshops documented 900 cultural-marine heritage elements (fishing, navigation, traditional knowledge) linking land-sea-people. Created inventory for marine protected area 2013-2014.

properties.title: Eau et Océan - Réveil Climat de la Coalition Française des Fondations
properties.description: Coalition addresses ocean climate impacts: carbon absorption, acidification, plastic pollution. Actions: scientific data sharing, Mediterranean cleanup, river-to-ocean pollution prevention, youth education. 135k+ youth reached 2021.
properties.funder: Coalition française des fondations pour le climat

properties.title: The Sea Cleaners - Ocean Plastic Pollution Protection
properties.description: Solutions to protect oceans from plastic pollution. Supported by Fondation Nos étoiles pour l'avenir. Family united by climate urgency after witnessing Asia's environmental challenges. Focus on preserving planet for future.

properties.title: Projet ODySéÎles - Trouver des solutions pour lutter contre l'érosion côtière
properties.description: Participatory project engaging islanders from Yeu, Ouvéa, Mayotte & Noirmoutier islands to address climate change & sea level rise impacts through scientific workshops with students seeking coastal erosion solutions.

properties.title: Protéger les océans pour protéger la planète
properties.description: Multi-project initiative protecting oceans & coasts through research, sustainable fishing, plastic cleanup, art, VR mapping. Supports Atlantiles, Pleine Mer, Wings of Ocean, ADAPTO. France & overseas.

properties.title: De la Terre à la Mer, la Jeunesse s'Engage Pour l'Eau
properties.description: 3-year program engaging 12-25 year-olds in coastal ecosystem preservation through immersive activities: species monitoring, invasive species removal, water quality tracking. 10 projects across France & Réunion combining education & action.

properties.title: Nouvelle Vague - Programme d'insertion par la mer
properties.description: 3-year program for 20 youth/year in La Rochelle & Brest. Social-professional insertion through maritime careers, sailing, marine biodiversity workshops, ecosystem studies & beach cleanups. Targets youth in social/educational rupture.

properties.title: ADELE - Microbiomes in Mangroves: a hotspot of biodiversity yet to be explored
properties.description: IRD explores microbial biodiversity in mangroves across French Guiana, Senegal, Vietnam. Inventories microorganisms in water, sediments, and aquatic species to identify environmental determinants. 3-year transdisciplinary research.

properties.title: La Fondation TotalEnergies renouvelle son partenariat avec la SNSM pour cinq ans
properties.description: 5-year partnership renewal supporting French sea rescue volunteers with training, safety equipment (helmets, communication systems, medical devices), and operational gear to secure maritime rescue interventions along French coasts.

properties.title: Le Grand Bleu - Centre de formation aux métiers aquatiques et protection du littoral
properties.description: Training center in Marseille teaching aquatic professions to 400 youth by 2025, integrating marine biodiversity protection modules. Responds to Olympic sailing needs while promoting coastal conservation awareness.

properties.title: La Clé du Littoral
properties.description: Educational program for priority network students to discover coastal ecosystems and maritime professions through week-long immersive stays at Notre-Dame-de-Monts, Vendée. Inaugurated Oct 2024.

properties.title: La Clé du Littoral - Classes de Mer
properties.description: Educational marine program for priority schools at Notre-Dame-de-Monts, Vendée. Students discover coastal ecosystems, dunes, marine life through beach observations, nautical activities (canoe, paddle, catamaran), and climate workshops.

properties.title: Littoral, attention fragile - Programme de conservation du littoral et de la mer
properties.description: Fondation de France funds 85+ research projects since 2011 to protect fragile coastal/marine areas. Focus: climate change impacts, biodiversity, sustainable coastal living. Camargue flamingo study & coastal retreat planning included.

properties.title: Concours Oceano pour Tous 2023-2024
properties.description: Educational contest by Institut océanographique de Monaco rewarding 9 classes for ocean protection projects. 1000+ students created collective, creative projects. EU-labeled 'European Maritime Day in My Country 2024'.

properties.title: Projet Adapto - Gestion souple du trait de côte
properties.description: Adapto explores soft coastal management solutions to address climate change effects on French coastlines. Experimental actions on 10 pilot sites across French maritime facades restore natural coastal equilibria and protective capacities.

properties.title: Préserver l'écosystème des roselières avec la Maison de l'Estuaire
properties.description: Restoration of aging reed beds in Seine estuary reserve through eco-grazing, vegetation export, species monitoring. Youth training via nature workshops. Protects habitat for specialized birds like bittern.

properties.title: Deep Sea Protection and Mining Moratorium Advocacy
properties.description: Minderoo advocates for deep-sea protection from mining. Highlights biodiversity, climate regulation, Pacific Island impacts. Calls for precautionary pause on seabed mining until science-based safeguards exist.

properties.title: Oceano pour Tous 2022-2023
properties.description: Youth ocean education contest where 600 students from 25 classes created concrete actions for ocean protection through video reports, webinars with scientists, and hands-on marine conservation activities.

properties.title: Coral Spawning Research and Reef Resilience at Ningaloo
properties.description: Scientists at Minderoo Exmouth Research Lab study coral spawning and test heat-tolerant Gulf corals to strengthen Ningaloo Reef resilience against marine heatwaves and climate change.

properties.title: Coastal and Ocean Forest Conservation - ONF Partnership
properties.description: 7 projects preserving coastal forests & marine biodiversity: dune restoration in Gironde/Landes, sargassum removal in Martinique, mangrove education in Guadeloupe, beetle inventory in Vendée, reforestation in Mayotte. 2024.

properties.title: Formez-vous et embarquez pour des métiers de la mer
properties.description: CMQ IndMer Bretagne helps 2500 youth discover maritime careers through PRO BREIZH events, training visits, technical workshops, and sailing aboard 'Le Français'. Focuses on job insertion and ecological transitions in Brittany's maritime sector.

properties.title: Oceano pour tous - Ocean Education Program
properties.description: Educational contest by Monaco Oceanographic Institute for disadvantaged youth (12-25) to understand and protect oceans through video projects. 30 classes/year across France and overseas territories. Renewed 2025-2027.

properties.title: ADELE - Microbiomes in Mangroves: a hotspot of biodiversity yet to be explored
properties.description: IRD explores microbial biodiversity in mangroves across French Guiana, Senegal, Vietnam. Inventories microorganisms in water, sediments, aquatic species to identify environmental determinants. 3-year transdisciplinary research.

properties.title: Whale Shark Environmental DNA Research at Ningaloo Reef
properties.description: Researchers use environmental DNA to track whale shark migration patterns at Ningaloo Reef, Western Australia. The project studies ecosystem health and pressures facing the world's largest fish to strengthen conservation efforts.

properties.title: Community eDNA Collection in the South Pacific
properties.description: Sailors collect environmental DNA samples across remote South Pacific waters to help scientists monitor marine species, ecosystems, and conservation pressures through citizen science network.

properties.title: Australian Right Whale Research Program
properties.description: 35-year monitoring program tracking southern right whales at Head of Bight, Great Australian Bight. Photo-ID research shows declining calving rates since 2015 due to climate change impacts on Southern Ocean feeding grounds.

properties.title: Coral Reef Conservation and Climate Change Research
properties.description: Marine biologist Zoe Richards studies coral reef biodiversity across Pacific and Indian Ocean sites. Research documents climate impacts on reefs including 60% coral death at Ningaloo 2024/25. Advocates nature-positive action.

properties.title: STS Leeuwin II Restoration and Repair Project
properties.description: Restoration of sail-training tall ship STS Leeuwin II at Australian Marine Complex WA after container vessel collision. Includes new masts, rigging, sails, underwater repairs for summer sailing season return.
properties.funder: Minderoo Foundation, Seaready Maritime Maintenance Solutions

properties.title: Hifadhi Blu Programme - Gender Action Plan
properties.description: Community-led marine conservation in Western Indian Ocean. Launched 2024 with WIOMSA. Gender Action Plan (2025-29) embeds equity into ocean governance, supporting 70M people dependent on these biodiverse waters.

properties.title: High Seas Treaty Ratification and Implementation
properties.description: Minderoo Foundation supports High Seas Treaty implementation with US$2.8M grants. Establishes marine protected areas in international waters, supports 30x30 goal. Focuses on ratification, compliance, science-based standards.

properties.title: In Focus: Ningaloo Coral Bleaching
properties.description: Scientists assess 2025 coral bleaching at Ningaloo Reef caused by marine heatwave. On-ground research documents climate impacts, coral resilience, spawning activity. Community-led monitoring to protect World Heritage reef.

properties.title: Sri Lankan Blue Whale Project & Oceanswell
properties.description: Dr. Asha de Vos discovered blue whales feeding in Sri Lankan tropical waters, defying scientific norms. She established the Sri Lankan Blue Whale Project and Oceanswell (2017), Sri Lanka's first marine conservation research org, promoting equitable p

properties.title: United Nations Ocean Conference (UNOC3) - Ocean Protection Advocacy
properties.description: Advocacy at UNOC3 in Nice, France to ratify High Seas Treaty, establish Marine Protected Areas for 30x30 goal, deploy eDNA technology, ban destructive fishing, and strengthen Global Plastics Treaty commitments.

properties.title: 30x30: Protecting 30% of Oceans by 2030
properties.description: Global initiative to protect 30% of oceans by 2030 through marine protected areas. Minderoo supports via Blue Nature Alliance, Hifadhi Blu, $10M finance program, OceanOmics monitoring, and policy advocacy. Aims to rebuild fish stocks and ecosystems.

properties.title: eDNA Biodiversity Survey - North West Shelf
properties.description: eDNA survey near Scarborough gas site detected endangered whales & dolphins in 2023. Advocates for eDNA monitoring standards to protect marine biodiversity from fossil fuel expansion through 2070.

properties.title: UNOC3 Ocean Protection Commitments and Minderoo Foundation Investment
properties.description: Minderoo committed AU$170M total to ocean protection at UNOC3 in Nice (June 2025). Funding marine protected areas, eDNA research with UNESCO, vessel tracking, and supporting High Seas Treaty ratification.

properties.title: OceanOmics - Environmental DNA Marine Conservation
properties.description: Using eDNA technology to monitor marine ecosystems across Australian waters. 20+ ocean voyages collecting seawater samples with on-board sequencing lab. Building marine genome reference library to protect ocean biodiversity.

properties.title: Ocean with David Attenborough
properties.description: Documentary film showcasing ocean life wonder and challenges. Co-produced by Silverback Films, Open Planet Studios, and Minderoo Pictures with National Geographic. Global ocean conservation awareness.

properties.title: Global Plastics Treaty Negotiations (INC-5.2)
properties.description: Why: Plastic pollution threatens marine life & ecosystems. What: Global treaty negotiations. How: UN talks to reduce plastic production, phase out toxic chemicals. When: INC-5.2 Aug 5-14, 2025. Where: Geneva

properties.title: Ningaloo Reef Coral Bleaching Response and Assisted Gene Flow Research
properties.description: Minderoo develops heat-resistant corals via selective breeding at Exmouth Research Lab to combat mass bleaching threatening WA's Ningaloo Reef. Testing coral larvae resilience, studying DNA since 2023.

properties.title: OceanOmics eDNA Marine Conservation
properties.description: Minderoo's OceanOmics uses environmental DNA to detect marine species without disturbing them, reshaping ocean conservation through genetic material traces in water to understand and protect marine ecosystems globally.

properties.title: Swan-Canning Ecosystem Restoration Project
properties.description: Restoring shellfish reefs in Swan-Canning estuary. 24 reefs built across 4 sites (6 hectares) to enhance marine life, improve water quality, and restore threatened ecosystems. Goal: 60 reefs by 2030.

properties.title: OceanOmics
properties.description: Why: Ocean biodiversity crisis. What: eDNA tech to monitor marine life. How: Collect seawater samples, analyze DNA, build genomic library. When: 20+ voyages completed. Where: Great Barrier Reef, Ningaloo, Perth Canyon, Abrolhos Islands, SW Australia

properties.title: Ocean Plastics Awareness Through Art
properties.description: Artist Ben von Wong creates large-scale art installations using ocean plastics to raise awareness. Projects include underwater mermaid in 10,000 bottles & 4-story plastic tap at UN. Addresses Great Pacific Garbage Patch.

properties.title: EPICS: AI-Driven Marine Animal Tracking for Manatee Conservation
properties.description: NSF-funded 5-yr project uses AI to enhance photo-ID tracking of Florida manatees in coastal/inland waters. Led by FAU with Mote Marine Lab, develops EPICS system for cost-effective monitoring of survival & reproduction rates.
properties.funder: U.S. National Science Foundation, Paul G. Allen Family Foundation

properties.title: Native Conservancy Ocean Restoration and Regenerative Farming
properties.description: Indigenous-led ocean restoration in Cordova, Alaska. Building regenerative ocean farms, reviving traditional food practices, strengthening marine ecosystems. Founded 2003 by Eyak peoples. Combines traditional knowledge with stewardship.

properties.title: California Marine Sanctuary Foundation - Watersheds to Whales Conservation
properties.description: 30-year science-based program protecting ecosystems from coastal mountains to sea. Addresses climate change, whale protection, water quality, coastal restoration & community resilience in California sanctuaries.

properties.title: Oceans 5 Global Marine Protection Initiative
properties.description: International funders' collaborative stopping overfishing, establishing marine protected areas, and constraining offshore oil/gas development across all five oceans. Addresses top priorities identified by marine scientists worldwide.

properties.title: Shark Biodiversity Initiative
properties.description: Global initiative to protect sharks in 50+ marine protected areas by 2030. Adds shark safeguards, identifies critical habitats, prohibits harmful fishing gear. Launched 2022, supports 10 projects across 4 continents.

properties.title: GEM-in-a-Box: Commonwealth Ocean Eutrophication Monitoring Project
properties.description: Commonwealth & Canada provide low-cost monitoring kits to 8 nations (Bahamas, Bangladesh, Cameroon, Kenya, Malaysia, Trinidad, Solomon Islands, S.Africa) to test waterways for eutrophication, combat ocean acidification & protect marine life.
properties.funder: Commonwealth Secretariat, Fisheries and Oceans Canada

properties.title: WCS 10x10 Sharks, Skates, and Rays Conservation Initiative
properties.description: Global initiative implementing comprehensive shark management reforms in 10 key geographies by 2030, focusing on protecting species, managing fisheries, and controlling trade to halt population declines and prevent extinctions.

properties.title: Puget Sound Integrated Modeling Framework
properties.description: Coupled environmental-human systems modeling framework for Puget Sound Basin. Simulates water, carbon, nutrients, contaminants, sediments across terrestrial-freshwater-marine habitats under climate change scenarios.
properties.funder: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, NOAA, University of Washington

properties.title: Wild Salmon Center - Protecting Wild Salmon Rivers
properties.description: Protecting the world's 20 wildest salmon rivers by 2032 across the North Pacific. Habitat preservation, river management, and coalition building to conserve wild salmon ecosystems supporting wildlife and communities.

properties.title: Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Orca Monitoring in Puget Sound
properties.description: UW researchers use fiber optic cables to monitor endangered Southern Resident killer whales near Whidbey & San Juan Islands, tracking movements to mitigate maritime traffic impacts. 2-year study started Oct 2024.

properties.title: Decoding Mexico's Orca Ecotypes
properties.description: Determining existence of undescribed orca ecotype in Gulf of California through fatty acid analysis, vocalization studies, AI/machine learning for photo-ID, and hydrophone arrays between Los Cabos and La Paz Bay.

properties.title: The impact of fisheries on deep-sea food webs
properties.description: Studies deep-sea shark ecology on Chatham Rise, comparing trophic data across time to identify species resilience and susceptibility to fishing pressure, focusing on threatened sharks like school shark and gulper shark.

properties.title: Conservation of Gymnura sereti: A Collaborative Approach to Protecting a Threatened Butterfly Ray Species
properties.description: Protecting Seret's butterfly ray in Badagry, Nigeria by monitoring bycatch, mapping habitats, and working with fishers to reduce accidental deaths in gill nets and trawls in coastal waters and estuaries.

properties.title: Population genomics of the endangered narrownose smooth-hound shark (Mustelus schmitti) in Uruguayan waters
properties.description: Genomic analysis of Critically Endangered narrownose smooth-hound sharks in Uruguay (2006-2025) to evaluate population structure, genetic diversity, and local adaptation for conservation and sustainable fishing management.

properties.title: WAVES: Widening Access to Versatile Education in Shark Sciences
properties.description: Transforms shark/ray bycatch in India into learning tools. Builds anatomical library, creates multilingual outreach for fishers & students. Addresses data gaps in 150+ species, many endemic & small-bodied.

properties.title: Identifying critical habitat for threatened sharks and rays in the Gulf of Oman
properties.description: Uses citizen science, baited cameras & eDNA to map remaining hotspots for Critically Endangered wedgefish, guitarfish & rays in southern/western Gulf of Oman to inform protection before local extinction.

properties.title: Restoring sharks and reef resilience through Fishery Replenishment Zones in Mnemba Island Marine Conservation Area
properties.description: Why: Sharks lost to overfishing, disrupting reef ecosystems. What: Establish fishery replenishment zones. How: Underwater video monitoring, community engagement. Where: Mnemba Island, Zanzibar. When: Ongoing restoration effort.

properties.title: Arctic Sentinels: Plastic Contamination in Arctic Sharks and Skates
properties.description: PhD research studying plastic contamination in Arctic sharks and skates. Investigates microplastic presence in Arctic Ocean elasmobranchs. Conducted by Arctic University of Tromsø researcher studying plankton ecology.

properties.title: Understanding heavy metals in commercially traded rays in coastal West Bengal
properties.description: First assessment of toxic metal contamination in rays along West Bengal's Bay of Bengal coast. Studies mercury, cadmium, lead levels in landed rays at Digha and Fraserganj to link public health risks with conservation needs.

properties.title: Thousands Lost: Community-Led Solutions for Endangered Shark Bycatch in Palawan's Small-Scale Coastal Fisheries
properties.description: Documenting & reducing shark/ray bycatch in San Vicente, Palawan through landing surveys, identifying high-risk gear/areas, and developing community-based mitigation strategies with local fishers to protect endangered species.

properties.title: Stress Test: What's the Impact of US Recreational Fishery Capture on Prohibited Sharks?
properties.description: Studies post-release mortality of white, dusky & sand tiger sharks in NY Bight recreational fisheries using blood biomarkers & satellite tags to develop handling guidelines that reduce fishing impacts on protected species.

properties.title: Monitoring the Shark and Ray Bycatch of an Artisanal Mackerel Fishery in Seychelles
properties.description: 12-month monitoring of shark/ray bycatch in Beau Vallon mackerel fishery. Collects biometric data on endangered species like hammerheads, eagle rays to inform protective regulations in Seychelles waters.

properties.title: Setting the tempo for Halavi guitarfish behavioural rhythms
properties.description: Studies Critically Endangered Halavi guitarfish in Al Wajh Lagoon, Red Sea. Analyzes blood samples from 200+ individuals to understand how temperature and coastal development affect health, growth, reproduction. Informs habitat protection.

properties.title: Wedgefish Habitat Mapping and Conservation in Java
properties.description: Mapping wedgefish habitats in Java, Indonesia to balance ecological protection with fishing community livelihoods through coastal ecosystem research and community engagement in Banyuwangi district.

properties.title: Searching for sawfish in Guinea-Bissau
properties.description: Using eDNA to detect critically endangered largetooth and smalltooth sawfish in Guinea-Bissau's Bijagós Archipelago mangroves, one of West Africa's last potential sawfish habitats, to guide conservation action.

properties.title: From the Sea to the Market: Elasmobranch Fisheries and Supply Chain in Guatemala
properties.description: Tracks sharks/rays from Guatemala's Pacific coast through supply chain using landing data, DNA testing, market monitoring. Targets threatened species like hammerheads, silky sharks to improve traceability and conservation.

properties.title: Muddy Waters: Essential Habitat Protections for Juvenile Elasmobranchs in the Ba River and Estuary, Fiji
properties.description: Protecting Ba River nursery habitats for juvenile sharks through legislative action, enforcement against illegal gill netting, and research to identify critical areas for threatened elasmobranch species.

properties.title: Islands in the Sea: Understanding Connectivity in Brazil's Lemon Sharks
properties.description: Investigating genetic structure and connectivity of lemon sharks across Brazilian oceanic islands (Fernando de Noronha, Atol das Rocas, Abrolhos) using DNA analysis and ecological modeling to inform MPA management.

properties.title: Sentinels of the Sea Ice (SENSEI)
properties.description: Studies climate change impacts on polar marine ecosystems via seabirds & marine mammals in Arctic & Antarctic. Tracks snow petrels, penguins, guillemots, gulls & seals to understand sea ice effects on demographics.

properties.title: Adelie Penguins as Monitor of the Marine Environment
properties.description: Tracks Adelie penguin feeding behavior using GPS in Terre Adelie colonies to monitor Antarctic marine ecosystem changes and sea ice impacts. Studies breeding success and climate change effects since 2010.

properties.title: Reef Services - Crypto-benthic fish role in coral reef productivity
properties.description: Study reveals tiny crypto-benthic fish provide 60% of consumed fish tissue on coral reefs through rapid reproduction and unique larval strategy, supporting reef ecosystem productivity and resilience.

properties.title: Can upwelling events influence spatial and temporal niche partitioning in round stingrays?
properties.description: Tracking leopard and starry round rays in El Jobo Bay, Costa Rica using acoustic tags to understand how they share space and respond to seasonal upwelling, informing habitat protection and sustainable tourism.

properties.title: Good or Bad Guests: Understanding Human Disturbance in Whitetip Reef Shark Resting Areas
properties.description: Study documenting diver impacts on whitetip reef sharks at Gili Trawangan using camera traps and acoustic recorders. Aims to develop sustainable tourism guidelines for Gili Matra Marine Park, Indonesia.

properties.title: Documenting Diet in Coastal Sharks
properties.description: Studies bull shark diets in Florida's Big Bend using novel DNA sampling to understand trophic roles and climate-driven range shifts in coastal ecosystems, particularly in Crystal River's freshwater springs and seagrass beds.

properties.title: Keep caring for Cameroon's sharks and rays
properties.description: Protecting 45 shark/ray species in Cameroon's coastal waters through fisher-led monitoring, safe-release training, and community education. Expanding from Kribi to 5 coastal sites near Campo Marine National Park since 2015.

properties.title: Coordinating citizen science and local ecological knowledge in Kenya
properties.description: Kenyan project using fisher knowledge & citizen science to monitor threatened rhino rays, hammerheads & mobulids. Addresses local extinctions, fills data gaps for National Plan of Action implementation.

properties.title: Safe Assessments for the Eastern Tropical Pacific's Pregnant Silky Sharks
properties.description: Studies silky shark reproduction using non-lethal methods (hormones, ultrasound) at Revillagigedo National Park, Mexico. Aims to understand why pregnant females move between offshore and coastal areas to inform conservation.

properties.title: Cameras for Conservation in South Africa's MPAs
properties.description: Marine conservation project using camera technology to monitor and protect South Africa's Marine Protected Areas. Led by South African Shark Conservancy to advance marine resource management.

properties.title: Conserving Malaysian Rhino Rays with Communities, BRUVs and Genetics
properties.description: Protecting critically endangered bottlenose wedgefish & giant guitarfish on Johor's east coast through BRUVS surveys, genetic analysis & community engagement with fishers/anglers to map habitats & populations.

properties.title: Can Gulper Sharks Recover? Building a National Monitoring Programme for Deep-Sea Sharks in the Maldives
properties.description: Why: Gulper sharks fished near extinction for liver oil. What: Baseline data on diversity, distribution, bycatch. How: Community monitoring, genetic sampling, fisheries data. When: Post-2010 ban. Where: Maldives deep-sea.

properties.title: MPAs for Sharks and Rays
properties.description: Conservation of Critically Endangered guitarfish in coastal Bangladesh through managed marine areas. Engages local communities to develop equitable conservation framework balancing species protection with socio-economic needs.

properties.title: NEOBLUE: Monitoring Newborn Blue Sharks in Coastal Galicia
properties.description: Underwater video surveys map neonate blue shark presence in Ría de Vigo to identify nursery habitats. Protects juveniles from bycatch/disturbance. Informs ISRAs & conservation policy. Summer surveys in Galician embayments.

properties.title: Stewardship for Sharks and Rays in Central America
properties.description: Why: Disconnect from marine wildlife, illegal shark fishing. What: Public education on sharks/rays. How: Museums, cultural centers, learning institutions. Where: Honduras, Belize, Panama. When: Ongoing

properties.title: The Life and Times of the Freckled Guitarfish
properties.description: Study of freckled guitarfish in Gulf of Mexico & W Atlantic to determine age, growth, reproduction, habitat use & nursery areas. Aims to fill data gaps for this Vulnerable species caught as bycatch to inform conservation strategies.

properties.title: Racing to Research Tanzania's Rhino Rays
properties.description: Research wedgefish & guitarfish biology, threats & conservation in Tanzania. Map fishing grounds, assess populations, analyze trade chains, build fisher capacity for sustainable practices & habitat protection in coastal waters.

properties.title: Where do tope sharks mate and pup?
properties.description: Studies critically endangered tope sharks in Wales' Pen Llŷn a'r Sarnau SAC. Measures hormones in pregnant females, gathers fisher knowledge to identify mating/pupping areas critical for species recovery.

properties.title: Biomonitoring for Conservation: DNA Barcoding the African Wedgefish
properties.description: Creating first genetic library for Critically Endangered African wedgefish via DNA barcoding from tissue samples at fish-landing sites. Training communities in species ID, monitoring fishing, enforcing CITES protections along West Africa coast.

properties.title: Saving Sharks from Stranded Eggs
properties.description: Rescuing shark & ray egg cases stranded on Changa beach, Coquimbo Bay, Chile when kelp washes ashore. Identifying species, returning viable eggs to ocean. Studies reveal unknown species present, requiring further research.

properties.title: Better shark and ray bycatch management for South Africa's bottom trawl hake fishery
properties.description: Why: 200 shark/ray species, half at risk from bycatch. What: Recording protocol for trawl fishery. How: Working with observers/crew to design data collection. Where: South African waters. When: Ongoing MSC certification improvement.

properties.title: Documenting shark diversity and fisheries in Angola
properties.description: Documents shark & ray biodiversity at Angolan landing sites (Namibe, Benguela, Luanda). Assesses small-scale fisheries impact, collects biological data, investigates trade networks, engages communities through education.

properties.title: Filling data gaps with fisher-contributed secondary fins in Honduras
properties.description: Evaluating anal fin monitoring to track shark catches in La Moskitia, Honduras. Works with fishers to assess incidental catches, especially hammerheads during Lent fishing season, strengthening management post-2016 amendment.

properties.title: The Ghost Sharks of Western Norway
properties.description: Tracking chimaeras in Norwegian fjords using acoustic telemetry to understand their movement, behavior, and habitat use. Aims to protect these understudied elasmobranchs vulnerable to bycatch and fishing.

properties.title: Local song: adaptative potential of endemic southwest Atlantic guitarfish to anthropogenic stressors
properties.description: Study testing if Brazilian guitarfish in polluted areas express more stress-adaptation genes than those in protected areas. Focuses on endangered endemic species from Rio de Janeiro to Argentina facing overfishing threats.

properties.title: Bio-imaging the brain to save sawfish
properties.description: Study of smalltooth sawfish brain growth patterns in SW Florida to understand behavior, habitat shifts, and investigate neural anomalies linked to mysterious 2024 spinning disease outbreak causing mass mortalities.

properties.title: Better Protection for Scalloped Bonnetheads
properties.description: Studying critically endangered scalloped bonnethead sharks in Colombian Pacific to establish effective no-take zone protection. Focuses on ecology, movement patterns of this endemic species facing extinction.

properties.title: Living Alongside the Sharks of Ascension Island
properties.description: Addresses human-shark conflict at Ascension Island by studying why Galápagos and silky sharks move inshore, affecting fishers and divers. Applies wildlife conflict management to protected waters since 2015.

properties.title: Cutting the Bycatch in Colombia's Caribbean Artisanal Fisheries
properties.description: Reducing batoid (ray/skate) bycatch in Magdalena's artisanal fisheries through alternative methods. Addresses knowledge gaps on vulnerable populations & works with fishers to adopt sustainable practices compliant with regulations.

properties.title: Training Shark Taggers to Build Public Trust in Thai Conservation Research
properties.description: Workshop training Thai govt agencies in shark tagging/telemetry to rebuild public trust after dugong deaths, address 91% shark decline, improve data collection in under-researched areas, and strengthen conservation planning.

properties.title: Cataloguing shark life in Timor-Leste's rich waters
properties.description: Research sharks, rays & chimaeras in Timor-Leste to identify species, key habitats & fishery value. Fills critical knowledge gap in Indo-Pacific biodiversity hotspot to enable future conservation initiatives.

properties.title: Connecting the Dots: Population Genetics of Pacific Spotted Eagle Rays
