properties.description: Studies genetic diversity of Pacific spotted eagle rays at Malpelo Island, Colombia using DNA analysis to guide conservation of this Vulnerable species facing overfishing and habitat loss in Eastern Pacific waters.

properties.title: Monitoring the Effectiveness of New Shark Protection Laws in Seychelles
properties.description: Assessing new elasmobranch legislation protecting 10 threatened species in Seychelles artisanal fishery. Monitoring catch data, training fishery technicians, public education, DNA analysis of hammerhead philopatry for conservation.

properties.title: Collision Course: Predicting Whale Shark Aggregations and Migrations off West Africa
properties.description: Tracking whale sharks in Gulf of Guinea to map migration routes & aggregation hotspots. Aims to reduce ship strike mortality, establish MPAs & safe corridors in Cape Verde & São Tomé. Uses satellite tracking & habitat models.

properties.title: Protecting pregnant and pupping porbeagle sharks
properties.description: Tracking pregnant porbeagle sharks in NE Atlantic to identify reproductive hotspots and pupping grounds around UK waters. Focuses on south-western England as potential spring reproductive area.

properties.title: Are Fiordland's MPAs protecting sharks?
properties.description: Studying how threatened sharks (school shark, spiny dogfish, sevengill) use Fiordland's marine reserves via acoustic telemetry to identify key habitats and inform conservation in this NZ World Heritage Site.

properties.title: Local solutions to deliver positive outcomes for Lunyuk's fisheries
properties.description: Reducing hammerhead & wedgefish mortality in Lunyuk, Sumbawa through participatory research, testing gear alternatives & compensation schemes while maintaining coastal community well-being. Targets Critically Endangered species nursery.

properties.title: Improving management of scalloped hammerhead shark fisheries in Benin
properties.description: Documenting catches & trade of Critically Endangered scalloped hammerhead sharks in Benin's coastal waters. Training fishermen in safe release & building fisheries manager capacity to reduce overfishing threats.

properties.title: Freshwater nurseries for sharks in a changing world
properties.description: Evaluating Florida's Kings Bay/Crystal River as bull shark nursery and thermal refuge. Investigating how geothermal springs provide stable habitat for young sharks amid climate change. Focus on euryhaline species survival.

properties.title: Monitoring and managing bycatch of Tunisia's shortfin mako sharks
properties.description: Mapping shortfin mako movements in Gulf of Hammamet, Tunisia to reduce bycatch in swordfish fisheries. Studies fishing practices to develop management strategies for this Critically Endangered species.

properties.title: Championing Indicator Species for Deep-Sea Conservation
properties.description: Conserving Skagerrak deep-sea ecosystems using Greenland sharks and sailrays as biodiversity indicators. Tracking behavior, migrations, home ranges to support marine protected area expansion under '30 by 30' initiative.

properties.title: Making Fisheries Sustainable for Scalloped Hammerhead Sharks in Cameroon
properties.description: Reducing hammerhead shark bycatch 20% in Cameroon through community engagement, hotspot mapping, age/pollutant analysis, and sustainable fishing training to protect endangered populations in coastal waters.

properties.title: Lifeboats for hammerheads: essential habitats for conservation
properties.description: Identifying critical habitats for feeding, reproduction & shelter in 3 threatened hammerhead species across northern Australia using telemetry, diet studies & remote sensing to guide global conservation.

properties.title: Our changing oceans and the changing lives of coastal sharks
properties.description: Comparing life-history traits of coastal sharks between Gulf of Oman (present) and Persian Gulf (future climate proxy) to understand how ocean warming alters vulnerability to overfishing using genetic analysis.

properties.title: The X, Y and white sharks: capturing chromosome information
properties.description: Study white shark chromosomes using new methods to understand their XX/XY sex determination system, verify genome assemblies, monitor chromosomal abnormalities, and explore karyotype evolution in endangered sharks.

properties.title: The value of eDNA in avoiding shark and ray extinctions in Sri Lanka
properties.description: Developing eDNA technology to monitor threatened sharks and rays in Sri Lankan artisanal fisheries, particularly in Batticaloa. Aims to improve species records and support sustainable management balancing biodiversity with livelihoods.

properties.title: Where are sharks and rays gathering in the Gulf of Gabès?
properties.description: Confirming aggregation zones for endangered sandbar sharks & guitarfish in Tunisia's Gulf of Gabès using BRUV systems & onboard monitoring. Working with fishermen to protect nursery grounds & pregnant females for sustainable management.

properties.title: Distinguishing the genetic diversity of spotted eagle ray species
properties.description: Study DNA of spotted eagle rays worldwide to identify species, understand population connectivity, and inform conservation strategies for these threatened rays across ocean ecosystems.

properties.title: Bringing guitarfish back from the brink in Bangladesh
properties.description: Study decodes vertebral cartilage of 3 Critically Endangered guitarfish species in Bangladesh coastal waters to reveal biology, age, growth patterns. Provides baseline data for effective management and protection of declining populations.

properties.title: Are hot sharks hungry sharks? Understanding drivers and solutions for depredation amidst a changing climate
properties.description: Investigates shark depredation in Maldives by studying social, ecological, physiological factors. Aims to co-develop climate-resilient mitigation strategies with fishers to balance livelihoods and shark conservation.

properties.title: Preventing genetic bottlenecks for bottlenose wedgefish
properties.description: Study bottlenose wedgefish mating systems in Karimunjawa National Park, Indonesia using genetic tools to determine reproductive strategy and genetic diversity, supporting conservation under new quota regulations.

properties.title: Conserving the Chilean Eagle Ray
properties.description: Study age/growth of endemic Chilean eagle ray in Peru's Humboldt Current to guide sustainable fishery management. Train artisanal fishers in Pucusana for sustainable practices amid high fishing pressure.

properties.title: Kinship in the Kimberley
properties.description: Genetic study of dwarf & green sawfish in Western Australia's Kimberley/Pilbara regions to assess kinship, genetic diversity & population viability for conservation of these critically threatened species.

properties.title: Tiger sharks, dugongs and sea turtles: a triangle of fear in Shark Bay
properties.description: Study of tiger shark predation on dugongs & sea turtles in Shark Bay after 2011 heat wave decimated seagrass. Examines predator-prey dynamics & climate impacts on threatened species in UNESCO World Heritage ecosystem.

properties.title: Deep-diving sharks in a warming world
properties.description: Studies deep-diving sharks and rays in the Azores' twilight zone (200-1000m) using sensor-equipped animals to validate models of meso-pelagic prey distribution and assess climate change impacts on oceanic predators.

properties.title: Future-proofing a Swedish shark conservation success story
properties.description: Why: Spiny dogfish stock collapsed, now recovering. What: Acoustic telemetry & sampling study. How: Track movements, aggregations, fishing vulnerability. Where: Swedish west coast, Kattegat & Skagerrak. When: Initiated 2024.

properties.title: Tracking pregnant silky sharks in the Red Sea
properties.description: Using ultrasound to identify if pregnant silky sharks use Red Sea coral reefs as pupping grounds. Tracking movement patterns to inform spatial management plans and protect vulnerable populations from fishing pressure.

properties.title: Finding Endangered Rhino Rays in the Malacca Strait
properties.description: Studying newly discovered rhino ray species in Malacca Strait. Collecting samples from landing sites to assess distribution, biology, and genetics of endangered eyebrow wedgefish, Ranong guitarfish, and roughnose wedgefish.

properties.title: Sharks Come to Life in Cartoons in Cameroon
properties.description: Educational cartoon program in Limbe schools teaching children about 28 ray & 17 shark species. Addresses overfishing threats through culturally relevant storytelling to increase conservation awareness by 40% by 2025.

properties.title: Oceanic Manta Ray Connections
properties.description: Studying 1,000+ oceanic manta rays in Maldives' southern atolls, peak April near Fuvahmulah. Tracking migration patterns to protect from Sri Lankan fisheries killing hundreds yearly. Low resighting rates suggest larger Indian Ocean population.

properties.title: Shark and ray baselines using eDNA in Bahrain
properties.description: Establishing first shark population baselines in Bahrain using eDNA, BRUVs & fish market surveys to determine elasmobranch distribution, seasonality & nursery areas in Arabian Gulf waters for conservation policy.

properties.title: Tracking Whale Sharks to Protect Their Habitat in Madagascar
properties.description: Acoustic tagging of endangered whale sharks in Nosy Be bay since 2016 to establish marine protected area corridor Tandavandriva, supporting KBA and ISRA designation in northwestern Madagascar waters.

properties.title: Can epaulette sharks become climate change chameleons?
properties.description: Testing epaulette shark responses to future climate temps in Australia. Studying genetics of adaptation to extreme environments (low oxygen, high temps). Aims to predict shark/ray resilience to climate change by 2100.

properties.title: Trophic ecology and population genetic structure of South Florida's Atlantic guitarfish (Pseudobatos lentiginosus)
properties.description: Study characterizing diet and trophic role of Atlantic guitarfish in South Florida's coastal ecosystem using stable isotope analysis, stomach content analysis, and DNA meta-barcoding to inform conservation.

properties.title: Linking pollution and shark health in the Mediterranean
properties.description: Research investigating connection between pollution levels and shark health in Mediterranean waters. Studies shark abundance, seasonality, area preference through sampling and environmental monitoring.

properties.title: The importance of kelp forests for sharks and rays in Chile
properties.description: Studies how kelp harvesting affects Chilean sharks/rays that lay eggs on Lessonia trabeculata. Identifies kelp attributes critical for breeding sites to guide conservation of overharvested forests.

properties.title: Communities Taking Care in Watamu and Mida Creek
properties.description: Protecting 10+ shark & ray species in Watamu Marine National Park, Kenya through community partnerships. Addresses overfishing & habitat loss by empowering locals in conservation of Endangered & Critically Endangered elasmobranchs.

properties.title: The guitarfish of Grand Béréby
properties.description: Protecting Critically Endangered guitarfish in Grand-Béréby MPA, Côte d'Ivoire. Identifying species, studying fishing interactions, establishing population baselines, and raising community awareness to prevent decline.

properties.title: The Wedgefish of Sungai Kakap
properties.description: Studies critically endangered wedgefish in Indonesian waters to understand life history, diet, population structure and ecology. Aims to support species-specific management and marine protected area development in high-catch regions.

properties.title: Missing the Target: Refining Spiny Dogfish Fishery Surveys
properties.description: Tracking juvenile spiny dogfish movements in eastern North Pacific to inform fishery assessments and prevent bycatch declines. Uses acoustic tagging where electronic tags are too large for juveniles.

properties.title: Capturing the Impact of Catches
properties.description: Studies at-vessel and post-release mortality of chondrichthyans (sharks/rays) caught as bycatch. Develops standardized health protocols and identifies mortality predictors to guide conservation actions and fishing practices.

properties.title: The Tooth-About Australias Sawfish Hotspots
properties.description: Using chemical fingerprints from sawfish rostral teeth to identify population hotspots and movements. Microchemical analysis of confiscated rostra fills knowledge gaps in distribution to create risk maps for conservation management.

properties.title: Seeking Ghost Shark Secrets
properties.description: Study chimaera (ghost shark) reproduction, breeding sites, and tooth development using ROVs and 360° cameras in deep ocean habitats. Partners include UW, Florida Museum, Seattle Aquarium to understand ancient fish biology.

properties.title: Critical Habitats for Smalltooth Sawfish
properties.description: Identifying mating areas for adult smalltooth sawfish in USA using acoustic tagging and genetic data to define critical habitat for large sawfish, supporting recovery of this Critically Endangered species.

properties.title: Caring for Cameroon's Sharks and Rays
properties.description: AMMCO conserves threatened sharks & rays in Cameroon through citizen science, market surveys & socio-economic studies since 2015. Focus on southern coast elasmobranchs, especially scalloped hammerheads & blackchin guitarfish.

properties.title: Using DNA to identify the sharks in squalene products
properties.description: Developing DNA extraction protocol from shark liver oil to identify species in squalene trade. Targets deep-water gulper sharks threatened by cosmetics/health product demand. Aims to improve traceability and conservation.

properties.title: Deep trouble: measuring the impact of fishing on Caribbean deep-sea sharks
properties.description: Studying deep-sea shark populations in Guatemalan Caribbean. Monitoring fishing impact on gulper, kitefin, sixgill sharks through landing surveys & community engagement to establish no-take MPA.

properties.title: Tracking Denmark's thornback rays
properties.description: Acoustic tagging of thornback rays in Danish waters to identify migration routes, mating/pupping sites, and critical habitats. Aims to inform policy and halt population decline through protection of key areas.

properties.title: The Angola Elasmo Project
properties.description: Assessing shark & ray populations in Angola through fisheries monitoring, biological sampling & trade analysis. Engaging communities to reduce threats & secure future for elasmobranchs since civil war decline.

properties.title: Saving the giants of Karimunjawa
properties.description: Protecting critically endangered giant guitarfish & wedgefish in Karimunjawa National Park, Java Sea. Studies ecology, fisheries impact & trade to develop inclusive management plan for species & local fishers.

properties.title: A Red List of Benin's Sharks
properties.description: Compiling Red List of threatened sharks in Benin's waters to support MPA management. Identifying species, assessing populations, mapping distributions to create management plan and spark community conservation.

properties.title: Strengthening conservation efforts for the highly exploited scalloped hammerhead shark (Sphyrna lewini) in Western Nigeria
properties.description: Collecting biological data on Critically Endangered scalloped hammerheads in SW Nigeria through local fisher knowledge, studying biology/trade routes, and community conservation programs to protect this heavily fished species.

properties.title: Littering Lifetimes: Understanding the Accumulation of Pollution in Sharks
properties.description: Comparing pollution bioaccumulation in sevengill & tope sharks between urbanized San Francisco Bay & pristine Willapa Bay. Sampling water, sediment & shark tissues for mercury & PFAS across life stages to inform conservation.

properties.title: Guardian Angels 2
properties.description: Documentary film project raising awareness of Critically Endangered angel sharks in East Atlantic and Mediterranean. Aims to improve baseline knowledge, public identification skills, and support conservation through storytelling and impact campaigns.

properties.title: Taking the Temperature on Nurse Shark Movement Patterns
properties.description: Study of Pacific nurse shark aggregations in Santa Elena Bay, Costa Rica using drones and telemetry to understand how water temperature and upwelling affect their seasonal movement and thermal refuge behavior.

properties.title: Missing in Macquarie: The Case of the Disappearing Maugean Skate
properties.description: Monitoring critically declining Maugean skate population in Macquarie Harbour, Tasmania. Investigating reproductive failure linked to human impacts (mining, aquaculture). Developing recovery plan for this Endangered endemic species.

properties.title: Building capacity to foster sustainable management of threatened mobulid rays in East Africa
properties.description: Builds local capacity to identify protected mobulid rays, exposes illegal supply chains via DNA barcoding, and informs marine protected area expansion in East Africa where mobulid populations declined 90% due to overfishing.

properties.title: Bringing to Light the Lost Sharks
properties.description: Surveying fish markets and landing sites in biodiversity hotspots to identify and document over 1,200 'lost shark' species not seen for decades, threatened by overfishing and habitat loss, to raise awareness and inform conservation.

properties.title: Caribbean Connections
properties.description: Study Caribbean reef shark population genetics across 20 sites in 10 countries using 3RAD sequencing to identify connectivity barriers and inform regional recovery plans and IUCN assessments.

properties.title: DNA barcoding to identify sharks in Vietnam
properties.description: Uses DNA barcoding to identify threatened shark species caught in Central Vietnam's fisheries. Addresses illegal finning where only fins are landed. Determines IUCN/CITES-listed species in catch and raises conservation awareness.

properties.title: Community Shark Conservation in Turks and Caicos
properties.description: Community-driven lemon shark research in Turks and Caicos mangroves. Trains local youth in shark tagging, habitat monitoring. Combines field science with school curriculum to inspire ocean stewards and support shark protection legislation.

properties.title: Setting the baseline: gathering data on rough skates in the Thracian Sea
properties.description: Studying endangered endemic rough skates in Greece's Thracian Sea to identify nursery grounds, assess fishery bycatch impact, and develop management plans to protect this species in an Important Shark and Ray Area.

properties.title: The Bahamas: a beacon of hope for smalltooth sawfish
properties.description: Protecting Critically Endangered smalltooth sawfish at Andros through surveys, community workshops, student training, and advocacy for species-specific legislation and critical habitat protection in Bahamian waters.

properties.title: It's elemental: shark life histories from cartilage chemistry
properties.description: Validates chemical tagging in shark cartilage to study complete life histories. Uses spiny dogfish & thorny skates in Gulf of Maine. Analyzes elemental composition of vertebrae, spines & thorns via isotope spiking experiments.

properties.title: The seas' sheepdogs: tuna and whale shark feeding associations in the Azores
properties.description: Studies whale shark-tuna feeding associations in Azores using biologging tech. Investigates how tuna herd fish into bait balls for whale sharks and impacts of human disruption on both species' energy budgets.

properties.title: Guarding sharks in Ghana
properties.description: Collecting shark & ray data along Ghana's coast. Training 10 volunteers for long-term monitoring. Piloting alternative livelihoods with fishers. Focus on guitarfish & shark-like rays conservation strategies using ecological & socio-economic data.

properties.title: Counting eagle rays with close-kin mark-recapture
properties.description: Estimating endangered whitespotted eagle ray populations in eastern Gulf of Mexico using genomics and close-kin mark-recapture to understand 50-79% population declines and inform conservation management.

properties.title: Tracking time through teeth
properties.description: Unlocking largetooth sawfish movement & life history through chemical analysis of rostral teeth from Brazilian museum specimens. Reveals migration patterns, growth rates, habitat use & food web changes across their lifetime.

properties.title: Correcting shark catch counts in Chile
properties.description: Assessing underestimation of artisanal shark catches in Chile. Interviews with fishers reveal species caught vs reported, regional naming variations, and bycatch identification to improve catch reporting and conservation policies.

properties.title: Sicklefin devil rays in 3D: how are they using space in the Azores?
properties.description: Tracking endangered sicklefin devil rays at Azores seamounts to map 3D movement patterns and identify critical habitats for marine protected area network development through satellite tagging.

properties.title: Methods to reduce shark stress
properties.description: Testing dried blood spot sampling as minimally invasive method to study shark feeding ecology. Targets scalloped hammerhead, silky & sandbar sharks at Flower Garden Banks sanctuary, Gulf of Mexico.

properties.title: Unearthing the truth about the common eagle ray
properties.description: Studies Critically Endangered eagle rays along South Africa's coast using genetics, acoustic telemetry to determine species identity, population connectivity, movement patterns & critical habitats for conservation.

properties.title: Fine-scale activity and behaviour regimes of reef manta rays in the Anthropocene
properties.description: Quantifying behavior & energy budgets of reef manta rays at D'Arros Island, Seychelles using biologging devices to understand their ecology, critical habitats & role in coral reef nutrient cycling within an MPA.

properties.title: Manta and devil rays of the Canary Islands
properties.description: Study mobulid ray species in Canary Islands using citizen science & photo-ID. Tracks seasonal patterns, site fidelity, connectivity. First regional research on manta & devil rays to support conservation.

properties.title: Food Security and the Future for Sharks
properties.description: Analyzes nutrient composition of shark/ray meat to understand their role in coastal food security and develop effective conservation strategies addressing meat consumption as major driver of elasmobranch overexploitation.

properties.title: Same But Different: Distinguishing Blacktip Shark Populations in the Gulf of Mexico
properties.description: Uses stable isotope analysis of shark vertebrae to identify distinct blacktip subpopulations in Gulf of Mexico, examining diet and habitat differences to improve species management in this critical habitat.

properties.title: Climate change at the end of the earth: sevengill sharks in Fiordland, New Zealand
properties.description: Assessing climate change impacts on broadnose sevengill sharks in Fiordland, NZ. Studying responses to temperature/salinity changes during heatwaves to improve conservation management of this key predator.

properties.title: The sustainability of shark fisheries in Indonesia
properties.description: Evaluating small-scale shark fishery in Batuwingkung Village, Sangihe Islands. Assessing vulnerability of silky & blacktip sharks, designing sustainable management with community participation to balance livelihoods & conservation.

properties.title: Searching for sawfish in northern Peru
properties.description: Why: Largetooth sawfish thought extinct in Peru until 2016 bycatch. What: eDNA survey to locate nursery grounds. How: Sampling mangrove systems fed by Tumbes/Zarumilla rivers. Where: Tumbes coast, northern Peru.

properties.title: Conserving Largetooth Sawfish on the Amazonian Coast
properties.description: Research largetooth sawfish distribution in Amazon estuary using eDNA, gather catch data, raise awareness in fishing communities, train enforcement agents on illegal trade, protect mangrove/mudbank habitats.

properties.title: Keeping watch on winghead sharks in Papua New Guinea
properties.description: Monitoring winghead sharks in Kikori Delta, Gulf of Papua, where unmanaged swim-bladder fishery threatens endangered species. Recording catch data to inform management plan for inshore fisheries targeting large estuarine fish.

properties.title: Can eco-engineering make a man-made ocean fish-friendly?
properties.description: Study how 29 shark/ray species use Ngqura artificial port, South Africa. Underwater footage reveals year-round residents vs seasonal visitors, breeding/nursery use. Aims to boost conservation in man-made habitats.

properties.title: Nurseries for giant guitarfish of the Andaman Islands
properties.description: Identifying nursery habitats for Critically Endangered giant guitarfish & rays in Andaman Islands' shallow waters to guide protection. Surveys at 31 sites assess habitat features, juvenile abundance & human impacts.

properties.title: The guitarfish of Goa, western India
properties.description: Study guitarfish habitat use & fisheries impact in Goa's shallow coastal waters. Focus on juvenile survival after bycatch release, identify nursery areas, develop conservation measures for Critically Endangered species.

properties.title: Turning the tide for sharks in Tunisia's Gulf of Gabes
properties.description: Protecting sharks/rays in Gulf of Gabes from spring/summer fisheries targeting breeding grounds. Testing mitigation measures, mapping nurseries, proposing spatial-temporal closures to protect pregnant females and neonates.

properties.title: Making sense of sharks, electromagnetic fields and magnetic senses
properties.description: Studies how offshore wind energy electromagnetic fields affect shark/ray navigation and foraging. Uses tagging and lab models to assess impacts on movement and habitat use before/during/after construction in NY waters.

properties.title: An Eye on the Eagle Rays of Northern Chile
properties.description: Drone surveys estimate abundance, size, habitat use of vulnerable Chilean eagle rays in Mejillones Bay. Raises conservation awareness among fishing communities. 763 rays observed 2021-2024, avg density 176/km2.

properties.title: Assessing the population, distribution, and conservation status of Raja Ampat Epaulette Shark in West Papua
properties.description: Study Raja Ampat epaulette shark ecology in West Papua's MPAs using photo-ID and capture-mark-recapture. Address declining populations from fishing and tourism impacts. Build database, create citizen science platform for long-term conservation.

properties.title: Trawling for solutions for effective guitarfish conservation
properties.description: Protecting critically endangered guitarfish from demersal trawling in eastern Mediterranean by identifying hotspots, combining fisher knowledge with surveys, and raising awareness for area closures during vulnerable life stages.

properties.title: Failure to Launch: What's Happening with Seychelles Turtle and Tortoise Eggs?
properties.description: Investigates hatching failure causes in green/hawksbill turtles and Aldabra tortoises across Seychelles islands using microscopic egg analysis. Found early embryonic death main cause, not infertility. Informs conservation partners' management.

properties.title: Bringing up baby: shark embryos and our warming oceans
properties.description: Studies climate change impacts on small-spotted catshark embryos in France. Tests warming & acidification effects on development, sex ratios, skeletal abnormalities & behavior to inform conservation policy for vulnerable species.

properties.title: Getting to grips with sharks and rays in India's fisheries
properties.description: Study of shark/ray distribution, fishing gear impacts, and critical habitats along Indian coast at Malvan and Visakhapatnam. Surveys and fisher interviews inform community-driven conservation strategies for declining elasmobranch populations.

properties.title: Connecting local fishers, their histories and the halavi guitarfish
properties.description: Mapping historical occurrence of Critically Endangered halavi guitarfish in coastal Kenya through fisher interviews. Aims to reconstruct population changes, raise awareness, and promote sustainable management of surviving populations.

properties.title: Going round in circles: clarifying the distribution of round stingrays in the Mexican Pacific
properties.description: Researchers use genetic analysis to clarify taxonomy of Urotygon round stingrays along Mexico's Pacific coast, where species are morphologically similar but genetically distinct, affecting bycatch management.

properties.title: Assessment of the Sustainability of Deep-Sea Shark Fisheries in the Sulu Sea, Philippines
properties.description: Assessing deep-sea shark fisheries sustainability in Cagayancillo, Palawan. Studies dogfish shark fishing for liver oil, trade routes, and ecological impact to protect vulnerable species and local livelihoods in Sulu Sea.

properties.title: On a mission for missing information about 'mini mantas' in the Gulf of Mexico
properties.description: Why: Endangered pygmy devil rays declining, data-deficient. What: Study populations, diet, movement patterns. How: Tagging, acoustic telemetry, field research. Where: Gulf of Mexico, Florida. When: Ongoing since 2019.

properties.title: Night Moves
properties.description: Using ROVs for nocturnal surveys of cryptic elasmobranchs on Great Barrier Reef. Addresses gaps in daytime-only data to better understand behavior, ecology, and population status of night-active sharks and rays.

properties.title: Essential habitats for smooth hammerheads
properties.description: Mapping nursery habitats for smooth hammerhead sharks in Sagres, southern Portugal using telemetry to track movement, depth, temperature preferences, and migratory pathways to inform conservation.

properties.title: Changing Coral: Assessing Reef Health
properties.description: Analyzing 6-year data on 2016 global coral bleaching impacts at D'Arros & St Joseph Atoll, Seychelles. Assessing reef recovery, coral recruitment trends 2012-2017, and fish species diversity before/during/after bleaching.

properties.title: An Island Refuge
properties.description: Investigating humphead wrasse as umbrella species for coral reef conservation in Seychelles. Tracking home range and habitat use to inform marine protected area management decisions for Indo-Pacific reef biodiversity.

properties.title: Protecting the African Wedgefish in Ghana
properties.description: Assessing population, catches, trade & socio-economic value of Critically Endangered African wedgefish in Ghana's overfished coastal waters to develop conservation action plan & prevent extinction through awareness & regulation.

properties.title: Rising Temperatures Shrinking Rays
properties.description: Studies how ocean warming affects ray maturity size using Gill Oxygen Limitation Theory. Examines temperature impact on batoid growth and sex-size differences to inform conservation of vulnerable ray species facing climate change.

properties.title: Motivation Behind Movements: The Home Range of Sharks
properties.description: Studies how body size and metabolic rate influence home range size in sicklefin lemon sharks using acceleration data loggers to bridge lab and field research, determining habitat requirements and movement patterns.

properties.title: Deep trouble? Gulper sharks and longline fisheries in New Zealand
properties.description: Studies gulper shark vulnerability to longline fisheries in NZ's South Pacific via satellite tagging, post-release mortality assessment, stress response analysis, movement patterns, and nursery ground confirmation.

properties.title: Spatial ecology of Pacific guitarfishes taken in commercial fisheries
properties.description: Satellite and acoustic tagging of endangered wedgefish and guitarfish in Taiwan to identify critical habitats, inform conservation management, and assess if offshore wind farms create protected areas for these bycatch species.

properties.title: Learning from Sharks to Combat Microplastics
properties.description: Study shark spiral intestine flow dynamics to design Tesla valve-style filter removing microplastics from water without mechanical parts. Uses CT scans of 32 shark species to create bio-inspired filtration system.

properties.title: Nurseries for Florida's protected whitespotted eagle ray
properties.description: Identifying nursery hotspots in Indian River Lagoon & Sarasota Bay for endangered whitespotted eagle rays using acoustic telemetry to track juvenile movement patterns & protect young rays until adulthood.

properties.title: The thresher sharks of Rhun Island
properties.description: Conserving endangered pelagic thresher sharks in Banda Neira, Indonesia. Collecting first fisheries data, studying socio-economic dependence, and developing management strategies for Ay and Rhun Islands Marine Protected Area.

properties.title: Accelerometers on Sharks
properties.description: Optimizing motion sensor tech (accelerometers, gyroscopes, magnetometers) to classify shark behavior at sub-second resolution, improving sampling frequency choices to enhance data collection efficiency and study duration.

properties.title: A new way to count white sharks
properties.description: Using close-kin mark-recapture genetic analysis on samples from KwaZulu-Natal Sharks Board to estimate great white shark population size in South African waters, establishing monitoring protocol for conservation decisions.

properties.title: PROJECT MUSTELUS: Empowering fishers and anglers to save Chilean houndsharks
properties.description: Linking fishers & scientists in N Chile to promote sustainable practices for Critically Endangered houndsharks. Reducing fishing mortality through community awareness & fisher empowerment to prevent extinction.

properties.title: Karimunjawa: The Last Hope for Java's Giants
properties.description: Study giant guitarfish ecology in Karimunjawa National Park, Java Sea. Assess bycatch by artisanal fisheries, identify critical habitats, promote live release practices through workshops and citizen science to protect Critically Endangered species.

properties.title: Ghost Birds of St Joseph Atoll
properties.description: Tracking Wedge-tailed Shearwaters at St Joseph Atoll to identify critical foraging areas and diet for marine protected area designation in the western Indian Ocean, monitoring seabird-fishery interactions.

properties.title: On a knife-edge: saving sharpnose guitarfish in the Bay of Bengal
properties.description: Study of Critically Endangered sharpnose guitarfish reproductive biology in Bay of Bengal, Bangladesh to develop conservation plans. Research on breeding cycles, maturity, and fisheries impact despite protected status.

properties.title: Phylogeography and conservation genetics of the bonnethead sharks: tracing the origin of a species complex
properties.description: Resolving taxonomy of bonnethead sharks in Panama's Pacific waters through genetic analysis to determine if S. tiburo vespertina is a third cryptic species, providing baseline for sustainable fisheries management in Latin America.

properties.title: Coming Home: Movement Patterns of Australian Bull Sharks
properties.description: Investigating natal philopatry in female bull sharks along Australia's east coast to understand movement patterns, connectivity, and population recovery potential through tracking and genetic relatedness studies.

properties.title: Not Just a FAD: Protecting Silky Sharks in Fishing Hotspots
properties.description: Studies silky shark social behavior and aggregation near Fish Aggregating Devices (FADs) to reduce bycatch. Uses acoustic telemetry to model habitat use patterns and inform fisheries management for species recovery.

properties.title: Taxonomy and Phylogeny of Sharks and Rays in Mauritania
properties.description: Research project using molecular methods to identify shark/ray diversity in Mauritania's Banc d'Arguin, training local observers in species identification, and raising conservation awareness among stakeholders.

properties.title: Gut Feeling: The Impact of Heavy Metals on Shark Microbiomes
properties.description: Study of digestive tract microbiomes in hammerhead sharks and electric rays across Gulf of California sites with varying heavy metal pollution levels, using 16S rRNA gene sequencing to identify bacterial communities.

properties.title: Forever Young: New Ways to Age Sharks
properties.description: Developing cutting-edge microchemistry methods to improve shark age estimation and life history reconstruction, challenging conventional approaches through interdisciplinary science and advanced analytical instrumentation.

properties.title: Home Sweet Home for Colombian Hammerheads
properties.description: Studying movement patterns of scalloped bonnethead sharks in Colombian Pacific to establish no-take zones with local communities, protecting the last refuge of this critically endangered species with smallest shark home range recorded.

properties.title: Baby Blues: Female Blue Sharks in Irish Waters
properties.description: Studies reproductive status of female blue sharks visiting Irish waters May-October to determine if they mate or give birth there, informing conservation measures for this Near Threatened species important to local sport angling.

properties.title: Chimaeras in South America: How many species are out there?
properties.description: Determining if American elephant fish in Atlantic & Pacific South America are one species/population. Vulnerable species facing high fishing pressure since 1950s in Chile & Argentina, caught in gill nets.

properties.title: Documenting Biodiversity in Colombia's Malpelo MPA
properties.description: Monitoring shark & turtle populations in Malpelo Sanctuary, Eastern Tropical Pacific. Assessing biodiversity decline (hammerheads down 73%) due to overfishing, mining, pollution outside MPA boundaries.

properties.title: Shedding Light: Assessing LAMP to Identify Sharks in Mexico's Trade
properties.description: Validates LAMP DNA technique to identify shark species in Mexican fish markets. Successfully detected 5 commercial species among fillets/fins to support trade monitoring and conservation enforcement.

properties.title: Hammerheads of the Bay of Bengal
properties.description: Establishing scientific basis for hammerhead shark conservation in Bangladesh through sustainable fisheries approach. Identifies threats from fishing/trade, assesses extinction risk, and develops conservation plans in Bay of Bengal.

properties.title: Sevengills sharks in San Francisco Bay
properties.description: Studies juvenile sevengill shark diet, habitat use, and catch-and-release stress in SF Bay nursery grounds to inform fisheries management and protect this vulnerable apex predator along the Eastern Pacific coast.

properties.title: The ghost of oceans future
properties.description: Studies noise pollution impact on Australian ghost sharks in Western Port Bay. Uses 3D bioimaging to describe hearing systems and tests behavioral responses to human-generated sounds like shipping and construction.

properties.title: Going Viral: Understanding Viral RNA Diversity in Sharks
properties.description: Characterizes RNA virus diversity in sharks, rays & chimaeras to establish baseline pathogen data. Uses NGS sequencing across species with different ecologies to monitor host-pathogen dynamics in endangered populations.

properties.title: Trophic importance of kelp forest for elasmobranchs in the Baja California peninsula
properties.description: Study kelp forest importance for sharks/rays in San Quintin Bay. Analyze how climate-driven kelp changes affect horn sharks & guitarfish. Estimate elasmobranch diversity & trophic contribution of kelp habitat.

properties.title: Coping with climate: is it in the genes?
properties.description: Studies shark immune system genes (MHC) to understand climate adaptation and predict population shifts. Maps genetic diversity across seascapes to identify vulnerable species and model future habitat distribution changes.

properties.title: Phylogeography of Pacific Angel Shark (Squatina californica) in Northeastern Pacific: understanding evolution for prioritizing conservation
properties.description: Genetic study of Pacific angel sharks in Gulf of California & Baja California to identify cryptic species & population structure. Uses DNA analysis to define conservation units for overfishing-vulnerable sharks.

properties.title: Forecasting the future: pollution and sharks
properties.description: Assessing how marine pollutants impact shark reproductive health using American elephant fish in Chubut, Argentina. Studies chemical disruption to forecast future population viability and set ocean health baselines.

properties.title: Shark Conservation Fund
properties.description: Global fund halting shark/ray overexploitation via grants. Protects 100 vital areas by 2030, regulates trade, safeguards endangered species, combats unsustainable fishing through policy, advocacy, science.

properties.title: 1001 Seaforest Species
properties.description: Documenting 1001 species in South Africa's Great African Seaforest through underwater tracking, research & storytelling to build biodiversity dataset & nurture appreciation for marine nature's fragility & wonder.

properties.title: The devil is in the details – molecular identification of guitarfishes sold as 'pez diablo'
properties.description: Documents guitarfish species marketed as 'pez diablo' in Mexico using morphometric/genetic methods. 8 of 9 Pseudobatos species occur in Mexico; 7 are IUCN threatened. Carved/dried for traditional medicine/curios.

properties.title: All About Sawfish in The Bahamas: Tracking Movement, Breeding and Nurseries
properties.description: Tracking smalltooth sawfish in Bahamas using acoustic transmitters to monitor population size, nursery habitats, breeding patterns, and movements. Aims to identify critical habitats and ecological processes for conservation.

properties.title: Clues from the past to guide the future
properties.description: Uses archaeological science to reconstruct shark population impacts over millennia in Monterey Bay. Analyzes ancient DNA and isotopes from Tope and Leopard Sharks to establish behavioral baselines for conservation.

properties.title: The heat is on: how might rising temperatures affect shark reproduction?
properties.description: Research on ocean warming impacts on epaulette shark reproduction at Heron Island. Assessing reproductive biology changes over 20 years and temperature tolerance across life stages to predict climate change effects.

properties.title: Protecting Rhino Rays in the World's Largest Bay
properties.description: Minimizing extinction risk of sharpnose guitarfish in Bangladesh through strategic research on fisheries management, trade limits, and habitat protection. Uses guitarfish as flagship for all rhino rays conservation.

properties.title: Building Local Supports for Rhinoray Conservation in the Java Sea
properties.description: Collaborative conservation of guitarfish and wedgefish in Java Sea through community engagement, fishermen data collection, and awareness campaigns. 164 live juveniles released, 10 vessels participating, reaching 1M+ viewers online.

properties.title: Linking Local Knowledge and Local Hearts to Save the Sharks of Holbox Island
properties.description: Why: Holbox faces environmental degradation, overfishing, shark population decline. What: Shark conservation via education, community events, biodiversity data collection. How: Kids' workshops, LEK integration, archaeological data. Where: Holbox Isla

properties.title: Amending the understanding of deep-sea gulper sharks of India
properties.description: Study of gulper shark species along Indian coast to determine catch composition, abundance, distribution, resolve taxonomy via DNA, and quantify by-catch in squalene fishery. Focus on Kollam, Kerala.

properties.title: Important Shark and Ray Areas
properties.description: IUCN SSC Shark Specialist Group develops criteria to identify critical ocean habitats for sharks, rays & chimaeras worldwide. Aims to guide spatial planning & highlight importance to policymakers, complementing existing marine conservation areas.

properties.title: Marine Protected Areas to Conserve Highly Migratory Sharks in the Eastern Tropical Pacific
properties.description: Tracking hammerhead & Galapagos sharks between Cocos Island & seamounts using acoustic tags & ROV. Established connectivity along Cocos-Galapagos Swimway. Led to 54,000 km² MPA expansion protecting critical migratory habitat.

properties.title: Community-supported conservation goals for Scalloped Hammerhead
properties.description: Identifying nursery areas for juvenile scalloped hammerhead sharks around Trinidad. Researchers catch, tag, and track sharks to determine movement patterns, growth rates, and mortality to develop management plans protecting these critical habitats.

properties.title: Mediterranean guitarfishes: addressing fisheries pressure and market demand
properties.description: Protecting Critically Endangered guitarfish in Mediterranean through monitoring networks, fisher engagement, and trade restrictions across North Africa and Eastern Mediterranean coastal fisheries.

properties.title: Don't be caught sleeping: proactive conservation research for Pacific sleeper sharks
properties.description: Satellite tagging Pacific sleeper sharks off San Diego to study movements, behavior, and habitat use. Aims to reduce bycatch in swordfish fisheries through gear modifications and conservation strategies.

properties.title: The Right Reefs for Sharks
properties.description: Uses cutting-edge tech & ecological modelling to identify critical reef shark habitat in Seychelles. Aims to inform regional management strategies & protect reef sharks in near-pristine Indian Ocean waters.

properties.title: Satellite tracking shortfin mako sharks in the South Atlantic
properties.description: Tracking large female mako sharks off St Helena using satellite tags to identify critical habitats, migration patterns, fishing overlap zones, and climate change impacts on this overfished species over 2+ years.

properties.title: Gill Guardians: An Elasmobranch Conservation and Education Hub
properties.description: Online hub educating public about sharks, skates & rays through video lessons, activities & live seminars. Bridges scientists & public to grow conservation advocates. Serves 400+ users, 1200+ outreach participants.

properties.title: Combining community and genetics for conservation in Cameroon
properties.description: Citizen science app tracks sharks/rays along Cameroon's 400km coast. Fishers upload sightings to create first elasmobranch atlas. Genetic sampling informs policy for 33 species (11 threatened), none legally protected.

properties.title: Rapid DNA testing gives hope for rhino rays in Hong Kong
properties.description: Developing portable DNA tools to help Hong Kong border control detect illegal rhino ray fins. Testing targets wedgefish & guitarfish DNA to enforce CITES trade restrictions & stop trafficking of endangered species.

properties.title: Searching for Sawfish in Indonesian Seas
properties.description: Documenting sawfish presence, distribution & diversity in Asmat Regency, Papua. Investigating cultural & socio-economic value. Provides baseline data for Indonesian government conservation strategy in remote coastal waters.

properties.title: Disentangling the drivers of Antarctic Peninsula penguin colony declines
properties.description: Monitoring Antarctic penguins during COVID-19 to separate impacts of tourism, climate change & krill fishing on colony declines. Uses drones, cameras & faecal samples (2020-22) to inform conservation policy.

properties.title: Does habitat use change with age for cownose rays?
properties.description: Tracking cownose rays in Apalachicola Bay to define seasonal habitat use, identify changes in core habitat preferences across life stages, and determine if Brazilian and Atlantic species are mating. Data collection until 2024.

properties.title: Raising awareness of the critically endangered flapper skate in Northern Ireland
properties.description: Training sea-anglers in safe release techniques for critically endangered flapper skate using 3D life-size model. Roadshow across Northern Ireland to raise awareness and support for first marine protected area designation for the species.

properties.title: All About the Bottlenose: An Endangered Wedgefish in Malaysia
properties.description: Studies white-spotted wedgefish population genetics and fishery threats in Malaysian coastal waters. Uses molecular tools to assess connectivity and evaluate commercial/artisanal fishing impacts on this Critically Endangered species.

properties.title: What's the catch? Understanding shark catches in large-scale, data-limited artisanal fisheries
properties.description: Developing long-term monitoring for sharks/rays in Sri Lanka's small-scale fisheries through data collection, biological studies, best-practice toolkit creation, and capacity-building workshops.

properties.title: Mexico's Forgotten Sharks: Rediscovering a Natural Legacy
properties.description: Recovering local ecological knowledge of elasmobranchs in Terminos Lagoon through participatory mapping and community videos to empower fishers and protect threatened shark species in this critical nursery area.

properties.title: Conservation for Cameroon's sharks and rays
properties.description: Assessing diversity, abundance & threats to sharks/rays on Cameroon's north coast. Raising awareness where no legal protection exists. Addressing overfishing & bycatch through data collection & community outreach.

properties.title: Sustainable Science in the Deep Blue Sea
properties.description: Comparing eDNA, BRUVs & longline methods to assess deep-water shark/ray diversity in Azores EEZ. Identifying essential habitats & species hotspots for sustainable deep-sea fish conservation across protected areas.

properties.title: Identifying potential nursery habitats and determining life history of the Critically Endangered guitarfish
properties.description: Why: Sharpnose guitarfish critically endangered, lacks data. What: Study life history, identify nursery habitats. How: Fish landing surveys, biological studies with fishers. Where: Mathagal, northern Sri Lanka. When: Ongoing since 2017

properties.title: Providing Sawfish Education for Global Conservation Action
properties.description: Global sawfish education program combining research, management & public outreach to protect 5 Critically Endangered species. Builds on successful US model where education helped stabilize populations after 95% decline.

properties.title: Understanding the amulet trade of bowmouth guitarfish in Thailand
properties.description: Quantifying bowmouth guitarfish thorn trade in Thailand markets. Tracing supply chains from Bangkok's Tha Prachan market through ports. Investigating socio-economic drivers to inform CITES policy for this Critically Endangered ray.

properties.title: Sharks of the Sulu Sea
properties.description: Film & campaign to protect sharks/rays in Palawan's Sulu Sea. Documents Tubbataha shark aggregations, whale sharks, manta rays. Engages communities & government for habitat protection. Addresses illegal bycatch & overfishing threats.

properties.title: A genetic tool to help monitor sharks and skates in the North-East Atlantic
properties.description: Develops genetic monitoring tools using SNP markers for flapper skate & spurdog in NE Atlantic. Analyzes kinship, diversity & connectivity in MPAs. Uses egg cases & tissue samples. Aims to create conservation management manual.

properties.title: It's in the genes: conserving Cabo Verde's blackchin guitarfish populations
properties.description: Assembling reference genome for critically endangered blackchin guitarfish around Santa Luzia, Cabo Verde to estimate population size, assess genetic distinctness from mainland Africa populations, and inform conservation efforts.

properties.title: Unraveling the amphi-American guitarfishes: genetics, morphology, and biogeography of guitarfishes
properties.description: Genetic study of 9 Pseudobatos guitarfish species across Americas to aid species identification & conservation. Uses DNA, morphology & biogeography to inform fishery management of threatened bycatch species.

properties.title: Changing hearts and minds about Southern Florida's sharks
properties.description: Understanding public attitudes toward sharks in Biscayne Bay, Florida. Testing outreach messages to drive conservation action for great hammerheads & sawfish in this urban coastal nursery habitat.

properties.title: Protecting North America's Largest No-Take Marine Protected Area
properties.description: Revillagigedo National Park rangers combat illegal fishing using SKYLIGHT satellite monitoring to detect poachers near San Benedicto & Clarion Islands. Project aims to acquire seaworthy vessel for interception & monitoring surveys.

properties.title: Solutions for shark fisheries in a Surfer's Paradise
properties.description: Reducing threats to Critically Endangered sharks/rays in Indonesia's fisheries via payment schemes. Focuses on hammerheads/wedgefish in Kuta, Palau Weh, Tanjung Luar, Aceh Jaya. Links tourism revenue to fisher incentives for conservation.

properties.title: Protecting the sharkiest place on earth
properties.description: Assessing migratory routes & genetics of pregnant hammerheads & movement ecology of female silky sharks around Galapagos Marine Reserve. Advising on shark conservation policy in the Tropical Eastern Pacific.

properties.title: The clown wedgefish: no laughing matter
properties.description: Uses eDNA & local fisher knowledge to map critically endangered clown wedgefish habitat in Riau Islands, Indonesia. Aims to determine range & secure future of this rare species through conservation planning.

properties.title: Re-writing the sawfish story: Inspiring community driven conservation of sawfishes in Papua New Guinea
properties.description: Educating PNG communities on sawfish conservation through interactive children's books and safe-release guides for fishers. Targets coastal/riverine areas where sawfish are caught in gill nets, promoting live release.

properties.title: Temperature-driven movement patterns of blacknose sharks in Florida Bay and the Florida Keys
properties.description: Acoustic telemetry tracks blacknose shark movements in Florida Bay/Keys to identify migration corridors, habitat use drivers, and population differences between Gulf and Atlantic stocks for improved management.

properties.title: The Deep-Water Sharks of Puerto Rico
properties.description: Study deep-water shark diversity around Mona Island, Puerto Rico using DNA barcoding and stable isotopes. Collaborate with fishers to identify species, assess ecological roles, and promote conservation (2021-2024).

properties.title: Assessment of catch and bycatch of guitarfishes in Peruvian waters
properties.description: Recording guitarfish fishery data at 12 Peruvian ports to identify species, understand catch patterns, and support conservation management. Engaging fishers to collect biological samples and trade information for sustainable fishery measures.

properties.title: Effects of salmon aquaculture on diet and habitat use of Chondrichthyes from unique Patagonian fjords
properties.description: Assessing impacts of salmon farms on sharks/rays in Chilean Patagonian fjords through diet & isotope analysis. Focuses on catshark, elephantfish, dogfish. Informs aquaculture planning & conservation priorities.

properties.title: British Shark Life: Are Spurdog Siblings Sticking Together?
properties.description: Genetic study of spurdog sharks in British waters to identify relatives within aggregations, assess genetic diversity and connectivity across NE Atlantic populations. Found 39% related individuals in single aggregation.

properties.title: Family ties of critically endangered flapper skates and their implications for conservation management
properties.description: Genomic analysis reveals reproductive connections & movement of critically endangered flapper skates in/out Scottish MPA. Combines citizen science data to assess population connectivity, genetic diversity & MPA efficacy for conservation.

properties.title: Hvaldimir: the lost beluga whale
properties.description: Monitoring welfare of Hvaldimir, a previously captive beluga whale seeking human contact along Norway's coast since 2019. Studying health, behavior, vocalizations to evaluate potential reintroduction to natural pod.

properties.title: Importance of the Seychelles for endangered blue whales and other cetaceans
properties.description: Study blue whale abundance, behavior & habitat in Seychelles using acoustic & visual surveys around D'Arros Island. Assess acoustic pollution impacts, train local students, raise public awareness about cetaceans.

properties.title: Conservation Strategies for Hammerhead Sharks Nursery in the Galapagos Marine Reserve
properties.description: Monitoring scalloped hammerhead nursery areas in Galapagos to protect Critically Endangered species, assess population status, and support regional conservation across Eastern Tropical Pacific.

properties.title: Can deep-sea sharks survive and thrive in fishing grounds?
properties.description: Studies deep-sea shark/skate bycatch in southern Portugal bottom-trawl fisheries (200-600m depth). Assesses survival rates, diet, fishing impacts. Creates handling protocols with fishers to reduce mortality. Found 95% mortality rate.

properties.title: Which nursery is best for Peru's baby smooth hammerhead sharks?
properties.description: Assessing diet, habitat use, and nutritional status of juvenile smooth hammerhead sharks across three Peruvian nursery areas to identify critical habitats for protection and propose marine protected areas.

properties.title: A Lifeline for Libya's Angel Sharks
properties.description: Why: Angel sharks critically endangered, Libya potential hotspot. What: Document presence/distribution via fisher surveys. How: Social media network, market surveys, awareness. Where: Libyan coast. When: Ongoing

properties.title: Tracks: tagging the shark-like rays of Pilbara
properties.description: Tracking critically endangered bottlenose wedgefish & giant guitarfish in Pilbara, Western Australia via acoustic tagging to determine distribution, nursery habitats & movement patterns in pristine remote waters.

properties.title: Better the devil you know
properties.description: PhD research addressing devil ray data gaps in Indian Ocean. Clarifies taxonomy, investigates population structure, defines management units. Sampling network across 10 countries collects photos, biological data, tissue samples.

properties.title: Tracing Tanzania's Illegal Shark Product Networks
properties.description: Uses DNA barcoding to identify endangered sharks in traded products, exposes illegal supply networks, and raises awareness to enhance law enforcement and enable sustainable shark fisheries recovery in Tanzania.

properties.title: Protecting the threatened sharks and rays of the Republic of Congo
properties.description: Study artisanal fishery in Gulf of Guinea to understand catch composition of threatened wedgefishes and guitarfishes. Collect landing site data, train local researchers in species ID and data management.

properties.title: The Whole Tooth
properties.description: Interactive video blog & podcast connecting public to marine researchers. Answers ocean questions about sharks, rays & marine life from global experts. Available on YouTube & podcast platforms.

properties.title: Stingrays, pollution and their microbiome
properties.description: Studies maternal offloading of contaminants in placental elasmobranchs (Bonnethead sharks), examining how pollutants transfer to offspring during reproduction and gestation, and how feeding affects contaminant exposure in embryos.

properties.title: Monitoring Threatened Elasmobranchs in Greece: Identifying the Conservation Importance of Kos Island
properties.description: Collecting seasonal data on guitarfish, Gymnura altavela, and angel sharks around Kos Island to identify critical habitats and develop management plans for these Critically Endangered species in the South Aegean Sea.

properties.title: Training and tools to save bowmouth guitarfish
properties.description: Genetic analysis of Critically Endangered Rhina ancylostoma in Indian Ocean to inform management plans. Developing portable DNA sequencing for rapid species ID in Sri Lankan elasmobranch fishery monitoring.

properties.title: Close Kin and Cownose Ray Conservation
properties.description: Developing close-kin mark-recapture (CKMR) genomic methods to estimate elasmobranch population abundance. Focuses on whitespotted eagle rays and threatened species like smalltooth sawfish in nursery habitats.

properties.title: Back to Basics: Bottlenose Wedgefish Biology
properties.description: Studies age, growth & life history of bottlenose wedgefish (Rhynchobatus australiae) in Indo-Pacific to inform CITES conservation. Focuses on specimens from Singapore markets & Australia's Northern Prawn Fishery bycatch.

properties.title: Searching for El Guacapa with eDNA
properties.description: Using eDNA to assess sawfish populations in Choco, Colombia's estuaries and mangroves. Traditional surveys limited by fishing restrictions and turbid waters. Aims to determine status of threatened sawfish in TEP region.

properties.title: Filling in the gaps for Ghana's shark fisheries
properties.description: First comprehensive study of guitarfishes, wedgefishes & sawfishes in Ghana. Collects ecology, biology, socio-economic & trade data. Community-driven conservation & stakeholder workshops for species protection.

properties.title: Saving Kenya's Ocean Rhino
properties.description: Maps distribution of endangered guitarfish across Middle East & East Africa via fisher interviews. Identifies occurrence hotspots, historic trends, seasonality to inform conservation management & ISRAs.

properties.title: A new use for old things: saving sawfishes with repurposed rostra
properties.description: Repurposing old sawfish rostra into 25 educational displays across Far North Queensland to teach fishers safe release methods, prevent trophy hunting, and gather distribution data for critically endangered sawfish conservation.

properties.title: Can Corals Recover at Darros Island?
properties.description: Studies how internal waves bring cool deep water to coral reefs at D'Arros Island, Seychelles, reducing thermal stress and bleaching. Monitors temperature variability and coral health to understand recovery mechanisms.

properties.title: BC Whales
properties.description: Protecting cetaceans along northern BC coast since 2001. Hydrophone network monitors humpback, fin, orca populations. Combines scientific research with First Nation knowledge. Drone surveys study social behavior and genetics.

properties.title: Tracing sawfishes in the last habitats of Costa Rica
properties.description: Identifying & monitoring remote Pacific & Caribbean areas with viable largetooth sawfish populations using eDNA surveys to create nation-wide conservation strategy. Started 2016, led to legal protection 2017-2022.

properties.title: Of algal blooms and bull sharks
properties.description: Monitoring juvenile bull shark behavior in Florida's Indian River Lagoon using accelerometers to assess responses to harmful algal blooms in this critical nursery area. Aims to understand behavioral impacts of HABs.

properties.title: Community Conservation in the Caribbean
properties.description: Studies shark fisheries & consumption patterns in Saint Vincent & Grenadines. Investigates recent shift in shark meat demand, species diversity, sustainability concerns, and mercury contamination risks to human health.

properties.title: Secret lives of silky sharks
properties.description: Satellite-tagging silky sharks across western Atlantic, Gulf of Mexico & Caribbean to track movements, analyze diet & stable isotopes, documenting their food web role to support management & recovery of this vulnerable species.

properties.title: Catch Up: Understanding India's Rays Fisheries
properties.description: Study documenting ray species, fisheries drivers, and stakeholders in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Orissa to address 25% increase in landings since 1980s. Creates baseline data for conservation of threatened populations.

properties.title: Microplastics: A Macro Disaster
properties.description: Studies microplastic ingestion by whale & basking sharks in Maldives & Ireland via fecal sampling. Engages communities on plastic pollution impacts on filter-feeding giants & marine ecosystems. Year-round monitoring.

properties.title: Connecting Communities to Conservation
properties.description: CDF's ECO-Program educates Galapagos communities (ages 8-17, adults) on marine science through experiential learning, addressing lack of environmental education and fostering conservation proactivity in this isolated 25,000-person archipelago.

properties.title: Environmental Education in the Seychelles
properties.description: UCEE provides environmental education through fieldwork in rivers, mangroves, seagrass & coral reefs. Programs build awareness via presentations, workshops & field trips for students, supporting sustainable schools in Seychelles.

properties.title: Secrets of the Whale Sharks of the Galapagos Marine Reserve
properties.description: Satellite tagging & research to understand whale shark movements, feeding, mating & birthing sites in Galapagos Marine Reserve. Aims to identify critical habitats for protection. Started 1990, formal project began after 6yrs fundraising.

properties.title: Building future conservation leaders in The Bahamas
properties.description: Environmental education program at Cape Eleuthera Island School fostering critical thinking and marine ecosystem connection for 120+ students annually through experiential learning, field research, and mentorship in South Eleuthera.

properties.title: Decoding DNA for diversity
properties.description: Using DNA barcoding to identify shark species in Puerto Rican waters via fish market samples and fisher assistance. Assesses local shark consumption and educates community on shark ecological importance.

properties.title: Conservation implications of biomineralization patterns in shark vertebrae cartilage
properties.description: Investigates vertebrae biomineralization in shortfin mako sharks across ocean basins to improve age estimates. Uses manganese patterns to objectively determine age, critical for population models and sustainable catch quotas.

properties.title: Population genomics assessment of blacktip sharks in the Gulf of Mexico and Northwest Atlantic Ocean
properties.description: Assessing genomic variation in 500+ blacktip sharks across Gulf of Mexico, US Atlantic & Caribbean to determine population connectivity across national boundaries & inform multinational fisheries management collaboration.

properties.title: DNA fingerprinting to identify harvest location in the shark finning industry
properties.description: Using DNA fingerprinting to trace silky shark fins from Hong Kong markets back to their origin populations, identifying illegal fishing areas and monitoring harvest of vulnerable shark stocks globally.

properties.title: Home on the Lemon Shark Range
properties.description: Studies lemon shark space use, body size, and energetics using acceleration data loggers to understand how metabolic rate scales with size and predicts home range requirements in wild populations.

properties.title: On the Ray-dar
properties.description: Study batoid foraging rates & bioturbation impact on coastal sandflats using drone methods. Aims to establish species-specific foraging patterns, habitat use & develop efficient abundance estimation for threatened ray populations.

properties.title: What's Happening with Wedgefish?
properties.description: Research on White-spotted Wedgefish in Philippines to gather baseline data on catches, fishing methods, and distribution. Aims to list R. australiae and look-alikes as protected species nationally and support CITES listing.

properties.title: Getting to the Bottom of By-catch
properties.description: Research on manta and devil ray bycatch in global tuna purse seine fisheries, particularly Eastern Tropical Pacific. Uses genetic techniques to assess impacts on 5 mobulid species and develop conservation solutions.

properties.title: Curbing Conflict in Cape Cod
properties.description: Study white shark predatory behavior and movements off Cape Cod to mitigate human-shark conflicts. Using tagging tech to identify when/where sharks hunt seals near beaches, informing safety strategies for recreational water users.

properties.title: Baselines for butterfly babies
properties.description: Study critically endangered spiny butterfly rays on Spanish coast. Map populations via sand marks, assess tourist impact, conduct awareness campaigns. Local communities monitor ray presence and size.

properties.title: Breaking ground with Bimini's babies
properties.description: PhD research uses genetic analysis to study pollution impacts on lemon sharks in Bimini nurseries. Investigates epigenetic responses to coastal development stress across generations in one of world's largest shark nurseries.

properties.title: Better days for mobulid rays
properties.description: Training fishery observers to assess mobulid ray survival after purse-seine net release in Eastern Pacific. Creating best-practice guidelines to improve survival rates through better handling methods.

properties.title: Playing for time: Guitar- and Violyn Sharks, is this the last dance?
properties.description: Clarifying taxonomy, biogeography & fisheries status of threatened guitarfish & wedgefish in Western Indian Ocean to inform conservation strategies & fisheries management for these critically endangered shark-like rays.

properties.title: Shark Survival from the Shore
properties.description: Studies great hammerhead survival rates in Florida's recreational shore fishery. Surveys angler practices, develops best-handling protocols, and informs federal/state management to improve shark conservation.

properties.title: Catch-up: Mexico's shark fisheries
properties.description: Monitoring artisanal shark fishery at Popotla, Mexican Pacific coast, focusing on prickly sharks and chimaeras. Surveys catch sites, interviews fishers to understand species composition, biology, and fishing effort for conservation management.

properties.title: Fisheries in far-flung places
properties.description: Managing shark fishery in Honduras' Moskitia region. Establishing baseline for shark abundance/diversity, characterizing artisanal fishery targeting hammerheads, building fisher capacity. Post-2016 sanctuary repeal.

properties.title: Eat or be eaten
properties.description: Studies bonnethead shark movement in Apalachicola Bay, Florida. Examines how prey (blue crabs) and predators (bull sharks) influence habitat use through acoustic tracking and surveys. Aims to inform fisheries management.

properties.title: Searching for sharks in South Asian seas
properties.description: Documents elasmobranch diversity in Andaman & Nicobar Islands through catch composition analysis, species identification, and trade data to inform conservation planning for threatened shark and ray populations.

properties.title: Honing in on habitats
properties.description: Mapping critical sawfish habitat in Bangladesh's Sundarbans by training local fishers as para-biologists to track declining populations of 4 Critically Endangered sawfish species through cellphone reporting system.

properties.title: Assessing Angola's fisheries
properties.description: Ana assesses shark & ray diversity in Angola's artisanal fisheries in the Benguela Ecosystem. Building baseline data for managing threatened species in West African waters through surveys & tissue sampling at landing sites.

properties.title: The Sawfish Sleuth
properties.description: Monitoring endangered smalltooth sawfish recovery in Tampa Bay, Florida. Investigating population expansion north from south Florida through field surveys, acoustic tracking, and public reports. Aims to protect recovering populations.

properties.title: Batoids on your plate: Species composition of the Mediterranean ray trade
properties.description: DNA barcoding study identifying ray/skate species in Mediterranean fish markets to assess threatened species in trade, estimate population maturity, and support conservation management of vulnerable batoid populations.

properties.title: There's Something About Sawsharks
properties.description: Studies Common and Southern Sawsharks in Southern Australia through molecular analysis, tagging, and diet studies to assess population structure, genetic diversity, movement patterns, and habitat use for conservation management.

properties.title: From the Boat to the Vote
properties.description: Monitoring shark/ray fisheries in Guyana to provide species-level data for CITES trade regulation. Addresses data gaps in elasmobranch landings to inform government voting on international conservation listings.

properties.title: Global Sawfish Search
properties.description: Uses eDNA sampling to survey sawfish populations globally. Aims to determine current distribution of 5 critically endangered sawfish species across countries where status is uncertain, enabling targeted conservation efforts.

properties.title: Toxic traces in endangered sharks
properties.description: Characterizing inorganic and organic contaminants in endangered guitarfishes and angelsharks off Baixada Santista coast, southeastern Brazil. Evaluating metals, pesticides, and PPCPs bioaccumulation in near-shore habitats.

properties.title: The Great South African White Shark Count
properties.description: Why: Assess white shark population status. What: Comprehensive abundance estimate using telemetry & mark-recapture. How: Multi-site data integration. When: Ongoing. Where: South African waters.

properties.title: Sawfish Status PNG
properties.description: Baseline assessment of sawfish populations in Papua New Guinea, particularly in Western Province near Fly River. Surveys document all 4 PNG sawfish species, evaluate threats from development, and educate communities.

properties.title: Kick-starting ELMO - Using citizen science to study the reproductive biology of South African catsharks
properties.description: Citizen science project studying reproductive biology, breeding grounds, and embryo development of endemic South African catsharks to improve protection of these threatened species along the coastline.

properties.title: Guardian Angels
properties.description: Testing BRUV cameras to monitor Critically Endangered angelsharks in Welsh & Canary Islands waters. Piloting methodology to understand ecology & distribution where visual surveys fail due to cryptic species behavior.

properties.title: Bonnetheads – magneto sharks
properties.description: Studying how bonnethead sharks use Earth's magnetic field for navigation during philopatric migrations in South Carolina. Sharks are displaced offshore with magnetic tags to assess geomagnetic navigation.

properties.title: Migration Mechanics USA
properties.description: Study blacktip shark migration along US East Coast using acoustic telemetry & 3D accelerometers. Track seasonal movement from Georgia/Carolinas to SE Florida, measure energetic costs, identify critical habitat as range expands northward due to warmin

properties.title: Galápagos Marine Education Programme
properties.description: Marine education program in Galápagos teaching local students about shark conservation through experiential activities. Aims to create future conservation agents among island youth through hands-on learning.

properties.title: Keeping tabs on tiger shark moms
properties.description: Tracking mature female tiger sharks in Bimini, Bahamas to identify pupping areas. Combines satellite telemetry with body condition & reproductive status data to understand movement drivers within shark sanctuary.

properties.title: Experimental validation of unmanned aerial vehicles to survey smalltooth sawfish in the Bahamas
properties.description: First UAV survey of critically endangered smalltooth sawfish in Bimini, Bahamas. Validates drone detection rates using captive sharks and models under varying conditions to assess population status in shallow mangrove habitats.

properties.title: Sawfish eDNA USA
properties.description: Evaluating eDNA to detect endangered smalltooth sawfish in Florida estuaries. Monitoring presence/absence in Indian River Lagoon & Tampa Bay to assess range expansion & support recovery planning with public encounter data.

properties.title: Artisanal fishery of Rays fish in relation to local livelihoods - in Mafia District, Tanzania
properties.description: Study of declining ray populations in Mafia Island, Tanzania due to overfishing. Assesses ray fishery status, reproductive parameters, and local livelihoods. Aims to develop conservation strategies for sustainable fisheries.

properties.title: On-site ID: take-away tech for threatened sharks
properties.description: Testing portable Lab-on-a-Chip DNA tech in Ecuador's coastal markets to rapidly identify threatened shark species, combat illegal fishing, and monitor CITES-restricted trade. Empowers local communities with field-ready identification.

properties.title: Impact of extreme climatic conditions on reproductive biology of endangered sea turtles in Iran
properties.description: Studies how extreme Persian Gulf temperatures affect sea turtle sex ratios and reproduction. Monitors nesting beach temps, determines wild turtle gender ratios via laparoscopy, uses genetics to link populations to beaches.

properties.title: The Starting Point for Saving Albania's Sharks
properties.description: Survey of shark catches in Albanian waters (Adriatic & Ionian seas). Training fishermen on conservation, sensitizing coastal communities. Addressing threats from professional/sport fishing to 40+ Mediterranean shark species.

properties.title: Rays of Paradise: Ecology and Distribution of Spiny Butterfly Ray in Gran Canaria
properties.description: Studies vulnerable spiny butterfly rays in Gran Canaria, Canary Islands. Uses citizen science & visual surveys to map distribution, abundance & population structure in nearshore reproduction hotspots threatened by fishing.

properties.title: Sawfish hunt: return to Senegal
