properties.description: Assessing if critically endangered smalltooth sawfish still exist in Casamance River estuary, Senegal, where they were abundant in 1970s. Sampling juveniles in former nursery grounds via gill nets and fishermen interviews.

properties.title: Ecological consequences of personality in sharks
properties.description: Study of juvenile lemon shark personality traits (exploration, sociability) in Bimini to understand how behavior influences ecology, survival, habitat use, and niche specialization for improved conservation strategies.

properties.title: Sharks and Rays of the Arabian Seas
properties.description: Research project studying sharks and rays in Arabian Seas. Focuses on species identification, distribution, and conservation needs in the region through field surveys and market monitoring.

properties.title: Sharks from Peninsula Valdes: a research and conservation initiative
properties.description: Research on school & sevengill sharks in Northern Patagonia to produce conservation knowledge, promote awareness among stakeholders, and include sharks in Peninsula Valdes management agenda through tagging & fishermen engagement.

properties.title: Sea Turtle Hospital: The Cancer Unit
properties.description: Research on fibropapillomatosis tumor disease affecting sea turtles. Studies disease prevalence, causes, and treatment methods to improve conservation outcomes for wild turtle populations.

properties.title: What's on the menu for sharks and rays?
properties.description: Uses amino acid stable isotope analysis on captive sharks/rays to determine trophic enrichment factors. Analyzes tissue samples from aquarium animals to improve understanding of wild elasmobranch food webs and feeding ecology.

properties.title: Nurturing Shark and Ray Science in Mexico
properties.description: Training Mexican students in manta ray conservation research in Bahia de Banderas and Revillagigedo Islands to study seasonality, boat strikes, entanglement threats, and build local elasmobranch research capacity.

properties.title: Sawfish status in Indonesia
properties.description: Survey sawfish status across Indonesia's 13,000 islands through field surveys, biological sampling, awareness campaigns, Alert Network implementation, and capacity building to support conservation of 4 protected Pristidae species.

properties.title: Ocean Connectors: Sharks and Their Threats
properties.description: US-Mexico student knowledge exchanges using art, letters, videos to build awareness of sharks and ocean threats. Targets underserved National City youth along San Diego Bay with bilingual environmental education.

properties.title: Sawfish Gene Pool
properties.description: Compares genetic diversity of historic vs contemporary sawfish populations using DNA from museum rostra to assess impact of population declines on largetooth & green sawfish in Australia, Brazil, Red Sea & Persian Gulf.

properties.title: Lost Fishes of Easter Island
properties.description: Study pelagic top predators around Easter Island using BRUVS technology to assess species composition, abundance & distribution of sharks, tuna & jacks in this isolated biodiversity hotspot facing overfishing.

properties.title: Saving Sharks in Sabah
properties.description: Conservation of 95 elasmobranch species in Sabah, Malaysia. Addresses knowledge gaps for threatened sharks & rays through research, community education, and citizen science monitoring to combat IUU fishing.

properties.title: Sharks and People of Watamu MPA
properties.description: Elasmobranch conservation in Watamu Marine National Park, Kenya's oldest marine park. Surveys 8 shark/ray species including juveniles. Fills conservation gap through research and education at A Rocha Kenya facility.

properties.title: Seafood Detectives Guatemala
properties.description: DNA testing identifies shark/ray species sold in Guatemalan markets. Addresses mislabeling in seafood supply chain, targeting silky, whitenose, hammerhead sharks. Conducted in Pacific/Caribbean regions during peak demand Oct-Mar.

properties.title: Do stingrays have superpowers?
properties.description: Studies how yellow stingrays detect Earth's magnetic field to understand shark navigation during migration and assess impacts of undersea power cables on elasmobranch orientation in Florida waters.

properties.title: Project Airship
properties.description: Developing nonlethal shark-human interaction strategies to replace harmful shark meshing programs. Testing scientifically proven methods to ensure public safety while protecting vulnerable marine species from capture and death.

properties.title: Fish and fishers of the Colombian Seas
properties.description: Surveys artisanal fishers along Colombia's Caribbean coast to assess elasmobranch catch/bycatch magnitude. Uses fisher knowledge to fill data gaps and inform sustainable management of sharks and rays.

properties.title: Understanding Genetic Population Structure of Endangered Nassau Grouper to Support their Conservation in The Bahamas
properties.description: DNA analysis of Nassau Grouper in the Bahamas to assess population sizes, genetic diversity & structure. Aims to inform sustainable management of this endangered species facing drastic decline from overfishing at spawning sites.

properties.title: Shark Aerial Patrol
properties.description: Analyzing 18 years of aerial shark observation data in SE Australia to improve non-lethal shark safety strategies. Aims to ensure accuracy of volunteer-collected data for shark management and beach safety.

properties.title: Global protection for devil rays
properties.description: Advocacy for CITES Appendix II listing of all mobula ray species to regulate international trade in gill plates and products, addressing 96-99% population declines from unsustainable fisheries targeting these vulnerable rays.

properties.title: Great Barrier Reef's sharks of the deep
properties.description: Studies deep-dwelling sharks/rays in Great Barrier Reef using stable isotope analysis. Assesses diet, movement, bycatch threats in deep water habitats. Located at James Cook University, Australia. Ongoing research.

properties.title: The Watermen Project
properties.description: Free diving and ocean conservation project led by west coast Canada waterman. Focuses on protecting marine environments through spearfishing, sailing, and ocean advocacy, inspired by 40+ years of ocean experience.

properties.title: Bioaccumulation of organochlorine contaminants in three species of predatory sharks occupying multiple trophic levels
properties.description: Studies DDT and PCB accumulation in blue, shortfin mako, and thresher sharks across age classes in southern California waters to understand bioaccumulation dynamics and assess contaminant risks in pelagic predators.

properties.title: Predator-prey interactions: understanding how shark presence influences sea turtle habitat use, distribution and movement
properties.description: Tracks loggerhead & green turtles with bull & tiger sharks to understand predator-prey dynamics, habitat overlap & movement patterns in high shark density regions to inform marine protected area design.

properties.title: The Manta Code Continues
properties.description: Why: Understand manta ray evolution & adaptation to threats. What: DNA sequencing of 2 manta species & color morphs. How: Next-gen genomics & bioinformatics. When: Ongoing. Where: Global manta populations across reefs & migratory routes.

properties.title: Sharks on the urban edge
properties.description: Studies white shark ecology in False Bay, South Africa. Monitors shark presence, distribution, behavior across habitats/seasons. Examines environmental drivers, prey availability, trophic role to balance conservation with public safety.

properties.title: The global genetic population structure of the tiger shark (Galeocerdo cuvier)
properties.description: Examines genetic connectivity of tiger sharks globally using high-throughput sequencing to determine population structure across Atlantic, Caribbean, and Indo-Pacific regions for proper management and conservation.

properties.title: Return to the Unknown: Discovering Deep-Sea Sharks
properties.description: Exploring Southern Indian Ocean's deep-sea seamounts to discover new shark species and study impacts of commercial fishing on vulnerable deep-sea elasmobranch populations along Melville and 90 East Ridges.

properties.title: Fishes of St Joseph: where, when & why?
properties.description: Acoustic telemetry study of bonefish & permit at St Joseph Atoll, Seychelles. Investigates movement, habitat use, trophic ecology & post-release recovery to support fly-fishing management & assess ecosystem health.

properties.title: Pacific Mobulids Unwanted Catch
properties.description: Study manta and mobula ray bycatch in eastern Pacific tuna fisheries to reduce incidental mortality. Analyzes catch distribution, species diversity, and habitat use to inform conservation of vulnerable populations.

properties.title: Shark CSI: conserving sharks through genetic investigation
properties.description: Uses genetic techniques to assess shark population health and establish parent-offspring relationships. Analyzes samples from sharks worldwide to answer conservation questions through molecular ecology.

properties.title: Sawfish safehouse
properties.description: Investigating largetooth sawfish role in Northern Australia's ecosystem. Barbara Wueringer studies trophic positions of euryhaline elasmobranchs in Cape York Peninsula coastal/riverine habitats, engaging citizen scientists for awareness.

properties.title: Connecting Oceanic Whitetips
properties.description: Research project studying oceanic whitetip sharks to understand their movement patterns, behavior, and connectivity across ocean regions to support conservation efforts for this vulnerable pelagic species.

properties.title: Sharks in the birthplace of evolution
properties.description: Exploring shark communities in Galapagos Marine Reserve. Assessing population status, critical habitats, and effectiveness of marine protection. Inspiring local communities to protect sharks through education programs.

properties.title: Feasibility of a novel, low-cost tracking system to monitor the movements of marine turtles
properties.description: Developing low-cost GPS-GSM tags for Mediterranean loggerhead turtles. Testing prototypes on rehabilitated turtles in Italy to track movements, improve spatial data, and reduce costs vs Argos satellite systems.

properties.title: Shark Share Global
properties.description: Global database connecting shark & ray researchers to share tissue samples, fostering collaboration & efficient use of limited resources. Addresses knowledge gaps in elasmobranch biology, genetics & conservation.

properties.title: Refuges and Risks: Transboundary Tiger Sharks
properties.description: Studies tiger shark movement patterns between South Africa's iSimangaliso Wetland Park and Mozambique's Ponta do Ouro Marine Reserve to improve conservation policies and assess threats from culling and fishing in the south-west Indian Ocean.

properties.title: Catching devils on camera
properties.description: Studies Chilean devil ray aggregations in Azores seamounts using underwater video observatories and photo-ID. Aims to understand seasonal patterns, behavior, and diving tourism impacts to support conservation of these deep-diving rays.

properties.title: Andros Island: A Lifeboat for Sawfishes
properties.description: Tracking smalltooth sawfish habitat use and genetics in Andros West Side National Park, Bahamas. Using satellite telemetry and DNA analysis to determine if this 1.3M-acre park protects a distinct breeding population critical to species recovery.

properties.title: Deep-dwelling and little-known
properties.description: Study deep-sea sharks in Belize threatened by expanding fisheries. Baseline surveys of abundance, diversity, life history via fisher interviews, tissue samples, tagging. Atolls near 1,500m depths. Ongoing multi-year research.

properties.title: Keeping sharks and rays in the Quirimbas
properties.description: Assessing shark/ray conservation status in Quirimbas archipelago, Mozambique. Establishing baseline data, monitoring catches, identifying species/aggregations, raising local awareness amid growing fishing pressure.

properties.title: Shark Skin Time Travel
properties.description: Studies declining North Pacific shark populations (blue, mako, salmon sharks) through Japanese fishing vessel captain interviews. Analyzes catch data & local knowledge to improve conservation policies for migratory species.

properties.title: Keeping Watch on Palmyra's Sharks
properties.description: Quantifying how reef sharks respond to human presence (diving, snorkeling, boating) at Palmyra Atoll to correct bias in population surveys. Aims to improve accuracy of shark abundance estimates for better conservation.

properties.title: Reconstructing mid-Holocene shark baselines in Panama and the Dominican Republic using dermal denticle assemblages
properties.description: Uses fossilized shark skin (denticles) to establish pre-human shark population baselines in Caribbean reefs, quantifying historical degradation to inform modern conservation targets in Bocas del Toro and Dominican Republic.

properties.title: Great Bear LIVE
properties.description: Live-streaming underwater cameras monitor killer whales & humpback whales in Great Bear Rainforest, BC. Research distribution/behavior, identify critical habitat, advocate protection from industrial threats like tankers.

properties.title: Rebranding Sharks
properties.description: Research on public attitudes and policy responses to shark bites to improve shark conservation. Led by American political scientist studying how shark bite policies affect shark protection efforts.

properties.title: Sea turtles on Darros
properties.description: Community-based sea turtle nesting monitoring on D'Arros Island & St Joseph Atoll, Seychelles. Local workers conduct daily beach surveys, shifting from historical turtle harvesting to active conservation participation.

properties.title: Creating conservation heroes
properties.description: Training 100 marine park rangers across 22 Ecuadorian marine protected areas in biological conservation, monitoring, education & community development to combat illegal logging, wildlife trafficking & habitat destruction.

properties.title: National assessment of the Indian mobulidae fishery
properties.description: Studies biology and fisheries of manta and mobula rays along Indian coast. Surveys landing sites, records species/catch data, documents gill plate trade. Addresses high exploitation from international trade where India is major exporter.

properties.title: The effects of white shark cage-diving on the ecological importance of residing around seal colonies
properties.description: Assessing how cage-diving tourism affects white shark foraging at Neptune Islands seal colony using fatty acid analysis. Comparing diet of newly arrived vs resident sharks to determine if tourism disrupts natural feeding.

properties.title: Pacific Plastics Expedition
properties.description: 63-day trans-Pacific survey from San Francisco to Yokohama studying microplastic pollution. First comprehensive North Pacific Gyre debris survey using small sailing vessel, collecting samples to understand ocean plastic extent and impacts.

properties.title: Britain's basking sharks
properties.description: Photo-ID database tracks protected basking sharks in UK waters to understand life history, movements & population recovery. Teams collect photos & DNA samples across Scotland, Isle of Man, England & Ireland.

properties.title: Activities at the Shark Lab
properties.description: Founded 1990 at Bimini Biological Field Station. 50-year shark research studying vision, behavior. Training young researchers through field-based education in unique Bahamian ecosystems.

properties.title: Seeking Madagascar's sawfishes
properties.description: Assessing critically endangered sawfish populations in Western Madagascar. Identifying species, habitats, threats via field research & community interviews. Developing conservation plans with local authorities to protect remaining populations.

properties.title: Makos: nomads of the high seas
properties.description: Tracking shortfin mako sharks in North Atlantic to study movements, habitat preferences & fisheries overlap. Uses satellite tags to map migration routes & assess conservation needs for this vulnerable species.

properties.title: Sharks & rays of paradise
properties.description: Research in Jardines de la Reina MPA, Cuba assessing shark/ray diversity, abundance, spatial ecology via tagging. Provides benchmark for MPA effectiveness in protecting mobile species. Aims to inform Cuban shark legislation.

properties.title: Angel of the Canary Islands
properties.description: Studies angel shark distribution, nursery areas & movement patterns in Canary Islands via tagging & citizen science. Achieved Spanish endangered listing & developed recovery plan. Identified 15 nursery areas across archipelago.

properties.title: Sharks4Kids App
properties.description: Educational mobile app and video series teaching children about shark anatomy, evolution, and conservation. Uses HD macro photos/videos to explore shark features and threats. Free curriculum for educators globally.

properties.title: Unravelling the mystery of smooth-hound sharks
properties.description: Examining physical & genetic differences between common & white-spotted smooth-hound sharks targeted by fishermen along South Africa's coast to understand species relationships & aid conservation.

properties.title: The Acoustic Tracking Array Platform (ATAP)
properties.description: Collaborative acoustic tracking array spanning thousands of km of Southern African coast to monitor fish and shark movements, painting a picture of species behavior for better management and protection.

properties.title: Drone Diaries of the Bahamas
properties.description: Why: Fill public understanding gap on shark fishing ban benefits. What: Shark conservation education in Bahamas sanctuary. How: Promote catch-release, support ecotourism. Where: Bahamas coastal waters. When: Post-2011 ban.

properties.title: Shark DNA Workshop
properties.description: Workshop studying elasmobranch DNA and migration patterns, examining human impacts on shark populations through genetic analysis. Conducted in Australia and Southern California coastal waters.

properties.title: Tracking critically endangered oceanic whitetip sharks for effective transboundary conservation
properties.description: Tracking oceanic whitetip sharks in Bahamas Shark Sanctuary to determine time spent in protected vs. unprotected waters, informing transboundary conservation policy for this critically endangered species.

properties.title: Tracking Hungry Hawksbills
properties.description: Study movement behavior of critically endangered hawksbill turtles at D'Arros Island & St Joseph Atoll, Seychelles using acoustic tracking to determine habitat preferences, home range & migration patterns for improved conservation management.

properties.title: Sharks for Sale in India
properties.description: Assessing shark stocks & fisheries in Gujarat & Maharashtra (46% of India's catch). Addresses overfishing driven by fin trade, CITES regulations, and 'fins attached' policy. Aims to conserve declining shark populations.

properties.title: Giants of Peru
properties.description: Research whale shark ecology in Peru, focusing on El Ñuro where they most frequently occur. Surveys with fishermen and dive companies to generate knowledge about this vulnerable migratory species and implement conservation.

properties.title: Giant clams and climate change: ocean acidification and global warming research for conservation and management
properties.description: Research on climate change impacts on giant clams to prevent extinction. Studies ocean acidification & warming effects on survival, growth, calcification. Develops management plans for wild populations & hatcheries in Pacific reefs.

properties.title: ID-shot Southern Right Whales
properties.description: Combining theodolite tracking with drone ID-photography to study southern right whale mating behavior and surface active groups along South Africa's coast during June-January breeding season, revealing sperm competition strategies.

properties.title: Lemon Sharks: Familiar Friends
properties.description: Studies juvenile lemon shark social behavior and partner preference to understand group formation mechanisms. Aims to overcome public fear of sharks by demonstrating their social complexity and ecological importance as apex predators.

properties.title: Sawfishes: Spreading the Love
properties.description: Tag-and-release study of critically endangered sawfish in Cape York river systems, Queensland's Gulf of Carpentaria - a global stronghold. Builds on 2008 study to protect vulnerable species in remote coastal habitats.

properties.title: Mobulid Ray Conservation
properties.description: Conserving manta & mobula rays globally threatened by fisheries targeting gill plates for Asian markets. Research, tourism & policy address knowledge gaps for sustainable protection of these vulnerable planktivorous rays.

properties.title: Turtle Action Group of Seychelles (TAGS): group revival and website production
properties.description: Reviving TAGS to coordinate sea turtle monitoring across Seychelles islands. Standardizing methods, sharing data from 20+ programs, and creating a website to disseminate conservation success since 1994 turtle protection laws.

properties.title: Baby sharks sharing space
properties.description: Studies young blacktip reef & sicklefin lemon sharks in St Joseph's lagoon, Seychelles. Examines how juvenile sharks coexist in nursery areas during early life stages. Investigates diet, growth & habitat use.

properties.title: Shark Tunes
properties.description: Studies how background music in shark documentaries influences public perception and fear of sharks. Pilot study showed playful music made sharks seem 44% less scary and increased conservation donations by 40% vs scary music.

properties.title: Hunting for porcupines
properties.description: Research on porcupine ray movement and habitat use in Great Barrier Reef coral environments using cameras, kayak, and snorkeling to assess vulnerability to climate change and reef degradation.

properties.title: Tracking hammerheads in Japan
properties.description: Study scalloped hammerhead aggregation off Mikomoto, Japan. Track migration, social behavior, habitat use via tagging. Protect last northern hemisphere hotspot. Raise awareness in Asian communities.

properties.title: Shark spy: bird's eye view
properties.description: Using drones to monitor shark & ray populations in Moorea's shallow coral reefs. Non-invasive aerial surveys estimate abundance, distribution & behavior of juvenile sharks in nursery habitats, replacing stressful fishing methods.

properties.title: Conserving Mobulas Under Fire
properties.description: Monitors mobulid ray landings in Gaza to assess fishery scale, sustainability, and gill plate trade. Conducts fisher interviews, DNA sampling, and conservation workshops to protect endangered Mobula mobular in Palestinian waters.

properties.title: A tale of three sharks
properties.description: Genetic study of blacktip, great hammerhead & nurse sharks in Florida Keys, Everglades & Bahamas. Assesses population status under varying fishing pressures to evaluate conservation policy effectiveness using molecular tools.

properties.title: Underwater shark surveillance
properties.description: Studies how shark-diving bait provisioning affects lemon shark behavior and diet in Moorea using underwater cameras and tissue biopsies. Investigates feeding ecology, abundance, and habitat use patterns. Funded 2014.

properties.title: False Bay on Film
properties.description: Uses underwater cameras (BRUVs) to monitor fish diversity & abundance in False Bay, South Africa. Integrates data into conservation planning to manage fisheries & anthropogenic pressures. Surveys reef fish, invertebrates, establishes biotopes.

properties.title: Tracking Bimini's Sharks
properties.description: Studying great hammerhead spatial data & habitat use to reduce fishery capture (90% mortality). Researching lemon shark personality variation & behavior. Bimini Biological Field Station conducts conservation & behavioral research.

properties.title: Undulate Ray Genetics
properties.description: Study of undulate ray population structure in eastern Atlantic (British Isles to NW Africa) using genetics and tagging to identify stock units and site fidelity for effective management of this Endangered species.

properties.title: White Shark Central
properties.description: Acoustic tagging study in Gansbaai, South Africa investigating white shark behavior, habitat use, and cage diving impacts. Tracks day/night movements year-round to inform conservation and reduce human-shark conflict.

properties.title: The Great Eggcase Hunt App
properties.description: UK citizen-science project tracking shark, skate & ray eggcases to map distribution & nursery grounds. 35,000+ records from 1,000+ volunteers since 2003 help monitor declining elasmobranch populations.

properties.title: Protecting Pakistan's Mantas
properties.description: Study mobulid rays in northern Arabian Sea (Pakistan) to assess seasonal abundance, distribution, reproduction & feeding habits. Address high gillnet by-catch mortality through research & community awareness for conservation.

properties.title: Discovering Deep-Sea Sharks
properties.description: Study of deep-sea sharks on Southern Indian Ocean seamounts. Research focuses on biodiversity, ecology, and fishing impacts on vulnerable slow-reproducing species. 2012-2014 surveys discovered 7 new shark species.

properties.title: Pristine Habitat Pristine Population
properties.description: Study reef manta ray aggregations at D'Arros Island MPA using acoustic telemetry, photo-ID, isotope analysis to understand residency, food chains, social structures for conservation via marine protected areas across Indian Ocean sites.

properties.title: Shark Kryptonite
properties.description: Testing SMART Hook technology in commercial longline swordfishery to reduce shark bycatch by 60-94% using magnetic/repellent treatment while maintaining target fish catch. Field trials compare hundreds of treated vs control hooks.

properties.title: Wise on the Water
properties.description: UK-based training program teaching boat owners safe marine wildlife watching practices. Covers disturbance causes/effects, wildlife law, and practical guidelines. Pilot launched in west Scotland, expanding nationwide since 2003.

properties.title: Coral Reef Sharks
properties.description: Studying reef sharks in Great Barrier Reef to evaluate their ecological importance as apex predators. Quantifying trophic relationships and top-down structuring role via diet analyses and stable isotopes across shark density gradients.

properties.title: A stingray's story
properties.description: Investigating stingray ecology at St Joseph Atoll: population demographics, diet, habitat use & movement of cowtail, porcupine & mangrove whiptail rays. Acoustic tracking reveals how these species move & live in the lagoon.

properties.title: Sea eagles of the Caribbean
properties.description: Studying spotted eagle ray biology, ecology & fisheries across US, Mexico & Cuba. Using genetics to understand population connectivity & guide transnational conservation policy for this vulnerable species.

properties.title: Global manta & devil ray conservation
properties.description: Developing worldwide network & strategy to protect manta & devil rays threatened by gill plate trade for traditional Chinese medicine. Led by Nick Dulvy through IUCN Shark Specialist Group coordination.

properties.title: Decoding desert sharks
properties.description: Sudan's first shark scientist collects tissue samples at landing sites to study genetic diversity and population structure of Red Sea sharks using mtDNA and microsatellite analysis for conservation.

properties.title: Fishing for devil rays
properties.description: First assessment of manta and mobula ray fishery in Peru. Studies species composition, distribution, catch data, and markets to inform conservation strategies for slow-breeding rays vulnerable to overfishing.

properties.title: Rediscovering sawfishes in West Africa
properties.description: Saving critically endangered sawfishes in West Africa after 15 years of presumed extinction. Working with local communities to evaluate status, create alert networks, and reduce mortality through education in Guinea-Bissau and Sierra Leone.

properties.title: White shark population
properties.description: Using genetics to determine white shark population size in Australia. Compares historical jaw samples with contemporary data to assess if populations increased since protection, informing policy on shark management.

properties.title: Finny the Funny Shark
properties.description: Educational program using Finny the Funny Shark to teach children in Palau, Yap & Pohnpei about shark conservation. Aims to create youth ambassadors for marine protection across Micronesian islands. Active 2008-2013.

properties.title: Fighting Fish Bombers
properties.description: Eliminating fish bombing in Tun Sakaran Marine Park, Sabah using acoustic monitoring system. Hydrophones detect explosions in real-time, alert rangers via mobile, provide coordinates for immediate interception of illegal bombers.

properties.title: Hard-Eating Stingrays
properties.description: Global symposium bringing experts to review durophagous stingray biology, counter negative perceptions from shellfish fisheries, and develop conservation measures for these low-reproduction species at risk from kill tournaments.

properties.title: Da Manta Code
properties.description: Uses next-gen DNA sequencing to understand manta ray speciation, color morphs, and genetic adaptations. Identifies populations for conservation priority to help them adapt to fishing pressure and climate change globally.

properties.title: Manta Network Philippines
properties.description: Multi-scale study of manta and mobula ray distribution, exploitation and trade across Philippine waters. Citizen-science network with researchers, students, divers and fishers to map landings, markets and sightings.

properties.title: Whale sharks down under
properties.description: Study whale shark feeding ecology at Ningaloo Reef, Western Australia. Investigate why hundreds congregate annually by analyzing stomach contents, diet, and prey. Aims to inform conservation of this vulnerable species.

properties.title: Fishing, Fins and Food
properties.description: Environmental Justice Foundation assesses shark and turtle mortality in Liberia's artisanal fisheries, engaging fishing communities in marine species protection through surveillance, education, and capacity building since 2012.

properties.title: Migration, population status and monitoring of grey reef sharks in Palau
properties.description: Studies grey reef sharks in Palau through tagging, photo-ID & community monitoring to inform conservation. Tracks migration patterns, population status & economic value of shark diving to strengthen protection laws & management.

properties.title: Shark Bite: What's in a Word?
properties.description: Doctoral research examining how language framing of shark incidents affects public attitudes and conservation policy. Studies connection between negative perceptions and shark management decisions like drum-lines. Started March 2010.

properties.title: The Great Eggcase Hunt
properties.description: UK public records shark/skate/ray eggcases washed on beaches to identify nursery grounds & aid conservation. Engages citizens via apps, events. Funded 2010-2013. Over 30,000 eggcases reported to reverse species decline.

properties.title: The big BRUV
properties.description: Underwater video cameras (BRUVs) document sharks and fish in False Bay, South Africa. Simple, replicable system provides glimpses of underwater worlds. Led by Lauren de Vos, studying marine life distribution and abundance.

properties.title: Conservation and Natural History of the Greenland Shark
properties.description: Study Greenland sharks in Arctic waters using satellite tags and tissue sampling to understand movements, age structure, and longevity. Deploy PSATs for 1-12 months, collect samples for radiocarbon dating to inform conservation.

properties.title: Which mobulid is which?
properties.description: Creating world's first comprehensive mobulid ID guidebook & genetic kit for 11 vulnerable manta/mobula species. Addresses misidentification issues impeding conservation. Global scope targeting researchers & enforcers.

properties.title: Academy by the Sea
properties.description: Marine education program teaching Seychellois teenagers about their marine ecosystem through snorkeling and field camps. Led by Marine Conservation Society Seychelles, exposing youth to ocean life beyond beaches.

properties.title: Critical habitat for sharks
properties.description: Identifying critical mangrove/estuarine nursery habitats for sharks and rays in tropical eastern Pacific. Working with fishing communities to sustain biodiversity. Assessing protection adequacy for elasmobranchs.

properties.title: Shark tourism: friend or foe?
properties.description: Studies how shark feeding tourism affects reef shark behavior and metabolism at Osprey Reef, Australia. Uses electronic tags to measure activity and energy budgets, providing best practice guidelines for ecotourism operators.

properties.title: Cetacea Lab
properties.description: Protecting orcas in Great Bear Rainforest, BC by monitoring underwater hydrophones, deciphering whale language, identifying critical habitat, and supporting recovery of northern resident killer whales. Ongoing research since 2001.

properties.title: Shark Advocates International
properties.description: Policy advocacy for shark conservation. Addresses overfishing vulnerability through expert analysis in management forums. Tackles slow growth, late maturity issues. Global scope targeting fishing limits and trade regulations.

properties.title: Tight lines and easy release
properties.description: Educates Florida recreational anglers on safe release techniques for accidentally hooked sharks and rays. Provides videos, website resources, and materials at coastal locations to promote conservation and proper handling.

properties.title: Nursehound Purses
properties.description: Monitoring nursehound shark breeding in Gulf of Naples. Monthly dives track embryo development in mermaid's purses at Santa Croce Bank reef. Citizen science engages divers to report egg sightings across Mediterranean.

properties.title: Mobile sharks
properties.description: Training Vezo community members to collect real-time shark fishing data via mobile phones in Madagascar. Addresses shark population decline through community-based monitoring network across 5,500km coastline.

properties.title: Sharks on the line
properties.description: Studies recreational catch-and-release shark fishing in South Africa. Collects fishery data, measures post-release survival rates, and educates anglers on best practices to improve shark survival through tagging and physiological research.

properties.title: Do no-take reserves conserve coastal sharks?
properties.description: Research on school shark nursery recovery in Tasmania since 1960s fishing closure. Uses electronic tags to monitor juvenile sharks in protected areas, assess MPA effectiveness, and study predator-prey dynamics.

properties.title: The Shark Specialist Group
properties.description: IUCN SSG coordinates strategic conservation for 181+ threatened shark species through CITES listings, finning bans, and management plans. Addresses capacity limits with ~300 experts assessing 1000+ species globally.

properties.title: The Sawfish Report
properties.description: IUCN assessment found all 7 sawfish species Critically Endangered. Project develops conservation strategies for these threatened fish, addressing fishing threats, habitat loss, and population fragmentation in tropical/subtropical waters.

properties.title: The Shark That Got Lost: Mediterranean Great Whites
properties.description: Study Mediterranean white shark isolation, genetics & Atlantic connectivity. DNA shows Pacific ancestry (450k yrs). Assess migration, genetic diversity, pollutants & reproduction to protect vulnerable population.

properties.title: The Shark Riddle
properties.description: Educational shark episode & family events for children 5-12 to develop empathy, ownership & empowerment about sharks. Includes film screenings, live programs & hands-on activities at west coast US museums/aquariums.

properties.title: Cayman Islands shark project: achieving protective legislation
properties.description: First shark surveys in Cayman Islands using sonic/satellite tagging and BRUVs to study reef shark movements, tourism effects, and cetacean occurrence. Aims to protect endangered species and support sustainable shark tourism.

properties.title: Djibouti's Baby Giants
properties.description: Characterise whale shark identities in Djibouti aggregation through photo-ID, tissue samples & size data to estimate population demographics, growth rates & abundance. Inform regional population estimates.

properties.title: Marine Education Seychelles
properties.description: Marine education program inspiring Seychellois children to respect ocean environment through school sessions, guided snorkels, museum events, and community awareness. Led by Abbie Hine in collaboration with Ministry of Education.

properties.title: Saving Indonesia's manta rays
properties.description: Research & conservation of vulnerable manta rays in Indonesia since 2010. Studying fishery impacts, manta ecology, raising awareness, promoting eco-tourism alternatives to fishing. Addressing commercial gill trade threats.

properties.title: Ocean acidification: our changing seas
properties.description: Studies underwater volcanic vents in Mediterranean to understand how rising CO2 levels affect marine ecosystems. Examines biodiversity loss where pH drops 0.4 units. Aims to forecast ocean acidification impacts globally.

properties.title: Sea turtles of Malaysia
properties.description: Saving Malaysia's turtles by equipping shrimp trawlers with Turtle Excluder Devices (TEDs) and studying turtle ecology. Led by Nick Pilcher since 1993, focusing on reducing fishery impacts in Sabah waters.

properties.title: Where do tiny turtles go?
properties.description: Tracking neonate sea turtles in Florida using satellite tags to discover nursery habitats. Develops methods to tag hatchlings, tracks their offshore movements, identifies threats, and characterizes oceanographic features.

properties.title: Manta Rays Maldives
properties.description: Study of world's largest known manta ray population in Hanifaru, Maldives since 2005. Research provides critical insights on manta behavior, reproduction, feeding aggregations. Led by Guy Stevens, Manta Trust.

properties.title: Shark Spotters South Africa
properties.description: Cape Town shark warning system. Spotters monitor beaches for great white sharks, alerting beachgoers when sharks approach. Enables coexistence between ocean lovers and sharks through early detection and safety protocols.

properties.title: Ailan Awareness Marine Conservation
properties.description: New Ireland Province communities use traditional & scientific methods to manage marine resources. Roadshows, Indigenous conservation plans, Saltwater School education, Malagan cultural revival. Since 1993.

properties.title: Alliance of Solwara Warriors - Deep Sea Mining Opposition
properties.description: PNG community alliance opposing seabed mining since 2009. Educates coastal communities on mining impacts, mobilizes protests, petitions, court cases. Advocates for moratorium on deep-sea mining to protect marine ecosystems.

properties.title: BLOOM Association - Marine Advocacy and Deep Sea Conservation
properties.description: Campaigns for marine stewardship, deep-sea protection, fisheries reform. Achieved EU ban on deep-sea trawling below 800m (2016). Focuses on deep seas, subsidies, small-scale fisheries, education through media advocacy.

properties.title: Bengal Elasmo Lab - Sawfish and Guitarfish Conservation
properties.description: Bay of Bengal conservation of critically endangered sawfish & guitarfish. Collaborative research with fishers collecting catch data, developing stakeholder-led sustainable fisheries model & species recovery plan since 2018.

properties.title: Bismarck Ramu Group
properties.description: Mobilizes PNG communities to challenge seabed mining, nickel mine pollution, and land exploitation threatening coastal biodiversity and marine ecosystems. Campaigns against Madang seabed mining and Ramu Nickel impacts since 2013.

properties.title: Bukluran Indigenous and Community Conserved Areas
properties.description: Filipino Indigenous Peoples protect 349,423 hectares across 16 ICCAs with biodiverse rivers, springs, and marine ecosystems. Reviving traditional stewardship, advocating for Indigenous rights and biodiversity protection since 2014.

properties.title: Deep Ocean Stewardship Initiative (DOSI)
properties.description: Expert network supporting sustainable deep-ocean management through scientific collaboration, policy guidance, and stakeholder engagement. 512 members across 40 countries work via 13 groups on deep-sea ecosystems.

properties.title: Deep Sea Conservation Coalition - High Seas Protection
properties.description: Advocates for deep-sea protection through UN lobbying. Secured 6 UN resolutions restricting bottom trawling, closed vast ocean areas, banned EU deep-sea fishing below 800m. Campaigns against seabed mining via ISA regulations.

properties.title: Eco Custodian Advocates - Customary Marine Management
properties.description: Promotes traditional marine closures (Gwala/Hivi/Doi) in Milne Bay, PNG. Documents customary fishing regulations via digital tools, empowering coastal communities in marine resource management and cultural knowledge transmission.

properties.title: FORKANI - Indigenous-led Marine Conservation in Wakatobi
properties.description: Indigenous group conserves Wakatobi UNESCO biosphere's marine biodiversity through traditional wisdom, community-led fisheries monitoring, seagrass education, and mangrove protection on Kaledupa Island, Indonesia since 2002.

properties.title: High Seas Alliance - High Seas Biodiversity Treaty
properties.description: Alliance working at UN since 2011 to develop treaty protecting biodiversity in high seas (two-thirds of ocean beyond national jurisdiction). Uses science, reports, UN interventions. UN committed to treaty in July 2017.

properties.title: James Cook University Fish and Fisheries Lab - Shark and Ray Conservation in Southeast Asia
properties.description: Why: SE Asia is hub for shark trade. What: Workshop building shark/ray research capacity. How: Training scientists, community collaboration, citizen science. Where: Northern Australia, Singapore, Papua New Guinea, Indonesia. When: Ongoing

properties.title: Make Stewardship Count
properties.description: Coalition of 82 NGOs & scientists advocating for urgent reforms to Marine Stewardship Council certification standards to restore scientific rigor & transparency in seafood sustainability labeling globally since 2018.

properties.title: Ocean Voices
properties.description: Empowers ocean communities through mentoring, training in ocean law/policy, research support, and Fellowship programme. Connects local voices to international policy, advances knowledge, fosters exchange on ocean governance.

properties.title: Community-based Ecological Mangrove Restoration Programme
properties.description: Protects blue carbon habitats (mangroves, seagrass) in Philippines. Community-led restoration for food security, education, biodiversity. Addresses UN SDGs through data-driven multi-stakeholder approach.

properties.title: Oceans Initiative - Marine Mammal Protection Tools
properties.description: Protects marine mammals from bycatch by developing cost-effective animal counting toolkit. Translates science to policy. Field tested in Vancouver & Indonesia. Addresses 650k annual marine mammal deaths.

properties.title: Project Seagrass - SeagrassSpotter Citizen Science Mapping
properties.description: Mapping seagrass meadows in Southeast Asia via SeagrassSpotter citizen science tool. Communities contribute to global database for conservation, restoration & management. Addresses 35% global seagrass loss since 1980.

properties.title: Tara Coral Expedition 2026-2028 - Heart of the Coral Triangle
properties.description: Why: Study coral reef resilience to warming. What: 2-year expedition sampling Southeast Asian reefs. How: Scientific schooner with 14+ partners. When: 2026-2028. Where: Coral Triangle, Southeast Asia (35% of world's reefs).

properties.title: Community Seagrass Restoration - Save Andaman Network
properties.description: Enhancing seagrass & biodiversity conservation through 3 coastal communities in Trang, Thailand. Building capacity for restoration, protecting dugongs, developing sustainable fishery rules & alternative livelihoods.

properties.title: Ocean Rise & Resilience Coalition - Adapting Coastal Cities & Regions
properties.description: Coalition uniting 1000 reps & 1B people affected by sea level rise. Enhances coastal resilience through adaptation strategies & multi-sectoral responses. Launched at UNOC3 June 2025, chaired by Nice Mayor.

properties.title: Giving plastic waste a sustainable second life
properties.description: Innoceana sets up plastic recycling workshop in Bahia Ballena, Costa Rica to process 250kg/month beach waste into new products. Targets fishermen to recycle fishing lines. Includes awareness workshops for tourists and students.

properties.title: Tara Polar Station - Studying the Arctic Sentinel of Climate
properties.description: Drifting polar research station in Arctic ice (2025-2046). Scientists study climate change impacts, oceanography, biology, glaciology. Ship remains ice-locked 90% of time for continuous Arctic ecosystem monitoring.

properties.title: Mission UNOC 2025 Expedition
properties.description: Schooner Tara sails from Lorient to Nice (May-Jun 2025) stopping at ports to raise ocean awareness before UN Ocean Conference. Mobilizes public & politicians for better ocean protection ahead of UNOC3 global summit.

properties.title: Ocean and Climate Platform - Think Tank for Ocean Advocacy
properties.description: Global advocacy platform uniting 80+ NGOs and research institutes to promote ocean-climate science, coordinate networks, and influence policy at UNFCCC and CBD. Launched pre-COP21, contributed to Paris Agreement ocean inclusion.

properties.title: Sea'ties: studying the resilience of coastal towns
properties.description: Study climate change risks in coastal towns across Europe, West Africa, North Africa, US West Coast & Pacific. Analyze solutions, organize workshops to strengthen local adaptation & integrate findings into public policies.

properties.title: World Coral Conservatory - Global Coral Protection Reference Centre
properties.description: Creating a global network of aquariums housing living coral colonies to preserve biodiversity, provide research resources, and restore degraded reefs threatened by climate change and ocean acidification.

properties.title: Mission Microbiomes - Discovery of the Invisible Peoples of the Oceans
properties.description: 2-year, 70,000km expedition studying marine microbiomes (viruses, bacteria, microalgae) and their vulnerability to climate change through DNA sequencing, imaging, and environmental parameter analysis aboard Tara ship.

properties.title: Alkalinisation solution to ocean acidification
properties.description: Research initiative studying ocean alkalinisation to combat acidification. Adding alkaline minerals to seawater increases CO2 absorption. OACIS project evaluates feasibility, costs, and marine life impacts across global oceans.
properties.funder: Veolia Foundation, Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: TREC Expedition Tara - Major Study of Europe's Coastline and Waste at Sea
properties.description: Tara schooner sails Europe (2023-2024) studying coastal biodiversity, pollution, land-sea interface. Mobile labs collect samples across 10+ countries. Continues to Iceland (2025), SE Asia/Japan (2026-27).

properties.title: Mangroves: a land/sea ecosystem to protect
properties.description: IUCN France coordinates tropical wetlands protection, focusing on mangroves across French overseas territories. Network strengthens mapping, monitoring, technical exchanges to preserve ecosystems lost 35% in 20 years.

properties.title: Mission Bougainville - Setting Sail to Learn More About Our Planet
properties.description: Plankton Planet & Sorbonne deploy low-energy sensors on French naval vessels globally to study aquatic microbiome, marine ecosystems, climate change, pollution & ocean acidification impacts. Ongoing worldwide data collection.

properties.title: Improving scientific knowledge about microplastic pollution in marine environments
properties.description: Mediterranean expedition sampling microplastics with defined protocols. Crew conducts conferences and documentary film for public awareness. Supported by Cnes, Marbec, Mercator Ocean, Prince Albert II Foundation.

properties.title: Pollution in the Mediterranean: what impact from micro and nanoplastics?
properties.description: Université de Toulon develops detection methods for nano/microplastics in Mediterranean waters, assessing toxicity on marine plankton and seafood industry impact. Focus on Toulon harbor ecosystem.

properties.title: 13 Ocean - Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture Demonstrator
properties.description: Sustainable urban aquaculture combining multi-species farming, permaculture & training. IMTA system recycles water naturally, uses insect meal feed, includes hydroponic greenhouses. Demonstrates eco-friendly food production.

properties.title: Restoring mangrove Casamance
properties.description: Up2Green & Océanium restore Casamance mangroves in Senegal. Planting fruit/forest species, creating jobs, beekeeping training, protecting ecosystem for local livelihoods. Biodiversity conservation & water management. 2019-ongoing.

properties.title: Understanding Ocean Pollution: Plastics and Microplastics Educational Tools
properties.description: Educational toolkit with games and workshops to teach about plastic pollution in oceans. Downloadable materials for teachers and associations to raise awareness about marine plastic proliferation impacts.

properties.title: Halong Bay Ecosystem Conservation Pilot Projects
properties.description: Phase 3 of Haiphong/Halong Bay project. Pilot projects for ecosystem conservation: training fishermen in clean aquaculture, beach erosion protection & sustainable tourism, reducing industrial pollution. Vietnam, 2015 start.

properties.title: Oceans 2015 Initiative - Ocean Solutions Research Partnership
properties.description: Global researchers network studying ocean acidification & climate impacts. Produced findings for IPCC ocean report. Presented solutions at 2017 Monaco conference on marine ecosystem risks through 2100.
properties.funder: Veolia Foundation and Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Raise Awareness to Save Coral Reefs in Palawan
properties.description: Coral reef protection & restoration on Pangatalan Island. 40ha marine protected area, Ocean Academy for local education, post-larvae farm to combat overfishing, sustainable aquaculture development for local communities.

properties.title: Microplastic pollution on the French Atlantic coastline investigated by Observatoire du Plancton
properties.description: Study microplastics <5mm on South Brittany coast via participatory science. Uses Zooscan imaging to measure/classify particles in Gulf of Morbihan, Etel river, Lorient harbour. Addresses data gap vs Mediterranean.

properties.title: Raising Awareness About Plastic Pollution and Encouraging Widespread Action
properties.description: Mediterranean plastic pollution research via Tara expeditions, measuring microplastics in Toulon harbour, public exhibitions across European ports, and BeMed initiative supporting NGOs and solutions against ocean plastics.

properties.title: BeMed - Beyond Plastic Med
properties.description: Call for micro-initiatives to reduce plastic pollution in Mediterranean. Supports NGO projects promoting behavioral change, waste management, alternatives to plastics across Mediterranean basin. Started 2016 on World Oceans Day.
properties.funder: Veolia Foundation and Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

properties.title: Tara Pacific - Protecting Coral Reefs
properties.description: Study coral reef health, adaptive potential & resilience to climate change across Pacific islands. Research biodiversity from genes to ecosystems. Raise awareness through expeditions, media & stopovers in Asia, Middle East & Mediterranean.

properties.title: Berlin-on-Sea: Ocean Protection and Environmental Education
properties.description: 18-month initiative bringing ocean conservation to Berlin through partnerships with 50+ hotels, restaurants, schools, and aquariums. Educates citizens on how urban consumption impacts ocean health. Pilot for European expansion.

properties.title: Protecting Sea Turtles and Sustainable Local Economy
properties.description: CEDTM-Kélonia manages sea turtle conservation in Réunion & Mayotte, conducting research, habitat protection, eco-tourism training, and regional collaboration across Indian Ocean countries since 2002.

properties.title: Scirena: Automated Marine Species Monitoring System
properties.description: Automated underwater species recognition system monitoring artificial reef recolonization in Toulon Bay. Combines photography & AI to count/identify marine life, validating Remora reef restoration impact post-pollution treatment.

properties.title: Tara Expeditions - Mediterranean Marine Conservation
properties.description: Study plastic debris distribution in Mediterranean Sea. University of Michigan & CNRS analyze fragments by size/weight. Public exhibitions at ports, school visits. Results guide 22 riparian countries on pollution.

properties.title: Sick or Cured: Joining Hands for Life
properties.description: Maritime adventure for hospitalized children sailing Brittany coast (St Quay Portrieux to St Nazaire). Youth explore Iroise marine park, meet seals/cetaceans, study flora/fauna. 2,500 children in 25+ French hospitals participate via videos.

properties.title: Remora Artificial Reef Project
properties.description: Innovative artificial reef near Toulon wastewater plant to restore marine habitat. Fibreglass structures at 15m depth attract flora/fauna. 5-year study (2014-2019) compares two reefs to assess biodiversity recovery.

properties.title: Surfrider Europe Foundation - Ocean and Seashore Protection Training Program
properties.description: Training campaign for 5,000 members across Europe to protect ocean, seashore & marine environment. Internet/intranet training + field tours + new exhibition 'From Mountains to Sea' on water pollution & treatment. 2010 launch.

properties.title: Gold of Bengal - Jute Sailboat World's Largest Fleet
properties.description: Building Bangladesh's first sailing ship from jute fiber composite to replace declining wood resources. Demonstrates sustainable alternative to fiberglass for world's largest fleet. Supports 4M jute farmers in Ganges Delta.

properties.title: Anak Laut - Coral Reef Education Project
properties.description: Educates 300 Indonesian schoolchildren as conservation ambassadors in North Sulawesi, teaching water cycles, waste recycling, and marine ecosystems to promote sustainable coral reef management in coastal villages.

properties.title: Santo 2006 Extraordinary Expedition
properties.description: Multi-habitat scientific expedition exploring marine biodiversity, reefs, underwater caves, and forests of Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu. 100+ experts from 15 countries conducting fieldwork Aug-Dec 2006 using oceanographic ship and canopy equipment.

properties.title: Cap Marseille - Sailing School and Mediterranean Environmental Conservation
properties.description: Sailing school using traditional boats to provide environmental awareness about Mediterranean ecosystem while employing disadvantaged youth and disabled persons. Renovating flagship La Flâneuse for continued operations.

properties.title: New Lifebuoy Professional Integration
properties.description: Oceanplus creates jobs in Finistère for disadvantaged workers through nautical services: boat maintenance, eco-friendly careenage, and innovative rescue device production. Launched 2006 with 4 initial jobs.

properties.title: Conserving vast and recently discovered coral reef
properties.description: Abrolhos archipelago coral reef conservation. Extends Protected Marine Areas, reinforces co-management with local communities, monitors climate impact, promotes sustainable fishing & ecotourism. 18 new fish species discovered.

properties.title: Protecting Exceptional Natural Heritage: Scattered Islands
properties.description: Preserving biodiversity in Scattered Islands (Indian Ocean) through coral reef monitoring, waste removal (20 tons tar), and scientific research. Partnership removes hazardous waste, studies coral recovery post-1998 bleaching.

properties.title: Laboratory Ship to Test Innovations in Extreme Conditions
properties.description: Océan Vital Foundation tests renewable energy tech on laboratory ship in extreme ocean conditions. Developing silent vertical-shaft wind generator for marine/land use. Aims to protect oceans from CO2 pollution.

properties.title: Backing Sustainable Development in the Bay of Haiphong
properties.description: Bay contract to improve water quality in Haiphong Bay, Vietnam's 2nd largest port. Modeled on Brest's success, project diagnoses pollution, engages stakeholders, protects biodiversity and marine economy (fisheries, aquaculture, tourism).

properties.title: A Different Approach to the Sea
properties.description: Nature Discovery Clubs in Nice & Villefranche-sur-Mer teach underprivileged & handicapped children about marine environment through kayaking, sailing. Partners: Oceanographic Museum Monaco, local observatories. 2005 start.

properties.title: Karaikal Tsunami Recovery and Water Infrastructure Project
properties.description: Post-2004 tsunami reconstruction in Karaikal villages near Pondicherry. Rehabilitated salinized land, installed water supply systems, wells, rainwater cisterns, treatment systems. Supported agricultural revival and microcredit programs.

properties.title: Rescue Hai Phong Bay - Reinforced Partnership
properties.description: Partnership between Brest & Hai Phong to combat severe water pollution & bay silting threatening fishing, tourism & port traffic. GIS development, water quality monitoring, food safety studies for seafood consumers. 2010-ongoing.

properties.title: Tara Oceans - Three Years Research on All Seas and Oceans
properties.description: 3-year expedition studying plankton diversity & ocean ecosystems. 150,000km voyage collecting 27,000 samples to model climate change impacts. 500 scientists from 50 labs analyzing marine biodiversity & creating open-access archive.

properties.title: Ocean Exchange - Global Blue Economy Innovation Accelerator
properties.description: 501(c)(3) accelerating ocean health & Blue Economy solutions via annual awards, global expert network. Categories: alternative materials, CO2 reduction, robotics, energy, fisheries, vessel ops, water treatment. 13th event 2025.
properties.funder: Ocean Exchange (501(c)(3)), NOAA, Guy Harvey Foundation

properties.title: High Seas Treaty (BBNJ Agreement) - Global Ocean Protection
properties.description: High Seas Alliance advocates for ratification & implementation of BBNJ Treaty protecting 50% of planet beyond national jurisdiction. Establishes marine protected areas, environmental standards. Treaty entered force Jan 2026.
properties.funder: High Seas Alliance (70+ NGO members and IUCN)

properties.title: Illegal Fishing Detection and Prevention System
properties.description: Automated statistical system analyzing fisheries data to detect illegal fishing patterns, helping inspectors identify suspicious vessels. Addresses third-largest international crime affecting 120M livelihoods globally.

properties.title: Oceana Global Ocean Conservation
properties.description: Oceana protects and restores oceans through strategic campaigns using law, science, and advocacy. Achieved 325+ victories protecting 4M+ sq miles of ocean globally. Focuses on policy change and measurable outcomes.

properties.title: Global Fishing Watch - Ocean Monitoring and Transparency
properties.description: Uses AI & satellites to map global fishing fleets, monitor marine reserves, and create public data on ocean activity. Enables fair, sustainable ocean use through transparency. Partners with governments & scientists worldwide.

properties.title: SECORE Coral Reef Restoration
properties.description: Holistic coral reef restoration integrating research, cutting-edge breeding technology, and capacity building. Breeds resilient corals, develops scalable restoration tools, and trains partners globally for sustainable reef recovery.

properties.title: Shipping Decarbonisation and Green Fuels Initiative
properties.description: EU advocacy for maritime decarbonisation through green e-fuels (hydrogen, e-ammonia). Targets 7% green fuel mix by 2030, zero emissions by 2050. Addresses shipping's 3% global CO2 share via carbon market & fuel mandates.

properties.title: First Descent: Indian Ocean
properties.description: Multi-nation programme exploring Indian Ocean through expeditions, establishing ocean health baselines for MPAs, storytelling campaigns, and knowledge exchange. Completed missions in Comoros, Seychelles, Maldives since 2018.

properties.title: Ocean Rising
properties.description: Why: Bridge culture & ocean conservation. What: Integrate ocean themes in fashion, music, gaming, arts. How: Partner with cultural icons & influencers. When: Ongoing. Where: Global cultural industries.

properties.title: The Ocean Census
properties.description: Global alliance discovering marine species through expeditions and science. Launched April 2023 to document ocean biodiversity (only 10% of estimated species known). Open-access data sharing for conservation.

properties.title: First Descent Maldives
properties.description: Deep-sea research expedition exploring 590km from North Malé to Addu Atoll. Discovered 'Trapping Zone' ecosystem at 500m depth. Conducted taxonomic workshops and Voice of Maldives campaign to amplify conservation efforts.

properties.title: Ocean Census - Discover Life
properties.description: Global alliance discovering ocean life. Launched April 2023 by Nippon Foundation & Nekton. Expeditions to biodiversity hotspots, documenting marine species (only 10% known). Open access data for conservation policy.

properties.title: First Descent: Seychelles
properties.description: Deep-sea research mission in Seychelles exploring ocean depths, collecting data/specimens, training scientists, creating identification guides, and hosting symposium to inform marine policy and conservation.

properties.title: XL Catlin Deep Ocean Survey
properties.description: Deep ocean survey in Bermuda (50-300m depths) identifying rariphotic zone, discovering 100+ new species, documenting deepest lionfish record, and establishing standardized marine research framework (GOSSIP).

properties.title: Weddell Sea Expedition
properties.description: 45-day expedition in 2019 deploying AUVs/ROVs to study life beneath Antarctic ice in western Weddell Sea. 36 scientists examined marine ecosystems and climate change impacts in one of Earth's most remote regions.

properties.title: Ocean Rising
properties.description: Cultural initiative bridging ocean conservation with fashion, music, gaming & arts. Partners with influencers to inspire ocean advocacy globally through creative content. Ongoing alliance program.

properties.title: Pathfinder Comoros Expedition
properties.description: 4-week ROV benthic survey expedition in Oct 2018 to inform Indian Ocean research. Collected video surveys, analyzed samples, shared findings with Comoros partners Dec 2019 to improve marine management practices.

properties.title: First Descent: Indian Ocean
properties.description: Multi-nation programme conducting deep-sea expeditions, establishing ocean health baselines, creating MPAs across Indian Ocean. Combines applied research, storytelling, knowledge exchange. Completed missions in Comoros, Seychelles, Maldives since 201

properties.title: Yachts for Science
properties.description: Platform connecting private yachts with marine scientists to conduct ocean research. Addresses vessel scarcity by utilizing 11,000+ private yachts globally for marine science and conservation work. Founded 2019.

properties.title: First Descent Comoros
properties.description: Deep-sea exploration mission in Comoros waters to survey marine ecosystems, strengthen ocean governance, and support coastal communities through science-based conservation and sustainable livelihoods.

properties.title: Moodhu Madharusaa Marine Education Programme
properties.description: Marine education program teaching Maldivian secondary students ocean conservation through classroom lessons and fieldtrips. 281 students completed 6-month program; 1000+ learned swimming/snorkeling since 2015 across four atolls.

properties.title: Ocean Women
properties.description: Empowers women/girls in tropical coastal communities through swim/snorkel training. Trains local instructors, conducts research on gender ocean access inequality. Maldives pilot since 2022. Creates Ocean Connection Toolkit by 2026.

properties.title: Mobulid Genetics Project
properties.description: Uses DNA sequencing to resolve manta/devil ray taxonomy, characterize global population structure, and develop genetic tools for species identification to monitor fisheries and enforce CITES regulations worldwide.

properties.title: Maldives Manta Conservation Programme
properties.description: Conserving manta rays & relatives in Maldives through community, research & education. Identified 6,000+ reef mantas, drove UNESCO Biosphere Reserve designations, spearheaded protected species legislation (2014).

properties.title: RahVeshi Programme
properties.description: Manta ray conservation in Maldives. Develops local island-based programmes to protect marine ecosystems threatened by climate change and development. Partnerships with resorts support research and tourist engagement since 2005.

properties.title: Fisheries and Conservation Policy Programme
properties.description: Reduce manta & devil ray catch globally through policy engagement with RFMOs, CITES, CMS. Focus on West Africa, Peru, Mexico, Indonesia, China, India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Myanmar. Research, enforcement, sustainable livelihoods.

properties.title: Ocean Ambassadors
properties.description: Youth programme for 13-18 year olds to learn marine science from leading scientists, conduct interviews, and develop conservation projects in their regions. Launched 2026 with global ambassadors.

properties.title: Atlantic Manta & Devil Ray Research Coalition
properties.description: Collaborative research initiative studying 7 endangered mobulid ray species across Atlantic Ocean. Investigates distribution, genetics, movements, threats. Uses photo-ID, tracking, citizen science. Partners across US, Caribbean, Brazil, Azores, Afric

properties.title: HAMER - Hawaii Association for Marine Education and Research
properties.description: Protects Hawaii's marine life through manta ray/sea turtle catalogs, turtle rescues, reef cleanups (44,617ft fishing line removed), securing 4 ISRAs, genetic research showing distinct Kona/Maui manta populations. Ongoing statewide.

properties.title: Ocean Giants Programme for Conservationist Development
properties.description: Training next generation marine researchers through Manta Trust & Plymouth University collaboration. Students gain charity operations experience while fundraising supports NGOs protecting threatened marine megafauna globally.

properties.title: French Polynesia Manta Project
properties.description: Studies both manta ray species across 118 islands/atolls in French Polynesia since 2015. Uses photo-ID citizen science to monitor 400+ individuals, assess population dynamics, connectivity, and threats. Supports conservation and ecotourism.

properties.title: Manta Watch Aotearoa New Zealand
properties.description: Combines research & citizen science to study NZ's manta & devil rays. Advocates for oceanic ecosystems through conservation, education & collaboration. Tracks sightings to protect endangered gentle giants in NZ waters.

properties.title: Indonesia Devil Rays - Mobula Project Indonesia
properties.description: Sustainable fisheries project reducing bycatch of mobulid rays and threatened elasmobranchs in Muncar, Banyuwangi. Combines social-ecological approaches to sustain ray populations while supporting coastal communities.

properties.title: Seychelles Manta Ray Programme
properties.description: Studies reef manta ray biology, movement, feeding & genetics at D'Arros Island & Outer Islands since 2013. Uses photo-ID, acoustic/satellite tagging, tissue sampling to understand population in absence of human impacts.

properties.title: Chagos Manta Ray Project
properties.description: Protects reef manta rays in Chagos Archipelago MPA via satellite tagging, photo-ID, acoustic tracking. Studies movement, feeding, habitat use in pristine ecosystem. Trains Mobulid Ambassadors. Led to Egmont Atoll ISRA designation 2024.

properties.title: India Mobulid Project
properties.description: Conserving manta & devil rays in Tamil Nadu & Andhra Pradesh through fishery/trade assessment & community engagement. Started 2012, PhD-led since 2023. Reduces targeted catches & bycatch via policy, enforcement & fisher collaboration.
properties.funder: UK Government ISPF, Society for Conservation Biology, Government of India

properties.title: Raja Ampat Manta Project
properties.description: Monitors 750+ manta rays in Raja Ampat, Indonesia using photo-ID & satellite tags. Achieved nationwide fishing ban (2014) & sanctuary creation. Studies movement patterns to protect both manta species from fisheries.

properties.title: Thailand Manta Project
properties.description: Est. Jan 2015. Studies oceanic manta rays in Andaman Sea (Koh Bon, Koh Tachai, Hin Daeng, Hin Muang). Photo-ID database tracks populations, behavior, threats. Works with Thai govt, dive operators for sustainable tourism & protection.

properties.title: Sri Lanka Mobulid Ray Project
properties.description: Long-term study of shark and ray landings in Sri Lanka collecting biological data, updating species checklists, informing IUCN assessments and CITES policy, and training fisheries officers to conserve threatened species.

properties.title: Indonesian Manta Project
properties.description: Protects manta rays in Bird's Head Seascape (Raja Ampat) and Savu Sea through research, habitat protection, and conservation advocacy. Recent win: Heliana Island designated as Important Shark and Ray Area (ISRA).

properties.title: Japan Manta Project
properties.description: Studies manta & devil ray populations in Japan, focusing on Okinawa. Uses photo-ID, satellite tagging, genetic analysis to understand movement, connectivity. Collaborates with fishers to reduce bycatch, improve handling practices.

properties.title: Manta Project Fiji
properties.description: Conserving manta & devil rays in Fiji through research, education & collaboration. Studies population dynamics, movement ecology, genetics. Promotes sustainable eco-tourism, reduces bycatch. Est. 2012.
properties.funder: Donor funded, Manta Trust affiliate, Barefoot Manta Resort, Conservation International

properties.title: Myanmar Ocean Project
properties.description: Community-focused marine conservation in Myeik Archipelago. Reduces ghost gear impacts, conducts shark/ray research, maintains manta photo-ID database, builds ocean literacy. Founded 2018 by Thanda Ko Gyi.

properties.title: Papua New Guinea Manta Project
properties.description: Studies endangered oceanic & reef manta rays in Milne Bay Province. Monitors population, movements, behavior via photo-ID & drones. Partners with local NGOs, empowers indigenous women rangers. Est. 2023 in Coral Triangle biodiversity hotspot.

properties.title: Initiative Manta En Nouvelle Calédonie
properties.description: Research reef manta rays in New Caledonia's southwest Pacific waters. Photo-ID database, satellite tagging, genetics study population ecology. Raise awareness with local communities. Started 2016 by Manta Trust.
properties.funder: The Manta Trust, Conservation International, Aquarium des Lagons

properties.title: Guam Manta Project
properties.description: Study & protect manta rays in Guam through photo ID, spawning aggregation research, & community education. Uses photography to identify individuals & determine population sizes.

properties.title: Yap Manta Ray Conservation and Research
properties.description: Research and conservation of manta ray populations in Yap through partnership with Manta Trust. Annual Manta Mania festival provides citizen science opportunities. Supports sustainable scuba diving tourism industry.

properties.title: MantaID Palau - Reef Manta Ray Photo Identification Project
properties.description: Photo ID database tracking 350+ individual manta rays in Palau since 2009. Non-invasive monitoring via dive guides & tourists reveals year-round reef/lagoon behavior, feeding patterns, and cleaning stations at 5 sites including German Channel.

properties.title: Caribbean Islands Manta Conservation Program
properties.description: Studies mobulid biology/ecology across 700 Caribbean islands. Uses citizen science to track 5+ species, identify aggregation sites, assess threats. Established 2021 to drive conservation measures for endangered manta and devil rays.

properties.title: Costa Rica Manta Ray Conservation and Marine Protected Area Initiative
properties.description: ConnectOcean partners with Manta Trust to catalog manta sightings, develop global ID app, and establish acoustic tagging around Las Catalinas Islands. Aims to create Marine Protected Area for oceanic manta rays along Pacific Coast.

properties.title: Manta Caribbean Project
properties.description: Studies understudied manta rays in Mexico Caribbean since 2013. Photo-ID, aerial surveys, satellite tagging assess population. Education workshops with schools, fishermen, tour operators. Aims to eliminate targeted fisheries, reduce bycatch.

properties.title: Réserve Naturelle Marine de Cerbère-Banyuls
properties.description: Protects seagrass meadows, rocky reefs & underwater cavities in western Mediterranean. 1,239 animal & 497 plant species. Managed by Pyrénées-Orientales Council to protect biodiversity & sustainably manage human activities.

properties.title: Proyecto Mantas Ecuador
properties.description: Research & conservation of world's largest oceanic manta population at Isla de la Plata & Bajo Cope. Studies threats from artisanal fisheries, develops action plans with government to reduce impacts on this endangered species.

properties.title: Cape Rodney-Okakari Point Marine Reserve
properties.description: Protects diverse NZ habitats: rocky coast, sponge gardens, deep reefs. 1000+ species. Kelp forest recovery after sea urchin decline. Supports Ngāti Manuhiri Maori tribe aspirations. Hauraki Gulf, North Island.

properties.title: Arnavon Community Marine Park
properties.description: 152-169km² park in Solomon Islands protecting 2,000+ nesting hawksbill turtles, mangroves, corals. Community-managed since 1991 after 1976 decline. Upgraded from sanctuary (1995) to Marine Park (2017).

properties.title: Cordillera de Coiba Managed Resources Area
properties.description: 67,900 km2 protected area in Panama's Pacific waters with 24 seamounts. Protects migratory species like whales, sharks, tuna. Satellite monitoring curbs illegal fishing. Part of Eastern Tropical Marine Corridor.

properties.title: Pacific Manta Research Group - Mexico Pacific
properties.description: Studies oceanic manta rays in Eastern Pacific (Revillagigedo, Gulf of California, Banderas Bay) using photo-ID & acoustic telemetry. 1500+ individuals identified since 1978. Monitors habitat use, movements & ecology.

properties.title: Chumbe Island Coral Reef Sanctuary
properties.description: Protects 474 reef fish species, endangered turtles, resilient corals in Western Indian Ocean. Model ecotourism MPA with local employment, sustainable management, environmental education in Zanzibar.

properties.title: Abrolhos Marine National Park
properties.description: Protects South Atlantic's highest marine biodiversity hotspot with 20 coral species, endemic reefs, humpback whale breeding grounds, sea turtles, mangroves. Blue Park Award winner. Central Brazil coast since 1983.

properties.title: Aldabra Atoll Special Reserve
properties.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site protecting pristine coral reefs, mangroves, seagrass beds in SW Seychelles. Expanded 2018 to 2599 km². Hosts giant tortoises, green turtles, dugongs, manta rays, sharks, whales in intact ecosystems.

properties.title: Alcatrazes Refuge
properties.description: Brazil's 2nd largest marine protected area, 40km off São Paulo coast. Protects coral reefs, highest reef fish biomass, threatened turtles, dolphins, sharks. Major breeding site for seabirds including frigatebirds. Conserves ichthyofauna.

properties.title: Mantas Costa Rica
properties.description: Studies oceanic manta rays along Pacific coast of Costa Rica using acoustic telemetry, photo ID, tissue samples. Focuses on Cabo Blanco Reserve. Aims to inform marine policies, identify protected areas, track migration patterns.

properties.title: Conservation and Research of Cameroon's Elasmobranchs (CREC)
properties.description: AMCO & Manta Trust protect sharks, rays & marine megafauna in Cameroon's Gulf of Guinea. Citizen science app SIREN tracks bycatch, field surveys, community outreach, policy advocacy for sustainable fishing & food security since 2015.

properties.title: Mobula Conservation Project
properties.description: Interdisciplinary research protecting threatened mobula rays in Eastern Tropical Pacific. Studies fisheries bycatch, habitat use, genetics. Works with fishers on bycatch reduction, sustainable ecotourism. Est. 2020.

properties.title: Proyecto Manta Pacific México
properties.description: Protects endangered oceanic manta rays in Bahia de Banderas, Mexico since 2014. Research on biology, ecology, movements via photo ID, tagging. Engages fishers, students to reduce entanglements, boat strikes, promote sustainable tourism.

properties.title: Manta Catalog Azores & Canary Islands
