properties.description: Photo-ID databases tracking mobulid rays in Azores (since 2012) & Canary Islands (since 2021). Studies population dynamics, ecology, migration. Engages 80+ dive centers, citizen scientists to protect critical habitats.

properties.title: Brazilian Marine Megafauna Project
properties.description: Assesses manta ray populations in Brazil's biodiversity hotspots via photo-ID, satellite tagging, genetics. Monitors threats from shipping routes, fishing. Promotes citizen science, education. Est. 2015 in São Paulo state.

properties.title: Exuma Cays Land and Sea Park
properties.description: Protects Caribbean spiny lobster, Nassau grouper, queen conch & seabirds. No-take reserve enhances fish biomass, larval transport & spillover to fisheries. Important Bird Area with tropicbirds & shearwaters.

properties.title: Malpelo Fauna and Flora Sanctuary
properties.description: Platinum Blue Park 500km off Colombia. Largest no-fishing zone in Eastern Tropical Pacific protecting massive shark aggregations, marine mammals & hundreds of fish species. Expanded twice, pledged to double in size.

properties.title: Revillagigedo National Park
properties.description: Gold-level Blue Park protecting unique ecosystems from volcanoes to coral reefs. Focuses on surveillance and monitoring to conserve sharks, manta rays, turtles, and endemic species in the Mexican Pacific.

properties.title: Wilsons Promontory Marine National Park
properties.description: Australia's largest Victorian MPA protects biodiversity hotspot where warm eastern & cold Bass Strait waters mix. Shelters white sharks, whales, seals across reefs, kelp forests & sponge gardens since 2002.

properties.title: Papahānaumokuākea Marine National Monument
properties.description: Protects 7,000+ marine species in Northwestern Hawaiian Islands through strict no-take policy (2006) and limited-use buffer zone (2016). Safeguards 22 endangered species including monk seals in pristine coral reefs and seamounts.

properties.title: Cocos Island National Park
properties.description: Protects 300+ marine fish species & hammerhead sharks at intersection of Pacific currents. UNESCO site since 1997. Established 1978, expanded for marine habitat. Gold Blue Park 2019, Platinum 2025.

properties.title: Brijuni National Park Blue Parks Award
properties.description: Croatian MPA protecting 14 islands with seagrass meadows, sea caves, reefs. Hosts dolphins, sea turtles, endemic species. Uses climate-adaptive management via Mediterranean MPA platforms. Blue Parks Award recipient.

properties.title: Galapagos Marine Reserve Blue Park
properties.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site protecting 2,900+ marine species including sharks, sea turtles, penguins at intersection of 3 major currents. Established 1998 via Organic Law for Galápagos conservation.

properties.title: Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park
properties.description: Marine protected area in Philippines protecting 1,200+ species including endangered sea turtles and seabirds. No-take protections since 1988 maintain exceptionally healthy reef ecosystem. Platinum Blue Park award winner.

properties.title: Misool Marine Reserve Protection
properties.description: Protects coral reefs & deep waters in Raja Ampat, Indonesia. Partnership since 2005 between Misool Foundation & local communities. Safeguards endemic species, mangroves. No-take zones show highest reef fish biomass in region.

properties.title: Torre Guaceto Marine Protected Area
properties.description: Italian MPA protecting Mediterranean biodiversity: seagrass meadows, coral formations, endemic species. Established 1991, managed by consortium since 2000. Includes Ramsar wetland site.

properties.title: Apo Reef Natural Park
properties.description: 34 km² no-take zone protecting world's 2nd largest coral atoll in Coral Triangle. Sanctuary for overfished species, sea turtles, sharks, rays. Supports local transition to sustainable dive tourism. Occidental Mindoro, Philippines.

properties.title: Old Providence McBean Lagoon National Park
properties.description: Protects Caribbean barrier reef with 109 fish species, coral, mangroves. Created with indigenous Raizales after grassroots protest against tourism development. 90% Raizal staff manage conservation respecting traditional practices.

properties.title: Raja Ampat Islands Marine Conservation Area
properties.description: Network of 7 MPAs across 1400+ islands in Indonesia's Bird's Head Seascape protecting 75% of world's coral species, 1000+ fish species, mangroves & seagrass. Integrates traditional Sasi management with local communities.

properties.title: Channel Islands Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: 11 no-extraction Marine Reserves off Southern California protect kelp forests, coral gardens, 5000+ species. Managed by National Park, Sanctuary & CA Fish/Wildlife since 1980-2007.
properties.funder: Channel Islands National Park, Channel Islands National Marine Sanctuary, California Department of Fish and Wildlife

properties.title: Jardines de la Reina National Park
properties.description: Cuba's Coral Garden MPA protecting 600+ cays with 30+ coral species. Fish increased 50% since 1996 protection. Gold Blue Park 2021 for pristine reefs, mangroves, sharks, turtles. Benefits fishers via spillover.

properties.title: Kisite-Mpunguti Marine Park & Reserve
properties.description: Kenya's largest MPA protecting 250 fish species, dolphins, corals, mangroves & turtles. Gold Blue Park Award for effective management using SMART tech. Supports sustainable tourism & local fishing since 1978.

properties.title: Selvagens Islands Marine Reserve
properties.description: Portugal's 1971 reserve protects North Atlantic's last intact marine ecosystems. Safeguards IUCN red-listed species, endemic mollusks, commercial fish. Manages tourism, research, habitat preservation across diverse marine zones.

properties.title: Gitdisdzu Lugyeks Marine Protected Area
properties.description: 33.5 km² Indigenous-led MPA protecting herring spawning grounds, kelp forests & eelgrass in Kitasu Bay, BC. Managed by Kitasoo Xai'xais using traditional knowledge. Designated June 2022, management plan Oct 2023.

properties.title: Siete Pecados Marine Park
properties.description: 1.8 km² MPA in Coral Triangle, Philippines protecting reefs, mangroves, seagrass. Established 2005 by Barangay Tagumpay community to combat overfishing. Conserves endangered species, highest fish diversity in Calamianes network.

properties.title: Kaho'olawe Island Reserve
properties.description: Hawaiian MPA protecting biodiversity-rich waters around Kaho'olawe Island. Managed by KIRC, combining ecological restoration with Native Hawaiian cultural preservation. Monitors fish, removes debris, controls invasive species.

properties.title: Gorgona National Natural Park
properties.description: Protects Eastern Tropical Pacific's most diverse coral reef ecosystem, breeding grounds for sharks, turtles, marine mammals. Managed since 1984 by Colombia's National Parks, 35km off Colombian coast with local community involvement.

properties.title: Cocos-Galapagos Swimway
properties.description: Protecting Cocos Ridge migration corridor for sharks & marine species between Galapagos, Cocos Island & Malpelo. First transboundary MPA in Latin America spanning Ecuador & Costa Rica waters.
properties.funder: MigraMar, Only.One, Mission Blue, Marine Conservation Institute

properties.title: Cahuita National Park
properties.description: Costa Rica's Caribbean coast park protects coral reefs, mangroves, seagrass. Co-managed by local community & SINAC since 1970. 31 coral species, 90 fish species, sea turtles. Balances conservation, tourism, food security.
properties.funder: Sistema Nacional de Areas de Conservacion (SINAC)

properties.title: Bazaruto Seascape Marine Conservation
properties.description: 20-year research program protecting marine megafauna (manta rays, wedgefish, sharks, dolphins) in Bazaruto Archipelago & San Sebastian Peninsula, Mozambique. Evidence-based conservation strategies for threatened species.

properties.title: Tristan da Cunha Marine Protected Area
properties.description: 750,000 km² EEZ protection in South Atlantic. 91% no-take zone. Protects seamounts, kelp forests, deep ocean. Whale sanctuary since 2001. High endemism, seabird nesting. Community-led by 245 residents. Declared by Island Council.
properties.funder: UK Blue Belt Programme, UK Government, Royal Society for the Protection of Birds

properties.title: Cabo Pulmo National Park
properties.description: 70 sq km marine park in Baja California protected 25 years ago by local community. Ecosystem recovery brought back corals, fish, sharks. Now supports tourism and fishing via spillover effects.

properties.title: Piedra del Viento Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: Protecting Chile's O'Higgins coast where algueros harvest kelp & surfers ride waves. Campaign restored beach access blocked by development, established 10,000-acre sanctuary for biodiversity, fishing communities & sustainable recreation.
properties.funder: Marine Conservation Institute, Save the Waves Coalition, Patagonia

properties.title: PIHMNM Project
properties.description: Marine conservation project in Pacific Islands. Details on specific conservation activities, timeline, and objectives not provided in available page content.

properties.title: California Seamounts Protection Project
properties.description: Protecting 60+ seamounts off California coast supporting deep-sea corals, fish, sharks, marine mammals. Co-founded CA Seamount Coalition (2015), designated Hope Spot (2019). Fighting destructive fishing, mining threats.

properties.title: Reserva Marina Hermandad
properties.description: Expansion of Galápagos Marine Reserve protections to safeguard migratory species (sharks, turtles, seabirds) from fishing fleets. Creates buffer zones and responsible fishing areas in Ecuador's EEZ.

properties.title: Palau National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: World's largest no-take MPA protecting 80% of Palau's waters (475,077 km²). Safeguards 800+ species including endangered turtles, sharks, whales. Enacted 2015, effective Jan 2020. Combines indigenous 'bul' tradition with modern conservation.

properties.title: Parque Nacional Coiba
properties.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site protecting 2000+ km² of coral reefs, mangroves & pelagic species in Eastern Tropical Pacific. Part of CMAR network. Community-involved management with participatory workshops for conservation planning.

properties.title: Inhambane Bay Community Conservation Network (IBCCN)
properties.description: 9 no-take MPAs in Inhambane Bay, Mozambique protecting seagrass & mangrove habitats. Established 2017 by village elders reviving traditional 'ocean rules'. Covers 6.69 km2, managed by 5 coastal communities for fish nurseries & endangered species.

properties.title: Shark Fin Bay MPA Network
properties.description: Network of 5 MPAs (9 km²) in northern Palawan, Philippines protecting coral reefs, seagrass, mangroves. Community-led conservation since 2011 restoring ecosystems degraded by destructive fishing, protecting threatened species.

properties.title: Caño Island Biological Reserve
properties.description: Protecting Costa Rica's most resilient coral reefs & breeding grounds for whales, sharks, manta rays & sea turtles in the Eastern Tropical Pacific. Designated 1978, serves as coral refugia during El Niño events.

properties.title: Sustainable Seas Programme
properties.description: Improves marine resource mgmt in Mozambique through community-led LMMAs, reducing destructive fishing, protecting megafauna, educating Ocean Ambassadors, creating marine corridor along Inhambane coast (Tofo, Pomene, Bazaruto)

properties.title: Migration Corridor Protection Project
properties.description: Protecting critical shark & ray migration corridor between Loreto & Cabo Pulmo National Parks, Baja California. Focuses on scalloped hammerheads & mobula rays using seamounts as refuges & nursery grounds in productive waters.

properties.title: Manta & Devil Rays
properties.description: Studying manta & devil ray movement ecology in Mozambique to identify critical habitats, map threats, protect core areas. 20-year research led to legal protection in 2021. Province-wide monitoring along Inhambane coast.

properties.title: Ocean Guardians
properties.description: UNESCO-recognized marine education program teaching 3,800+ Mozambican youth about ocean conservation, climate change impacts, swimming & water safety since 2012 in Inhambane Province through school curriculum & community outreach.

properties.title: Leopard Shark Conservation Mozambique
properties.description: Why: Endangered leopard sharks face extinction from overfishing. What: Population research in data-deficient East Africa. How: Study aggregation sites along Inhambane coast. Where: Southern Mozambique reefs. When: Ongoing

properties.title: Madagascar Whale Shark Project
properties.description: Research, education & conservation project studying whale sharks off Nosy Be, Madagascar since 2016. Uses photo-ID, satellite tracking & acoustic tags to understand population ecology & movements. Established tourism code of conduct.

properties.title: Bull Shark Conservation Project
properties.description: Studies bull shark ecology, migrations, and habitat use in Mozambique to address population threats from fisheries (220% catch increase), habitat degradation, and human-shark conflicts through research and conservation.

properties.title: Mafia Island Whale Shark Research Project
properties.description: Long-term whale shark study in Tanzania tracking movements, feeding, genetics, population trends, behavior, health via acoustic telemetry, tissue samples, photo-ID. Informs protection measures since 2016.

properties.title: Palau Hope Spot Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue explored Palau's protected waters (Nov 2018) to document marine biodiversity, meet conservationists, and showcase successful ocean conservation in this Pacific island nation with vast no-take zones.
properties.funder: ACTAI Global Foundation, Baum Foundation, Martha Shaw's Foundation

properties.title: Balearic Islands Hope Spot Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue expedition to document and raise awareness about MPAs, overfishing, illegal anchoring, and plastic pollution in Balearic Islands. Focus on Posidonia oceanica meadows protection and marine conservation.

properties.title: Mozambique Wedgefish Conservation Project
properties.description: Researching critically endangered wedgefish in Mozambique's Inhambane Province. Monitoring aggregation sites, tracking movements, collecting genetic samples to develop science-based conservation strategies.

properties.title: Smalleye Stingrays
properties.description: Study rare smalleye stingrays in Mozambique's Inhambane Province. Photo-ID, telemetry & genetics reveal distribution, movement & habitat use. 100 individuals identified since 2008. Protects world's largest marine stingray from fishing threats.

properties.title: Mozambique Elasmobranch Census
properties.description: Census of sharks & rays in Inhambane Province using BRUVs, camera traps & eDNA to establish baseline diversity, abundance & critical habitats for threatened species conservation & effective management.

properties.title: Galapagos National Park Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue expedition to Galapagos Islands studying migratory sharks, newly-discovered deep kelp forests, and marine biodiversity. Used submersibles at Wolf/Darwin Islands. Supported marine reserve expansion and species protection.
properties.funder: Seth Casden, Carol Hempf, Dr. Fisk Johnson

properties.title: Florida Manta Project
properties.description: First dedicated study of Florida's manta rays since 2016. Studies nursery habitat in south Florida and adult aggregation in central Florida using photography, drones, telemetry. Identifies critical habitats, mitigates fishing impacts.

properties.title: Mozambique Whale Shark Conservation Program
properties.description: Monitoring endangered whale sharks in southern Mozambique's key feeding area since 2005. Photo-ID tracking 600+ individuals, satellite tagging, threat assessment. Led to 2021 legal protection & IUCN Important Shark Areas.

properties.title: Oman Whale Shark Research Project
properties.description: Studies whale shark distribution, abundance & threats in Gulf of Oman hotspots (Musandam, Daymaniyat Islands). Tracks sharks to identify migratory corridors & areas vulnerable to gillnet capture & ship strikes. Started 2010.

properties.title: Malpelo Island Hope Spot Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue expedition to Malpelo Island, Colombia (Aug 2019) to study shark migration, document MPA enforcement challenges, and protect whale sharks, hammerheads, and groupers through tagging and DNA sampling.
properties.funder: Mission Blue, Malpelo Foundation, Conservation International Colombia, Migramar

properties.title: Svalbard Archipelago Hope Spot Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue documented climate change impacts in Arctic Norway's Svalbard, including melting glaciers and effects on polar bears, walruses, seabirds. June 2018 expedition created multimedia content to raise awareness.
properties.funder: Biotherm, Polar Bears International, IUCN, ScubaPro, Gates Products

properties.title: Black Marlin Research Project
properties.description: Studies black marlin movements and spawning in Bazaruto Seascape using satellite tagging and genetics. Launched Oct 2022, collected 21 tissue samples, tagged first marlin Nov 2022. Aims to identify Indian Ocean's first spawning ground.

properties.title: Galapagos Whale Shark Project
properties.description: Studies whale shark ecology at Darwin Island, Galapagos. Tracks adult females via satellite tags, conducts ultrasound/blood sampling for reproduction research. 700+ sharks identified. Expanded marine reserve protection.

properties.title: Guitarfish and Devil Rays Research - Florida Manta Project
properties.description: Research on Atlantic Guitarfish & devil rays in Florida waters using photo ID, acoustic telemetry & behavioral observation. Started 2020. Fills knowledge gaps in distribution, life history & critical habitats for conservation.

properties.title: Microplastics & Megafauna - Indonesia
properties.description: Studies microplastic impacts on manta rays & whale sharks in Indonesia's Coral Triangle. Estimates ingestion rates, analyzes plastic exposure, engages communities on waste management. Started 2016 in key feeding grounds.

properties.title: Balearic Islands Hope Spot
properties.description: First Mediterranean Hope Spot protecting Posidonia seagrass, loggerhead turtles, bluefin tuna spawning areas, and Balearic shearwater nesting sites across Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza and Formentera archipelago.
properties.funder: Mission Blue, Asociación Ondine, Stefan Hearst

properties.title: Cocos Island Costa Rica Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue expedition to Cocos Island to highlight marine biodiversity, conduct deep-sea dives to 1,000ft, document bait balls, and campaign for Costa Rica to ban hammerhead shark fin exports. Partnership with Fusion/Univision.

properties.title: Costa Rica Thermal Dome Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue & MarViva expedition to Costa Rica Thermal Dome Hope Spot. Tagged sharks & turtles, sampled plankton, documented biodiversity. Apr 2-7, 2017. Building case for regional UNEP conservation framework for this upwelling zone.

properties.title: Cashes Ledge Gulf of Maine Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue expedition to document Cashes Ledge, largest cold-water kelp forest on US Atlantic seaboard, nursery for cod, pollock, halibut. Partnership with CLF, Nat Geo, Google, NRDC calling for permanent protection.
properties.funder: Conservation Law Foundation, National Geographic, Google, National Resources Defense Council

properties.title: South African Coast Hope Spots Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue expedition established 6 Hope Spots along South African coast with Sustainable Seas Trust. Areas include False Bay, Cape Whale Coast, Knysna, Plett, Algoa Bay, and Aliwal Shoal to advance ocean conservation.

properties.title: Costa Rica Dome Playa Grande Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue & MarViva expedition documenting Costa Rica Dome's ecological & commercial value. Filmed with Dr. Sylvia Earle to raise awareness for protecting unique species & habitats in this High Seas area. Jan 22-28, 2014.
properties.funder: The Baum Foundation, The Leatherback Trust, LightHawk, Bula Bula Hotel, National Geographic

properties.title: Swan Islands Honduras Expedition
properties.description: Expedition to explore and document marine biodiversity at Swan Islands, the 'Galapagos of the Caribbean,' to support designation as marine protected area. 500+ fish species, 350+ mollusks surveyed at Mesoamerican Reef Hope Spot.

properties.title: Gulf of California Hope Spot Expedition
properties.description: Mission Blue expedition to Gulf of California/Sea of Cortez to highlight marine protection needs, engage stakeholders, and support local conservation groups protecting this UNESCO World Heritage Site's rich biodiversity.

properties.title: Exuma Cays Bahamas Expedition
properties.description: Expedition to Exuma Cays Land and Sea Park, Caribbean's first marine fishery reserve (1958). Documented pristine marine habitats, thriving populations of queen conch, Nassau grouper, spiny lobster, and invasive lionfish species.

properties.title: Revillagigedo Archipelago Expedition
properties.description: Expedition to document shark science and migratory patterns in Mexico's 'little Galápagos', 300 miles south of Cabo San Lucas. Filmed shark tagging to support MPA protection and marine corridor conservation.
properties.funder: MaiTai Global, Paul M. Angell Family Foundation, Marisla Foundation

properties.title: KIME Akva
properties.description: Integrated cod farming in Northern Norway. Founded 2020, scaling from 12.8k to 24k tonnes/year by 2030 across nine locations. Addresses declining wild cod quotas through sustainable aquaculture.

properties.title: AquaExchange
properties.description: Tech platform using IoT devices & data analytics to improve shrimp/fish aquaculture in India. Automates feeding, monitors aerators, manages finance & procurement. Founded 2020, serves 12% of local industry with transparency solutions.

properties.title: aquaManager
properties.description: Software solution for fish aquaculture from hatchery to harvest, using IoT and smart equipment for cage/pond farming, RAS, and hatcheries. Deployed across Mediterranean, Africa, Middle East, Latin America.

properties.title: Sofar Ocean
properties.description: Deploys global network of ocean sensors (Spotter platform) providing real-time ocean data for climate research. Wayfinder platform optimizes ship routes using accurate weather forecasts, reducing fuel and emissions in maritime shipping.

properties.title: MITO - European Clam Hatchery and Breeding
properties.description: MITO breeds and hatches high-quality clam juveniles to boost sustainable bivalve farming in Europe, reducing dependency on depleted wild stocks while providing low-impact, restorative protein in Italian lagoons.

properties.title: SyAqua - Shrimp Genetics and Alternative Feeds
properties.description: Singapore-based supplier of shrimp genetics (broodstock, nauplii, post-larvae) and micro-encapsulated feeds to hatcheries across Asia and US. 20+ years experience, advanced P. Vannamei breeding program with 10% YoY genetic improvement.

properties.title: The Kingfish Company
properties.description: Land-based RAS aquaculture producing yellowtail kingfish in Europe & US. 3,500 tonnes capacity, 100% renewable energy, no antibiotics, seawater-based, zero fish escape risk. Sustainable protein for $2.1T global market.

properties.title: WellFish Tech
properties.description: Aquaculture diagnostics using blood biomarkers & AI to assess fish health, enabling farmers to monitor welfare & optimize production. Spun out from University of West Scotland in 2021, first sales same year.

properties.title: Bureo - Fishing Net Recycling Program
properties.description: Collects discarded fishing nets in Chile, Argentina, Peru, Ecuador, Mexico & US. Recycles 1,000+ tonnes yearly into NetPlus® materials for brands like Patagonia. 4,500+ tonnes collected since 2013 to end net pollution.

properties.title: Operation Octopus - Greece
properties.description: Sea Shepherd removes illegal octopus traps from Greek waters. 75-day campaign launched July 2025 in Eastern Macedonia & Thrace. 4,650 traps removed in 4 days. Replicating Italy success where 7,672 traps removed led to octopus rebound.
properties.funder: Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace

properties.title: Ava Ocean - Low-Impact Seabed Harvesting Technology
properties.description: Ava Ocean developed precision seabed harvesting tech to collect scallops in Barents Sea without dredging, protecting ecosystems. Reopened Arctic scallop fishery after 30yr closure. Expanding to other species globally.

properties.title: Scorpion Reef Protection Operation
properties.description: Sustained patrol operation protecting Alacranes Reef & Bajos del Norte breeding grounds from industrial poaching. Two ships patrol 6,300 sq mi of protected Gulf of Mexico waters, supporting fish nurseries & sea turtle nesting sites.

properties.title: Vaquita Refuge Protection
properties.description: 24/7 patrols remove illegal totoaba gillnets threatening vaquita porpoise (<10 remain) in Upper Gulf of California. Navy coordination, thermal drones, fast launches. 1,200+ nets removed since 2015. Active operation.

properties.title: Antarctica Krill Protection Campaign
properties.description: Sea Shepherd confronts industrial krill supertrawlers in Antarctic waters competing with whales for food. Operates in Gerlache Strait & South Orkney Islands. 2025 fishery hit seasonal limit early; one whale killed in trawl net.

properties.title: Stop the Grind - Faroe Islands Cetacean Defense
properties.description: Sea Shepherd opposes grindadráp whale/dolphin hunts in Faroe Islands since 1983. Documents slaughter, advocates internationally, challenges tradition killing 745 cetaceans in 2024. Active ground presence.

properties.title: Sea Lion Protection in the Upper Gulf of California
properties.description: Protecting sea lions from gillnet entanglement in vaquita refuge. Removes illegal fishing gear that drowns sea lions, sharks, rays. Permanent vessel patrols with Mexican authorities monitor and respond to threats.

properties.title: Kenya Marine Conservation Project
properties.description: Blue Ventures supports community-led marine conservation in Kenya, working with coastal fishing communities to protect coral reefs and marine ecosystems through locally-managed conservation initiatives.

properties.title: Community-Based Fisheries Management in Indonesia
properties.description: Supporting 17 Indonesian orgs in community-based coral reef & mangrove conservation across 81 communities in 14 provinces since 2016. Peer learning network promotes fishing community rights, temporary fishery closures, mangrove forest mgmt.

properties.title: GEM - Community-led Marine Conservation in Indonesia
properties.description: Supporting 17 Indonesian orgs in community-based coral reef & mangrove conservation across 81 communities in 14 provinces since 2016. Focus on fishery closures, mangrove forest mgmt, & traditional fishing rights in Coral Triangle.

properties.title: Blue Forests - Community-led Marine Conservation in Indonesia
properties.description: Supporting 17 Indonesian orgs in coral reef & mangrove conservation across 81 communities in 14 provinces since 2016. Focus on community-based fisheries mgmt, temporary closures, mangrove forests in Sumatra & Kalimantan. Reaches 80,000+ people.

properties.title: Transform Bottom Trawling Coalition
properties.description: Global movement uniting fishing communities to tackle bottom trawling - the most destructive industrial fishing method that destroys seabeds, threatens food security, and contributes to climate crisis.

properties.title: Secure Rights - Indonesia Community-Led Marine Conservation
properties.description: Supporting 17 Indonesian orgs in community-based coral reef & mangrove conservation across 81 communities in 14 provinces since 2016. Promotes traditional fishing rights, temporary fishery closures, mangrove forest management.

properties.title: Climate REEFS: Integrating Risks, Evolution, and socio-Economics for Fisheries Sustainability
properties.description: Climate adaptation project for coral reefs in Philippines & Indonesia. Uses remote sensing to identify adaptive reefs, studies gender/social vulnerabilities, strengthens community fisheries capacity & MPA management in Coral Triangle.
properties.funder: University of Leeds, Coral Reef Alliance, Rare, Pattimura University

properties.title: SMART Technology for Illegal Fishing Prevention in Western Caribbean
properties.description: CORAL partners use SMART app to track illegal fishing, protect marine areas. Roatan Marine Park & Bay Islands Conservation patrol waters, monitor fish populations critical for reef health in Western Caribbean.

properties.title: Empowering Artisanal Fishers in Micos Lagoon, Honduras
properties.description: CORAL established first marine territorial use right system in Micos Lagoon, Honduras to regulate artisanal fishing. Increased fish biomass 600% through sustainable management, protecting sea turtles, manatees, crocodiles.

properties.title: CORAL 2024 Global Coral Reef Conservation Programs
properties.description: Multi-region coral reef conservation: clean water programs in Western Caribbean & Hawaii, sustainable fisheries in MPAs, climate adaptation research via satellite monitoring, sediment reduction in Maui watersheds. Aims for 80% coastal wastewater trea

properties.title: 2023 Year in Review: Coral Reef Conservation Projects
properties.description: Multi-region coral conservation: bleaching toolkit, water quality protocol for Mesoamerican Reef, lobster/conch preservation, Molokai fishpond restoration, Coral Triangle expansion in Philippines/Indonesia. 2023.

properties.title: Climate REEFS Initiative
properties.description: Identifies adaptive coral reefs via satellite, analyzes social vulnerabilities, and develops equitable climate adaptation pathways for coastal communities in Indonesia and Philippines dependent on reef resources.
properties.funder: UK Foreign Commonwealth and Development Office, International Development Research Centre Canada, UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: CORAL Joins Maui Nui Makai Network
properties.description: CORAL joins community network in Maui Nui to protect marine ecosystems. Provides technical expertise, implements projects reducing local reef threats. Partnership combines biocultural approach with community collaboration since 2021.

properties.title: Tela Bay Closed Fishing Season Increases Fish Biomass in Coastal Lagoons
properties.description: 2-month closed fishing season in Tela Bay, Honduras coastal lagoons achieved 500% fish biomass increase. Collaborative effort with local partners enforces sustainable fishing, allowing reef recovery and supporting fisher communities.

properties.title: New Management Plan Will Protect Coral Reefs in Tela Bay, Honduras
properties.description: CORAL collaborated with local partners to create a management plan for Tela Bay Wildlife Refuge MPA. Plan guides sustainable fishing, tourism, and enforcement to protect critically endangered corals along the Mesoamerican Reef.

properties.title: Using Lessons Learned in Puakō, Hawaii to Tackle Wastewater Pollution Worldwide
properties.description: CORAL fights wastewater pollution in Puakō, Hawaii where 53M gallons of raw sewage enter ocean daily. Partners with community to advocate for treatment plant, monitors water quality, and shares methods globally through RRN course.

properties.title: Tela Bay Closed Fishing Season Success
properties.description: Los Micos Lagoon closed fishing season (May-June 2021) showed 483% increase in fish biomass. Protects juvenile fish migrating to coral reefs, addresses overfishing through patrols and local fishing rights in Tela Bay, Honduras.

properties.title: Sustainable Fisheries and Marine Protected Areas - Puerto Castilla, Honduras
properties.description: Combating overfishing in Puerto Castilla through marine protected areas, community scientist programs, aquaculture support, and fisher education to restore fish populations and protect coral reef ecosystems.

properties.title: Partnering with the Belize Tourism Board to Save Coral Reefs
properties.description: CORAL partners with Belize Tourism Board to reduce water pollution and expand sustainable tourism in Belize City and Caye Caulker. Building wastewater treatment systems, monitoring water quality at 90 sites, and establishing sustainable tourism progr

properties.title: Aquaculture as Alternative to Overfishing in Tela Bay, Honduras
properties.description: Testing small-scale aquaculture systems using native copetona fish to reduce fishing pressure on reefs, increase fisher income, and address food insecurity in Tela Bay. Training fishers to build home systems.

properties.title: Aquaponics System for Coastal Communities in Tela Bay, Honduras
properties.description: Aquaponics system combining fish farming and organic vegetable growing to reduce overfishing pressure on Los Micos Lagoon and Mesoamerican Reef. Provides food security and income for fishers in Tela Bay, Honduras. Started 2022.

properties.title: Cleaner Water Farewell for Coral Disease - Roatán, Honduras
properties.description: CORAL partnered with West End community since 2013 to revitalize wastewater treatment plant. Reduced bacteria 98% by 2020, coral disease dropped from 25% to 0% (2011-2016). Blue Flag beach certified.

properties.title: Stony Coral Tissue Loss Disease Response in Bay Islands Honduras
properties.description: Treating fast-spreading coral disease in Roatán, Guanaja, Utila reefs using topical antibiotics. 14 orgs collaborate on treatment, monitoring, rescue center. Detected Sept 2020. Addressing water quality threats.

properties.title: New Coral Reef Discovery and Protection in Trujillo, Honduras
properties.description: CORAL & HRI discovered new functional reefs in Trujillo with 12-16% coral cover. Monitoring & protecting these reefs through fisheries management & community engagement to establish healthy reef networks across Mesoamerica.

properties.title: Supporting Marine Protected Areas During COVID-19 in Mesoamerican Reef
properties.description: CORAL & MAR Fund supported tourism-dependent conservation orgs in Honduras & Belize during pandemic. RMP increased patrols, confiscated 905 illegal fishing items. TASA developed business plan for 342k acre reserve management.

properties.title: Clean Water for Reefs - Puakō Wastewater Treatment Project
properties.description: Addressing ocean sewage pollution in Puakō by transitioning 643 homes off cesspools. $1.8M allocated to develop wastewater system facilities plan, preventing 53M gallons daily sewage from entering groundwater and coral reefs.
properties.funder: Hawai'i Department of Health, Hawai'i County Council

properties.title: Transitioning to co-management in Caribbean reef fisheries: Tela Bay case study
properties.description: 5-year fisheries co-management study in Tela Bay, Honduras. Built trust between fishers, NGOs & government through community dialogues & collaborative planning. Lane snapper populations now sustainable. Started 2016 when fish stocks were critically l

properties.title: First-Ever Fish Catalogs Created for Honduras Fisheries

properties.title: Elasmobranch Research and Management in Namibian MPAs
properties.description: Study sharks, skates & rays in Africa's 2nd largest marine reserve (NIMPA) using video, acoustic tags & angler collaboration. Develop management measures for unstudied elasmobranch populations in Namibian waters.

properties.title: Participatory Management and Conservation of the Shark Sanctuary of Parda Bay
properties.description: Protecting Lemon sharks & nursery in Baía de Parda through sustainable resource mgmt & shark-watching tourism. Community-focused project develops local livelihoods using best practices to ensure shark population health.

properties.title: Identifying Key Habitats for Endangered Whale Sharks in Madagascar
properties.description: Research project identifying 400+ juvenile whale sharks in NW Madagascar to integrate critical habitats into MPA management plans and support National Plan of Action for Sharks and Rays development.

properties.title: Assessing the Scale of Exploitation of Sharks and Rays in West Africa
properties.description: Surveys at processing sites in Senegal & Mauritania to assess shark/ray fisheries impact, estimate trade quantities, identify species composition, map trade flows, and inform policy on fisheries controls.

properties.title: Conservation and Management of Sharks & Rays in Mozambique
properties.description: Prevents extinction of manta rays & whale sharks through research, education & conservation. Addresses marine illiteracy, changes attitudes/behavior/policy to protect marine resources at local & national levels in Mozambique.

properties.title: Protection for Threatened Sharks and Rays in South Africa
properties.description: Improve protection of IUCN Red List threatened sharks/rays in South African waters through research, legal strengthening, enforcement, and public mobilization. Prioritizes endemic species.

properties.title: Save the Maugean Skate
properties.description: Film campaign to save critically endangered Maugean Skate in Macquarie Harbour, Tasmania, threatened by industrial aquaculture. Features Aboriginal voices, scientists, govt reps to build community support for conservation.

properties.title: Improving Species Catch Data Collection for the Conservation and Management of Sharks and Rays in Kenya
properties.description: Introduces species-level shark/ray identification at 3 landing sites to assess fishing threats and develop policy briefs for Kenya's National Plan of Action, enhancing conservation management and fisher awareness.

properties.title: Improving Conservation of Sharks and Rays in Ghana Through Education and Sensitization
properties.description: Training fishermen in data collection on sharks/rays to inform sustainable management measures in Ghana's waters. Educational campaigns promote conservation policies and community acceptance of management plans.

properties.title: Biodiversity and Conservation of Elasmobranchs in Watamu Marine National Park, Kenya
properties.description: Enhance conservation of sharks, rays & guitarfish in Watamu Marine National Park. Collect data on critically endangered species like Halavi guitarfish using park as nursery. Provide education in schools & community events.

properties.title: Using Kinship to Investigate Population Status and Reproductive Behaviour of Largetooth Sawfish
properties.description: Uses genetic techniques to assess kinship of 300 juvenile sawfish in NW Australia over 20 years, providing life-history data for fisheries management of this threatened species.

properties.title: Assessment of the Extent of Shark Depredation in North Male and Baa Atolls, Maldives
properties.description: Assessing shark-fishery interactions in Maldives shark sanctuary. Advocates for modified fishing gear with shark deterrents to reduce conflicts. Addresses fishermen concerns over catch reduction in North Male and Baa Atolls.

properties.title: Creation of a Platform of Community-Based Conservation Advocates for Sharks and Rays in Liberia
properties.description: Community-based shark and ray conservation platform in Liberia. Builds local advocacy network to protect elasmobranch species through community engagement and education along Liberian coast.

properties.title: Survey of the Nursery Areas of Green Sawfish (Pristis zijsron) in the Sudanese Red Sea
properties.description: Survey nursery areas of green sawfish in Sudanese Red Sea to assess juveniles, study ecology, collect genetic samples, use eDNA to detect presence, and train fishermen on sawfish protection. 12-month project by University of Bahri.

properties.title: Mapping Critical Habitats to Safeguard the Critically Endangered Rhinorays of the Karimunjawa National Park Java Sea
properties.description: Mapping and protecting critical habitats for endangered wedgefish and guitarfish species in Karimunjawa National Park, Java Sea, through research and bycatch reduction efforts with local fishing communities.

properties.title: Use of Ancient Environmental DNA to Identify a Viable Site for Conservation of the Maugean Skate
properties.description: Uses ancient DNA to assess if Bathurst Harbour is suitable for releasing captive-bred Maugean skates. Population halved in 7 years in degraded Macquarie Harbour. Urgent captive breeding needed for near-extinct species.

properties.title: SharkTrack: Developing a Traceability System for Shark and Ray Products
properties.description: Develops tagging system to track sharks/rays from capture through supply chain, enabling legal source verification, supporting CITES compliance, and reducing illegal catch in managed fisheries.

properties.title: An Assessment of Sharks and Rays at a Critical Site in Mozambique
properties.description: Assessing threatened sharks and rays in Zavora, Mozambique, focusing on reef manta rays after drastic decline. Protecting critical habitat where remaining individuals may have relocated over past decade.

properties.title: Evaluating the Efficacy of a Marine Reserve for Endemic and Threatened Sharks off South Africa
properties.description: Study evaluating if extending De Hoop Nature Reserve boundary 5km eastward will protect endemic/threatened sharks from longline fishing. Results inform Cape Nature's reserve design decisions. 12-month research on shark protection.

properties.title: Germ Cell Transplantation as an Insurance Tool for the Conservation of the Endangered Maugean Skate
properties.description: Using germ cell transplantation to preserve endangered Maugean skate genetics. Injecting skate germ cells into surrogate species to produce offspring from cryopreserved material. Located in Macquarie & Bathurst Harbours, Tasmania.

properties.title: Unravelling Fishing and Trade of Endangered Guitarfish in the Bijagos Archipelago
properties.description: Study guitarfish population status & fishing pressure in Bijagos Archipelago. Collaborate with IBAP to gather current/historical data via stakeholder involvement, establish evidence-based conservation agenda for endangered species.

properties.title: Building Capacity of Emerging Shark Researchers in the Philippines
properties.description: Training emerging shark researchers in the Philippines to build local conservation capacity through research skills development and knowledge transfer for shark and ray protection.

properties.title: Sharks International 2026
properties.description: World's largest shark/ray conference in Sri Lanka 2026, bridging science & policy. Enables Asian scientists/policymakers to attend, fostering partnerships for elasmobranch conservation through accessible venue.

properties.title: Protecting Sharks and Rays in Australia Phase 2
properties.description: Protecting endemic sharks, rays, and sawfish in Australia's tropical ecosystems by reducing threats from commercial fishing and shark control programs across eastern Australia's unmanaged waters.

properties.title: Preventing Shark Extinctions from Australia's North to South
properties.description: AMCS partners with SCF to prevent extinction of endangered sharks and rays across Australia, focusing on sawfish conservation in northern Australia, Maugean Skate protection, and safeguarding critically endangered species.

properties.title: Save the Maugean Skate Campaign
properties.description: Campaign to save <1,000 Maugean Skates in Macquarie Harbour, Tasmania from extinction due to industrial aquaculture. Science-based community engagement to implement conservation actions for survival.

properties.title: Estimation of Acquisition Time of CITES-Listed Sharks: A Tool for Pre-Convention Specimens
properties.description: Develops DNA tool to determine age of shark products via DNA fragmentation, enabling enforcement of CITES trade regulations for endangered sharks and rays in Hong Kong wildlife trade markets.

properties.title: Global Shark Conservation Campaign South Asia & West Africa
properties.description: Implements CITES shark/ray listings in Sri Lanka & Senegal through mortality controls. Supports additional species listings at 2019 CITES meeting. 12-month campaign for endangered species protection.

properties.title: Southeast Asian Shark and Ray Research and Conservation Capacity Building Workshop 2019
properties.description: Workshop bringing researchers from 6 nations to build capacity in shark/ray research in SE Asia, a diversity hotspot & fisheries center. Develops skills & networks for future conservation efforts.

properties.title: Investigating the Past and Present of Sawfish in Bangladesh
properties.description: Volunteer monitoring by trained coastal communities to report sawfish encounters and landings in Bangladesh. Data shared via open-access web portal to support national sawfish conservation and global assessment.

properties.title: Developing Local Conservation Policy for Pelagic Thresher Shark in Alor, Indonesia
properties.description: Establishing District and village-level conservation policy to stop unsustainable thresher shark fishing in newly identified hotspot. Working with fishing communities on livelihood mitigation strategies.

properties.title: Developing Conservation Approaches for Sawfish and Rhino Rays in Papua New Guinea
properties.description: Conservation project protecting critically endangered sawfish and rhino rays in PNG waters through research and community engagement to develop sustainable management strategies.

properties.title: Restoring Manta and Devil Ray Populations in the Philippines
properties.description: Identifying remaining manta/devil ray populations after fishery closure (2017). Creating first manta sanctuary, mapping priority areas/migration corridors, establishing protected area network for species recovery in Philippines.

properties.title: CITES Shark and Ray Listings Implementation Capacity Building Fin Identification Workshops Taiwan
properties.description: Capacity building workshops for Taiwan officials on visual ID of shark fins and mobular gill plates, trade document review, to increase regulation and monitoring of CITES-listed species and deter illegal trade.

properties.title: Securing the Only Known Viable Population of the Ganges Shark (Glyphis gangeticus)
properties.description: Protect critically endangered Ganges Sharks in N Kalimantan estuaries. 17 individuals found 2023. Work with local govt/universities for national protection policy. Population <250 mature individuals globally.

properties.title: Understanding Artisanal Fishing Activity and Data Collection on Sharks and Rays in Indonesia
properties.description: Identifies shark/mobulid interactions with artisanal fisheries in Savu Sea through on-board/land observation to promote fishing regulation modifications and area management. Addresses lack of fishing data in Indonesian waters.

properties.title: In Situ Conservation of Queensland's Sawfish
properties.description: Sharks and Rays Australia works with fishers in Queensland to protect sawfish through capture reporting and best practice release methods for animals entangled in nets. 12-month project addressing conservation barriers.
properties.funder: Global Partnership for Sharks and Rays

properties.title: Halting Extinction: Ensuring Live Release of Sawfish, Alleviating Barriers of Fishers in Bangladesh
properties.description: Creating fisher networks to release sawfish live by breaking barriers. Collaborative model with stakeholders, policymakers & researchers to mitigate bycatch in developing countries & limit population decline.

properties.title: Simplifying the CITES Non-Detriment Findings (NDF) Process: The Electronic NDF (e-NDF)
properties.description: Workshop to assess new software streamlining CITES NDF process for sharks/rays, making it accessible to Parties. Ensures sustainable trade of 30k species while promoting population recovery and sustainable livelihoods.

properties.title: Towards a Sustainable Future for Sri Lankan Rhino Rays: Science Implementation in the Indian Ocean
properties.description: Delivers critical data on threatened rhino rays in Sri Lanka to inform trade regulations and fisheries management. Addresses knowledge gaps in diversity and population structure to support Non-Detrimental Findings and action plans.

properties.title: Saving Sharks in Indonesia Through Developing and Implementing Science-Based Management Reforms
properties.description: WCS program delivering science-based fisheries/trade reforms in Indonesia (world's largest shark fishing nation). Enhances legal protection, tackles illegal trade, implements sustainable fishing, evaluates impact on species/communities.

properties.title: Awakening of Public Opinion for Withdrawal of Japan's Reservation of CITES Shark Species Regulations
properties.description: Raising public awareness in Japan about shark conservation and CITES trade regulations through symposiums and information campaigns to pressure withdrawal of Japan's reservations on shark species listings.

properties.title: Implementing Outreach and Advocacy Activities for the Passage of the Philippine Shark Conservation Act
properties.description: Advocacy for national shark/ray conservation policy in Philippines. Balances fishery use by coastal communities with tourism potential. Outreach campaign to support legal framework for sustainable utilization of 200+ species.

properties.title: Building Capacity for Long-Term Shark Conservation in Myanmar
properties.description: Fauna & Flora supports Myanmar govt to improve shark/ray conservation through science, advocacy, national planning. Reduces illegal landings, bycatch, protects Myeik archipelago habitats, reforms legislation.

properties.title: Reduce Shark Mortality in the Arabian Sea Around Pakistan
properties.description: WWF reduces shark bycatch in Arabian Sea via modified fishing gear, regional data sharing, and national management blueprint. Establishes coordinated shark/ray conservation strategy across Pakistan and neighboring waters.

properties.title: Sabah Shark and Ray Initiative
properties.description: Strengthens shark/ray conservation in Sabah through improved regulations, bycatch reduction, MPA effectiveness, and awareness. Supports Malaysia's National Plan of Action on Sharks via multi-org collaboration.

properties.title: Shark Fin Demand Reduction
properties.description: Multi-country study of shark fin consumption trends & trade dynamics in Asia to inform culturally specific demand reduction campaigns. Addresses manta/mobula ray gill plate demand. Partners: Traffic, WWF, ADMCF.

properties.title: A Scoping Study for Traceability Improvements in Singapore, a Globally Significant Trading Hub for Shark and Ray Products
properties.description: Research shark/ray supply chain in Singapore to combat IUU fishing. Maps product flow, stakeholders, legal requirements. Identifies gaps and recommends traceability improvements for CITES implementation in this major trading hub.

properties.title: Angel Sharks: A Regional Action Plan for the Mediterranean
properties.description: Protect 3 Critically Endangered angel sharks in Mediterranean via regional action plan. Increases profile, classifies threats, fosters collaboration, facilitates legislation adoption. 2-year core grant.

properties.title: Rapid Assessment Toolkit for Sharks (RAT)
properties.description: WWF developed a Rapid Assessment Toolkit to help fisheries authorities understand shark/ray populations and stock health through simplified DNA data methods. Trials conducted in Papua New Guinea, Malaysia, Indonesia to improve species management.

properties.title: Protecting Sharks and Rays in Australia
properties.description: 3-year program to protect endemic sharks/rays through public campaigns, fisheries reduction, threatened species listings, and transitioning shark control programs to non-lethal methods in Australian waters.

properties.title: Conservation of Angel Sharks (Squatina squatina) in Their Last Stronghold
properties.description: Investigating nursery areas for Critically Endangered Angelsharks in Canary Islands. Research environmental characteristics, engage stakeholders, raise awareness to drive spatial protection in this unique stronghold.

properties.title: Strengthening Angel Shark Conservation in the Southern Aegean Sea
properties.description: Protecting 3 Critically Endangered angel shark species in Aegean Sea hotspot through Sub-Regional Action Plan implementation, addressing illegal fishing threats in Greek waters around Crete over 12 months.

properties.title: Advancing Shark and Ray Conservation and Management in Indonesia
properties.description: WCS supports Indonesian govt to develop policies for shark/ray protection, implement site-based conservation programs, and strengthen law enforcement capacity for elasmobranch regulations.

properties.title: Protecting Critical Shark and Ray Habitat in Sabah
properties.description: Conservation project in Sabah protecting critical habitats for sharks and rays as apex predators essential to ocean health. Addresses threats from overfishing killing 250,000+ sharks/rays daily.

properties.title: Build a National Reporting System for Forest Officials to Protect Threatened Sharks and Rays
properties.description: Training forest officials in Bangladesh to report shark/ray data, standardizing wildlife monitoring to enforce national laws and international commitments for elasmobranch protection through 12-month capacity building.

properties.title: Protecting Sharks and Rays in the Spanish Mediterranean
properties.description: Reversing shark/ray decline in Balearic Islands via MPAs, fisheries management, habitat protection. Collaborating with NGOs, researchers, fishermen to protect threatened species and establish conservation model.

properties.title: SAW Search: Old Saws Shed New Light in Sawfish Conservation
properties.description: Analyzing historic largetooth sawfish museum specimens from UK to quantify genetic diversity loss over ~100 years, assessing survival outlook for Critically Endangered populations affected by bycatch and habitat loss.

properties.title: Hong Kong Policy Work for the Shark Fin Related Trade
properties.description: Reviews policies/legislation on shark fin trade in Hong Kong (50% global imports hub). Enhances CITES enforcement, combats illegal trade through research and public engagement to classify wildlife crimes as serious offenses.

properties.title: Reversing the Decline of Shark Populations in Indonesia by Transforming Fisheries and Trade
properties.description: Protecting endangered sharks/rays in Indonesia through evidence-based fisheries management, CITES implementation, and community collaboration across 17,000+ islands with 2.3M fishers.

properties.title: Securing the Long-Term Conservation of Angelsharks in their Stronghold of the Canary Islands
properties.description: Protecting Critically Endangered Angelsharks in Canary Islands through government partnerships, data collection, fisher collaboration to reduce bycatch, and implementing the Angelshark Action Plan.

properties.title: Strengthening Shark and Ray Protections in Sabah, Malaysia
properties.description: Strengthening shark/ray conservation in Sabah through improved legal frameworks, CITES protection, policy research on landings/ecotourism, media campaigns, education, and hosting 2018 conference for regional collaboration.

properties.title: Protecting Sharks in the Northwest Adriatic
properties.description: Promotes spatial management for threatened sharks/rays in overfished NW Adriatic ISRA. Addresses declining populations where fisheries measures fail to protect vulnerable species in Croatia & Italy waters.

properties.title: Blue Shark Regional NDF Guidance
properties.description: Developing regional Non-Detriment Findings guidance for blue shark conservation to support sustainable fisheries management and CITES compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

properties.title: Island Shark: Oceanic Islands as Nurseries for Migratory Sharks
properties.description: Mapping nurseries of smooth hammerhead and tope sharks in Azores using traditional knowledge, tagging, and video census to inform marine protected areas. 12-month study of threatened migratory species.

properties.title: Mediterranean Angel Sharks Regional Action Plan Phase 2 Implementation
properties.description: Coordinates delivery of Regional Action Plan for 3 Critically Endangered angel shark species in Mediterranean. Focuses on Turkey, Cyprus, and Tunisia to protect Sawback, Smoothback & Angelshark species.

properties.title: Supporting the Sustainable Management of Gulper Sharks
properties.description: Reducing mortality of 15 deep-sea Gulper Shark species threatened by overfishing for liver oil (squalene). Working globally across 119 nations to ensure sustainable catch levels for these slow-reproducing sharks.

properties.title: Guardians of the Blue
properties.description: Documentary advocating CITES Appendix I protection for whale sharks & mobulids in Honda Bay, Philippines. Highlights marine biodiversity, ecotourism benefits, and sustainable community development through stakeholder interviews.

properties.title: Angel Shark Project: Coordinated Action for the Protection of Angel Sharks Across Their Ranges
properties.description: Protecting 3 Critically Endangered angel shark species in Eastern Atlantic/Mediterranean across 7 countries through legislation support, community engagement to identify key habitats, and sharing conservation toolkits via network.

properties.title: Improving the Conservation Status of Sharks and Rays in the Southwest Indian Ocean
properties.description: Protecting sharks/rays in SWIO hotspot through scientific research, CITES trade controls, and policy development across Madagascar, Mozambique, Tanzania & Kenya's artisanal fisheries where shark populations face severe decline.

properties.title: Important Shark & Ray Areas: A Tool to Optimize Marine Protected Areas to Benefit Sharks and Rays
properties.description: IUCN delineates Important Shark and Ray Areas (ISRAs) globally to optimize marine protected areas. Addresses inadequate protection by identifying scientifically-based discrete regions for threatened species conservation.

properties.title: Bridging the Gap: Promoting Treaty Implementation to Recover Atlantic Sharks
properties.description: Securing science-based fishing limits for Atlantic sharks (shortfin makos, blue sharks) through ICCAT management measures and aligning CITES obligations across Atlantic shark fishing nations.

properties.title: Sharks International 2022
properties.description: Quadrennial shark conference in Valencia, Spain (2022) with online platform. Offers talks, workshops, exhibitions for international audience. Supports shark conservation knowledge sharing globally.

properties.title: The Critically Endangered Sand Tiger Shark as an Umbrella Species in the Southwestern Atlantic Ocean
properties.description: Advocacy for sand tiger shark protection via CMS Appendix I listing & recreational fishing legislation in Argentine maritime provinces. Protects multiple shark species in SW Atlantic. 12-month campaign by Vida Silvestre Argentina.

properties.title: Turning CITES Listings into Conservation Action
properties.description: WCS project implementing CITES regulations for shark and ray species protection. Focuses on translating international trade agreements into practical conservation measures for threatened elasmobranch species.

properties.title: Safeguarding Atlantic Mediterranean Elasmobranchs through RFMOs
properties.description: Protects sharks/rays from finning/overfishing in Mediterranean & Atlantic via regional fishery orgs. Implements catch limits, enforces existing rules, bans at-sea fin removal. 2-year effort by Ocean Foundation & partners.

properties.title: Close-Kin Mark-Recapture Methods: Designing a Scientific Study to Increase the Use of Fisheries Independent Data in Management for Atlantic Mako Sharks
properties.description: Feasibility study using genetic Close-Kin Mark-Recapture methods to estimate shortfin mako abundance in Atlantic Ocean, supporting sustainable management through fisheries-independent population data.

properties.title: CITES: Delivering Comprehensive Trade Regulation to Drive Global Shark Conservation
properties.description: WCS works with governments in 15 countries to implement CITES shark/ray listings, improve fisheries management, enhance catch/trade data collection, and support additional species protections at CoP 19 to regulate global shark fin trade.

properties.title: Improving the Understanding of Threatened Wedgefish and Guitarfish to Inform CITES Assessments
properties.description: Studies biology of threatened wedgefish/guitarfish globally, focusing on Indonesia/SE Asia. Collects life history, distribution, abundance data to inform CITES conservation and local fishery management for these overfished species.

properties.title: Enhancing the Conservation of Endangered Sharks and Rays in the Mediterranean
properties.description: Identifies gaps in bycatch data collection for Mediterranean sharks/rays in Italy. Addresses enforcement of EU/GFCM retention bans. Targets vulnerable species facing extinction from high fishing effort and bycatch.

properties.title: Global Shark Trends
properties.description: IUCN Shark Specialist Group creates global dashboard tracking 1,250 shark/ray species conservation status. Combines Red List data with distribution maps to identify priority locations and policy interventions for decision-makers.

properties.title: Concerted Action for the Atlantic Blue Shark (Prionace glauca)
properties.description: Marine Research and Conservation Foundation works with partners to achieve sustainable management of Atlantic blue sharks through CMS Concerted Actions. North Atlantic stock declined 50% in 3 generations.

properties.title: Assessing the Risk of Overexploitation of the Most Traded Species of Sharks and Rays
properties.description: Uses M-Risk assessment to identify heavily traded shark/ray species at overexploitation risk and determine needed management interventions. Works with Global Shark Trends project to inform managers.

properties.title: Mitigating Devil Ray Bycatch from Artisanal Gillnet Fisheries in the Southwestern Gulf of California
properties.description: Testing LED lights on gillnets to reduce devil ray bycatch in artisanal fisheries. Assessing survival rates and developing mitigation measures with fishing communities in Gulf of California, Mexico.

properties.title: SharkTraits – A Global Life History Trait Database for Sharks and Rays
properties.description: Global database compiling shark/ray life history traits (maturation, reproduction, lifespan) to support CITES listings and IUCN Red List assessments for data-deficient species. Now available as SharkiPedia.

properties.title: Global Mobuild Conservation Programme
properties.description: Reduces fisheries threats to manta and mobula rays in Indonesia, Sri Lanka, and Peru through policy development, community engagement, and protective measures in countries with major mobulid fisheries.

properties.title: Identifying and Communicating the Ecological Importance of Sharks
properties.description: Global scientists analyze datasets to determine when/why sharks matter for ocean health, how to restore populations amid rapid declines, and communicate findings to decision makers and public for better ecosystem management.

properties.title: ICCAT Protections for Sharks and Rays in the Turks and Caicos Islands
properties.description: Implementing ICCAT regulations banning retention of 14 shark species and mobulid rays through multilingual outreach and education campaigns for commercial and recreational fisheries stakeholders in Turks and Caicos Islands.

properties.title: Responsible Coastal Fisheries Management for Shark Conservation and Marine Sustainability in Panama
properties.description: Participatory planning with communities in Gulf of Chiriquí to reduce fishing impacts on sharks and marine habitats through improved regulations and voluntary measures for ocean conservation and fisheries sustainability.

properties.title: Finalizing Sawfish Protection in the Bahamas
properties.description: Securing national regulations to protect Critically Endangered smalltooth sawfish from fishing threats in the Bahamas, promoting enforcement and safe release practices, and expanding Caribbean-wide protections.

properties.title: It's More Than Just Fins: Reducing Trade of Elasmobranch Products in Honduras
properties.description: Reduce shark/ray trade in Honduras via supply chain analysis, species assessment, capacity building, and regulatory framework development for incidental captures through National Shark Working Group collaboration.

properties.title: Global Shark Conservation Campaign
properties.description: Implements CITES shark/ray listings in Bangladesh & Senegal through mortality controls. Supports additional species listings at 2019 CITES meeting. Focuses on South Asian & West African conservation efforts.

properties.title: eDNA: A New Way to Assess Sharks for Conservation
properties.description: FIU tests environmental DNA sampling vs traditional surveys at 20 Caribbean, Indian & Pacific Ocean sites to validate eDNA as cheaper, easier method for measuring shark abundance & diversity at unprecedented scales.

properties.title: Maximizing Outcomes for Shark and Ray MPAs
properties.description: Research to provide decision-makers tools for effective shark/ray MPAs. Develops spatial models, analyzes past MPA successes/failures, creates socio-economic criteria. Scales: national to global, coastal to open ocean.

properties.title: Dangerous or Endangered? Sharks in Uruguay - Phase 2
properties.description: Protecting 50 shark species in Uruguay's coastal waters through research, management plans for Isla de Lobos MPA, establishing new Restinga Pez Limón MPA, and stakeholder collaboration to promote sustainable blue economy.

properties.title: Protecting the Bahamas Shark Sanctuary
properties.description: Assessing 10-year impact of Bahamas' 2011 shark sanctuary across their EEZ. Doctoral student repeats 2015/16 Global FinPrint survey to evaluate protection effects on shark populations and human ocean users.

properties.title: Contributing to the Declaration of Tiquisate-Sipacate an Important Site for Sharks and Rays
properties.description: Collaborating with government and communities to declare Sipacate and Tecojate nursery sites as Important Shark and Ray Areas (ISRAs) through monitoring and workshops in Guatemala's coastal waters.

properties.title: Implementing the National Plan of Action of Sharks and Rays in Guatemala's Pacific Coast and CITES
properties.description: FUNMZ implements Guatemala's 2021-2026 NPOA for sharks, rays & chimaeras, collaborating with authorities & fishing communities to ensure elasmobranch protection & sustainable management through CITES compliance.

properties.title: Closing the Triangle: A New MPA for Sharks and Rays in the Nicoya Peninsula
properties.description: Establishing a new marine protected area in Costa Rica's Nicoya Peninsula to protect critical shark and ray habitats, particularly for hammerhead nursery grounds in the Eastern Tropical Pacific.

properties.title: Updating the Zoning of the Galapagos Marine Reserve as a Tool for Sustainable Management and Shark Conservation
properties.description: Developing enforceable zoning plan for Galapagos Marine Reserve through participatory process with fishing communities, using latest science to protect sharks and marine biodiversity in one of world's largest MPAs.

properties.title: Enhancing Elasmobranch Conservation through the Convention on Migratory Species (CMS)
properties.description: Expert report documenting CMS Parties' performance on 34 shark/ray species obligations. Engages countries on Atlantic shortfin Mako protection, informs sawfish conservation, highlights shortfalls and solutions.

properties.title: Strengthening Fisheries Management and Conservation Strategies for the Brazilian Guitarfish in its Southern Distribution Boundary
properties.description: Protecting critically endangered Brazilian guitarfish in El Rincón, Argentina through policy reform, research, and stakeholder engagement. Targets mating aggregations threatened by recreational fishing tournaments along Patagonian coast.

properties.title: Identifying the Last Remaining Areas of the Critically Endangered Largetooth Sawfish in Costa Rica
properties.description: Research to identify and monitor critical habitats of Critically Endangered largetooth sawfish in Costa Rica, working with government to develop a Sawfish Conservation Plan for Central America population recovery.

properties.title: Sharks of Ilha Grande Bay: Safeguarding Critical Habitats for Sharks in Brazil
properties.description: Protecting shark habitats in Ilha Grande Bay, Brazil through conservation efforts focused on safeguarding critical marine areas for shark populations.

properties.title: Assessing Elasmobranch Nurseries on a Global Conservation Hotspot for Improved Management
properties.description: Investigating Brazil's North Coast as communal nursery for threatened sharks/rays using vertebrae microchemistry to analyze habitat use and develop conservation areas amid artisanal fishing pressures.

properties.title: Strengthening Sharks and Rays Fisheries Management Regulation and Improving Catch Monitoring
properties.description: Influence public policies for elasmobranch conservation in Guatemala. Establish Technical Group to update National Plan of Action for Chondrichthyes. Monitor landings to provide data for sustainable fisheries management.

properties.title: Assessing the Effectiveness of Jardines de la Reina National Park in Shark and Ray Conservation
properties.description: Investigates movement patterns and habitat use of hammerhead sharks and rays in Cuba's Jardines de la Reina MPA to inform effective management of IUCN endangered and CITES regulated species.

properties.title: Stopping Costa Rican Exports of Endangered Shark Species
properties.description: Media & policy advocacy to stop threatened shark exports from Costa Rica. Addresses scientific gaps in fisheries authority decisions, promotes Executive Decree for multisectoral, science-based shark management & conservation.

properties.title: Protecting Nursery Areas for the Scalloped Hammerhead Shark in the Colombian Pacific Coast
properties.description: Protect scalloped hammerhead nursery in Colombian Pacific by delimiting areas, reducing angler-shark interaction, promoting better fishing practices, training anglers in resuscitation techniques and data collection for authorities.

properties.title: Dangerous or Endangered: Sharks in Uruguay
properties.description: Pilot project creating Uruguay's first shark/ray database combining fisher & scientific data. Works with fisheries, communities, schools to shift perception from 'dangerous' to 'endangered' & inform MPA policies.

properties.title: Developing a Science-Based Approach to Scale Up Transboundary Marine Policy and Management: The Designation of the Galapagos-Cocos Swimway
properties.description: Establishing legal protection for Cocos-Galapagos swimway corridor between MPAs. Creating first protected transboundary swimway in Eastern Tropical Pacific with binational governance structure between Costa Rica & Ecuador.

properties.title: Reducing Catch and Post-Release Mortality of Elasmobranchs in Small-Scale Fisheries of Colombia
properties.description: Reducing shark/ray bycatch in Colombian Pacific artisanal fisheries through gear modifications and practice changes with fishermen via participatory workshops to decrease elasmobranch mortality.

properties.title: Enhancing Morphological Tool to Identify Shark Fins Combating the International Illegal Trade
properties.description: Develops software/app using digital image analysis to identify CITES-listed shark species from fins, enabling enforcement officers to combat illegal trade through fast, reliable species identification at ports.

properties.title: Sustainable Shark and Ray Management Regulations and Continued Population Monitoring in Tobago
properties.description: Develop sustainable shark/ray management regulations in NE Tobago's 60,000ha nominated MPA through government-civil society collaboration. Monitor populations to inform policy against commercial longline threats.

properties.title: Protecting Endangered Shark Species in Argentina: A Flagship for Coastal Environments Conservation
properties.description: Fish Ecology Lab in Patagonia develops critical shark conservation knowledge and direct initiatives using holistic strategy for shark and coastal habitat protection in Argentina.

properties.title: Restoring the Pacific Angelshark Population in Peru
properties.description: Collecting biological & fisheries data on Pacific angelshark (97% decline 2001-2015) to develop management strategies for sustainable use in Peru. Species is Near Threatened with no current protection measures.

properties.title: Largetooth Sawfish in the Amazonian Coast: Presence and Improving Enforcement in this Twilight Zone
properties.description: Protecting endangered Largetooth Sawfish on Amazonian Coast through enforcement training, fisher safe-release guidance, ID guides, and eDNA analysis to confirm presence in this critical stronghold region.

properties.title: Saving Oceanic White-tips in their Final Atlantic Stronghold
properties.description: Protecting Critically Endangered oceanic whitetip sharks in Western Atlantic. Relic population in Bahamas sanctuary studied for decade. Aims to reduce mortality from targeted/bycatch fisheries in Bahamas, Dominican Republic, Haiti, Cuba.

properties.title: Sharks from the Interjurisdictional Marine Coastal Park Patagonia Austral PIMCPA: A Research and Conservation Initiative
properties.description: Research large sharks in central Patagonia using underwater video, tagging, and fishermen knowledge to guide conservation. Aims to ban shark killing and raise awareness among fishermen in South West Atlantic.

properties.title: Reconstruction of Historical Catches for Shark CITES Species in Mexico to Strengthen NDF Issuance
properties.description: Reconstructs historical catch data of CITES-listed sharks in Mexico to assess population status and support Non-detriment findings. Addresses data gaps in a top shark fishing nation and leading fin exporter.

properties.title: Reduce Fishing Efforts Over Endemic Imperiled Sharks in Uruguay Using a Sustainable Haul System
properties.description: Prevent extinction of endemic Angelshark & smooth-hound in Uruguay by reducing bycatch mortality. Testing Sustainable Haul Gear System in 2 communities, targeting valuable bony fish instead of threatened sharks.

properties.title: CITES Sharks Management Workshop for Guatemalan Customs, Fisheries Officers and Private Exporters
properties.description: Two-day workshop training 60+ Guatemalan officers on shark fin identification to implement CITES trade restrictions, addressing illegal shark fin trade threatening endangered species through capacity building in species ID.

properties.title: Campaign to Restore America's Sharks and Rays
properties.description: Coalition raises shark/ray conservation profile with US federal government and Congress. Restores US leadership in science-based shark conservation and strengthens fisheries management through advocacy.

properties.title: Ensuring the Recovery of Endangered U.S. Sawfish
properties.description: Track & accelerate recovery of Florida's smalltooth sawfish through outreach, enforcement of safeguards, research under ESA Recovery Plan, NGO partnerships for habitat conservation & fisheries management.

properties.title: Conservation Actions for Sharks and Skates in Patagonia
properties.description: WCS-Argentina protects endemic sharks/skates in Argentine waters via Patagonian Coastal Corridor MPA for critical life phases & action plan for Critically Endangered tope shark in key MPA. 3-year project in Patagonia.

properties.title: Hammerhead Shark (Sphyrna lewini) Nursery Areas in the Eastern Colombian Pacific
properties.description: Acoustic & satellite tagging of 11 hammerhead sharks to identify nursery areas in Colombian Pacific. 3 acoustic receptors deployed along coast. Provides data for management plans to protect endangered species.

properties.title: Strengthening the Implementation of CITES in Mexico for Appendix II Listed Sharks
properties.description: Training local champions in Pacific fishing camps to improve CITES arrival notices reliability for 9 commercially relevant shark species, supporting sustainable export management in areas with 70% of shark landings.

properties.title: Assessing the Recovery of the Smalltooth Sawfish: A Kin-Based Approach
properties.description: Evaluates smalltooth sawfish population recovery using kin-based genetic analysis. Assesses conservation effectiveness in US waters where species is critically endangered. Applies innovative DNA methods to track population trends.

properties.title: Sharks & Rays Conservation Initiative: Shark Fin Transit Project Phase 1
properties.description: Investigates shark fin transit through US ports from Central America to Asia. Assesses volumes, routes, species, ports, and US legal authority to monitor and seize illegal shipments. Addresses poorly understood fin trade problem.

properties.title: Closing the Gap in U.S. Caribbean Scalloped Hammerhead Protections
properties.description: Earthjustice works to close regulatory loopholes allowing unregulated catch of juvenile scalloped hammerheads in Puerto Rico, using science to identify nursery areas and legal strategies to secure comprehensive ESA protections for threatened sharks.

properties.title: Strengthening Shark and Ray Conservation within the Western and Central Pacific Fisheries Commission
properties.description: Analysis of regulatory gaps in WCPFC shark/ray fisheries management. Provides recommendations to strengthen framework implementing CITES/CMS requirements for directed fisheries and bycatch in Western-Central Pacific.

properties.title: Implementing a Transboundary Swimway in the Eastern Tropical Pacific Ocean
properties.description: Establishing first transboundary swimway between Galapagos and Cocos Islands MPAs to protect migrating sharks, turtles and marine wildlife in the Eastern Tropical Pacific.

properties.title: Can eDNA be used to track changes in shark populations?
properties.description: Comparing aerial shark counts with water DNA concentration to develop cheap, easy population monitoring. Testing if environmental DNA can replace expensive fishing/video surveys for tracking shark numbers and conservation success.
