properties.title: Saving Caribbean Sawfishes
properties.description: Improving scientific understanding and legal protection of endangered sawfish populations in Bahamas and Cuba. Addressing local extinctions through research and conservation partnerships to reverse declines of these rays.

properties.title: Sharks & Rays Conservation Initiative: Shark Fin Transit Project Phase II
properties.description: NRDC reviews U.S. laws and international treaties to strengthen provisions against shark fin trafficking. Develops strategies to leverage U.S. legal framework and enforcement to combat illegal shark fin trade globally.

properties.title: Protecting Scalloped Hammerhead Nurseries in Puerto Rico
properties.description: Conservation of scalloped hammerhead shark nursery habitats in Puerto Rico's coastal waters through research and protection measures.

properties.title: Balloon-Busting Crew
properties.description: Educates public about balloon debris harming sea turtles and marine life through ingestion and entanglement. Promotes alternatives to balloon releases. Active in Texas coastal areas where balloons frequently wash ashore.

properties.title: Adopt-A-Block Program
properties.description: Community litter prevention in Galveston where residents/businesses adopt 1-5 blocks (500 sq yards) for year-round cleanup. Supplies provided, data tracked via NOAA Marine Debris app to combat plastic pollution.

properties.title: Bring the Bag
properties.description: Partnership with Surfrider Galveston to reduce single-use plastic bags in Galveston, TX. Installing reminder signs at stores, declaring Bring the Bag Day, promoting reusable bags to protect sea turtles from plastic pollution.

properties.title: Save the Leatherback
properties.description: Preventing Pacific leatherback extinction through fishing restrictions, habitat protection, and policy advocacy. Implemented Pacific Leatherback Conservation Area reducing deaths from 112 to near zero. Focus: California/Oregon coast.

properties.title: Hold On To Your Butt
properties.description: Turtle Island & Surfrider tackle cigarette butt pollution in Galveston by installing 50+ butt cans, recycling via TerraCycle, public education, and citizen science to protect marine life from plastic filter ingestion and toxic contamination.

properties.title: California Set Gillnet Bycatch Reduction Campaign
properties.description: Campaign to ban set gillnets in Southern California offshore waters (3-200 miles). Nets catch 125 species with 64% discarded; threaten sea turtles, sharks, marine mammals. Advocacy for selective fishing methods.

properties.title: The Cocos-Galapagos Swimway
properties.description: Protecting marine corridor between Costa Rica's Cocos Island & Ecuador's Galapagos where sea turtles, whale sharks, hammerhead sharks migrate. Urging governments to establish protected swimway against industrial fishing threats.

properties.title: Stop Expanded Offshore Drilling and Protect Cordell Bank National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: Opposing offshore drilling expansion & fishing in Cordell Bank Sanctuary (50mi NW San Francisco). Protects whales, sea turtles, seabirds, rockfish from industrial threats through advocacy & science-based policy.

properties.title: Take Action to Stop Offshore Drilling
properties.description: Opposition campaign against Trump's offshore drilling plan covering 1.27B acres. Threatens Alaska, Gulf of Mexico, California, Florida coasts. Protects marine wildlife, coastal communities from drilling risks.

properties.title: Rice's Whale Conservation in the Gulf of Mexico
properties.description: Urging federal protection for critically endangered Rice's whale (<100 remaining) in Gulf of Mexico through 28,000 sq mi critical habitat designation, vessel speed limits, opposing oil/gas expansion threatening the species with strikes and pollution.

properties.title: The Final Straw Galveston
properties.description: Campaign to eliminate single-use plastic straws in Galveston Island restaurants/bars to protect sea turtles from plastic pollution. Provides resources for businesses to switch to reusable/paper straws. Started March 2020.

properties.title: Oppose Restarting Sable Offshore's Pipeline That Caused Devastating 2015 Oil Spill
properties.description: Campaign opposing Trump admin's use of Defense Production Act to restart failed offshore oil pipeline that spilled 500k gallons across 150 miles of California coast in 2015, bypassing state safety laws

properties.title: Speak Up for Northeast Canyons and Seamounts Marine National Monument
properties.description: Advocacy campaign to protect Northeast Canyons and Seamounts Marine National Monument, a deep-sea ecosystem off New England coast with unique marine biodiversity including sea turtles, whales, and corals.

properties.title: Protect Harbor Porpoises from Atlantic Gillnet Fisheries
properties.description: Advocacy to prevent NMFS deregulation of gillnet twine size from 0.90mm to 0.81mm in Atlantic waters. Aims to reduce harbor porpoise bycatch through stricter regulations, acoustic pingers, and better monitoring. Comment deadline Feb 2.

properties.title: Uphold the Clean Water Act: Protect Our Waters & Wetlands
properties.description: Advocacy campaign opposing EPA's proposed WOTUS rule weakening Clean Water Act protections for streams and wetlands. Focuses on preventing pollution in watersheds affecting coastal areas like Galveston. Public comment period through Jan 2026.

properties.title: Uphold the Legacy of the Marine Mammal Protection Act
properties.description: Advocacy campaign opposing Congressional bill weakening Marine Mammal Protection Act. Protects whales, dolphins, seals from industrial impacts, offshore drilling. Maintains healthy populations vs survival standard.

properties.title: Prevent Deep-Sea Mining Near the Mariana Trench Marine National Monument
properties.description: Campaign to prevent deep-sea mining near Mariana Trench Marine National Monument, protecting unique seamount ecosystems and marine biodiversity in the Pacific Ocean's deepest waters.

properties.title: Protect Marine National Monuments from Commercial Fishing
properties.description: Campaign opposing Executive Order 14276 that threatens to open U.S. marine national monuments to commercial fishing. Advocates for ocean protection from industrial fishing gear that harms sea turtles, whales, and marine ecosystems through bycatch.

properties.title: Deep-Sea Mining: Stop the Race to the Bottom
properties.description: Campaign opposing NOAA rule allowing simultaneous deep seabed exploration and mining permits. Advocates for moratorium to protect fragile deep-sea ecosystems from irreversible harm caused by mining operations.

properties.title: A Call to the Sea - Art & Science Residency
properties.description: Art-science residency at Vasco da Gama Aquarium, Lisbon, exploring more-than-human geographies, multispecies narratives, water intelligence. 3-month projects Jul-Dec 2024, €10k funding, access to marine sites, Tagus estuary.

properties.title: Ressonâncias
properties.description: Sound art project exploring aquatic ecosystems through sonic practices with migrant students in Esposende. Combines field recording, composition, and ecological materialities to amplify aquatic environments and their social manifestations.

properties.title: Mare Liberum
properties.description: Youth sailing program on replica caravel Vera Cruz combining navigation with creative workshops (writing, photography, cinema, theater) exploring themes of sea, horizon & freedom. Lisboa/Oeiras 2019-2022, 74 youth participants.

properties.title: Gulbenkian Carbono Azul
properties.description: Maps & characterizes blue carbon ecosystems (seagrass, salt marshes, kelp forests) across Portugal to enable conservation/restoration investments. Pioneers voluntary blue carbon market, starting with pilot project to offset foundation's 2021 emission

properties.title: Blue Bio Value
properties.description: Accelerator for marine bioeconomy startups using ocean resources sustainably. Addresses food security, climate change, aging population, resource scarcity. Aims to make Portugal a global leader in marine biotechnology.
properties.funder: Fundação Calouste Gulbenkian e Fundação Oceano Azul

properties.title: 5 Gyres Institute - Marine Plastic Pollution Research
properties.description: Research on ocean plastic pollution sources including microfibers, textiles, fishing gear. Studies microplastic contamination in oceans, coastal zones. Tests alternatives, nature-based solutions like floating wetlands. Global scope, ongoing.

properties.title: Do Less for the Planet - Textile Microfiber Pollution Reduction
properties.description: Campaign to reduce marine microplastic pollution from textiles through lifestyle changes: buying less fast fashion, washing clothes less frequently, and repairing garments. Textiles are the largest source of marine microfibers.

properties.title: 5 Gyres Institute Advocacy for Microplastic Pollution Policy
properties.description: Leading microplastic pollution research org drives policy to reduce plastic harm. Campaigns include #MicroplasticFreeUS & #PlasticFreeParks. Passed Microbead-Free Waters Act 2015, CA foodware laws. Ongoing since 2015.

properties.title: Plastic Smog: 40-Year Ocean Plastic Pollution Trend Analysis
properties.description: Analysis of 10,000+ ocean samples showing plastic particle trends from 1970s-present. Post-2005 data reveals skyrocketing plastic levels correlating with shift from binding maritime laws to voluntary policies.

properties.title: Trash Academy
properties.description: Virtual educational series in English/Spanish on plastic pollution. Covers plastic origins, environmental harm, solutions, and industry sectors using plastic. Integrates education, advocacy, and community science.

properties.title: 5 Gyres Ambassador Network - Global Plastic Pollution Action
properties.description: Global network of 1,952 ambassadors across 95 countries combating plastic pollution through science, advocacy, and TrashBlitz cleanups. Includes Action Fund supporting marine conservation research and community mobilization.

properties.title: Strengthening Marine Enforcement in the Eastern Tropical Pacific Seascape
properties.description: Launched 2024 to combat IUU fishing across Ecuador, Costa Rica, Colombia, Panama. Enhances monitoring, surveillance, regional cooperation. Protects biodiversity hotspots including 4 UNESCO sites. Benefits 15,000+ coastal residents.

properties.title: Protecting marine biodiversity and coastal communities in the Philippines
properties.description: Strengthening fisheries law enforcement in Coral Triangle through 16 community patrol teams, 3 patrol boats delivered Oct 2024. Partners: Rare, Canada, local governments. Combats IUU fishing, supports 1.9M fishers.

properties.title: Microfibers & Textiles Research and Solutions
properties.description: 5 Gyres addresses microfiber pollution from synthetic clothing through scientific research, expeditions, symposiums, and policy advocacy. Focuses on filtration solutions and industry supply chain strategies to reduce microfibers in oceans.

properties.title: Pemba Channel Conservation Area Protection
properties.description: Protecting Pemba Channel's diverse coral reefs & endangered species. WildAid Marine partners with local communities since 2019, providing patrol boats & training to combat illegal fishing in 1,200 km2 protected area.

properties.title: Galapagos Marine Reserve Protection
properties.description: Protecting 51,000 sq mi reserve off Ecuador since 2002. Combating illegal fishing of sharks & sea cucumbers through enforcement, VMS/AIS monitoring, ranger training, & Navy partnerships. Now world's densest shark population.

properties.title: Arctic Ocean Conservation
properties.description: Protecting Arctic Ocean biodiversity through science-based advocacy. Opposing offshore oil drilling, regulating shipping, establishing marine protected areas. Addressing climate change impacts on wildlife and Indigenous communities.

properties.title: Coastal Ecuador Marine Conservation
properties.description: Protecting 19 coastal MPAs & mangrove concessions in Ecuador since 2015. Strengthening enforcement, training rangers, equipping patrols to protect sea turtles, mantas, sharks & support 87k artisanal fishers.

properties.title: Protecting Africa's Last Eden - Gabon Marine Conservation
properties.description: WildAid partners with DGPA since 2022 to combat illegal fishing in Gabon's 200,000 km2 EEZ. Provides patrol vessels, surveillance equipment, training for fisheries inspectors to protect leatherback turtles, dolphins, whales.

properties.title: Better Alternatives 3.0: Bioplastics Environmental Degradation Study
properties.description: 64-week study testing 22 bioplastic items across marine & terrestrial environments in FL, CA, ME. Found environment, thickness, polymer type affect degradation. Aims to provide transparency on bioplastic alternatives to single-use plastics.

properties.title: Bahamas Marine Protection System
properties.description: Partnership to combat IUU fishing in Bahamas' EEZ. Developing comprehensive Marine Protection System Plan for 630,000 km2 sanctuary protecting 40+ shark species, lobster, conch fisheries. Started 2018 with TNC & govt agencies.

properties.title: Protecting the Yucatan Peninsula's Sustainable Fisheries
properties.description: WildAid & Impact Blue support fishing federations in Yucatan Peninsula to transition to sustainable lobster & octopus fisheries. Provides enforcement equipment, training, patrol strategy. Started Nov 2020, working with 3 federations.

properties.title: 5 Gyres Research Expeditions - Global Plastic Pollution Investigation
properties.description: 19 research expeditions across 50,000 nautical miles investigating plastic pollution in ocean gyres. Citizen science trawls, microplastic sampling, marine mammal health studies. Global coverage: Arctic, Atlantic, Pacific, Galapagos, Belize.

properties.title: Protecting Palau's Coral Reefs, One of the Seven Underwater Wonders of the World
properties.description: Strengthening enforcement for 29 MPAs in Palau since 2014. Training rangers, providing patrol equipment, developing Marine Protection System plans. Protecting 500+ coral species, 1,300 reef fish species in Coral Triangle waters.

properties.title: Greywater from Passenger Vessels in Alaska
properties.description: Reviews greywater contents, volumes & management from passenger vessels in Alaska. Analyzes 19 years of ADEC sampling data to improve greywater management practices in Alaska & internationally.

properties.title: How Do Oil Spills Effect the Arctic?
properties.description: Ocean Conservancy partnered with Dr. Suprenand to model oil spill impacts in Beaufort Sea Arctic ecosystem, evaluating effects on polar bears, seals, fish, and indigenous communities from platform, pipeline, and vessel spills.

properties.title: Plastic Free Cities
properties.description: Youth-led program engaging students, businesses & local governments to eliminate single-use plastics in Florida. 240+ students trained, 100+ businesses engaged, preventing 1.2M+ plastic items annually in Miami-Dade, expanding to Orlando & Tampa Bay.

properties.title: Navigating the North: An Assessment of the Environmental Risks of Arctic Vessel Traffic
properties.description: Assessment of Arctic vessel traffic environmental risks: oil spills, air emissions, invasive species, marine mammal disturbance, sewage discharge. Provides recommendations for Arctic marine protection.

properties.title: Protecting Central Arctic Ocean
properties.description: International accord bans commercial fishing in 1.1M sq mi Central Arctic Ocean for 16+ years while scientists research marine life impacts from climate change. 10 parties signed Oct 2018.

properties.title: Healthy Fisheries - Magnuson-Stevens Act Implementation
properties.description: US fishery management via MSA (1976-present). Eight regional councils govern federal waters (3-200 nautical miles offshore). Reduced overfishing to all-time low through science-based management and diverse stakeholder input.

properties.title: Sea Level Rise in Florida
properties.description: Protecting Florida's 1,350-mile coastline from 3-8 ft sea level rise by 2100. Restoring coastal ecosystems as nature-based solutions. Supporting 7.4M residents within 6 ft of sea level through habitat conservation.

properties.title: Ensuring the magic of Florida's coasts lasts forever
properties.description: Comprehensive conservation addressing harmful algal blooms, pollution, sea level rise, coral disease, and seagrass loss across Florida's coasts through policy advocacy, community engagement, and beach cleanups. Ongoing statewide effort.

properties.title: Central Arctic Ocean Sea Ice Protection
properties.description: Protecting Central Arctic Ocean from fishing, shipping & deep-sea mining as ice melts. 10 countries agreed to ban commercial fishing until 2037. Monitoring dramatic ice loss: thickness down 52%, 20% now open water in summer.

properties.title: Restoring the Gulf of Mexico's Red Snapper Fishery
properties.description: Rebuilding Gulf red snapper from 2% historic biomass through 27-year recovery plan to 2032. Addresses overfishing challenges, supports sustainable fisheries management for fishermen and communities in Gulf of Mexico region.

properties.title: e-Navigation in Arctic Waters: Enhancing Safe and Environmentally Sound Maritime Operations
properties.description: Advancing navigation & communication tech to enhance shipping safety & environmental protection in U.S. Arctic waters. Partnership with Marine Exchange of Alaska using real-time GPS, AIS & e-charting.

properties.title: The Arctic Ahead
properties.description: Addressing rapid Arctic environmental changes: rising temps, ocean acidification, diminishing sea ice, thawing permafrost, coastal erosion. Protecting Arctic wildlife & peoples from unprecedented climate impacts in U.S. Arctic.

properties.title: Global Ghost Gear Initiative
properties.description: Global alliance combating abandoned fishing gear (ghost gear) through removal, prevention, policy development, and stakeholder collaboration. Active worldwide since 2015, hosted by Ocean Conservancy since 2019.

properties.title: Arctic Corporate Shipping Pledge
properties.description: Voluntary pledge by companies to avoid Arctic shipping routes to protect rapidly melting sea ice and ecosystems. Promotes precautionary practices including heavy fuel oil bans and pollution controls.

properties.title: Healthy Fisheries
properties.description: Why: Sustain fish populations for ecosystems, food security & economy. What: Science-based fishery management across US waters. How: Policy advocacy, data collection, POSEIDON AI tool. Where: US coasts, Gulf of Mexico, Pacific. When: 25+ years ongoin

properties.title: Ocean to Everglades (O2E) Initiative - Super Bowl LIV Miami Partnership
properties.description: Partnership with Miami Super Bowl Host Committee (Feb 2019-Feb 2020) to reduce ocean plastic and promote sustainability. Removed 54 tons of waste from Florida coasts through cleanups, reduced plastics at Hard Rock Stadium, featured sustainable seafoo
properties.funder: Miami Super Bowl Host Committee, Pepsi, NFL Green

properties.title: North American Net Collection Initiative (NANCI)
properties.description: First transboundary initiative addressing ghost fishing gear in Mexico, US & Canada waters. Removes abandoned nets, creates predictive hotspot maps, recycles 14+ tons into products, trains 800+ fishers across 17 Mexican states.

properties.title: 100% Clean Ocean Energy by 2050
properties.description: Transition from fossil fuels to responsible clean ocean energy through offshore wind, wave/tidal energy. Focuses on responsible planning, ending oil/gas leases, marine-safe development, policy reform. By 2050 target.

properties.title: Considering Deep-Sea Source Minerals and Rare Elements
properties.description: Reviews climate implications of deep-sea mining for critical minerals. Identifies knowledge gaps in environmental risks, ocean carbon storage, biodiversity impacts. Concludes mining should not proceed until uncertainties resolved.

properties.title: Decarbonizing Shipping
properties.description: Reducing shipping emissions globally. Shipping emits 1B tons CO2/year (3% global GHGs). Solutions: IMO emissions plan targeting 50-100% reduction by 2050, slow steaming, fossil fuel elimination. US leadership to set international standards.

properties.title: Climate-Smart Marine Protected Areas for Mitigation and Adaptation Policy
properties.description: Policy brief on MPAs for climate mitigation/adaptation. Reviews carbon sequestration, ecosystem resilience, biodiversity preservation. Guides policymakers on climate-smart MPA design. Global ocean-climate policy.

properties.title: Ocean-Based Climate Solutions
properties.description: Global initiative promoting ocean solutions for climate: offshore wind, clean marine transport, blue carbon wetlands protection. Targets 1/5 of GHG cuts by 2050. Includes UK offshore wind, Marshall Islands shipping proposals, Costa Rica wetlands.

properties.title: Ocean Carbon Dioxide Removal Research
properties.description: Research program studying ocean CDR techniques to remove atmospheric CO2 via biological, physical & geochemical processes. Develops code of conduct, assesses effectiveness & biodiversity impacts. Global ocean focus.

properties.title: Ocean-Climate Guide to Action
properties.description: Guide for countries to include ocean-based climate mitigation & adaptation in Paris Agreement plans. Addresses ocean's role in fighting climate change through economic activities worth $1T+ annually.

properties.title: Models for Ocean-Climate Action Along the Pacific Coast of North America
properties.description: Pacific Coast Collaborative (WA, CA, OR, BC) shares climate mitigation/adaptation policies addressing local ocean impacts. Aims to guide others via documented experience and best practices.

properties.title: Action Plan for Blue-Green Shipping Investment in the Pacific
properties.description: Decarbonize Pacific shipping/ports via clean fuels, renewable energy, climate-ready infrastructure. 4 pillars: finance clean ships, develop port renewables, build resilient ports, foster connectivity. Targets midcentury zero emissions.
properties.funder: Ocean Conservancy, Bank of the West

properties.title: Blueprint for International Ocean-Climate Action
properties.description: Global framework addressing ocean-climate linkages through marine protected areas, blue carbon restoration, and policy recommendations. Targets governments and stakeholders at international summits for holistic ocean-climate solutions.

properties.title: Ocean-Climate Actions to Support the Biden-Harris Decarbonization Plan
properties.description: Ocean-based climate solutions for US decarbonization: offshore renewables, shipping emissions cuts. Targets 6-21% global emissions reductions to limit warming to 1.5°C. Focus on first 100 days.

properties.title: Overlooked Ocean Strategies to Address Climate Change
properties.description: Advocates for ocean integration in Paris Agreement climate plans via 4 strategies: sustainable ocean mitigation, CO2 reduction for acidification, ocean-based mitigation research, and ocean adaptation.

properties.title: All Aboard: How the Biden-Harris Administration Can Help Ships Kick Fossil Fuels
properties.description: Policy report by Ocean Conservancy & Pacific Environment on eliminating shipping industry greenhouse gas emissions. Recommends US set emissions reduction timeline before 2050 to combat climate change from 50,000+ ocean vessels.

properties.title: Future Maritime Fuels USA
properties.description: Transitioning US shipping from fossil fuels to scalable zero emission fuels (SZEF) to meet Paris Agreement goals. Report analyzes energy sources, propulsion tech, and pathways for maritime decarbonization this decade.

properties.title: Analysis of Liquefied Natural Gas as a Marine Fuel in the United States
properties.description: Research analyzing LNG marine fuel risks for shipping emissions. Examines policies, engine tech, vessel fleets, health impacts. Concludes LNG not climate solution due to methane potency. Published 2024.

properties.title: State Climate Action - Ocean Climate Solutions
properties.description: State-level ocean climate solutions for mitigation & adaptation. Integrates climate planning into coastal management, builds coalitions, shares best practices across jurisdictions for emissions reduction & resilience.

properties.title: Ocean-Based Climate Solutions in Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)
properties.description: Tracks ocean-based climate actions in Paris Agreement NDCs. 93 of 100 coastal countries include ocean elements. Monitors blue carbon ecosystems & marine solutions in national climate goals updated every 5 years since 2023.

properties.title: Zero-Carbon Shipping North America
properties.description: Explores zero-carbon electrofuels (green hydrogen, ammonia) adoption at 5 major west coast ports. Aims to transition maritime shipping to emission-free future through renewable-powered fuels and port investments.

properties.title: Green Shipping Corridors
properties.description: Maritime routes testing zero-emission fuels/tech to decarbonize shipping by 2040. Aims for 5% zero-emission fuels by 2030 to meet Paris Agreement goals. Addresses shipping's 1+ gigatonne annual CO2 emissions.

properties.title: Propelling investment in South and Central America with hydrogen-based shipping fuels
properties.description: Report identifies ports in Central & South America ready to develop green electrofuels from renewable energy to enable zero-carbon maritime shipping. Published 2020 by Ocean Conservancy to accelerate low-carbon fuel adoption.

properties.title: Gulf of Mexico Alliance
properties.description: Regional partnership of 5 Gulf states addressing ocean-climate challenges through Priority Issue Teams. Tackles water quality, HABs, microplastics via Gulf Star Program funding. Established 2004, Gulf Coast region.
properties.funder: Gulf Star Program (public-private partnership), NOAA, EPA

properties.title: Maritime Fleet USA Decarbonisation
properties.description: US shipping fleet decarbonisation via zero-emission fuels & energy efficiency to meet Paris Agreement targets. Data-driven approach identifies opportunities across US coastal regions for maritime climate action.

properties.title: Ocean-Based Climate Solutions Act
properties.description: First comprehensive U.S. bill on ocean-climate action. Reduces shipping emissions, supports offshore wind, protects 30% ocean waters by 2030, creates climate-ready fisheries, funds living shorelines, addresses acidification.

properties.title: Transitioning the Shipping Industry to Green Hydrogen
properties.description: Why: Eliminate shipping emissions by 2050. What: Green hydrogen fuel transition. How: Renewable energy electrolysis, green shipping corridors, US govt support. When: 2022-2050. Where: US ports & international routes.

properties.title: Action Agenda for a Blue-Green Future
properties.description: Federal ocean-climate policy recommendations addressing greenhouse gas pollution threats. Focuses on blue carbon, offshore renewables, MPAs, fisheries, reducing shipping emissions. Targets midcentury decarbonization.

properties.title: Ocean-Climate Actions to Support the Biden-Harris Plan to Build Back Better
properties.description: Ocean-based climate solutions for Biden-Harris first 100 days addressing coastal flooding, ocean acidification, water quality, fisheries & ecosystem loss to build physical, economic, social & ecological resilience

properties.title: Opportunities for Ocean-Climate Action in the American Jobs Plan
properties.description: Policy advocacy urging US federal investment in ocean-climate solutions, clean energy tech, and coastal community adaptation through the American Jobs Plan to reduce emissions and address climate inequities.

properties.title: Plastic Everywhere Except One Place: Climate Commitments
properties.description: Ocean Conservancy examined 28 companies, 12 investors, and 15 climate frameworks to address gaps in plastic-climate commitments. Develops 10 First Principles to incorporate plastics into climate goals.

properties.title: Principles of a Blue-Green Recovery
properties.description: Climate-smart economic recovery leveraging ocean solutions for job creation, climate mitigation & adaptation. Targets US stimulus legislation to protect economy long-term while benefiting frontline communities.

properties.title: California's Ocean-Climate Contribution
properties.description: California's ocean-climate contribution supporting Paris Agreement at COP24. Addresses climate mitigation and adaptation strategies for ocean resilience, submitted as part of Nationally Determined Contributions framework.

properties.title: Fibers to Filters: A Toolkit for Microfiber Solutions
properties.description: Addresses microplastic pollution from washing clothes through microfiber filtration in washing machines. Coauthored by Ocean Conservancy, 5 Gyres Institute, and The Nature Conservancy to prevent microfibers entering oceans.
properties.funder: Ocean Conservancy, The 5 Gyres Institute, The Nature Conservancy

properties.title: Ocean-Based Solutions Contribute to Net Zero - Global Climate Summit
properties.description: Why: Address climate crisis through ocean solutions. What: Global commitments on offshore wind, zero-emission shipping, 30% ocean protection, blue carbon. How: MPAs, renewable energy, habitat restoration. When: April 2021. Where: Global
properties.funder: Ocean Conservancy, UN Foundation, Friends of Ocean and Climate

properties.title: Federal Actions to Deliver on America's Offshore Wind Potential
properties.description: Policy recommendations to scale US offshore wind 700x by 2030, preventing 78M metric tons CO2 emissions. Addresses regulatory challenges via BOEM, NOAA, USCG coordination to achieve climate goals with minimal ecosystem impact.

properties.title: International Coastal Cleanup®
properties.description: Global volunteer program removing trash from beaches/waterways. 19M+ volunteers collected 400M+ lbs since 1986. Uses Clean Swell app to track debris data. Ongoing cleanups worldwide to combat plastic pollution.

properties.title: Elements of a Blue-Green Foreign Policy
properties.description: US ocean-climate diplomacy integrating marine issues into global climate action: Paris Agreement, emissions targets, shipping decarbonization, marine protected areas, offshore renewables. Policy brief for Administration.

properties.title: Plastics Policy Solutions for Ocean Conservation
properties.description: Advancing evidence-based policies to reduce plastic pollution at source. Focuses on eliminating single-use packaging, microplastics through EPR, state legislation, filters for microfibers. Ongoing US-wide advocacy.

properties.title: Ocean Acidification: Confronting our ocean's changing chemistry
properties.description: Why: CO2 pollution acidifies oceans, threatening marine life. What: Research & advocacy to protect shellfish, coral, fisheries. How: Collaborate with communities, scientists, policymakers. Where: US coasts (Chesapeake, West Coast, Florida)

properties.title: Collective Currents: Global Solutions to End Ocean Plastics
properties.description: Global initiative tackling ocean plastic pollution through zero waste systems, extended producer responsibility policies, and strategic cleanup. Provides roadmap for communities, governments, companies to end plastic pollution worldwide.

properties.title: Tackling Plastic Pollution Through Producer Accountability
properties.description: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) policy toolkit holding plastic producers financially accountable for product lifecycle. Requires reduction of single-use plastics, redesign for reusability, investment in recycling infrastructure across US state

properties.title: Modeling Wildlife Mortality Risk From Ingested Plastics
properties.description: Quantifies marine wildlife death risk from macroplastic ingestion using 10,000+ necropsy datapoints. Models mortality likelihood for sea turtles, seabirds, mammals. Published PNAS Nov 2025. Includes Wildlife Impact Calculator tool.

properties.title: Working towards a legally binding instrument to end plastic pollution
properties.description: UN-led global treaty negotiations (INC-5.2, Aug 2025, Geneva) to create legally binding agreement addressing plastic pollution lifecycle: source reduction, ghost gear, microplastics, circular design, waste collector inclusion

properties.title: Pandemic Pollution: The Rising Tide of Plastic PPE
properties.description: Volunteers removed 107,219 PPE items from beaches/waterways in late 2020. Tracks COVID-19 pandemic's impact on plastic pollution via Clean Swell app. Provides recommendations for responsible PPE waste management.

properties.title: Ocean Plastics Research Program
properties.description: Why: Plastic pollution threatens 1,300+ marine species. What: Research on wildlife impacts, human exposure, pollution prevention. How: Risk assessments, monitoring protocols, tracking trash movement. Where: Global, North America rivers, American Samo

properties.title: Indonesia Longline Tuna Swordfish Fishery: Enhancing Observer Monitoring
properties.description: Training onboard observers to monitor 364 longline vessels in Indonesia's Indian Ocean EEZ. Improves data on bycatch, ETP species interactions, aligns with IOTC regulations and MSC standards for sustainable tuna fishery.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Transition Assistance Fund

properties.title: What the Foam - National Plastic Foam Ban Campaign
properties.description: Campaign to ban single-use plastic foam foodware nationally. Foam containers ranked 7th most collected item in 2022 coastal cleanups. Advocates for Congressional action to eliminate non-recyclable foam polluting beaches and waste streams.

properties.title: Western and Central Pacific Ocean Tuna: Handling Sharks and Rays
properties.description: Evaluating post-release survival of shark/ray bycatch in WCPO tuna fisheries. Tagging 30 specimens, training fishers in handling techniques, analyzing mortality data to develop improved release guidelines for regional application.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Science and Research Fund

properties.title: South African Hake: Trialling Technologies for Improved Environmental Performance
properties.description: SA hake trawl fishery trials tech to meet MSC v3.1: recycling nets via micro-pods, electronic monitoring for bird scaring lines, AI video analysis for bycatch. Aims: reduce ghost gear, verify seabird protection, automate species ID.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Science and Research Fund

properties.title: South Atlantic Albacore Tuna Harvest Strategy Project
properties.description: Five S Atlantic albacore fisheries develop science-based harvest strategy via MSE framework. Ensures long-term tuna stock sustainability, ICCAT compliance. 24-month roadmap: data analysis, workshops, performance testing.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Science and Research Fund

properties.title: Mexican North Pacific brown shrimp 2025
properties.description: Brown shrimp fishery in Baja California improving stock assessment, harvest strategy, trawling impact monitoring, and stakeholder awareness to reach MSC certification by 2027. April 2025 start.

properties.title: Adapting Management Iberian Sardine Stocks
properties.description: Ecosystem-based management for Iberian sardine fishery. Assessing predator consumption impact, developing robust harvest control rules. PhD research integrating ecosystem considerations into stock management for Atlantic sustainability.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund, Carrefour Italy, Delicius

properties.title: Improving Sustainability and Management Gulf of California Hake
properties.description: Gulf of California hake trawl fishery developing robust harvest strategy & control rules for MSC certification by 2026. Aims to be first certified industrial trawl fishery in region, improving stock management & ETP species protection.

properties.title: Namibia Hake: Targeted Acoustic Startle Technology for Cape Fur Seals
properties.description: Testing acoustic startle tech to deter Cape fur seals from hake trawls/longlines in Namibia. Uses low-frequency sound triggering brainstem response without hearing damage. Starts April 2025.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Science and Research Fund

properties.title: Chile Demersal Crustacean Harvest Control Rules
properties.description: Evaluating management strategies for MSC certified Chilean squat lobster and nylon shrimp fisheries. Developing stock assessment models and testing harvest control rules to prevent overfishing along south-central Chile coast.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Science & Research Fund

properties.title: Plastic Free Beaches
properties.description: Global initiative using 35+ years of International Coastal Cleanup data to reduce ocean plastics through banning polluting items, redesigning products, and revamping recycling. Targets 11M metric tons/year entering oceans.

properties.title: Age-structured production model harvest control rules New Zealand orange roughy 2024
properties.description: Developing age-structure models & harvest control rules for orange roughy sustainability. Collating 1990s-2010s data on fish age/size to inform catch limits & ensure stock replenishment in Chatham Rise deepwater fishery.

properties.title: California Market Squid: Improving Understanding of Populations
properties.description: Study squid hatchlings to assess population dynamics, validate harvest control rules, and monitor ETP species interactions. Digital e-logs improve data collection for sustainable management of this short-lived species.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Science and Research Fund

properties.title: Tropical Tuna Purse Seine Fisheries Shark Bycatch Project
properties.description: French tuna fisheries deploy shark enumerators to correct bias in bycatch estimates. Compares observer vs enumerator counts across Indian & Atlantic Oceans to improve IRD protocols & shark conservation.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Science and Research Fund

properties.title: Indonesia Central Java prawn environmental DNA project
properties.description: eDNA metabarcoding assesses bycatch species diversity in Central Java prawn fishery. Identifies IUCN status & abundance to develop action plan minimizing ecosystem impacts toward MSC certification by 2026.

properties.title: Aegean Longline Tuna & Swordfish: Minimising Interactions with Endangered Species
properties.description: Research to reduce bycatch of endangered species in Aegean Sea longline fisheries. Literature review of mitigation tech, consultation with fishers, testing bycatch reduction devices. Starts April 2025.

properties.title: Improving Fishery Knowledge Nicaragua Spiny Lobster
properties.description: Census of Nicaragua Caribbean spiny lobster trap fishery to improve data on fishing effort, catch data for stock assessments, and develop Harvest Control Rules. Targets artisanal fleet in Corn Islands, Bluefields area.

properties.title: Improvements in practices and governance North Peru eel trap 2024
properties.description: North Peru eel trap fishery strengthens monitoring via logbooks, improves eel population understanding, develops harvest control rules, and enhances fisheries management to work toward MSC certification by early 2025.

properties.title: Indonesia Central Java size and genetics project
properties.description: Research on white prawn size & genetics in Wedung to assess stock health. Collects morphometric data, genetic connectivity samples along fishing routes. Informs sustainable management strategy for prawn fishery.

properties.title: Continued Research Sustainability of Deep-Sea Shrimp Kerala India
properties.description: Kerala deep-sea shrimp trawl fishery developing harvest strategy, reducing bycatch via square mesh nets, protecting ETP species in Arabian Sea. Aims for MSC certification 2025. Targets 3 shrimp species for US/EU export.

properties.title: Reducing sawfish and sea snake bycatch in the Australia Northern Prawn fishery
properties.description: Study analyzing 2012-2022 bycatch data to identify sawfish interaction patterns by vessel, gear, location & season. Designs mitigation trials testing gear modifications & underwater lights. Evaluates sea snake escape hatches added 2020.

properties.title: Tagging silky sharks to identify post-release survival rates
properties.description: Electronic tagging of silky sharks in Eastern Pacific tuna fishery to monitor 60-day survival rates post-release, analyze stress markers, and develop improved handling practices to reduce bycatch mortality in purse seine operations.

properties.title: Knowledge sharing to reduce dolphin interactions in Australia-UK sardine fisheries
properties.description: South Australian and Cornish sardine fishery managers share bycatch mitigation strategies through workshops and fishing trips, focusing on marine mammal detection, deterrence, and release techniques in purse seine operations.

properties.title: Improving brown pelican population estimates Mexico Pacific sardine fishery
properties.description: Research on brown pelican populations at Isla Todos Santos, Baja California to assess sardine fishery bycatch impacts. Field surveys measure breeding success, survival rates. Modeling analyzes population trends vs environmental/fishing mortality.

properties.title: Seabird bycatch reduction Greenland lumpfish fishery
properties.description: Testing LED lights on gillnets and fishing season delays to reduce seabird bycatch in Greenland lumpfish fishery. Focuses on common eider, long-tailed duck protection. Studies migration-spawning overlap. April 2023 start.

properties.title: Training observers minimising sardine fishery impacts Mexican Pacific biodiversity hotspot
properties.description: Training onboard observers to monitor bycatch, ETP species interactions in Pacific sardine fishery off Baja California. Data collection informs management strategy to minimize environmental impacts on biodiversity hotspot.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Transition Assistance Fund

properties.title: Kerala Deep-Sea Shrimp Trawl Bycatch Reduction Devices
properties.description: PhD research verifying cod-end mesh devices reduce bycatch & emissions in Kerala shrimp trawl fishery. Testing gear efficacy, documenting biodiversity, measuring fuel savings in Arabian Sea. Supports MSC certification pathway.

properties.title: Improving data on seabird interactions in Alaskan salmon fishery
properties.description: Alaska salmon fishery trials SkipperScience app for fishers to record endangered murrelet bycatch, identify hotspots, develop mitigation methods. Indigenous Sentinel Network expansion supports data collection from remote locations.

properties.title: Predicting Silky Shark Hotspots to Mitigate Bycatch in Papua New Guinea
properties.description: Statistical model predicts silky shark hotspots in PNG purse seine tuna fishery. Assesses area/time-based management to reduce vulnerable shark bycatch. Replicable approach for other Pacific tuna fisheries. Started April 2023.

properties.title: Genetic testing to identify octopus species Madagascar
properties.description: DNA barcoding of 100+ octopus samples from SW Madagascar fishery to identify species composition, enable accurate stock assessments, and improve sustainable management for coastal communities dependent on octopus fishing.

properties.title: Identifying distinct squid populations in Indonesia
properties.description: Genetic analysis of Indian squid in Malacca Strait to identify distinct populations, enabling better stock management and harvest strategies for sustainable fishery development in North Sumatra.

properties.title: Reducing turtle bycatch in Réunion longline swordfish fishery
properties.description: Training Réunion Island swordfish fishers to identify, handle and release turtle bycatch, especially vulnerable loggerheads. Using environmental data to minimize bycatch. Collaboration with scientists to improve survival rates.

properties.title: Managing Skate Bycatch Australian Toothfish Fishery
properties.description: Monitoring sandpaper skate post-release survival in Heard Island toothfish fishery via satellite tagging and blood stress markers to improve bycatch management in southern Indian Ocean.

properties.title: Improving scientific knowledge Mexico barred sand bass student research 2024
properties.description: PhD research on barred sand bass stocks in Baja California to create age-structure models, establish stock assessments, and inform harvest strategies for sustainable fishery management and MSC certification by 2026.

properties.title: Suriname: Smartphone technology to understand ETP species
properties.description: Corvina/acoupa weakfish trawl fishery uses smartphone app to collect geo-tagged images of endangered species, building database to develop management strategies minimizing bycatch interactions in Western Atlantic waters off Suriname.

properties.title: Improving management of squid North Sumatra 2023
properties.description: Research analyzing 100+ squid samples in North Sumatra to understand population dynamics and reproductive capacity, developing sustainable stock management strategies to prevent overfishing of mitre squid (Uroteuthis chinensis).

properties.title: Monitoring Crab Baits and Ecosystem Effects Mexican Yucatan Octopus Fishery
properties.description: Monitors octopus catch & crab bait species in Yucatán fishery. Uses genetic testing to prevent endangered species use. Develops sustainable bait strategy. Supports 15,000+ jobs. Started April 2024.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Transition Assistance Fund

properties.title: Identifying how environmental factors impact the abundance and distribution of deep-water Cape hake
properties.description: PhD research analyzing 2003-2019 survey data on Cape hake distribution vs temperature, salinity, oxygen. Compares with monkfish, kingklip. Supports SA-Namibia joint stock management in Benguela region.

properties.title: Investigating interactions of South African longline fisheries with orcas and Cape fur seals
properties.description: Student research analyzing 20 years of observer data to quantify orca and seal depredation rates in hake longline fishery, informing management decisions to minimize marine mammal interactions and improve stock assessments.

properties.title: Mexican Barred Sand Bass Cooperatives Project 2024
properties.description: Artisanal barred sand bass fishery in Baja California developing harvest strategy, stock assessment, and management framework to achieve MSC certification by 2026. Implements monitoring systems and harvest control rules.

properties.title: Safeguarding Future India Shrimp and Squid Fisheries
properties.description: Developing management strategy evaluation framework for Kerala trawl fishery targeting shrimp and cephalopods to achieve MSC certification by 2024, ensuring sustainable stock management.

properties.title: Further improvements Mexico red rock lobster fishery 2023
properties.description: Baja California red rock lobster fishery transitioning to MSC certification. Improving stock assessments, harvest protocols, ETP monitoring, habitat impact studies. Strengthening community surveillance and management for 2025 assessment.

properties.title: Innovative DNA methods to age blue swimming crabs in Indonesia
properties.description: DNA methylation testing of blue swimming crabs to determine age structure for sustainable stock management in Madura Island fishery. Supports harvest strategy development and MSC assessment progress.

properties.title: Improving and Promoting Best Practice in Yucatan Octopus Fishery
properties.description: Helps Yucatan octopus fishery monitor catch data, prevent endangered crab use as bait, and develop sustainable practices. Targets red & common octopus supporting 15,000 jobs. Includes genetic testing and ecosystem impact assessment.

properties.title: Minimising Fishing Impacts on Indonesian Squid Stocks
properties.description: Developing fishery management plan for mitre squid in Belawan, Medan. Research spawning areas, harvest strategies to protect stock health. Supporting small-scale fisheries toward MSC certification in Indonesian FMA 571.

properties.title: Climate models to predict crab survival in Indonesian fisheries
properties.description: Develops climate model predicting blue swimming crab survival in Indonesian fisheries. Creates color-coded maps identifying climate impacts on crab life stages to inform fishery management decisions and prevent overfishing.

properties.title: Strengthening Traceability in Kotabaru Shrimp Fishery
properties.description: Improves data collection and traceability for South Kalimantan white/spot prawn fishery. Installs cameras, tracking devices on vessels, registers hundreds of boats. Enables MSC certification by 2026. Started 2022.

properties.title: Mapping Risks to Endangered Species North Sea Wash Brown Shrimp Fishery
properties.description: GIS mapping to assess impacts on endangered species from beam trawl shrimp fishery in North Sea. Literature review & risk assessment to identify ETP species interactions, create mitigation measures for MSC-certified Wash fishery.

properties.title: Testing Novel Seabird Bycatch Mitigation in Iceland Lumpfish Fisheries
properties.description: RSPB & ISF test 'looming-eyes buoy' device in Icelandic lumpfish gillnet fishery to reduce seabird bycatch by 25%, protecting endangered species like black guillemots. Trials funded to develop effective mitigation strategy.

properties.title: Using genetic markers to identify snapper stocks in Makassar Strait
properties.description: PhD research collecting 350+ tissue samples from malabar blood & goldband snapper in Makassar Strait to identify distinct stocks, enabling sustainable management plans for Indonesian snapper fisheries through genetic analysis.

properties.title: Investigating Artificial Bait Use in Australian Tuna Fisheries
properties.description: Research sustainable bait alternatives for Australian Eastern Tuna and Billfish Fishery to replace Argentine shortfin squid. Testing artificial/alternative baits on fishing trips and developing responsible bait sourcing code.

properties.title: Growing Supply of Sustainable Mexican Red Octopus to Meet Demand
properties.description: Research to improve Yucatan red octopus stock assessments using CPUE methodology. Addresses TAC enforcement issues where catches exceed limits by 50%. Monthly sampling and fisher surveys to propose better management strategies.

properties.title: Improving Understanding of Stocks in Mexico Pacific Artisanal Shrimp Fishery
properties.description: Stock assessment for 3 shrimp species in Southern Gulf of California to ensure sustainable fishing levels, monitor ETP species interactions, and study seabed gear impacts. Aims for MSC certification by 2023.
properties.funder: MSC Ocean Stewardship Fund - Transition Assistance Fund

properties.title: Making Kerala's Deep-Sea Shrimp Fishing Sustainable
properties.description: WWF-India supports Kerala deep-sea shrimp fishery toward MSC certification by 2025. Stock assessments, bycatch reduction devices, harvest control rules development. Targets Arabian red shrimp in Kollam Bank using trawl gear.

properties.title: Boosting Gonad Health Mexico Red Sea Urchins
properties.description: Evaluating red sea urchin translocation from low to high kelp areas in Baja California to improve gonad quality while monitoring ecosystem impacts. Divers harvest urchins for Asian export markets.

properties.title: Creating a Fisheries Communication Platform to Enhance Observer Safety
properties.description: Developing one-touch satellite communication platform for at-sea fisheries observers in Alaska. RockSTAR device with open-source software enables 24hr check-ins, SOS alerts, improving observer safety and data collection quality.

properties.title: Safeguarding Indonesian Blue Swimming Crab Fisheries
properties.description: Rebuilding depleted crab stocks in Madura Island fishery through harvest strategy, gear modifications, ghost fishing awareness, ETP species training, and regional management councils. Aims for MSC certification by Dec 2024.

properties.title: Using DNA to identify bycatch species in Java Sea blue swimming crab fishery
properties.description: eDNA techniques identify bycatch species in Java Sea crab fishery. Collected 825 crab samples & seawater from 13 points to assess stock status & distribution of vulnerable crustaceans caught in traps, supporting sustainability assessment.

properties.title: Reducing bycatch of diving birds in Greenland lumpfish gillnets
properties.description: Quantifying and reducing seabird bycatch in West Greenland lumpfish fishery by testing modified gillnets with white mesh. Modified nets reduced bycatch by ~50% but decreased catch by 21%. Protects common eiders while sustaining livelihoods.

properties.title: Empowering Indonesian Shrimp Fishers to Improve Practices
properties.description: Training Central Java banana shrimp fishers in sustainable practices, data collection, habitat protection, and endangered species handling. Builds fisher cooperatives to strengthen community voice and implement improvements toward MSC certification b

properties.title: WWF South Africa and the South African albacore tuna pole and line fishery
properties.description: Supporting SA albacore tuna pole-line fishery to meet MSC standards via harvest control rules, observer monitoring, and ETP species protection. Off Cape Town to Namibian border. Aims to ensure sustainable tuna stock management.

properties.title: Improving the Safety of Fishery Observer Programmes
properties.description: Global review of fishery observer programmes to ensure safe working conditions. Interviews with observers & industry across Pacific, Indian, Atlantic tuna fisheries. Develops safety guidelines for at-sea monitoring.

properties.title: Keep Our Oceans Amazing Campaign
properties.description: Disney contributed $1M to The Nature Conservancy to protect 10 ocean animals and habitats, supporting TNC's goal of protecting 10% of world's oceans by 2030. Linked to Avatar: The Way of Water film.

properties.title: Disney Conservation Fund Helps Sea Turtle Conservancy Protect Florida's Sea Turtles
properties.description: Sea Turtle Conservancy protects sea turtles at Archie Carr National Wildlife Refuge, FL through satellite tracking, education via Tour de Turtles, and community engagement to address threats like pollution and lighting.

properties.title: Tour de Turtles - Sea Turtle Migration Tracking
properties.description: Annual sea turtle migration tracking at Vero Beach using satellite telemetry. Monitors nesting, studies migration patterns, educates public. 20yr program tracked 1.5M hatchlings, 2000 nests/year.

properties.title: Wildlife at Lookout Cay
properties.description: Disney Cruise Line's Bahamas destination protects 100+ bird species, relocated 50 giant barrel sponges, built artificial reefs for 74 fish species, monitors land crabs, preserves 200 plant species via elevated structures on <16% of land.

properties.title: Disney's Moana 2 Ocean Conservation Campaign
properties.description: Disney partners with Pristine Seas and Polynesian Voyaging Society to protect oceans. Supports 29 marine protected areas covering 6.8M km² and traditional wayfinding practices. Campaign launched Nov 2024 for Moana 2 film release.

properties.title: Ocean Oxygen Loss Joint Action
properties.description: Enhances ocean oxygen measurement, data accessibility & monitoring to address oxygen loss impacts on marine ecosystems. Focuses on biogeochemical observations in vulnerable areas affected by climate change & eutrophication.

properties.title: Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation
properties.description: Review report on AMOC state of knowledge, assessing ocean current weakening impacts on ecosystems, climate tipping points, and sea level rise across the Atlantic. Expert synthesis for policymakers.

properties.title: European Marinas Network
properties.description: Network of ~10,000 European marinas as ocean monitoring hubs. Installs low-cost sensors measuring temperature, sea state, dissolved gases, phytoplankton, microplastics. Fills coastal data gaps, supports marine management.

properties.title: JPI Oceans Joint Action on Blue Carbon
properties.description: Knowledge Hub addressing blue carbon gaps in coastal ecosystems (marshes, mangroves, seagrass). Creates carbon stock maps, data platform, and joint research calls across 7 European countries. May 2023-Apr 2027. Led by Ireland.

properties.title: Perry Institute for Marine Science - Bahamian Reef Protection
properties.description: Protecting shrinking Bahamian reefs through study, training, limiting harmful human contact, promoting ecosystem resilience, coral nurseries, and reef rehabilitation in The Caribbean.

properties.title: Tour de Turtles - Sea Turtle Conservation at Disney's Vero Beach Resort
properties.description: Disney & Sea Turtle Conservancy track sea turtle migration via satellite, monitor 2,800+ nests yearly along 5-mile beach. Year-round protection of loggerhead, green & leatherback turtles. Vero Beach, FL since 2008.

properties.title: Ocean Carbon Capacities Knowledge Hub
properties.description: Multi-country initiative measuring ocean CO2 absorption (25% of emissions). Develops European reference materials hub, enhances vessel observations, evaluates surface CO2 monitoring to improve carbon sink data for policymakers.

properties.title: Ecological Aspects of Deep-Sea Mining
properties.description: Assesses long-term impacts of polymetallic nodule mining on deep-sea environment. Three phases (2015-2028) studying seafloor disturbances, monitoring mining robots, informing ISA Mining Code policy with €22.9M funding across 8 countries.

properties.title: Changing Marine Lightscapes
properties.description: Studies ocean darkening from runoff & artificial light at night pollution in European seas. Two projects (ISOLUME, ALANIS) investigate impacts on marine ecosystems, biodiversity & fisheries. Pan-European collaboration across 7 countries.

properties.title: Blue Bioeconomy ERA-NET Cofund (BlueBio)
properties.description: ERA-NET funding 49 projects across Europe to develop sustainable aquatic biomass products, zero-waste fisheries/aquaculture solutions, marine biotechnology, and blue circular economy innovations. Dec 2018-Jun 2026.
properties.funder: European Commission, JPI Oceans, 17 European countries

properties.title: Joint Action Underwater Noise in the Marine Environment
properties.description: Pan-European partnership studying underwater noise impacts on marine life from genes to ecosystems. Five funded projects assess soundscapes, population effects, and cumulative noise impacts across European seas (2019-2026).

properties.title: Science for Good Environmental Status (S4GES)
properties.description: Knowledge Hub coordinating research to assess Good Environmental Status in European marine waters via MSFD. Uses adaptive sampling, satellites, e-DNA, contaminants analysis. Proof-of-concept in Belgium/Netherlands 2022. Ongoing 2019-2027.
properties.funder: JPI Oceans (Belgium, Italy, Malta lead + 8 countries)

properties.title: Knowledge Hub on Sea Level Rise
properties.description: Joint JPI Climate-Oceans effort providing periodic assessments of sea level rise drivers, impacts & policy options for Europe's ocean basins. Phase 1 completed 2024 First Assessment Report; Phase 2 scoping begins 2026.
properties.category: Climate Change and Sea Level Rise

properties.title: Offshore Freshened Groundwater
properties.description: Exploring sub-seafloor freshwater in sediments/rocks near coasts as alternative water source. Interdisciplinary research on technological feasibility, environmental impacts, legal framework. Focus on passive continental margins within 50km of coast.

properties.title: Transdisciplinary Research for Ocean Sustainability
properties.description: 13 international consortia funded €14.25M to develop transdisciplinary solutions for sustainable ocean use and climate mitigation under SDG 14, integrating natural/social sciences with stakeholders globally.
properties.funder: JPI Oceans, Belmont Forum, Future Earth

properties.title: Integrated Assessment of New Pollutants
properties.description: Knowledge Hub network of experts developing methodological improvements for marine chemical status assessment, focusing on chemicals of emerging concern. Published policy paper on integrated assessment approaches.

properties.title: Intercalibration for Water Framework Directive
properties.description: Scientific intercalibration exercise for EU WFD bringing experts to analyze phytoplankton and benthic fauna, ensuring comparable ecological status assessments across European coastal/transitional waters. 9 countries jointly funded 2014-2017.
properties.funder: JPI Oceans (Belgium, Ireland, Netherlands, Norway, Sweden, France, Germany, Denmark, UK)

properties.title: Multi Use of Infrastructure for Monitoring in the North Sea
properties.description: Pilot testing integrated monitoring for MSFD descriptors during International Bottom Trawl Surveys across North Sea. 7 countries tested additional monitoring during IBTS cruises in 2014, assessing costs and limitations.

properties.title: European Marine Sensor Calibration Network
properties.description: Pan-European network establishing calibration standards for marine sensors measuring pH, salinity, fluorescence. Created working group and strategic plan to support marine observatories across Europe.

properties.title: Climate Science for Oceans
properties.description: Joint JPI Oceans-JPI Climate action funding research on ocean-climate interactions to improve climate models and inform adaptation policies. Four projects studying mixed layer dynamics, ocean-atmosphere interactions, and coastal impacts.

properties.title: Cumulative Effects of Human Activities Knowledge Hub
properties.description: Developed guidelines for assessing cumulative effects of human activities on marine environments. Published 2024 Handbook to help European countries implement Marine Strategy Framework Directive and achieve Good Environmental Status.

properties.title: Ecological Aspects of Microplastics
properties.description: Pan-European research studying sources, distribution & impact of microplastics in marine environments. 10 projects across 15 countries analyzing ecotoxicological effects, weathering, nano-particles & reduction concepts. €18.2M funding.

properties.title: Resilient Protected Areas and Parks
properties.description: Coastal Quest manages public-private partnerships to strengthen coastal protected areas and parks, supporting 30x30 targets, climate adaptation, and community access through grants and planning along California coast.

properties.title: MPA Outreach and Education Small Grants Program Round 1
properties.description: Pilot grants to 14 CA MPA regional collaboratives for outreach, education, enforcement & monitoring. Achieved 48 events, 12 workshops, educational materials. Increased stewardship, compliance & citizen science.

properties.title: Coastal 30x30 - Protecting and Restoring Coastal Ecosystems
properties.description: Accelerates coastal nature-based solutions to protect 30% of lands/waters by 2030. Provides grants, technical assistance, webinars for conservation, restoration projects building coastal resilience in vulnerable communities.

properties.title: Resilient California State Parks San Diego Coast District Pilot
properties.description: Sea level rise vulnerability assessments and adaptation pathways for San Diego Coast District state parks. Holistic planning for coastal access, recreation, cultural/natural resources through 2050. Community engagement and toolkit development.
properties.funder: California Ocean Protection Council, California State Coastal Conservancy, philanthropic donors

properties.title: Protecting and Restoring Coastal Ecosystems
properties.description: Global blue carbon initiative protecting/restoring coastal ecosystems for climate solutions. Convenes dialogues, provides technical assistance/funding, builds partnerships with Ocean Protection Council in California.

properties.title: Munition in the Sea Knowledge Hub
properties.description: Multi-national expert group assessing risks from legacy underwater munitions across Europe. Shared practices, technologies, expertise on mapping, remediation, and environmental impacts. Launched information portal in 2024.

properties.title: MPA Outreach and Education Small Grants Program
properties.description: Statewide CA program funding $25k-$100k grants to increase MPA compliance, ocean stewardship, and engagement. Targets fishing communities, underserved groups, and tribes through education and outreach since 2017.
properties.funder: Ocean Protection Council, The Marisla Foundation, Maxwell/Hanrahan Foundation

properties.title: Blue Carbon Collaborative
properties.description: International community advancing blue carbon initiatives through policy integration, partnerships, research, and coastal ecosystem conservation. Focuses on carbon capture in coastal plants/algae for climate mitigation and adaptation.

properties.title: MarTERA - ERA-NET Cofund on Marine Technologies
properties.description: EU-funded ERA-NET coordinating 16 countries to develop marine technologies through 4 transnational calls (2017-2022). Funded 48 projects totaling €69.5M for maritime innovation, monitoring, offshore activities, and Blue Growth.

properties.title: Piloting Tools to Assess State Water Quality Protection Areas
properties.description: Coastal Quest partners with CA Water Resources Control Board to pilot GIS tool assessing Central Coast areas for State Water Quality Protection Area nominations, strengthening water quality enforcement since 2022.
properties.funder: California State Water Resources Control Board

properties.title: SWQPA Assessment Tool
properties.description: ArcGIS database mapping California coastal resources across 6 categories: infrastructure, managed areas, species, habitats, water quality, renewable energy. Tool helps assess State Water Quality Protection Areas.

properties.title: Fish Forever in Mozambique
properties.description: Combating overfishing along Mozambique's 1,500-mile coastline through community-led fisheries management. Small-scale fishers protect biodiversity and restore declining fish stocks using sustainable techniques.

properties.title: Fish Forever in Brazil
properties.description: Sustainable fisheries management in Brazil's northern/northeastern coastal states. Addresses unsustainable fishing, habitat degradation in mangrove forests. Supports small-scale fishers' livelihoods and food security.

properties.title: From Bomber to Protector: A Story of Change in North Sulawesi Indonesia
properties.description: Rare partners with North Sulawesi fishers to end destructive fishing, establish no-take zones, and restore reefs. Former destructive fisher Sofian Gondang now champions Managed Access program, rebuilding livelihoods.

properties.title: Fish Forever in the Mesoamerican Reef
properties.description: Community-based fisheries management across 600 miles of Mesoamerican Reef (Mexico-Honduras). Addresses overfishing through local governance, supporting 2M+ people dependent on reef health for livelihoods and food security.

properties.title: Fish Forever in Indonesia
properties.description: Addresses unsustainable fishing, poor governance, habitat degradation in Indonesian coastal fisheries. Partners with 1,700 communities, 160,000 fishers, local governments to ensure sustainable fisheries and food security.

properties.title: Fish Forever in Palau and the Federated States of Micronesia
properties.description: Community-led coastal fisheries management in Palau & FSM to combat overfishing, protect biodiversity, ensure food security. Partners with 1,700 communities, 160,000 fishers. Target: 50% marine resources managed by 2030.

properties.title: Coastal 500
properties.description: Global network of 500+ mayors/local leaders across 8 countries committed to thriving coastal communities through sustainable fisheries management, promoting responsible fishing, advocating fishers' rights. Finalist 2023 Earthshot Prize.
properties.funder: Bloomberg Philanthropies Bloomberg Ocean Initiative, Swedish Postcode Lottery Foundation

properties.title: UN Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development
properties.description: IOC-UNESCO coordinates global ocean science cooperation across 152 nations through capacity development, observations, tsunami warnings, and literacy programs. Leads UN Ocean Decade 2021-2030 for sustainable ocean management.

properties.title: Where Land Meets Sea: Building Climate Resilience with Honduras's Coastal Fishers and Farmers
properties.description: Rare links sustainable fishing with regenerative agriculture in Trujillo and Santa Fe, Honduras. Empowers fisher-farmers to restore mangroves, reduce runoff, protect coral reefs, and build climate resilience through community-led conservation.

properties.title: Local Fishers on Buton Island Turn Everyday Ice Needs into Coastal Resilience
properties.description: Fishers in Dongkala Village operate ice-making business to reduce post-harvest loss & fund marine surveillance. Launched Feb 2026 in Pasarwajo Bay, profits support PAAP Ngapatoowa fisheries management & conservation.

properties.title: Expanding Community-Led Conservation in Honduras
properties.description: Rare partnered with Honduran communities to place 14,000+ sq km of Mesoamerican Reef waters under sustainable management, addressing fishery decline and building community-led ocean conservation movement along Caribbean coast.

properties.title: 30x30 Campaign - Fish Forever Community-Led Marine Conservation
properties.description: Rare's Fish Forever program advances 30x30 goals through community-led co-management of territorial seas (12 nautical miles from shore). Uses Managed Access with Reserves (MA+R) combining fishing rights with no-take zones.

properties.title: Guatemalan Fishing Communities Join Forces to Protect Life on the Caribbean Coast
properties.description: Rare & local fishers launched Pesca Unida campaign in Puerto Barrios to unite fishing communities, strengthen governance, promote sustainable fisheries. Includes savings clubs benefiting 3,731 people directly across Caribbean coast. Sept 2024.

properties.title: Rare Philippines Marine Conservation Program
properties.description: Supporting 1.9M small-scale fishers through Marine Protected Areas, sustainable fishing practices, and coastal resource management in the world's coral biodiversity center. Addressing overfishing and fish stock decline.

properties.title: Coral Reef Alliance
properties.description: Marine conservation project supporting coral reef protection and restoration through the Coral Reef Alliance, funded by Tiffany & Co. Foundation.

properties.title: Great Barrier Reef Conservation and Restoration
properties.description: World's largest collaborative effort protecting the Great Barrier Reef ecosystem from climate change through coral restoration, water quality improvement, resilient reef programs, and island habitat restoration.

properties.title: Robots4Whales
properties.description: WHOI project improving whale conservation and maritime safety using ocean robots. Develops autonomous technology to protect marine mammals and enhance vessel operations in whale habitats.

properties.title: Coral Reef Alliance (CORAL) - Global Coral Reef Conservation
properties.description: CORAL protects coral reefs globally through 4 strategies: creating well-managed marine protected areas, building climate-resilient reef networks, reducing land-based pollution, and influencing global conservation policy.

properties.title: FORCE BLUE Tour of Duty - National Marine Sanctuaries
properties.description: Special Operations veterans conduct marine conservation missions in US National Marine Sanctuaries. Missions planned for 2026 as part of America's 250th birthday celebration. Restores lives and planet.
properties.funder: Publix, NFL, NHL, Fortress Investment Group, UBS, Boeing, Newmark, National Marine Sanctuary Foundation

properties.title: Coral Reef Alliance (CORAL) - Global Coral Reef Conservation
properties.description: CORAL protects coral reefs through 4 strategies: creating well-managed marine protected areas, building climate-resilient reef networks, reducing land-based pollution, and influencing global conservation policy across multiple regions.

properties.title: Ocean Institute Marine Education and Conservation Programs
properties.description: Ocean-based education programs in Dana Point offering marine science labs, whale watching tours, research vessel cruises, and hands-on environmental education to inspire ocean conservation and scientific awareness.

properties.title: Cerulean - Global Marine Oil Pollution Tracking
properties.description: Uses satellite imagery, AI & cloud computing to detect & track marine oil pollution globally in near real-time. Makes oil slick data freely accessible to hold polluters accountable for harmful activities.

properties.title: 50 Reefs - A Global Plan to Save Coral Reefs
properties.description: Pioneering initiative identifying 50 coral reefs most likely to survive climate change and reseed surrounding areas. Scientific study published 2018 targets conservation efforts, resulting in $100m+ funding for protection and restoration.

properties.title: Sailors for the Sea Powered by Oceana
properties.description: Global ocean conservation org educating sailing/boating community. Provides Clean Regattas certification, KELP marine education activities for youth, and advocacy campaigns to protect habitats, save marine wildlife, stop pollution.

properties.title: Coral Reef Alliance Global Conservation Program
properties.description: Protecting coral reefs through marine protected areas, climate-resilient reef networks, pollution reduction, and global policy. Active in Hawaii, Mesoamerican Reef, Indo-Pacific, and Eastern Caribbean.

properties.title: Blue Parks Initiative
properties.description: Provides blueprints for marine protected area effectiveness, incentivizes conservation excellence, and unites ocean's best protected places in strategic network to safeguard marine biodiversity and build ocean resilience.

properties.title: Oceans 5 - Global Ocean Protection Initiative
properties.description: International funders' collaborative stopping overfishing, establishing marine protected areas, and constraining offshore oil/gas development across all five oceans. Addresses top priorities identified by marine scientists worldwide.

properties.title: Sailors For The Sea Inc
properties.description: Marine conservation project funded by Tiffany & Co. Foundation in 2009. Details unavailable from page content.

properties.title: Wild Salmon Center - Protecting Wild Salmon Rivers
properties.description: Protecting the world's 20 wildest salmon rivers by 2032 across the North Pacific. Habitat preservation, wild fish diversity management, and coalition support. Currently halfway to goal with 35.7M acres preserved.

properties.title: Marine Conservation Institute - Ocean Protection Initiative
properties.description: Advocates for protecting 30% of oceans through Blue Parks network, MPAtlas tracking, and policy collaboration. Works with communities and experts to establish strong marine protected areas globally for biodiversity.

properties.title: The Ocean Foundation - Marine Conservation Community Foundation
properties.description: Community foundation bridging philanthropy gap for ocean conservation. Supports marine science & conservation communities globally. Founded 20+ years ago to increase ocean funding from <1% of all philanthropy.

properties.title: Ocean Conservation - Pacific Environment
properties.description: Working with coastal communities and local governments to strengthen marine protected areas and safeguard marine wildlife across the Pacific Rim through evidence-based solutions and global partnerships.

properties.title: Scaling Coral Reef Insurance in the Caribbean
properties.description: Parametric insurance releases funds immediately after hurricanes to restore damaged coral reefs. Covers 11 sites across Belize, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Costa Rica, Colombia. Protects 10,000 hectares, supports 2M+ people.
properties.funder: Government of Canada, UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Human rights abuses on the open ocean
properties.description: Uses ML to identify fishing vessels with high forced labor risk by analyzing movement patterns, gear type, voyages. Collaborates with port authorities for inspections, improving seafood industry transparency.

properties.title: Dark Vessels Research Project
properties.description: Tracking non-AIS broadcasting vessels globally using satellite imagery & machine learning. Reveals illegal fishing & forced labor vessels in West Africa, East Asia. Uses Sentinel-1/2 radar & optical data for near-real-time mapping.

properties.title: Regenerative Seaweed Farming Linked to Improved Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: Coast 4C supports 300 seaweed farmers (80% women) in 8 Philippine MPAs with quality seedlings, climate-smart techniques, and equipment to boost resilience, reduce crop losses, and strengthen marine protection through sustainable aquaculture.

properties.title: Establishing a Voluntary Carbon Market in Tanzania
properties.description: Restoring 3,632 ha of mangroves near Dar-es-Salaam to generate carbon credits, funding community priorities like clean water and education while creating sustainable income for 9,672 people (61% women).
properties.funder: UK Blue Planet Fund, Government of Canada, ORRAA

properties.title: Developing a pipeline of bankable blue SMEs in the Philippines
properties.description: Capacity building for blue SMEs in Philippine marine biodiversity corridors. Provides investment readiness support, business planning, and blended finance access to scale sustainable ocean enterprises addressing the $2T funding gap.

properties.title: Establishing a Blended Finance Facility for Marine Protected Areas in the Global South
properties.description: Blended finance facility investing $22M+ in 10 large MPAs across Global South. Supports reef-positive businesses (aquaculture, ecotourism, fisheries) protecting 1M+ ha coral reefs while strengthening coastal livelihoods. 2023-2024.

properties.title: Scaling finance for Indonesia's MPAs through reef-positive investments
properties.description: Building scalable financial model for 600,000 ha MPA network in Banggai, Central Sulawesi through reef-positive businesses: aquaculture, sustainable fisheries, ecotourism, blue carbon credits to curb coral degradation and uplift livelihoods.
