properties.funder: Global Fund for Coral Reefs, UNDP, Blue Natural Capital Finance Facility (IUCN), UBS optimus, AXA Climate, Milkywire, Convergence, Genesis Charitable Trust

properties.title: Satellite data reveals meet-ups on the high seas
properties.description: Uses machine learning and satellite data to track transshipment encounters between fishing vessels on high seas. Analyzes GPS data to identify when/where vessels meet, publishing events to verify activities and reduce illegal transfers.

properties.title: Creating comprehensive vessel information spanning our global waters
properties.description: Consolidates vessel identity data from 40+ registries using ML to track 600k+ vessels. Addresses illegal fishing via name/flag changes. Provides transparent fishing activity monitoring globally.

properties.title: Revealing the footprint and global growth of infrastructure in the ocean
properties.description: Mapping offshore infrastructure globally using SAR imagery & deep learning to detect oil platforms, wind turbines, fish cages. Monitors development & seasonal variation to assess ocean industrialization impacts.

properties.title: Powering Sustainable Fishing Through Community-Led Technology
properties.description: Tech platform empowering small-scale fishers in South Africa & Africa with data tracking, savings, insurance & market access. Addresses financial vulnerability, promotes sustainable fishing. 2023-2025, expanding globally.
properties.funder: Swiss Re Foundation, UK Government Blue Planet Fund, Government of Canada

properties.title: When and why vessels stop broadcasting their position
properties.description: Tracks when fishing vessels intentionally disable AIS signals to identify IUU fishing. Uses machine learning to analyze signal gaps near transshipment hotspots and EEZ boundaries globally.
properties.funder: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration Southwest Fisheries Science Center

properties.title: Pioneering a high-integrity blue carbon initiative in Guinea
properties.description: Restoring mangrove forests in Guinea's Forécariah and Boffa prefectures to generate carbon credits and sustainable revenue for communities. Uses cookstoves, solar salt production, and rice cultivation to address deforestation root causes.

properties.title: Identifying maritime supply chains and supporting risk assessment
properties.description: Maps global vessel movements using AIS data to track port visits and voyages since 2012. Supports monitoring of fishing vessels, IUU fishing, forced labor, and supply chain risk assessment through open-access port databases.

properties.title: Measuring Impacts of Vessel Traffic on Ocean Ecosystems
properties.description: Global Fishing Watch maps all sea-going vessels via AIS to reveal impacts on marine life. Partners with researchers to address vessel traffic challenges like whale strikes and sand mining. Aims to improve ocean governance.

properties.title: Vessel Viewer
properties.description: Insurance risk assessment tool combating IUU fishing. Provides vessel identity, activity data, and risk indicators. Launched Oct 2023, now commercially available with APIs for insurer integration. Global coverage.

properties.title: Detection of Fishing Impacts
properties.description: Uses AI algorithms on AIS vessel data to detect and classify fishing activity globally. Differentiates fishing from non-fishing, identifies gear types, and measures impacts like bycatch and habitat disturbance.

properties.title: Rare First Small-Scale Fisheries Impact Bond
properties.description: World's first fisheries impact bond supporting community-led marine management in SE Sulawesi, Indonesia. Establishes 3 Managed Access with Reserves sites (21,000 ha) benefiting 26,866 people through sustainable fishing and conservation.

properties.title: Protecting Mangroves in the Dominican Republic through the Blue Carbon Exchange
properties.description: First Blue Carbon Exchange in Dominican Republic to conserve/restore mangroves via high-quality carbon credits. Quantifies carbon capture, establishes formal credit system, engages stakeholders for climate mitigation and community benefits.

properties.title: Piloting an Innovative Seascape Financing Approach in Tanzania
properties.description: WWF pilots sustainable blue entrepreneurship financing in RUMAKI Seascape, combining revenue streams to support community-led conservation, reduce poverty, preserve biodiversity in East Africa's most productive marine area. Oct 2024-Mar 2026.

properties.title: PescaData App: Enhancing financial decision making with sustainable fishing practices
properties.description: Mobile app for small-scale fishers in Latin America to log catches, costs, share data, and improve sustainability. Provides weather forecasts, eco-certification tracking, and financial tools. Scaling to 4,730 fishing orgs by 2030 across 5 countries.
properties.funder: Government of Canada, Swiss Re Foundation, UK Blue Planet Fund, US Department of State

properties.title: Lagos State Partnership for Coastal Resilience Initiative
properties.description: Public-private collaboration addressing coastal risks in Lagos through nature-based solutions, policy reform, and stakeholder engagement. Targets flood-vulnerable communities via research, advocacy, and bankable resilience products. 2024-2025.

properties.title: Building a Community-Managed Biodiversity Fund
properties.description: FFI establishes 'Mỹ Hải' fund in Núi Chúa MPA, Vietnam, providing affordable loans for biodiversity-friendly enterprises. Loan interest finances MPA patrols. Reduces illegal fishing pressure, supports sustainable livelihoods in coastal villages.

properties.title: Ocean Sand: Time To Assess Its Real Economic, Social and Planetary Value
properties.description: Global research assessing ocean sand extraction impacts on coastal ecosystems and communities. Develops governance frameworks and monitoring tools to address habitat destruction, biodiversity loss, and coastal erosion from sand mining.
properties.funder: ORRAA and UK's Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Developing a Practitioners Guide for High-Quality Blue Carbon Projects
properties.description: Guide for stakeholders to develop high-quality blue carbon projects that conserve/restore coastal ecosystems, ensure community benefits, and establish transparent carbon market standards. Ongoing 2022-2024, global scope.

properties.title: Ocean Eye Conservation with Biodiversity-Linked Micropayments
properties.description: Platform enabling marine tourists to report wildlife sightings and make micropayments to coastal communities in Indonesia (Banda, Komodo, Bali, Raja Ampat), incentivizing protection of endangered species and sustainable livelihoods.

properties.title: Reducing Marine Waste through Ocean Bound Plastic Credits in Mozambique
properties.description: AMOR implements finance facility strengthening circular economy by removing 1000 tonnes ocean-bound plastic from 6 coastal municipalities. Sells verified OBP credits, trains CSOs, uses KOLEKT app to monitor waste streams, pays communities for collect

properties.title: Developing Seaweed Farm as a Service (SFaaS)
properties.description: Mawimbi provides seaweed farmers access to deep-water farming tech, training & equipment rental. Guarantees purchase of harvest, creating income for coastal communities in Kenya & Tanzania. Addresses climate impacts on shallow farms.
properties.funder: Swiss Re Foundation, UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Developing a Nature-Based Municipal Bond for Canal Restoration in Kochi, India
properties.description: Nature-based municipal bond financing canal restoration in Kochi using green-grey-blue infrastructure to improve flood resilience, water quality, and marine ecosystems for 3.4M coastal residents. Sept 2024-March 2026.

properties.title: Understanding financial flows into the Southwest Indian Ocean (SWIO) by identifying key risks and leverage points to drive a transition to a Sustainable Blue Economy
properties.description: Maps financial flows into SWIO blue economy sectors (seafood, ports, extractives) to identify key risks and redirect capital toward sustainable pathways. Analyzes financiers and ESG policies across Kenya, Madagascar, Mozambique, South Africa, Tanzani

properties.title: Guyana Mangrove-Seawall Engineering Guidance
properties.description: Integrates mangroves with seawalls to protect 90% of Guyana's coastal population from sea level rise and erosion. Develops engineering guidelines for green-grey infrastructure combining natural ecosystems with man-made solutions.

properties.title: Creating a market for invasive Lionfish and providing financial security for fishers
properties.description: Building fisher networks to capture invasive lionfish for pet food. Acari LLC guarantees market prices, upfront payment, and training. Fishers double income while protecting native reef species reduced 79% by lionfish invasion.
properties.funder: Swiss Re Foundation, UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Neptune Endowment
properties.description: Expendable endowment providing 8-10 year funding for locally-led marine conservation in Southeast Asia, Pacific Islands. Supports community-led fisheries, species protection, habitat restoration, Indigenous knowledge in SIDS and LDCs.
properties.funder: Synchronicity Earth, Aurum Fund Management Ltd.

properties.title: Developing Parametric Climate Risk Insurance for Small-Scale Tuna Fishers
properties.description: Parametric insurance for Indonesian tuna fishers providing payments when extreme weather prevents fishing. Protects 2,700+ small-scale fishers across 3 provinces from climate impacts and income loss during unpredictable monsoons.
properties.funder: UK Blue Planet Fund, Swiss Re Foundation, Government of Canada

properties.title: Advancing traceability and financial inclusion for small-scale fishers in Indonesia
properties.description: Mobile app enabling Indonesian small-scale fishers to log catches & transactions, improving traceability to combat IUU fishing, building financial records for loans, supporting sustainable practices. 500 fishers in 2 communities.
properties.funder: Swiss Re Foundation, UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Sustainably Financing South Africa's MPA Network
properties.description: Developing sustainable financing for South Africa's MPA network, focusing on uThukela and iSimangaliso MPAs. Using Nature-based Solutions to restore coastal ecosystems, support livelihoods, and work toward 30% ocean protection by 2030.
properties.funder: Blue Action Fund, UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Satellite based Coastal Hazard Assessment for Sustainable Economic and Tourism Development
properties.description: Satellite imaging & geospatial analytics quantify coastal erosion/flooding risk in Sunderbans mangrove area, enabling insurance products & sustainable tourism development to protect 12M people while conserving ecosystems.
properties.funder: Swiss Re Foundation and UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Invasive Lionfish Management, Quintana Roo, Mexico
properties.description: INVERSA finances fishers to catch invasive lionfish destroying Caribbean coral reefs, converting them to leather. Protects 42M livelihoods, revives ecosystems. Backed by NOAA, Mexico govt. Started <2 years ago in Quintana Roo.
properties.funder: Swiss Re Foundation, UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Financial Tools for Small-Scale Fishers in Melanesia
properties.description: WWF & WTW develop microfinance products & risk transfer tools for small-scale fishers in Fiji & PNG to build resilience against climate & ocean risks, enhance financial literacy, supported by GEF.

properties.title: The #BackBlue Ocean Finance Commitment
properties.description: UN-backed finance commitment launched 2021 pre-COP26. Financial institutions (AXA, Deutsche Bank, etc.) commit to ocean-focused ESG standards, net-zero targets, and $500M investment in coastal nature by 2030 to build resilience.

properties.title: Understanding Global Risks to Coral Reefs
properties.description: TNC assessed 16 risks to coral reefs globally (warming, pollution, hurricanes) to help managers allocate resources. Analysis compares severity/frequency of threats to inform protection policies and investments.

properties.title: Blue Acceleration: An Ocean of Risks and Opportunities
properties.description: Report exploring Blue Acceleration era risks/opportunities for SIDS & LDCs coastal communities. Examines equity, benefit sharing, stranded assets & finance role in sustainable blue economy transformation. Global scope.

properties.title: The Coastal Risk Index
properties.description: Global data platform quantifying how mangroves and reefs reduce coastal flood risk. Launched 2023, provides 90m resolution modeling for 2030/2050 scenarios, helping policymakers and insurers value nature-based solutions.
properties.funder: AXA XL, Government of Canada, UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Critical Role of Women in the Fisheries Sector
properties.description: Research exploring gender dynamics in Global South fisheries to amplify women's contributions, address systemic gaps, and strengthen their leadership in sustainable blue economy through evidence-based factsheets and governance analysis.
properties.funder: Government of Canada, UK Blue Planet Fund, US Department of State

properties.title: Enabling Plastic Credit Finance to Scale Waste Management Activities in Goa
properties.description: rePurpose Global uses Plastic Credits to fund vRecycle's waste collection in Goa's neglected coastal areas. Removes low-value plastics from beaches, mangroves, islands. 500,000+ kg recovered since 2020, employing 25+ workers.
properties.funder: Swiss Re Foundation, UK Blue Planet Fund, Government of Canada

properties.title: Assessing the Global Value at Risk in the Global Blue Economy
properties.description: WWF & Metabolic model financial risks in ocean sectors. Shows $8.4T at risk over 15yrs under business-as-usual vs sustainable development. Covers fisheries, aquaculture, ports, tourism, coastal real estate, marine renewables globally.

properties.title: Insuring Nature to Reduce Risk: Risk Transfer Solutions for Coral Reefs
properties.description: UNDP leads global analysis on coral reef risks to guide investment & create reef insurance markets. Develops standards for risk transfer solutions to fund reef repair, protect vulnerable communities & catalyze resilience.

properties.title: Securing the Livelihoods of Seaweed Farmers through Innovation and Financial Inclusion
properties.description: MARI Indonesia empowers seaweed farmers in South Sulawesi through tech upgrades, finance access, and governance. Uses sensors, blockchain platform, climate-resilient seedlings. Targets 40K tonnes/year by 2024, supporting 1K+ people.

properties.title: First Coastal Community Livelihood Incubator for the South-West Indian Ocean Seascape
properties.description: WWF empowers SWIO coastal communities via regional incubator, unlocking finance for sustainable enterprises. Addresses food security, livelihoods. Kenya pilot 2022, expanding regionally.

properties.title: Parametric Insurance for Small-Scale Fishers in the Philippines
properties.description: Weather index insurance protecting 14,200 Filipino fishers from climate-related income loss. Pays out during storms/rough seas, reducing overfishing pressure. Piloted in 5 coastal areas with gov't funding.
properties.funder: Government of Canada and UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Climate Smart Shrimp Initiative
properties.description: Incentivizes mangrove restoration while enabling sustainable shrimp farming intensification in Philippines. Farmers restore mangroves on portions of ponds while sustainably increasing production, reducing environmental damage and building climate res

properties.title: Strengthening the Financial Resilience of Small-Scale Fishers
properties.description: Rare provides insurance products & financial literacy training to small-scale fishers in Philippines, Indonesia & Honduras, protecting livelihoods from climate shocks. 4,000+ enrolled, expanding to 6,500 policyholders across 3 countries.
properties.funder: Government of Canada and UK Blue Planet Fund

properties.title: Establishing the Restoration Insurance Service Company
properties.description: Conservation International creates RISCO to finance mangrove conservation in Philippines through blue carbon credits and insurance payments for flood risk reduction. Pilots aim to scale model to Costa Rica, Indonesia, Vietnam.

properties.title: Cerulean - Global Ocean Oil Pollution Tracking System
properties.description: Tracks ocean oil pollution globally using satellite imagery and machine learning to detect oil slicks and identify nearby vessels/infrastructure. Free map application for conservationists, journalists, and enforcement agencies.

properties.title: Capturing the Value of Coastal Wetlands through Blue Carbon Resilience Credits
properties.description: TNC & AXA XL create Blue Carbon Resilience Credits for Caribbean mangroves. Offsets carbon while reducing coastal flooding. 10,000 hectares protect 750+ people, avoid $140M damages/year. Supports fisheries & livelihoods.
properties.funder: In-Kind and the Government of Canada

properties.title: Ocean Resilience Innovation Challenge
properties.description: Global challenge surfacing investable projects that build coastal resilience through novel finance products. Provides mentoring, $50K funding, and connects community-led enterprises with investors to protect ocean-dependent communities.
properties.funder: Swiss Re Foundation, Government of Canada, UK Blue Planet Fund, US Department of State

properties.title: Climate-Smart Solutions in SIDS and Coastal Cities using CORVI
properties.description: Develops rapid assessment tools using CORVI to help SIDS and coastal cities understand climate vulnerabilities and prioritize nature-based solutions. Covers 90+ risk indicators across environmental, economic, and social categories in 16 countries.
properties.funder: UK Blue Planet Fund, ORRAA, Government of Canada

properties.title: Oil Spill Tracker
properties.description: Crowdsourced platform tracking BP Deepwater Horizon oil spill impacts on Gulf coastline. Citizens submitted reports with images, helping prevent premature cleanup suspension. Operated 2010-2017.

properties.title: Global Fishing Watch
properties.description: Global platform mapping commercial fishing via satellite AIS data. Launched Sept 2016 by Oceana, Google, SkyTruth. Provides near real-time global view of fishing activity for transparency and sustainable ocean management.

properties.title: Cerulean - Global Bilge Dumping Detection
properties.description: Automated ML analysis of satellite imagery to detect illegal bilge dumping globally. Uses AIS data to identify vessels polluting oceans in Southeast Asia, Mediterranean, West Africa, Latin America. Protects fisheries & coastal livelihoods.

properties.title: Offshore Drilling and Infrastructure Monitoring
properties.description: SkyTruth monitors oil pollution from offshore drilling in Gulf of Mexico using satellite imagery. Revealed BP Deepwater Horizon spill scale, detected Taylor Energy leak. Maps global offshore infrastructure to target pollution monitoring.

properties.title: Overfishing and Illegal Fishing Monitoring
properties.description: SkyTruth uses satellite data to monitor fishing activities globally. Started with Easter Island monitoring in 2011, led to Global Fishing Watch creation. Now maps offshore infrastructure to distinguish vessels from platforms.

properties.title: BP Deepwater Horizon Oil Spill Monitoring and Analysis
properties.description: SkyTruth analyzed satellite imagery to reveal BP Deepwater Horizon spill was vastly larger than reported. Tracked 18,000+ Gulf of Mexico oil/gas leaks since 2010. Ongoing monitoring of offshore drilling safety.

properties.title: Assessment Framework for Successful Development of Viable Ocean Multi-Use Systems
properties.description: Develops framework for ocean multi-use systems combining activities like aquaculture, energy, transport. International collaboration across Brazil, Germany, Sweden, US, Norway, Mozambique, France. Aims viable ocean space management.

properties.title: ARMS to Reefs: A New Tool to Restore Coral Reef Biodiversity, Fisheries Yields, and Human Health in Madagascar
properties.description: Using ARMS to passively collect reef biodiversity from healthy reefs and transplant to artificial reefs in Madagascar to restore fisheries and improve human health. Addresses declining reef fisheries contributing to malnourishment.

properties.title: Beyond Freshwater Generation: Mineral Extraction from Seawater Desalination Brine and Seawater Greenhouse Farming
properties.description: Multi-country project extracting minerals from seawater desalination brine and developing seawater greenhouse farming. Involves Norway, South Africa, Australia, Kenya, and Somalia to advance sustainable marine resource utilization.

properties.title: Bio-economic Analysis for Arctic Marine Resource Governance and Policy
properties.description: Develops integrated marine resource management tools for Arctic decision-making, addressing unique environmental challenges, geopolitical complexity, and changing risks across space and time in Arctic waters.

properties.title: Coastal Ocean Assessment for Sustainability and Transformation (COAST Card)
properties.description: Stakeholder tool monitoring coastal sustainability via report cards, social network analysis & system dynamics models. Sites: Chesapeake Bay, Manila Bay, Tokyo Bay, Ishigaki Island, Goa coast.

properties.title: Coastal Ocean Sustainability in Changing Climate
properties.description: International collaboration studying coastal ocean sustainability under climate change. Multi-institutional research across Russia, Brazil, US, and other regions focusing on marine ecosystem resilience and coastal management.

properties.title: De-icing of Arctic Coasts: Critical or New Opportunities for Marine Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services
properties.description: Studies Arctic coastal ecosystem changes from sea ice loss, examining impacts on marine biodiversity and ecosystem services across circumpolar regions through international collaboration.

properties.title: Ecological and Economic Impacts of the Intensification of Extreme Events in the Benguela Upwelling System
properties.description: Studies climate-driven extreme events in Benguela Upwelling System (South Africa, Namibia, Angola) to understand ecological/economic impacts and develop ecosystem-based management framework through 2070.

properties.title: Evaluation, Mitigation and Adaptation of Impacts of Ocean Acidification to Marine Ecosystems
properties.description: Monitoring ocean acidification impacts on coral reefs across 5 Pacific/Indian Ocean sites using innovative pH-alkalinity tech. Testing seaweed farming mitigation. Building toolbox for OA management and reef conservation.

properties.title: Enhancing the Contribution of Small-Scale Fisheries to the Sustainable Development Goal
properties.description: Multi-country research on small-scale fisheries sustainability. Partners from Nigeria, Kenya, Madagascar, Ecuador (Galapagos), Mexico, Colombia, Malta, France study fisheries' role in SDGs through coastal community engagement.

properties.title: Global Learning for Local Solutions: Reducing Vulnerability of Marine-Dependent Coastal Communities
properties.description: Reduces vulnerability of marine-dependent coastal communities through global learning and local solutions. Multi-country collaboration across Australia, India, Brazil, UK, US, Madagascar, Mozambique studying coastal resilience.

properties.title: From Nunavik to Iceland: Climate, Human and Culture Through Time Across the Coastal Sub-Arctic North Atlantic
properties.description: Assesses resilience of Arctic-subarctic North Atlantic by integrating sea ice/climate data, human adaptation, and cultural perceptions. Creates climate database, documents environmental-cultural variations, involves local populations in workshops.

properties.title: Global Shipping: Linking Policy and Economics to Biogeochemical Cycling and Air-Sea Interaction
properties.description: ShipTRASE analyzes environmental, economic & legal aspects of shipping emission reduction. Studies scrubbers & alternative fuels impact on atmosphere & ocean through measurements, modeling & stakeholder engagement in Germany & Sweden.

properties.title: Holistic Integration for Arctic Coastal-Marine Sustainability
properties.description: Arctic coastal-marine sustainability project integrating oceanography, policy, and mapping across circumpolar regions. Multi-national collaboration studying Arctic Ocean changes and coastal management.

properties.title: Integrated and Sustainable Regulation of Cones in Eastern Polynesia
properties.description: Sustainable regulation of cone snails in Eastern Polynesia through integrated research combining marine biology, toxinology, and local resource management to balance conservation with traditional and scientific uses.

properties.title: Marine Arctic Resilience, Adaptations and Transformations
properties.description: Arctic marine ecosystem resilience study examining adaptations and transformations in northern waters through international collaboration across Canada, USA, Sweden, and Denmark.

properties.title: Managing Ocean-Front Ecosystems for Climate Change
properties.description: Research on ocean-front ecosystems and climate change impacts in East Africa. Collaborative study involving oceanography and coastal development institutions focusing on marine ecosystem management and climate adaptation.

properties.title: Ocean Sustainability Pathways for Achieving Conflict Transformation (OCEANS PACT)
properties.description: Trans-disciplinary research developing conflict resolution tools for ocean sustainability across South Africa, India, Brazil, Norway/Barents Sea, Baltic Sea and US, addressing disputes over marine resources.

properties.title: Resilience and Adaptive Capacity of Arctic Marine Systems Under a Changing Climate
properties.description: Studies Arctic marine ecosystem resilience to climate change through international collaboration between Norway, Japan, and USA, examining fisheries, oceanography, and adaptive capacity in Arctic waters.

properties.title: Establish California Surf Reserves
properties.description: AB 1938 creates State Surfing Reserves program to protect iconic CA surf breaks. Local groups apply to Ocean Protection Council. Designated sites get recognition, signage, stewardship plans protecting waves, seafloor, coast.

properties.title: Don't Roll Back California's Plastic Bag Pollution Protections
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Don't Roll Back California's Plastic Bag Pollution Protections
properties.description: Campaign opposing AB 2226 which would repeal SB 1046's requirement for compostable pre-checkout produce bags. Protects California's composting infrastructure and prevents plastic pollution in waterways and ocean ecosystems.

properties.title: Stop attempt to create loophole for new coastal armoring
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Prevent New Loophole to Add Armoring Along California's Coast
properties.description: Campaign opposing AB 2373 bill that would allow new seawalls along California coast. Bill creates loophole enabling new developments to build coastal armoring, accelerating beach erosion and privatizing public beaches.

properties.title: End "Reef-Safe" Greenwashing in California
properties.description: Campaign supporting AB 1744 to ban misleading "reef safe" sunscreen labels in California. Prohibits claims unless products use only non-nano mineral UV filters, protecting marine ecosystems from harmful chemicals.

properties.title: Secure State Dept. Funding for the Intl. Boundary and Water Commission in FY27
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Secure State Dept. Funding for the Intl. Boundary and Water Commission in FY27
properties.description: Secured FY25 funding for IBWC to address toxic pollution crossing US/Mexico border through Tijuana Watershed. Billions of gallons of sewage, industrial waste, trash close beaches in San Diego/Baja. Supports $700M infrastructure solution.

properties.title: Keep California's Coast for Everyone
properties.description: Campaign to stop AB 1740 from eliminating beach access protections in California's Coastal Act. Prevents removal of coastal parking, protects public access rights, and maintains environmental review requirements for coastal development.

properties.title: Establish an EPA Geographic Program in the Tijuana River Watershed
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Establish an EPA Geographic Program in the Tijuana River Watershed
properties.description: Advocacy to pass Border Water Quality Restoration Act creating EPA Geographic Program for Tijuana River Watershed. Addresses cross-border sewage, industrial waste, trash polluting San Diego/Baja beaches. 1500+ day beach closure.

properties.title: Establish a Border Water Quality Protection Unit in San Diego
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Establish a Border Water Quality Protection Unit in San Diego
properties.description: $1M FY27 CA budget for new staff/dept at SD Regional Water Board to address cross-border sewage, industrial waste, trash from Tijuana Watershed causing beach closures, illness, economic/environmental damage.
properties.funder: California State Budget (Waste Discharge Permit Fund)

properties.title: A Vehicle Free Beach for Oceano by December 2030
properties.description: Campaign to eliminate vehicle access on 2.2 miles of Oceano Beach, CA by 2030, addressing environmental and economic injustice from 44 years of beach driving. Targets State Legislature, Coastal Commission, and State Parks.

properties.title: California Beaches Forever
properties.description: Safeguarding California's beaches from coastal squeeze through advocacy at Coastal Commission, nature-based solutions like dune restoration, preventing armoring, ensuring public access, and climate adaptation to protect 1,100 miles of coast.

properties.title: World Wide Web of Plankton Image Curation (WWW.PIC)
properties.description: Builds distributed web platform for plankton image curation, collaborative taxonomic identification, and ecological metadata storage. Facilitates open access to planktonic organism data for scientific community.

properties.title: Fund the Border Water Infrastructure Grant Program FY27
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Fund the Border Water Infrastructure Grant Program FY27
properties.description: Increase BWIP funding to $50M to address sewage/pollution in US/Mexico border region. Tijuana River pollution closes San Diego beaches 1500+ days, sickens communities. Goal: reduce beach closures 95%, transboundary flows 75%.

properties.title: Protect Communities from Exposure to Dangerous Levels of Hydrogen Sulfide
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect Communities from Exposure to Dangerous Levels of Hydrogen Sulfide
properties.description: Campaign for CA bill SB 58 requiring health-based hydrogen sulfide thresholds. Addresses US/Mexico border sewage pollution causing beach closures 4+ years, sickening thousands in South San Diego County via contaminated water/air.

properties.title: Designate the California Sea Lion as Official State Pinniped
properties.description: SB 1286 would designate California sea lion as official state pinniped, recognizing its ecological role in regulating fish populations and serving as ocean health indicator along California's coastline.

properties.title: Require Disclosure of Shoreline Erosion Issues in Real-Estate Advertisements
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Require Disclosure of Shoreline Erosion Issues in Real-Estate Advertisements
properties.description: Campaign to pass SB3035 requiring Hawaii sellers/agents to disclose shoreline erosion structures, violations, and risks in property ads upfront, not late in transactions, protecting buyers and reducing beach loss.

properties.title: Restore Beach Act Funding FY2018
properties.description: Campaign to restore EPA BEACH Grant funding for state/local beach water quality monitoring and public notification programs. Supports public health protection at US beaches. Congress restored ~$10M funding in FY2016 budget Dec 2015.

properties.title: Protect National Coastal and Ocean Programs
properties.description: Advocacy campaign to secure federal funding for NOAA programs managing US coasts and oceans. Focuses on Marine Sanctuaries, Coastal Zone Management, Sea Grant, and climate resilience programs. Active 2025-2027 during Congressional budget cycles.

properties.title: Establish a Bahia de Aguadilla Marine Reserve
properties.description: Surfrider Puerto Rico leads community effort to create multi-use marine reserve in Bahia de Aguadilla, protecting ecology from development/pollution while allowing sustainable use. Draft bill planned 2026.

properties.title: 1.25 Percent for Oregon's Wildlife
properties.description: Legislative effort (HB 4134) to increase Oregon's tourism lodging tax by 1.25% to fund wildlife conservation programs, focusing on Marine Reserves, Protected Areas, and climate resilience for coastal habitats and ocean wildlife.

properties.title: Permanently Pass Funding Transfer Authority Language
properties.description: Secure permanent funding authority for wastewater infrastructure at US/Mexico border to stop billions of gallons of sewage, industrial waste & trash polluting San Diego/Tijuana beaches. Supports $700M solution to reduce flows 95%.

properties.title: Defend Marine National Monuments in the Pacific
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Defend Marine National Monuments in the Pacific
properties.description: Defending Pacific Islands Heritage & Papahānaumokuākea Marine Monuments from federal plans to open them to commercial fishing. Submitted public comments Oct 2025 opposing industrial fishing in protected areas.

properties.title: Conserve Blake Plateau
properties.description: Expand Gray's Reef National Marine Sanctuary to protect Blake Plateau's deep sea coral reefs off NC, SC, GA, FL coasts from harmful mining. Coalition effort during sanctuary management plan review to safeguard world's largest deep coral habitat.

properties.title: Plastic-Free San Diego County
properties.description: Surfrider San Diego works with municipalities across San Diego County to pass plastic reduction ordinances. Targets polystyrene foam, single-use foodware, bags, balloons, and water bottles to protect beaches, bays, and ocean.

properties.title: Protect Beach Access in Rye NH
properties.description: Surfrider NH fights proposals to eliminate free parking along Ocean Blvd (Route 1A) in Rye, NH. Campaign ensures equitable beach access for all by opposing paid/permit-only parking restrictions.

properties.title: Pass the Digital Coast Act
properties.description: Reauthorize NOAA's Digital Coast Program providing coastal communities data on sea level rise, flooding, erosion to plan climate adaptation. $4M/year program yields $117M benefit by 2028. Advocacy in 119th Congress.

properties.title: Reduce Plastic Pollution in Florida
properties.description: Surfrider advocates for SB240/HB575 legislation to reduce 7,000 tons of annual plastic pollution entering Florida's ocean. Bills allow local regulation of single-use plastics, grandfather existing ordinances, mandate statewide debris plan.

properties.title: Stop Dumping Wailua Sewage into the Ocean
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop Dumping Wailua Sewage into the Ocean
properties.description: Campaign to stop Wailua Wastewater Treatment Plant from discharging 1.5M gallons of partially treated sewage daily into ocean near Lydgate Beach Park, Kauaʻi. Demands stronger water pollution permit to protect coral reefs and public health.

properties.title: Stop the Williams NESE Pipeline
properties.description: Opposing 35-mile fracked gas pipeline from NJ through NY/NJ Harbor to Rockaway Beach, Queens. Would disrupt seabed, release toxic sediment, pollute air/water, undermine clean energy goals. Resubmitted to FERC May 2025 after defeats in 2019-2020.

properties.title: Stop Harmful Deep-Sea Mining off American Samoa
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop Harmful Deep-Sea Mining off American Samoa
properties.description: Campaign opposing seabed mining in American Samoa's 200-mile Economic Zone. Mobilizing public comments to Dept. of Interior against mining that threatens marine ecosystems, fisheries, coral reefs, and contradicts territorial moratorium.

properties.title: Pass Bills A5755/S4677 in New Jersey
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Support Beach Badge Financial Sunshine in New Jersey
properties.description: Surfrider supports NJ bills requiring municipalities to disclose beach fee revenues and costs. Aims to ensure beach access fees legitimately fund beach operations like lifeguards, maintenance, not excess revenue generation.

properties.title: Protect Connecticut's Waters from Toxic Chemicals
properties.description: Preventing pesticide runoff & toxic chemicals from lawns/fields reaching Long Island Sound. Banning Acelepryn pesticide, modernizing pesticide data reporting, stopping artificial turf expansion to protect shellfish & marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Stop Harmful Seabed Mining in the Pacific Ocean
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop Harmful Seabed Mining in the Pacific Ocean
properties.description: Campaign opposing deep-sea mining exploration licenses in Clarion-Clipperton Zone between Hawaii and Mexico. Advocates for ocean protection from seabed mining that threatens marine ecosystems, fisheries, and Pacific communities.

properties.title: Protect Beach Access in Maine
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation combats barriers to Maine beach access by opposing increased parking fees, restricted hours, and limited passes in Scarborough and Portland that disproportionately impact inland and underserved communities.

properties.title: Say Farewell to Foam!
properties.description: Campaign to pass federal legislation prohibiting sale of plastic foam food service ware nationwide. Targets expanded polystyrene containers that pollute beaches, harm marine life through ingestion, and release toxins.

properties.title: Oregon Stop Microfiber Pollution
properties.description: Campaign to require washing machine filters in Oregon to capture plastic microfibers before entering waterways. Senate Bill 526 mandates manufacturers install proven filter technology to prevent microfiber pollution at source.

properties.title: Let's Ban Single-Use Plastic Products in Stamford, CT!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Let's Ban Single-Use Plastic Products in Stamford, CT!
properties.description: Surfrider CT supports Ordinance LR31.091 to ban single-use plastics in Stamford food establishments. Monthly cleanups remove plastic pollution from beaches and waterways, protecting marine ecosystems from microplastic contamination.

properties.title: Pass a Delaware 'Skip the Stuff' Bill
properties.description: Surfrider Delaware Chapter campaigns for HB111 'Skip the Stuff' bill requiring customers to request takeout utensils/condiments rather than automatic inclusion, reducing plastic pollution in Delaware's ocean and beaches.

properties.title: Oregon Eelgrass Action Now
properties.description: Establish conservation targets and habitat protection for Oregon's eelgrass meadows through HB 3580. Protects vital habitat for salmon, crab, birds while storing carbon and reducing ocean acidification in estuaries.

properties.title: Support a Statewide Recycling Program for Beverage Bottles and Cans (TX)
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Support a Statewide Recycling Program for Beverage Bottles and Cans (TX)
properties.description: Establish statewide beverage container deposit/refund program in Texas to reduce beach litter and microplastic pollution. Supports HB 2048 and SB 725 for glass, aluminum, plastic container recycling.

properties.title: Protege La Reserva Natural Comunitaria Mabodamaca
properties.description: Community-led coastal restoration in Isabela, PR. Protecting mangroves, dunes, turtle nesting areas. Proposing eco-friendly solution to relocate damaged boardwalk inland, restore dunes, remove debris vs concrete walls that threaten beach.

properties.title: Eliminate single-use toiletries from hotels in Maine
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Eliminate single-use toiletries from hotels in Maine!
properties.description: Supporting LD 1928 to ban single-use plastic toiletry containers in Maine hotels. Reduces plastic pollution, protects marine ecosystems. Testimony given May 12, 2025. Aligns with Ocean Friendly Hotels program.

properties.title: Hold Producers Accountable to Reduce Plastic Packaging in California
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Hold Producers Accountable to Reduce Plastic Packaging in California!
properties.description: Campaign to ensure strong implementation of SB 54, requiring 25% reduction in single-use plastic packaging by 2032 and 100% recyclable/compostable materials. Addresses plastic pollution on California coastlines through producer accountability.

properties.title: Coastal Commission Approves New Gaviota Coast Plan to Improve Coastal Protections and Public Access
properties.description: South Padre Island redesigned Gulf Blvd to increase public beach parking via diagonal parking, sidewalks, and ROW realignment. Surfrider South Texas Chapter advocated 3+ years for Texas Open Beaches Act compliance. Phase I approved Jan 2012.
properties.funder: Surfrider Foundation, Unknown, NRDC, Maui County Open Space Fund, County of Hawaii, Washington State

properties.title: Ban Polystyrene and Single-use Plastic in CT!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Polystyrene and Single-use Plastic in CT!
properties.description: Campaign supporting HB6229 to ban polystyrene and single-use plastics in Connecticut. Aims to protect beaches and waterways from non-biodegradable waste that harms marine life and human health through legislative action.

properties.title: Ban Packaging Peanuts in Maine!
properties.description: Surfrider Maine & Oceana support LD 476 to ban polystyrene packing peanuts statewide. Non-biodegradable peanuts break into microplastics harming oceans & marine life. Testimony given 3/3/25 at state house.

properties.title: Improve Beach Water Quality Monitoring in Florida
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Improve Beach Water Quality Monitoring in Florida
properties.description: Advocates for consistent beach water quality testing and public notification across Florida counties through legislation requiring standardized monitoring, health advisories, and signage when bacteria levels are elevated.

properties.title: Texas Protect Our Open Beaches
properties.description: Defending Texas Open Beaches Act against legislative attacks. Surfrider rallied opposition to 2025 bills weakening beach access protections, including space flight closure authority and dune protection changes. Ongoing vigilance for 2027.

properties.title: Eliminate Aqueous Film-Forming Foam (AFFF) in Maine!
properties.description: Surfrider Maine supports legislation to eliminate PFAS-laden AFFF firefighting foam after 1,450 gallons spilled into Androscoggin River and Harpswell Cove in Aug 2024, threatening marine ecosystems and public health with forever chemicals.

properties.title: Keep Toxic Pesticides & Fertilizers Banned in Maui County Parks
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Keep Toxic Pesticides & Fertilizers banned in Maui County Parks
properties.description: Surfrider Maui opposes Bill 131 exempting Parks Dept from pesticide/fertilizer ban (Ord 5232). Supports reef-friendly alternatives to protect Maui waterways and coastal environment from pollution.

properties.title: Regulate Ocean Pollution from the Mānā Plain Drainage Ditch System
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Regulate Ocean Pollution from the Mānā Plain Drainage Ditch System
properties.description: West Kauaʻi drainage ditches discharge polluted water from agriculture, livestock, wastewater into ocean via 7 outfalls. Surfrider sued to strengthen NPDES permit requiring testing, discharge limits, cleanup measures.

properties.title: Stop New Offshore Drilling in U.S. Waters
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop New Offshore Drilling in U.S. Waters
properties.description: Campaign opposing Trump admin proposal to open 1.27B acres for oil/gas drilling off CA, Gulf of Mexico, FL, Alaska & Arctic. Includes legal action, public comment period & congressional advocacy to protect coastal ecosystems & economies.

properties.title: Clean Water at Linda Mar State Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Cut The Crap! Let's Clean Up Linda Mar Beach
properties.description: Addressing chronic fecal bacteria pollution at Linda Mar Beach, Pacifica. 54% unhealthy water tests in 2023. Coalition advocates for better signage, pump house investigation, and increased testing to identify sewage sources.

properties.title: Skip the Stuff in Suffolk County, NY
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Skip the Stuff in Suffolk County, NY
properties.description: Surfrider supports Suffolk County legislation requiring restaurants to provide plastic utensils, straws, condiments only upon request. Reduces ocean pollution; volunteers removed 1,425 takeout items from beaches 2019-2022.

properties.title: Keep Mentor Lagoons Nature Preserve Natural
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Keep Mentor Lagoons Nature Preserve Natural
properties.description: Protect The Goons surf break and prevent shoreline armoring along 1.5 miles of eroding Lake Erie coastline at Mentor Lagoons Nature Preserve through managed retreat strategy in the Shoreline Master Plan.

properties.title: Designate a Cashes Ledge National Marine Sanctuary
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Designate a Cashes Ledge National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: Advocating for National Marine Sanctuary designation of Cashes Ledge, an undersea mountain range 90 miles off New England. Protects marine habitats, builds climate resilience in Gulf of Maine. Coalition support since 2023.

properties.title: Pass the Resilient Coasts and Estuaries Act
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Pass the Resilient Coasts and Estuaries Act
properties.description: Reauthorize coastal resilience programs with $60M annually for land conservation and $47M for estuarine reserves. Protect coastal ecosystems as natural flood barriers, enable habitat migration from sea level rise.

properties.title: Removal of abandoned vessels along the coastline
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Removal of abandoned vessels along the coastline
properties.description: Removing derelict vessels releasing fiberglass, chemicals, and plastic debris into Puerto Rico's marine ecosystem. Creating formal protocol for immediate vessel removal after discovery and assigning responsibility to proper agency.

properties.title: Ban Miniature Liquor Bottles (Nips) in Plymouth, MA
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Miniature Liquor Bottles (Nips) in Plymouth, MA
properties.description: Plymouth, MA campaign to ban sale of mini liquor bottles (nips) under 100mL. Non-recyclable plastic containers pollute coastal ecosystems. Ban passed Oct 2023 but overturned Jan 2024. Chapter continuing advocacy efforts.

properties.title: Stop Kahana Sunset Condo Impacts to Public Shoreline
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop Kahana Sunset Condo Impacts to Public Shoreline
properties.description: Legal appeal to stop seawall repairs at Kahana Sunset condos on West Maui that encroach on public beach. Advocates for managed retreat instead of emergency permits. Filed July 2023 challenging coastal zone violations.

properties.title: Don't Enable Sable - Stop the Oil Restart
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Don't Enable Sable - Stop the Oil Restart
properties.description: Stop restart of 3 offshore oil platforms in Santa Barbara Channel, offline since 2015 Plains All American pipeline spill. Prevent corroded pipeline restart threatening coast, ocean ecosystems, climate.

properties.title: Stop Radioactive Roads in Florida
properties.description: Preventing phosphogypsum (radioactive fertilizer waste) use in FL roads. Releases radon gas, heavy metals. Causes toxic runoff harming waterways, marine life. Advocacy targets EPA permit denial, supports No Radioactive Roads Act.

properties.title: Implementation of the Puerto Rico Plastics Ban
properties.description: Advocacy to implement Puerto Rico Law 51 banning single-use plastics by June 2024. Opposing PS1374 bill that delays ban until 2026. Protects beaches, land, tourism, and public health from plastic pollution.

properties.title: Reauthorize the BEACH Act Grant Program
properties.description: Campaign to reauthorize EPA BEACH Act grants ($30M annually, 2024-2028) for beach water quality monitoring across 35 US coastal states/territories. Expands grants to include pollution source ID and testing innovations.

properties.title: Nix the Nips CT
properties.description: Campaign to ban 50mL alcohol miniature bottles (nips) in Connecticut or include them in bottle deposit system. These single-use plastics wash into storm drains and waterways, ending up in ocean. Advocacy for legislative hearings ongoing.

properties.title: Pass the Plastic Pellet Free Waters Act
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Pass the Plastic Pellet Free Waters Act
properties.description: Campaign to pass HR 7543 requiring EPA to prohibit discharge of plastic pellets (nurdles) into US waterways. 200,000 metric tons enter oceans yearly, harming marine life. Bill mandates updated permits within 60 days.

properties.title: Ocean Access For People Of All Mobility in Lauderdale-By-The-Sea
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ocean Access For People Of All Mobility in Lauderdale-By-The-Sea
properties.description: Surfrider Broward & Thresher Aquatics seek ocean-accessible beach wheelchair for LBTS to enable individuals with different mobility levels to enjoy SCUBA diving, snorkeling & water activities at Florida's best beach diving spot.

properties.title: Stop Intentional Balloon Releases in North Carolina
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop Intentional Balloon Releases in North Carolina
properties.description: Prevent plastic pollution from balloon releases in NC. SB20 introduced Jan 2025 to ban intentional balloon releases. Protects wildlife, farmed animals from balloon litter, reduces microplastics in soil and waterways.

properties.title: San Diego Coastal Resilience Master Plan
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/San Diego Coastal Resilience Master Plan
properties.description: Nature-based resilience strategies for SD beaches facing sea level rise. Dune restoration at Sunset Cliffs, Ocean Beach, Mission Beach, Tourmaline, La Jolla Shores. Advocacy for beach preservation over seawalls by 2050-2100.

properties.title: Protect West Maui Coral Reefs and Community Water Resources
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect West Maui Coral Reefs and Community Water Resources
properties.description: Advocating for stricter pollution limits in Lahaina wastewater permit to protect Hā'enanui reef from nutrient discharge via injection wells. Pushing for reduced nitrogen/phosphorus, pH controls, and wastewater reuse at Kahekili Beach Park.

properties.title: Decommission California's Offshore Drilling Rigs
properties.description: Advocating for safe decommissioning of 35+ year old offshore oil/gas rigs off California. Supporting federal EIS & state legislation to remove aging infrastructure posing pollution threats after 2021 Amplify Energy spill.

properties.title: Save The Avila Coast Again
properties.description: Opposing California's largest beachfront entertainment complex in Avila. 11,000 daily visitors would restrict coastal access, create traffic/safety issues, and conflict with Coastal Act protections for public recreation.

properties.title: No Concrete Development On Galveston Beaches
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/No Concrete Development On Galveston Beaches
properties.description: Campaign to stop Galveston ordinance allowing reinforced concrete within 200ft of vegetation line. Protects beach access, prevents erosion, flooding. Targets $100M beachfront condo threatening dunes.

properties.title: Demand a Strong Global Plastics Treaty to Protect Our Ocean
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Demand a Strong Global Plastics Treaty to Protect Our Ocean
properties.description: Surfrider advocates for binding UN Global Plastics Treaty requiring reduced plastic production. Addresses ocean pollution, climate change, human health impacts. Targets US government commitment to treaty with lifecycle approach.

properties.title: Protect Rhode Island's Coastline!
properties.description: Surfrider's RI Chapter raises awareness about seawall dangers and coastal erosion, advocating for nature-based solutions like dune restoration over man-made structures to protect marine life and public coastal access.

properties.title: Skip the Stuff in East Hampton Village
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Skip the Stuff in East Hampton Town
properties.description: Campaign for East Hampton law requiring restaurants provide single-use takeout accessories only by request. Reduces plastic waste from utensils, stirrers, napkins entering oceans. Beach cleanups found 1,425 items 2019-2022.

properties.title: Strengthen the Olympic Coast National Marine Sanctuary
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Strengthen the Olympic Coast National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: Surfrider chapters advocate for stronger OCNMS management plan via NOAA's 2023 update process, addressing climate change, pollution, vessel traffic threats to Pacific Northwest marine ecosystems.

properties.title: California Oil Spill Environmental Restoration
properties.description: Restoration plan for Oct 2021 Orange County oil spill (24,696 gal). Surfrider engages with NOAA/trustee agencies on NRDA process to assess damages to marine life, habitats, recreation and ensure Amplify Energy funds restoration.

properties.title: Stop EPA Use of Chemical Oil Spill Dispersants
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop EPA Use of Chemical Oil Spill Dispersants
properties.description: Surfrider urges EPA to ban toxic Corexit dispersants used in oil spill response. After 2010 BP spill, 1.77M gallons dispersed in Gulf of Mexico caused health issues, wildlife deaths. Campaign demands immediate removal from approved products list.

properties.title: Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Tequesta
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Tequesta
properties.description: Ban cigarette smoking on Tequesta beaches/parks to reduce plastic pollution and cigarette litter harming marine life. Palm Beach County Chapter advocates for municipal smoking ban following FL HB105 passage.

properties.title: Save Boca Bluffs in San Clemente!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Save Boca Bluffs in San Clemente!
properties.description: Protect Boca Bluffs near T-Street from 7-home development that would block ocean views, public beach access, and coastal trail. Active landslide area threatened by construction on last undeveloped coastal stretch in San Clemente.

properties.title: Save South Orange County Beaches from Railroad Armoring
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Save South Orange County Beaches from Railroad Armoring
properties.description: Surfrider advocates for long-term railroad track relocation and beach restoration in San Clemente to prevent erosion from 26,500 tons of emergency riprap armoring placed since 2021, threatening coastal resources.

properties.title: End Public Funding for Private Coastal Armoring, Florida
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/End Public Funding for Private Coastal Armoring, Florida
properties.description: Campaign to terminate Florida's $50M Hurricane Restoration Reimbursement Grant Program funding private seawalls/armoring that accelerates beach erosion. Advocating with state legislature to end harmful coastal management precedent.

properties.title: Place a Five Cent Fee on Plastic Bags in Virginia Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Put a Fee on Single Use Plastic Bags in Virginia Beach
properties.description: Campaign to enact 5-cent fee on single-use plastic bags at stores in Virginia Beach to reduce plastic pollution in waterways and beaches. Revenue funds litter cleanups and reusable bag programs.

properties.title: Establish a Chesapeake National Recreation Area
properties.description: Coalition effort to create National Recreation Area protecting Chesapeake Bay. Includes collection of parks and public lands. Aims to increase Bay access, recreation opportunities, and national recognition of conservation needs.

properties.title: Stop the septic discharges at Domes Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop the septic discharges at Domes Beach
properties.description: Campaign to replace failing septic tank at Rincón Lighthouse that overflows onto Domes Beach, Puerto Rico. Surfrider Rincon Chapter advocates for upgraded system away from beach to handle wastewater from public facilities.

properties.title: Reduce lead contamination at Puʻuloa Beach
properties.description: Surfrider Oʻahu demands Navy cleanup of lead pollution from century-old rifle range at Puʻuloa Beach Park, ʻEwa Beach, Oʻahu. Sediment shows 17x safe levels. Goals: cleanup, testing of soil/water/reef, relocate berms.

properties.title: Stop Seawalls in Pismo Beach
properties.description: Surfrider SLO opposes 2 seawalls (120ft & 110ft, 40ft high) at Indio Dr & Shoreline Dr, Pismo Beach. City misinterpreted 'existing' structure rules. Appeal to CA Coastal Commission Dec 2023 to protect bluffs/beaches.

properties.title: Move the Road to Save the Beach in Carlsbad
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Move the Road to Save the Beach in Carlsbad
properties.description: Realign 1-mile of Carlsbad Blvd inland to save eroding beach from sea level rise. Surfrider advocates for demolishing old road post-realignment. Managed retreat project sets precedent for coastal adaptation while preserving beaches.

properties.title: Create a new National Marine Sanctuary for the Hudson Canyon
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect the Hudson Canyon Offshore of New York and New Jersey
properties.description: Designate Hudson Canyon (250mi long, 3,500ft walls) as National Marine Sanctuary to protect 100+ species including whales, sharks, turtles. Prohibits oil/gas exploration while supporting fisheries and tourism.

properties.title: Expand Beach Access for ALL, MA!
properties.description: Campaign to reform MA's restrictive 1640s beach access law by adding 'recreation' to protected public uses (fishing, fowling, navigation) on private tidelands up to high tide line, expanding coastal access for all.

properties.title: Stop the Line 5 Tunnel Under the Straits of Mackinac
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop the Line 5 Tunnel Under the Straits of Mackinac
properties.description: Prevent Enbridge's Line 5 tunnel project under Straits of Mackinac. 72-year-old pipelines carry 23M gallons oil daily between Lakes Michigan & Huron. Coalition seeks shutdown after MI revoked easement in 2020; Enbridge defies order.

properties.title: Save Boca Chica Beach
properties.description: Protecting Boca Chica Beach, TX from SpaceX launch impacts. Advocating for full environmental review to safeguard sea turtle nesting, piping plover habitat, wildlife refuge, state park, and beach access threatened by rocket launches.

properties.title: Get Your Rocks Off Oceanside
properties.description: Preserve Oceanside beaches & improve public access by enforcing Coastal Act & municipal code. Address beach erosion, rock revetment issues, unpermitted development & closed access points to reprioritize community beach rights.

properties.title: Supporting North Shore First Responder Center Over a Tourist Mall
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Supporting North Shore First Responder Center Over a Tourist Mall
properties.description: Prevent overdevelopment at Shark's Cove, Oahu's North Shore. Protect Marine Life Conservation District from polluted runoff, litter, overuse. Advocate for First Responder Center instead of mall via lawsuit and land purchase.

properties.title: Preserve Lighthouse Beach Access
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation campaign to restore public access to Lighthouse Beach in Coos Bay, Oregon after barbed wire blocked a decades-old footpath. Filed lawsuit in 2022, reached agreement in 2023 for property donation to Oregon State Parks.

properties.title: Relocate the Train Off Del Mar's Bluffs & Return 1.7 Miles of Coast to the Public
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Relocate the Train Off Del Mar's Bluffs & Return 1.7 Miles of Coast to the Public
properties.description: Relocating 1.7 miles of LOSSAN railroad off eroding Del Mar bluffs by 2035 to preserve beaches and public safety. Managed retreat of infrastructure, returning bluffs to public access while addressing interim stabilization.

properties.title: Water Testing and Notification at Ormond Lagoon
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Water Testing and Notification at Ormond Lagoon
properties.description: Surfrider Ventura advocates for water quality testing at Ormond Lagoon after finding bacteria levels exceeding recreational standards, posing health risks to kayakers and beachgoers.

properties.title: Coastal Access in La Jolla
properties.description: Restoring historic Princess Street trail in La Jolla to reconnect public access to beach and State Marine Reserve. 50-foot descent from blufftop to shoreline, reversing decades of development isolation. Community-led 40-year effort.

properties.title: Reject the Proposed Skipjack Wind Project Cable Landing Proposal
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Reject the Proposed Skipjack Wind Project Cable Landing Proposal
properties.description: Surfrider Delaware opposes Orsted's Skipjack offshore wind cable landing at Fenwick Island State Park due to sea level rise concerns on the barrier island. Advocates for alternative landing site while supporting responsible offshore wind.

properties.title: Clean Water Sunset Bay
properties.description: Sourcing bacteria contamination at Sunset Bay, Oregon through water quality monitoring and DNA sampling to end 20+ years of health advisories at this contaminated beach. Partnering with state agencies and tribes.

properties.title: Support Coastal and Ocean Acidification and Threats (COAST) Research Act
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Support Coastal and Ocean Acidification and Threats (COAST) Research Act
properties.description: Legislation to expand scientific research and monitoring of ocean acidification, supporting coastal communities' adaptation to climate crisis. Focuses on Pacific Northwest where shellfish industries face collapse from changing ocean pH.

properties.title: Coastal Texas Protection and Restoration Feasibility Study
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Coastal Texas Protection and Restoration Feasibility Study
properties.description: US Army Corps & Texas GLO study coastal storm risk mgmt & ecosystem restoration. Surfrider advocates for living shorelines, restored dunes over hard armoring, incorporating sea level rise into planning.

properties.title: Protect Corpus Christi Bay From Desalination
properties.description: Campaign to protect Corpus Christi Bay's water quality and marine life from cumulative impacts of multiple proposed desalination plants that would discharge concentrated brine into the mostly enclosed bay.
properties.funder: Surfrider Foundation Texas Coastal Bend Chapter

properties.title: Puget Sound Nutrient Reduction
properties.description: Reduce nutrients & pollution from wastewater treatment plants in Puget Sound via advanced nutrient-reduction technology & strong General Permit. Protects salmon, shellfish from low oxygen & acidification. 16 of 67 plants upgraded.

properties.title: Get Nuclear Waste Off The Coast - San Onofre
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Get Nuclear Waste Off The Coast!
properties.description: Advocating removal of radioactive waste from deactivated San Onofre Nuclear Station near San Clemente, CA. Site faces earthquake/erosion risks, stores spent fuel rods & releases treated radioactive wastewater offshore.

properties.title: Emerald Coast Beach Access Campaign
properties.description: Protects public beach access rights along Florida's Emerald Coast Gulf beaches through customary use doctrine and defense against quiet title actions. Focuses on Walton County access threats and monitoring.

properties.title: Preserve The Gaviota Coast - Santa Barbara
properties.description: Protect Gaviota Coast (Coal Oil Point to Point Sal) from development. Surfrider's Santa Barbara Chapter works with Naples Coalition to prevent development south of Highway 101, preserving largest intact coastal Mediterranean ecosystem in US.

properties.title: Skip the Stuff Ordinance in Sag Harbor
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Passed a Skip the Stuff Ordinance in Sag Harbor
properties.description: Surfrider's Eastern Long Island Chapter passed ordinance requiring restaurants to provide single-use utensils/condiments only upon request, reducing plastic pollution in ocean and beaches while saving costs.

properties.title: Protecting Beacon's Beach for This and Future Generations
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protecting Beacon's Beach for This and Future Generations
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation San Diego advocates for safe beach access at Beacon's Beach, Encinitas CA. Engaged since 2001 to prevent coastal armoring, ensure trail safety, and maintain public access through policy work and permits.

properties.title: Protect Height Restrictions in Lake Worth Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect Height Restrictions in Lake Worth Beach
properties.description: Surfrider successfully advocated to maintain 65-foot building height restrictions east of A1A at Lake Worth Beach, preventing overdevelopment in vulnerable coastal areas facing sea level rise and erosion. Victory achieved Oct 2025.

properties.title: Accelerate Access to Prop 4 Funds for Tijuana River Valley
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Accelerate Access to Prop 4 Funds for Tijuana River Valley
properties.description: Addresses cross-border sewage crisis in Tijuana River Valley affecting South San Diego. AB 35 accelerates $50M Prop 4 funding for wastewater infrastructure to treat billions of gallons of pollution causing beach closures and illness.

properties.title: Malibu Lagoon Inlet Relocation
properties.description: Advocates mechanical relocation of Malibu Lagoon inlet breach westward to improve surf conditions at Surfrider Beach, reduce Adamson estate erosion, enhance lifeguard access to Third Point, and increase wetland tidal circulation.

properties.title: Ban Polystyrene Foam Bodyboards in Kauaʻi
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Polystyrene Foam Bodyboards in Kauaʻi
properties.description: Surfrider Kauaʻi supported Bill 2976 banning sale of disposable polystyrene foam bodyboards. Polystyrene breaks into fragments harming marine life. First county in Hawaiʻi to ban beyond foodware. Passed unanimously 2024.

properties.title: Ban The Butt Capitola
properties.description: Capitola banned retail sales of tobacco products with plastic filters/butts to reduce cigarette litter, the top item found at beach cleanups. Ordinance takes effect 7/1/27, following similar bans in Santa Cruz County.

properties.title: Pass Funding Transfer Authority Language
properties.description: Advocacy to pass transfer authority language allowing federal/non-federal funding for wastewater infrastructure at US/Mexico border. Addresses billions of gallons of toxic pollution crossing Tijuana Watershed annually.

properties.title: Celebrate the Ocean Friendly Way, Miami Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Celebrate the Ocean Friendly Way, Miami Beach
properties.description: Miami Beach bans plastic decorations (confetti, glitter, petals) at beaches, parks, marinas. Prevents microplastic pollution harming sea turtles, birds, fish. Surfrider Miami advocated for ordinance passage.

properties.title: Stop the Guana Land Swap
properties.description: Opposed land swap of 600 acres of Guana River WMA to private ownership. Protects coastal habitat, flooding buffer, water quality filtration. Application withdrawn May 2025 after public opposition. St. Johns County, FL.

properties.title: Fund the Border Water Infrastructure Grant Program FY26
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Fund the Border Water Infrastructure Grant Program FY26
properties.description: Secured $35M FY26 funding for US/Mexico border wastewater infrastructure. Addresses billions of gallons of sewage/waste polluting Tijuana River, closing San Diego beaches 1500+ days. Targets $100M for comprehensive solution.

properties.title: Defended Equal Beach Access in Deal, NJ
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Defended Equal Beach Access in Deal, NJ
properties.description: Surfrider's Jersey Shore Chapter successfully challenged Deal, NJ's discriminatory beach pass pricing (Oct 2025-Jan 2026). Borough dropped plan to charge nonresidents $200 vs $150 for residents after advocacy citing NJ law.

properties.title: Bring Down Matilija Dam
properties.description: Remove 200-ft Matilija Dam on Ventura River to restore steelhead spawning, release 6M cubic yards of trapped sediment to starving beaches, and improve water quality. Largest dam removal ever attempted, requiring careful sediment management.

properties.title: Stop the city of Norwalk from building turf fields!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop the city of Norwalk from building turf fields!
properties.description: Prevented artificial turf at Broad River Park, Norwalk CT. Turf runoff (zinc, PFAS) threatens river water quality and marine life like oysters. Victory July 2025: Council approved natural grass/clay fields instead.

properties.title: Strengthen Nature-Based Solutions in Florida
properties.description: Florida law SB302 signed March 2026 establishes regulatory frameworks for dune/wetland restoration, mangrove protection, seagrass projects. Promotes nature-based coastal resilience, restricts dredging in Terra Ceia Preserve near Tampa Bay.

properties.title: Nature First for Oregon's Beaches
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation advocated for HB 2925 & SB 504 in Oregon's 2025 legislative session to protect public beaches, advance nature-based erosion solutions, and improve shoreline management against climate change impacts.

properties.title: Protect Plastic Ordinance St. Pete
properties.description: Campaign to uphold St. Petersburg Ordinance 356-H restricting single-use plastics and polystyrene to prevent ocean pollution. City Council voted to maintain the 2020 ordinance without repeal in St. Petersburg, FL.

properties.title: Fund FY26 National Coastal and Ocean Programs
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Fund FY26 National Coastal and Ocean Programs
properties.description: Advocacy campaign to secure level federal funding for NOAA coastal/ocean programs in FY2026 budget, including Coastal Zone Management, Marine Sanctuaries, Sea Grant, and coral reef protection. Victory achieved Jan 2026.

properties.title: Bull Kelp is the Best
properties.description: WA designated bull kelp as official state marine forest (April 2025). Vital habitat for orcas, salmon, rockfish. Declined in Puget Sound. Goal: conserve/restore 10,000 acres kelp/eelgrass by 2040.

properties.title: Oregon Foam and Plastic Free Foodware
properties.description: Surfrider Oregon supported SB 795 to streamline removal of abandoned vessels in bays/rivers that release debris (foam, fiberglass, fuel) onto beaches. Law gives state faster authority to act, reducing coastal pollution and cleanup burden.

properties.title: Oregon Seafood Not Sewage
properties.description: Surfrider successfully amended HB 3814 to protect recreational water quality standards from seafood processing wastewater discharge in Oregon coastal waters, ensuring public health protections while supporting industry needs.

properties.title: Stop the Expansion of Plastic Preemption in Florida
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop the Expansion of Plastic Preemption in Florida
properties.description: Surfrider successfully blocked Florida legislation (SB1822/HB565) that would expand state preemption on plastic regulation, preserving local governments' ability to address plastic pollution harming beaches and marine habitats.

properties.title: No Riprap on Tillicum Beach
properties.description: Surfrider opposed 150ft riprap structure at Tillicum Beach mansion, advocating for nature-based erosion control. OPRD denied permit Feb 2025, citing inadequate alternatives analysis and public beach impacts.

properties.title: Protect free parking and ocean access at Ala Wai Boat Harbor
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect free parking and ocean access at Ala Wai Boat Harbor
properties.description: Community campaign successfully blocked SB 364 legislation that would privatize Ala Wai Boat Harbor in Waikīkī, protecting 300 free parking stalls and public ocean access for local surfers and beachgoers. Deferred Feb 2025.

properties.title: Improve State Run Beach Restoration in Hawaiʻi
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Improve State Run Beach Restoration in Hawaiʻi
properties.description: Expands Hawaiʻi beach restoration definition via HB1137 to include dune restoration, native vegetation management, and removal of abandoned erosion structures. Addresses chronic erosion and sea level rise threats to beaches.

properties.title: 28th St Stormwater Infiltration Project
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stormwater Solutions for a Cleaner Coast in Manhattan Beach
properties.description: Manhattan Beach infrastructure to capture & infiltrate 60% of city stormwater before reaching Santa Monica Bay, reducing bacteria & pollutants. Approved by city, advocated by Surfrider using water quality data.

properties.title: Defeated TX Bills Criminalizing Presence in Beach Closure Area
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Defeated TX Bills Criminalizing Presence in Beach Closure Area
properties.description: Defeated TX bills SB2230 & HB4661 that would criminalize presence at Boca Chica beach during closures. Bills threatened public beach access by assuming trespass intent before asking visitors to leave during day-to-day closure changes.

properties.title: Defeated TX Bill Allowing Partial Approval of Beach Access and Dune Protection Plans
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Defeated TX Bill Allowing Partial Approval of Beach Access and Dune Protection Plans
properties.description: Victory: Defeated House Bill 802 that would have allowed Galveston to bypass state law requiring complete Beach Access and Dune Protection plans for Gulf coast municipalities. Upheld existing coastal protection laws.

properties.title: Skip the Stuff Bill in New Jersey
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Passed a Skip the Stuff Bill in New Jersey
properties.description: NJ law requiring restaurants to provide single-use utensils/condiments only upon request, reducing plastic pollution in ocean and communities. Signed Jan 2026, effective Aug 2026.

properties.title: Eliminate single-use plastics and styrofoam from Miami-Dade County Purchasing
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Eliminate single-use plastics and styrofoam from Miami-Dade County Purchasing
properties.description: Miami-Dade County passed Item 11A4 banning single-use plastics and styrofoam from county purchasing to reduce plastic pollution on coastal areas. Victory achieved November 2024.

properties.title: Defend Cannon Beach from Harmful Riprap
properties.description: Surfrider's North Coast Chapter opposed riprap revetment threatening Cannon Beach public shoreline. Despite Planning Commission denials, City Council approved application. Advocacy continues at state level to protect beach access.

properties.title: Motion to Phase out Artificial Turf in Los Angeles
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Motion to Phase out Artificial Turf in Los Angeles
properties.description: Ban artificial turf in LA to prevent microplastic pollution in waterways/beaches. Promotes Ocean Friendly Gardens using nature-based solutions for climate-resilient green spaces reducing urban runoff.

properties.title: Ensure Access to San Onofre State Beach
properties.description: Protecting public access to San Onofre State Beach through lease renewal between California State Parks and Camp Pendleton. 25-year agreement secured for this iconic surf destination and 5th most visited state beach.

properties.title: Protect Wailūa Beach, Kauaʻi- Stop Sandsavers Project
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect Wailūa Beach, Kauaʻi- Stop Sandsavers Project
properties.description: Surfrider Kauaʻi successfully stopped HDOT's experimental Sandsaver plastic blocks at Wailūa Beach through community advocacy. Campaign continues monitoring shoreline mitigation to ensure public access and natural processes.

properties.title: California Funding to Heal Our Coast
properties.description: Securing $50M CA funding for US/Mexico border water infrastructure to address transboundary sewage, trash & industrial waste flowing through Tijuana River into Pacific. Proposition 4 Climate Bond passed 2024.

properties.title: Stop Armoring at Lincoln Beach
properties.description: Surfrider successfully opposed 600ft riprap installation at SeaRidge Condominiums, Depoe Bay. OPRD denied application Sept 2024, citing inadequate alternatives analysis. Protects beach ecology, recreation, prevents erosion to neighbors.

properties.title: Unified Beach Water Quality Monitoring and Assessment Program Approved for South Orange County
properties.description: Charleston Surfrider advocated to close plastic bag ban loophole and restrict polystyrene cutlery. Town Council voted Feb 15, 2024 to ban thick single-use bags previously classified as reusable and require request-only polystyrene.
