properties.funder: Surfrider Foundation, Unknown, California State Water Board, Orange County Health Care Agency, Orange County Public Works, South Orange County Wastewater Authority

properties.title: Miami-Dade Pass the Impervious Surface Ordinance
properties.description: Ordinance to limit impervious surfaces like roads and parking lots in Miami-Dade County to reduce polluted stormwater runoff into waterways, decrease flooding, and enhance climate resilience. Passed unanimously Sept 2024.

properties.title: Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Melbourne Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Melbourne Beach
properties.description: Surfrider Space Coast Chapter worked with Tobacco Free Brevard to ban cigarette smoking in Melbourne Beach parks and beaches to reduce plastic pollution and prevent toxic cigarette litter from harming marine life.

properties.title: Protect Clatsop County Public Beaches and Dunes
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect Clatsop County Public Beaches and Dunes
properties.description: Surfrider's North Coast Chapter worked to update Clatsop County's comprehensive plan for beach/dune management. Oct 2024: County adopted climate-forward updates addressing sea level rise, erosion, public access protection.

properties.title: Strengthen the Statewide Bag Ban in California! Eliminate ALL Plastic Bags
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Strengthen the Statewide Bag Ban in California! Eliminate ALL Plastic Bags
properties.description: Ban all plastic bags at CA grocery stores. SB 1053 signed Sept 2024 requires 50% recycled paper bags, encourages reusables. Prevents ocean pollution, microplastics, wildlife harm from non-recyclable thick plastic bags.

properties.title: Beacons Beach Parking Lot Relocation
properties.description: Relocate blufftop parking lot inland to prevent beach erosion and avoid seawall construction. Approved by CA Coastal Commission Feb 2024 after appeals. Protects Beacons Beach from coastal armoring while maintaining public access.

properties.title: Stopped Construction Site Plastic Pollution in Ocean City, NJ
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stopped Construction Site Plastic Pollution in Ocean City, NJ
properties.description: Surfrider South Jersey Chapter passed ordinance requiring construction sites to contain plastic dust from composite lumber cutting. Contractors must use vacuums, tarps, confined spaces to prevent pollution draining to ocean.

properties.title: Oppose SB 951 Unless Amended
properties.description: Campaign to defend Coastal Act protections at Ocean Beach and Great Highway in San Francisco. Opposed SB 951's coastal zone boundary changes that would remove areas from Coastal Commission oversight. Victory achieved April 2024 with bill amendments.

properties.title: Reduce stormwater pollution into the Indian River Lagoon at Ballard Park
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Reduce stormwater pollution into the Indian River Lagoon at Ballard Park
properties.description: Install native buffer gardens at Ballard Park, Melbourne to intercept stormwater before entering Indian River Lagoon. Addresses high bacteria levels exceeding safe swimming standards. Funded by One Lagoon grant. Approved Aug 2024.
properties.funder: Indian River Lagoon National Estuary Program

properties.title: Suffolk County Water Quality Restoration Fund
properties.description: Ballot measure (Prop2) passed Nov 2024 with 72% support to fund wastewater infrastructure upgrades across Suffolk County, replacing 380,000 polluting septic systems to reduce nitrogen pollution in bays, harbors, and drinking water.

properties.title: Fund the BEACH Act & EPA Clean Water programs FY2025
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Fund the BEACH Act & EPA Clean Water programs FY2025
properties.description: Advocacy campaign securing $9.737M for EPA BEACH Act to fund coastal beach water quality monitoring and public notification programs, plus $3B for Clean Water State Revolving Fund to upgrade wastewater infrastructure.

properties.title: Conduct CDC Public Health Study on Transboundary Pollution Crisis in Tijuana Watershed
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Conduct CDC Public Health Study on Transboundary Pollution Crisis in Tijuana Watershed
properties.description: CDC investigation of health impacts from Tijuana River pollution affecting Imperial Beach, CA. Cross-border sewage causes 34K+ illnesses/year. Study examines water/air contamination in watershed. Supported by CA Senate Resolution 2024.
properties.funder: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

properties.title: Secure FY24 Supplemental Funding for South Bay International Treatment Plant in San Diego
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Secure FY24 Supplemental Funding for South Bay International Treatment Plant in San Diego
properties.description: $156M secured to repair treatment plant addressing transboundary sewage pollution from Tijuana affecting San Diego beaches. Part of $700M solution to reduce toxic flows 95% summer, 76% wet weather.

properties.title: Defend the Coastal Act in the State Legislature in 2024
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Defend the Coastal Act in the State Legislature in 2024
properties.description: Surfrider opposed 4 CA bills (SB 951, SB 1077, SB 1092, AB 2560) seeking to weaken Coastal Act protections. Victory: all amended to remove development exemptions, protecting coastal access and ecosystems while supporting affordable housing.

properties.title: Post Brown Water Advisory Signs at Maui Beach Parks
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Improve Public Water Quality Notifications on Maui
properties.description: Maui County posts Brown Water Advisory signs at lifeguarded beaches to warn public of elevated bacteria and pollutants after heavy rains. Signs improve water quality notifications so beachgoers can make informed ocean safety decisions.

properties.title: Underwater Gardens of Vega Baja y Manatí Marine Reserve
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Underwater Gardens of Vega Baja y Manatí Designated as Marine Reserve
properties.description: 43,700-acre marine reserve in Puerto Rico protecting Elkhorn coral & marine wildlife. Signed into law Aug 2024. Supports biodiversity, ecosystem recovery, research & sustainable tourism through community advocacy.

properties.title: Strengthen the Northeast Canyons & Seamounts Marine Monument
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Strengthen the Northeast Canyons & Seamounts Marine Monument
properties.description: Surfrider advocated for restored protections in the Northeast Canyons & Seamounts Marine Monument, 130 miles off New England. Final management plan released June 2024 restores commercial fishing prohibitions for deep sea corals, whales, turtles.

properties.title: Opened Beach Access in Ocean Grove, NJ
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Opened Beach Access in Ocean Grove, NJ
properties.description: Surfrider's Jersey Shore Chapter ended Sunday morning beach closures in Ocean Grove, NJ. NJDEP issued final order Dec 2025 stopping closures, upholding Public Trust Doctrine rights for all beachgoers.

properties.title: North Shore Beach Management Plan
properties.description: Comprehensive beach management plan for North Shore Oʻahu (Sunset Point to Sharks Cove) analyzing coastal erosion, recommending measures for government/community to preserve public beaches while addressing property & infrastructure challenges.

properties.title: Ban Intentional Balloon Releases, Florida
properties.description: Florida banned intentional balloon releases on June 24, 2024, reclassifying them as litter. Surfrider's network advocated to close a loophole allowing 10 balloons/day, protecting marine life from deadly balloon pollution.

properties.title: Pass San Diego County-wide Emergency Proclamation for Border Pollution
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Pass San Diego County-wide Emergency Proclamation for Border Pollution
properties.description: Campaign to declare county-wide emergency for US/Mexico border pollution crisis affecting South San Diego beaches. Seeks federal emergency declaration to fund water infrastructure improvements and reduce transboundary pollution.

properties.title: Ban The Butt Santa Cruz County
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban The Butt Santa Cruz County
properties.description: Santa Cruz County banned sale of filtered tobacco products to reduce plastic pollution. Cigarette butts are 24.5% of Monterey Bay shoreline litter, leaching toxins into marine ecosystems and breaking into microplastics.

properties.title: Stop Illegal Coastal Development above Cueva las Golondrinas in Aguadilla, Puerto Rico
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop Illegal Coastal Development above Cueva las Golondrinas in Aguadilla, Puerto Rico
properties.description: Coalition stopped illegal construction above brown pelican nesting site in Aguadilla Bay. Court ordered demolition & habitat restoration in Feb 2023. Includes mangrove restoration, cleanups, species studies. Goal: marine reserve.

properties.title: Protect Public Beach Access in Key Largo
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect Public Beach Access in Key Largo
properties.description: Defending Sunset Point Park beach access in Key Largo from privatization by adjacent HOA. Surfrider advocated to Monroe County to preserve public right-of-way. Victory: BOCC rejected code change; court ruled for county ownership 2025.

properties.title: Obtain Funding Transfer Authority Language from Congress
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Obtain Funding Transfer Authority Language from Congress
properties.description: Congressional authority to fund wastewater infrastructure at US/Mexico border. Addresses billions of gallons of sewage/industrial waste polluting San Diego beaches. Aims to close $700M funding gap for solutions.

properties.title: Protect Special-Use Beach Parking in Galveston
properties.description: Successfully preserved special-use parking at Stewart Beach for anglers, disabled people, and boaters. Galveston City Council reversed 2023 elimination vote in Oct 2024, maintaining accessible year-round beach access.

properties.title: Stop the Superdrive Cannon Beach
properties.description: Campaign to deny private driveway development on public beach right-of-way in Cannon Beach, OR. Preserved beach access, prevented infrastructure in climate hazard zone. Won unanimous City Council denial Aug 2023.

properties.title: Defeat proposals in Congress to expand offshore drilling in FY 2024 budget bill
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Defeat proposals in Congress to expand offshore drilling in FY 2024 budget bill
properties.description: Surfrider successfully campaigned to remove harmful riders from FY24 budget that would have mandated oil/gas lease sales in Gulf of Mexico and Alaska, protecting Rice's Whale and North Atlantic Right Whale from drilling operations.

properties.title: Pass SB 272 to require Local Coastal Program Updates by 2034
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Support Sea Level Rise Plans for the Entire California Coast
properties.description: California law requiring all coastal areas to update Local Coastal Programs accounting for sea level rise by 2034. Uses best science and community engagement for transparent planning decisions.

properties.title: Protect Sonoma County's Magnificent Coast
properties.description: Surfrider's Sonoma Coast chapter campaigned to preserve parcel-specific coastal protections in the Local Coastal Program for undeveloped areas including Fort Ross, Timber Cove, Bodega Bay. Won July 2023.

properties.title: Washington Coastal Resiliency Funding
properties.description: $3.9M funding for WA Dept. of Ecology to address coastal flooding, erosion, sea level rise. Expands vulnerability assessments, technical assistance, local capacity for resilience projects along 3,026 miles of coastline.

properties.title: Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Delray Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Delray Beach
properties.description: Campaign to ban cigarette smoking from Delray Beach parks and beaches to reduce plastic pollution and prevent cigarette litter from harming marine life. Ordinance passed August 16, 2022.

properties.title: Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Islamorada
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Islamorada
properties.description: Ban cigarette smoking on Islamorada beaches/parks to protect Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary from plastic pollution and cigarette litter harming marine life. Passed ordinance July 2022 after advocacy campaign.

properties.title: Stop Ventura County's Agricultural Pollution from Entering Our Ocean
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop Ventura County's Agricultural Pollution from Entering Our Ocean
properties.description: LA Regional Board adopted waste discharge requirements to reduce nitrate and pesticide pollution from agricultural land into Ventura County rivers, ocean, and groundwater through monitoring and grower compliance.

properties.title: Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Palm Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Palm Beach
properties.description: Palm Beach passed ordinance banning cigarette smoking on municipal beaches/parks to reduce plastic pollution and cigarette litter harming marine life. Effective July 2022 following Florida HB105 passage.

properties.title: Don't Mess with Texas Beach Access - Stop SB 2026 / HB3859
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Don't Mess with Texas Beach Access - Stop SB 2026 / HB3859
properties.description: Victory campaign defeating Texas Senate Bill 2026 and HB 3859 to protect public beach access rights along Texas coastline. Surfrider Foundation advocacy effort preserving coastal access for all.

properties.title: Port Hueneme Plastics Reduction
properties.description: Surfrider Ventura County advocated for Port Hueneme ordinance banning EPS and single-use foodware. Ban effective May 2023 with 6-month education period, enforcement starting November 2023.

properties.title: Restore the Coastal Resilience Budget
properties.description: Surfrider led 35 orgs to restore CA's coastal resilience budget after $481M cuts. Victory: $298.2M restored for climate resiliency, $69.5M for sea level rise planning, funding living shorelines & adaptation plans.

properties.title: Massive New Development at the Ventura County Fairgrounds Prevented
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Massive New Development at the Ventura County Fairgrounds Prevented
properties.description: Surfrider prevented development of baseball stadium and malls at historic wetlands in flood-prone coastal zone. Proposal threatened beach access and ignored sea level rise impacts. Board voted 5-0 against in 2023.

properties.title: Passed a Bag Bill in Salisbury
properties.description: Surfrider Ocean City Chapter passed Ordinance 2756 banning single-use plastic bags in Salisbury, MD. 10 cent fee on paper/reusable bags. Effective July 1, 2023. Aims to pressure MD state legislation.

properties.title: Cleaning Up Unauthorized Shoreline Structures
properties.description: Hawaii law SB1391 authorizes liens on properties with illegal shoreline structures (seawalls, sandbags) encroaching public lands. Addresses chronic beach erosion affecting 70% of sandy beaches on Maui, Oahu, Kauai.

properties.title: Reduced permit fees for coastal restoration and public access projects in California
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Reduced permit fees for coastal restoration and public access projects in California
properties.description: AB 2160 reduces coastal development permit costs/times for nonprofits and agencies doing habitat restoration and public access projects. Allows fee waivers at local level with Coastal Commission appeal option.

properties.title: Open the Gates at Hoʻokipa
properties.description: Opens Hoʻokipa Beach Park gates at 5:30am (vs 7am) for safe parking access ocean-side of highway, preventing surfers from crossing dangerous traffic. Partnership with County of Maui for early beach access during winter surf season.

properties.title: Seabed Mining Banned In Hawaiʻi
properties.description: Hawaii banned seabed mining in state waters (3 miles from shore) via SB 2575, signed July 9. Surfrider's Hawaii chapters advocated through education and grassroots efforts to protect deep-sea ecosystems, fisheries, and tourism.

properties.title: Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Monroe County
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Monroe County
properties.description: Ban cigarette smoking on Monroe County beaches/parks to reduce plastic pollution and cigarette litter harming marine life. Ordinance passed Aug 2022 with Surfrider support, effective countywide.

properties.title: Ban Butts from Our Beaches, St. Pete
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Butts from Our Beaches, St. Pete
properties.description: Ban cigarette smoking on St. Petersburg's beaches, parks, and piers to reduce plastic pollution and prevent toxic cigarette butt litter from harming Gulf Coast marine life and waterways.

properties.title: Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Miami Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Miami Beach
properties.description: Ban cigarette smoking on Miami Beach beaches and parks to reduce plastic pollution and prevent cigarette litter from harming marine life. Ordinance passed Sept 2022, effective 2023.

properties.title: Congress Increases NOAA's Budget for 2023
properties.description: Surfrider campaign secured increased 2023 federal funding for NOAA coastal programs including $81.5M for Coastal Zone Management, $68M for Marine Sanctuaries, $80M for Sea Grant, protecting coasts from climate change and pollution.

properties.title: Protected Maritime Forest at McLean-Spell Park
properties.description: Prevented development of 30-acre maritime forest in Emerald Isle, NC. Forest protects homes from hurricanes, aids stormwater absorption & erosion prevention. Town abandoned dog park plan, will maintain trails instead.

properties.title: Solana Beach Balloon Ban
properties.description: Ban on sale, use & release of lighter-than-air balloons to protect marine life from plastic pollution. Surfrider San Diego volunteers campaigned Mar-May 2022, City Council unanimously approved ordinance in Solana Beach, CA.

properties.title: Laguna Beach Balloon Ban
properties.description: Ban on retail sales, release and use of mylar and latex balloons in Laguna Beach to prevent beach litter and protect marine life from plastic pollution. Ordinance enacted Feb 2023, first in Orange County.

properties.title: Protect Our Mangroves, Miami!
properties.description: Campaign to prevent Miami from banning mangrove planting in waterfront parks. Mangroves protect coasts from flooding, erosion, sea level rise. Victory: ordinance withdrawn May 31, 2022 after advocacy.

properties.title: Reduce Cigarette Butt Litter in Encinitas
properties.description: Ban smoking in public spaces to reduce toxic plastic cigarette filter pollution. Butts are #1 littered item, 20-30% of beach cleanup finds. Ordinance approved April 2023 in Encinitas, CA coastal city.

properties.title: Litigation to Defend Denial of Exxon Oil Trucking Plan
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Litigation to Defend Denial of Exxon Oil Trucking Plan
properties.description: Surfrider defended Santa Barbara County's denial of Exxon's oil trucking plan to transport crude from offshore rigs. Victory achieved Feb 2024 when Exxon dismissed lawsuit, protecting coastal waters from spill risks.

properties.title: Stop Kīkīaola Ditch Pollution
properties.description: Lawsuit settlement requiring water quality testing, cleanup of wastewater/asphalt plant pollution, and NPDES permits for Kīkīaola ditch discharging sediment and pesticides into Kekaha Beach waters, protecting coral reefs and fishing grounds.

properties.title: Urge Congress to Invest in Ocean-Based Climate Solutions
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Urge Congress to Invest in Ocean-Based Climate Solutions
properties.description: Advocacy campaign resulting in $3B+ for coastal restoration, blue carbon ecosystems, and climate resilience through the Inflation Reduction Act. Includes grants for states/tribes and NOAA facilities.

properties.title: Strengthen Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: Surfrider supports NOAA's Restoration Blueprint for Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary, advocating for expanded boundaries, cruise ship discharge bans, water quality improvements, and climate protections for coral reefs and marine habitat.

properties.title: Protect Access to Cherry Point
properties.description: Campaign to repeal Gulf Rd closure ordinance and maintain public viewing access to Cherry Point beach for water recreationists, community science, and mobility-limited visitors in Whatcom County.

properties.title: Fund Enforcement of the Coastal Act!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Fund Enforcement of the Coastal Act!
properties.description: Secured $5M in CA 2022-23 budget for Coastal Act enforcement to resolve 3,000 violations including illegal wetland destruction, habitat loss, blocked public access. Supports CA Coastal Commission enforcement personnel.

properties.title: California Seabed Mining Prevention Act
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Bill Passed to Prevent Seabed Mining in California
properties.description: Law banning seabed mining in CA waters to protect marine habitats, fisheries, wildlife. Prevents hard mineral extraction leases. Signed Sept 2023 by Gov. Newsom after unanimous bipartisan passage.

properties.title: Papahānaumokuākea National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: Marine sanctuary designation in Northwestern Hawaiian Islands adds protections to existing monument. Co-managed by NOAA, State of Hawaii, Office of Hawaiian Affairs. Effective March 2025.

properties.title: Stop Shrimp Farm Water Pollution
properties.description: Surfrider Kauai secured stronger water permit for shrimp farm eliminating 6,000ft mixing zone, imposing end-of-pipe pollutant limits to protect nearshore waters from fish kills and pollution flowing to Pacific Ocean. Victory Dec 2024.

properties.title: Limit the Use of Emergency Shoreline Hardening Permits for Chronic Erosion
properties.description: Hawaii DLNR updated 2023 policy to stop emergency permits for seawalls/sandbags causing beach loss. Enforces removal of expired structures. Protects public beaches from chronic erosion hardening (230+ exemptions in 20 years).

properties.title: Save the Waves at Bob Hall Pier in Corpus Christi, TX
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Save the Waves at Bob Hall Pier in Corpus Christi, TX
properties.description: Secured two-piling pier design for Bob Hall Pier after Hurricane Hanna damage to preserve quality sandbars and surfing waves. Texas Coastal Bend Chapter advocated for design that maintains wave formation at this premiere Gulf Coast surf spot.

properties.title: Save Public Access at Keawakapu
properties.description: Protecting free public beach parking at Keawakapu Beach, Maui. County took over state land management in 2022 after private operator harassment issues. Community advocating for permanent county control of half-acre lot.

properties.title: Balloons and Lanterns Blow, Broward!
properties.description: Broward County Chapter campaign to ban balloon/lantern releases and regulate single-use plastics on county property. Prevents wildlife deaths from ingestion. Victory: lanterns, confetti banned Feb 2023.

properties.title: Plastics Ordinance Passed in Lauderhill
properties.description: Lauderhill, FL banned single-use plastics by city vendors and balloon releases to protect marine wildlife. Ordinance passed unanimously 5-0 on Jan 10, 2022 to reduce beach pollution and microplastics.

properties.title: Hillsborough County Fertilizer Ordinance
properties.description: Fertilizer ban to prevent runoff fueling red tide, fish kills, and seagrass loss in Tampa Bay. Passed 7-0 by County Commissioners on November 17th 2021 after 11-year advocacy effort.

properties.title: Party Ocean-Friendly Campaign - Palm Beach Gardens Resolution 69
properties.description: Surfrider supported Resolution 69 prohibiting balloons, confetti, glitter on public property to protect wildlife and marine environment. Passed 4-1 Dec 2021. Promotes eco-friendly alternatives like native plants, flower petals.

properties.title: Comprehensive Solution Selected to Stop Border Sewage
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Comprehensive Solution Selected to Stop Border Sewage
properties.description: EPA selected Alternative I-2 to address Tijuana River transboundary sewage pollution affecting San Diego beaches. River diversion system for US treatment aims to reduce pollution 95% in summer, 76% overall. Needs $625M funding.
properties.funder: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), United States Mexico Canada Agreement (USMCA)

properties.title: Protect Beach Access in Scarborough
properties.description: Campaign opposing parking fee increases at Scarborough beaches to maintain equitable public access. Advocates against raising rates from $5 to $10 for reduced hours and $1 to $2/hr for metered spots.

properties.title: Encinitas Balloon Ban
properties.description: Campaign to ban sale, use, and release of lighter-than-air balloons in Encinitas, CA. Surfrider SD activists supported effort from environmental commission through unanimous City Council approval. Model ordinance for other cities.

properties.title: Victory! Increase funding for Oʻahu Natural Resources
properties.description: Honolulu passed Bill 40 allocating 0.25% of County TAT (3% hotel tax) to natural resources, providing $7M/year for beach/park conservation, visitor impact mitigation, and coastal resilience on Oʻahu. Passed Dec 14, 2021.

properties.title: City of St. Augustine Beach Balloon Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of St. Augustine Beach Balloon Ordinance
properties.description: Surfrider First Coast Chapter successfully campaigned for St. Augustine Beach to ban intentional balloon releases to protect marine wildlife from balloon litter pollution along Florida's coast.

properties.title: Atlantic Beach Polystyrene Ordinance
properties.description: Ban on polystyrene foam sale/distribution on Atlantic Beach city property and beach. Passed Dec 2021 to reduce plastic pollution, protect marine life, and prevent microplastics from entering ocean ecosystems.

properties.title: Plan For Sea Level Rise and Resiliency, Florida
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Plan For Sea Level Rise and Resiliency, Florida
properties.description: Establish statewide Office of Resilience, develop flood vulnerability & sea level rise data, create state resilience action plan for Florida roadways. Victory: CS/SB7053 signed May 2022.

properties.title: Protect Dunes in Miami Beach
properties.description: Surfrider Miami Chapter restores dunes, removes invasive plants since 2014. Advocated for 2021 ordinance protecting coastal dune system from unauthorized activities threatening integrity, health and habitat in Miami Beach.

properties.title: St. Johns County Balloon and Lantern Release Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/St.Johns County Balloon and Lantern Release Ordinance
properties.description: First Coast Surfrider led coalition to ban balloon/lantern releases in St. Johns County, FL (first in state). Protects marine life from ingesting balloon litter mistaken for jellyfish. Passed unanimously Jan 2022 after petition campaign.

properties.title: SB 474 - Sea Level Rise Disclosure
properties.description: Hawaii law requiring sellers to disclose if properties are in sea level rise exposure areas (3.2ft by 2050). Protects homebuyers from climate risks and limits harmful seawalls. Passed June 6, 2021.

properties.title: Fund the California Coastal Commission!
properties.description: Advocacy campaign to secure $40M funding for CA Coastal Commission's sea level rise unit and Whale Tail grants. Protects beaches from erosion, ensures coastal access, oversees local coastal programs. Signed July 2021.

properties.title: Pass a Comprehensive Foodware Ordinance in Newport, OR
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Pass a Comprehensive Foodware Ordinance in Newport, OR
properties.description: Newport, OR banned single-use plastic/foam foodware to reduce ocean pollution. Plastic utensils are top 10 coastal cleanup items. Ordinance 2178 passed Dec 6, 2021 restricting EPS foam and plastic foodware.

properties.title: Banned the Sale of Balloons in East Hampton, NY
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Banned the Sale of Balloons in East Hampton, NY
properties.description: Eastern Long Island Chapter banned helium balloon sales in East Hampton to prevent beach/ocean litter, wildlife harm, and power outages. Passed unanimously Dec 2021 after advocacy with local trustee and 30+ organizations.

properties.title: Ban Balloon Releases in City of St. Augustine
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Balloon Releases in City of St. Augustine
properties.description: Surfrider First Coast Chapter successfully campaigned to ban intentional balloon releases in St. Augustine to protect marine wildlife from balloon litter. City commissioners approved the ban on August 9th.

properties.title: Strengthened Delaware's Bag Law
properties.description: Delaware Chapter helped pass HB-212 in 2021, closing plastic bag thickness loopholes and expanding store coverage. Worked with Plastic Free Delaware through testimony and advocacy to strengthen weak existing bag law.

properties.title: Reducing Plastic Pollution in Delaware
properties.description: 3-year campaign by Surfrider Delaware Chapter to ban EPS foam foodware and plastic stirrers/straws. Senate Bill 51 passed June 2023, signed Aug 2023. Reduces common beach cleanup items harming marine life.

properties.title: Protect Humboldt Bay from Fish Factory Impacts
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Massive Fish Factory Impacts Must Be Fully Considered
properties.description: Campaign opposing Nordic Aquafarms' massive land-based salmon factory on Samoa Peninsula. Project would intake 10M gallons/day from Humboldt Bay and discharge 12M gallons to Pacific, requiring full Environmental Impact Report.

properties.title: Surfing, other wave-riding exempted from MI water entry prohibition
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Surfing, other wave-riding exempted from MI water entry prohibition
properties.description: Surfrider testimony influenced Michigan DNR to amend water entry prohibition during hazardous conditions, exempting surfing, skimboarding, and bodyboarding, preserving wave-riding access at state parks.

properties.title: Oxnard EPS Foam Ban
properties.description: Oxnard City Council unanimously banned expanded polystyrene (EPS/Styrofoam) to protect marine life, oceans, and beaches. Ordinance prohibits use, manufacturing, distribution of single-use EPS foodware. Effective Feb 16, 2023.

properties.title: Polystyrene Foam, Balloon and Confetti Ordinance in Boca Raton
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Polystyrene Foam, Balloon and Confetti Ordinance in Boca Raton
properties.description: Boca Raton banned foam, balloons & confetti at beachside parks to protect sea turtles & marine wildlife from dangerous litter. Ordinance passed June 8th by city commission to remove these items from city property.

properties.title: Keep National Parks Free From Fees in San Francisco and Marin
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Keep National Parks Free From Fees in San Francisco and Marin
properties.description: Successfully opposed NPS parking fees at 7 Bay Area beaches (Baker, Lands End, Rodeo, Stinson etc). Generated 379+ comments. Protects equitable coastal access for all, especially low-income visitors. Completed 2021.

properties.title: HB 243 - Sea Level Rise Adaptation
properties.description: Hawaii law requiring state agencies to identify facilities vulnerable to sea level rise, assess mitigation options, coordinate adaptation efforts, and report annually. Signed July 7, 2021 to protect beaches and coastal communities.

properties.title: Support Senate Bill 1 (Atkins) - Address Sea Level Rise
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Support Senate Bill 1 (Atkins) - Address Sea Level Rise
properties.description: California law addressing sea level rise through planning, physical adaptations, and governance structures to protect coastal ecosystems and communities. Signed Sept 2021 to address $150B property risk.

properties.title: NOAA's Coastal Management Budget Increased for 2022
properties.description: Surfrider campaign secured increased 2022 federal funding for NOAA coastal programs including zone management, resilience, estuarine reserves, and Sea Grant through grassroots advocacy and 125 Congressional visits.

properties.title: Supported construction of the South Fork Wind Project
properties.description: Surfrider's Eastern Long Island Chapter supported South Fork Wind offshore wind project after environmental review, advocating for BOEM approval with high environmental and recreational protections. Project completed.

properties.title: Puerto Rico Foam Ordinance
properties.description: Law 51 bans expanded polystyrene foam food containers (cups, plates, clamshells) throughout Puerto Rico to reduce marine plastic pollution from single-use foam products entering coastal waters and beaches.

properties.title: Ban Balloon and Sky Lantern Releases in Tequesta
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Balloon and Sky Lantern Releases in Tequesta
properties.description: Surfrider Treasure Coast Chapter campaigns to ban intentional balloon and sky lantern releases in Tequesta to protect marine wildlife from ingestion and entanglement hazards in this coastal Florida community.

properties.title: Stop Sewage Spills at the Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop Sewage Spills at the Beach
properties.description: Campaign to stop 850B+ gallons annual raw sewage spills into US waterways via wastewater infrastructure upgrades. Secured $27.35B EPA CWSRF funding through 2021 Infrastructure Act. Nationwide coastal protection effort.
properties.funder: EPA Clean Water State Revolving Fund

properties.title: City of Boynton Beach Polystyrene Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Boynton Beach Polystyrene Ordinance
properties.description: Ban polystyrene foam food-ware on Boynton Beach city property to reduce plastic pollution. Polystyrene is a major beach litter source. Ordinance passed April 20th by city commission.

properties.title: City of Boynton Beach Balloon and Confetti Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Boynton Beach Balloon and Confetti Ordinance
properties.description: Prohibits balloons and plastic confetti at beachside parks and city property to protect sea turtles and marine wildlife from ingesting dangerous litter. Passed by city commission April 20th.
properties.funder: Surfrider Foundation Palm Beach County Chapter

properties.title: Smoke Free Beaches and Parks, Florida!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Smoke Free Beaches and Parks, Florida!
properties.description: Campaign to allow Florida counties/municipalities to regulate smoking on beaches/parks. Addresses cigarette butt pollution (most abundant coastal debris). HB 105 signed June 2022, enabling local smoke-free ordinances statewide.

properties.title: Banned EPS Foam Food Containers in Virginia
properties.description: Virginia banned EPS foam food containers by 2025. Surfrider VA advocated for HB1902, signed March 2021, protecting marine life from non-recyclable foam pollution that leaches toxins and harms coastal ecosystems.

properties.title: Atlantic Beach Coal Ash Resolution
properties.description: Campaign to stop coal ash shipments through Jacksonville Ports after 2021 barge spill released thousands of tons into ocean near Mayport surf break. Resolution 21-82 passed Dec 2021 banning coal ash receipt at Atlantic Beach ports.

properties.title: LA County Foodware Accessories Upon Request - Skip The Stuff!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/LA County Foodware Accessories Upon Request - Skip The Stuff!
properties.description: Campaign to reduce plastic pollution by requiring LA County restaurants and delivery services to ask customers before providing single-use takeout accessories like utensils, napkins, and condiments rather than automatically including them.

properties.title: Banned the Intentional Release of Balloons in Delaware
properties.description: Surfrider Delaware Chapter passed Bill SB24 banning intentional balloon releases to protect marine life from choking/entanglement. Signed Sept 20, 2021 by Gov. Carney with Plastic Free Delaware.

properties.title: Laguna Beach Plastic Foodware Ordinance
properties.description: Ordinance banning plastic straws, cutlery, disposable foodware & takeout bags at restaurants citywide. Includes EPS foam ban at beaches/parks. Passed June 2021 to reduce ocean plastic pollution in Laguna Beach, CA.

properties.title: City of LA Foodware Accessories Upon Request - Skip the Stuff!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of LA Foodware Accessories Upon Request - Skip the Stuff!
properties.description: LA ordinance requiring single-use utensils, straws, condiments, napkins only upon request from food vendors. Reduces waste polluting waterways. Passed April 2021, signed May 2021 by Mayor Garcetti.

properties.title: Florida Sea Level Rise Rule-making
properties.description: Surfrider worked with coalition to ensure Florida institutes robust regulations requiring sea level rise analysis for state-funded coastal construction projects, effective July 2022.

properties.title: Keep Del Mar Rail Relocation on Track
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Keep Del Mar Rail Relocation on Track
properties.description: Surfrider advocated to relocate 1.7 miles of railroad off Del Mar's eroding bluffs and prevent rail agencies from bypassing California Coastal Act review, protecting beach access and coastal environment (2020-2024).

properties.title: Re-open Public Beach Parking in Bal Harbour
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Re-open Public Beach Parking in Bal Harbour
properties.description: Restore 60 public parking spaces at Bal Harbour Jetty, a prime surfing location in Miami Dade. Activists coordinated with local officials to restore public beach access for surfing and swimming. Successfully restored Sept 2020.

properties.title: Save Biscayne Bay
properties.description: Campaign to protect Biscayne Bay after 2020 fishkill. Organized meetings, rallies to address pollution and dumping. Secured $20M funding from state and county for bay restoration and protection.
properties.funder: Florida State Government and Miami-Dade County

properties.title: City of Miami Beach Fertilizer Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Miami Beach Fertilizer Ordinance
properties.description: Surfrider Miami advocated for fertilizer restrictions to reduce nutrient pollution in Biscayne Bay. Successful campaign led to unanimous ordinance passage in Jan 2021 to regulate fertilizer use and prevent algal blooms.

properties.title: Federal Board Ruling Ensures Coastal Railroad Projects Must Adhere to the Coastal Act
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Federal Board Ruling Ensures Coastal Railroad Projects Must Adhere to the Coastal Act
properties.description: Federal Surface Transportation Board denied NCTD's exemption from environmental review for Del Mar railroad bluff stabilization, protecting coastal regulations and supporting rail relocation by 2035.

properties.title: Water Notice Sign at South Pointe Outfall
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Water Notice Sign at South Pointe Outfall
properties.description: Miami Chapter detected elevated enterococcus levels at South Pointe Park outfall through weekly testing in 2020. City installed permanent warning sign advising against swimming/recreation after activists presented findings.

properties.title: City of Sunny Isles Beach Polystyrene Ordinance in Public Parks, Offices and Beaches
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Sunny Isles Beach Polystyrene Ordinance in Public Parks, Offices and Beaches
properties.description: Ban polystyrene foam food-ware on Sunny Isles Beach city property. Addresses major beach litter source found in cleanups. Ordinance passed March 18th prohibiting foam on all municipal property including beaches and parks.

properties.title: Funding for New Wastewater System Technology to Reduce Cost of Cesspool Conversion
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Funding for New Wastewater System Technology to Reduce Cost of Cesspool Conversion
properties.description: Hawaii project to eliminate 83,000 cesspools discharging 52M gallons/day sewage into coastal waters. UH pilot program tests affordable wastewater tech; DOH staffing for conversion support. Goal: cesspool elimination by 2050.

properties.title: Restore Public Beach Access at Koʻolina
properties.description: Restored public parking and beach access to Ko'olina Lagoons after resort blocked 180 public parking spots citing COVID. City violation notice issued Oct 2020, full access restored Feb 2021 through community advocacy.

properties.title: Protect Coral Reefs in the City of Key West by Limiting Cruise Ships
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect Coral Reefs in the City of Key West by Limiting Cruise Ships in Key West
properties.description: Limit cruise ships to 1,500 passengers/day in Key West to protect coral reefs from sediment damage that blocks light and kills marine life. Ballot measure passed Nov 2020, reducing cruise visits 95%.

properties.title: Ban Seabed Mining in Washington
properties.description: Washington passed SB 5145 prohibiting seabed mining in state waters to protect marine ecosystems, fisheries, and coastal communities from destructive mining practices. Signed into law May 3rd, 2021 by Governor Inslee.

properties.title: Regulate Fertilizer Use in Miami Dade County
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Regulate Fertilizer Use in Miami Dade County
properties.description: Surfrider Miami advocates for fertilizer restrictions to reduce nutrient flow into Biscayne Bay, preventing algal blooms and fishkills. County passed ordinance April 20th to protect the bay.

properties.title: Protect Wāwāmalu Sand Dunes
properties.description: Coalition stopped illegal off-roading at Wāwāmalu Beach, Oʻahu by installing barriers in 2021. Protects Hawaiian Monk Seal habitat, native plants, and sensitive sand dune ecosystems at Kaiwi State Scenic Shoreline.

properties.title: Protect Oregon's Seafloor
properties.description: Strengthen policies protecting Oregon's seafloor and beaches from undersea cable impacts. Advocates for environmental standards, financial assurance, and planning for telecommunication projects after abandoned cable left equipment.

properties.title: Solana Beach Seawall Denied
properties.description: California Coastal Commission denied seawall application for Pacific Avenue gap in Solana Beach to prevent beach narrowing and protect public access. Property owners attempted to bypass deed restrictions through neighboring applications.

properties.title: Orange County Beach Access
properties.description: Surfrider urged Orange County to develop COVID-19 beach access plan for 42 miles of coast, balancing public health with active recreation (surfing, swimming, walking). Advocating equitable coastal access.

properties.title: Court Victory for Beach Access Rights in California Lent Case
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Court Victory for Beach Access Rights in California Lent Case
properties.description: Surfrider defended CA Coastal Commission's $4.2M fine against Malibu homeowner blocking public beach access for 9 years. CA Supreme Court denied appeal July 2021, setting precedent for beach access enforcement.

properties.title: Sharp Park Beach Saved From Hazardous Development
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Sharp Park Beach Saved From Hazardous Development!
properties.description: Pacifica beach protected from 7-unit condo development relying on seawall. California Coastal Commission denied project 6-5, preventing beach loss from armoring. Surfrider argued against loophole allowing new development on hazardous coastal sites.

properties.title: Defend the Federal Clean Water Act
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Supreme Court Upholds the Clean Water Act
properties.description: Surfrider won Supreme Court case stopping Lahaina Wastewater Facility from discharging 3-5M gallons daily of treated sewage into Pacific via groundwater, devastating reef at Kahekili Beach, Maui since 2012.

properties.title: A Portion of Pleasure Point Saved From Never Ending Seawalls
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/A Portion of Pleasure Point Saved From Never Ending Seawalls
properties.description: Surfrider Santa Cruz appealed permit for 8,200 sq ft blufftop house at Opal Cliffs relying on illegal seawalls. CA Coastal Commission denied development in May 2023, preventing beach erosion and creating path to coastal resiliency.

properties.title: City of Neptune Beach Balloon Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Neptune Beach Balloon Ordinance
properties.description: Surfrider First Coast advocates for Neptune Beach to ban intentional balloon releases to protect marine wildlife from balloon litter. Promotes alternatives like tree planting and beach cleanups.

properties.title: Remove Fencing from Pacific City Beach
properties.description: Surfrider campaign to remove unpermitted fencing installed by homeowners on Pacific City beach that violated Oregon's Beach Bill public easement. Victory achieved May 2020 when all property owners removed fencing.

properties.title: Help Designate the Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Help Designate the Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: Advocacy to designate 140-mile sanctuary from Cambria to Santa Barbara. First sanctuary focused on indigenous culture and ocean habitat protection. Nominated 2015, remains in inventory until 2025.

properties.title: Save the Avila Coast
properties.description: Campaign opposing luxury resort overdevelopment at Avila Beach, CA. Protects coastal access, sacred Chumash sites, and marine recreation from traffic/crowds. Reduced resort from 5,000 to 3,000 capacity after advocacy.

properties.title: Santa Barbara Oil Trucking Proposal STOPPED!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Santa Barbara Oil Trucking Proposal STOPPED!
properties.description: Stopped Exxon's proposal to truck oil from offshore platforms, preventing risk to coastal economy & marine ecosystems. Coalition effort protected Santa Barbara's beaches from potential spills after 2015 Refugio disaster.
properties.funder: Surfrider Foundation Santa Barbara County Chapter

properties.title: BEACH Act Funding Saved for FY2021
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/BEACH Act Funding Saved for FY2021
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation led campaign to save EPA BEACH Grant Program funding for coastal states' beach water quality monitoring and public notification programs, preventing elimination proposed in 2021 federal budget.

properties.title: Increased Water Quality Testing in Ft. Lauderdale, FL
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Increased Water Quality Testing in Ft. Lauderdale, FL
properties.description: After 125M+ gallons sewage spilled 2019-2020, Surfrider Broward advocated for expanded water testing at recreation sites. City allocated $100K in Nov 2020 for testing 10 sites in coastal waters and rivers.

properties.title: Halt the Shoreline Armoring at Puʻuloa Rifle Range
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Halt the Shoreline Armoring at Puʻuloa Rifle Range
properties.description: Surfrider Oʻahu demanded EIS for 1,500ft barrier at ʻEwa Beach firing range. Navy relocated berms inland in 2023 after community pressure. Concerns: coral reefs, erosion, lead contamination from bullets eroding into ocean.

properties.title: Oppose Shoreline Armoring at Breakers Point
properties.description: Prevented sheet pile wall installation at Ecola Creek Estuary, Cannon Beach OR. Protected essential salmon habitat from accelerated sediment transport and beach erosion. Victory achieved May 2020.

properties.title: Allow Ocean Recreation Access When & Where It's Safe
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Allow Ocean Rec Access When & Where It's Safe
properties.description: COVID-19 beach access advocacy in NH. Surfrider successfully campaigned to reopen seacoast beaches June 1, 2020 for all ocean recreation (not just walking/swimming), while ensuring safety protocols and equitable parking access.

properties.title: Follow Mass Beach Reopening Guidelines in COVID-19
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Follow Mass Beach Reopening Guidelines in COVID-19
properties.description: Advocated for clear public noticing of beach access rules during COVID-19 reopening. Worked with MA DCR to ensure consistent parking and amenity information across state beaches, particularly Nahant Beach, achieving updated guidance June 2020.

properties.title: Stop Plastic Bag Pollution in Virginia
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop Plastic Bag Pollution in Virginia
properties.description: Coalition passed VA legislation allowing local governments to tax single-use plastic bags up to 5 cents, protecting Chesapeake Bay waterways and beaches from common pollution. Effective Jan 1, 2021.

properties.title: EPA requires Hawaii to account for plastic pollution under Clean Water Act
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/EPA requires Hawaii to account for plastic pollution under Clean Water Act
properties.description: EPA ordered Hawaii DOH to evaluate plastic pollution data for state waters. Lawsuit by Surfrider, CBD, and Sustainable Coastlines Hawaii challenged EPA's failure to declare waters impaired under Clean Water Act section 303(d).

properties.title: City of Hollywood Single Use Plastic and Polystyrene Ordinance in Public Parks, Offices and Beaches
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Hollywood Single Use Plastic and Polystyrene Ordinance in Public Parks, Offices and Beaches
properties.description: Ban polystyrene foam food-ware & single use plastics on Hollywood city property. Ordinance passed Feb 2020 to reduce plastic pollution found in beach cleanups. Applies to city offices, buildings, events.

properties.title: Improve the Hawaii Department of Health's beach monitoring program
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Improve the Hawaii Department of Health's beach monitoring program
properties.description: Campaign to enhance Hawaii beach water quality testing. Achieved 2024 victory: HDOH now continues testing popular Tier 1 beaches during Brown Water Advisories, improving public health protection through better monitoring.

properties.title: Stop the Flood of Takeout Food Plastics in NYC!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stop the Flood of Takeout Food Plastics in NYC!
properties.description: NYC law requiring food delivery apps & restaurants to let customers opt-in for single-use plastics (utensils, napkins). Reduces plastic pollution flowing from streets to waterways & ocean. Passed Jan 2023.

properties.title: Ban the Foam on Kauai
properties.description: Kauai banned polystyrene foam food containers in 2020 to prevent marine pollution. Foam breaks into pieces, harms wildlife, persists indefinitely. Ban effective Jan 1, 2022, making Hawaii 5th foam-free US state.

properties.title: Pass Foodware and Single-use Beverage Ordinance for the City of Arcata
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Pass Foodware and Single-use Beverage Ordinance for the City of Arcata
properties.description: Surfrider Humboldt advocates for Arcata ordinance banning single-use plastic foodware and beverage containers at city facilities to reduce 10M metric tons annual ocean plastic pollution through source reduction.

properties.title: Ban Single-Use Plastic Foodware on Maui
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Single-Use Plastic Foodware on Maui
properties.description: Maui County banned single-use plastic foodware (containers, cups, straws, utensils) effective Jan 1, 2022. Businesses must use paper or compostable alternatives, reducing ocean plastic pollution and fossil fuel dependence.

properties.title: Foam Free Washington
properties.description: Washington state legislation (SB5022) bans expanded polystyrene products, mandates recycled content in plastics, requires opt-in for single-use items. Bipartisan support. Tackles plastic pollution in coastal waters.

properties.title: Say NO to Offshore Oil Drilling in Virginia Waters
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Say NO to Offshore Oil Drilling in Virginia Waters
properties.description: Ban oil drilling in Virginia state waters (3 miles from shore). Surfrider Virginia Chapter worked with coalition to pass SB795 and HB706, protecting tourism, recreation jobs, and marine wildlife. Effective July 1, 2020.

properties.title: City of Atlantic Beach Balloon Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Atlantic Beach Balloon Ordinance
properties.description: Surfrider First Coast Chapter campaigns for Atlantic Beach to ban intentional balloon releases to protect marine wildlife from balloon litter. Promotes alternatives like tree planting and beach cleanups.

properties.title: Oregon Ocean Climate Action
properties.description: Advancing Oregon legislation for ocean climate science, adaptation & mitigation. Secured $2M for Ocean Science Trust (HB 3114, 2021) to address ocean acidification, hypoxia & evaluate marine reserves along Oregon coast.

properties.title: Help Ban Polystyrene in SLO County
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Help Ban Polystyrene in SLO County
properties.description: Campaign to ban polystyrene in San Luis Obispo County to reduce plastic pollution entering waterways and coastlines. Targets microplastics harming marine life. Urges support for ordinance No. 2019-1.

properties.title: Support the CT Blue Plan!
properties.description: Connecticut's Long Island Sound Blue Plan protects ecosystems and traditional uses through science-based ocean management. Identifies Ecologically Significant Areas and Human Use Areas. Unanimously approved 2021.
properties.funder: CT Department of Energy and Environmental Protection, The Nature Conservancy

properties.title: NOAA's Budget Saved for 2021
properties.description: Surfrider campaign defended NOAA from proposed budget cuts targeting coastal zone management, resilience, estuarine reserves & Sea Grant. Grassroots advocacy & 125 Congressional visits secured 2021 funding.

properties.title: Ban Single-Use Plastic and EPS Foam Products in LA County
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Single-Use Plastic and EPS Foam Products in LA County
properties.description: LA County ordinance banning EPS foam and single-use plastics in foodware to reduce waterway/beach pollution. Requires compostable/recyclable items and reusables at restaurants. Protects marine wildlife from plastic debris.

properties.title: Long Beach Plastics Reduction Ordinance
properties.description: Long Beach banned retail EPS foam & plastic straws in Feb 2020 to reduce ocean plastic pollution. Surfrider Long Beach advocated 10+ years after witnessing plastic at beach cleanups. Builds on existing restaurant foam ban.

properties.title: Stopping Intentional Balloon Releases in Maryland
properties.description: Surfrider's Ocean City Chapter passed MD bills HB391/S716 banning intentional balloon releases. Balloons end up in oceans, choking marine life like turtles and whales. Law effective Oct 1, 2021.

properties.title: Banned Intentional Balloon Releases in Virginia
properties.description: Surfrider VA worked with partners to ban intentional balloon releases statewide, closing loophole allowing <50 balloons. Prevents marine debris harming ocean wildlife. Governor signed HB 2159 into law March 30, 2021.

properties.title: Made Straws By Request Only in NYC
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Made Straws By Request Only in NYC
properties.description: NYC legislation requiring bars/restaurants to provide plastic straws only upon request. Addresses top beach cleanup pollutant that harms marine wildlife and enters food chain through waterways.

properties.title: Mickler Beach Beach Access
properties.description: Campaign to keep Mickler Beach in St. Johns County open to public. In Nov 2019, beach was closed for geo-thermal tube installation by homeowners. First Coast activists rallied and successfully kept beach open.

properties.title: Help California Address Nonfloating Oil Spills Before It's Too Late!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Help California Address Nonfloating Oil Spills Before It's Too Late!
properties.description: Campaign urging CA Senate to pass AB 936 establishing contingency plans for non-floating oil spills that sink below water. Bill requires response orgs, research funding, transport notices, and raises liability caps to $10B.

properties.title: Save Santa Cruz Beaches and Waves from Sea Level Rise
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Save Santa Cruz Beaches and Waves from Sea Level Rise
properties.description: Surfrider opposes Santa Cruz County's coastal program allowing seawalls for new development at Pleasure Point/Opal Cliffs. Advocates managed retreat, living shorelines over armoring that drowns beaches as seas rise.

properties.title: Redondo Beach Plastics Reduction Ordinance
properties.description: Surfrider South Bay advocated for ordinance banning polystyrene food ware, plastic straws/utensils, and balloon releases in Redondo Beach. Passed Jan 2020 to reduce top plastic pollution sources entering ocean.

properties.title: Trestles and San Onofre Saved from Road Construction
properties.description: 15-year campaign to protect San Onofre State Beach and Trestles from toll road construction. Coalition of activists prevented damage to watershed, surf break, endangered species, and Indigenous sites. Secured permanent protection via AB 1426.

properties.title: Carlsbad Plastic Foodware Reduction Ordinance
properties.description: Carlsbad banned single-use plastic foodware & polystyrene from restaurants (July 2023). Includes 'Skip the Stuff' requiring utensils/straws only on request. Protects ocean from plastic pollution in San Diego County.

properties.title: Ormond Beach Plastic Straw Ordinance
properties.description: Surfrider's Volusia/Flagler Chapter worked with Ormond Beach, FL to pass a single-use plastic straw ordinance in Sept 2019, eliminating straws to reduce fossil fuel use and marine plastic pollution.

properties.title: Pass the Coronado Plastics Reduction
properties.description: Surfrider San Diego supported Emerald Keepers to pass comprehensive plastic ordinance in Coronado, restricting single-use plastics, foam, bags, balloons, water bottles. Adopted 2024 after 6-month advocacy campaign.

properties.title: Say NO to polystyrene, Norwalk!
properties.description: Connecticut Chapter worked with residents to ban single-use polystyrene food service wares in Norwalk. Ordinance passed Sept 2019, effective Earth Day 2020, prohibiting foam containers and packaging peanuts.

properties.title: Redondo Beach Outdoor Smoking Ban
properties.description: Citywide smoking ban in public places approved Sept 2019 to reduce cigarette butt litter in beach areas and ocean. Butts contain plastic filters with toxins that wash into waterways. Surfrider volunteers advocated at council meetings.

properties.title: City of Key West Single Use Plastic Straw Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Key West Single Use Plastic Straw Ordinance
properties.description: Key West passed ordinance banning single-use plastic straws to prevent marine pollution. Surfrider Florida Keys Chapter advocated summer 2019, city voted September 4, 2019.

properties.title: Make Intentional Releases of Balloons Illegal in the Town of Hempstead, NY
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Make Intentional Releases of Balloons Illegal in the Town of Hempstead, NY
properties.description: Surfrider's Central Long Island Chapter worked with coalition partners to pass a law banning intentional balloon releases in Hempstead, NY to prevent ocean litter and protect coastal wildlife. Passed Nov 2019.

properties.title: Protect ʻAliomanu Beach Access
properties.description: Restored public beach access at ʻAliomanu South, Kauai. Community fought blockage of 50-year traditional path used for beach cleanups, fishing, limu gathering, and ancient Ala Loa Trail. Access secured Oct 2023.

properties.title: Say NO to Straws, Norwalk!
properties.description: Norwalk, CT passed straw mitigation ordinance Sept 2019. Ask-first policy for straws, ban on plastic stirrers. Youth-led advocacy after coastal cleanup. Addresses plastic pollution and climate crisis connection.

properties.title: Satellite Beach Single Use Plastic and Polystyrene Measures
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Satellite Beach Single Use Plastic and Polystyrene Measures
properties.description: Ban polystyrene foam & single-use plastics at Satellite Beach city facilities & events. Passed July 17th resolution to stop foam/plastic use at city parks, venues, permitted events, reducing beach litter found in cleanups.

properties.title: Gaviota State Beach Pier approved to rebuild without shoreline armoring
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Gaviota State Beach Pier approved to rebuild without shoreline armoring
properties.description: Pier reconstruction at Gaviota State Park approved without 1700-ton riprap seawall. Metal grated design protects Kashayit Marine Conservation Area habitat and beach access. Surfrider Foundation advocacy changed Coastal Commission recommendation.
properties.funder: California Department of Parks and Recreation

properties.title: Stopped the Williams Transco Pipeline -- Round 2!
properties.description: Blocked NESE fossil fuel pipeline from crossing NY-NJ Harbor to Rockaway Beach. Protected benthic communities, sturgeon, whales from construction impacts and reduced greenhouse gas emissions. Coalition advocacy led to permit denials in May 2020.

properties.title: Bill 40 Passes on Oahu, One of the Strongest Plastic Laws in the Nation
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Bill 40 Passes on Oahu, One of the Strongest Plastic Laws in the Nation
properties.description: Surfrider's Oahu Chapter passed Bill 40 banning single-use plastics island-wide. Phases out plastic bags, polystyrene, containers, straws & utensils over 2 years. Approved Dec 2019, affects 72% of Hawaii's population.

properties.title: Solana Beach Plastics Reduction
properties.description: Comprehensive ordinance banning single-use plastics, polystyrene foam, plastic straws/utensils at food establishments and city facilities in Solana Beach. Passed unanimously Sept 2019, phased implementation May-Nov 2020.

properties.title: Pacific Grove Says No to Single-Use
properties.description: Pacific Grove, CA banned single-use plastics including straws, to-go containers, bags, and toiletries. Requires BPI certified compostable alternatives and 100% recycled paper bags. Strongest ordinance in region.

properties.title: Ban Intentional Balloon Releases in Suffolk County
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban Intentional Balloon Releases in Suffolk County
properties.description: Ban intentional balloon releases in Suffolk County, NY to protect marine life from balloon debris found at beach cleanups. Passed Sept 2019 after public hearings. Prevents marine wildlife ingestion and entanglement.

properties.title: Save North Strands Beach
properties.description: Campaign to deny 1,200+ft rock revetment protecting private homes at Strands Beach, Dana Point. Opposed shoreline armoring threatening public beach access. Successfully blocked Feb 2020 at CA Coastal Commission.

properties.title: Wilton Manors Single Use Straw Ordinance
properties.description: Ordinance eliminating single-use plastic straws in Wilton Manors, FL to reduce fossil fuel use and prevent plastic litter in marine environments. Passed October 14, 2019 after advocacy by Surfrider chapters.

properties.title: North Myrtle Beach, SC Bans Plastic Bags
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/North Myrtle Beach, SC Bans Plastic Bags
properties.description: North Myrtle Beach banned retail plastic carryout bags including bioplastics to reduce ocean pollution. Ordinance passed April 2019 protecting coastal waters and marine life from plastic waste.

properties.title: Florida Sunscreen Preemption
properties.description: Campaign to stop Florida bills preempting local bans on reef-damaging sunscreen chemicals oxybenzone and octinoxate. Key West passed local ban; Surfrider activists defeated state preemption bills May 2019.

properties.title: City of West Palm Beach Plastic Straw Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of West Palm Beach Plastic Straw Ordinance
properties.description: Ordinance passed March 2019 to ban single-use plastic straws in West Palm Beach, reducing fossil fuel use and preventing plastic pollution in marine environments through local policy advocacy.

properties.title: Imperial Beach Plastics Reduction Ordinance
properties.description: Ordinance bans plastic straws, stirrers, utensils and polystyrene products in Imperial Beach restaurants/retailers. Surfrider San Diego volunteers advocated at council meetings. Effective Nov 2019.

properties.title: Banning the Intentional Release of Balloons in Long Branch, NJ
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Banning the Intentional Release of Balloons in Long Branch, NJ
properties.description: Surfrider activists worked with Long Branch, NJ to pass ordinance banning intentional balloon releases in April 2019, protecting Atlantic Coast from plastic pollution at this major boardwalk destination with hundreds of thousands of visitors.

properties.title: NOAA Funding Saved for 2020
properties.description: Surfrider campaign defended NOAA from Trump admin budget cuts targeting coastal zone management, resilience, estuarine reserves & Sea Grant. Congress passed FY2019 budget with level/increased funding for ocean & coastal programs.

properties.title: Manhattan Beach Balloon Release Ban
properties.description: Manhattan Beach banned balloon releases and distribution on public property to prevent marine plastic pollution. Surfrider volunteers advocated at city council meetings, resulting in stricter ordinance passed March 2019.

properties.title: Help Us Ban Foam in Maryland
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Help Us Ban Foam in Maryland
properties.description: Statewide ban on expanded polystyrene (EPS) food containers in Maryland to reduce marine litter and toxin exposure. Law passed May 2019, effective July 2020. Led by Ocean City Chapter and Trash Free Maryland coalition.

properties.title: Hollywood Balloon Release Ban
properties.description: Surfrider Broward County Chapter successfully campaigned for Hollywood, FL to ban intentional balloon releases to protect marine life and endangered ocean species from balloon litter and ingestion deaths. Ordinance passed Feb 2020.

properties.title: Ban single-use foam food containers, Maine!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban single-use foam food containers, Maine!
properties.description: Campaign to ban polystyrene foam food packaging statewide in Maine. After multiple attempts, LD289 passed in 2019, making Maine first US state to ban foam containers. Effective Jan 1, 2021. Prevents ocean pollution from non-recyclable foam.

properties.title: Manhattan Beach Polystyrene Tray Ban
properties.description: Ban on polystyrene meat trays passed March 2019 to eliminate EPS foam pollution in Manhattan Beach. Targets hard-to-collect beach cleanup items that break into small pieces. Surfrider volunteers advocated at council meetings.

properties.title: City of Stuart Single Use Plastic and Polystyrene Ordinance in Public Parks, Offices and Beaches
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Stuart Single Use Plastic and Polystyrene Ordinance in Public Parks, Offices and Beaches
properties.description: Ban on polystyrene foam food-ware and single use plastics in Stuart city beaches and parks. Passed Oct 28 to reduce plastic pollution found in beach cleanups, diverting tons of waste from landfills.

properties.title: Banning Foam in Suffolk County, NY
properties.description: Suffolk County polystyrene foam food container ban led by Surfrider's Eastern Long Island Chapter. Law prohibits foam to-go containers and packaging peanuts, effective Jan 1, 2020. Signed Earth Day 2019.

properties.title: Surfrider Hawaii Helps Pass 4th Cesspool Bill
properties.description: Hawaii law extends Cesspool Conversion Working Group funding to address 88,000 cesspools leaching 53M gallons daily of sewage. Coalition secured Act 170 to extend deadline to 2022 for conversion plan by 2050.

properties.title: Protect Sawyer's Beach in Rye, NH!
properties.description: Surfrider NH defeated porta-potty placement at Sawyer's Beach to prevent pollution from human waste, chemicals entering eel pond and ocean. Town vote passed 1209-404 in March 2019, permanently banning porta-potties at this location.

properties.title: Prohibit Drilling Activity in New Hampshire State Waters
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Prohibit Drilling Activity in New Hampshire State Waters!
properties.description: Law prohibiting offshore oil/gas drilling in NH state waters and related infrastructure. Passed unanimously through legislature, signed Sept 2019 at Rye Harbor State Park, protecting coastal waters from drilling.

properties.title: San Clemente Foam Ban Defended
properties.description: Surfrider's South Orange County chapter successfully defended San Clemente's 2004 EPS foam foodware ban from being weakened, preventing thousands of foam pieces from littering coastal beaches through advocacy and testimony.

properties.title: Straw Ban in Suffolk County, NY
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Straw Ban in Suffolk County, NY
properties.description: Suffolk County plastic straw ban led by Surfrider's Eastern Long Island Chapter. Law prohibits single-use plastic straws, requires paper/biodegradable alternatives by request only. Exceptions for disabilities. Effective Jan 1, 2020.

properties.title: City of Stuart Single Use Plastic Straw Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Stuart Single Use Plastic Straw Ordinance
properties.description: Ordinance passed Oct 2019 banning single-use plastic straws in Stuart city limits to prevent marine pollution. Complements existing beach property ordinances, reducing fossil fuel use and plastic litter in marine environments.

properties.title: ReWild Mission Bay Wetland Restoration
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/San Diego Water Board Approves Supplemental Environmental Project
properties.description: Wetland restoration in Mission Bay to improve water quality, sequester carbon, buffer storms/sea level rise. Study planning options for restoring <1% remaining historic wetlands. Coalition led effort.

properties.title: Florida Plastic Straw Preemption
properties.description: Surfrider activists opposed 2019 FL bills preempting local plastic straw ordinances. Through emails, opeds, phone banks, they defeated initial bills. Governor DeSantis vetoed HB 771 moratorium, preserving local control.

properties.title: Village of Pinecrest Polystyrene Ordinance
properties.description: Ban on polystyrene foam foodware in Pinecrest to reduce beach litter. Approved Jan 8, effective Apr 1, 2019. Led by Surfrider Miami Chapter to eliminate major pollution source found in beach cleanups.

properties.title: Del Mar Plastic Straw and Stirrer Ban
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Del Mar Plastic Straw and Stirrer Ban
properties.description: Ban on plastic straws/stirrers in Del Mar, CA. Surfrider San Diego volunteers advocated at city council, raised awareness. Ordinance passed March 2019, effective April 2019 with 6-month grace period. Ocean Friendly Restaurants program aids implementa

properties.title: Bellingham Polystyrene Ordinance
properties.description: Ban on polystyrene takeout containers & single-use plastics in Bellingham, WA. Ordinance passed May 2021, effective July 2022. Led by Surfrider chapters with local partners to reduce plastic pollution entering marine waters.

properties.title: Lauderdale by the Sea Plastic Straw Ordinance
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Lauderdale by the Sea Plastic Straw Ordinance
properties.description: Surfrider Broward Chapter advocated for single-use plastic straw ban in Lauderdale by the Sea to prevent marine pollution. Town unanimously passed ordinance Feb 2019, reducing fossil fuel use and ocean litter.

properties.title: Protect Dunes Beach from development
properties.description: Opposing 200-room hotel & 170-site RV park at Dunes Beach, Half Moon Bay. Threatens 50-acres pristine habitat, agriculture, recreation, coastal views. Urging City Council denial due to sea level rise risk.

properties.title: Washington Reusable Bag Act
properties.description: Statewide legislation eliminating single-use plastic bags in Washington, effective Jan 2021. Retailers charge 8¢ for paper/reusable bags. Addresses 2B bags used yearly, <6% recycled, harming marine life in Salish Sea.

properties.title: No Porta-Potty at Sawyer's Beach!
properties.description: Surfrider NH opposed porta-potty at Sawyer's Beach, Rye due to pollution risks from waste/chemicals near eel pond and ocean. Board voted to remove funding 1/14/19. Article 35 seeks permanent ban at March 2019 election.

properties.title: Protecting Florida Keys Coral Reefs by Banning Oxybenzone
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protecting Florida Keys Coral Reefs by Banning Oxybenzone!
properties.description: Key West banned oxybenzone and octinoxate sunscreen chemicals to protect coral reefs. These chemicals cause genetic damage, disease susceptibility, and bleaching in corals. First Florida city ban, Feb 2019.

properties.title: Expand Paddleboard and Surfing Zone at Hollywood Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Expand Paddleboard and Surfing Zone at Hollywood Beach
properties.description: Surfrider's Broward Chapter advocates to remove stand up paddle restrictions at Hollywood Beach, FL. Currently illegal on most of beach. Campaign promotes water recreation, eco-tourism access to cafes/businesses.

properties.title: Washington Oil Spill Prevention
properties.description: Preventing oil spills in Puget Sound and Washington coast through advocacy for tug escort requirements for smaller oil tankers near San Juan Islands, protecting salmon, orcas, and local economies.

properties.title: Prohibit Drilling Activity in Maine State Waters
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Prohibit Drilling Activity in Maine State Waters!
properties.description: LD955 law prohibits oil/gas exploration in Maine waters. Protects coastal communities from spills, pollution. Safeguards tourism, fishing, beaches. Signed June 2019 by Governor Mills after legislative victory.

properties.title: Ft. Lauderdale Straw Ordinance
properties.description: Surfrider's Broward Chapter successfully campaigned for a single-use plastic straw ordinance in Ft. Lauderdale to prevent plastic pollution in marine environments. Passed January 22, 2019.

properties.title: Let's Reduce Foam on California Beaches
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Let's Reduce Foam on California Beaches
properties.description: Campaign to ban expanded polystyrene (EPS/Styrofoam) food packaging at California state parks and beaches. SB 1335 signed requiring reusable, compostable, or recyclable food service packaging to reduce ocean pollution.

properties.title: Deerfield Beach Straw Ordinance
properties.description: Surfrider Broward Chapter successfully passed ordinance banning single-use plastic straws in Deerfield Beach to prevent marine pollution and reduce fossil fuel dependency. Ordinance passed Sept 2018.

properties.title: Protect Our Coasts from Harmful Algal Blooms
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect Our Coasts from Harmful Algal Blooms!
properties.description: Advocacy campaign to reauthorize federal harmful algal bloom research & prevention program after expiration in 2018. Victory: Congress passed reauthorization Dec 2018, signed into law Jan 2019.

properties.title: Solana Beach Geologic Setback Line Upheld
properties.description: Surfrider's San Diego Chapter successfully defended blufftop setback policies, preventing bluff-edge development that would require future shoreline armoring and threaten public beach access as sea levels rise.

properties.title: Ban Foam in Southampton Town
properties.description: Ban expanded polystyrene foam in Southampton Town, Long Island to protect marine life from petroleum-based plastic pollution. Law passed Feb 2019, effective May 2019, prohibits foam food containers, packaging, coolers.

properties.title: Ban Straws in Southampton Town
properties.description: Surfrider Eastern Long Island worked with Southampton Town to ban plastic straws. 164 straws removed from beaches. Ban passed Feb 2019, effective May 2019. Restaurants provide straws only on request, non-plastic materials.

properties.title: Melbourne Beach Single Use Plastic and Polystyrene Ordinance in Public Parks, Offices and Beaches
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Melbourne Beach Single Use Plastic and Polystyrene Ordinance in Public Parks, Offices and Beaches
properties.description: Ban polystyrene foam foodware & single-use plastics in Melbourne Beach parks & beaches. Addresses major litter source found in cleanups. Works within FL state law limiting bans to municipal property only.

properties.title: Isle of Palms, SC Expands Single-Use Plastics Ban
