properties.description: Capitola City Council passed plastic checkout bag ban with 25 cent paper bag fee. Led by Surfrider Santa Cruz, Save Our Shores, and Environment CA. Ordinance effective April 10, 2013 to reduce ocean plastic pollution.

properties.title: Agate Beach, OR Access Improvement
properties.description: Newport Chapter opposed road vacation to preserve public beach access at Agate Beach. 2+ years of stakeholder work secured $600k ODOT funding for parking, bathrooms, recreational facilities completed 2013.

properties.title: Hermosa Beach Polystyrene Foodware Ban
properties.description: Ban on polystyrene take-out food packaging in Hermosa Beach to reduce ocean pollution. Surfrider South Bay Chapter supports ordinance through public meetings, letters, and rallying businesses. Backed by Green Task Force.

properties.title: Final Settlement for Access at Strands Beach in Dana Point
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Final Settlement for Access at Strands Beach in Dana Point
properties.description: 6-year litigation securing public beach access at Dana Point Strands Beach. Settlement ensures 5am-10pm access, gate removal, new trails, educational programs on marine conservation, sea level rise impacts for Title 1 schools.

properties.title: Strands Beach Access
properties.description: Legal victory ensuring public beach access at Dana Point Headlands. Fought restrictions on central accessway after 2010 residential development. Court ruled city's access limits unlawful, arbitrary. Ongoing pressure on appeals.

properties.title: Cannon Beach Water Quality Protection
properties.description: Reducing bacterial contamination at Ecola Court Outfall through monitoring, advocacy, and infrastructure testing. Victory: City identified sewer failures and cross-connections, approved repairs after decade of Surfrider advocacy.

properties.title: Redfish Rocks Marine Reserve Management Plan Adopted
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Redfish Rocks Marine Reserve Management Plan Adopted
properties.description: Support implementation of Redfish Rocks Marine Reserve off Port Orford, Oregon. Designated 2009, community-developed management plan includes education, enforcement, biological/socioeconomic monitoring, economic development.

properties.title: Big Wave Development Opposition
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation opposed 225,000 sq ft mixed-use development at Pillar Point Marsh. Campaign stopped project threatening historical wetlands, water quality, and coastal ecosystem through advocacy with environmental partners.
properties.funder: Surfrider Foundation San Mateo County Chapter

properties.title: Strands Gate Beach Access Campaign
properties.description: Legal campaign to expand public beach access at Strands Vista in Dana Point. Challenged restrictive gate hours (8am-5pm) as Coastal Act violations. 2016 settlement achieved 5am-10pm access, gate removal, and $300k mitigation.

properties.title: Santa Cruz World Surfing Reserve
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Santa Cruz World Surfing Reserve Designated
properties.description: World's 4th surfing reserve protecting 23+ surf breaks from Natural Bridges to Opal Cliffs. Designated Feb 2011, dedicated Apr 2012 to protect world-class waves like Steamer Lane & facilitate local stewardship.

properties.title: Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/NOAA Designates Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary!
properties.description: NOAA designated 4,500 sq mi sanctuary protecting marine habitats from oil drilling, seabed mining, pollution. First Indigenous-nominated sanctuary honoring Chumash culture, spanning 116 miles of central CA coast.

properties.title: Honolua Bay Is Saved!
properties.description: Protected 280 acres at Lipoa Point/Honolua Bay from golf course development. Coalition opposed luxury homes threatening world-famous surf spot, cultural area & marine reserve. HB 1424 authorized state acquisition for conservation.
properties.funder: Hawaii Department of Land and Natural Resources

properties.title: Maine Beach Access Litigation
properties.description: Litigation (2009-2019) protecting public beach access rights at Goose Rocks Beach, Kennebunkport. Court ruled beach is town-owned and held in public trust, ensuring access for all despite <10% public coastline ownership in Maine.

properties.title: Improve Water Quality at Larrabee State Park
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Improve Water Quality at Larrabee State Park
properties.description: Multi-year effort to identify and fix pollution sources at Wild Cat Cove beach, Larrabee State Park, WA. Stakeholder collaboration and camper education reduced bacteria levels, removing swim advisory and restoring beach access.

properties.title: Maui Bans Plastic Bags
properties.description: Surfrider's Maui Chapter helped pass Hawaii's first county-wide single-use plastic bag ban in 2008, effective Jan 2011. Coalition effort resulted in cleaner island and broad public support, inspiring Kauai's ban.

properties.title: Favorable Hawaii Navy Sonar Ruling
properties.description: Court ruled Navy must implement mitigation measures to protect marine mammals from sonar exercises in Hawaii waters, including increased monitoring, lookouts, 500m safety zones, and gradual sonar power-up.

properties.title: California Legislature Approves Statewide Bag Ban with SB 270
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/California Legislature Approves Statewide Bag Ban with SB 270
properties.description: California bans single-use plastic bags statewide to reduce ocean pollution. SB 270 approved Aug 2014, signed by Gov. Brown Sept 2014. First US statewide ban after 6-year advocacy effort.

properties.title: City of Marina Polystyrene Ban
properties.description: Surfrider Monterey Chapter worked with coalition to ban polystyrene foam food containers in Marina, CA. Ordinance adopted Nov 2011 requires biodegradable/compostable alternatives for food providers and city events.

properties.title: New Surfing Beach in NYC
properties.description: NYC Chapter secured second legal surfing beach at Rockaway 67th Street in 2007. Advocacy convinced Parks Dept to designate surfing-only access after earlier victory at Beach 90th Street, expanding coastal recreation rights.

properties.title: Encinitas Bag Ban Passed
properties.description: Encinitas adopted single-use plastic bag ban with 10¢ paper bag fee. Effective March 2015 for grocery stores, Sept 2015 for all retail. Reduces plastic pollution entering ocean from coastal community.

properties.title: Monterey Regional Water Supply
properties.description: Surfrider advocated to reduce seawater desalination plant from 9,000 to 2,933 acre-feet/year, require slant wells to protect marine life, mitigate brine discharge impacts, and achieve net zero emissions in Monterey Peninsula.

properties.title: City of San Diego Plastic Bag Ban
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of San Diego Plastic Bag Ban
properties.description: 8-year advocacy campaign to ban disposable plastic checkout bags in San Diego. Surfrider activists educated public, built coalition, pressured policymakers. Ordinance passed Aug 2016, making SD 150th CA jurisdiction to ban bags.

properties.title: Long Island, NY Surfing Access Near Montauk Point Lighthouse
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Long Island, NY Surfing Access Near Montauk Point Lighthouse
properties.description: Surfrider advocates for legal surfing access near Montauk Point Lighthouse, restricted by NY State Parks. Successfully defended surfing tickets in court against surfcaster opposition to expand coastal recreation rights.

properties.title: Stopped Singer Island Breakwaters
properties.description: Surfrider opposed 11 breakwater segments planned 200ft offshore Singer Island to trap sediment. Project would cover 18.9 acres including hard bottom habitat, harm fish & sea turtles. County abandoned 2011 due to cost & concerns.

properties.title: Morro Bay/Cayucos Wastewater Treatment Plant Siting
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Morro Bay/Cayucos Wastewater Treatment Plant Siting
properties.description: Campaign to upgrade wastewater treatment to Clean Water Act standards, relocate plant outside coastal hazard zones, maximize water reclamation, and eliminate ocean discharge of partially treated sewage in Morro Bay/Cayucos.

properties.title: Trestles Saved Forever From Toll Road
properties.description: Decade-long campaign stopped 6-lane toll road through San Onofre State Beach. Protected Trestles surf break, San Mateo Creek watershed, wildlife habitat. Settlement created $28M conservation fund, avoidance areas.

properties.title: Better Public Notice of Beach Pollution in Hawaii
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Better Public Notice of Beach Pollution in Hawaii
properties.description: Campaign to require Hawaii Dept of Health to post warning signs at chronically polluted beaches and during Brown Water Advisories. EPA pressured state to comply with posting laws after Surfrider advocacy.

properties.title: Eliminate Single Use Plastics from Beach Concessionaires in Miami Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Eliminate Single Use Plastics from Beach Concessionaires in Miami Beach
properties.description: Surfrider Miami advocates to eliminate single-use plastics from beachside concession stands. City ordinance passed Oct 2019 requires 100% reusable products by Oct 2020, preventing plastic pollution entering marine environment.

properties.title: NJ Now Posting Warnings After One High Bacteria Test
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation successfully advocated for NJ to post beach warnings after one high bacteria test, replacing the previous two-day testing requirement that rarely resulted in closures, improving public health protection.

properties.title: Stop Muddying Kauai's Waters
properties.description: Combat soil erosion from agriculture & development killing Kauai's coral reefs. Surfrider exposed illegal GMO farming practices lacking erosion controls, forcing adoption of Best Management Practices & permits to protect ocean waters.

properties.title: Toll Road Stopped at San Onofre State Beach / Trestles
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Toll Road Stopped at San Onofre State Beach / Trestles
properties.description: US Commerce Dept upheld CA Coastal Commission denial of 6-lane toll road through San Onofre State Beach near Trestles, protecting state park, natural resources, and surf break from highway impacts.

properties.title: City of Santa Cruz adopts ban on polystyrene food service wares
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/City of Santa Cruz adopts ban on polystyrene food service wares
properties.description: Santa Cruz banned polystyrene food service wares in 2008 to protect coastal waters from plastic pollution. This ordinance prevents foam containers from breaking down into ocean microplastics.

properties.title: Implementation of National Ocean Policy
properties.description: US National Ocean Policy implementation plan released April 2013 with 50+ actions for ocean, coast, and Great Lakes protection. Focuses on ecosystem management, habitat restoration, climate adaptation, spatial planning, water quality.

properties.title: Santa Cruz County Polystyrene Ban
properties.description: Santa Cruz County banned polystyrene food service wares. Surfrider's Santa Cruz Chapter partnered with organizations to pass this ordinance protecting coastal waters from foam pollution in 2008.

properties.title: Hawaii, Oahu, North Shore—Preservation of Pupukea-Paumalu (Save Sunset Beach)
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Hawaii, Oahu, North Shore—Preservation of Pupukea-Paumalu (Save Sunset Beach)
properties.description: Prevented development of 300-home gated community on bluffs above Sunset Beach, Pipeline & Rocky Point. Coalition raised $8M to purchase land for public preservation. Ongoing stewardship protects North Shore surf breaks.
properties.funder: North Shore Community Land Trust, Trust for Public Land, State, City, Military and Federal Agencies

properties.title: Polystyrene Banned in Monterey
properties.description: Monterey banned polystyrene to reduce marine debris in coastal waters and Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary. Surfrider's Monterey Chapter led community coalition, garnered business support, achieving unanimous city council approval.

properties.title: Coastal Commission Receives Authority to Fine Coastal Act Violators
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Coastal Commission Receives Authority to Fine Coastal Act Violators
properties.description: CA Coastal Commission gains authority to fine violators blocking beach access. Addresses 2,000 violations, mainly illegal no parking/access signs by private landowners. Protects public coastal access rights.

properties.title: Prevented Damaging Energy Project on Oregon Coast
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Prevented Damaging Energy Project on Oregon Coast
properties.description: Surfrider intervened with FERC to stop Oceanlinx's Florence Wave Energy facility. After 9 months with no public outreach, company withdrew permit. Protected surfing, fishing, and beach access at south jetty.

properties.title: Lake Worth Surf Saved
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation successfully protected Lake Worth surf break by stopping a beach fill project that threatened this coastal surfing area in 2006.

properties.title: Town of East Hampton, NY Approves New Coastal Legislation
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Town of East Hampton, NY Approves New Coastal Legislation
properties.description: East Hampton prohibits new hard erosion structures on ocean beaches, creates Coastal Erosion Hazard Overlay District. Prioritizes non-structural measures like vegetation, sand fencing, building setbacks to protect beaches.

properties.title: Beach access in South Florida
properties.description: Protected beach access to local surf spot from condo development in South Florida. Campaign ensures public coastal access rights against private development threats.

properties.title: Governor Signs Rapid Water Quality Testing Bill
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Governor Signs Rapid Water Quality Testing Bill
properties.description: SB 1395 enables rapid beach water quality testing, delivering results in hours vs 24-48hrs. Provides real-time pollution alerts to ocean users, strengthening protection and public safety at California beaches.

properties.title: Plastic Bag Ban in Malibu
properties.description: Surfrider's West LA/Malibu Chapter worked with Heal The Bay to ban plastic bags in Malibu retail stores, addressing plastic pollution in marine environments through the Rise Above Plastics campaign in 2008.

properties.title: Jones Beach and Moses Park opened to surfing access
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Jones Beach and Moses Park opened to surfing access
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation successfully opened Jones Beach State Park and Robert Moses State Park to surfing access in 2006, expanding coastal recreation opportunities for surfers in New York.

properties.title: A Win for Diversity In the Surfing Line Up In Pacifica!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/A Win for Diversity In the Surfing Line Up In Pacifica!
properties.description: Pacifica approved Community Access Partnership Permit program allowing Brown Girls Surf and City Surf Project to operate at Pacifica Beach, promoting diverse community access to coastal recreation. Approved Aug 2020.
properties.funder: Surfrider Foundation San Mateo County Chapter

properties.title: Marin County Bag Ban
properties.description: Surfrider Marin & partners persuaded Marin County to ban single-use bags. Over 1M bags enter Bay annually. Initiative reduces plastic pollution harming marine ecosystems outside Golden Gate. County defended ban in court.

properties.title: Westport Connecticut Votes to Ban Plastic Checkout Bags
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Westport Connecticut Votes to Ban Plastic Checkout Bags
properties.description: First East Coast town to ban plastic checkout bags. Westport CT, on Long Island Sound, voted Sept 2008 to prohibit disposable plastic bags at retail stores, giving retailers 6 months to comply. Protects marine environment.

properties.title: New beach access for the First Coast
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/New beach access for the First Coast
properties.description: Surfrider First Coast Chapter secured perpendicular beach walkway at Escambia Right of Way, St. Johns County, FL. Approved May 4th by County Commission to improve public beach access in undeveloped area.

properties.title: Southern California Establishes Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: CA Fish & Game Commission approved network of MPAs in Southern California after years of negotiations. Part of Marine Life Protection Act (1999). Surfrider worked with diverse groups for balanced input in MLPA process.

properties.title: Dana Point Plastic Bag Ban
properties.description: Single-use plastic bag ban at stores and city facilities to reduce plastic litter in beaches, parks, roads and waterways. Passed March 2012, effective April 2013. Second Orange County city after Laguna Beach.

properties.title: Massive Playa Vista Development Stopped
properties.description: Surfrider's South Bay Chapter stopped Phase 2 development threatening Ballona Wetlands. Settlement reversed permits, enabling potential public acquisition for wetland restoration in Southern California's coastal network.

properties.title: Improved Beach Access in Walton County, FL
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Improved Beach Access in Walton County, FL
properties.description: Defending public beach access on Miramar Beach against condo owners' opposition. County creating 100+ parking spaces on public easement near Whale's Tail Restaurant to formalize beachgoer access previously limited to roadside parking.

properties.title: NJ/NY LNG Victory
properties.description: Defeated Liberty Natural Gas offshore LNG facility off Asbury Park, NJ. Project would have used seafloor turret & pipeline for tanker re-gasification. Victory achieved through coalition opposition led by Jersey Shore Chapter.

properties.title: Landmark Court Decision to Protect Marine Species
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Landmark Court Decision to Protect Marine Species
properties.description: US Court of Appeals struck down EPA rule on 'once through' cooling systems by coastal generators. Surfrider Foundation co-plaintiff victory enforcing Clean Water Act protection for marine species.

properties.title: Protect Southeast Florida's Coral Reefs
properties.description: Established Southeast Florida Coral Reef Ecosystem Conservation Area near Biscayne National Park to study and protect reefs from disease and bleaching, with water quality monitoring program funding.

properties.title: Rincoeños Stop Condos and Save Beach Access in PR
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Rincoeños Stop Condos and Save Beach Access in PR
properties.description: Stopped condo construction threatening beach access & fishermen's area in Rincón, PR. Legal battles led to permit freeze (2008) due to flood zone violations. Illegal fence removed, restoring public access near Elkhorn coral reefs.

properties.title: Turtle Bay Kuilima Resort Required to do SEIS
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Turtle Bay Kuilima Resort Required to do SEIS
properties.description: Surfrider's Oahu Chapter filed amicus brief and donated $10,000 to lawsuit forcing Turtle Bay Resort to conduct Supplemental EIS for massive North Shore Oahu development, protecting coastal environment from outdated 1985 plan.

properties.title: Bellingham, WA Plastic Bag Ban
properties.description: Community campaign led by Surfrider Foundation to ban plastic bags in Bellingham. Gathered 3,000+ signatures, passed 7-0 by City Council in July 2011. Ordinance bans carry-out plastic bags, adds 5¢ paper bag fee to reduce ocean impact.

properties.title: New Water Quality Measures for Santa Monica Bay
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/New Water Quality Measures for Santa Monica Bay
properties.description: Adoption of bacteria Total Maximum Daily Load (TMDL) into Regional Water Quality Control Board Storm Water Permits for Santa Monica Bay to improve coastal water quality and protect ocean health.

properties.title: Encinitas Plastic Bag Ban Ordinance
properties.description: First San Diego County city to ban plastic bags & fee paper bags to reduce single-use plastics. Surfrider SD Chapter collected 2,000 signatures, worked with City Council on phased implementation with education for residents & businesses.

properties.title: Surfing access to Deerfield Beach FL
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation secured surfing access at Deerfield Beach, Florida where beach access was previously restricted. Campaign completed in 2006 to protect coastal recreation rights.

properties.title: World Surfing Reserve at Malibu's Surfrider Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/World Surfing Reserve at Malibu's Surfrider Beach
properties.description: First World Surfing Reserve designation preserving iconic Malibu surf break and coastal heritage. UNESCO-inspired program protects surfing areas through community-driven conservation of important surf breaks worldwide.

properties.title: Plastic Bags Banned in Edmonds, WA
properties.description: Seattle Chapter campaign achieved plastic shopping bag ban in Edmonds. Community and local businesses supported the initiative to reduce marine plastic pollution in Puget Sound coastal waters.

properties.title: Goleta Beach Saved - Groin Defeated
properties.description: California Coastal Commission denied Santa Barbara County's groin project at Goleta Beach on July 8. Project would have trapped sand, causing erosion to eastern beaches and damaging habitats.

properties.title: Rockpile seawall stopped
properties.description: Surfrider stopped a 300-foot seawall at Rockpile, Heisler Park, Laguna Beach in 2006. Campaign protected coastal area from hardening infrastructure that threatens beaches and marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Governor signs bill that will help fund conservation programs
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Governor signs bill that will help fund conservation programs
properties.description: AB 754 creates tax check-off box for CA Coastal Commission WhaleTail Grants funding nonprofits doing ocean conservation: water testing, beach cleanups, Ocean Friendly Gardens. Signed Sept 2013.

properties.title: Governor signs Sea Level Rise Planning Bill
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Governor signs Sea Level Rise Planning Bill
properties.description: Surfrider lobbied for AB 691 requiring California public trust lands to analyze and plan for sea level rise impacts, protecting coastal natural and manmade resources through climate change adaptation planning.

properties.title: Pacific Grove Polystyrene Ban
properties.description: Pacific Grove banned polystyrene food service wares to reduce non-biodegradable waste reaching local beaches and ocean. Partnership with Sustainable Pacific Grove and Monterey Green Action achieved ordinance passage in 2008.

properties.title: Temporary seawall ban in Solana Beach
properties.description: Ban on new seawalls in Solana Beach until new ordinance is devised. Campaign to protect coastal areas from hardened shoreline structures that damage beaches and marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Morro Bay/Cayucos Wastewater Treatment Plant Upgrade
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Morro Bay/Cayucos Wastewater Treatment Plant Upgrade
properties.description: Upgrade wastewater plant from partial to full secondary+tertiary treatment, ending 301(h) waiver. Cleaner ocean discharge, water reclamation opportunity. Morro Bay/Cayucos, CA. Approved May 2024.

properties.title: Oregon Oil and Gas Drilling Moratorium
properties.description: Oregon Legislature passed HB 3613 restoring moratorium on offshore oil/gas drilling in territorial waters (0-3nm) through 2020. Coalition of conservationists, fishing groups, businesses supported ban to protect ocean ecosystems.

properties.title: Solana Beach Public Recreation Fee
properties.description: Advocacy campaign to establish fair mitigation fees for coastal armoring impacts on beach access in Solana Beach. Surfrider SD Chapter successfully pushed for 67% wage rate in travel cost methodology, doubling recreation fees.

properties.title: Prevent Defacto Seawall in Solana Beach
properties.description: Surfrider successfully opposed filling 90ft of seacaves with concrete to protect homes not threatened by erosion. Prevented defacto seawall loophole that would harm beach access and set bad precedent for coastal armoring.

properties.title: Ban Polystyrene in Imperial Beach
properties.description: Imperial Beach banned polystyrene in food establishments to prevent plastic pollution. Restaurants phased out EPS over 6 months. Protects coastline and ocean from thousands of styrofoam items.

properties.title: San Diego Plastics Ordinance
properties.description: Ban on polystyrene foam containers, beach toys, coolers at San Diego restaurants and retailers to reduce ocean plastic pollution. Approved Dec 2022 after 3-year legal delay. Grassroots campaign led by Surfrider volunteers.

properties.title: Stopped Reclassification of Shoreline in Rhode Island
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stopped Reclassification of Shoreline in Rhode Island
properties.description: Surfrider prevented Rhode Island CRMC from reclassifying Matunuck Beach shoreline as man-made, blocking future seawall expansion. Small wall approved for road protection only. Advocates natural erosion management over hard structures.

properties.title: Puerto Rico's Northeastern Ecological Corridor Saved
properties.description: Protected wave-rich ecological corridor from mega-resort development through executive order designating it as nature reserve. Coalition effort led by Initiative for Sustainable Development in Puerto Rico's northeast coast.

properties.title: Marine Reserves Designated in Oregon
properties.description: Oregon designated Cape Perpetua, Cascade Head, and Cape Falcon marine reserves protecting 9% of territorial sea from fishing, drilling, and development through no-take zones and protected areas.

properties.title: Save Trestles
properties.description: Campaign to stop toll road development threatening Trestles surf break and coastal ecosystem. Surfrider and partners successfully blocked road segments through water quality protection, defeating developer appeals at State Water Board.

properties.title: Central Long Island Pro Park Campaign
properties.description: Surfrider campaign to preserve seascape vistas at Jones Beach, Robert Moses, Gilgo State Parks & Fire Island National Seashore by opposing offshore wind turbines in viewshed. Successfully cancelled LIPA proposal.

properties.title: Governor Signs Bill to Improve Coastal Commission Transparency
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Governor Signs Bill to Improve Coastal Commission Transparency
properties.description: AB 474 improves transparency of California Coastal Commission by requiring disclosure of all participants in ex parte communications, not just initiators. Ensures open, impartial coastal protection decisions.

properties.title: Tidepool awareness and educational success in Los Angeles
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Tidepool awareness and educational success in Los Angeles
properties.description: Compelled State Parks to implement Tidepool Awareness Program at Malibu and Point Dume with educational signage protecting intertidal marine life. Completed 2006.

properties.title: Santa Monica Bag Ban
properties.description: Santa Monica banned single-use plastic bags at retail stores to reduce ocean pollution. Passed Jan 2011, enforced Sept 2011. Paper bags sold for 10 cents. Restaurants exempt.

properties.title: No LNG Island in NY & NJ
properties.description: Surfrider chapters successfully opposed Atlantic Sea Island Groups' proposal to build a 60-acre artificial LNG terminal island 13 miles offshore Long Beach, NY on Cholera Banks reef through petitions, hearings, and paddle-outs.

properties.title: Washington State Year-Round Rescue Tug
properties.description: Year-round rescue tug stationed at Neah Bay to prevent oil spills in Strait of Juan de Fuca and Washington's outer coast. Funded by shippers/tankers. Signed into law March 24th after years of advocacy following Exxon Valdez.

properties.title: Long Beach Bag Ban
properties.description: Long Beach banned plastic checkout bags and imposed 10-cent fee on paper bags at supermarkets, pharmacies, farmers markets. Ordinance signed May 2011 to reduce marine plastic pollution in this California port city.

properties.title: Jetty Island Water Quality
properties.description: Improving public notification of wastewater spills (2-4/year) at Everett Treatment Plant near Jetty Island to protect swimmers, kite/wind surfers. Surfrider added to alert list for immediate beach closure warnings May-Oct.

properties.title: Long Beach NY Beach Fill
properties.description: City of Long Beach, NY voted against poorly designed beach fill plan by Army Corps of Engineers. Campaign to protect coastal integrity and prevent harmful beach engineering project in Long Beach.

properties.title: VICTORY - San Francisco Votes No on Prop I
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/VICTORY - San Francisco Votes No on Prop I
properties.description: Defeated Prop I to enable Great Highway Extension retreat at South Ocean Beach. Avoided $80M seawall that would consume beach. Advancing coastal resilience project with managed retreat to protect against sea level rise.

properties.title: Removal of Rincon, CA septic tanks
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation partnered with Heal the Ocean to compel state agency to force removal of septic tanks at Rincon, CA coastal area to prevent ocean pollution from wastewater contamination in 2006.

properties.title: Defeat of Pro-Oil Drilling Legislation in California
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Defeat of Pro-Oil Drilling Legislation in California
properties.description: Defeated Assembly Bill 2719 to prevent offshore drilling in California state waters. Surfrider Foundation led 5-town road show educating communities on drilling dangers, mobilizing chapters for legislative victory.

properties.title: Budget Victory for Coast
properties.description: California 2015 budget allocated $3M for Coastal Commission to partner with local governments to complete and update Local Coastal Programs (LCPs), protecting coastal resources at local level after Surfrider advocacy.

properties.title: Stopped Coastal Armoring at Sloat, San Francisco
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stopped Coastal Armoring at Sloat, San Francisco
properties.description: Surfrider SF stopped unpermitted rock revetments at Ocean Beach. Worked with partners to deny 600ft armoring permit, protect beach, allow Ocean Beach Master Plan for community-supported erosion strategies.

properties.title: Capitola Polystyrene Ban
properties.description: Santa Cruz chapter mobilized support for Capitola ordinance banning polystyrene foam disposable food service ware, promoting biodegradable alternatives. Passed 3-2 after community testimony and letters.

properties.title: Dana Point Foam Foodware Ban
properties.description: Dana Point banned polystyrene foodware at vendors & city events on Feb 21, 2012. Surfrider South OC Chapter mobilized activists to support the ordinance after foam was found as top beach cleanup item.

properties.title: Ocean Protection Law in NJ
properties.description: NJ law requiring ecosystem-based ocean management. Establishes Ocean Protection Council to study, coordinate & develop management plans. Surfrider & Coastal Ocean Coalition of NJ advocated for passage.

properties.title: Year-Round Water Quality Testing in Delaware
properties.description: Delaware Chapter convinced DNREC to expand beach water quality monitoring beyond tourist season to year-round testing, protecting surfers and beachgoers who use beaches during off-season and winter swells.

properties.title: 7-Year Ban on Domestic Drilling
properties.description: Obama Administration halted new offshore drilling leases along continental US for 7 years. Reversed March 2010 plans for south Atlantic, eastern Gulf of Mexico, Alaska. Protects coastal waters from drilling expansion.

properties.title: Stopped Destructive Development Project at the Fitzgerald Marine Reserve
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stopped Destructive Development Project at the Fitzgerald Marine Reserve
properties.description: San Mateo County rejected oversized residential development at Moss Beach's Fitzgerald Marine Reserve. 3,159 sq ft addition threatened sensitive coastal habitat and would require shoreline armoring. Board voted 4-1 to deny permits in 2024.

properties.title: WA Legislature supports coastal Marine Resources Committees
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/WA Legislature supports coastal Marine Resources Committees
properties.description: Washington Legislature passed bill establishing citizen advisory Marine Resources Committees on outer coast to address beach health, pollution, invasive species, habitat loss. $250k funding provided for coastal ecosystem protection.

properties.title: Lee County Fertilizer Ordinance
properties.description: Limits fertilizer use within 10ft of waterways Jun-Sep to reduce red tide & algal blooms affecting Lee County's beaches & $2B tourism. Violations up to $500. Partners: Sierra Club, SCCF, Nature Conservancy.

properties.title: Protected Beach Access at Bonaire Beach
properties.description: Secured public beach access to 900ft of beachfront at former Coast Guard property in Jupiter Island through inter-local agreement. Added 20 parking spaces at nearby Hobe Sound Beach for conservation and recreation.

properties.title: Texas Opens It's Beaches with a Constitutional Amendment!
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Texas Opens It's Beaches with a Constitutional Amendment!
properties.description: Texas passed Prop 9 constitutional amendment (75% voter approval) protecting public beach access rights along Gulf of Mexico's 367-mile coast, strengthening 1959 Open Beaches Act against development challenges.

properties.title: Oregon Marine Reserves
properties.description: Oregon Legislature passed HB 3013 to implement marine reserves at Redfish Rocks (Port Orford) and Otter Rock (Depoe Bay), with evaluation of additional sites at Cape Falcon, Cascade Head, Cape Perpetua, and Coos County area.
properties.funder: New Carissa salvage funds, grants, private donations

properties.title: Stopped Sewage Outfall at Delray Beach
properties.description: Surfrider partnered with local groups to close Florida's first sewage outfall at Delray Beach in 2006, protecting endangered corals and reef ecosystems from sewage dumping.

properties.title: Florida Beach Test Funding Protected
properties.description: Surfrider Florida Chapters successfully prevented state budget cuts to beach water quality monitoring programs, protecting public health and safety in a state where 85% of tourism depends on coastal resources.
properties.funder: State of Florida and Federal Beach Act

properties.title: Stopped gold mining on WA coast
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation partnered to stop gold mining operations at beaches on Washington's outer coast in 2006, protecting coastal ecosystems from mining impacts.

properties.title: CA Beach Monitoring Funding Restored
properties.description: Surfrider restored California beach water quality monitoring funding cut in 2008. Mobilized 2400+ activists, lobbied with partners. State approved Prop 13 Beach Grant funds for 2008-2009, seeking long-term solution.

properties.title: Florida Inlet Management Bill
properties.description: Addresses beach erosion from 60+ artificially deepened inlets. Jetties interrupt sand flow causing erosion. Campaign seeks state management to mitigate inlet impacts and establish cost-sharing for restoration solutions.

properties.title: Smoking Banned on All Beaches in Santa Monica Bay
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Smoking Banned on All Beaches in Santa Monica Bay
properties.description: Redondo Beach banned smoking at beaches/parks, completing Santa Monica Bay coverage. Reduces cigarette litter, protects marine life from toxic butts, improves water quality and beachgoer health.
properties.funder: South Bay Coalition for Smoke-Free Beaches

properties.title: Ventura City Council Adopts Green Street Policy
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ventura City Council Adopts Green Street Policy
properties.description: Ventura adopts green streets policy allocating 20% of paving funds to incorporate stormwater management elements in repaving projects, with pilot demonstration to reduce urban runoff impacting ocean health.

properties.title: Treasure Coast destructive restoration project stopped
properties.description: Surfrider stopped a destructive, non-compliant emergency dune restoration project on Florida's Treasure Coast in 2006, protecting coastal ecosystems from harmful development practices.

properties.title: Protected Coral Reef from Pollution in Lake Worth, FL
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protected Coral Reef from Pollution in Lake Worth, FL
properties.description: Stopped Lake Worth's plan to discharge 4M gallons/day of nutrient-laden wastewater onto coral reef. Public outcry & 1000+ letters led FDEP to change permit from ocean discharge to injection, protecting reef ecosystem.

properties.title: Florida Access Legislation
properties.description: Legislation to protect both lateral and perpendicular beach access in Florida by amending Chapter 161 Beach Management statute, addressing coastal overdevelopment impacts on public beach access.

properties.title: Clean Oceans Act in Florida
properties.description: Stops gambling boats dumping 44M gallons chlorinated waste yearly. Requires DEP registration, waste treatment systems, and federal dumping prohibition. Led by Sebastian Inlet Chapter.

properties.title: Access Restored in South Florida
properties.description: South Florida chapter restored public beach access closed by developers during construction. Campaign successfully reopened indefinitely closed beach with no temporary access provided during project.

properties.title: Save surfing access at Cocoa Beach Pier
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Save surfing access at Cocoa Beach Pier
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation campaign that successfully saved surfing access at Cocoa Beach Pier, Florida. Protects coastal recreation rights and public beach access for surfers and ocean users at this iconic Atlantic coast location.

properties.title: Derelict Crab Pots Cleaned from Southern Oregon Coast
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Derelict Crab Pots Cleaned from Southern Oregon Coast
properties.description: Removed 283 derelict commercial crab pots from Brookings beach and nearshore. Pots spilled Dec 2006, threatened surfing access and safety. Activists cleaned Southern Oregon coast to protect marine environment.

properties.title: Bill passes to improve WA oil spill response programs
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Bill passes to improve WA oil spill response programs
properties.description: WA law requires Dept of Ecology to train volunteers, mandate oil spill drills, equip fishermen as first responders, improve tanker requirements & stockpile response equipment. Passed on Gulf Oil Spill anniversary.

properties.title: Beach Water Quality Notification in Corpus Christi, TX
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Beach Water Quality Notification in Corpus Christi, TX
properties.description: Corpus Christi City Council unanimously approved beach water quality posting signs per Texas Beach Watch Program, enabling residents and tourists to make informed decisions about swimming and water activities in bay and Gulf waters.

properties.title: Governor Lifts Suspension on Coastal Act
properties.description: After Refugio State Beach oil spill, coalition urged Governor to restore Coastal Act jurisdiction. Successfully advocated for lifting suspension to maintain regulatory oversight of California coast.

properties.title: Prevention of Shoreline Structure Expansion at Herring Point, DE
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Prevention of Shoreline Structure Expansion at Herring Point, DE
properties.description: Prevented groin expansion/new structures at Herring Point, Cape Henlopen State Park to address erosion. Protects surf and natural resources drawing thousands regionally.

properties.title: Oppose Offshore Oil Drilling in Hermosa Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Oppose Offshore Oil Drilling in Hermosa Beach
properties.description: Campaign to stop E&B Oil's offshore drilling proposal in Hermosa Beach. Voters rejected slant wells 78.9% in March 2015. Surfrider South Bay Chapter led opposition with Heal the Bay through forums, ads, and voter outreach.

properties.title: Public Hearings required for Beach Fill Projects in NJ
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Public Hearings required for Beach Fill Projects in NJ
properties.description: NJ legislation requiring public hearings before beach replenishment projects. Addresses disastrous consequences of beachfill projects through community input and oversight of coastal protection efforts.

properties.title: Shoreline Preservation in Cannon Beach, OR
properties.description: Surfrider successfully opposed Measure 37 claim to build motel on protected sand dunes. City ruled against development west of vegetation line, upholding Oregon Beach Bill protections for ocean beaches.

properties.title: Enhanced Water Testing and Notification in Imperial Beach
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Enhanced Water Testing and Notification in Imperial Beach
properties.description: Daily water quality testing at 9 Imperial Beach beaches to monitor sewage pollution from Mexico. Results posted publicly to protect health along southern San Diego coast affected by 150+ closure days in 2020.

properties.title: Treasure Coast protection of the offshore sand shoals
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Treasure Coast protection of the offshore sand shoals
properties.description: Protected nearshore sand shoals off Florida's Treasure Coast from Army Corps of Engineers dredging. Campaign safeguards critical coastal sediment resources and marine habitat from extraction activities.

properties.title: Increased Protection for the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Increased Protection for the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: 7-year plan expanded sanctuary by 775 sq mi to include Davidson Seamount, prohibited cruise ship discharges, limited motorized watercraft, added Maverick's tow-in surfing zone, reduced invasive species introduction.

properties.title: South Padre Island - Plastic Bag Ban
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/South Padre Island - Plastic Bag Ban
properties.description: South Padre Island banned non-compostable plastic bags at point of sale. Allows reusable bags, recycled paper bags (40% post-consumer content), and compostable bags. Voluntary ban started Feb 2011, mandatory Jan 2012.

properties.title: Marine Protected Areas on the Central Coast, CA
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Marine Protected Areas on the Central Coast, CA
properties.description: Network of MPAs enacted on CA Central Coast under Marine Life Protection Act. Surfrider worked with activists and stakeholders statewide to protect special coastal places and marine life.

properties.title: Governor Brown Signs Legislation Strengthening Enforcement of Marine Protected Areas
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Governor Brown Signs Legislation Strengthening Enforcement of Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: AB 298 allows CA Fish & Wildlife officers to issue tickets for MPA violations, streamlining enforcement against poaching and illegal fishing in protected coastal waters. Signed Oct 2015.

properties.title: National Ocean Policy
properties.description: Established July 19, 2010 by President Obama. First comprehensive U.S. ocean policy protecting ocean, coastal & Great Lakes ecosystems. Uses marine spatial planning, regional cooperation, and National Ocean Council for implementation.

properties.title: Texas Open Beaches Act Defended by Courts
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Texas Open Beaches Act Defended by Courts
properties.description: Legal victory ensuring public beach access in Surfside, TX. Court ruled 16 houses on public beach must be removed under Texas Open Beaches Act. Surfrider provided key evidence through beach photos and adoption.

properties.title: Manhattan Beach Passes Ordinance to Ban Plastic Carry-Out Bags
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Manhattan Beach Passes Ordinance to Ban Plastic Carry-Out Bags
properties.description: Manhattan Beach City Council unanimously banned plastic carry-out bags. Phased implementation: 6 months for groceries/restaurants, 1 year for other retail. Supported by Surfrider Foundation and local residents.

properties.title: Martin's Beach Access Bill Signed
properties.description: SB 968 requires State Lands Commission to negotiate public access to Martin's Beach after landowner blocked entry. One-year negotiation period, with alternative acquisition mechanisms if unsuccessful. Signed Sept 2014.

properties.title: Topanga water quality
properties.description: Convinced State Parks to test and clean up water quality issues from leaking septic systems at Topanga Lagoon and Beach. Protects coastal water quality and beach health for ocean users and marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Surfer's Point
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation campaign focused on Surfer's Point coastal protection and preservation. Details on specific objectives, timeline, and location not available from page metadata.

properties.title: Texas Coastal Bend Building Setback Campaign
properties.description: Surfrider activists successfully advocated to maintain 350-foot building setback from ocean in Texas Coastal Bend to protect against erosion, hurricanes, and sea-level rise threatening ports and coastal communities.

properties.title: Stopped LNG Terminal in Long Island Sound
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Stopped LNG Terminal in Long Island Sound
properties.description: Surfrider CT & environmental groups stopped Broadwater LNG terminal in Long Island Sound. NY Governor Patterson rejected project in April after sustained citizen advocacy & state government pressure protected coastal waters.

properties.title: Styrofoam Banned in Scotts Valley
properties.description: Scotts Valley banned polystyrene food containers to protect sea creatures that mistake foam pieces for food. Ordinance passed Dec 2008, effective 6 months later. Part of coalition effort for county-wide ban.

properties.title: Sonar Testing in Southern California Rejected
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Sonar Testing in Southern California Rejected
properties.description: California Coastal Commission unanimously rejected Navy explosives and sonar training off Southern California coast due to insufficient evidence of negligible impact on marine ecosystems and endangered mammals in MPAs.

properties.title: Port Orford Stormwater Ordinance Strengthened
properties.description: Port Orford amended stormwater ordinance to protect water quality in streams and nearshore. 2+ year collaboration included research, education, outreach. Goal: protect water quality per Community Stewardship Area objectives.
properties.funder: Surfrider Foundation, Port Orford Ocean Resource Team, New Wave Planning, City of Port Orford, Oregon Department of Land Conservation and Development

properties.title: Neah Bay Rescue Tug Funded
properties.description: Year-round rescue tug at Neah Bay to prevent oil spills from tankers/cargo vessels. Protects Puget Sound wildlife & beaches. Responds to vessels in distress. $3.7M funded by WA Legislature after advocacy campaign.

properties.title: VA Gov Kaine Reject Oil drilling Bill
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/VA Gov Kaine Reject Oil drilling Bill
properties.description: Governor Kaine rejected bill seeking to end moratorium on natural gas/oil exploration, development, and production off Virginia coast. Campaign to protect coastal waters from offshore drilling impacts.

properties.title: El Morro returned to Crystal Cove
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/El Morro returned to Crystal Cove
properties.description: El Morro section of Crystal Cove State Park returned to public access. Surfrider Foundation campaign to restore public coastal access at Crystal Cove, California.

properties.title: Save Holualoa and Lyman's Surf Break in Kona
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Save Holualoa and Lyman's Surf Break in Kona
properties.description: Stopped 4-story condo development 40ft from reef at sacred Lyman's surf spot, Holualoa Bay, Kona. Community rallies & hearings led developer to withdraw permit application, protecting coastal access & Hawaiian cultural site.

properties.title: Ventura Approves Curb Cuts to Reduce Runoff
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ventura Approves Curb Cuts to Reduce Runoff
properties.description: Ventura County Surfrider worked with City of Ventura to create no-cost permits for parkway curb cuts and bio-basins. Cuts allow street runoff to be absorbed and filtered, reducing urban pollution flowing to ocean via stormdrains.

properties.title: Beach Access Bill Passed in HI
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Beach Access Bill Passed in HI
properties.description: Hawaii law requires DLNR to maintain beach transit corridors, prohibiting landowners from blocking public shoreline access with vegetation, fences, or walls. Enforcement action after 21-day notice period.

properties.title: Oahu Bans Plastic Bags!
properties.description: Surfrider's Oahu Chapter passed plastic bag ban in Honolulu City Council (April 2012, effective 2015). Coalition effort made Hawaii first US state with county-wide bans, reducing ocean plastic pollution.

properties.title: Lake Worth Surf and Reefs Protected
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Lake Worth Surf and Reefs Protected
properties.description: Surfrider challenged Palm Beach's permit to dredge 1.8 miles of beach with 700k cubic yards of sediment that would bury 7 acres of reefs, harm sea turtles, and damage surfing/fishing. Judge ruled against project in 2008.

properties.title: Blue Carbon Solutions for Mangrove Restoration in Tañon Strait
properties.description: Restoring mangroves in Tañon Strait through blue carbon credits to fund community development, address overfishing/pollution, and enhance climate resilience after Typhoon Odette damage.

properties.title: Jekyll Island Protected
properties.description: Surfrider's Coastal Georgia chapter successfully advocated to protect Jekyll Island State Park beachfront from commercial development, securing public park designation with improved beach access and an Environmental Conservation Center.

properties.title: Charleston, SC Single-Use Plastics Reduction Ordinance
properties.description: Charleston banned plastic bags, styrofoam, and straws to reduce pollution in waterways. Passed Nov 2018, enforced Jan 2020. Chapter helps businesses transition to protect coastal health.

properties.title: Oceanside Beach Fill Modified to Meet Coastal Preservation Standards
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Oceanside Beach Fill Modified to Meet Coastal Preservation Standards
properties.description: Surfrider San Diego worked with Oceanside and Coastal Commission on beach nourishment program, advocating for dual sand placement sites, enhanced surf monitoring, and corrected impact language to protect surfing areas.

properties.title: Mangrove and Seagrass Protection, Misool Island, Indonesia
properties.description: 30-year initiative protecting Raja Ampat's marine ecosystems through mangrove conservation, seagrass restoration, and biodiversity monitoring. Develops carbon/biodiversity credits to finance conservation across Misool's coastlines.

properties.title: Coastal Commission Requires Proof of Erodible Concrete
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Coastal Commission Requires Proof of Erodible Concrete
properties.description: Surfrider San Diego stopped untested erodible concrete installation at Solana Beach Tennis Club sea cliffs. Commission required proof material erodes before installation, protecting coastal resources. Jan 2016.

properties.title: Building Heights Limited in Kill Devil Hills, NC
properties.url: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Building Heights Limited in Kill Devil Hills, NC
properties.description: Surfrider's Outer Banks Chapter successfully preserved oceanfront building height restrictions in Kill Devil Hills to protect eroding shorelines and prevent increased pressure for beach fill and dredging projects.

properties.title: Access 33 Kept Open
properties.description: Surfrider's Cape Fear Chapter secured permanent public beach access at Wrightsville Beach Access 33 after 40+ years of use was threatened by property dispute. Town purchased easement through advocacy and negotiation.

properties.title: Kauai Bans Plastic Shopping Bags
properties.description: Kauai banned non-biodegradable plastic grocery bags after 2-year campaign. Retailers face $250-1000/day fines. 25,000 reusable bags distributed. Effective Jan 11, 2011 to reduce ocean plastic pollution.

properties.title: Ponte Vedra FL beach access
properties.description: Surfrider Foundation campaign securing favorable ruling to open beach access in Ponte Vedra, Florida, protecting public coastal access rights.

properties.title: Restored Access for Surfers in Miami
properties.description: Challenged Miami Beach's ban on launching vessels from public beaches. City Commission attempted global prohibition on surfboards/vessels except in designated rental areas, restricting public beach access.

properties.title: Community Mangrove Protection New Ireland Papua New Guinea
properties.description: Protects 18,000ha mangroves in New Ireland Province from mining threats through community-led monitoring, carbon measurement, and blue carbon credits. Establishes coastal management plan with local governance (2023-2025).

properties.title: Building a model for mangrove restoration under Indonesia's new carbon legislation
properties.description: Restores 1,729 hectares of abandoned fishponds to mangroves in Southeast Sulawesi. Tests Indonesia's 2023 forest carbon regulation on village land. Funded by Blue Carbon Accelerator Fund to enhance coastal resilience and carbon storage.

properties.title: Safeguarding the biodiversity of Malaysia's Rajang-Belawai Delta
properties.description: Restoring 77,600 hectares of mangrove forests in Rajang-Belawai Delta threatened by logging and palm oil. Blue carbon project with community benefit-sharing, carbon credits, and biodiversity protection. 2024-2025.

properties.title: Building sustainable aquaculture in the Sesayap River delta
properties.description: Integrates mangrove restoration with shrimp farming in Sesayap Delta, Indonesian Borneo. Aims for 5,000 ha aquaculture with 50% mangrove coverage by 2030. Combines sustainable seafood production with blue carbon credits.

properties.title: West Africa Coastal Areas Resilience Investment Project 2
properties.description: World Bank project investing in coastal resilience across West Africa, addressing erosion, flooding, and climate adaptation through infrastructure and community-based solutions.

properties.title: Restoring mangrove and seagrass ecosystems to safeguard Indonesia's coastlines
properties.description: Restoring mangrove & seagrass in Central Java & West Nusa Tenggara to combat climate change, protect against sea level rise, enhance blue carbon capture & support coastal communities. 30-month project (2023-2025).

properties.title: Tanzania Scaling-up Sustainable Marine Fisheries and Aquaculture Management Project (TASFAM)
properties.description: Scales up sustainable marine fisheries & aquaculture mgmt in Tanzania. Enhances coastal resource management, improves livelihoods of fishing communities, strengthens governance of marine resources along Tanzanian coast.

properties.title: Resilient Tourism and Blue Economy Development in Cabo Verde Project
properties.description: Develops sustainable blue economy and resilient tourism in Cabo Verde through coastal management, marine resource protection, and tourism infrastructure to support economic growth while preserving marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Accelerating Blue Economy Development in the Kingdom of Morocco
properties.description: World Bank project to accelerate blue economy development in Morocco, focusing on sustainable marine resource management, coastal development, and ocean-based economic opportunities.

properties.title: Oceans for Prosperity Project - LAUTRA
properties.description: World Bank marine conservation project LAUTRA focused on ocean prosperity. Details on specific objectives, implementation methods, timeline and location not available from page content.

properties.title: Belize Blue Cities and Beyond Project
properties.description: World Bank project supporting Belize's coastal cities with marine conservation, sustainable development, and blue economy initiatives to protect coastal and marine ecosystems while promoting economic growth.

properties.title: West Africa Coastal Areas Erosion and Blue Economy Multi-Phased Program
properties.description: Multi-phased program addressing coastal erosion and promoting blue economy development across West African coastal areas through integrated coastal zone management and sustainable marine resource utilization.

properties.title: Unleashing the Blue Economy of the Caribbean (UBEC)
properties.description: World Bank project developing Caribbean blue economy through sustainable marine resource management, fisheries, coastal tourism, and ocean-based economic opportunities across Caribbean island nations.

properties.title: Safeguarding Biodiversity and Livelihoods on North-Western Coast of Madagascar
properties.description: WWF & UNIMA restore 2,088 hectares of mangroves across 3 sites. Planting, training locals, carbon credits. Sequesters 530k tonnes CO2, protects against cyclones, enhances fisheries & crab farming. 2022-2025.

properties.title: Guinea - Kounki project - Climate resilience, fisheries and aquaculture
properties.description: World Bank project in Guinea focusing on climate resilience, fisheries and aquaculture development in the Kounki region to enhance sustainable marine resource management and coastal community livelihoods.

properties.title: MARINE BIODIVERSITY ASSESSMENT AND PREDICTION ACROSS SPATIAL, TEMPORAL AND HUMAN SCALES
properties.description: Pan-European marine biodiversity study from viruses to mammals, Mediterranean to Arctic. TREC expedition 2023/24 across 21 coastal countries, 35 marine labs. Creates open-access data hub, ecosystem health indicators.

properties.title: National Sanctuary Manglares de Tumbes, Peru
properties.description: Conservation of Peru's largest mangrove forest (29.72 km²) through carbon market certification. Protects 148 bird, 105 fish species. Generates income via carbon credits for local communities. 18 months, 2022-2024.

properties.title: Human History of Marine Life: Extraction, Knowledge, Drivers & Consumption of Marine Resources, c.100 BCE to c.1860 CE
properties.description: Global assessment of marine resource exploitation's role in human societies from 100 BCE to 1860 CE. Interdisciplinary study examining when/where marine harvest mattered, socio-economic/environmental drivers, and impacts on development.

properties.title: Atlantidae: Predators at the Ocean SurfacE as InDicators of chaNge
properties.description: Studies atlantid heteropods as bio-indicators of ocean acidification and warming. Investigates past, present, future effects on these aragonite-shelled planktonic gastropods to understand surface ocean changes.

properties.title: Climate relevant interactions and feedbacks: the key role of sea ice and snow in the polar and global climate system
properties.description: Studies polar sea ice decline & ocean-ice-atmosphere interactions. Improves climate models through satellite/in-situ observations. Quantifies feedback mechanisms & teleconnections for better climate projections.

properties.title: OBSERVING AND MAPPING MARINE ECOSYSTEMS – NEXT GENERATION TOOLS
properties.description: Develops toolbox integrating remote sensing, eDNA, optical instruments & citizen science with existing monitoring to map marine ecosystems & biodiversity at higher resolution across 4 European seas for better resource management

properties.title: OCEAN CITIZEN - Marine forest coastal restoration: an underwater gardening socio-ecological plan
properties.description: Restores marine forests (seagrasses, seaweeds, corals, sponges) across 3 sites (subtropical, tropical, cold temperate) via 'sea gardeners', ecoengineering, carbon sequestration, citizen involvement, depths to 100m.

properties.title: MARCO-BOLO
properties.description: Strengthens European coastal/marine biodiversity observation using eDNA, robotics, acoustics. Develops autonomous monitoring tech, establishes protocols across ecosystems. Links to global ocean health efforts via MBON, GOOS, UN Ocean Decade.

properties.title: Blueprint for Atlantic-Arctic Agora on cross-sectoral cooperation for restoration of marine and coastal ecosystems and increased climate resilience through transformative innovation
properties.description: Demonstrates nature-based solutions for marine ecosystem restoration in Atlantic-Arctic coastal areas. Uses ecosystem-based management to boost climate resilience through blue reforestation and pressure reduction at demo sites in Portugal, Ireland, N

properties.title: The critical role of sedimentary trace element fluxes in ocean biogeochemistry
properties.description: Investigates trace elements (iron, neodymium, zinc) and isotopes in ocean sediments to understand carbon/oxygen cycles and improve climate predictions through global biogeochemical modeling.

properties.title: MARINE CARBON PUMP - Chromium isotopes as a tracer of the marine biological carbon pump
properties.description: Develops Chromium isotope proxy to trace marine biological carbon pump strength, investigating biogeochemical processes regulating ocean CO2 exchange and export productivity through phytoplankton cultures, water-column studies, and sediment analysis.

properties.title: Beyond the Iron Curtain: Trace Metal Co-limitation of Phytoplankton Growth
properties.description: Models trace metal co-limitation (iron, cobalt, copper, manganese, zinc) of phytoplankton growth to understand ocean productivity, carbon cycle, and marine food webs. Combines data synthesis with numerical modeling.

properties.title: Ultimate Paleo-Ocean Records from Biogenic Calcites
properties.description: Creates accurate paleo-ocean records by analyzing biogenic calcite fossils using ultra-high-resolution isotopic imaging to understand ocean's role in climate evolution, correcting diagenesis bias in sediment records.

properties.title: Southern Ocean Silicon Cycling: combining views of the past and present using silicon isotopes
properties.description: Studies Southern Ocean silicon cycling and isotopes to understand nutrient dynamics, carbon export, and climate change over glacial cycles. Analyzes seawater and sediment cores to track silicon transport and diatom activity.

properties.title: The global ocean carbon cycle after peak emissions: Dynamics and process attribution in a seamless model framework from coastal shelves to the open ocean
properties.description: Develops forecasting tool to predict global ocean CO2 uptake in low emission scenarios using multi-resolution model. Quantifies ocean carbon sink from coastal to global scales for Paris Agreement monitoring.

properties.title: BlueActionBANOS
properties.description: EU Mission Ocean project scaling solutions for biodiversity, pollution reduction, climate-neutral blue economy in Baltic & North Sea. Provides financial & technical support to communities for ocean restoration.

properties.title: ObsSea4Clim
properties.description: EU project improving ocean observing for climate assessment through EOV/ECV framework, regional indicators, AI data quality control, and FAIR data standards. Addresses sea ice, ocean warming, marine heat waves globally.

properties.title: Co-Creating Transformative Pathways to Biological and Ecosystem Ocean Observations
properties.description: Develops Blueprint for Integrated Ocean Science to improve biological/ecosystem ocean observation. Co-creates with stakeholders to advance data collection, monitoring, and models for Essential Ocean Variables globally.

properties.title: Next generation multiplatform Ocean observing technologies for research infrastructures
properties.description: Develops autonomous sensors for ocean CO2 monitoring on moving/fixed platforms. Advances biogeochemical observing systems to track ocean acidification and carbon fluxes, supporting climate policy and blue economy goals.

properties.title: Support to SET Plan Implementation Working Group and European Technology and Innovation Platform for Ocean Energy
properties.description: EU project enhancing cooperation in ocean energy sector. Supports ETIP Ocean & SET Plan IWG through coordination, knowledge exchange, sustainability focus. Aims to integrate renewable ocean electricity into European energy systems.

properties.title: Promoting ocean and water literacy in school communities
properties.description: ProBleu expands the Network of European Blue Schools to improve ocean/water literacy through open schooling, citizen science, and scientist interaction, protecting marine/freshwater ecosystems and preventing pollution across Europe.

properties.title: New Copernicus capability for trophic ocean networks
properties.description: Enhancing Copernicus Marine Service to monitor European marine ecosystems through innovative models fusing satellite, acoustic, pollution & omics data. Simulates higher-trophic-levels, benthic habitats, pollutants for biodiversity conservation.

properties.title: Blue Carbon production, export and sequestration in emerging polar ecosystems
properties.description: Studies emerging polar ecosystems in high-latitude seas to assess blue carbon sequestration potential, marine biodiversity impacts, and climate role. Field surveys and models quantify carbon stocks in coastal/pelagic/benthic systems.

properties.title: SHORE: EmpOweR Students as the agents of cHangE
properties.description: 36-month ocean literacy project engaging students/teachers across Baltic, Black, Mediterranean seas & Danube/Rhine rivers. Grants to 100 schools, workshops, exhibitions. Digital platform tracks progress. Annual awards.

properties.title: EDITO-Model Lab - European Digital Twin Ocean Virtual Model Lab
properties.description: Develops next-gen ocean models & Virtual Ocean Model Lab enabling stakeholders to create ocean management scenarios. Uses AI & HPC to support sustainable blue economy & explore what-if scenarios for ocean hazards. Part of EU Digital Twin Ocean.

properties.title: Polar Ocean Mitigation Potential
properties.description: Assesses blue carbon mitigation in Arctic/Antarctic ecosystems. Studies CO2 capture by primary producers, carbon flow, sequestration. Develops models, remote sensing to guide marine protected areas. Pan-Arctic focus.

properties.title: COmmunity Ocean farms and Local Business cLUstErs (COOL BLUE)
properties.description: Northern European network empowering coastal communities to develop low-impact ocean farming systems in Baltic & North Sea. Creates resilient socioecological systems through sustainable seafood practices, targeting ocean recovery by 2030.

properties.title: European Hydrography Support Programme
properties.description: Supports European oceanographic networks with shared facilities, training, equipment pools, and data curation for water column measurements serving marine policy and climate science across coastal countries.

properties.title: Marine SABRES - Marine Systems Approaches for Biodiversity Resilience and Ecosystem Sustainablity
properties.description: Co-designing Simple Social-Ecological Systems approach to enable Ecosystem-Based Management across Europe. Reversing marine biodiversity decline through sustainable blue economy integration in Tuscan Archipelago, Arctic NE Atlantic, Macaronesia.

properties.title: Marine Coastal Ecosystems Biodiversity and Services in a Changing World
properties.description: Studies climate change impacts on seagrass, kelp, coral reefs, mangroves, salt marshes. Develops models, vulnerability assessments, nature-based solutions for EU marine coastal ecosystem conservation from tropics to sub-polar regions.

properties.title: MARine Biodiversity and Ecosystem Functioning leading to Ecosystem Services
properties.description: 23 institutes from 15 EU countries evaluate links between marine biodiversity, ecosystem functioning & services across Arctic to Mediterranean. Develops ecological & economic valuation tools for policy.

properties.title: DiverSea - Integrated Observation, Monitoring and Prediction Architecture for Functional Biodiversity of Coastal Seas
properties.description: Develops DNA-based marine monitoring using eDNA/eRNA, autonomous systems, satellite data, and AI-ML to map coastal habitats, predict biodiversity, and link ecosystem functions to services via interactive dashboard for policymakers.

properties.title: COMPASS - Processes on the Antarctic continental shelf and slope
properties.description: Uses autonomous gliders to observe Antarctic shelf/slope processes crucial for sea level rise, bottom water export, and carbon cycle. Studies ocean fronts, ice-atmosphere-ocean interaction, and ice shelf heat exchange across Antarctica.

properties.title: Making the Earth Global: Early Modern Nautical Rutters and the Construction of a Global Concept of the Earth
properties.description: Studies 16th-17th century Iberian nautical rutters and ship logbooks documenting oceanic navigation, oceanography, meteorology, and geophysics to understand how global earth concepts emerged from maritime exploration.

properties.title: Coastal Climate Resilience and Marine Restoration Tools for the Arctic Atlantic basin
properties.description: Develops modular toolbox for coastal ecosystem restoration & climate resilience across Arctic-Atlantic (Svalbard to Madeira). Integrates stakeholder involvement, cost-benefit analysis, nature-based solutions for diverse habitats.
properties.funder: Horizon Europe, European Union - Horizon Europe

properties.title: Tracking Of Plastic In Our Seas
properties.description: Models plastic movement in oceans via virtual parcels simulating fragmentation, sinking, beaching. Maps pathways, identifies high-risk zones for marine life. Informs policy on mitigation strategies and responsibility allocation.

properties.title: Impact of diatom evolution on the oceans
properties.description: Studies diatom evolution from 200M years ago and their impact on ocean biogeochemical cycles of silica, carbon, nutrients. Examines fossil records to understand timing of dissolved silicon drawdown and ancient ocean productivity changes.

properties.title: Breathing Oceans: understanding the organic skin that modulates the exchange of greenhouse gases between the atmosphere and the ocean
properties.description: Studies ocean's organic skin layer modulating CO2, CH4, N2O exchange between atmosphere and ocean. Uses sensors and geochemical analysis on South America-Africa transect to model surfactant effects on gas flux.

properties.title: Gauging Ocean organic Carbon fluxes using Autonomous Robotic Technologies
properties.description: Uses underwater gliders to measure ocean carbon flux and remineralisation depth variability. Aims to improve climate models by understanding how organic carbon sinks and is stored in deep ocean, reducing CO2 prediction uncertainty.

properties.title: Plate tectonics: Rheological lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary study
properties.description: Systematic imaging of oceanic plate beneath Atlantic from birth at ridge to 40 My old seafloor using ocean bottom seismometers and magnetotelluric instruments to determine processes defining tectonic plates.

properties.title: Competing Interests in the Ocean: The Law of the Sea, Climate Change and Energy
properties.description: Legal framework for ocean governance balancing offshore industry, marine protection, climate change, and energy security through analysis of sea law, climate law, and energy law regime interactions.

properties.title: Ocean Artificial Upwelling
properties.description: Studies artificial upwelling to enhance ocean productivity, fish farming & CO2 sequestration by pumping nutrient-rich deep water to surface. Uses experiments, field observations & modeling to assess feasibility & ecological impacts.

properties.title: Climate Change and Future Marine Ecosystem Services and Biodiversity
properties.description: Nature-based solutions for marine conservation: restoration of habitat-forming species, marine protected areas, sustainable seafood harvesting to safeguard biodiversity and ecosystem services against climate change impacts.

properties.title: Ocean ICU
properties.description: Measures biological carbon pump processes in oceans to resolve CO2 sink model-data mismatch. Develops tools linking human activities (fishing, extraction) to ocean carbon storage for UNFCCC global stocktake and Green Deal fisheries management.

properties.title: ACTNOW - Advancing understanding and forecasting of cumulative impacts on marine biodiversity
properties.description: EU program studying climate change impacts on marine biodiversity across European seas. Develops monitoring tools, forecasting models, and decision-support systems to restore habitats and protect marine ecosystems. 2022-2027.

properties.title: Wave-modulated Arctic Air-sea eXchanges and Turbulence (WAAXT)
properties.description: Studies wave-driven processes, turbulence, ice formation in Arctic Ocean using field experiments in Saint Lawrence Estuary and Arctic. Focuses on air-sea fluxes, ice breakup, stratification. 2019-2024.

properties.title: Large scale RESToration of COASTal ecosystems through rivers to sea connectivity
properties.description: Upscaled coastal restoration for low-carbon adaptation across EU regional seas (Baltic, Black, North, Atlantic, Mediterranean). Restores wetlands, seagrass beds, dunes via river-coast connectivity. 9 pilots reduce erosion/flooding, enhance biodiversi

properties.title: OceaNice - Oceanography and Ice sheet evolution: a new approach for projecting future sea level rise
properties.description: Studies Antarctic ice sheet melt via Southern Ocean warming using past climate proxies (dinoflagellate cysts, biomarkers) to project future sea level rise. Calibrates proxies, applies to warm periods, models ocean circulation.

properties.title: Plastic in the Ocean: Microbial Transformation of an 'Unconventional' Carbon Substrate
properties.description: Studies microbial degradation of ocean plastics using isotope labeling to trace carbon from polymers into CO2 and biomass, identifying microbes and pathways that break down marine plastic pollution across environmental conditions.

properties.title: Biogeochemical and ecosystem interactions with socio-economic activity in the global ocean
properties.description: Develops unified modeling framework integrating ocean physics, chemistry, ecology & fisheries to understand human impacts on marine ecosystems, including oxygen zones, nutrient cycling & fishing interactions globally.

properties.title: CAUSALITY
properties.description: Develops Bayesian methods to infer causal relations in ocean dynamics. Studies interocean transport around South Africa where Southern, Indian, and Atlantic Oceans meet, crucial for global heat/salt circulation.

properties.title: CO2 exerts a major control on Earth's environment, including ocean acidity and global climate
properties.description: Reconstructs 100 Myr ocean pH & atmospheric CO2 using boron isotopes from fossil shells to understand Earth's climate response to high CO2 & predict future ocean acidification impacts.

properties.title: Global land ice, hydrology and ocean mass trends
properties.description: Constrains sea level rise sources by combining satellite/in-situ observations with physical principles to solve all sea level budget components (steric, hydrological, cryospheric, solid earth) for 1981-2020 globally.

properties.title: Southern Indian Ocean climate evolution and its global linkages
properties.description: Studies past oceanic conditions in Southern Ocean during warmer periods to improve climate forecasts. Uses sediment cores from Indian sector to analyze phytoplankton, ocean circulation, and biological variations as analogs for future conditions.

properties.title: Ocean-Bottom Distributed Acoustic Sensors: new tools for Underwater Seismology
properties.description: Retrofitting undersea telecom fiber optic cables into seismic sensor arrays to monitor offshore earthquakes and tsunamis. Low-cost alternative to ocean-bottom seismometers, monitoring 50+ km spans with thousands of points.

properties.title: Transformative adaptation towards ocean equity
properties.description: Interdisciplinary research analyzing how ocean stressors (climate change, biodiversity loss) affect marine protected areas and coastal communities, developing frameworks to address ocean inequality across Africa, Europe, and Latin America.

properties.title: TRUST: Towards Resilient and SUStainable ConTainer Supply Chains
properties.description: Addresses climate, cyber & safety risks in container shipping. Quantifies climate impacts, forecasts security threats, advances holistic safety for sustainable maritime supply chains. Liverpool-based research 2020-2025.

properties.title: Ozone dry deposition to the sea surface microlayer
properties.description: Studies ozone deposition on ocean surfaces (70% of Earth). Combines modeling & field observations to quantify global ocean deposition flux, reducing uncertainty in climate models. Focuses on chemical reactions in sea surface microlayer.

properties.title: Turbulent transport in the ocean: from theory to climate models
