properties.description: Develops physics-based parameterization for ocean mesoscale eddy transport to improve climate models. Combines theory, lab experiments, simulations & satellite data to quantify how ocean redistributes heat & CO2 globally.

properties.title: A new era of transient tracers in the Arctic and Atlantic oceans
properties.description: Studies Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation using radionuclide tracers (129I, 236U, 39Ar, 14C) to understand water mass pathways and ventilation timescales in Arctic and North Atlantic. 2020-2025, expeditions across regions.

properties.title: Ocean deoxygenation effects on threatened top predators: New understanding and predictions from novel bio-logging instruments and data
properties.description: Studies how expanding oxygen minimum zones affect sharks and tuna using new biologging tech to measure oxygen tolerances and metabolism in free-living fish, predicting impacts on distribution and fisheries vulnerability.

properties.title: How evaluation shapes ocean science. A multi-scale ethnography of fluid knowledge.
properties.description: Ethnographic study analyzing how research evaluation shapes ocean science agendas, interdisciplinary engagement, and societal relevance in European policy contexts through scientometric and qualitative methods.

properties.title: Advanced Braking Module with Cyclic Energy Recovery System (CERS) for enhanced reliability and performance of Wave Energy Converters
properties.description: Develops innovative braking module with energy recovery for Wave Energy Converters. Solves end-stop problem, increases energy production 25%, reduces costs 30%. Tested on CorPower platform, applicable to point absorber WECs.

properties.title: VALID - Hybrid Testing Platform for Wave Energy Converters
properties.description: Develops accelerated hybrid testing platform combining physical and virtual testing to improve reliability and survivability of Wave Energy Converter components, reducing costly sea testing failures.

properties.title: Advancing Novel imaging Technologies and data analyses in order to understand Interior ocean Carbon Storage
properties.description: Studies ocean carbon storage using imaging tech & machine learning to track organic matter sinking in Atlantic upper 600m. Maps flux attenuation processes to improve climate models predicting atmospheric CO2 variations up to 200 ppm.

properties.title: European Scalable Complementary Offshore Renewable Energy Sources
properties.description: Multi-source offshore renewable energy parks combining solar PV, wind, and wave energy. Demonstrations in Belgium (offshore solar with bottom-fixed wind) and Portugal (wave array with floating wind) to prove continuous power, higher capacity, lower c

properties.title: EU-INTERCHANGE - European Regional and Coastal Seas in a Rapid Changing Climate
properties.description: Digital Ocean Twin using wave, ocean, biogeochemistry models to monitor climate change impacts across European Seas and Pan-Arctic. Assesses coastal resilience, sea level rise, aquaculture, marine renewables. Database 1995-2100.

properties.title: EmpowerUs - Empowering Coastal Communities for Sustainable Transition
properties.description: Enables coastal communities across EU regions to transition towards sustainable development via 6 Transition Coastal Labs, co-creating social innovation & Nature-Based Solutions with capacity building & Ocean Literacy programs.

properties.title: Social Transformation for Water Stewardship through Scaling Up Citizen Science
properties.description: OTTERS scales up citizen science for marine/freshwater monitoring. Co-creates data standards, runs Spring-to-Sea campaigns, connects to EMODnet/ILIAD portals. Supports EU Water Framework Directive goals.

properties.title: Participatory Art for Society Engagement with Ocean and Water
properties.description: EU project using participatory art to strengthen emotional attachment to oceans/waters, raise awareness of challenges, build trans-European artistic networks, and support sustainable policies through 20 multi-stakeholder initiatives.

properties.title: C-FAARER
properties.description: Develops community-driven business models for regenerative ocean farming (seaweed aquaculture) in Atlantic and Arctic basins. Works with ocean farmers in Norway and Ireland to create sustainable practices benefiting ecosystems and communities.

properties.title: Empowering Community Led Action in the Atlantic & Arctic (ACT-AA)
properties.description: EU Mission project mobilizing Atlantic & Arctic communities to restore marine/freshwater ecosystems through cascading grants (€200k-€2M), technical assistance, and capacity-building for sustainable local action by 2030.

properties.title: HADES - Benthic diagenesis and microbiology of hadal trenches
properties.description: First detailed analysis of benthic diagenesis and microbial ecology in deepest oceanic trenches. Studies organic material deposition, carbon/nitrogen cycles, microbial communities, and viral regulation at extreme pressure using novel in situ instrume

properties.title: Danish EU Presidency Event for the Mission Restore our Oceans and Waters
properties.description: Danish EU Presidency conference in Nyborg (Sept 2025) convening European stakeholders to advance Mission Ocean goals: ecosystem restoration, zero pollution, sustainable blue economy. Develops Strategic Roadmap for marine/freshwater protection.

properties.title: SEADOTs - Social-Ecological ocean management Applications with Digital Ocean Twins
properties.description: Advancing sustainable ocean management via digital ocean twins combining socio-ecological data with ocean models. Demonstrates applications in Norwegian North Sea, Southern North Sea & Baltic Sea for marine spatial planning.

properties.title: FLOW - Future Lives with Oceans and Waters
properties.description: Youth-led co-creation of ocean stewardship across Europe. Engages young people via advisory boards, NGO networks, experiential workshops in 7 regions, and stakeholder collaboration to restore oceans by 2030.

properties.title: Centre of Excellence in Ocean Research and Engineering
properties.description: Portugal creates ocean research hub focusing on marine robotics, structures, energy & AI digitalization. Aims to boost blue economy, foster academia-industry collaboration, train talent in sea technology for sustainable ecosystem development.

properties.title: ECOTWIN - Emulating complex causal socio-ecological models in digital twins of ocean
properties.description: Develops graph theoretic models integrating social, economic & ecological factors for European Digital Twin Ocean. Validates in North Sea, Celtic Sea, Thracian Sea & Waterford Harbour to assess marine renewables, fishing & tourism impacts.

properties.title: Recycling versus loss in the marine nitrogen cycle: controls, feedbacks, and the impact of expanding low oxygen regions
properties.description: Studies microbial nitrogen transformations in oxygen-depleted ocean zones to predict impacts of deoxygenation on marine ecosystems and carbon sequestration through ecophysiological experiments and global modeling.

properties.title: BlueMissionBANOS – supporting the Mission Ocean Lighthouse in the Baltic and North Sea basins
properties.description: EU Mission to restore ocean, seas & waters by 2030. Engages stakeholders across Baltic & North Sea to protect ecosystems, eliminate pollution, make blue economy carbon-neutral via lighthouses, BlueParks & digital systems.

properties.title: SEAClim: European SEAs CLIMate impact prediction through regional models
properties.description: Predicts decadal-to-multidecadal marine environment changes using regional ocean models. Focuses on northeastern Atlantic, North Sea, Arctic Ocean. Develops ocean health indicators for climate policy and blue economy decisions.

properties.title: BlueGreen Governance
properties.description: Develops innovative land-sea governance integrating institutions, policy sectors, scientific evidence & citizen participation across 8 European coastal cases. Uses e-governance tools to respond to changing conditions in multiple sea basins.

properties.title: UNITED - Multi-Use offshore platforms demoNstrators for boostIng cost-effecTive and Eco-friendly proDuction in sustainable marine activities
properties.description: Pilot demonstrators proving multi-use offshore platforms combining marine activities are economically, socially & environmentally viable. Focus: tech synchronization, economics, legal frameworks, societal acceptance & environmental impact.

properties.title: Technical assistance and support to communities of actors for the Mission Restore our ocean and waters by 2030 for the Mediterranean basin
properties.description: Supports Mediterranean marine restoration through €9M funding for scale-up solutions and transition agendas. Provides technical support on policy, funding, business planning. Aims to restore seas by 2030 via Blue doughnut concept.

properties.title: OKEANO - Supporting the All-Atlantic Ocean Research and Innovation Alliance
properties.description: Supports All-Atlantic Ocean Research Alliance to sustainably manage Atlantic Ocean through international cooperation, addressing pollution, overfishing, climate change. Connects stakeholders across Atlantic regions.

properties.title: High Arctic Ocean Observation System
properties.description: Develops ocean-observing tech for ice-covered Arctic Ocean. Deploys multipurpose moorings in Nansen & Amundsen Basins for ocean/sea ice measurements, acoustic thermometry, marine mammal detection. 2024-2026 field experiments.

properties.title: Source to Sea: Leveraging community knowledge and action for restoring the Danube River basin and the Black Sea region
properties.description: Community-led restoration of Danube River Basin & Black Sea through water literacy programs, capacity-building, cascade funding for innovative solutions addressing pollution, biodiversity loss via tech, nature-based approaches.

properties.title: Robots Explore plankton-driven Fluxes in the marine twIlight zoNE
properties.description: Robotics study of ocean twilight zone (200-1000m depth) to quantify biological carbon pump and plankton communities' role in CO2 sequestration across five oceanic zones using autonomous profiling floats and AI analysis.

properties.title: Coalition of Waterfront Cities, Regions and Islands
properties.description: Unites waterfront cities, regions & islands to protect oceans via Mission Ocean and Waters. Provides networking, training, advisory support & MOW Label to empower systemic action, citizen engagement & funding access.

properties.title: Explaining and Predicting the Ocean Conveyor
properties.description: Studies Atlantic meridional overturning circulation (AMOC) using observations, machine learning & climate models to understand ocean heat/freshwater transport, predict climate change & assess tipping point risks.

properties.title: Stochastic Transport in Upper Ocean Dynamics
properties.description: Develops stochastic models to assess ocean variability, sea level rise, heat uptake, carbon storage & marine debris transport using satellite data, simulations & data assimilation across UK & France institutions.

properties.title: Geochemical-physical coupled study of the modern Arctic Ocean: GEOTRACES-ARCTIC
properties.description: Pan-Arctic study investigating climate-driven changes through biogeochemical tracers, ocean circulation, and land-ocean exchanges. Field research from Canada Basin to Labrador Sea using modeling and measurements.

properties.title: DIATOMIC - Untangling eco-evolutionary impacts on diatom genomes over timescales relevant to current climate change
properties.description: Studies diatom algae evolution/adaptation using ancient DNA from sub-seafloor sediments to forecast ocean primary production and carbon sequestration under climate change. Focuses on Chaetoceros genus over 100,000 years.

properties.title: Are marine living microorganisms influencing clouds?
properties.description: Investigates how marine microorganisms emit gases/particles affecting cloud formation. Studies gas-phase emissions, nucleation, aerosol growth, and cloud properties in Southern Hemisphere oceans using mesocosms and modeling.

properties.title: Tipping Points in Antarctic Climate Components
properties.description: Studies Antarctic ice sheet tipping points & sea level rise reversibility using ocean-circulation & ice-flow models, remote sensing & paleo-reconstructions to predict sudden changes & develop early-warning indicators.

properties.title: Advanced Prediction in Polar regions and beyond: Modelling, observing system design and LInkages associated with ArctiC ClimATE change
properties.description: Arctic climate prediction framework improving weather/climate models via enhanced atmospheric boundary layer, sea ice-ocean coupling, observing systems. Multi-model experiments assess Arctic change impacts on Northern Hemisphere.

properties.title: OCEAN SENTINEL
properties.description: Bio-logging tech on marine predators to detect/locate fishing vessels via radar emissions in Southern Indian Ocean. Monitors legal/illegal fishing in EEZs & international waters. Tested from Crozet & Kerguelen Islands.

properties.title: Carbon Cascades from Land to Ocean in the Anthropocene
properties.description: Studies carbon transfer from land to ocean via rivers, lakes, coastal waters. Quantifies CO2/CH4 fluxes, develops sensors, models carbon transformations globally. Trains scientists on climate-carbon cycle interactions.

properties.title: FOXSTORM - Feedbacks On eXtreme STorms by Ocean tuRbulent Mixing
properties.description: Measures ocean turbulence in extreme storms using autonomous underwater gliders to understand how ocean mixing affects storm intensity and upper ocean temperatures, developing new forecasting models for climate change impacts.

properties.title: SEAMLESS - Services based on Ecosystem data AssiMiLation: Essential Science and Solutions
properties.description: Develops data assimilation methods integrating satellite/in-situ ocean data to improve marine ecosystem monitoring, estimating climate impacts, carbon export, plankton dynamics for Copernicus Marine Service across European waters.

properties.title: FLOATECH - Floating Offshore Wind Energy Technology
properties.description: Develops advanced simulation tools and control techniques for floating offshore wind farms in deep waters to increase energy yield, reduce costs, and support EU renewable energy goals through innovative design methods.

properties.title: RAMONES - Radioactivity Monitoring in Ocean Ecosystems
properties.description: Develops AI-driven robotic sensors for continuous deep-sea radioactivity monitoring. Addresses under-sampling gap in ocean radiation data from natural/artificial sources. Targets coastal & deep ecosystems globally.

properties.title: Multi-disciplinary Comparison of Fluid Venting from Gas Hydrate Systems on the Mediterranean and Brazilian Continental Margins over Glacial-Interglacial Timescales
properties.description: Comparative study of gas hydrate venting on Mediterranean & South Atlantic margins. Uses geophysical, geological & geochemical analysis to understand methane release dynamics over glacial cycles. Nile fan field campaign planned.

properties.title: OCEAN:ICE
properties.description: Assesses Antarctic & Greenland ice sheet impacts on sea level, ocean circulation & climate via observations & models. Reduces uncertainty in ice melt predictions, evaluates tipping points. Contributes to IPCC assessments.

properties.title: The 'orphan' boundary type in plate tectonics: oceanic transform faults reconstructed
properties.description: Seismological, geodetic & geological surveys of oceanic transform faults to reveal if they're wrongly classified as conservative boundaries & instead are two-stage accretion features, revolutionizing plate tectonics understanding.

properties.title: Gliders for Research, Ocean Observations and Management: Infrastructure and Innovation
properties.description: EU project building distributed infrastructure for underwater/surface drones (gliders) to support ocean research, monitoring, blue economy & innovation. Advances robotics, AI, sensors for marine observations down to 6000m depth.

properties.title: Ocean DYNAmics reconstruction using remotely sensed variables in two CLIMate hotspots
properties.description: Reconstructs 3D ocean currents from satellite data (salinity, temperature, height) in Arctic & Mediterranean to improve climate models & understand climate change impacts on navigation & maritime transport.

properties.title: Ocean-based Negative Emission Technologies - analyzing the feasibility, risks, and cobenefits of ocean-based negative emission technologies for stabilizing the climate
properties.description: Investigates ocean-based carbon removal technologies to limit warming to 1.5°C. Assesses feasibility, impacts on society & Earth systems, policy challenges. Transdisciplinary approach evaluating NETs within UN SDG framework.

properties.title: MOORING - Ocean mixing from novel submarine cable data
properties.description: Studies ocean mixing via submarine fiber-optic cables & modeling to quantify wave-topographic interactions driving climate-critical meridional overturning circulation. Novel seismology-oceanography approach for energy budgets.

properties.title: A Probe of the Periodic Elements for Life in the Sea
properties.description: Studies trace metal requirements of marine phytoplankton to understand ocean carbon pumping and climate. Uses proteomics and mass-spectrometry to define the marine metallome/metalloproteome.

properties.title: Social-Ecological Analysis and Models for Digital Twin Ocean
properties.description: Develops social-ecological models and decision-support tools for EU Digital Twin Ocean to restore marine/freshwater health by 2030. Case studies in Baltic, North Sea, Mediterranean. Creates interactive platform with scenarios.

properties.title: SEAFIRE - Path towards a sustainable Mediterranean Sea: mitigation actions to cope with Marine Heat Waves
properties.description: Investigates Marine Heat Waves effects on Western Mediterranean ecosystems using physical/biogeochemical models, in-situ observations, fishing data & Digital Twin Ocean platform to propose mitigation strategies.

properties.title: MARINECOSMICS - Characterizing the most abundant unknown microbes in the global ocean
properties.description: Study of 81 unknown microbial eukaryotes found globally in sunlit oceans via Tara expedition. Culturing, microscopy & transcriptomics reveal biology, interactions & ecosystem roles of these abundant protists.

properties.title: European Eddy-RIch ESMs (EERIE)
properties.description: Develops next-gen Earth System Models simulating ocean mesoscale eddies (<100km swirls) to improve climate predictions, variability, extremes & tipping points for IPCC reports using Europe's pre-exascale supercomputers.

properties.title: PADDLE - Planning in A liquiD worlD with tropicaL StakEs
properties.description: EU-Africa-Brazil network developing Marine Spatial Planning methods for tropical Atlantic. Addresses sustainable ocean use, reconciling conservation with economic activities like fishing, tourism, renewable energy in tropical waters.

properties.title: MEESO - Ecologically and economically sustainable mesopelagic fisheries
properties.description: Quantifies mesopelagic fish biomass (200-1000m depth) and assesses sustainable exploitation options. Develops acoustic/trawling tech, maps nutrients/contaminants, explores commercial viability. Pan-European study 2019-2023.

properties.title: Our common future ocean in the Earth system – quantifying coupled cycles of carbon, oxygen, and nutrients for determining and achieving safe operating spaces with respect to tipping points
properties.description: Studies ocean tipping points in carbon, oxygen, nutrient cycles & ecosystems under climate change. Integrates Earth system science, oceanography, fisheries & ecology to define safe marine operating spaces & mitigation pathways.

properties.title: Sustainable management of mesopelagic resources
properties.description: SUMMER explores mesopelagic fish biomass (90% of planet's fish) for sustainable exploitation. Uses eDNA, acoustics, gut analysis to estimate biomass, ecosystem services, and impacts. Develops decision support tool for trade-offs.

properties.title: Novel roles of dimethylated sulphur in marine microbial interactions
properties.description: Investigates dimethylated sulfur's role in marine microbial food-web interactions, exploring phytoplankton-bacteria exchanges, energy transfer, and grazing dynamics to assess ecosystem robustness and efficiency in oceanic biomes.

properties.title: Improved transdisciplinary science for effective ecosystem-based maritime spatial planning and conservation in European Seas (MarinePlan)
properties.description: Develops Decision Support System for ecosystem-based maritime spatial planning across European Seas. Aligns marine protected areas, conservation & restoration measures at 8 sites from coastal to deep sea, addressing biodiversity loss & climate change

properties.title: FRESH-CARE
properties.description: Arctic freshwater dynamics study using AI & satellite data to track ocean currents, quantify freshwater transport through Arctic gateways, and forecast climate impacts from 2010s-2040s. Aims to improve global climate models.

properties.title: PROTECT - PROjecTing sEa-level rise: from iCe sheets to local implicaTions
properties.description: Studies ice sheet collapse in Antarctica/Greenland to project sea-level rise. Models atmosphere-ocean-ice interactions, assesses coastal impacts globally. Engages EU coastal states, low-lying islands, Arctic communities.

properties.title: NextGEMS - Next Generation Earth Modelling Systems
properties.description: Develops storm-resolving Earth system models (3km grid) for climate projections. Studies ocean-atmosphere coupling, carbon/nutrient cycles, aerosols. Addresses climate sensitivity, marine nutrients, extremes. 30-year simulations.

properties.title: AquaVitae - Sustainable and innovative aquaculture across the Atlantic Ocean
properties.description: Develops sustainable aquaculture in Atlantic Ocean through new low trophic species (macroalgae, shellfish, echinoderms), IMTA systems, biosensors, and circular economy approaches. 36 partners across Atlantic nations. 2019-2023.

properties.title: MISSION ATLANTIC
properties.description: Develops Atlantic Integrated Ecosystem Assessments (IEAs) to identify marine ecosystem components at risk from human activities and natural hazards. Maps, models and assesses Atlantic Ocean ecosystems using monitoring data and climate projections.

properties.title: Mesopelagic Southern Ocean Prey and Predators
properties.description: EU-Australia network studying Southern Ocean micronekton (small marine organisms) using acoustic monitoring and modeling to understand ecosystem changes from climate warming and resource exploitation in Antarctic waters.

properties.title: CArbon Production of under-ICE phytoplankton blooms in a changing Arctic Ocean
properties.description: Studies under-ice phytoplankton blooms in Arctic Ocean to quantify their impact on carbon cycle and climate change. Uses pan-Arctic expeditions, modeling, and Bio-Argo floats to assess primary production beneath sea-ice.

properties.title: Carbon pathways in the Southern Ocean
properties.description: Studies biological carbon pump in Southern Ocean using Biogeochemical Argo floats. Tracks how phytoplankton-fixed CO2 transfers to deep ocean via particle sinking, mixing, and zooplankton migration to close carbon budgets year-round.

properties.title: Southern Ocean Carbon and Heat Impact on Climate
properties.description: Quantifies heat/carbon budgets in Southern Ocean's Atlantic sector through observation and modeling to reduce climate prediction uncertainties. Focuses on atmosphere-ocean-ice exchanges and Weddell Polynya dynamics.

properties.title: INSPIRI - Imaginative Narratives and Scenarios for Inspiring Restoration and Innovation for European Seas and Water Systems
properties.description: Co-creating aspirational futures for EU waters using participatory methods, visioning, and modeling across Mission Lighthouse regions to inspire restoration action by 2030 and 2050, supporting European Green Deal goals.

properties.title: Opening sub-ice shelf cavities and exploring their impact on dense water Production and Export in NEMO global ocean models
properties.description: Studies Antarctic ice shelf-ocean interactions and their impact on Antarctic Bottom Water formation, the deepest global water mass driving ocean circulation, heat, carbon and nutrient transport.

properties.title: WhiteShift
properties.description: Studies calcifying phytoplankton response to ocean warming/acidification in Subarctic Ocean using satellite observations and autonomous floats to understand carbon flux impacts on climate-sensitive marine ecosystems.

properties.title: CarbOcean - An integrative approach to unravel the ocean's biological carbon pump
properties.description: Studies ocean carbon storage via microscopic marine plants. Develops autonomous robotic profilers to observe organic/inorganic carbon fluxes from surface to twilight zone, improving biogeochemical models of CO2 sequestration.

properties.title: PHAROS - Lighthouse for Atlantic and Arctic Basin
properties.description: Bridges EU Ocean Mission phases via Atlantic demos using nature-based solutions and integrated multi-trophic aquaculture to restore marine ecosystems, reduce pollution, and achieve carbon-neutral blue economy by 2030.

properties.title: WAPITI - Water mass transformation and pathways in the Weddell Sea
properties.description: Studies Antarctic deep water formation in Weddell Sea through field experiments and modeling. Investigates shelf circulation, ice-shelf interactions, and global ocean overturning to understand climate feedbacks.

properties.title: Science, Technology, and Society Initiative to minimize Unwanted Catches in European Fisheries
properties.description: Multi-actor project to eliminate discards in European fisheries through selective fishing tech, gear modification, ecolabelling & ecosystem modelling. Field trials across Mediterranean, Atlantic & Nordic waters.

properties.title: Arctic Research Icebreaker Consortium: A strategy for meeting the needs for marine-based research in the Arctic
properties.description: Coordinates European research icebreakers to study Arctic Ocean changes, sea-ice, weather predictions. Provides trans-national access to 6 key vessels, develops autonomous measurement tech, creates 3D Virtual Icebreaker data platform.

properties.title: TechOceanS - Innovative ocean observation technologies
properties.description: Develops 9 underwater technologies (sensors, imaging, samplers, AI) to monitor ocean biology, chemistry, plastics, toxins, and species. Measures 63% of priority ocean variables. Demonstrated in Naples and Gran Canaria for science and industry.

properties.title: Tropical and South Atlantic climate-based marine ecosystem predictions for sustainable management
properties.description: Predicts Atlantic marine ecosystem changes over 40 years using climate models, observations & socio-economic data. Assesses impacts of fishing, pollution & climate on tropical/South Atlantic to enable sustainable management.

properties.title: Euro-Argo Research Infrastructure Sustainability and Enhancement
properties.description: Enhances Argo float network monitoring global oceans to 2000m depth. Expands to 4000 floats: 25% biogeochemical sensors, 25% abyssal depths. Provides open data for climate research and operational users across European waters.

properties.title: Improved Science-Based Maritime Spatial Planning to Safeguard and Restore Biodiversity in a coherent European MPA network
properties.description: Develops knowledge-based maritime spatial planning for biodiversity protection across 6 test sites in 5 European sea basins. Integrates socio-ecological management for coastal, offshore & deep-sea ecosystems supporting EU Biodiversity Strategy 2030.

properties.title: Ecocentric management for sustainable fisheries and healthy marine ecosystems
properties.description: EU project developing EcoScope platform & toolbox for ecosystem-based fisheries management across European Seas. Addresses unsustainable exploitation via data integration, ecosystem modeling, spatial planning & capacity building.

properties.title: IMMERSE - Improving Models for Marine Environment Monitoring Service
properties.description: Develops next-gen ocean modeling tools for Copernicus Marine Service. Enhances NEMO model for high-res satellite data, coastal forecasting, HPC integration. Covers global oceans, EU waters. 2019-2023.

properties.title: Genomic and nutritional innovations for genetically superior farmed fish to improve efficiency in European aquaculture
properties.description: Integrates fish breeding & nutrition for Atlantic salmon, rainbow trout, seabream & seabass. Uses genomic selection, novel feeds & smart tech to produce robust, healthy fish. Improves EU aquaculture competitiveness.

properties.title: PREP4BLUE - Preparing the Research & Innovation Core for Mission Ocean, Seas & Waters
properties.description: Develops co-creation tools for EU Mission Ocean to restore ocean & water health by 2030. Links R&I across disciplines, mobilizes stakeholders & citizens. Tests pilots to optimize Mission projects 2022-2025 across European seas.

properties.title: SURIMI
properties.description: Develops social-ecological models & decision support tools for EU marine policy analysis via Digital Twin Ocean. Integrates data across EU waters for fisheries & ecosystem management using MSE framework. 2024-2028.

properties.title: BlueMissionAA - Building a Coordination Hub to Support the Mission Implementation in the Atlantic and Arctic Basin
properties.description: EU coordination hub supporting ocean restoration in Atlantic & Arctic basins through ecosystem restoration, climate resilience, stakeholder mobilization, monitoring frameworks, and citizen engagement by 2030.

properties.title: Optimizing and Enhancing the Integrated Atlantic Ocean Observing System
properties.description: AtlantOS transitions loosely-coordinated ocean observing to a sustainable Integrated Atlantic Ocean Observing System. Fills gaps, integrates satellite/in-situ data, reduces costs, promotes innovation across Atlantic.

properties.title: FOCCUS - Forecasting and observing the open-to-coastal ocean for Copernicus users
properties.description: Enhances Copernicus Marine Service coastal monitoring/forecasting using Sentinel satellites, in-situ observations, data fusion & seamless numerical prediction from global to near-shore scales for climate resilience & blue economy.

properties.title: Blue-Cloud: Piloting innovative services for Marine Research & the Blue Economy
properties.description: EU project developing a cloud-based cyber platform for ocean sustainability research. Provides multidisciplinary marine data, analytical tools, and computing facilities through 5 pilot demonstrators to support Blue Economy.

properties.title: Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together
properties.description: AMRIT unifies Europe's ocean monitoring networks (EMSO, EURO-ARGO, ICOS) into a coordinated European Ocean Observing System. Creates EOOS Technical Support Center to harmonize sensors, link platforms, eliminate duplication, and streamline data collec

properties.title: Advancing Black Sea Research and Innovation to Co-Develop Blue Growth within Resilient Ecosystems
properties.description: Assessing Black Sea ecosystem health, resilience to pollution/overfishing stressors. Developing predictive tools, adaptive management for sustainable blue economy through interdisciplinary approach.

properties.title: A touch of Blue in the EU Research Nights for a more Sustainable Use of the Ocean
properties.description: EU Blue Researchers' Nights connecting citizens to ocean science across Europe. Interactive events demonstrate ocean research diversity, promote ocean literacy, and support European Green Deal priorities for healthy, sustainable oceans.

properties.title: Smart technology for MArinE Litter SusTainable RemOval and Management
properties.description: Automated tech to identify, remove, sort & recycle marine litter in EU coastal ecosystems. Uses renewable energy, AI, robotics. Assesses marine debris impact on protected areas. Converts waste to raw materials.

properties.title: GoJelly - A gelatinous solution to plastic pollution
properties.description: Develops jellyfish mucus-based microplastics filter to combat coastal pollution. Tests prototype in Norwegian, Baltic, Mediterranean seas. Creates jobs for fishermen, produces by-products for food/feed/farming.

properties.title: Extending the Ocean Data Interoperability Platform
properties.description: Develops global framework for marine data management, creating interoperability between regional e-infrastructures. Provides open access to multidisciplinary ocean data supporting climate change research and marine conservation.

properties.title: Euro-Argo ERIC scaling up for OneArgo Network Extension
properties.description: Expands Europe's ocean monitoring network through OneArgo initiative. Deploys full-depth multidisciplinary floats globally for climate projections and ocean health. 23 partners enhance data delivery and services. 2024-2028.

properties.title: Addressing Sustainability Transition Pathways in the Blue Economy
properties.description: Develops integrated framework linking human-ocean interactions to blue growth sectors. Uses machine learning to simulate environmental/socio-economic effects of ocean technologies on marine ecosystems. Tests Spain's 2050 transition plan.

properties.title: EuroSea - Improving and Integrating European Ocean Observing and Forecasting Systems for Sustainable use of the Oceans
properties.description: Integrates European ocean observation systems for sustainable management. Advances monitoring technology, coordinates international efforts, improves forecasting for blue growth, ocean health & climate services across Europe.

properties.title: JERICO-NEXT - Joint European Research Infrastructure network for Coastal Observatory
properties.description: European network providing operational services for continuous monitoring of coastal seas through integrated physics, biogeochemistry and biology observations. Delivers high quality environmental data on European coastal marine environment.

properties.title: Atlantic ECOsystems assessment, forecasting & sustainability
properties.description: AtlantECO develops framework for Atlantic Ocean management, studying microbiomes, plastics, and connectivity to assess ecosystem services and predict future changes across the Atlantic basin with partners from Europe, South America, and South Africa.

properties.title: Widely scalable Mobile Underwater Sonar Technology
properties.description: Develops cooperative marine robotic systems with distributed acoustic arrays for geophysical surveying, ocean exploration, and seafloor characterization using networked surface and submerged vehicles.

properties.title: MINKE - Marine Integrated Network on Key European research infrastructures
properties.description: Integrates European marine metrology infrastructures to coordinate oceanographic data quality framework. Develops monitoring networks using Essential Ocean Variables, citizen science, and cost-effective tech for ocean health.

properties.title: NEUTRINOSHOT - Breakthrough underwater telescope on the hunt for cosmic neutrinos
properties.description: Developing P-ONE, a multi-cubic-km neutrino telescope in Pacific Ocean to detect cosmic neutrinos from supermassive black holes. Uses deep-sea sensors to track light from neutrino collisions, advancing beyond IceCube capabilities.

properties.title: Developing Optimal and Open Research Support for the Black Sea (DOORS)
properties.description: Implements Black Sea SRIA to harmonize research, build infrastructure for ecosystem understanding, support Blue Growth/start-ups, inform policy. Engages stakeholders, harmonizes data, strengthens networks.

properties.title: SeaClear - SEarch, identificAtion and Collection of marine Litter with Autonomous Robots
properties.description: Autonomous underwater robots collect seafloor litter in coastal areas using UAVs, USVs, and UUVs with suction-gripper systems. Targets 80% detection, 90% collection success at 70% cost reduction vs divers in Hamburg and Dubrovnik.

properties.title: Coordination action in support of the implementation of the Joint Programming Initiative on 'Healthy and Productive Seas and Oceans'
properties.description: 36-month EU project supporting JPI Oceans Strategic Research & Innovation Agenda. Coordinates transnational marine research activities across 12 European partners to advance healthy, productive seas through joint funding & foresight.

properties.title: CLAIM - Cleaning Litter by developing and Applying Innovative Methods in European seas
properties.description: Develops innovative cleaning tech for marine litter in Mediterranean & Baltic: photocatalytic nanocoating for microplastics, thermal treatment for energy recovery, floating booms. Prevents litter at wastewater plants & river mouths.

properties.title: InlanD watErs in the digitAl TwIn OceaN
properties.description: Develops digital twin for EU inland waters (rivers, lakes, wetlands) integrating with Digital Twin Ocean. Multi-stakeholder forums co-design architecture, standards for unified hydrosphere model supporting ocean/water restoration.

properties.title: EurofleetsPlus - An alliance of European marine research infrastructure
properties.description: Provides open access to 27 research vessels across Atlantic, Mediterranean, Black, North, Baltic Seas & Pacific for marine research on clean, healthy oceans. Includes ROVs, AUVs & telepresence systems for remote access.

properties.title: SeaClear2.0
properties.description: Autonomous robot teams monitor and collect Mediterranean seafloor/surface litter. Combines AI robotics, citizen engagement, and recycling solutions. Targets 57% litter removal in covered areas. Demonstrates scalable marine cleanup technology.

properties.title: Joint European Research Infrastructure of Coastal Observatories: Science, Service, Sustainability - JERICO-S3
properties.description: EU network observing European coastal/shelf seas. Provides high-quality environmental data, research facilities, services for marine coastal monitoring. Supports biodiversity protection, policy needs. 2019-2023.

properties.title: EUMarineRobots - Marine robotics research infrastructure network
properties.description: Pan-European network providing transnational access to marine robotic assets (aerial, surface, subsurface) for ocean exploration and research. Enables shared R&D infrastructure across 15 partners in 10 countries.

properties.title: Multiscale Ocean models and Information for climate Risk Assessment and Impact mitigation
properties.description: Advances ocean climate models for European seas, integrating historical data and future projections to enhance biogeochemical cycle understanding and coastal climate resilience through Digital Twin of the Ocean.

properties.title: Blue-Cloud 2026
properties.description: Federated European ecosystem delivering FAIR open data & analytical services for ocean, sea, coastal & inland water research. Supports Green Deal, Digital Twin Ocean via Virtual Labs, data lakes. 40 partners, 42 months.

properties.title: NAUTILOS - New Approach to Underwater Technologies for Innovative, Low-cost Ocean obServation
properties.description: Develops cost-effective sensors for ocean variables (salinity, nutrients, plastics) to monitor marine environment changes, aquaculture, fisheries impacts. Integrates tech into observing platforms across EU waters.

properties.title: ATLAS - A Trans-AtLantic Assessment and deep-water ecosystem-based Spatial management plan for Europe
properties.description: Trans-Atlantic partnership assessing deep-sea Atlantic ecosystems, VMEs, EBSAs for sustainable Blue Growth. 25 cruises studying 12 Case Studies: sponge, cold-water coral, seamount ecosystems. When: H2020. Where: Atlantic Ocean.

properties.title: Maritime elements increasing fuel efficiency by 7%
properties.description: 13 Mari developed innovative drag-reducing elements for cargo ships, cutting fuel consumption by 7%. Passive device applicable to all hull types, achieving 1-year ROI. Eliminates 45M tonnes CO2 annually across commercial fleet.

properties.title: The future of Arctic coastal ecosystems - Identifying transitions in fjord systems and adjacent coastal areas
properties.description: Studies Arctic fjord biodiversity changes from cryosphere loss in Greenland, Svalbard, N Norway. Enables adaptive co-management of social-ecological systems, indigenous livelihoods, food production, tourism. Supports EU Arctic policy.

properties.title: River cleaning as a free service model to tackle ocean plastic issue
properties.description: RiverRecycle collects plastic from rivers before it reaches oceans using proprietary technology. Operates entire value chain: collection, pre-treatment, recycling. 400+ tons removed since Dec 2021. Finland-based, seeking €1.5M.
properties.category: Coastal and environmental protection and regeneration

properties.title: Optimal locations for Marine Protected Areas in European seas
properties.description: Maps optimal MPA locations across EU Atlantic, Mediterranean, Baltic & Black Seas using biodiversity measures & blue carbon data. Prioritises top 10-30% areas for species, habitats & ecosystems. Stakeholder feedback via MSP.

properties.title: Sustainable Blue Economy Partnership
properties.description: EU partnership fostering transition to regenerative, sustainable blue economy. Aligns R&I priorities across 30 countries, launches co-funded calls, strengthens science-policy interfaces for EU Green Deal marine domains, supports coastal communities.

properties.title: Recreational Diving Oasis with Artificial Reefs
properties.description: ARIA develops artificial reef tech for diving parks to combat degradation from mass ecotourism. Creates underwater attractions simulating natural rocky reefs for coastal protection, fisheries mgmt & aquaculture. TRL9, seeking €500k.
properties.category: Coastal and environmental protection and regeneration

properties.title: Biobased and biodegradable trammel fishing nets
properties.description: SeaBird developed biodegradable trammel nets tested over 3 seasons in northern France ports. Reduces ocean plastic pollution from lost fishing gear. Nets reach 82% strength of nylon, compostable after 1-2 seasons, degrade rapidly if lost at sea.
properties.category: Coastal and environmental protection and regeneration

properties.title: GES4SEAS - Achieving Good Environmental Status for maintaining ecosystem SErvices, by ASsessing integrated impacts of cumulative pressures
properties.description: Develops toolbox for adaptive ecosystem-based marine management across 11 EU learning sites plus Caribbean. Assesses cumulative pressures, climate impacts on biodiversity & ecosystem services to achieve Good Environmental Status under MSFD.

properties.title: tide ocean material
properties.description: Collects ocean-bound plastic from coastal communities, processes it through award-winning upcycling into quality raw materials for products. Provides infrastructure & knowledge transfer to affected coastlines.
properties.category: Coastal and environmental protection and regeneration

properties.title: SeaDataCloud - Further developing the pan-European infrastructure for marine and ocean data management
properties.description: Pan-European marine data infrastructure connecting 100+ data centres across 34 countries. Provides discovery/access to ocean observations, supports EMODnet portals, uses cloud/HPC tech for Virtual Research Environment.

properties.title: Enhancing Biogeochemical Essential Ocean Variables for European and Global Assessments
properties.description: Tracks ocean chemistry changes (acidification, oxygen loss, carbon cycling) via improved biogeochemical observation, validation & modelling. Delivers indicators for ocean health & climate regulation across European & global waters.

properties.title: Arctic biodiversity change and its consequences: Assessing, monitoring and predicting the effects of ecosystem tipping cascades on marine ecosystem services and dependent human systems
properties.description: ECOTIP maps Arctic marine biodiversity response to climate change, sea ice loss, and invasive species. Uses trait-based approach to predict tipping points affecting carbon sequestration and fisheries. Engages indigenous communities.

properties.title: 52 Hertz - Underwater Communication System
properties.description: Bone conduction underwater voice communication for divers. Waterproof microphone + speech enhancement algorithm. Improves safety & coordination for professional, scientific, defense diving. TRL 6. Seeking €1.8-2.5M funding.

properties.title: 4SeasonCTV
properties.description: EU pilot validating Airkeel stabilizers on Crew Transfer Vessels for offshore wind. Improves safety, comfort, fuel efficiency for offshore installations. Partners: Dacoma, Tuco Marine, OPUS Marine. TRL7, seeking €1.5M.

properties.title: Integration of biodiversity monitoring data into the Digital Twin Ocean
properties.description: AI-powered project integrating marine biodiversity data into EU's Digital Twin Ocean. Activates sleeping data, develops automated flows via EMODnet, creates models/algorithms to protect ocean biodiversity by 2030.

properties.title: Integrated Arctic observation system
properties.description: Develops integrated Arctic Observation System (iAOS) unifying existing systems across Arctic regions. Combines satellite & in-situ data from atmosphere, ocean, cryosphere, terrestrial sciences to fill observing gaps.

properties.title: Integrated Assessment of Atlantic Marine Ecosystems in Space and Time
properties.description: Assesses deep & open-ocean Atlantic ecosystem health against climate change & multiple stressors. Uses 30+ expeditions across 12 key ocean areas, eDNA genomics, machine learning & robotics for basin-scale predictions & sustainable management.

properties.title: A scalable seaweed-for-food cultivation & processing blueprint
properties.description: Scaling EU seaweed-for-food production via replicable farming model. 50+ sites across Europe, 350+ tons/yr output. Enables 100+ entrepreneurs, local food chains. TRL 7. Seeks €10-30M funding.

properties.title: Accelerating Marine Restoration in the Dutch North Sea - The first large-scale oyster restoration project in the Dutch Central Oyster Grounds
properties.description: Restoring 200M native oysters in Dutch North Sea to enhance biodiversity, sequester carbon, reduce nitrogen, provide coastal protection. Addresses 90% oyster reef loss through native species, community engagement, local sourcing.
properties.category: Coastal and environmental protection and regeneration

properties.title: ACE Aquatec - Sustainable humane slaughter for fish
properties.description: Humane electric stunning system for farmed & wild fish. Stuns fish in water within 1 second, eliminating stress & handling. Improves fish quality, reduces blood spotting vs air-stunning. Serves 2B+ fish killed annually.

properties.title: ABIM - PORT ASSET INTEGRITY WEB PLATFORM
properties.description: Digital twin platform for port infrastructure monitoring. Uses 3D modeling, AR/VR, satellite data & underwater inspections to enable predictive maintenance of port assets. Improves climate resilience & strategic decision-making.

properties.title: ABYSSA
properties.description: Deep ocean mapping (to 6000m) using AUVs for high-res seabed surveys. Provides bathymetric, habitat & biodiversity data for marine heritage inventory & industrial projects. Enables informed decisions on deep ocean protection.

properties.title: AE-FishBIT
properties.description: Miniaturised accelerometer (<1g) monitors farmed fish activity & respiratory frequency non-invasively. Tracks climate change impact on aquaculture, selects resilient organisms for sustainable farming, preserving marine biodiversity.

properties.title: ECOPEMER, a new production system for competitive aquaseed
properties.description: Acuinuga develops sustainable aquaseed production in Galicia, Spain using novel recirculation systems for bivalve mollusks, organic fish fingerlings & algae. Targets carbon capture, ecological certification & job creation.

properties.title: Aerones Engineering - Robotic Offshore Wind Turbine Maintenance
properties.description: Robotic offshore wind turbine maintenance system replacing manual rope access. 3-6x faster inspections/repairs, remotely managed, reducing CO2 by 6.4M tons yearly, cutting marine pollution 37% in 5 years. TRL8, seeking €20M scale-up.

properties.title: Access to the First in-exclusive PADI Underwater Farming License
properties.description: Barcelona Diving Club trains underwater farmers via exclusive PADI license. Combines seaweed planting, ecosystem restoration, diving education & sustainable tourism. Seeks €300k to scale licenses globally. TRL 8.

properties.title: Open Access to GTS Project (Open-GTS Project)
properties.description: Eases exchange of marine data and increases data available for real-time forecasts. Accepts multiple data formats while retaining quality and integrity. Increases transparency and encourages participation from commercial shipping.

properties.title: The Administrative Centre for China's Agenda 21 (ACCA21)
properties.description: ACCA21 supports Ocean Decade through financial contributions, BRICS forums, capacity building on 7 outcomes (clean, healthy, productive, predicted, safe, accessible, inspiring ocean), and establishing policy platform
properties.funder: Ministry of Science and Technology – China

properties.title: ILIAD - Digital Twin of the Ocean
properties.description: Creates interoperable Digital Twin of Ocean fusing diverse data sources, models & earth observations. Enables climate scenarios, supports EU Green Deal & UN Ocean Decade goals. Marketplace for apps & services.

properties.title: ADDWINGSAIL - Augmented Wind Propulsion System
properties.description: Wing propulsion system for bulk carriers reducing fuel consumption by 30%. Uses existing equipment, no vessel immobilization. Targets IMO GHG requirements. Proven on racing/fishing vessels. Seeking €1M for R&D, sales, operations.

properties.title: Bay of Bengal Large Marine Ecosystem Project II (BOBLME II)
properties.description: Addresses overexploitation, habitat loss, pollution in Bay of Bengal through ecosystem fishery management, marine managed areas, stock rebuilding, women's inclusion, plastic reduction. Regional collaboration via Strategic Action Programme.

properties.title: AETHER - GPS-Independent Maritime Navigation System
properties.description: Maritime navigation aid calculating local position independent from GPS, enabling ships to navigate during satellite signal attacks. Detects sophisticated GPS spoofing. Norway-based, TRL 4, seeking €150k-300k.

properties.title: Climate-Resilient Aquatic Food - Feeding the Future (ClimeFOOD)
properties.description: Develops sustainable pathways for climate-resilient aquatic food systems through holistic approach. Focuses on optimal nutritional yield from fisheries/aquaculture, supporting small-scale actors in LDCs. 2022-2030.

properties.title: National Coastal Condition Assessment
properties.description: EPA tracks water quality in US coastal waters & Great Lakes. Monitors sediment, contaminants, biological integrity using statistical surveys. Data collection in 2020/21, 2025, 2030 to assess coastal health.
properties.funder: Environmental Protection Agency – United States of America (USA)
properties.category: Marine pollution monitoring and ecosystem protection

properties.title: DIAPHONIA
properties.description: Assesses underwater noise impacts on marine food web organisms using tissue markers, molecular/metabolomic techniques. Studies behavioral/cellular effects of noise exposure on invertebrates, fish, mammals across European basins.

properties.title: PURE WIND
properties.description: Studies radiated noise from fixed/floating offshore wind farms and impacts on marine life (zooplankton to predators). Develops tools for spatial planning and mitigation policies for offshore wind expansion across pelagic food webs.

properties.title: SONORA - Understanding Particle Motion and Acoustic Pressure Impact on Marine Fish
properties.description: Studies anthropogenic noise impact on fish, focusing on particle motion vs acoustic pressure in shallow waters and aquaculture. Evaluates physiological effects on larval fish and wild ecosystems to develop risk assessment matrices.

properties.title: ORCHESTRA
properties.description: Studies underwater noise impacts on plankton & benthos across European basins. Field surveys & lab experiments test noise+warming effects on invertebrates. Aims to identify high-risk areas & develop mitigation strategies for GES.

properties.title: National Sea Grant College Program
properties.description: 50+ year program delivering actionable science for marine/coastal challenges through research, extension & education. Empowers coastal stakeholders with science-based info to solve societal problems. Supports Ocean Decade priorities.

properties.title: Ocean School Global Community Project: Building Ocean Literacy through Community Engagement
properties.description: Develops content showing how global communities innovate to solve ocean challenges. Builds capacity in knowledge creation and education, empowering communities in Canadian Arctic and Peru via Ocean School platform in 4 languages.

properties.title: Call for Proposals of the MeerWissen Initiative for African-German marine research partnerships
properties.description: African-German partnerships funding marine research on Nature-based Solutions. Two-phase approach: co-design then 2-year implementation. Strengthens capacity, science-policy dialogue, digital innovation for ocean protection.
properties.funder: German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ)

properties.title: Advancing Ocean Literacy for the UN Decade in Canada
properties.description: Supports Canadian Ocean Literacy Coalition to measure ocean literacy via new framework and amplify diverse voices in ocean science community during UN Ocean Decade. Led by Ocean Networks Canada Society.

properties.title: Sustained Data for a Changing Ocean
properties.description: Ocean Observatories Initiative provides 25+ year sustained ocean observations via 5 instrumented arrays measuring 200+ parameters (physical, chemical, geological, biological) from air-sea interface to seafloor. Data freely available globally.

properties.title: MegaMove – Overhauling Conservation of Highly Migratory Marine Megafauna at Global Scale
properties.description: Global initiative tracking marine megafauna movements via biologging data to predict occurrence, map risks, and guide conservation across all ocean basins through 2030.

properties.title: Center: Chemical Currencies of a Microbial Planet
properties.description: Studies seawater metabolites from microbial activity governing carbon cycle, nutrients & marine food webs. Uses analytical/data sciences & ocean sampling tech. Woods Hole, USA. 2021-2026.

properties.title: Endorsed Ocean Decade Activities
properties.description: UN Ocean Decade endorses events & publications advancing ocean science for sustainable development. Addresses 10 Ocean Decade Challenges across all ocean basins. Global stakeholder collaboration platform.

properties.title: NOAA Harmful Algal Bloom Forecasting
properties.description: NOAA issues regional HAB forecasts (twice weekly to seasonal) alerting coastal managers to harmful algal blooms. Forecasts identify bloom location, size, direction & severity using weather, ocean conditions & environmental data for prevention.
properties.funder: NOAA National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science

properties.title: Inundation Signatures on Rocky Coastlines
properties.description: Research network studying coastal wave inundation records on rocky coasts to understand storm/tsunami impacts, develop data standards, and improve long-term risk predictions for coastal communities worldwide.

properties.title: Global Litter Observatory (GLO)
properties.description: Harmonizes global macro-litter data using citizen monitoring and mass-based metrics via mobile phones. Compiles worldwide litter characterization across all ocean basins. 2021-2026.

properties.title: Sea Grant International
properties.description: Shares US Sea Grant model internationally to co-develop ocean science linking local stakeholders, universities & agencies. Promotes bottom-up research, education & outreach through workshops & exchanges. 2000-2030.

properties.title: Joint Programming Initiative Healthy and Productive Seas and Oceans (JPI Oceans)
properties.description: Pan-European platform coordinating national research for sustainable oceans. Facilitates Ocean Decade Actions through network mobilization, partnerships, resource coordination, and strategic joint actions across member states.

properties.title: Supporting Canadian Arctic Marine Research Projects Responding to the United Nations Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development
properties.description: ArcticNet funds 4-5 Canadian Arctic Ocean Decade projects (2021-2024) focusing on Indigenous co-development, marine research, and training 40-50 researchers. Produces 40-100 peer-reviewed publications supporting sustainable Arctic development.

properties.title: Resilience of the Ecosystems, Fisheries and Marine-Based Economy Under a Persistent Anomalous Warm and Low-Productivity Regime in the Gulf of California
properties.description: Evaluating impacts of warming & low productivity on Gulf of California biodiversity & fisheries (2014-2020 anomaly). Mexico-USA collaboration identifying mitigation strategies for ecosystems & marine economy through 2030.
properties.funder: Instituto de Ciencias del Mar y Limnología, Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México

properties.title: Integrated Coastal Management as an Adaptation to Climate Change Measure
properties.description: Recovery of marine-coastal ecosystems affected by massive sargassum arrivals using satellite detection, hydrodynamic modeling, and coordinated collection operations to restore environmental services in the North Atlantic.
properties.funder: Instituto de Ciencias del Mar y Limnología – UNAM

properties.title: The West Asia Blue Waters
properties.description: 10-year initiative linking science & life to elevate ocean literacy in West Asia. Covers oceanographic disciplines via 5 projects: environmental preservation, education, data sharing, coastal observations with community involvement.
properties.funder: UNESCO Category II Regional Education and Research Centre on Oceanography for West Asia (RCOWA)

properties.title: Peking University Ocean Decade Contribution
properties.description: Peking University leverages multi-disciplinary research to provide marine education resources, initiate international cooperation, and serve Ocean Decade implementation across Arctic, Indian, and Pacific Oceans.

properties.title: Ocean Effects on Climate Variability of the Northwest Pacific
properties.description: Multi-nation effort to understand climate variability in NW Pacific and Indian Ocean impacts on regional ecosystems. Aims to improve forecasts and generate solutions to mitigate climate crisis in NW Pacific marginal seas.
properties.funder: Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology

properties.title: Global Fishing Watch Marine Manager
properties.description: Scalable technology portal providing real-time data on human activity, ocean conditions & biology to support MPA design, management & monitoring. Empowers managers with interactive tools for marine spatial planning & conservation.

properties.title: National Marine Data and Information Service-China (NMDIS)
properties.description: China's marine data service supporting ocean economy, spatial planning, resource management, and ecological protection across all ocean basins. Addresses sustainable economy, climate nexus, and capacity development.
properties.funder: Ministry of Natural Resources of People's Republic of China

properties.title: Tēnaka Mangrove Project
properties.description: Restores mangrove ecosystems in Borneo, Malaysia since 2020. Marine biologists monitor biodiversity quarterly using eDNA & blue carbon tools. Data feeds Tēnaka Science® Platform for impact reports to corporate clients.

properties.title: RV Polarstern and Heincke with Ocean Decade Logo
properties.description: Research vessels investigating climate in Arctic & Antarctic. Polarstern's MOSAiC expedition drifted through Arctic Ocean. Heincke operates in North/Baltic Sea. Provides research infrastructure for international scientists.
properties.funder: Alfred Wegener Institute, Helmholtz Centre for Polar and Marine Research

properties.title: Our Shared Ocean
properties.description: Ireland supports Small Island Developing States facing climate change impacts, sea-level rise, and extreme weather. Focuses on ocean-climate action, sustainable blue economy, and marine governance across multiple ocean basins.

properties.title: Mapping and Improving High-Value Habitat influenced by Derelict Fishing Gear in the Salish Sea
properties.description: Maps derelict fishing gear and damaged habitats in Salish Sea using natural and Indigenous knowledge, followed by gear removal to restore high-value marine habitats through community engagement.

properties.title: Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ)
properties.description: VLIZ strengthens marine knowledge & excellence in Flanders, focusing on oceans, seas, coasts & tidal systems. Supports research community, education, policymakers & blue economy through coordination & international partnerships.

properties.title: USAID Senegal Feed the Future Dekkal Geej
properties.description: Improving sustainability of Senegal's fisheries through better management practices, addressing fish demand, enhancing food security, increasing incomes and strengthening resilience via local/national institutions and private sector.
properties.funder: United States Agency for International Development (USAID)

properties.title: Monitoring ecological resilience in Northern Fisheries inshore regions through community-based environmental genomics
properties.description: eDNA project conducting baseline biodiversity assessment, habitat modeling for economic species, empowering communities through citizen science and student training to support biodiversity management in northern fisheries.

properties.title: Global Ocean Biogeochemistry Array (GO-BGC Array)
properties.description: Global fleet of 500 robotic floats collecting chemistry and biology data from surface to 1+ mile deep across all ocean basins. Observes climate change effects on ocean metabolism, carbon uptake, and marine resources. Data freely accessible.

properties.title: Ocean Energy Decade for a Blue Economy in SIDS
properties.description: International platform for ocean renewable energy in Small Island Developing States. Living lab demos for tech transfer, data exchange, knowledge sharing. Transitions SIDS from fossil fuels to Blue Economy via ocean energy.

properties.title: OSPAR Quality Status Report 2023
properties.description: Holistic assessment of North-East Atlantic marine environment, human pressures, and ocean benefits. 400+ scientists deliver 130+ assessments on species, habitats, pollution, climate change using DAPSIR framework. 2019-2023.

properties.title: Weather and Aajurait Lead Monitoring for Sea Ice Safety During the Break-up Season
properties.description: Monitoring sea ice break-off events in Nunavut communities using Inuit knowledge and scientific instruments to improve landfast ice models and support safe spring ice travel for hunting and tourism.

properties.title: Multinational Image Classification Assessing Coastal Habitats
properties.description: AI-powered rapid habitat classification toolbox assessing coastal habitat impacts from imagery. Global multinational effort across all ocean basins. NOAA-led digital ocean representation initiative.
properties.funder: National Oceanographic and Atmospheric Administration, Southeast Fisheries Science Center

properties.title: IOGP Sound and Marine Life (SML) Joint Industry Programme (JIP)
properties.description: Oil & gas industry partnership researching underwater sound impacts on marine life. Studies sound propagation, hearing effects, behavior, mitigation across all ocean basins since 2005.
properties.funder: International Association of Oil and Gas Producers (IOGP)

properties.title: The NASA Plankton, Aerosol, Cloud, Ocean Ecosystem (PACE) Mission
properties.description: NASA satellite mission launching 2023/24 to monitor ocean color, phytoplankton, algal blooms globally. Advanced spectrometer & polarimeters track aquatic ecosystems & climate responses across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Participatory Modeling for Nature-based Solutions in the WIO-Region (PaMoNBS)
properties.description: Develops decision support tools for nature-based solutions in Western Indian Ocean. Engages coastal communities and policymakers to optimize local ecosystem use through participatory modeling. 2022-2025.

properties.title: NSF Coastlines and People (CoPe)
properties.description: Multi-institution Coastal Research Hubs using convergent science to transform understanding of natural, human-built, and social systems in coastal populated environments. Supports Focused and Large-scale Hubs 2020-2027.

properties.title: Values of the Ocean – A 10 Area Decade Programme for Protection and Sustainable Use of the Ocean
properties.description: Norway-led research & innovation program addressing 10 ocean areas: climate, governance, seafood, renewable energy, transport, data, ownership, Arctic, economy & education. Multi-sector collaboration for Ocean Decade goals.
properties.funder: The Research Council of Norway's Ocean Secretariat

properties.title: MPAs as Sentinel Sites for Ocean Conservation, Science and Literacy
properties.description: Understanding climate impacts on oceans, promoting MPA research on socioeconomic benefits to coastal communities, developing ocean literacy initiatives, and supporting national/international MPA networks.
properties.funder: US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)

properties.title: Committee on Earth Observation Satellites – Coastal Observations, Applications, Services and Tools (CEOS COAST)
properties.description: Global satellite observation team addressing coastal zone challenges. Co-develops products for disaster risk reduction, climate resilience, SDGs across all ocean basins using multidisciplinary Earth Observation approach.
properties.funder: U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)

properties.title: NOAA Coastal Aquaculture Siting and Sustainability Program
properties.description: Provides science & guidance to coastal managers for sustainable aquaculture siting, permitting & operations while maintaining ecosystem health in North Atlantic & Pacific waters through 2030.
properties.funder: U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)

properties.title: US Tsunami Contributions to IOC Tsunami Pt 2
properties.description: NOAA supports UN Ocean Decade goal: 100% tsunami-risk communities prepared by 2030. Provides Tsunami Ready Coalition participation, capacity building, OTGA training, recognition facilitation, NWS Weather Ready Nations support.

properties.title: Blue Food Innovation Summit
properties.description: Two-day summit exploring challenges in scaling aquaculture production while protecting ocean ecosystems. Brings together producers, suppliers, start-ups and investors to encourage collaboration across the value-chain.

properties.title: Ocean of Solutions
properties.description: French research program addressing ocean challenges: extreme events in overseas territories, polar ocean changes, biodiversity protection, sustainable resource management, pollution exposome. Couples observation/modeling, boosts ocean literacy.

properties.title: National Institute of Oceanography and Fisheries (NIOF)
properties.description: NIOF supports Ocean Decade through capacity-building, marine research, and international cooperation in North Africa. Coordinates training, fosters tech development, promotes research cooperation, and organizes scientific events.
properties.funder: National Institute of Oceanography and Fisheries (NIOF) - Egypt

properties.title: Women's livelihoods in vulnerable coastlines
properties.description: Investigates gender-differentiated climate vulnerability among Bay of Bengal Delta coastal women, examining intra-household inequalities, health/livelihood risks, and migration pressures to inform decision-making.

properties.title: Plastic Drawdown
properties.description: Rapid assessment tool helping 10 countries develop evidence-based policies against ocean plastic pollution. Analyzes plastic waste flows, identifies interventions, supports national strategies across plastic lifecycle in data-limited contexts.

properties.title: Transboundary governance for climate change adaptation in marine socio-ecological systems
properties.description: Develops interdisciplinary network modeling to quantify climate impacts on fisheries and examine how legal pluralism in governance affects climate adaptation. Led by AXA Research Fund-Lancaster University.

properties.title: Global Marine Plastic Litter Monitoring Network Project
properties.description: Creates global network hub to share/compile marine plastic litter monitoring data. Harmonizes visualization of monitoring efforts across all ocean basins. Supports SDG 14.1 indicator. Started Sept 2020, ongoing.

properties.title: Science Without Borders: Conserving the Tropics
properties.description: Leverages 10-year global reef dataset to monitor and manage coral reefs, seagrass, and mangroves in SIDS and LDCs through science, outreach, and education programs to conserve tropical marine ecosystems.

properties.title: Crustal Ocean Biosphere Research Accelerator
properties.description: International collaboration studying deep-sea crustal ocean ecosystems to fill knowledge gaps on ecosystem services and resilience before deep-sea mining/carbon sequestration. Trains next-gen leaders via virtual expeditions.

properties.title: Hope for Reefs
properties.description: California Academy of Sciences initiative to reverse coral reef decline through community monitoring, restoration, marine protected areas, sustainable fisheries, and youth training programs over 5 years (2021-2026).

properties.title: Esprit de Velox
properties.description: Bio-inspired zero-impact research vessel for non-invasive interdisciplinary ocean research. Wind-propelled, carbon-free renewable energy, recyclable composites. Operates tropical to polar zones for marine pollution, ecosystem restoration studies.

properties.title: Advancing Indigenous Partnerships in Ocean Science for Sustainability
properties.description: Indigenous-led ocean sustainability solutions in Canada. Builds Indigenous capacity for ocean governance, connects communities to international networks, integrates Indigenous Knowledge Systems in ocean science through toolkits and partnerships.

properties.title: Decade Coordination Office for Connecting People and Ocean
properties.description: Coordinates Ocean Decade Challenge 10 to change humanity's ocean relationship. Supports endorsed actions, engages stakeholders, catalyses new initiatives, mobilises resources. Focuses on ocean values for wellbeing and culture. Global scope.

properties.title: Promote Seabed 2030 and Ocean Mapping
properties.description: Global ocean mapping program using multibeam sonar to create comprehensive digital representation of seafloor. Only 20% mapped to modern standards. Runs 2021-2030 across all ocean basins to enable sustainable ocean economy.
properties.funder: U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)

properties.title: Integrating aquaculture with capture fisheries to avert hunger in coastal communities in Africa
properties.description: Harmonizing marine aquaculture & fisheries in Sierra Leone to eradicate hunger, create income opportunities & strengthen resilience in African coastal communities. Led by Dr Nwamaka Okeke-Ogbuafor.
properties.funder: AXA Research Fund – University of Leeds

properties.title: Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech) and the Preparing Shenzhen Ocean University (SOU)
properties.description: SUSTech establishing world-leading oceanography program in Shenzhen, China. Focuses on ecosystem protection, ocean-climate nexus, community resilience & behavior change. 2024-2031.

properties.title: Peace Boat US Youth for the SDGs Program
properties.description: Youth leaders travel aboard Peace Boat ship engaging in ocean literacy, citizen science & SDG14 workshops. Partners with UN, academia & communities globally. Capacity-building through at-sea seminars & port visits.

properties.title: National Research Council of Canada Ocean Program
properties.description: NRC Ocean Program advances ocean health & blue economy through R&D, partnerships, and tech development. Aligns with Ocean Supercluster to restore ocean sustainability while benefiting Canada's economy. 2023-2027.

properties.title: Healthy Rivers Healthy Ocean
properties.description: Addresses disconnects between ocean and freshwater management communities. Enables source-to-sea action tackling pollution, sediment flows, habitat fragmentation affecting freshwater and marine ecosystems at regional levels.

properties.title: Community forestry to enhance conservation and restoration of mangroves for more resilient coastal livelihoods
properties.description: Investigates how community forestry and Indigenous co-management can improve mangrove conservation and restoration worldwide to reverse global decline and strengthen coastal populations' resilience.

properties.title: Strengthening coastal communities' resilience through better forecasting and projecting compound flood risk
properties.description: Machine learning methodology to forecast compound flood risk from tropical cyclones in Mozambique. Addresses climate change impacts on coastal flooding and sea-level rise. Started Nov 2022.

properties.title: Sustainability as Solutions to Marine Litter
properties.description: Environmental education, plastic recycling, market development, life cycle analysis, and microplastic prediction to support government policies and achieve sustainable waste management in Brazil (2023-2026).

properties.title: A Framework for Effective Trans-National Consolidation within Marine Research, Education and Management in the Northwestern Pacific and Asian Marginal Seas
properties.description: Asian Pacific initiative consolidating national efforts to restore marine environment resilience and enable sustainable resource exploitation through trans-national research, education and management in NW Pacific and Asian marginal seas.
properties.funder: V.I. Il'ichev Pacific Oceanological Institute, Far Eastern Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences

properties.title: Plastic oceans – Monitoring the plastic
properties.description: Monitors plastic production chain in South Atlantic, integrating disposal/recycling strategies. Creates income for coastal communities through concrete artifacts made from ocean-collected plastic. Addresses marine litter pollution.

properties.title: Mitigating tsunamis' threat and destructive impact on coastal communities through enhanced navigation satellite system to tsunami early warnings
properties.description: Develops GNSS-based algorithms to improve real-time tsunami warning systems' reliability, accuracy and speed for coastal communities. Led by Sapienza University of Rome, started July 2023.

properties.title: The Ocean Cleanup Science & Technology Programme
properties.description: Links cleanup, monitoring & research to address plastic pollution. Improves understanding of riverine/oceanic plastics, develops removal tech, establishes baselines for policy, accelerates action. Global ocean basins.

properties.title: Oceanographic and Ecological data for Nature-based coastal protection in Tunisia (ORIENTATE-TN)
properties.description: Seagrass transplantation in Tunisia's vulnerable coasts to combat erosion. Living lab monitors nature-based solutions as sustainable alternative to traditional coastal protection. Blueprint for other Tunisian beaches.
properties.funder: Alfred-Wegener-Institut, Helmholtz-Zentrum für Polar- und Meeresforschung (AWI)

properties.title: Technologies to Extract Microplastics from the Sea
properties.description: Researching extraction methods for micro/nanoplastics from marine environments to reduce bioaccumulation & health impacts. Studies technologies to remove particles <5mm from coastal/ocean waters 2023-2026.

properties.title: Urchinomics: Global Kelp Forest Restoration Sea Urchin Ranching Alliance
properties.description: Restores kelp forests by removing overgrazing sea urchins from barrens, ranching them in aquaculture systems, converting to premium seafood. Addresses climate change impacts globally across multiple ocean basins since 2021.

properties.title: A Transformative Decade for the Global Ocean Acidification Observing System
properties.description: Expands global CO2 observing systems to monitor ocean acidification through next-gen sensors, expert training, and data products. Fills gaps in under-observed regions and builds capacity for stakeholder-useful information.

properties.title: Ocean Knowledge Base
properties.description: Springer Nature & German Ocean Foundation create accessible ocean science database for policymakers, journalists & public. Simplifies finding & combining marine research info. Global scope, all ocean basins. 2022-2030.
properties.funder: German Ocean Foundation, Springer Nature, German Society for Marine Research

properties.title: Blue Symbiosis
properties.description: Converting oil/gas infrastructure into multi-species seaweed aquaculture sites for habitat restoration, carbon sequestration, eutrophication mitigation, and sustainable bioplastics/nutrition/construction materials production. 2021-2029.

properties.title: Universeum Ocean Science Lab
properties.description: National science centre in Sweden promoting ocean literacy through education on marine life, sustainable development, innovation, data modelling & ecosystem-based ocean management. Connects stakeholders via state-of-art tech. Runs until 2030.
properties.funder: Universeum, the National Science Centre of Sweden

properties.title: Sustainable Ocean Management Education Programme Strengthening the Blue Economy
