properties.description: Seychelles-led education initiative engaging learners in ocean literacy and Blue Economy development to address climate change and ocean exploitation in the Indian Ocean through mindset change in upcoming generations.
properties.funder: Department of Blue Economy, Ministry of Fisheries and Blue Economy, Seychelles

properties.title: Advancing the European Seas' Marine Research and Innovation to Support their Biodiversity and Resilience Under Multi-Stressors (ReSealience)
properties.description: Holistic initiative advancing marine research across European Seas (Atlantic, Mediterranean, Black, Baltic, North) to support biodiversity and resilience under multi-stressors through knowledge, innovation, and solutions.

properties.title: Observadores da Natureza para o Desenvolvimento Ambiental das Ilhas Oceânicas
properties.description: Empowers citizens of Brazilian oceanic islands (Fernando de Noronha, Trindade, Martin Vaz) to identify and resolve socio-environmental problems through science, promoting bottom-up environmental management for marine biodiversity conservation.

properties.title: Health of Ocean Under Stressors
properties.description: Multi-disciplinary study of marine biodiversity in Maritime Continent using oceanographic tools and collaborative cruises to address climate change and anthropogenic impacts, revealing patterns and interactions.

properties.title: MERMAID – Coral Reef Data Platform
properties.description: Open-source web platform aggregating real-time coral reef survey data. Scientists input underwater observations directly, replacing Excel workflows. Transforms data into evidence-based conservation actions globally.

properties.title: Training Through Research (TTR) – Floating University
properties.description: International multi-disciplinary initiative combining academic education with hands-on ocean research cruises. Students and early career scientists conduct field investigations under expert supervision across Arctic, Atlantic, and Pacific.
properties.funder: Capacity building Working Group for the UN Ocean Decade, National Oceanographic Commission of Russian Federation

properties.title: COVID-19 Bio-Logging Initiative
properties.description: Analyzes bio-logging data on marine animals (mammals, birds, reptiles, fish) to understand their responses to altered human activity during COVID-19 lockdowns globally, informing sustainable human-wildlife coexistence.

properties.title: Comprehensive Multidisciplinary Research and Monitoring of Ecosystems of the Arctic Ocean and its Seas
properties.description: Why: understand climate change impacts. What: multidisciplinary Arctic research. How: expeditions with meteorological, oceanological, hydrochemical observations. When: 2021-2030. Where: Eurasian Arctic seas and Arctic Ocean.

properties.title: Devising Early-Career Capacity Development-IndOcn (DECCaD-IO)
properties.description: Training early-career marine scientists in Indian Ocean region through 10 capacity-building events (2023-27). ECs serve as both students and faculty, transitioning from learners to teachers in marine science topics.
properties.funder: Early Career Scientists' Network at IIOE-2 JPO, INCOIS

properties.title: Arctic Deep Observation for Multi-sphere Cycling
properties.description: Multidisciplinary research on mass/energy exchange in Arctic Ocean's lithosphere, cryosphere, hydrosphere, biosphere. Studies mid-ocean ridge hydrothermal processes affecting deep ocean carbon cycle. Builds database, models climate response.
properties.funder: Second Institute of Oceanography, Ministry of Natural Resources – China

properties.title: FENOY-X: Data Domain System of Ocean Knowledge for the Future Prosperity of Ocean Resources in the Western Indian Ocean
properties.description: Interactive map identifying ocean knowledge gaps in Western Indian Ocean. Promotes accessible data, sustainable development, training in ecosystem protection. Advances regional marine science understanding through 2030.
properties.funder: Western Indian Ocean Early Career Scientists Network

properties.title: Ocean Community Empowerment and Nature Grants
properties.description: UK's Blue Planet Fund initiative providing grants (£250k-£3M) to support ocean-based climate solutions, marine protection, and poverty reduction in developing coastal communities through local and scalable projects.
properties.funder: Department for Environment, Food, and Rural Affairs – United Kingdom

properties.title: Circulatory Aquaculture and Water Improvement Education for Blue Economy
properties.description: Develops BUIK bacteria system converting aquaculture waste to feed, reducing marine pollution. Includes Fe2+ purification, sustainability evaluation, ICT-based Ocean Literacy program. Global dissemination 2021-2031.

properties.title: Coastal Livelihoods: Preserving Oceans to Strengthen Coastal Resilience
properties.description: AXA Research Fund provides €1M to 8 projects addressing coastal livelihoods, sustainable ocean economy, blue food, climate solutions & community resilience to ocean hazards through IOC-UNESCO partnership.

properties.title: Comparable Microplastics Monitoring of Oceans
properties.description: Harmonizes microplastics monitoring in beach sands & surface water. Develops sampling guidelines for SDG 14.1.1b reporting. Establishes global network to track coastal microplastic abundance & change over time (2023-2030).

properties.title: Fish for Africa Innovation Hub (FAIH)
properties.description: Public-private partnership mobilizing businesses, research institutions and government to support R&D for sustainable aquaculture and fisheries in Africa, fostering science, technology, policy innovations to meet demand for fish.
properties.funder: International Center for Living Aquatic Resources Management

properties.title: Complex Multidisciplinary Research and Monitoring of Ecosystems in Strategic Areas of the South Atlantic (with Interested Countries)
properties.description: Russian Antarctic research at Bellinghausen Station, King George Island. Annual expeditions (Jan-Apr, 2021-2030) using ice-class vessels to study South Atlantic ecosystems, ocean-climate nexus, and build capacity.

properties.title: BORA Blue Ocean Research Alliance
properties.description: Alliance enabling offshore energy industry to support ocean science via vessel access, ROV sensors, submarine canyon monitoring, and benthic species observation during UN Ocean Decade for sustainable development.

properties.title: Exploring the 7th Continent (E7C)
properties.description: Scientific research expeditions collecting micro/nano plastics in Atlantic gyres & Mediterranean. Educational tours in ports with schooner visits, experiments & conferences to raise awareness about ocean plastic pollution.

properties.title: 1000 Ocean Start-Ups Coalition
properties.description: Coalition accelerating ocean impact innovation by supporting 1000+ transformative startups through global incubators, accelerators, and VCs to restore ocean health and achieve SDG14 by 2030.

properties.title: Enhancement of Hydrographic and Oceanographic Observations in Support of Marine Scientific Research
properties.description: Morocco enhances ocean knowledge through hydrographic surveys in Atlantic & Mediterranean. Addresses climate change impacts: acidification, warming, sea-level rise. Supports SDGs, regional mapping programs. 2021-2030.
properties.funder: National Commission for Education, Sciences and Culture, Kingdom of Morocco

properties.title: Geosystems and Mineral Resources in the Transition Continent-Ocean Zones and Open Ocean (GEOMIR)
properties.description: Arctic-Asian-Indo-Pacific initiative mapping ocean floor mineral resources (ferromanganese, sulphides, phosphorites, REE) through expeditions and experiments. Creates Marine GeoBioBank for worldwide data sharing and sustainable exploitation.
properties.funder: V. I. Il'ichev Pacific Oceanological Institute, Far Eastern Branch of Russian Academy of Sciences

properties.title: Ocean Science in Action: Addressing Marine Ecosystems, Food Security and Climate Change Impacts
properties.description: Educational video resources on marine tech for sustainable ocean management. Covers robotics, remote sensing, modeling via Indian Ocean case studies on fisheries, blue carbon, coastal communities. Supports SDGs & Ocean Decade.

properties.title: Gain knowledge to respond to multiple stressors
properties.description: Addresses knowledge gaps on ecosystem responses to multiple stressors. Develops tools for resilience-building management frameworks. Monitors, protects and restores marine biodiversity under changing conditions.

properties.title: Benefits of Ocean Observing Catalog
properties.description: NOAA IOOS develops GIS/web tool cataloging ocean observation use cases. Quantifies economic/societal benefits of ocean data to support investment in observing systems. Serves policy, safety, economic growth, environmental protection globally.
properties.funder: NOAA U.S. Integrated Ocean Observing System (IOOS)

properties.title: Coastal Oxygen and Hypoxia in Asian Waters
properties.description: Studies deoxygenation and seasonal hypoxia in Asian coastal waters caused by eutrophication and global warming. Focuses on river pollutant discharge impacts and developing science-based mitigation strategies for expanding coastal hypoxia.

properties.title: BIO-Carbon
properties.description: Delivers understanding of marine life's role in ocean carbon storage. Addresses CO2 absorption, organic carbon conversion, and climate-induced respiration shifts to improve predictions of future ocean carbon storage capacity.

properties.title: Explore the strongest ocean current in the Western Pacific: the 2nd Cooperative Study of Kuroshio and Adjacent Regions
properties.description: Studies Kuroshio current's changing conditions under global warming. Develops knowledge for weather forecasts, climate predictions, fishery management. Addresses ecosystem protection, sustainable blue food, ocean-climate nexus.
properties.funder: IOC Sub-Commission for the Western Pacific (WESTPAC), IOC/UNESCO & UNESCO Bangkok

properties.title: Beaufort Ecosystem Biodiversity
properties.description: Integrates multi-year coastal/offshore research to assess Beaufort Sea biodiversity across habitats. Ecosystem-based approach identifies biodiversity change mechanisms. Co-develops monitoring to protect Arctic ecosystem.

properties.title: Global Plastic Ingestion Bioindicators
properties.description: Develops standardized bioindicators to monitor plastic ingestion in marine species globally, tracking ocean plastic pollution impacts on wildlife through systematic observation and data collection.

properties.title: Twilight Zone of West Pacific Ecosystem Research (TOWER)
properties.description: Investigates twilight zone (200-1000m) ecosystem structure, biodiversity & metabolic activities in Western Pacific/South China Sea. Aims to document ecosystem before human impacts & climate change cause irreversible damage. Provides data for policy.

properties.title: Study Development and Nature Management of the Azov Sea
properties.description: Operational monitoring & forecasting of hydrophysical/ecological parameters in Black Sea coastal zones. Includes hydrophysical, hydrobiological, hydrochemical, geological, archaeological & ethnolinguistic research with media coverage.

properties.title: Accelerate Marine Spatial Planning in the Western Pacific
properties.description: Promotes Marine Spatial Planning in Western Pacific to help member states achieve SDG 14 by 2030. Builds on MSPglobal Project results. Addresses pollution, ecosystems, blue food, ocean economy, and climate nexus.
properties.funder: IOC Sub-Commission for the Western Pacific, IOC/UNESCO

properties.title: Lusophone Hub of the Ocean Decade
properties.description: Improves data/knowledge access for Lusophone policymakers to enhance ocean governance. Creates engagement environment, strengthens partnerships, disseminates knowledge across Portuguese-speaking countries. 2022-2031.

properties.title: Coastal Zones Under Intensifying Human Activities and Changing Climate: A Regional Programme Integrating Science, Management and Society to Support Ocean Sustainability (Coastal-SOS)
properties.description: Examines 6 East Asian coastal ecosystems' 50-year trajectories, predicts 30-year futures. Integrates science, governance, society to transform coastal development for 2B people relying on these seas.

properties.title: Mesopelagic Ecosystem and Biopump Dynamics and Connectivity in the Pacific (MEBIDYC-P)
properties.description: Studies mesopelagic ecosystem (200-1000m depth) in Pacific Ocean: species diversity, biomass, food web connectivity, biological pump, carbon flux. Joint exploration, data sharing, capacity building for conservation. 2021-2030.
properties.funder: Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology

properties.title: Arctic Sea Ice Restoration
properties.description: Restoring Arctic ice by thickening winter ice through pumping seawater on top in strategic locations. Addresses 75% ice volume loss over 40 years. Aims to preserve Earth's refrigerator function by 2030.

properties.title: Accelerating capacity development transformations in the Western Pacific – Regional Network of Training and Research Centers (RTRCs) on Marine Science
properties.description: Establishes Regional Training & Research Centers in Western Pacific to develop capacity for sustainable development through regular training & research opportunities for young researchers & ocean stakeholders.
properties.funder: IOC Sub-Commission for the Western Pacific (WESTPAC), IOC/UNESCO & UNESCO Bangkok

properties.title: OceanTeacher Global Academy: Building Capacity and Accelerated Technology Transfer for the Ocean Decade
properties.description: Global online training platform delivering ocean science courses for UN Decade priorities. Builds capacity for equitable participation in ocean science across all countries through classroom, blended & distance learning. 2021-2027.

properties.title: Stem the tide of Asia's riverine plastic emission into the ocean
properties.description: Generates riverine plastic data from Asia's rivers (major source of marine waste) to inform waste management, policy, technology innovation and behavior change. Addresses marine plastic pollution at source through 2028.
properties.funder: IOC Sub-Commission for the Western Pacific (WESTPAC), IOC/UNESCO

properties.title: Polar Ecosystems, Global Impacts (BIOPOLE)
properties.description: Studies how polar nutrients drive global carbon cycling & productivity. Examines nutrient export from poles, ecosystem impacts on carbon sequestration, and climate change effects on fish stocks & carbon cycling in Arctic & Southern Oceans.

properties.title: Enhancing capacity development in the TAC Region
properties.description: Develops local ocean expertise in Tropical Atlantic & Caribbean through blue economy training, knowledge exchange & deep-sea awareness. Addresses barriers to sustainable development via stakeholder engagement & policy initiatives.

properties.title: The Sea as a Good Cause in support to the Ocean Decade
properties.description: VLIZ philanthropy seeks funding from donors for ocean research & innovation. Grant-making facility supporting Ocean Decade priorities: ecosystem protection, capacity development, behavior change across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Accelerating the delivery of SDG14 in Asia and the Pacific
properties.description: Regional program supporting Asia-Pacific states to implement SDG14 by 2030. Promotes ecosystem health protection, marine-land interconnectedness via one-health approach, enabling sustainable ocean use and conservation.
properties.funder: United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (UNESCAP)

properties.title: Observatory of Marine Anthropogenic Litter
properties.description: OLAMAR combats marine pollution in Amazon River estuary by studying dynamics/effects of marine litter, characterizing ghost fishing, creating database, and democratizing information to protect local biota on Brazilian Amazon coast.

properties.title: The Western Indian Ocean Productivity Under Climate Change
properties.description: Studies climate change impacts on Western Indian Ocean productivity, focusing on upwelling, nutrient distribution, and fisheries. Addresses warming effects on tuna spawning grounds and regional ecology. 2023-2028.

properties.title: Women from the Sea
properties.description: Empowers women in ocean careers via virtual hub uniting science & sentiment. Creates documentaries, campaigns to advance gender equity in maritime sectors & inspire next-gen ocean leaders globally. 2021-2027.
properties.funder: Help Images – Associação de Promoção e Apoio à Solidariedade Social

properties.title: Joint Exploration of the Twilight Zone Ocean Network (JETZON)
properties.description: Studies ocean depths 200-1000m containing largest fish stocks, vital for biogeochemical cycles & CO2 sequestration. Coordinates international research on this poorly understood zone facing fishing, mining & climate threats.

properties.title: Assessing Multiple Stressors in Coastal Ecosystems
properties.description: Assesses environmental stressors (pollutants, microplastics, land use, invasions) in Guaraguaçu coastal basin, Brazil. Creates ecological integrity index using biological indicators to monitor coastal conservation status. 2023-2026.
properties.category: Marine pollution monitoring and ecosystem restoration

properties.title: Establishing Turkey's Marine Environment Strategy
properties.description: Develops Turkey's national marine strategy aligned with EU Marine Strategy Framework Directive, addressing 11 descriptors across Turkish seas including pollution, ecosystems, and sustainable economy (2018-2021).
properties.funder: Ministry of Environment and Urbanization of Turkey

properties.title: Ocean Best Practices for the Decade
properties.description: Programme supporting ocean stakeholders in securing and sharing methodological heritage. Engages diverse communities through FAIR digital technologies to align interests, create better practices, improve interoperability and training for sustainable
properties.funder: International Oceanographic Data and Information Exchange (IODE) and Global Ocean Observing System (GOOS) of IOC-UNESCO

properties.title: Advancing predictions of marine heatwaves
properties.description: Develops predictive tools to forecast marine heatwaves and their impacts on Western Australian ecosystems. Empowers management agencies with knowledge to respond to extreme temperature events affecting fisheries and marine life.

properties.title: Integrated Ocean Observing System for New Zealand
properties.description: Community-driven ocean observing system integrating traditional knowledge with science. Monitors land-sea connectivity, carbon budgets, sustainable resource extraction, seafood sector, ocean state drivers, and maritime safety across NZ waters.
properties.funder: National Institute of Water and Atmospheric Research

properties.title: Advocating for Humane Capture Fisheries to Support Ocean and Fisheries Sustainability
properties.description: Researches & advocates animal welfare in wild capture fisheries (capture, handling, slaughter). Improves gear design to reduce mortality, bycatch, overfishing. Supports sustainable consumption & marine conservation.

properties.title: Deep Ocean Observing Strategy (DOOS)
properties.description: Global network observing deep-ocean physics, biogeochemistry & biology to establish baselines, understand habitat changes & enable sustainable management. Promotes infrastructure & diverse leadership for climate & biodiversity solutions.

properties.title: Making environmental DNA FAIR
properties.description: Standardizing environmental DNA data to make it Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable across global ocean basins. Develops vocabulary standards and scripts to consolidate eDNA datasets on biodiversity platforms like GBIF.
properties.funder: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organization

properties.title: Sustainable Total Value Chain of Cockle Industry
properties.description: Revolutionizing cockle culture in Malaysia through sustainable practices, responsible harvesting, welfare enhancement, food safety optimization, and innovative shell repurposing for wastewater treatment. Engages local communities.

properties.title: Image analysis by citizens for ocean's life study
properties.description: Ocean Spy platform enables citizens to annotate marine images, helping scientists analyze marine ecosystems through AI. Covers diverse habitats globally, combining citizen science with big data methods for ecosystem understanding.

properties.title: Harmful Algae Bloom Solutions (HAB-S)
properties.description: Global programme to manage harmful algal blooms through improved data, observing tech, and knowledge for decision-making. Protects aquaculture, fisheries, desalination, tourism via public awareness and interdisciplinary solutions.

properties.title: Elite Centre of Aquatic Nature-based Solutions
properties.description: Scales aquatic nature-based solutions across land-sea continuum for climate adaptation. Investigates carbon storage, coastal protection, water filtration. Co-creates guidelines with stakeholders. 2023-2027.

properties.title: Environmental Predictors of the Baltic Sea Eutrophication in Connection with Planning Human Activity (BaltEP)
properties.description: Understanding past/present/future Baltic Sea changes via oxygen supply to deepwater. Addresses eutrophication control through Atlantic water exchange, climate impacts on inflows, ice seasons, warming, cyanobacteria blooms.
properties.funder: Shirshov Institute of Oceanology, Russian Academy of Sciences

properties.title: Mayotte observatory for research and response
properties.description: MARMOR provides mobile/cabled equipment to study earth deformation, seismicity, tsunamis, volcanism & environmental issues in Mayotte's ocean/coastal areas, extending land observations into marine domain for community resilience.

properties.title: Coastal Ocean Resource Environment (CORE)
properties.description: Delivers high-quality coastal ocean data & products for ecosystem health, hazards & resource management. Provides open data access, management tools & best practices. Supports global & developing regions via one-stop-shop platform.

properties.title: Paraná Ocean Alliance: science, technology and collective actions strengthening ocean literacy and public policies
properties.description: Collaborative initiative promoting ocean literacy through science-society integration in Paraná, Brazil. Engages schools, communities, and policymakers via five thematic axes supporting UN Ocean Decade and 2030 Agenda goals.

properties.title: Monaco Explorations
properties.description: International expeditions combining scientific research, outreach & diplomacy to understand marine ecosystems, share knowledge globally, and support sustainable management of selected marine areas worldwide (2021-2030).

properties.title: AI Ensemble Engine for Coastal Hazard Predictions (Aquarius)
properties.description: Delivers coastal predictive products for European & African zones vulnerable to extreme hazards. Provides near-real-time early-warning via observations, modelling & forecasting to improve resilience & protect communities.

properties.title: Mangroves as Nature-based Solutions to Coastal Hazards in Eastern Ghana (MANCOGA)
properties.description: Develops decision support tools using mangroves as nature-based solutions to mitigate erosion and flooding along Ghana's east coast. Uses Digital Twin modeling and participatory co-design to increase community resilience.

properties.title: An Ocean Data and Information System supporting the UN Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development (OceanData 2030)
properties.description: Open-source data system linking global ocean information systems for efficient discovery of data, information and knowledge products. Ocean InfoHub is central element. Addresses digital ocean representation, capacity development, behaviour change.
properties.funder: International Oceanographic Data and Information Exchange (IODE) of IOC-UNESCO

properties.title: The Ocean Decade Image Bank and Toolkits
properties.description: Free digital library of ocean photos/videos by world-class creators, plus infographics and toolkits to accelerate ocean science communication, raise Ocean Decade awareness, and improve ocean science image globally.

properties.title: Canadian Ocean Climate Simulation 1958 to Present (CanOCS)
properties.description: High-resolution ocean model simulating Canada's 3 oceans (Atlantic, Arctic, Pacific) from 1958-present to understand drivers of physical & biological ocean changes under climate change for future projections.

properties.title: The World Ocean Database Programme (WODP): Openly, Discoverable, Accessible, Adaptable, and Comprehensive Digital Global Profile Oceanographic Data of Known Quality
properties.description: Global ocean profile database providing quality-controlled oceanographic data from 1778-present. Enables worldwide data centers to upload/retrieve uniform ocean data for climate, ecosystems & sustainable economy research.
properties.funder: U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)

properties.title: West African Science Service Centre on Climate Change and Adapted Land Use: Cabo Verde Graduate School on Climate Change and Marine Sciences (WASCAL-CV)
properties.description: Training 20 West African students per batch in Marine Sciences & Ocean Management. Interdisciplinary courses on oceanography, marine ecology, fisheries, coastal management. Develops climate-adaptive solutions in Cabo Verde.
properties.funder: West African Science Service Centre on Climate Change and Adapted Land Use (WASCAL)

properties.title: Quantitative Tools for Responsible Marine Energy
properties.description: Develops open-source SEAT toolkit for marine renewable energy projects, integrating environmental data to assess stressors like acoustics, supporting sustainable ocean power with ecosystem stewardship across Arctic, N Atlantic, N Pacific.

properties.title: Integrated coastal ocean observing and predicting (PredictOnTime)
properties.description: Delivers predictive systems for global coastal oceans to forecast extreme events, minimize impacts on resources/assets. Deploys observing/forecasting systems in 20+ nations, develops citizen science capacity. 2022-2027.
properties.funder: Euro-Mediterranean Centre on Climate Change Foundation

properties.title: Mediterranean Sea Ship-based Hydrography (Med-SHIP)
properties.description: Implements repeat hydrography across Mediterranean to monitor water mass changes, overturning circulation, climate impacts, and ocean biogeochemistry through coordinated ship-based observations similar to GO-SHIP programme.

properties.title: British Columbia Ocean Acidification and Hypoxia (OAH) Action Plan
properties.description: BC addresses ocean acidification & hypoxia impacts on fisheries/aquaculture. Expert workshops establish knowledge, gather community input, develop adaptation strategies. Enhances collaboration & awareness in BC coastal waters. 2021-2026.

properties.title: South East Australia Marine Ecosystem Study
properties.description: Multi-disciplinary voyages studying SE Australian marine ecosystem, a climate hotspot with marine heatwaves. Co-designed with fisheries, marine parks, oil/gas, renewable energy stakeholders for sustainable management.

properties.title: Cultural Heritage Framework Programme
properties.description: Framework integrating cultural heritage with ocean science to deliver sustainable development. Supports Decade Actions through co-design, data management, capacity development, diversity, ocean literacy & public engagement across all ocean basins.

properties.title: The Royal College of Art Ocean Decade Partnership
properties.description: RCA partners as Decade Implementing Partner to create co-design platform tackling ocean challenges. Connects scientific data to community actions through inclusive design solutions with stakeholders globally, focusing on ecosystems and society.

properties.title: Challenger 150 – A Decade to Study Deep-Sea Life
properties.description: Global cooperative developing deep-ocean expertise to sustainably manage deep-sea ecosystems. Advances understanding of deep-ocean biodiversity, distribution, and function through new technologies and observations across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Mitigation of Natural Incidence towards Ocean Resilience (MoNITOR)
properties.description: Develops prediction systems for coastal ecological changes in Indo-Pacific. Focuses on disaster prevention, youth education, regional physical-biological modeling, and operational forecasting for Indian and western Pacific coastal regions.
properties.funder: Second Institute of Oceanography, Ministry of Natural Resources – China

properties.title: Ocean Biomolecular Observing Network (OBON)
properties.description: Global system using DNA & biomolecules to understand ocean life from viruses to whales. Transforms sensing, protection & management of marine ecosystems facing pollution, habitat loss & climate change. Detects biological hazards.
properties.funder: The Partnership for Observation of the Global Ocean (POGO)

properties.title: Global Ocean Oxygen Database and Atlas (GO2DAT)
properties.description: Building open-access global ocean oxygen database combining coastal/open ocean data from multiple platforms. FAIR-compliant with quality control. Supports ocean deoxygenation monitoring and education. Launched 2022-2027.

properties.title: Royal Society Ocean Science Policy Programme
properties.description: Facilitates knowledge transfer between academia and policy. Provides platform for early career researchers to understand policy utility of their work, enhance networks, and inform ocean policy for Ocean Decade goals.

properties.title: Atlas Aquatica
properties.description: Maps global diving sites & operators to calculate economic value of diving industry. Builds capacity in diving sector, co-designs sustainability strategies with dive professionals, communities & researchers to achieve SDGs. 2021-2025.
properties.funder: Scripps Institution of Oceanography, University of California San Diego

properties.title: AGU's Mentoring365: UN Decade of Ocean Sciences
properties.description: Virtual global peer-to-peer mentorship program supporting Early Career Ocean Professionals through structured relationship-building tools, integrated into major ocean science events with 25,000+ participants worldwide.

properties.title: Blue Futures Pathways
properties.description: SOI Foundation program connecting Canadian youth (14-30) with education, employment & funding in Sustainable Blue Economy. Emphasizes Indigenous & under-represented groups via online learning, mentorship & ship-based experiences.

properties.title: Canadian Arctic Biogeochemsitry Observing Network
properties.description: Network monitoring ocean carbon chemistry, greenhouse gas cycling, primary production & acidification across Canadian Arctic using vessels, observatories & land installations. Provides real-time data to Inuit communities.

properties.title: Climate Data for Community Action
properties.description: Provides real-time environmental sensor data for South Pacific Island Nations to address climate change, sea level rise, flooding, and coastal hazards, enabling better policymaking and community resilience planning (2022-2027).

properties.title: South-East Australian Coastal Ocean Forecast System
properties.description: High-resolution ocean forecast system for SE Australian waters & East Australian Current using ocean sensing & numerical modelling. Supports shipping, fishing, coastal communities & environmental health in ocean warming hotspot.

properties.title: Ocean acidification in the Gulf of St. Lawrence
properties.description: Monitoring ocean acidification in Gulf of St. Lawrence due to high river runoff and primary production. Tracks pH, pCO2, and calcium carbonate levels affecting marine species. Focuses on estuary, northwest GSL, and Magdalen Shallows.

properties.title: Ocean Decade Expeditions
properties.description: Multi-year program delivering ship-based expeditions across Canada to create community-based management plans for MPAs, OECMs, and IPCAs through workshops and experiential learning. Runs 2023-2026.

properties.title: Fishing Vessel Ocean Observing Network
properties.description: Global network standardizing ocean data from fishing vessels to complement existing observing systems. Enables cost-effective coastal monitoring for research, forecasting, and sustainable blue economy growth worldwide.

properties.title: Coastal Pollution Toolbox
properties.description: Knowledge hub providing predictive tools & services for coastal pollution in temperate/polar zones. Links field data with models for forecasting. Co-developed with stakeholders for decision-making support. 2023-2027.

properties.title: Reef-Shaped Coastlines: Effects of Climate Change
properties.description: Studies hydro-morphodynamic processes on Brazilian tropical reef-shaped coasts using field experiments, satellite imagery & modeling to understand current coastal processes & project future coastline behavior under sea level rise.

properties.title: Integrating Coastal Hazard Warning Systems for TAC
properties.description: Co-design integrated early warning systems for Tropical Americas & Caribbean covering tropical cyclones, tsunami, sargassum, oil spills, coral bleaching. Focuses on monitoring, risk knowledge, communication & response capabilities.

properties.title: Tsunami & Climatic RR at Protected Areas in CR
properties.description: Enhancing tsunami & climate preparedness in Costa Rican coastal Wildlife Protected Areas through inundation maps, evacuation plans & vulnerability reduction. Develops manual for other coastal WPAs. Supports nature tourism economy.
properties.funder: SINAMOT Program, National University Costa Rica

properties.title: PH Ocean Observing and Coastal Resource Management
properties.description: Develops ocean observing systems and models to monitor Philippine coastal ecosystems threatened by stressors. Deploys tech for fisheries, aquaculture, tourism sites. Assesses biotoxins, pollutants. Co-designs tools with stakeholders.
properties.funder: Marine Science Institute, University of the Philippines Diliman

properties.title: Coastal Observation Lab in a Box (COLaB)
properties.description: Addresses lack of oceanographic data in coastal regions via affordable instruments for biological, physical, biogeochemical parameters. Training camps build hands-on oceanographers. Supports food security, ecosystem health.

properties.title: ACCASP Ocean Chemistry
properties.description: DFO working group monitoring ocean acidification in Canadian waters. Studies pH, controlling mechanisms, ecosystem responses. Reports to SDG 14.3. Covers Labrador Sea, Scotian Shelf, Arctic regions. 2023-2024.

properties.title: Global Coastal Ocean Restoration and Resilience
properties.description: Holistic coastal restoration across 14+ nations using nature-based solutions (coral, seagrass, mangroves). Co-designed with communities. Integrates observations, modeling, economic analysis for sustainable resilience.

properties.title: Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility
properties.description: Global network of 1034 real-time sea-level stations providing early warning for rapid-onset sea-level hazards. Supports coastal community resilience through free online monitoring service across all ocean basins. 2023-2026.

properties.title: Western Indian Ocean Marine Conservation Program (MARCOP)
properties.description: Regional program building capacity in East & South Africa for marine protection, governance & management. Supports biodiversity targets & climate adaptation in WIO through research, partnerships & tailored solutions. 2024-2030.
properties.funder: Western Indian Ocean Marine Science Association (WIOMSA)

properties.title: TAC Ocean Observing and Forecasting System
properties.description: Co-designed integrated ocean observation & forecasting system for Tropical Americas & Caribbean. Connects observations through data management to models & applications for sustainable development, safety & prosperity. Regional collaboration.

properties.title: The Caspian Sea Digital Twin (CASSEADI)
properties.description: Creates Caspian Sea Data Center with satellite, oceanographic, climate data to assess anthropogenic loads, climate change impacts, and develop adaptation strategies for the Caspian Sea environment.

properties.title: Ocean World of Sound: MesoAmerican Reef
properties.description: Understanding MesoAmerican Reef soundscape through recording, analysis, citizen science. Transdisciplinary approach integrating science, arts, local culture to support reef resiliency and inform Marine Protected Area management.

properties.title: Pilot Digital Twins for Water Pollution in Africa
properties.description: Digital twins in Nigeria & Cape Verde to increase coastal resilience to water pollution. High-res models, real-time data, local language platform. Empowers communities on fisheries/aquaculture impacts. Training & capacity building.

properties.title: Enhancing Estuary Resilience in Coastal BC
properties.description: Monitoring program across coastal BC estuaries with 15 First Nations & partners. Tracks sea-level rise, climate impacts on critical ecosystems supporting 80% of coastal wildlife. Informs restoration & adaptive management.

properties.title: Aleutian Trench Biodiversity Studies (AleutBio)
properties.description: Studies marine biodiversity from protists to megafauna in Aleutian Trench & Bering Sea. Maps seafloor, analyzes biogeography & species connectivity with Arctic Ocean. Examines climate change impacts on North Pacific gateway to Arctic. 2022-2024

properties.title: Numerical Seabed Using Hydroacoustic Digital Twins
properties.description: Multidisciplinary initiative developing digital twin tools to monitor coastal seabed health using hydroacoustic measurements. Quantifies physical seabed nature and analyzes complex underwater phenomena with uncertainty prediction.

properties.title: DeuteroNoise
properties.description: Characterizes maritime traffic noise pollution in European seas (North Adriatic, Venice Lagoon, North Sea, Black Sea, Barcelona). Tests effects on marine invertebrate behavior, nervous/immune systems via field and lab studies.

properties.title: Nazaré Artificial Reefs Seaweed Planting Pilot
properties.description: Pilot seaweed plantation off Nazaré harbor (Portugal) to restore ecosystems, enhance biodiversity, provide alternative livelihoods for fishing communities, increase oxygen production, and support sustainable food systems.

properties.title: Subseasonal to Seasonal North Pacific Prediction
properties.description: Predicting extreme ocean events like marine heat waves in NW Pacific through air-sea interaction monitoring using buoys and vessels, developing high-resolution climate prediction systems for 10-day to seasonal forecasts.
properties.funder: Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology

properties.title: Ghost Fishing Solutions
properties.description: Addresses ghost gear (abandoned fishing equipment) harming marine life through retrieval, recycling, and prevention using innovative technology and practices. Contributes to ocean sustainability and ecosystem restoration.

properties.title: Reef Recovery 2030
properties.description: Decade-long $1B effort led by Great Barrier Reef Foundation to boost coral reef resilience globally through science, reef management, and community partnerships. Addresses climate change threats to reefs supporting 1B people.

properties.title: Global Library of Underwater Biological Sounds
properties.description: GLUBS creates open-access platform integrating passive acoustic monitoring data, machine learning, and citizen science to standardize knowledge of underwater soundscapes globally from 2023-2028.

properties.title: Haig Fras Marine Protected Area Digital Twin
properties.description: Digital twin of Haig Fras MPA integrating seafloor geology, observations, models & AI tools. Publicly accessible platform using marine photography for non-destructive community monitoring. Completed 2022-2023.

properties.title: Rewilding the Oceans with Giant Kelp
properties.description: Growing giant kelp forests at scale in Namibia to restore ocean health, draw down CO2, boost biodiversity, and produce sustainable products. Kelp grows 50cm/day, requires no fertilizers or freshwater. Harvesting canopy only.

properties.title: Interoperability Architecture for a Digital Ocean
properties.description: Coordinates global initiatives to develop interoperability architecture for Digital Twins of the Ocean, advancing common understanding and prototype applications across science, engineering, and operations.

properties.title: The Mantaverse
properties.description: Immersive digital world using manta rays as ambassadors to teach ocean issues (IUU fishing, pollution, coral loss, biodiversity). Increases ocean literacy through gameplay, 3D imagery, dialogue. Multi-stage educational project.

properties.title: Shipwrecks as Artificial Reef Structures
properties.description: Evaluating shipwrecks as artificial reefs in Sri Lanka for species recruitment, biodiversity, habitat provision. Assessing ecological, historical, socio-economic value for marine communities, fisheries, tourism, and sustainable resource management.

properties.title: Marine Research Program Northern Australia
properties.description: Liveaboard research program surveying remote coral reefs in Northern Australia using drones, diving gear. Establishes monitoring protocols, supports local communities. Addresses knowledge gaps in biodiverse marine zones.

properties.title: Caspian Sea Carbon Dioxide Removal Project (CaspianCDR)
properties.description: Research project developing CO2 removal technology using microalgae photosynthesis in coastal desert ponds. Utilizes seawater without freshwater, contributing to healthier oceans and air. Caspian Sea, 2023-2027.

properties.title: Sustainable Mariculture Network
properties.description: Network for sustainable marine aquaculture in Colombian Caribbean. Develops integrated systems with local communities at Cienaga Grande de Santa Marta through knowledge exchange and in-situ experimentation.

properties.title: Engineering Resilient Caribbean Coastlines (ENRICO)
properties.description: Digital transformation of Caribbean coastlines through disaster risk management, tsunami modeling, and coastal ecosystem assessment. Creates comprehensive digital coastal ecosystem for Caribbean islands to enhance resilience and conservation.

properties.title: Marine Chemical Speciation (MarChemSpec)
properties.description: Develops free software for marine chemical speciation using Pitzer equations. Creates models for Tris buffers (pH calibration) and seawater CO2 system with trace metals. Enables SI-traceable oceanic pH scale development.

properties.title: Ocean Literacy Educational Program (Ocean Health and Protection)
properties.description: Cabo Verde creates mandatory ocean literacy education system via public-private partnership with academia, civil society, religious institutions. Training targets all society layers for ocean health and protection. 2021-2030.
properties.funder: Ministry of Maritime Economy – Cabo Verde

properties.title: SurfStainable Community – Slide Water Sports for Science in Action
properties.description: Engages water sports communities as ocean ambassadors for data collection on marine ecosystems and threats. Partners clubs, federations, universities, NGOs to promote ocean understanding and eco-friendly tech.

properties.title: European Marine Board
properties.description: EMB coordinates European marine research, provides policy recommendations, supports Ocean Decade actions through member coordination, communication, and science-to-policy translation via working groups aligned with Decade outcomes.

properties.title: Above and Beyond – Completing the World Register of Marine Species (ABC WoRMS)
properties.description: WoRMS provides complete taxonomic overview of all marine life, supporting scientists, policy, industry & public. Addresses taxonomic gaps globally, explores new taxonomy challenges, documents traits information for all ocean basins.

properties.title: Ocean Culture: Port to Port and Water Cycle
properties.description: Educational sailing ship program promoting ocean literacy through port-based webinars. Focuses on blue curriculum: finance, carbon, economics, governance. Addresses marine pollution and behavior change across Atlantic waters.

properties.title: Forecasting Ocean to Coasts, Connecting Users (FOCCUS)
properties.description: Co-produces ocean monitoring/forecasting info linking Copernicus Marine global/regional systems with national coastal systems. Builds seamless regional-coastal modelling framework for policy, blue economy. 2024-2030, all ocean basins.

properties.title: Hinemoana Halo Ocean Initiative (H2O)
properties.description: Indigenous Māori & Pacific communities protect 2.2M km² of ocean by 2030. $100M fund creates MPAs, restores whales, develops indigenous carbon credits, blends ancient wisdom with science for community-led conservation across Oceania.

properties.title: Scientists for Ocean Literacy: Oceanographers and Meteorologists for Ocean Literacy
properties.description: European oceanographers & meteorological agencies engage public on ocean sustainability through joint events, resources, best practice exchange, promoting blue careers & empowering scientists as ocean advocates. 2021-2030.

properties.title: SIDS Ocean Science Policy Network Pilot Project
properties.description: Supports ocean stewardship in Small Island Developing States through capacity development for emerging leaders, cross-regional knowledge exchange, SIDS-to-SIDS mentoring, and empowering sustainable ocean programs (2023-2026).

properties.title: Preventive Management of Industrial-Port zones (Enviro-Actions)
properties.description: Monitors air/water quality in industrial-port zones at land-sea interface using real-time systems. Supports stakeholders in preserving coastal ecosystems while enabling port/industrial development. Focus on pollution prevention.
properties.funder: Northern Institute for Research in Environment and Occupational Health and Safety (INREST)

properties.title: African Youths Sustainable Ocean Campaign (AYSOC)
properties.description: Multi-country initiative mentoring African youth in Gulf of Guinea on ocean literacy, sustainable ocean economy, climate change impacts, and marine litter cleanup through school-based clubs. Focus: Niger Delta & Angola coastal regions.
properties.funder: The Atlantic Maritime Academy Nigeria (Institute of Nautical Studies and Ocean Research)

properties.title: EuroMarine Outlook on International Ocean Programs
properties.description: TransOcean engages marine scientists towards SDGs via Ocean Decade & EU Mission. 3-year transoceanic initiative develops methods to turn marine science towards sustainability, addressing ecosystem restoration, pollution & blue economy.

properties.title: Monitoramento Mirim Costeiro (Junior Coastal Monitoring Program)
properties.description: Students become scientists in citizen-science initiative for ocean preservation. Engage in data collection, analysis, communication. Active in Brazil & Portugal, expanding globally to 100 schools by 2030.

properties.title: Global Fund for Coral Reefs
properties.description: Blended finance fund protecting coral reefs in LDCs/SIDS through reef-positive interventions: MPAs, mariculture, sustainable fisheries. Focus on South Asia, Pacific, Caribbean, Indian Ocean. Active in Fiji, Philippines, Bahamas, PNG, Kenya, Tanzania.

properties.title: A Federated Open Research Ecosystem for the Oceans: Blue-Cloud2026
properties.description: EU project creating web-based platform for FAIR ocean data. Provides researchers open access to multidisciplinary marine datasets, analytical services, computing for blue science across European seas, coastal & inland waters. 2023-2026.

properties.title: The Ripple Effect: Capacity Sharing for the Ocean
properties.description: Multi-national partnership addressing capacity sharing in ocean science, literacy & conservation in low/middle-income countries. Scales up support for local leaders developing learning exchanges between fishers, youth & communities by 2030.
properties.funder: New England Aquarium (Marine Conservation Action Fund)

properties.title: Ocean Voices: Building Transformative Pathways to Achieve the Decade's Outcomes
properties.description: Research program addressing equity in ocean science by studying actors, power dynamics, and decision-making. Incubates ideas, facilitates discussions, and builds capacity partnerships for equitable ocean governance.
properties.funder: Nippon Foundation Ocean Nexus Center, EarthLab, University of Washington

properties.title: Ocean & Me: School Under Sail
properties.description: Educational program developing youth competence through sailing expeditions. Partners with scientific & business sectors for career guidance in marine fields. Focuses on sustainable development & bridging education-labor market gap. Arctic & N Atlant

properties.title: Small fisheries management in coastal Mozambique (SFMCM)
properties.description: Reducing illegal fishing (beach seining, chicocota) in Mozambique by piloting alternative methods with communities and investigating mesopelagic resources to protect coral reefs and seagrasses, 2025-2029.

properties.title: Sargasso Sea Project
properties.description: Facilitates sustainable stewardship of Sargasso Sea through socio-ecosystem analysis and strategic action programme. Develops collaborative management frameworks for high seas conservation and captures best practices for areas beyond national jurisdi

properties.title: Virtual Platform for Sustainable Ocean Education
properties.description: Digital platform for ocean education in Western Indian Ocean SIDS. Provides educators & NGOs accessible materials for formal education & public engagement to build ocean literacy & conservation values. 2023-2027.

properties.title: Patagonia Ocean-Climate Innovation Hub
properties.description: Collaborative initiative restoring ocean health via innovation. Connects researchers, entrepreneurs, policymakers to develop ocean-climate solutions: carbon removal, regenerative aquaculture, startups. Patagonia region, 2023-2030.

properties.title: Tanzania Ocean Climate Innovation Hub
properties.description: Hub fostering innovation & collaboration to address ocean climate change impacts on Tanzanian coastal communities. Facilitates knowledge sharing, resilience building, sustainable practices for marine ecosystems & economies. 2023-2030.

properties.title: Picture Perfect: Rapid Classification of Plankton
properties.description: AI-powered image analysis of plankton (20-5,000 microns) across three ocean basins around Africa. Uses machine learning to analyze entire samples for routine monitoring, creating a decade-long time-series (2021-2030).

properties.title: Developing a conservation plan for Maui's corals
properties.description: Coral restoration on Maui through workshops, training, habitat monitoring, resort partnerships, and private tourism funding. Builds capacity for Maui Nui Marine Resource Council staff and community via seminars and skill development.

properties.title: Interactive World Ocean
properties.description: Touchscreen interactive ocean map generating curiosity through visuals, videos, data. Explores regions from rivers to deep sea, tropics to poles. Links regional/global perspectives on biodiversity, climate change across ecosystems.

properties.title: WreckLife
properties.description: Studies historic wrecks in Maltese waters to understand degradation impacts on marine organisms and environments. Uses interdisciplinary approach to predict future degradation, address seabed pollution, and protect benthic communities.

properties.title: New Copernicus Capability for Ocean Food Networks (NECCTON)
properties.description: Develops methods to integrate biogeochemical/biological data into ecosystem models for marine biodiversity conservation and food resource management. Co-designs 13 case studies with stakeholders globally and in regional seas.

properties.title: EPIC Academy: Plastic Pollution Education
properties.description: Educational curriculum teaching students about ocean plastic pollution through 10 lessons with quizzes. Aims to educate 1M people by 2027 on solutions and innovations to mitigate plastic pollution, awarding digital certificates.

properties.title: Contamination in Mangroves of Northeast Brazil
properties.description: Diagnose contamination across 12 coastal sites in NE Brazil, analyze anthropic impacts on water quality and biota, assess carbon/nitrogen stocks, mitigate risks to health and ecosystems, inform coastal management policies.

properties.title: Solutions for Cost-effective Ocean Observation (SCOOPp)
properties.description: Coordinates cost-effective ocean observation initiatives, creating a directory of technologies for marine/coastal management. Demonstrates pilot sites, develops best practices for sustained coastal observations supporting climate adaptation.

properties.title: Coastal and Marine Ecological Classification Standard
properties.description: Develops standard language for interpreting environmental data with faunal communities into habitat representations. Updates scientific knowledge, creates digital resource, harmonizes with IOC-UNESCO IODE Ocean InfoHub globally.
properties.funder: United States Interagency Working Group on Ocean and Coastal Mapping (IWG-OCM)

properties.title: OBIS 2030 – The biodiversity data hub for the Ocean Decade Actions
properties.description: Global biodiversity data hub providing standardized, quality-controlled marine data for decision makers to protect ocean ecosystems. Improves data flow, creates information products, supports Digital Twin development.

properties.title: Kelp Forest Challenge
properties.description: Global mission to protect and restore 4 million hectares of kelp forests by 2040. Grassroots initiative enabling governments, businesses, NGOs, and individuals to join conservation efforts for ocean health and equity.

properties.title: SanctuaryReef Food Basket: Empowering Aquafarmers
properties.description: Zanzibar seaweed farmers grow shellfish supplemented with low-voltage electric stimulation (2-15V DC) to boost growth rates and heat tolerance, testing climate adaptation for aquaculture while analyzing economic viability.

properties.title: The Grass Underwater Project
properties.description: Monitors, restores & conserves seagrass meadows & mangroves in Tanzania. Provides ocean literacy to coastal communities, empowers via sustainable blue economy, promotes sustainable ocean resource use. 2020-2030.

properties.title: Nord Observations and Research on Marine Life
properties.description: Nord University monitors marine biodiversity in Arctic & N Atlantic using conventional & new tech (webcams, eDNA, citizen science). Data published via OBIS for researchers & public. Covers zooplankton, benthos, multiple habitats.

properties.title: Ocean Online – web-based information platform
properties.description: Science-based info portal on marine topics by German Marine Research Alliance. AI-supported search for sustainable ocean use, climate, ecosystems. Targets decision-makers & public. Covers all ocean basins. Focus: capacity & behavior change.

properties.title: Portuguese Coastal Monitoring Network (CoastNet)
properties.description: Real-time coastal monitoring system tracking chemical, physical & biological variables along Portuguese coast. Provides open-access data to improve understanding of coastal ecosystem functioning & variability (2016-2027).

properties.title: Monitoring of the Deep-Sea Organisms for MPAs
properties.description: Survey deep-sea biodiversity in Japanese EEZ and high seas to establish 30%+ ocean MPAs/OECMs. Inventing monitoring devices to understand deep-sea organisms. Data shared with Japanese Ministry of Environment for MPA designation.

properties.title: Somos OceanoS: Ocean stories for conservation
properties.description: Promotes community perspectives on marine management, raises awareness of ecological, social & economic value of MPAs worldwide through accessible science communication. Works with Marine Life 2030, ECOP & Empowering Women programmes.

properties.title: Submersible Technology to Advance Reef Science
properties.description: Citizen science scuba divers collect ocean data via low-cost CTD-L devices attached to gear. Network shares observations openly for coastal monitoring, research & conservation. Global scaling planned beyond 2027.

properties.title: Migravías: Connecting marine protected areas (MPAs) through ocean swimways to protect migratory routes and critical habitats of endangered species
properties.description: Protects endangered migratory marine species by creating 6 protected swimways linking MPAs in Eastern Pacific. Involves transboundary data collection, management, enforcement. Builds climate resilience 2021-2031.

properties.title: Baffin Bay Oceanography and Biodiversity
properties.description: Surveys and tracking of marine species in Baffin Bay to monitor ecosystem conditions, biodiversity, and climate change impacts. Collects oceanographic and biological data to inform management decisions on fishing and shipping.

properties.title: TAC Pollutants Observatory
properties.description: Regional pollution observatory for Western Tropical Atlantic. Creates contaminant inventory, baseline database to assess pollutants & climate change impacts on marine life. Coordinates transboundary monitoring & publishes open data.

properties.title: Northeast Pacific Deep-sea Exploration Project
properties.description: Studies NE Pacific deep-sea biodiversity (seamounts, vents, seeps) to guide conservation strategies. UN Ocean Decade endorsed. Grassroots collaboration with Indigenous nations, scientists. Supports 30x30 goals. 2023-2030.

properties.title: One Ocean Hub Research Programme 4
properties.description: Deep-sea biodiversity surveys in South-East Atlantic. Assesses multiple stressors on vulnerable marine ecosystems. Co-produces modeling to predict species distribution and threats for management scenarios. Capacity building focus.

properties.title: Textile X Ocean Connector Project
properties.description: Addresses textile-ocean sustainability through experiential learning in San Francisco. Tackles microfiber pollution, climate change via sailing programs, expert talks, research demos. Connects 150+ annual participants across sectors.

properties.title: High Resolution Seafloor Habitat Mapping – WIO
properties.description: Maps Western Indian Ocean seafloor habitats using machine learning, acoustics & biological data to support fisheries management in Mozambique, Kenya & Tanzania. Assesses vulnerabilities, human impacts & conservation needs.

properties.title: NE Pacific Coastal Biodiversity Action Network
properties.description: Network fostering cross-boundary biodiversity science for marine conservation in NE Pacific. Co-develops Essential Biodiversity Variables, best practices, and analysis for conservation actions across Canada-US border.

properties.title: Reconstructing Biological Carbon Pump with Ancient Plankton DNA (BIOCAP)
properties.description: Uses ancient plankton DNA from sediment cores in North Atlantic and Nordic Seas to reconstruct biological carbon pump back to Last Interglacial, revealing how climate change affects ocean carbon sequestration and global warming.

properties.title: Welfare-Conscious Capture & Slaughter of Atlantic Bluefin Tuna in Norwegian Rod & Line Fishery
properties.description: Improves animal welfare in Norwegian Atlantic bluefin tuna rod-and-line fisheries. Addresses welfare impacts, handling practices, fish behavior, and bycatch to enhance sustainability and product quality through individual catch methods.

properties.title: LIFEDEEPER - Vulnerability of the Deep Sea Facing Exploitation
properties.description: Studies TAG & Snake Pit hydrothermal fields at 3600m depth to develop ecological preservation strategies for deep seabed ecosystems facing mineral resource exploitation through multidisciplinary research.

properties.title: Deep-Ocean Genomes Program
properties.description: Uses next-gen sequencing & comparative genomics to understand organization, evolution, functions & interactions of deep ocean life in Earth's least-understood regions. Covers all ocean basins 2022-2032.

properties.title: Detection of Undersea Features
properties.description: Seabed 2030 project using AI to detect 40 types of undersea features, develop S-100 specifications, and create a database of unnamed features to inform ecosystem management and marine conservation.

properties.title: Present and Past Climate Change Impacts on Norwegian Fjord Ecosystems (PASTIME)
properties.description: Studies climate/anthropogenic impacts on fjord microbial communities using paleogenomics in Norwegian Masfjorden & Svalbard Kongsfjorden. Analyzes sediment DNA from past 2-4 centuries to trace ecosystem changes.

properties.title: MACHC-IOCARIBE Seabed 2030 Project
properties.description: Creating accurate bathymetric map of Tropical Americas & Caribbean through partnerships. Essential for sustainable ocean use, disaster risk reduction, environmental management. Region vulnerable to climate change & hurricanes.

properties.title: Characterizing Migratory Strategies of Atlantic Lumpfish (ECOLUMP)
properties.description: Studies Atlantic lumpfish migration patterns & population structure using genetics, microchemistry & telemetry to identify resident vs migratory ecotypes, supporting fisheries management for roe & salmon aquaculture cleaner fish.

properties.title: Women, heritage and navigation in the Pacific
properties.description: Uses maritime archaeology to investigate Indigenous women's role in Pacific Islands ocean activities, highlighting their knowledge for environmental security, climate change, and sustainable ocean use.

properties.title: Empower Ocean
properties.description: Female empowerment initiative providing dive and marine conservation training for local women in coral reef communities to become ocean guardians. Addresses ecosystem protection, capacity development, and behavior change in Indian Ocean.

properties.title: Sea Academy+
properties.description: Expands marine protected areas, restores mangroves & coral reefs, develops sustainable livelihoods for fisherfolks, raises awareness in schools, and supports research in Taytay, Philippines to address biodiversity loss and food insecurity.

properties.title: Decade Coordination Office for the Western Pacific
properties.description: Coordinates Ocean Decade Actions across Western Pacific region. Creates synergies between existing actions, catalyzes new initiatives, monitors progress. Hosted by IOC-WESTPAC Thailand, covers all Ocean Decade Challenges.

properties.title: Towards Eco-Env-Social Sustainability in Norwegian Salmon Farming Rebalance
properties.description: Examines economic, environmental & social dimensions of Norwegian salmon farming. Addresses sea lice, waste, fish escape & feed issues while strengthening local value creation through stakeholder analysis & policy exploration 2024-2027.

properties.title: Colombia Ocean-Climate Innovation Hub
properties.description: Restores ocean & tackles climate change via innovation in bi-oceanic Colombia. Fosters public-private-academic collaboration for carbon removal, restorative aquaculture, ocean literacy & sustainable development solutions.
properties.funder: Laboratorio De Biologia Molecular Marina Biommar

properties.title: UNESCO Chair OceanExpert
properties.description: Promotes integrated ocean science education, literacy & sustainable economy. Research on ocean governance, training for disadvantaged groups, global network hub connecting UNESCO Chairs across continents.

properties.title: Sistema de Información Oceanográfica CHONOS
properties.description: Oceanographic web platform for Chilean Patagonia delivering forecasts & monitoring to balance environmental, conservation & productive interests. MOSA model provides daily physical variable forecasts for sustainable development.
properties.funder: Chilean Ministry of Economy, Development, and Tourism

properties.title: Impact of Black Carbon in South-East Asia (SOOT-SEA)
properties.description: Studies black carbon (soot) pollution from combustion entering oceans via atmosphere and rivers in SE Asia. Improves emission inventories, measures fluxes, and assesses marine ecosystem impacts. Addresses climate change and marine pollution.
properties.funder: National Research Institute for Sustainable Development (IRD)

properties.title: Climate-smart strategies to develop resilience in artisanal fisheries of Mediterranean Marine Protected Areas (CLISSARTES)
properties.description: Develops adaptive strategies for climate-smart MPA management in Mediterranean. Assesses climate risk, connectivity, vulnerability of commercial species & socio-economic costs in artisanal fisheries. Led by IEO-CSIC Spain.

properties.title: Bioregional Resilience: Professional CRM Planning
properties.description: Capacitation & certification for socio-ecological sustainability & food security across North Philippine Sea. Marine Spatial Food Security Planning for fisherfolk & 10M beneficiaries in 10 provinces. Model for 5 Philippine Bioregions.

properties.title: Trophic Cascades in Coastal Ecosystems (CASCADES)
properties.description: Uncovers ecological connections between marine and terrestrial environments in Norway and Scotland, examining how fishing pressure, invasive species, and native predators shape coastal ecosystem dynamics for sustainable management.

properties.title: Solent Seascape Project (SSP)
properties.description: Five-year initiative restoring saltmarsh, seagrass, oyster reefs & seabird sites in the Solent estuary (Isle of Wight-England). Ten organizations collaborate with communities to create thriving seascape & recovery plan.

properties.title: Pan-Arctic Distributed Biological Observatory
properties.description: Network documenting Arctic ecosystem responses to environmental changes through standardized physical, chemical & biological sampling across Pacific, Atlantic, Canadian Arctic & Siberian seas, tracking sea ice decline & warming impacts.
properties.funder: University of Maryland Center for Environmental Science and Chesapeake Biological Laboratory

properties.title: Uncrewed Surface Vehicle Network for GOOS (USV Network for GOOS)
properties.description: Global network coordinating uncrewed surface vehicles to observe air-sea interactions, fluxes & ecosystems across all ocean basins, including remote areas. Supports climate prediction & ocean understanding through 2030.

properties.title: Developing Best Handling Practices with Fishers - SafeTurtles
properties.description: Training fishers along Pacific American coast in best handling & release practices for sea turtles caught as by-catch, adapting techniques to specific fisheries to reduce post-release mortality, particularly in surface longline fisheries.

properties.title: Blue Links Conservation
properties.description: Mentorship program pairing early career conservation professionals with seasoned experts in Western Indian Ocean SIDS. Enhances capacity in ocean management, science, and governance through knowledge exchange and support networks.

properties.title: Plankton and Planktivory in a Changing Climate (PELAGIC)
properties.description: Studies how ocean warming and browning affect plankton communities and planktivore fish (herring, sprat, mackerel) in coastal waters. Examines prey quality changes and ecological shifts in pelagic food webs under climate stress.

properties.title: Plastic Mop-up
properties.description: Retrieves discarded PET bottles from landfills, drainage channels & aquatic environments in Nigeria. Empowers participants (esp. females) as surveyors/collectors. Supplies plastics to recyclers for reuse in textiles/building.

properties.title: Seafood FREE Seafood: Fishery Resource Ecosystem Engineering
properties.description: Rebuilding collapsed large yellow croaker population in East China Sea through seeding, augmentation, conservation, production, assessment & monitoring to recover species from IUCN CR status after 40 years of overfishing.

properties.title: Yagarrajalajalan Nagula Buru
properties.description: Integrates Indigenous Knowledge & Western Science for co-management of marine parks in northern Australia. Maps human & conservation values, develops management strategies, ensures equitable knowledge sharing with Traditional Owners (2023-2027).

properties.title: Non-invasive Biological Warning Systems (BIOWASYS)
properties.description: Develops non-invasive sensor systems and automated monitoring for salmon farm welfare using behavioral analysis. Monitors 3D environmental conditions and pathogen distribution in sea cages to detect fish health impacts.

properties.title: Vaka Oceanstory Lab
properties.description: Traditional Polynesian sailing canoes serve as platforms uniting Indigenous knowledge holders and scientists for marine research, ocean literacy, and ecosystem management across Pacific communities during 2024-2026.

properties.title: Anthropogenic Impacts of Climate Change & Fisheries on High Latitude Marine Fishers (ANTHROCOD)
properties.description: Studies climate change & fishing impacts on Atlantic cod reproduction across latitudes. Investigates atypical spawning shifts from spring to autumn due to warming, comparing cod, haddock & herring reproductive biology.

properties.title: Blue School Portugal
properties.description: Educational programme improving ocean literacy in Portuguese schools since 2017. Certifies schools working on ocean issues through interdisciplinary strategies, engaging students, teachers, families & communities for ocean sustainability.

properties.title: Study of Recent Behaviour of Cyclones and Marine Heatwaves
properties.description: Examines cyclones & marine heatwaves in Bay of Bengal using ERA5 datasets, analyzing temperature data & El Niño relationships to understand tropical cyclone impacts on Bangladesh coastal areas for sustainable development.
properties.funder: National Oceanographic and Maritime Institute – Bangladesh

properties.title: Global network to monitor marine plastic pollution (IAEA – NUTEC Marine Plastics)
properties.description: IAEA builds global lab network to track marine microplastics using nuclear tech. Provides equipment, training, harmonized methods to monitor plastic pollution pathways, impacts on ecosystems and seafood across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Integrated Ocean Carbon Observing System (IOCOS)
properties.description: Global ocean carbon monitoring system tracking CO2 uptake (25% of atmospheric emissions). Delivers data on ocean carbon sink behavior to inform climate mitigation costs. Completed 2021-2023. All ocean basins.

properties.title: Ocean Decade Odyssey
properties.description: Enhances Global Ocean Observing System by deploying autonomous instruments (floats, drifters, CO2 sensors) from ocean races, NGOs & private vessels. Coordinates observations in under-sampled areas globally. 2021-2030.

properties.title: CIIMAR na Escola / CIIMAR at School
properties.description: Ocean literacy education program for Portuguese-speaking students. Provides free experimental protocols, field activities, and lectures to bridge scientific and school communities. Supports Blue School and UNESCO OceanExpert Chair.

properties.title: Integrated Ocean Observing Across the Northwest Atlantic
properties.description: Interconnected system tracking environmental change from Arctic to Gulf of Maine. Monitors climate-driven changes, species distribution shifts, marine carbon stores. Multinational partnership model for ocean observation.
properties.funder: North-eastern Regional Association of Coastal Ocean Observing Systems (NERACOOS)

properties.title: Ocean Monitoring and Prediction Network for the Sustainable Development of the Gulf of Mexico and the Caribbean (OMPNETGC)
properties.description: Network of ocean observation systems and forecasting models for Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean. Assesses vulnerability of species/habitats to oil spills, deoxygenation, acidification, warming. Builds capacity for sustainable ocean development.
properties.funder: Consorcio de Investigación del Golfo de México (CIGOM)

properties.title: Nutrient Pollution Global Action Network
properties.description: Addresses nutrient & wastewater pollution from agrochemical runoff & sewage. Develops monitoring tools, guidelines & mitigation solutions for marine ecosystems & human health across temperate & tropical systems globally.

properties.title: Synchro: Co-Design for Technology Evolution
properties.description: Co-design lab and test bed in Monterey Bay accelerating ocean observing tools from prototype to operational use in management. Focuses on cross-walking technologies to broader data acceptance and user inclusion across full lifecycle.

properties.title: Coastal Observatory for Climate, CO2 and Acidification for the Global South Society (COCAS)
properties.description: Implements coastal observatories in Global South EEZs to assess marine environmental changes, CO2, and acidification impacts on biodiversity. Creates science-based decision support for sustainable coastal management through 2030.

properties.title: Blue Carbon for Sustainable Development
properties.description: Mainstreaming blue carbon in Kenya's climate agenda by conserving mangroves, seagrass, tidal marshes. Reduces degradation, improves fisheries, creates jobs, protects shorelines, alleviates poverty through sustainable coastal development.

properties.title: Animal-Borne Ocean Sensors (AniBOS): A Decadal Vision Through New Eyes
properties.description: Bio-logging network deploying sensors on marine animals to collect oceanographic data in polar and tropical oceans. Integrates animal-collected data into GOOS to improve climate prediction and animal behavior monitoring.

properties.title: Unraveling the dynamics of ocean soundscapes
properties.description: Develops AI tools to classify underwater sound data for species assessment & ocean monitoring. Uses passive acoustic monitoring across Arctic, N Atlantic & N Pacific. Advances ocean understanding through standardized data products.

properties.title: Zooniverse People-Powered Research
properties.description: Global citizen science platform engaging 2.5M volunteers in ocean research. Projects include kelp mapping, fish monitoring, dolphin vocalization, penguin counting, and plankton annotation across all ocean basins.

properties.title: National Best Practices for Marine Monitoring
properties.description: Develops national standards for monitoring Australia's marine estate using drop cameras, socioeconomic surveys, and microplastics monitoring. Creates implementation plan with Indigenous partnerships for sustainable ocean practices.

properties.title: FRDC Circular Economy Project
properties.description: Cross-sector initiative identifying circular opportunities in Australian fishing/aquaculture. Develops stakeholder capacity, showcases success stories to increase circularity adoption, improve ocean outcomes through waste reduction.

properties.title: F3 – Future of Fish Feed
properties.description: Promotes innovative alternatives to wild-caught forage fish in aquafeed (algae, insect meals, single cell proteins) to protect ocean ecosystems and food security. Runs challenges, networking, research sponsorship globally.

properties.title: MYTOXA
properties.description: Investigates emerging mycotoxins in salmon feed affecting fish health post-seawater transfer. Studies enniatin impacts on smolt robustness and growth through feeding trials across production cycle to set safe limits.

properties.title: Global Ocean Biodiversity Initiative
properties.description: International partnership advancing scientific basis for marine biodiversity conservation. Provides expertise, data and tools to identify ecologically significant marine areas (EBSAs) and enhance ocean protection and sustainable use.

properties.title: Global Ocean Decade Programme for Blue Carbon
properties.description: Enhances ocean-climate understanding, generates climate mitigation solutions through blue carbon ecosystems across estuarine-coastal-open ocean environments. Promotes nature-based solutions, global collaboration, capacity building. 2022-2030.

properties.title: FAIR Data in the UN Ocean Decade in Support of Integrated Ecosystem Assessment (FAIROD)
properties.description: Builds capacity and tools for place-based integrated ecosystem assessments. Strengthens global ocean data collection, curation, and integration to enable quantitative assessments for sustainable ocean management across all ocean basins.

properties.title: The Hidden Toll of Lice - HITLICE
properties.description: Studies salmon lice impact on wild Atlantic salmon in Norway through field/lab experiments and modeling to determine tolerance thresholds and improve marine survival estimates amid fish farming expansion.

properties.title: Community Engaged Ocean Science in Canada
properties.description: Co-designing ocean science with coastal & Indigenous communities in Canada to ensure research contributes to sustainable development. Explores community co-design models, Indigenous knowledge systems integration for marine resource use.

properties.title: Ocean Community: Engaging through best practices
properties.description: Develops interoperable ocean observation methods adapted to local capabilities in under-resourced regions. Engages experts, early career scientists, and Indigenous knowledge holders to standardize coastal monitoring globally.
properties.funder: Institut français de recherche pour l'exploitation de la mer (IFREMER)

properties.title: Ocean Literacy Toolkit for Governments
properties.description: Toolkit supporting countries, policymakers, educators to develop ocean literacy in classrooms and formal education curricula. Provides free teaching resources for localizing ocean education globally.

properties.title: From climate drivers to Antarctic ice sheet response: Improving accuracy in sea level rise projections
properties.description: Models Antarctic ice sheet melting & sea level rise using ocean-climate coupling. Focuses on basal melting, snowfall in Dronning Maud Land. Combines oceanography, glaciology, downscaling to reduce projection uncertainties.

properties.title: Tsunami Potential Coastal Area of Indonesia, Mountain Anak Krakatau, Banten, Sunda Strait, Indonesia
properties.description: Tsunami modeling based on bathymetric surveys to reconstruct the 2018 Anak Krakatau volcanic tsunami in Sunda Strait and inform future mitigation for Banten and Lampung coastal areas.
