properties.funder: Agency of Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics – Indonesia

properties.title: INCT Biodiversity of the Blue Amazon (INCT-BAA)
properties.description: Brazilian network mapping ocean biodiversity for conservation & sustainable use. Conducts research, trains marine scientists, produces educational content. Focuses on South Atlantic ecosystem protection & blue economy.
properties.funder: National Science and Technology Institute on Biodiversity of the Blue Amazon – Brazil

properties.title: Surfside Science
properties.description: Co-develops low-cost coastal monitoring methods for SIDS using remote sensing & electronics. Tests air/water quality, coastal change & seafloor mapping in Aruba's Surfside Bay. Openly shares replicable protocols for island communities.

properties.title: Canadian Ocean Acidification Community of Practice
properties.description: Interdisciplinary group sharing ocean acidification info across Canada. Connects gov, aquaculture, fisheries, academia, Indigenous leaders. Coordinates expertise, data, resources to address acidification impacts.

properties.title: Kinship-based assessment of Norwegian coastal cod to determine sustainable harvest levels and protect genetic diversity in fisheries (COASTAL-KIN)
properties.description: Uses genomic kinship analysis to estimate Norwegian coastal cod populations, improving fisheries management precision and protecting genetic diversity. Develops close kin mark recapture methods for sustainable harvest levels.

properties.title: Intelligent Coastal Urban Bay CO2 Emission Studies (iCUBES)
properties.description: 3D marine monitoring system for Pearl River estuary & global bays. Addresses algal blooms, oxygen depletion. Supports carbon neutrality in coastal-urban areas. Collaborates with Argentina, India, Pakistan, Spain, Saudi Arabia.

properties.title: HubSmolt: Novel Genetic Locus Atlantic Salmon
properties.description: Optimizes freshwater rearing for Atlantic salmon by studying a genetic locus affecting smoltification, gill development, and seawater survival. Combines photoperiod protocols, multi-tissue sampling, and virus challenges to improve aquaculture.

properties.title: Fisheries Strategies for Changing Oceans and Resilient Ecosystems by 2030 (FishSCORE 2030)
properties.description: Global programme developing frameworks to assess fishery vulnerabilities, determine climate adaptation options, and enhance resilience for marine fisheries through scientist-practitioner partnerships.

properties.title: Pacific Coral Reef Action Science and Knowledge
properties.description: Builds resilience of Pacific coral reefs through 8 action areas: capacity building, traditional knowledge, education, collaboration, habitat conservation, restoration science, fisheries management, and research monitoring.
properties.funder: Secretariat of the Pacific Regional Environmental Programme

properties.title: Ocean to Climate Seamless Forecasting System (OSF)
properties.description: Improves ocean-climate forecasting via satellites, drifting buoys, air-sea interaction theories, and multi-hazard early warning systems. Focuses on ocean-climate nexus, observations, and knowledge exchange with SIDS/LDCs.
properties.funder: First Institute of Oceanography (FIO), Ministry of Natural Resources – China

properties.title: Scripps Ecological Observatory
properties.description: Modern observational program at Scripps Pier using automated microscopy, molecular sampling, and gas analysis to create high-resolution records of environmental variables for modeling marine ecosystem dynamics and predicting change.

properties.title: Ocean to climate seamless forecasting in Africa
properties.description: Improves ocean-climate forecasting in Africa (minutes to years) via buoys, satellites, ultra-high resolution systems, and intra-annual prediction to forecast monsoons, precipitation, and extreme events like cyclones and marine heatwaves.
properties.funder: Institut de Recherches Halieutiques et Océanologiques du Bénin (IRHOB)

properties.title: Protecting at least 30% of the ocean by 2030 (MPA 2030)
properties.description: Provides knowledge to aid countries in achieving 30% ocean protection by 2030. MPAs protect biodiversity, support food security, sustainable development, and fisheries under climate change across global ocean basins.

properties.title: European Marine Omics Biodiversity Observation Network (EMO BON)
properties.description: Network of 16 marine stations from Arctic to Red Sea sampling genomic marine biodiversity. Establishes coordinated long-term observation framework generating open-access genomic data for holistic ocean understanding.

properties.title: High-resolution sea ice forecast in ARCtic routes (HiARC)
properties.description: Predicting snow/ice in Northeast & Northwest Passages (hours to years). Collects air-snow-ice-ocean data, develops high-res forecasting, uses AI for risk assessment, serves Arctic shipping & local communities. 2024-2030.

properties.title: Naples Ecological Research Augmented Observatory (NEREA)
properties.description: Augments Marechiara LTER in Gulf of Naples since 1983. Uses moorings, seabed platforms, cruises across pollution gradients. Applies genomics, imaging, microplastics sampling to develop ocean health indicators and microbiome models.

properties.title: Observing and Promoting Atlantic Microbiomes
properties.description: Atlantic Ocean Marine Microbiome Working Group studies marine microbiomes driving biogeochemical cycles and food webs. Canada, EU, and USA collaborate on biomolecular observing network for biodiscovery and climate regulation.
properties.funder: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO), Atlantic Ocean Marine Microbiome Working Group

properties.title: Development of a Warning System for Predicting the Risk of Formation of Intense Atmospheric Vortices of Various Spatial and Temporal Scales (Water Tornadoes, Polar Mesocyclones) Over the Seas of the A
properties.description: Automated system forecasting waterspouts & polar cyclones over Arctic & mid-latitude seas using radar, satellite data & weather models. Develops adaptive algorithms for risk prediction. Enhances marine safety & community resilience.
properties.funder: Research and Production Association "Typhoon" (RPA "Typhoon") – Russian Federation

properties.title: Protecting the Estuaries of the WIO Region
properties.description: Study anthropogenic & climate impacts on West Indian Ocean estuaries to develop protection recommendations. Estuaries are nurseries for marine life, fragile habitats dependent on salt-freshwater balance. 2021-2030.
properties.funder: School of Aquatic Sciences and Fisheries Technology, University of Dar es Salaam

properties.title: Pacific Ocean Pathways in Support of Sustainable Development (PACPATH)
properties.description: Trans-disciplinary network for Pacific Islands stakeholders addressing climate change impacts on ocean ecosystems in Fiji and New Caledonia. Co-constructs science-based solutions with local communities for SDG14 achievement.

properties.title: Hakai Institute Biomolecular Observing Network
properties.description: Network using genetic assessments to monitor marine biodiversity (fish, invertebrates, microbes) across British Columbia coast. Monthly sampling at 20+ sites creates baselines, tracks changes, provides remote area data for conservation.

properties.title: WCO Biomolecular Observing Network
properties.description: Builds on 100+ years of biological observations in Western English Channel (Plymouth, UK). Combines DNA sampling with autonomous tech to map biodiversity and predict biological function for sustainable ocean management.

properties.title: Threatened and migratory marine species science
properties.description: SPREP's Regional Marine Species Programme 2022-2026 conserves 5 priority groups (whales, dolphins, turtles, dugong, sharks, rays, seabirds) across Pacific through research, monitoring, threat reduction, habitat protection, and capacity building.
properties.funder: Secretariat for the Pacific Environment Programme

properties.title: Pacific Solutions to Save Our Ocean
properties.description: Integrated ocean science programme for Blue Pacific. Builds capacity, decision support systems for ocean management. Addresses climate change, ecosystem protection. Led by SPC across Pacific nations 2021-2030.

properties.title: Climate-Resilient Marine Spatial Planning Project
properties.description: Supporting Pacific Island countries in developing sustainable blue economies via Marine Spatial Planning. Focuses on Palau with regional capacity-building for Pacific nations, aligned with 2050 Blue Pacific Strategy.

properties.title: National Biodiversity DNA Library (NBDL)
properties.description: Creates DNA reference sequences for Australian marine species from museum specimens. Focuses on whole mitochondrial genomes for marine vertebrates. Enables eDNA biomonitoring transformation across Australian waters through online portal.
properties.funder: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO)

properties.title: Global Estuaries Monitoring (GEM) Programme
properties.description: Global network monitoring contaminants in urbanized estuaries worldwide. Develops standard methods, builds capacity, identifies pollution hotspots, recommends controls for cleaner estuaries globally.
properties.funder: State Key Laboratory of Marine Pollution, City University of Hong Kong

properties.title: Pacific eDNA Coastal Observatory
properties.description: Network tracking marine biodiversity using eDNA across Alaska to S. California (26° latitude). Combines molecular monitoring with visual surveys to predict ocean biodiversity changes and inform management during 2021-2029.

properties.title: Ocean Census
properties.description: Global alliance accelerating marine biodiversity discovery through expeditions, species documentation, and taxonomy. Targets 100,000 new species over 10 years. Builds international network for ocean conservation.

properties.title: Citizens of Surf
properties.description: Equips 35M+ surfers globally as citizen scientists monitoring climate indicators, microplastics & biodiversity in surfing zones. Tests data collection methodology while tracking Ocean Literacy engagement 2023-2029.

properties.title: Digital Deep-sea Typical Habitats
properties.description: Digital DEPTH studies 4 deep-sea habitats (seamounts, ridges, slopes, plains) using advanced tech to observe, simulate & map. Builds digital platform for conservation & sustainable development. Shares knowledge with SIDS/LDCs.

properties.title: The Hydrous Presents: The Decade of Ocean Empathy
properties.description: Brings empathy & creative problem-solving into marine conservation via immersive virtual ocean media, ocean literacy research, & international ocean solutionist fellows. Leverages human-centered design & emerging tech for ocean connection.

properties.title: J-DESC IODP Literacy Initiative
properties.description: Japanese scientific drilling consortium promoting ocean literacy through workshops, training, and expeditions. Advances understanding of climate change, earthquakes, tsunamis via sediment cores. Targets scientists, students, public.

properties.title: Costa Rica and Honduras Collective Action for the Implementation of the Voluntary Guidelines for the Sustainability of Small Scale Fishing
properties.description: Strengthening small-scale fisheries organizations on Pacific and Caribbean coasts of Costa Rica and Honduras through capacity building on tenure rights, responsible fishing, gender approach, and climate adaptation for sustainable blue food.

properties.title: The Science We Need for the Mediterranean Sea We Want (SciNMeet)
properties.description: Addresses Mediterranean challenges: climate change, pollution, overexploitation, marine hazards. Improves ecosystem functioning, sustainability. Mobilizes scientific community, policymakers, private sector. Includes ocean literacy, marine litter club

properties.title: Red de Tecnologías para el Océano
properties.description: Accelerates marine tech capacity in Costa Rica/region. Provides free oceanographic data for sustainable development. Installs ocean observing tech, promotes data access for coastal communities. Caribbean & N Pacific.

properties.title: NASA Sea Level Change Science Team
properties.description: Interdisciplinary sea level science analyzing observational evidence, quantifying causes, producing future projections. Studies ice sheet dynamics, ocean processes, mass loss impacts on coastal cities, vertical land motion since 2014.

properties.title: Enhancing Ocean Observing System within the Republic of Mauritius
properties.description: Mauritius Meteorological Services expands ocean monitoring network with additional tidal gauges, wave riders, drifters & ARGO floats. Develops ocean services for fishermen, staff capacity building & research tools for hazard warnings.

properties.title: Fisherman Weather Field School (SLCN)
properties.description: Ocean literacy program educating fishing communities in Indonesia, Fiji, Philippines on weather/climate forecasting to improve safety and protect ocean observation equipment. Targets traditional fishermen, aquaculture, salt farmers since 2016.
properties.funder: Agency for Meteorology Climatology and Geophysics (BMKG) – Indonesia

properties.title: Ocean Observing Co-Design: Evolving Ocean Observing for a Sustainable Future
properties.description: Global program building infrastructure for integrated ocean observing system. Tracks ocean state, enables predictions, manages resources. Co-designs agile observing/modelling to match requirements for sustainable ocean by 2030.

properties.title: Global Ocean Oxygen Decade
properties.description: Addresses ocean deoxygenation through global awareness, research, and solutions. Develops mitigation strategies for ecosystem services and ocean economy impacts via transdisciplinary research and education.

properties.title: Blue Climate Initiative – Solutions for People, Ocean, Planet
properties.description: Scientists, communities, engineers & investors collaborate on science-based programs protecting ocean & using its power to tackle climate change, renewable energy, sustainable food & resilient economies across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Observing Together: Meeting Stakeholder Needs and Making Observation Count
properties.description: Transforms ocean data access by connecting observers and communities through co-design. Leverages GOOS network to deliver decision-ready observations and forecasts to community users globally, making every observation count.

properties.title: Institutional Capacity Building Towards the Sustainability of Ocean Science in Light of COVID-19 Pandemic
properties.description: Enhances capacity to monitor coastal areas & marine litter during COVID-19. Develops baseline measurements of litter production in Tanzania to improve management through government, community & NGO collaboration.

properties.title: Marine Life 2030
properties.description: Global network uniting technologies & partners to observe & forecast marine life, delivering knowledge for ocean conservation, sustainable development & human well-being through 2030. Builds capacity across all ocean basins.
properties.funder: Marine Biodiversity Observation Network (MBON) and National Oceanographic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)

properties.title: Research Program for Climate Action Planning (CLAP)
properties.description: Develops ocean-atmosphere models for climate projections in Coquimbo coastal region. Creates socio-ecological models to quantify ocean services and ecosystem-based management strategies for near-term to end-of-century timescales.
properties.funder: CEAZA (Center for Advanced Studies in Arid Zones)

properties.title: Surfer Scientists
properties.description: Indonesian youth conduct benthic transect sampling at surf breaks to monitor coastal ecosystems, promoting science literacy and sustainable blue economy through accessible community-led habitat conservation (2023-2028).

properties.title: Connecting communities to Atlantic Ocean observing
properties.description: AtlantOS-connect builds Atlantic basin-scale ocean observing by fostering partnerships among user communities, observing networks, and data systems to deliver climate change information to stakeholders and policymakers across the Atlantic.

properties.title: Biodiversity in Northern European Seagrass Meadows (NORSE)
properties.description: Studies how climate change, nutrients, overfishing & invasive species affect seagrass biodiversity across northern Europe (2024-2027). Uses field data & experiments to inform conservation & restoration management.

properties.title: LCC The Climate Academy x The Ocean Decade Brief
properties.description: Connects ocean science with arts & creative education to address ocean communication challenges. Supports UN Ocean Decade Challenge 10 to change humanity's relationship with the ocean. Jan-Apr 2024, London.

properties.title: Baltic Sea Oxygenation and Super-Green H2
properties.description: Tackles anoxia in Baltic Sea by injecting oxygen from green hydrogen production below halocline. Pilot demonstration to restore benthic habitat, reduce phosphorus loading, suppress algae blooms. Addresses internal nutrient loading legacy.

properties.title: Digital Innovation Hand-in-Hand with Fisheries and Ecosystems Scientific Monitoring
properties.description: FAO creates Fisheries & Environmental Atlas using Open Data/Science for fisheries monitoring. Includes country profiles, environmental maps, FAIR data analysis. Works with countries & RFBs to track fisheries state, impacts, management for SDGs.
properties.funder: Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations

properties.title: Future Arctic Mobilities: Informing Transportation Adaptation Through Climate Observations and Model Projections of Changing Snow and Ice
properties.description: Forecasts marine shipping routes & winter trails in Canadian Arctic under warming scenarios. Provides climate projections of snow, ice, temperature to inform community adaptation for safe transportation & food security.

properties.title: GO-SHIP Evolve
properties.description: Global ship-based ocean surveys measuring climate, biology & ecosystem health across all ocean basins. Provides real-time data, calibration services & capacity building. 2021-2030.

properties.title: Popular Observatory of the Sea Amazon Coast
properties.description: Coastal observatory integrating remote sensing & citizen science to analyze vulnerability, support decision-making & formulate climate adaptation policies for Amazon River Mouth region. 2022-2030.

properties.title: EU4OceanObs
properties.description: Catalyst for UN Ocean Decade cooperation between UNESCO-IOC and EU Commission. Promotes international dialogue, strengthens ocean observing/forecasting, supports DCCs/DCOs, advances data standards. Oct 2023-Oct 2027.
properties.funder: European Commission DG Research and Innovation

properties.title: Protection and Sustainable Use of Marine Areas - sustainMare
properties.description: 250+ researchers study ecological, economic & social impacts of human use in North & Baltic Sea (German EEZ). Develops sustainable use options for marine resources to achieve EU Good Environmental Status by 2027.

properties.title: The Cozumel Coral Conservatory
properties.description: Coral restoration in Cozumel, Mexico using STEAM approach. Coalition preserves/grows corals, increases biodiversity at Villa Blanca Reef through artificial structures, science education. Rehabilitates Mesoamerican Barrier Reef.

properties.title: Ocean Vision AI: Scaling Up Marine Life Observing
properties.description: FathomNet hub scales marine life observation using AI, imaging networks, and open data to advance ocean biological monitoring through distributed systems and public engagement. Runs 2021-2030.

properties.title: The Ocean Decade Tsunami Programme
properties.description: Global tsunami early warning system enhancing detection, forecasting, and community preparedness. Focuses on SIDS/LDCs, ocean observations, Tsunami Ready communities, and critical infrastructure protection through 2030.

properties.title: IceDivA
properties.description: Samples Northwest & Northeast Atlantic deep-sea basins (3000-5500m) to map species diversity, connectivity along latitudinal gradients. Extends IceAGE program, links with DIVA & Southern Ocean projects using genomic & morphological methods.

properties.title: Empowering Women in Hydrography
properties.description: Enables women to participate equitably in hydrography and reach leadership roles through awareness campaigns, mentoring networks, training, and symposiums. Coordinated by IHO with Canada, Norway, UK participation. 2021-2026.

properties.title: Typhoon Forecast and Response in Northwest Pacific (TFRiN)
properties.description: Improves typhoon intensity forecasting in NW Pacific through international cooperation, data sharing, wind-wave-current coupling models, and disaster response policy. Addresses casualties and economic losses from tropical cyclones.

properties.title: Ocean Acoustics Education and Expertise
properties.description: Surveys stakeholders on ocean acoustics needs, documents training opportunities, identifies expertise gaps, and recommends capabilities for sustainable development goals. Covers all ocean basins. Completed 2024.
properties.funder: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine/Ocean Studies Board

properties.title: Flourishing Oceans Plastics and Human Health
properties.description: Minderoo Foundation project reducing plastic pollution impacts on oceans and human health through evidence generation, establishing causal links, supporting sustainable alternatives, and advocating for global plastics treaty across multiple ocean bas

properties.title: Marine ecosystem stressors in the Arctic
properties.description: Assessing Arctic oceanographic impacts on marine ecosystems using traditional knowledge & climate models. Focuses on phytoplankton, fish, acidification, warming in Inuvialuit Settlement Region & Canadian Arctic MPAs. 2021-2028.

properties.title: National Seabed Enhancement Programme
properties.description: Senegal seabed mapping project using advanced techniques to protect marine resources, create MPAs, support sustainable fisheries & marine infrastructure. Aims to stimulate economic growth & improve coastal communities' lives.
properties.funder: The Directorate of Management and Exploitation of the Seabed – Senegal

properties.title: Strengthening the Resilience of Coastal Communities in the Northeast Atlantic, Mediterranean Region to the Impact of Tsunamis and Other Sea Level-Related Coastal Hazards
properties.description: Builds tsunami-resilient communities in 7 NEAM countries through awareness, preparedness strategies, local alerting systems, and IOC-UNESCO Tsunami Ready recognition. Protects coastal lives, livelihoods, and property from multi-hazards.

properties.title: The EAF-Nansen Programme: Supporting the Application of the Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management
properties.description: FAO-Norway partnership strengthening fisheries policies across 32 African and Bay of Bengal countries using ecosystem approach. Focuses on sustainable management, ocean governance, and Blue Transformation for food security.
properties.funder: Norway and Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

properties.title: Global Fishing Index
properties.description: Minderoo Foundation develops globally-accepted measure of fish stock health using new technologies to protect seas from over-fishing, promote sustainable wild caught fisheries, and drive improved decision-making and compliance worldwide.

properties.title: IGIF-Hydro
properties.description: Operational Framework for Integrated Marine Geospatial Information to facilitate decision-making for sustainable oceans, seas, coastal zones, deltas, tributaries, and inland water bodies across all ocean basins.
properties.funder: UN Committee of Experts on Global Geospatial Information Management (UN-GGIM)

properties.title: EUceano
properties.description: Documentary filmmakers travel globally to explore ocean-human relationships through diving, sustainable fishing, and ocean literacy. Showcases people defending marine life and reducing plastic pollution to inspire change.

properties.title: Enhancing Accessibility of OA Reference Materials
properties.description: Diversifies production of certified reference materials for ocean acidification monitoring. Addresses COVID-19 supply shortage that compromised global ocean carbonate chemistry measurements. All ocean basins. 2021-2026.

properties.title: Unpath'd Waters
properties.description: Uses AI to connect UK marine heritage collections, from Bronze Age to WWII wrecks and prehistoric North Sea landscapes. Delivers integrated management tools, simulations, and public co-design for maritime legacy.

properties.title: OceanWISE: Indigenous Knowledge Alliance
properties.description: Empowers indigenous communities in territorial ocean management, integrating traditional wisdom for sustainable practices, carbon sequestration, and coastal resilience in Caribbean and South Pacific regions.
properties.funder: Asociación Centro para la Autonomía y Desarrollo de los Pueblos Indígenas (CADPI)

properties.title: MS in Science and Design for MSP
properties.description: Two-year Master's program at IUAV Venice integrating oceanography, marine sciences, and planning for maritime spatial planning. Trains professionals through theory and practice-based learning for coastal activities.

properties.title: Forever chemicals in the marine environment
properties.description: FEARLESS assesses PFAS toxicity & transformation in marine food webs. Studies impact on organisms near firefighting foam sources at Bergen airport & Ekofisk/Eldfisk oilfields in Norwegian waters, 2023-2026.

properties.title: Belmont Forum Ocean Collaborative Research Actions
properties.description: International funders develop multilateral calls for transdisciplinary ocean research. Co-designed with scientists, policymakers, communities to generate knowledge for environmental change mitigation. Global scope across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Enhancing capacity for global coastal resilience
properties.description: Deltares-led initiative (2025-2029) enhancing coastal resilience globally through technical expertise, capacity building, policy collaboration, and international networks. Provides tools, training, and nature-based solutions.

properties.title: NSF Convergence Accelerator - Networked Blue Economy
properties.description: Accelerates convergence research into practice by merging multidisciplinary expertise to address blue economy challenges. Track E focuses on interconnecting ocean research, innovation, and technology for societal impact. Completed 2024.

properties.title: Coral Reef Restoration Engaging Local Stakeholders Using Novel Biomimicking IntelliReefs
properties.description: Deploying nanotechnology artificial reefs in Sint Maarten to restore coral after Hurricane Irma. Biomimicking structures provide habitat, attract wild corals, support fish populations, enhance biodiversity.

properties.title: Atlantic Meridional Transect Omics Network (AMT-Omics)
properties.description: Long-term oceanographic monitoring across Atlantic Ocean (UK to South Atlantic, 100° latitude, 1000m depth). Integrates molecular omics data since 2009 with traditional methods for continuous time-series analysis.

properties.title: Low-Cost Real-Time Monitoring of Pollutants and Water Quality along the Coral Reefs in Tanzania: Supporting Effective Ocean Management
properties.description: Deploys water quality monitoring devices at 8 coral reef sites along Tanzania coast measuring temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH. Real-time data logged for 10 years to inform policy on reef protection & climate impact.

properties.title: Ufukwe Marine Center-Ocean Climate Innovation Hub (UMC)
properties.description: Centre of Excellence in Mombasa fostering ocean-climate research, innovations, and restoration. Advances ocean-based climate solutions in Kenya through collaboration with researchers, entrepreneurs, and local communities in the Indian Ocean.

properties.title: Plankton Biodiversity Through Remote Sensing and Omics
properties.description: PETRI-MED monitors microbial plankton biodiversity via satellite & genomics to assess marine health, carbon sequestration & ocean acidification. Combines remote sensing, field data & AI in Mediterranean 2023-2026.

properties.title: Coastal Resilience Through Knowledge Capacity
properties.description: CMCC 5-year initiative providing technical expertise for coastal resilience through multi-hazard early warning systems, nature-based solutions, Digital Twins, and AI. Focus on Global South capacity building via workshops and collaboration.

properties.title: European Knowledge Hub on Sea Level Rise
properties.description: Why: Support sea level policy decisions. What: Networking platform for 50+ experts. How: Interdisciplinary knowledge exchange on regional sea level rise. When: 2021-2027. Where: Nine European countries.

properties.title: GIRT Scientific Divers
properties.description: Trains recreational/technical divers to monitor underwater cultural heritage sites. Citizen science program shares data publicly and with management agencies to protect non-renewable UCH from natural and human threats. Started Australia 2018.

properties.title: Long-term Observation Program in the Baltic Sea (BalticObs)
properties.description: Five annual cruises monitoring hydrographic, chemical, biological parameters in Baltic Sea. Tracks ecosystem variability, anthropogenic impacts (nutrients, microplastics), climate change effects. Data supports regional cooperation and policy.

properties.title: Clean Water for Reefs: Tackling Wastewater
properties.description: Monitors water quality & implements wastewater solutions in Roatán, Honduras. Connected homes to treatment facility, preventing 29M gallons/year from ocean. Reduces fecal bacteria, protects coral reefs & human health. Scaling across MAR region.

properties.title: SEA2SEE
properties.description: Blockchain-based seafood traceability system covering Mediterranean & N Atlantic. Tracks fish from catch to consumer, verifying sustainable practices. Runs 2022-2026 to increase trust in sustainable seafood.

properties.title: WYTEC Blue – Women & Youth Technical Capacity for the Blue Economy
properties.description: Builds technical capacity for women & youth in Canada & West Africa for sustainable blue economy. Develops ocean innovation content via Ocean School platform in 4 languages. Targets Canadian Arctic & Peru communities.

properties.title: Plastics as a vector for spread of AMR
properties.description: Studies how marine plastics carry antibiotic-resistant bacteria from wastewater into oceans. Analyzes biofilms on plastic litter in Mediterranean & North Atlantic to assess AMR spread risks to marine food chains.

properties.title: MINKA citizen science observatory
properties.description: Community platform for coastal biodiversity data collection via geolocalized citizen photos. Volunteers document species; experts validate; data shared via GBIF. Aligns with EOVs, supports SDGs 11,14,15,17. 2024-2030.
properties.funder: Institut de Ciències del Mar, CSIC

properties.title: Acoustic Detection & Protection Tech for Endangered Right Whales
properties.description: Expands near-real time acoustic surveillance in eastern Canada to detect and locate North Atlantic right whales. Uses sophisticated acoustic tech and aerial surveillance to reduce vessel strikes and fishing gear entanglement.

properties.title: Integrated Climate Vulnerability Assessments
properties.description: Develops climate vulnerability assessment tool for American lobster fishery in Northwest Atlantic, incorporating climate exposure, sensitivity data, and habitat models to enable marine resiliency and food provisioning.

properties.title: Climate Change Impact on Marine Coastal Ecosystem Kerala (C3-eKerala)
properties.description: Indo-Norwegian project assessing climate change impacts on Kerala's 593km coast using satellite data, modeling & machine learning to predict sea level rise, shoreline changes, ecosystem impacts & harmful algal blooms for 2023-2030 mitigation plans

properties.title: Sustainable Blue Food Futures for People & Planet (BlueFood Futures)
properties.description: Builds on Blue Food Assessment to integrate aquatic foods into global policy. Focuses on understanding blue food potential, policy integration, stakeholder solutions, and capacity building through 2027.

properties.title: Improvement of Women's Access to Maritime Navigation Training in Togo
properties.description: Promotes gender equality in maritime sector by enhancing women's access to navigation training in Togo, where only 3 of 50 ship captains are women. Addresses barriers restricting women's participation as captains and deck officers.

properties.title: Quieting Oceans for a Sustainable Future (BluEcho)
properties.description: BluEcho mitigates underwater noise from shipping & wind farms across Mediterranean, North, Baltic, Norwegian & Polar Oceans. Uses 3D sound mapping, species impact assessment & mitigation strategies to protect marine biodiversity.

properties.title: NaturCap. Take Care of Cap de Creus
properties.description: Digital platform promoting cross-sectoral collaboration for blue economy growth amid climate change. Leverages Cap de Creus maritime heritage to drive conservation and pro-environmental behaviors through oceanic justice principles.

properties.title: Kelp Forests in the Anthropocene
properties.description: GEcoKelp reveals ocean warming & marine heatwave effects on kelp forests via genomics, experiments & models. Focuses on Norwegian kelp (S. latissima, L. hyperborea) to inform management & restoration strategies.

properties.title: Nature-Inclusive Designs for Offshore Renewables (NiD4OCEAN)
properties.description: EU-funded project developing nature-inclusive designs for offshore renewable energy in North Sea, Baltic Sea & Western Mediterranean. Balances carbon neutrality with biodiversity restoration through transdisciplinary solutions. 2024-2027.

properties.title: CoastSnap Community Beach Monitoring
properties.description: Community-driven beach monitoring using smartphones to track erosion and recovery. Citizens upload photos via cradles, creating accurate coastal change records comparable to GPS surveys for sea level and storm impact management.

properties.title: Global Coastal Bathymetry Observation
properties.description: Mapping coastal bathymetry 0-30m depth using satellite data, tidal models, and wave analysis. Cloud-based monitoring system for shallow waters globally where physical surveys are not feasible.

properties.title: CoastPredict – Observing and Predicting the Global Coastal Ocean
properties.description: Transforms coastal ocean science by integrating observations with models to predict extreme events to climate impacts on marine ecosystems, biodiversity, and coastal communities globally from river catchments to slope waters.
properties.funder: CMCC Foundation – Euro-Mediterranean Center on Climate Change, Italy

properties.title: Decade Coordination Office for Ocean Observing
properties.description: Coordinates Ocean Decade Challenge 7 to ensure sustainable ocean observing systems across all basins, delivering accessible data to users. Connects actions, fills capacity gaps, transforms GOOS beyond 2030.

properties.title: Decade Coordination Office for Ocean Data Sharing
properties.description: Manages ocean data sharing for UN Ocean Decade. Develops capacity, findability, interoperability of ocean data. Creates digital ocean representation. Supports global observing systems & knowledge transfer across regions.

properties.title: Decade Collaborative Centre for the Southern Ocean Region (DCC-SOR)
properties.description: Coordinates international efforts to protect Southern Ocean through research, stakeholder engagement, and resource mobilization. Addresses pollution, biodiversity, climate, and ocean economy across Antarctic waters (2023-2030).

properties.title: Polar Pod Expedition
properties.description: Unprecedented maritime exploration of Southern Ocean (2023-2026) using innovative platform for sustained in situ measurements. Addresses critical data gap in Earth's climate driver and biodiversity reserve.

properties.title: The Centre for Sustainable Ocean Science
properties.description: Transdisciplinary research on marine biodiversity & sustainability in Baltic Sea. Focuses on Archipelago Sea & Åland. Uses Living Lab methodology with stakeholders to address ecosystem protection & knowledge sharing challenges.

properties.title: Under the Pole: DeepLife 2021-2030
properties.description: 10-year exploration of mesophotic ecosystems (30-200m deep) across all ocean basins to discover biodiversity, species connectivity, vulnerability to climate change, and propose conservation measures for this largely unexplored marine zone.

properties.title: Mission Ocean Microbiomes (Tara Microbiomes)
properties.description: 5-year research on ocean microbiome, climate impacts & plastisphere. South Atlantic expedition (2020-2022) with AtlantECO, Chile CO2 mission. Research phase 2022-2025, advocacy & capacity building ongoing.

properties.title: Innovative Applications of Postharvest Fish Losses (WASTE2TASTE)
properties.description: 8 European partners developing commercially viable products from fish waste, by-catch & processing by-products. Creates marine ingredients via green bioprocesses, reducing extraction time & hazardous solvents.

properties.title: ATLASea: Atlas of Marine Genomes
properties.description: Sequencing genomes of 4,500+ marine species in French EEZ to monitor biodiversity, discover biotech materials, and support evolution research. Coordinated by CEA/CNRS, data freely available for aquaculture, medicine applications.

properties.title: Ocean Networks Canada
properties.description: ONC operates ocean observatories across Canada's 3 coasts & Antarctica, collecting continuous data from deep sea & coastal sensors since 2006. Advances ocean observing, delivers open data products, accelerates climate & sustainability research.
properties.funder: Canada Foundation for Innovation Major Science Initiatives Fund

properties.title: Canada's Coastal Environmental Baseline Program
properties.description: Collects baseline ecological data in 6 high-traffic Canadian coastal areas (Iqaluit, Vancouver, Prince Rupert, St Lawrence, Saint John, Placentia Bay) via partnerships with Indigenous communities. Data openly shared to support decision-making.

properties.title: Blue Carbon as a Canadian Climate Change Solution: Modelling the Mitigation Potential of Kelp Under Future Climate Change Scenarios
properties.description: Quantifies blue carbon potential of Canadian kelp ecosystems. Provides first Canada-wide assessment of kelp forest extent and climate change mitigation potential under future scenarios. Led by University of Victoria.

properties.title: Blue Carbon Assessment for Seagrass and Kelp
properties.description: Develops first carbon budget for kelp forests and seagrass beds in eastern Canada to value them as blue carbon habitats, addressing knowledge gaps in carbon export to deep sediments and global sequestration estimates.

properties.title: Global Ocean Negative Carbon Emission
properties.description: Evaluates eco-tech interventions for ocean CO2 sequestration: ecosystem restoration, land-sea management, upwelling manipulation, microbial carbon capture. Network of field stations, research, capacity building. 2022-2030.

properties.title: Ocean Observations of Surface Waters in Galicia (BOGAR)
properties.description: Autonomous coastal observation system in Galicia using mobile infrastructure with biogeochemical sensors to monitor CO2 flows and provide open oceanographic data for climate neutrality by 2050.

properties.title: EPOS Thematic Core Services TSUNAMI
properties.description: European consortium providing open access to tsunami data, simulations, and hazard products for researchers and early warning systems in NE Atlantic, Mediterranean, and connected seas. 18 institutions from 11 countries.

properties.title: ANEMONE Global
properties.description: Global eDNA biodiversity monitoring network. Empowers partners worldwide to survey marine ecosystems using environmental DNA technology. Establishes regional hubs for standardized long-term monitoring by 2033.

properties.title: North Atlantic Carbon Observatory
properties.description: Multinational platform delivering comprehensive ocean carbon measurements across North Atlantic to improve climate forecasts and support marine CO2 removal through integrated observing networks.

properties.title: A US Ocean and Great Lakes Literacy Strategy
properties.description: National strategy to foster Ocean Literacy in US through surveys, Blue Schools Network expansion, partnerships, stakeholder forums, and communication. Addresses pollution, climate, behavior change across oceans and Great Lakes.

properties.title: PROTEUS™, Space Station of the Ocean
properties.description: Modular underwater habitat in Curaçao with labs & broadcast studio. Focuses on coral reef health, biodiversity, environmental monitoring, human health & robotics. Delivery 2025. Promotes global collaboration.

properties.title: The Antarctic Monitoring and Assessment Programme (ANMAP)
properties.description: Circum-Antarctic surveillance of organic contaminant pollution and climate-driven ecosystem change. Monitors threats, provides scientific info and government advice for preventative action across Southern Ocean basins.
properties.category: Marine pollution monitoring and ecosystem protection

properties.title: GEMS Ocean for Ocean and Coasts Programme
properties.description: Multi-stakeholder partnership providing ocean/coastal data & analysis for policy-making. Addresses erosion, pollution, habitat loss via earth observation & modeling. Supports SIDS capacity building for sustainable marine resource management.

properties.title: Thalassophile Project: Accessible Ocean Literacy
properties.description: EU-funded initiative advancing universal accessibility in marine science for d/Deaf and visually impaired communities. Bridges gap in accessible ocean education through multidisciplinary partnership across global ocean basins.

properties.title: Co-Management Models for Fisheries Ocean Health
properties.description: Enhances fishermen & stakeholder understanding of co-management through capacity building & knowledge exchange for climate-resilient ocean resource management, supporting small-scale fisheries globally for food security & ecosystem health.

properties.title: ArtWaves: Fusion of Marine Biodiversity and Art
properties.description: Artist-in-residence program merging art & marine science to promote understanding of biodiversity change. Creates new formats for science transfer into social/political debates. Focus on ecosystem protection.
properties.funder: Helmholtz Institute for Functional Marine Biodiversity at the University of Oldenburg (HIFMB)

properties.title: Sustainable Aquaculture Industry Waste Valorization through Recycling (SEA-CYCLE)
properties.description: Valorizes aquaculture waste via circular economy: anaerobic digestion, pyrolysis, biochar for nutrient recovery & wastewater treatment. Reduces environmental impact while creating sustainable fertilizers. Norway-based, 2024-2027.

properties.title: Marine Biodiversity Library & MPA eDNA monitoring
properties.description: Building Canadian Marine Biodiversity DNA Library for non-destructive multi-species monitoring in MPAs. eDNA metabarcoding surveys baseline species diversity in Pacific/Atlantic regions. 2022-2026.

properties.title: SPACEWHALE for designating Marine Protected Areas
properties.description: AI-powered satellite imagery analysis counts whales from space. Mapping 4,000 km² in Indian Ocean to designate Important Marine Mammal Areas & Marine Protected Areas. Supports offshore wind farm assessments.

properties.title: Deltas associated with large rivers: Seeking solutions to the problem of sustainability (Mega-Deltas)
properties.description: Studies 25 representative river deltas facing erosion, flood risk, and ecosystem loss. Develops blueprints for sustainable delta management through international cooperation. Supports regional development and ecosystem restoration.
properties.funder: The State Key Laboratory of Estuarine and Coastal Research (SKLEC), East China Normal University

properties.title: Hybrid governance to protect and manage high seas
properties.description: Protects biodiversity in Thermal Dome & Sargasso Sea high seas. Develops hybrid governance models for ecosystem-based management beyond national jurisdiction, informing UN BBNJ negotiations on regional/global coordination.

properties.title: Ecosystem Studies of Sub-Arctic and Arctic Seas (ESSAS)
properties.description: Studies how climate change affects Sub-Arctic/Arctic marine ecosystems through comparative research. Working groups tackle physical, chemical, biological oceanography, fisheries. Supports commercial stocks, subsistence fishers, marine life.

properties.title: Global Ocean Corps and Conveyor
properties.description: Network of sustained education/research collaborations between global south/north scientists. Hosts summer schools in Ghana/Nigeria, expanding to East Africa 2025-26. Facilitates capacity sharing for ocean research.

properties.title: Ressoa Oceano Network
properties.description: Collaborative network improving ocean media coverage & expert communication. 4 axes: content curation, original production, journalist/scientist training, citizen science. Unites stakeholders for sustainable ocean communication in Brazil.

properties.title: From Global Gazetteer to Global Community
properties.description: Marine Regions creates open global gazetteer of georeferenced marine/coastal place names with persistent identifiers. Develops vector layers for boundaries/classifications. Engages stakeholders, experts, UN Actions for co-design.
properties.category: Ocean observations, Digital representation, Capacity development

properties.title: Sailing4Science – Expanding the Capacity for Ocean Observations and Ocean Citizen Science Awareness and Stewardship
properties.description: Empowers sailing professionals & citizen scientists with low-cost ocean observation tools. Focuses on remote coastal areas & SIDS. Co-creates crowd-sourced data for ocean literacy & stewardship. Global multi-basin project.
properties.funder: Norwegian University of Science and Technology

properties.title: Deep Ocean Observation to Predict Climate hazards
properties.description: DeePCMED strengthens deep-sea research in Mediterranean Sea through Eulerian observation systems. Clarifies extreme events impact on deep habitats stability/resilience to build marine ecological prediction system.
properties.funder: Institut National des Sciences et Technologies de la Mer – Tunisia

properties.title: Marine Resource Gathering Infrastructure in Norse North Atlantic (MARGAIN)
properties.description: Interdisciplinary study of marine resources (driftwood, seaweed, shellfish) along Norway's west coast from Viking Age to Early Modern Period using archaeology, ethnohistory, and scientific analysis to understand settlement patterns.

properties.title: OceanOmics: Monitoring & Protecting Ocean Life
properties.description: Minderoo Foundation uses genomics, automation & AI to monitor ocean biodiversity. Develops reference genome libraries, eDNA sequencing methods, and integrates genomic data into conservation frameworks for Australian waters.

properties.title: SMART Subsea Cables for Observing the Global Ocean
properties.description: Equips transoceanic telecom cables with sensors measuring temperature, ocean bottom pressure, and seismic activity to monitor climate, sea level rise, ocean circulation, and provide tsunami/earthquake early warning across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Powering the Blue Economy – Global (PBE-Global)
properties.description: International hub for marine energy knowledge sharing. Develops wave, tidal, current energy tech to power coastal industries & communities. Builds capacity for renewable ocean energy adoption globally. 2022-2032.
properties.funder: United States Department of Energy, Water Power Technologies Office

properties.title: Chinese Regional Hub for Blue Carbon
properties.description: Connects science, policy & outreach to advance blue carbon research in China & globally. Informs national policies, promotes ecosystem conservation best practices, enables public participation in blue carbon protection.
properties.funder: Third Institute of Oceanography, Ministry of Natural Resources – China

properties.title: Blue Tourism Initiative
properties.description: Promotes sustainable coastal tourism governance across Mediterranean, Western Indian Ocean & Caribbean. Exchanges knowledge & practices to address environmental, health, socio-cultural & economic challenges. 2022-2026.

properties.title: Marine Plan Partnership for the North Pacific Coast
properties.description: Partnership between BC and 17 First Nations developing marine use plans for North Pacific Coast using science and Indigenous knowledge for sustainable development and ecosystem protection. Ongoing since 2015.

properties.title: St. Lawrence Estuary Research and Observation Plan
properties.description: Studies hypoxic & acidic bottom waters in St. Lawrence Estuary to understand deoxygenation, acidification & eutrophication interactions. Aims to inform mitigation actions for ecosystem degradation from 2021-2026.

properties.title: EU Ocean research and innovation
properties.description: EU Commission program addressing marine pollution, ecosystem restoration & sustainable ocean economy across Arctic, Atlantic, Baltic, Black & North Seas. Research & innovation contribution to Ocean Decade challenges.
properties.funder: DG Research and Innovation, European Commission

properties.title: Portuguese National Oceanographic Data Centre
properties.description: NODC-PT gathers, processes & disseminates oceanographic data from Portuguese agencies in North Atlantic. Supports Blue Growth & ocean knowledge through data stewardship. Operational 2023-2030.
properties.funder: Portuguese Committee for the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO

properties.title: Aotearoa New Zealand Marine Carbon Forum
properties.description: Forum providing evidence-based analysis of nature-based carbon capture in NZ coastal waters. Facilitates collaboration across sectors and with Māori on marine carbon sequestration to inform national strategy and ecosystem resilience.

properties.title: Brazilian Tropical Estuaries Monitoring
properties.description: Multidisciplinary biomonitoring of 5 Northern Brazil estuaries affected by 2019 oil spill, integrating geosciences & biosciences to inform policy on hydrocarbon accidents, climate change & biodiversity loss through seasonal modeling & metabarcoding.

properties.title: Nutrition sensitive marine aquaculture in Africa (AfriMAQUA)
properties.description: Fostering sustainable marine aquaculture in Africa with nutrition-sensitive approach for food security, poverty alleviation, income creation through interdisciplinary partnerships, research, innovation, capacity development.
properties.funder: Institut de Recherche pour le Développement (IRD)

properties.title: Sustainability of Marine Ecosystems Through Global Knowledge Networks (SMARTNET)
properties.description: Global knowledge network strengthening ICES/PICES collaboration on climate change, fisheries, ecosystem management, and human dimensions. Emphasizes inclusivity, gender equality, early career engagement, indigenous communities.
properties.funder: International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) & The North Pacific Marine Science Organization (PICES)

properties.title: GEOTRACES
properties.description: International program coordinating marine biogeochemical cycles of trace elements and isotopes. Identifies processes controlling ocean distributions, studies nutrients, tracers, contaminants impacting carbon cycle, climate, ecosystems.

properties.title: Norway-Pacific Ocean-Climate Scholarship Programme
properties.description: PhD training partnership between U of Bergen & U of South Pacific. 19 candidates from 7 Pacific nations research ocean-climate nexus in marine biology, oceanography, law, social sciences. Joint supervision, bi-institutional degrees.

properties.title: Observing Air-Sea Interactions Strategy (OASIS)
properties.description: Global program observing air-sea energy, moisture & gas exchanges to improve weather/climate prediction, support blue economy & sustainable ocean health through 2030. Monitors carbon distribution & ocean-atmosphere interactions.

properties.title: Digital Twin of the Ocean Animal Tracking
properties.description: Maps marine life movements in North Sea using tracking data to create digital twin. Addresses animal movement component missing from existing DTs. Assesses offshore infrastructure impacts on wildlife for conservation policy.

properties.title: Global Subseafloor Ecosystem and Sustainability (GSES)
properties.description: Studies microbial life & carbon dynamics in subseafloor via global protocols, investigation tools & ecological indices. Addresses ocean governance gaps, threat mitigation for sustainable blue economy 2024-2030.

properties.title: Pearl River Delta Estuary Marine Restoration
properties.description: Coastal ecological disaster monitoring & wetland restoration in Pearl River Estuary, Nansha District, Guangzhou. Addresses ecological challenges in tropical-subtropical transitional estuarine ecosystem along migratory bird flyway.

properties.title: DNA-based Approaches for Fisheries Monitoring
properties.description: Atlantic network using DNA methods to monitor marine fish, supporting sustainable fisheries management. Partnerships across Portugal, Cape Verde, Brazil, Guinea-Bissau, Spain. Includes capacity-building workshops.

properties.title: COST Action Marine Animal Forest of the World (MAF-World)
properties.description: Global network studying Marine Animal Forests (sponges, corals, gorgonians). Unifies protocols for mapping, restoration, ecosystem services to tackle climate change and food crisis. Completed 2021-2025.

properties.title: One Ocean Hub
properties.description: International research program bridging law, science & society for sustainable ocean governance. Empowers Indigenous peoples, fishers, women & children through inclusive decision-making integrating multiple knowledge systems.

properties.title: Tsunami Ready Odisha
properties.description: Strengthens coastal community resilience in Odisha through tsunami awareness and preparedness. OSDMA implements UNESCO-IOC Recognition Programme in coastal villages with hazard maps and evacuation plans since 2019.

properties.title: Seabed Mining & Resilience To EXperimental impact
properties.description: Provides scientific understanding to reduce deep-sea mining risks for polymetallic nodules in Pacific abyss. Evaluates impact and recovery from realistic mining disturbance on decadal scale to assess long-term sustainability.

properties.title: Partnership for Observation of the Global Ocean (POGO)
properties.description: Global consortium of 55 oceanographic institutions advancing ocean observation through innovation, capacity development, and advocacy. Bridges gaps between developed/developing countries using low-cost tech and supports UN Decade actions.

properties.title: Marine Management and Climate
properties.description: Nordic project modeling climate change effects in Nordic seas to 2100, evaluating adaptation solutions including nature-based conservation, MPAs, and offshore wind synergies for ecosystem-based management.
properties.funder: Norwegian Ministry of Climate and Environment

properties.title: Automated Debris Imaging System of ocean plastic
properties.description: AI-enabled cameras on cargo ships detect & map ocean plastic >0.5m globally. 500 cameras monitor debris concentrations, sources & transport patterns to improve cleanup solutions. Runs 2022-2032 across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Preventing ocean plastic in rivers
properties.description: Plastic Fischer tackles ocean plastic in rivers using low-tech barriers to collect waste before it reaches the sea. Creates local jobs in India & Indonesia while organizing awareness campaigns. Aims to prevent thousands of tons entering ocean.

properties.title: Reefs Of Hope: Coral-Focused Climate Adaptation
properties.description: Propagating bleaching-resistant 'super' corals to prevent extinction from marine heat waves. Involves reef communities, tourism, governments across 7 pilot countries. Nature-based solutions building on MPAs. Nov 2023-Dec 2030.

properties.title: Ocean Decade Programme on Sustainable Ocean Planning
properties.description: Empowers nations to develop climate-smart, equitable ocean planning using scientific & Indigenous knowledge. Supports transboundary cooperation & capacity building for sustainable ocean use through 2050. Global community of practice.

properties.title: European Global Ocean Observing System (EuroGOOS)
properties.description: European component of Global Ocean Observing System coordinating sustained ocean observations across Europe's seas. Enhances cooperation, promotes operational oceanography benefits, delivers fit-for-purpose products for marine users.

properties.title: IOGP Environmental Genomics Joint Industry Programme
properties.description: Oil & gas industry research using eDNA to detect organisms & estimate biodiversity in offshore/onshore operations. Reduces field time & cost while improving ecological assessment data across global ocean basins.
properties.funder: International Association of Oil and Gas Producers (IOGP)

properties.title: Demonstration of Chinese estuarine conservation (Est. Project)
properties.description: Mainstreaming estuarine biodiversity conservation in Yellow & Pearl River deltas through protected area networks, wetland restoration, threat mitigation, capacity building & policy development. Addresses ecological degradation.

properties.title: Indigenous People, Traditional Ecological Knowledge, and Climate Change: The Iconic Underwater Cultural Heritage of Stone Tidal Weirs
properties.description: Documenting stone tidal weirs as sustainable fishing heritage across ocean basins. Indigenous ecological knowledge guides future marine conservation through ancient shoreline structures that harmonize traditional practices with ecosystem balance.
properties.funder: Tokyo University of Marine Science and Technology [UNESCO UNITWIN Network for Underwater Archaeology]

properties.title: Ocean Cities Network (OC-NET)
properties.description: Interdisciplinary network of marine cities committed to sustainability and regeneration of marine environments. Combines scientific knowledge and social awareness to transform how coastal cities interact with the ocean.
properties.funder: Mediterranean Center for Marine and Environmental Research (CMIMA-CSIC)

properties.title: Ocean Literacy with USA Blue Schools
properties.description: K-12 schools improving ocean literacy through hands-on stewardship and social action. 50 registered US schools in Global Blue Schools Network. NOAA and NMEA support expansion across North Atlantic and Pacific regions.
properties.funder: NOAA Office of Education and National Marine Educators Association

properties.title: BRIDGES Research Program
properties.description: 10-year transdisciplinary program studying marine spatial planning & conservation networks for biodiversity & sustainable fishing in SW Indian Ocean. Creates observatory, modeling tools & collaborative platforms for researchers & stakeholders.

properties.title: Integration of Socio-Ecological Aspects into Digital Twins of the Ocean (SEAtwins)
properties.description: Integrates socio-ecological models into European Digital Twin Ocean framework for scenario analysis & ecosystem-based management across European seas. Enables decision support via participatory co-design, advancing sustainable ocean management.

properties.title: The EMS Centre Model System for Future Oceans
properties.description: Studies Eastern Mediterranean Sea ecosystem resilience to climate change using observations, experiments, cruises, ROVs, AUVs, gliders, sensors & models. Based in Haifa, trains early career scientists through joint research activities.

properties.title: Digital REconstruction of Abyssal habitat Map
properties.description: Maps deep-sea habitats (seamounts, ridges) using AI & underwater vehicles. Enhances observation tech, builds data fusion platform, creates standardized mapping tools. Enriches marine science knowledge 2025-2030.

properties.title: Serious Game Promoting Maritime Heritage Awareness - CREAMARE
properties.description: Transnational framework connecting game designers, researchers, cultural institutions to create digital products promoting Underwater Cultural Heritage in Mediterranean. Serious game explores 9 UCH sites teaching preservation.

properties.title: Posidonia Soundscapes: Conservation Music Ibiza
properties.description: Ibiza-based project using soundscape analysis & music to conserve Posidonia oceanica seagrass. Combines underwater acoustics, artist residencies, A/V performances & citizen science to restore biodiversity & boost ocean literacy by 2030.

properties.title: Think Ocean Challenge
properties.description: Pro-Ocean Behaviour Change Model enabling society's reconnection with Ocean through personal challenge actions. Supports social science research on individual behaviour change to influence communities and decision-making. Active in 26 countries.

properties.title: The Green Sink Initiative
properties.description: Addresses liquid waste pollution from construction/building maintenance sectors. Raises awareness, promotes washwater recycling systems to prevent toxic discharge into oceans. Combines education & tech innovation globally.

properties.title: A Sea of Connections: Valuing Reef Passages
properties.description: SOCPacific2R studies reef passages as biodiversity hotspots in Pacific Islands. Integrates Indigenous knowledge with science for conservation, documenting management arrangements through participatory dialogue to protect these keystone ecosystems.
properties.funder: Leibniz Centre for Tropical Marine Research (ZMT)

properties.title: Plastic Clever Schools
properties.description: Global school program by Common Seas empowering youth to combat ocean plastic pollution through education and action. Students learn sustainability, investigate plastic waste, and implement solutions in schools and communities.

properties.title: Marine Monitor (M2): Ocean Conservation Technology
properties.description: Vessel monitoring platform using marine radar to track small-scale fisheries globally. Empowers coastal communities to enforce laws and manage resources sustainably. Deployed in 12 countries since 2015.

properties.title: Marine Heatwaves International Working Group
properties.description: International scientists study marine heatwaves globally: physical drivers, properties, predictability & socio-ecological impacts. Multi-disciplinary approach informs management & conservation of extreme ocean warming events.

properties.title: Action Plan for the Ocean
properties.description: Risk-based ocean action plan: assess/rank risks from ocean change, identify response options, develop local-to-global adaptation plans for sustainable ocean economy and climate nexus. All ocean basins. 2024-2030.

properties.title: Ocean Accounts for Sustainable Ocean Development
properties.description: Global Ocean Accounts Partnership implementing standardized ocean accounting frameworks across diverse countries, integrating economic, environmental & social data to support evidence-based ocean policy beyond GDP metrics.

properties.title: African Ocean Biodiversity Atlas
properties.description: Develops Fisheries Atlas & Blue Carbon Biodiversity initiative for Africa's coasts. Creates marine species data repository, promotes MPAs, engages indigenous fishermen in ocean sustainability & UN Ocean Decade awareness.

properties.title: PROCARIBE+: Protect, Restore Ocean Capital and Blue Economies
properties.description: Wider Caribbean project protecting marine capital through spatial planning, conservation, Blue Carbon, sustainable fisheries & ocean governance. Catalyzes climate-resilient Blue Economy investments via regional coordination.

properties.title: Mitigation of Natural Incidence To increased Ocean (MoNITOR)
properties.description: Establishes high-res physical-ecological forecasting for ocean disasters: oxygen deficiency, cyclones, acidification, glacier melting. Global partnerships for marine disaster prevention across all ocean basins. 2024-2030.
properties.funder: Second Institute of Oceanography, MNR – China

properties.title: Sustainable Ocean Management Program
properties.description: Develops toolkit integrating Maritime Cultural Heritage, Marine Spatial Planning & Climate Science. Trains ocean professionals via summer schools in Baltic, Mediterranean & North Seas. 2024-2027.

properties.title: DAN.PADI Ocean Literacy Training Program
properties.description: Training PADI diving instructors globally to teach ocean literacy to youth via free eLearning platform. Covers citizen science, plastic pollution, climate change, underwater archaeology. Builds on Italy's Scuola D'Amare program.

properties.title: Future Coastal Ocean Climates
properties.description: FLAME generates high-resolution decadal-centennial projections of coastal ocean climates & impacts on ecosystems, hazards & resources. Targets polar, temperate, subtropical & tropical coasts for climate adaptation solutions.

properties.title: West and NOC Science Bursary
properties.description: Financial support for post-graduate marine science students from developing countries to participate in mentoring and seagoing research with UK's National Oceanography Centre scientists. Focuses on capacity development.

properties.title: Enhance coastal resilience to sea level hazards
properties.description: CoastWAVE 2.0 scales up tsunami resilience in NE Atlantic & Mediterranean. Builds hazard assessment capacity, installs detection systems, expands Tsunami Ready communities. Engages stakeholders for multi-hazard preparedness.

properties.title: Carbon Cycles in Huang-Bohai Sea Wetlands
properties.description: Examines carbon cycling in Huang-Bohai Sea wetland deltas (Yellow, Liaohe, Luanhe, Yancheng Rivers). Develops multidimensional carbon budget model for coastal wetlands to guide blue carbon ecosystem practices globally. Focuses on delta types.

properties.title: Nature-based Solutions in Conflict-Affected Coastal Communities
properties.description: NbS climate adaptation in Caribbean coast Colombia. Household surveys, workshops, network analysis assess options. Builds resilience, reduces maladaptation, strengthens networks in conflict-affected vulnerable coastal areas.

properties.title: SeaTrees
properties.description: Community-led restoration of blue carbon ecosystems (kelp, mangroves, seagrass, coral reefs) globally. Plants, protects, and restores coastal habitats for carbon sequestration, biodiversity, and sustainable development. 2018-2030.

properties.title: Global Real-Time Early Alarm for Tsunami (GREAT)
properties.description: Real-time tsunami warning using sound signals to reduce false alarms. Deploys in National Tsunami Warning Centres using deep-sea observations, AI & modelling. Supports SDG 11 for safer coastal cities.

properties.title: ESB Marine Mammal Observer Training Programme
properties.description: Builds capacity for marine mammal conservation in Ireland's offshore energy sector. Provides certifications, field experience, mentorship for early career marine professionals. Supports blue economy & Net Zero goals.

properties.title: Coastal Conservation and Protection Project
properties.description: Protecting & restoring degraded coastal/marine ecosystems in Nigeria through sustainable ocean practices, climate resilience measures. Preserves habitats, enhances biodiversity, mitigates climate impacts, supports communities.
properties.funder: The Federal University of Technology, Akure – Nigeria

properties.title: A New Vision for Coastal Resilience
properties.description: Empowers coastal communities to co-design resilient futures through interdisciplinary partnership. Addresses barriers to coastal resilience by setting collective vision for long-term social, ecological sustainability vs short-term fixes.

properties.title: Project 19
properties.description: Teens (15-18) translate ocean research into creative projects. Analyze science papers, create art/performances. Portugal (2021), expanding to South Africa & EU. Builds ocean literacy & advocacy skills.

properties.title: Ocean Literacy with All (OLWA)
properties.description: OLWA advances Ocean Literacy through global partnerships, designing transformative research-based activities for diverse stakeholders. Builds capacity and behavior change for sustainable ocean development across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Ti Whale An Nou: Cetacean Future in the Caribbean
properties.description: Caribbean-wide cetacean conservation program (2021-2030) enhancing research, education, and policy. Focuses on species identification, threat mitigation, youth engagement, and marine protected areas across Caribbean nations.

properties.title: Understanding and Addressing Ocean Acidification and Changing Ocean Conditions Through the Development of OA Action Plans
properties.description: OA Alliance translates ocean acidification knowledge into policy actions across global ocean basins. Develops action plans to increase biodiversity, adaptive capacity, and resilience through government collaboration.
properties.funder: International Alliance to Combat Ocean Acidification

properties.title: Blue House Fellowship Programme
properties.description: Building capacity and generating knowledge for kelp forest conservation, cultivation and sustainable management across stakeholders in North Pacific and South Atlantic Ocean basins (2024-2027).

properties.title: FISHTWIN
properties.description: Digital twin platform integrating climate adaptation for fisheries management. Simulates marine resources, habitats, human activities to enhance sustainable fisheries, reduce ecosystem impacts, strengthen climate resilience. 2023-2030.

properties.title: OceanX and OceanQuest Around Africa Mission
properties.description: Mission around Africa (Mar-Jun 2025) studying ocean circulation, ecosystem health, marine biodiversity. Supports climate research, sustainable management, conservation through data collection and regional capacity building.

properties.title: Creating Capability, Capacity & Culture Change
properties.description: Australian fishing/aquaculture workforce development addressing tech transformation. Invests in people, establishes shared values, builds resilience to solve problems and increase ocean health through 2025.

properties.title: Monitoring CECs Impacts in European Seas
properties.description: CONTRAST develops monitoring framework for contaminants of emerging concern (CECs) in European seas using Integrated Assessment Framework combining chemical measurements with biological effects, 2024-2027

properties.title: Ocean Community Challenge: Educating, Innovating
properties.description: Empowers communities & entrepreneurs to develop sustainable ocean solutions through literacy platform, pre-accelerator programs & community engagement. Targets diverse global audiences including underrepresented regions.

properties.title: Ghana Ocean Climate Innovations Hub (GOCIB)
properties.description: Collaborates with stakeholders to form task force implementing nature-based ocean solutions for climate remediation in Ghana/West Africa. Compiles and develops ocean carbon removal techniques for climate action.

properties.title: Climate Resilience for Fishing and Aquaculture
properties.description: Mitigates climate impacts on Australian fishing & aquaculture. Reduces emissions from fuels, electricity & feeds to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050. Improves adaptation strategies for climate-affected aquatic ecosystems.

properties.title: Marine forest restoration: a coastal gardening plan
properties.description: Restores marine forests via coastal gardening. Creates sea gardener profession. Targets shallow to continental shelf areas. Enhances biodiversity, carbon sequestration, coastal resilience. Involves citizens, stakeholders.

properties.title: Building Adaptive Resilience of Spanish Fisheries (VADAPES-II)
properties.description: Assesses socio-ecological resilience of Spanish fisheries under climate change. Co-designs adaptation plans with fisheries sector to maintain productivity, food security, and prevent maladaptation while preserving ecosystems.

properties.title: BlueDOT: Divers for Ocean Temperature
properties.description: Creates open-access database of dive computer temperature data from 0-40m depth to monitor subsurface ocean heatwaves in Mediterranean Sea. Empowers divers as citizen scientists to complement existing monitoring systems for climate mitigation.

properties.title: Estuarine Ecological Knowledge Network (EEKN)
properties.description: Network utilizing coastal community experiences & traditional knowledge to inform estuarine research & policy. Community observers document ecological conditions, preserving indigenous knowledge for ocean health.

properties.title: 3D Purpose Built Reefs for Marine Restoration (Coast3D Reefs)
properties.description: 3D-printed breakwater structures promoting coral and mangrove habitat creation while protecting coastal communities in Caribbean and Atlantic. Pilots test sustainable designs under real-world conditions through 2030.

properties.title: Mediterranean Sea Peoples Observatory Data (MedSeaPOD)
properties.description: Citizen science monitoring sea temperature via divers/fishermen in Sardinia & Corsica to study climate impacts on coastal ecosystems. Creates Mediterranean's first coastal thermal map with open data platform (2023-2026).
properties.funder: CNR, EMODnet, Parc naturel marin du Cap Corse, Carloforte Municipality, SMEs

properties.title: Offshore kelp cultivation as a carbon sink
properties.description: 4-year study using offshore giant kelp cultivation in Namibia to measure carbon sequestration capacity. Kelp absorbs CO2, dies, and is buried deep ocean, storing carbon permanently while benefiting biodiversity and ocean health.

properties.title: Blue Carbon Canada
properties.description: Partnership quantifying carbon sequestration in Canadian coastal ecosystems (salt marshes, seagrass, kelp, seabeds), assessing fishing impacts, economic value, and biodiversity to inform climate-smart conservation and restoration.

properties.title: A Caribbean SIDS Pollutants Observatory
properties.description: Establishes pollutant observatory for Caribbean SIDS using co-design. Creates regional contaminant inventory/database, unifies monitoring programs, develops technical capacity, publishes open-access pollution data to guide stakeholders.

properties.title: A bridge of oceanic dreams from Asia
properties.description: Develops marine professionals in Asia-Pacific through education combining traditional knowledge & science (GIS, water quality). Trains youth, fishermen, engineers online & in-person for sustainable ocean economy & conservation. 2022-2031.

properties.title: Blue Schools Global Network
properties.description: UNESCO-IOC initiative promoting Ocean Literacy through transformative education. Connects global schools to integrate ocean learning into curricula via interdisciplinary, project-based approach, empowering students on real ocean issues.

properties.title: Marine Extreme Events & Natural Hazards – mareXtreme
properties.description: Analyzes marine extreme events, geohazards, biohazards & meteo/oceanographic hazards. Develops prediction tools, risk reduction models & adaptation solutions for coastal social-ecological systems across European seas.
properties.funder: MARUM – Center for Marine Environmental Sciences

properties.title: All-Atlantic Floating University Network
properties.description: Network connecting 42 training-at-sea programs across 27 Atlantic countries to expand opportunities for students and early-career ocean professionals through collaboration and best practices sharing.

properties.title: Developing Expertise Via Education and Learning (DEVELOP)
properties.description: International training initiative by China's Second Institute of Oceanography to enhance marine professionals' skills in oceanography, marine biology, and sustainability through expert-led courses. Global reach across all ocean basins.
properties.funder: Second Institute Of Oceanography, MNR – China

properties.title: The Internet of Oceans (Oceaneers)
properties.description: AI-driven ocean stewardship program using gamified advocacy tools to accelerate innovation, unite stakeholders, and enhance data accessibility across all ocean basins through digital representation and behavior change.

properties.title: National Geographic Perpetual Planet Ocean Expeditions
properties.description: Multi-year exploration of all 5 ocean basins integrating science & traditional knowledge to examine marine system changes, reveal ecosystem diversity & connectivity, and scale solutions to protect & restore ocean ecosystems globally.

properties.title: SAFE TUNA - System and Application for Excellence
properties.description: Android app for Indonesian fishers' mental health, marine protection, spatial info, fish prices, health facilities. Pilot in Pangandaran, Palabuhanratu villages. Uses participatory action research. 2025-2028.

properties.title: Malizia Explorer Science Sailing Vessel
properties.description: Professional sailing team operates dedicated research vessel across global oceans (2025-2030). Advances climate research, ocean observations, public engagement through expeditions. Mobilizes decision-makers, educates globally.

properties.title: SSF Curriculum: Youth Voices for Fishful Futures
properties.description: Youth learning framework exploring SSF Guidelines in coastal/inland fishing communities. Students interview elders, document climate impacts, map value chains. Co-created in Peru, Nigeria, India, Madagascar. Cultivates ocean literacy.

properties.title: IOI Ocean Academy – Ocean Knowledge for All
properties.description: Free 20-hour online ocean literacy courses in local languages, delivered by local experts to remove barriers of language, cost & access. Promotes inclusive ocean education globally through 2030.

properties.title: Da Grouper School
properties.description: Intergenerational Ocean Science Academy building capacity through youth-elder-professional collaboration. Fills data gaps in Caribbean & East Africa via community science on coral reefs, mangroves, seagrasses. 2025-2029.

properties.title: An observatory of the North Atlantic Gateway
