properties.description: ALONGate creates synergies between Fram Strait LTER and Icelandic benthic inventories, focusing on deep-sea benthos connectivity and anthropocene impact on Vulnerable Marine Ecosystems in the North Atlantic Gateway to Arctic.

properties.title: Towards Sustainable Coastal Marine Ecosystems
properties.description: Evaluates response of coral reefs, seagrass, mangroves to environmental changes in New Caledonia. Uses historical data & innovative tech to elucidate resilience mechanisms, supporting sustainable coastal management decisions.

properties.title: Sediment upheaval and negative carbon emissions
properties.description: Studies sediment diffusion and carbon emissions in estuaries through observations and simulations. Reveals water-sediment dynamics coupling mechanisms to enhance carbon sink potential in delta areas. Indian Ocean and North Pacific focus.

properties.title: Global Tsunami Model Association
properties.description: Establishes global tsunami community & competence centre for hazard/risk assessment. Develops reference models, probabilistic methods, training programs. Serves all ocean basins for disaster risk reduction aligned with SFDRR & SDGs.

properties.title: WESTPAC International Marine Science Conference
properties.description: Triennial conference since 1986 bringing together Western Pacific marine researchers and ocean stakeholders. Serves as UN Ocean Decade Regional Conference promoting multi-disciplinary collaboration for sustainable ocean management.

properties.title: Edges of Earth: A Driving Force for Change
properties.description: Multi-year expedition documenting life at Earth's edges, amplifying marginalized voices driving ocean & climate action through immersive storytelling, field documentation & strategic collaborations with communities.

properties.title: Global Hadal Exploration Programme (GHEP)
properties.description: Explores ocean's deepest zone (6,000-11,000m) studying biodiversity, ecosystems, pollution, geology via global network using HOV, AUV, ROV. Builds capacity for early career scientists, raises public awareness 2025-2035.
properties.funder: Institute of Deep-Sea Science and Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences

properties.title: ALDEBARAN
properties.description: Research vessel supporting marine science, education & media since 1992. Specializes in shallow/coastal waters, marine protected areas, climate & biodiversity studies. 100,000+ nautical miles, 250+ expeditions worldwide.

properties.title: Sustaining Our Oceans
properties.description: Empowers youth in South-East Asia to combat marine pollution & protect ecosystems. Educates students & teachers on marine litter impacts, conservation skills. Addresses plastic pollution from 6 of world's top 10 polluting countries.

properties.title: Miniaturwunderland-Ralley
properties.description: Interactive exhibit at Miniatur Wunderland featuring Monaco section with research vessel ALDEBARAN model. Rally guides visitors through ocean sustainability themes via puzzles and trivia, merging science and entertainment to inspire marine conservati

properties.title: Shaping an Ocean of Possibilities (SOOP)
properties.description: Innovation platform uniting science, industry & civil society to develop interoperable ocean observation tech, scalable sensors & open standards. Increases ocean data availability on non-scientific infrastructure for Blue Economy 2023-2026.

properties.title: National Marine Educators Association (NMEA)
properties.description: US-based org advancing Ocean Literacy via education, equity, traditional knowledge. 800+ members, 15 chapters. Hosts UN-endorsed OL Handbook. Restores society-ocean relationship through lifelong learning & outreach.

properties.title: Convex Seascape Survey
properties.description: Investigates carbon burial in continental shelf seafloors (where, why, how) and biodiversity's role. 16 global partners study ocean carbon sequestration to inform climate action. Targets 6% of needed carbon drawdown by 2027.

properties.title: JPI Oceans Joint Call: Changing Marine Lightscapes
properties.description: Studies coastal darkening & artificial light at night impacts on marine biodiversity, ecosystem functioning & ocean health. Generates knowledge on light changes in oceans/coasts & suggests mitigation measures for maritime planning.

properties.title: Ocean Science Exhibition
properties.description: Multimedia exhibition on Cap San Diego museum ship in Hamburg showcasing ocean tech, microplastic solutions, underwater satellites, and marine conservation. Solar-powered learning space for schools during UN Ocean Decade 2022-2030.

properties.title: Seamount Habitat Oasis Watch (SHOW)
properties.description: Studies seamount biodiversity hotspots in Western Pacific & Indian Ocean. Identifies climate-sensitive habitats, develops conservation tools, and creates ecosystem-based impact assessment frameworks for deep-sea protection.

properties.title: Decade Collaborative Centre for the Northeast Pacific Ocean (DCC-NEPO)
properties.description: Coordinates research, Indigenous communities, and stakeholders in the Northeast Pacific to support sustainable ocean development. Focuses on elevating Indigenous-led initiatives across Ocean Decade Challenges. Now completed.

properties.title: Submarine Geological Hazards and Digitization
properties.description: Digital DEPTH project studying submarine geological hazards through observations, lab analysis, and digital modeling. Creates global data platform for early warning systems and risk management of marine hazards. 2025-2030.

properties.title: Satellite Observations of Coastal Ocean (SOCO)
properties.description: Enhances satellite observation of coastal ecosystems to understand evolution under human and climate impacts. Monitors water quality, algal blooms, riverine fluxes, CO2. Builds datasets and training platform for sustainable coastal management.
properties.funder: Second Institute of Oceanography (SIO), Ministry of Natural Resources (MNR) – China

properties.title: Tides of Innovation: Caribbean Sargassum Solutions
properties.description: Transforms invasive sargassum seaweed into biodegradable bioplastic in Caribbean. Mitigates environmental damage, creates sustainable economic opportunities. Supports blue economy & fights plastic pollution. 2025-2030.

properties.title: Decade Coordination Office for Africa
properties.description: Coordinates Ocean Decade actions across Africa's coastal nations and SIDS. Addresses marine planning, governance, observation gaps. Partners with governments, NGOs to advance sustainable ocean management 2023-2030.

properties.title: Integrated Coastal Zone Management Working Group
properties.description: Enhances coastal resilience against hazards by providing scientific knowledge to decision-makers. Uses interactive platforms for disaster risk reduction, climate adaptation, and sustainable coastal governance in South Pacific communities.

properties.title: ForeSea – The Ocean Prediction Capacity of the Future
properties.description: International coordination to improve ocean prediction systems science, capacity & efficacy. Builds seamless ocean info value chain from observations to end users for economic & societal benefit across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Exploring the Potential of Ocean Blue Carbon
properties.description: Research project investigating ocean-CO2 relationships and blue carbon potential. Studies carbon absorption, storage, sequestration processes, and ocean ecosystem responses to warming, acidification, deoxygenation for climate resilience.
properties.funder: Atmosphere and Ocean Research Institute, The University of Tokyo

properties.title: Antarctica International Science & Infrastructure for Synchronous Observation (Antarctica InSync)
properties.description: Collaborative synchronous observation program for Southern Ocean & Antarctica. Preparatory phase 2024-26 establishes alliances & data frameworks. Implementation 2027-30 conducts fieldwork to understand drivers & impacts.

properties.title: Blue Economy Coalition for Ocean Climate Solutions
properties.description: Central America & Caribbean coalition uniting public, private, academic sectors for ocean carbon removal, marine tech development, coastal resilience. Drives sustainable blue economy through partnerships and innovation.

properties.title: Working Group to implement Ocean Literacy in Chile (GT COCEAN)
properties.description: Chilean initiative implementing ocean literacy through 8 activities: curriculum integration, IOC course adaptation, communication plan, public portal, strategic plan, funding identification, content promotion, and monitoring methodology.

properties.title: The Observatory of Mangrove and its Maretories
properties.description: Strengthens environmental governance of Amazonian & Peruvian mangroves through citizen science monitoring, participatory GIS, & big data. Creates Mangrove Researchers/Reporters groups to bridge traditional & scientific knowledge.

properties.title: Joint International Laboratory of Deltas
properties.description: International collaboration establishing intelligent database and early warning system for coastal water security across deltas in China, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Egypt, Romania. Addresses flooding, erosion, ecological threats.

properties.title: Team CASPI Climate Innovation Hub
properties.description: Caspian region climate action hub addressing planetary crisis through youth capacity building, marine carbon removal, ecosystem restoration, pollution monitoring, and coastal resilience (2025-2030).

properties.title: Marine Research Cruises in Remote Areas (CIMAR Program)
properties.description: Multidisciplinary oceanographic research in southern Chile & oceanic islands studying oceanography, meteorology, biodiversity. Expanding to northern oceanic waters 2024-2030. Creates comprehensive database for sustainable development.

properties.title: Bougainville Project
properties.description: Global network monitoring ocean microbiome via students on ships testing frugal sensors in Indian & Pacific Oceans. Tracks invisible organisms regulating climate. 2023-2030, led by Sorbonne University.

properties.title: PlaSTic On beaches: 3D-distRibution and weathering
properties.description: Studies fate of beached marine plastic debris on Hawaiian beaches through repeated field surveys and 3D mapping. Tracks plastic aging, fragmentation rates, and transformations near North Pacific Garbage Patch. 2022-2025.

properties.title: DiadSea: Transnational Cooperation for Diadromous Fish
properties.description: 9 partners from Portugal, France, Spain, Ireland cooperate to manage & conserve diadromous migratory fish in Atlantic waters. Addresses climate change impacts on species living in fresh & saltwater.

properties.title: SAILOR – South African Innovation Lab for Ocean-Climate Resilience
properties.description: South African innovation lab supporting ocean-based carbon sequestration & ecosystem restoration ventures. Focuses on mCDR, decarbonised shipping, sustainable aquaculture. 4-month program: validation, development, scaling.

properties.title: Institute of Marine Engineering, Science and Technology (IMarEST)
properties.description: Global network of 12,500+ members across 120+ countries advancing ocean science through 12+ endorsed actions including M2M mentoring, marine mammal conservation, and sustainable offshore practices via interdisciplinary collaboration.

properties.title: Whales and polar bear in a petri dish
properties.description: Research on contaminant effects on polar bears & whales as top predators. Develops alternative toxicology approaches to understand pollution impacts on marine mammal population dynamics. Arctic, N Atlantic & N Pacific focus.
properties.funder: University of Bergen, Department of Biological Sciences

properties.title: SEA'TIES: Sharing Solutions with Coastal Cities to Tackle Sea-Level Rise
properties.description: Global initiative facilitating sustainable adaptation solutions for coastal cities facing sea-level rise. Connects elected officials, urban planners across regions to exchange knowledge and best practices for coastal resilience.

properties.title: US Tsunami Contributions to IOC Tsunami Pt 1
properties.description: NOAA supports UN Ocean Decade tsunami detection goals via: drafting 10-yr R&D plan, sharing seismic/GNSS tech, promoting real-time data collaboration, deploying DART tsunameters, building capacity in island/developing states

properties.title: Hyperspectral Sensing of Coastal Soils
properties.description: Detecting nano/microplastics in mangrove, dune, coastal soils using hyperspectral sensing. Creates database of marine pollution distribution. Fast, cheap, digital tool for tracking plastic waste in coastal environments. 2023-2029.

properties.title: China Oceanic Development Foundation
properties.description: CODF coordinates Ocean Decade programs in China, transforming research into solutions and governance tools. Builds blue partnerships across Arctic, North & South Pacific through multi-stakeholder collaboration. 2025-2030.

properties.title: Leveraging Our Networks for the Ocean Decade
properties.description: Sustainable Ocean Alliance facilitates collaboration between Early Career Ocean Professionals regional nodes across Africa, Caribbean, Southeast Asia. Provides training, mentorship, networking through 64 Ocean Solutions Hubs in 42 countries.

properties.title: Women in blue: gender equity for ocean
properties.description: Empowers women in ocean science, fisheries & policy across Brazilian coast. Identifies barriers, strengthens networks, fosters leadership in climate & sustainability discussions. Led by Federal Univ of São Paulo, 2021-2026.

properties.title: A regional coupled atmosphere-ocean model
properties.description: Kilometer-scale coupled air-sea model simulating waves, sea spray, ocean mixing, and heat/moisture/carbon exchange. Focuses on hurricane development to improve weather and climate modeling. North Atlantic and Pacific basins.

properties.title: Ogyre - Fishing For Litter
properties.description: Fishers collect ocean plastic waste, managed via blockchain platform. Recycled/disposed locally. Real-time data tracks marine pollution impact. Supports coastal communities while combating marine plastic pollution globally.

properties.title: Protecting Marine Life from Toxins
properties.description: Monitors marine microalgae distribution & ecological role in Korean waters to enhance biodiversity data. Expands MBON network through field surveys, data analysis, institutional collaboration & capacity building. 2023-2030.

properties.title: Save the Waves Mobile App
properties.description: Surfing community crowdsources coastal threats data via mobile app. Users photograph development, pollution, sea-level rise, water quality issues. GPS-tagged photos shared with agencies to co-develop solutions. Global coverage.
properties.category: Marine pollution monitoring and ecosystem protection

properties.title: NEAM-COMMITMENT
properties.description: Enhances tsunami risk management in North-East Atlantic, Mediterranean & connected seas through hazard mapping, evacuation planning & capacity building. Develops inundation maps for Cyprus, Greece, Spain; pilots multi-hazard approach. 2025-2027.

properties.title: Ocean Acidification Research for Sustainability (OARS)
properties.description: Global programme addressing ocean acidification impacts on marine ecosystems through enhanced scientific cooperation, regional collaboration, capacity building, observation networks, and policy communication across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Recovering and reusing ghost nets (NETS FOR THE OCEAN)
properties.description: Collects, cleans & reuses discarded fishing nets from Brazilian coast, transforming them into products & income for communities. Prevents ghost fishing & marine pollution through innovation & social inclusion. 2023-2030.

properties.title: Cerulean Information Factory (CIF)
properties.description: ESA project using Earth Observation data to support Blue-Green Economy transition in North Atlantic/Arctic. Focuses on shipping, offshore renewable energy, and aquaculture through advanced analytics and decision support platforms.

properties.title: Decade Collaborative Center Challenge 4 Sustainable Ocean Economy
properties.description: Barcelona-based DCC enhances global coordination for sustainable ocean economy. Flexible model supports diverse initiatives. Mediterranean hub drives innovation, resilience, equity in ocean development 2025-2030.

properties.title: Decade Collaborative Centre for the Pacific Islands Region
properties.description: SPC-led center coordinating ocean science across 22 Pacific island nations. Addresses 10 Decade Challenges for SIDS/LDCs covering 30% of Pacific Ocean. Strengthens collaboration, provides integrated services, develops partnerships 2023-2027.

properties.title: Remote sensing of Underwater Cultural Heritage
properties.description: Uses underwater remote sensing to study submerged cultural sites & marine environments. Integrates archaeology, geosciences, biology for UCH protection. Develops Web3D models for digital heritage management in Mediterranean.

properties.title: 1Ocean Ocean Conservation Educator and Action Network
properties.description: Equips teachers in Tamil Nadu & Kerala with Indian Ocean knowledge on biodiversity, fisheries, livelihoods. Co-creates ocean literacy manual with indigenous communities, trains educators to communicate & take conservation action.

properties.title: Soneva Foundation Coral Restoration
properties.description: Maldivian NGO advancing coral reef regeneration through spawning, microfragmentation, photogrammetry & probiotics across 5 islands. Combines research, community stewardship & youth capacity-building for coastal resilience.

properties.title: Assessing spatiotemporal dynamics in herring population structure under climate change (HERPOPS)
properties.description: Genomic research tracking Atlantic herring populations in NE Atlantic using SNP markers and eDNA to understand climate change impacts, inform sustainable fisheries management, and maintain biodiversity through 2027.

properties.title: International Platform for Ocean Sustainability (IPOS)
properties.description: Global initiative bridging science, policy & society to accelerate ocean sustainability. Provides accessible knowledge supporting governments in ocean commitments via decentralized structure with regional nodes. Covers all ocean basins.

properties.title: Whales and Climate
properties.description: International team from 6 countries studying whale distributions under climate change scenarios, focusing on Southern Hemisphere humpback whales. Develops methods for assessing climate impacts on marine mammals and their role as carbon storage.

properties.title: ARTPORT_WE ARE OCEAN
properties.description: Transdisciplinary art project engaging artists, students, scientists, policy makers worldwide to raise ocean awareness. Works with young/underprivileged people on human-ocean interdependence through arts education until 2030.

properties.title: Projeto TransforMAR
properties.description: Environmental education for vulnerable youth through scuba diving in Brazil. Combines marine biology training with underwater experiences to promote ocean literacy and conservation in coastal communities. Started 2018, reached 500+ youth.

properties.title: Seaworthy Collective
properties.description: Miami nonprofit accelerating BlueTech startups for ocean impact. Supports diverse entrepreneurs in pollution reduction, coastal resilience, and climate solutions. 100 founders, 50 startups, $25M raised since 2021.

properties.title: FOODIMAR
properties.description: 3-year project valorising fisheries/aquaculture side-streams into sustainable food. Recovers nutrients, reduces climate impact, diversifies species (jellyfish, whitefish, sea bream), adds value to fish processing waste. 2024-2027.

properties.title: Bluer Africa
properties.description: Builds coastal resilience across Africa through ocean literacy, community adaptation, and infrastructure improvements. Empowers vulnerable coastal communities with sustainable practices for marine health and equitable development.

properties.title: First Nations – Trusted Crowd-Sourced Bathymetry & Capacity Building in British Columbia (FNTCSB&CBBC)
properties.description: Crowd-sourced hydrographic data collection in remote BC coastal areas. Indigenous community capacity building through training and knowledge transfer. Similar to Canadian Arctic project.
properties.funder: Interdisciplinary Centre for the Development of Ocean Mapping (CIDCO)

properties.title: The Future of Fisheries and Marine Ecosystems (FishMIP)
properties.description: Global project detecting, attributing & projecting marine ecosystem & fisheries changes under climate change. Co-creates simulation experiments, tests model ensembles & provides future scenarios for all regions.

properties.title: Synergistic Observing Network for Ocean Prediction (SynObs)
properties.description: Optimizes ocean observation by combining satellite and in-situ data across global, tropical, arctic, and coastal systems. Develops assimilation methods for enhanced ocean/coastal predictions through 2030.

properties.title: Sea the Value
properties.description: Interdisciplinary team determining pluralistic values for blue carbon and marine benefits to co-develop green investment options for marine ecosystem restoration and conservation through novel finance mechanisms (2022-2025).

properties.title: Blue Parks
properties.description: Accelerates establishment of MPAs meeting Blue Park Standard to revitalize ecosystems & safeguard biodiversity. Awards recognize effective MPAs; Blue Sparks program guides local leaders in planning effective protection globally.

properties.title: Sistema de Alerta, Predicción y Observación
properties.description: Expands ocean observing platform in South Pacific to monitor climate impacts, providing data to coastal communities and decision makers to boost resilience and ocean stewardship through 2030.

properties.title: Digital Twins of the Ocean (DITTO)
properties.description: Digital framework integrating marine data, AI, and modeling to create ocean development scenarios for energy, mining, fisheries, tourism. Enables users to build custom digital twins for local ocean issues using standard workflows.

properties.title: One Ocean Network for Deep Observation
properties.description: Global deep-sea observatory network studying ecosystem functioning under climate change, mitigating natural disasters, and engaging citizens. Uses high-tech devices across multiple ocean sites to unveil the unknown deep ocean.
properties.funder: Institut Français de recherche pour l'exploitation de la mer (IFREMER)

properties.title: Ocean Citizen Science Project
properties.description: Water sports enthusiasts collect ocean data via Scuba Schools International partnership, feeding EMODnet portal. Bridges science and public, enhancing ocean literacy and extreme weather predictions globally.

properties.title: Impacts of Heatwaves and Hypoxia on Shellfish
properties.description: Examines climate stressor impacts (heatwaves, hypoxia) on Pacific oysters and razor clams in NE Pacific via lab/field trials, develops genetic biomarkers for monitoring, tests mitigation methods. Completed.

properties.title: Migratory Crossroads: Predicting Dynamics of Great Vertical Migration in Changing Habitat
properties.description: Studies zooplankton vertical migration in northern Norway waters. Investigates how climate change affects Calanus finmarchicus daily and seasonal movements. Uses simulation models and field data to forecast ecological impacts.

properties.title: Southern Gulf of Guinea Upwelling System
properties.description: Climate projection model evaluating future impacts on sGGUS marine productivity, upwelling efficiency, nutrient availability, and fisheries sustainability in eastern tropical Atlantic (2025-2028).

properties.title: Sustainable Ocean Resilience for African Community
properties.description: Enhances African coastal community resilience through early warning systems, ocean literacy, and adaptive capacities. Integrates indigenous knowledge with science for sustainable ocean risk management in South Atlantic regions.

properties.title: Expedition Coastline in the Ocean Decade
properties.description: Year-long Belgian coastal education project where students conduct beach fieldwork, contribute to scientific databases, and tackle ocean challenges like pollution and biodiversity through action-oriented learning.

properties.title: The Oceano Vox Initiative: You sail, we care
properties.description: Participatory ocean monitoring using IoT sensors on leisure boats. Collects real-time coastal data on ocean conditions, climate change & pollution. Promotes ocean literacy & sustainable blue economy. All ocean basins focus.

properties.title: Building Bridges: Science, Policy and Society
properties.description: 5-day training workshop on co-design for ocean sustainability in Western Indian Ocean. Brings together communities, scientists, policymakers to solve socio-ecological challenges using transdisciplinary approaches and knowledge systems.

properties.title: Impacts of Artificial Light at Night on Pelagic Ecosystems in European Seas (ALANIS)
properties.description: Studies how artificial light from coastal activities and shipping affects zooplankton migration and marine ecosystems across European seas, from high latitude to Mediterranean waters, 2024-2028.

properties.title: Ocean Wise Shoreline Cleanup
properties.description: Citizen-science program empowering communities in Canada & US to combat plastic pollution through corporate cleanups, municipal partnerships using litter data for policy, and local collaborations to establish baselines.

properties.title: Fish Biodiversity Facing Global Change - FishGLOB
properties.description: Global network integrating 95 bottom-trawl surveys across continents to monitor 3,000+ fish taxa. Creates platform for multinational research to understand and predict fish diversity change in rapidly changing oceans.
properties.funder: French Foundation for Biodiversity Research (FRB-CESAB), Canadian Institute for Ecology & Evolution (CIEE), French Embassy in Canada

properties.title: International Blue Carbon Institute
properties.description: Advances blue carbon science to address climate change, protect biodiversity, support coastal communities. Develops policy, finance strategies. Global hub for knowledge exchange in Southeast Asian and Indo-West Pacific regions.

properties.title: Global Artificial Light at Night Network (GOALANN)
properties.description: International network studying marine light pollution impacts on ocean ecosystems. Develops tools, datasets, and policy guidance to manage artificial light emissions into the sea globally. Addresses ecological and societal impacts.

properties.title: Ocean Literacy Programme for Coastal Communities in Ecuador
properties.description: Pilot model for sustainable coastal communities through ocean education, resource management. Uses ESRA methodology with blue economy sectors. 8 years: 19k+ participants, 38 communities, 12+ tons garbage collected.

properties.title: Bow Seat's True Blue Fellowship
properties.description: Youth fellowship funding 10+ projects annually (ages 13-24) addressing ocean/waterways/climate issues through creative arts. Provides $2,500 USD, mentorship, capacity building. Projects must engage local communities with tangible impact.

properties.title: EDITO contributing to the DITTO
properties.description: EU's digital twin of the ocean (EDITO) digitizes ocean data management through interoperable standards for science-policy-private sector exchange. Covers all ocean basins. Runs 2025-2028.

properties.title: JPI Oceans Joint Call Blue Carbon
properties.description: Joint call advancing blue carbon ecosystem research across Ireland, Canada, Germany, Malta, Norway, Poland, Greece. Focuses on expanding knowledge, improving measurement protocols, identifying interventions for climate mitigation.

properties.title: West Coast Ocean Biomolecular Observing Network
properties.description: Network integrating biomolecular technologies for marine biomonitoring in Southern California. Addresses ocean acidification, harmful algal blooms, fisheries assessments through standardized molecular approaches across platforms.

properties.title: Computer vision and artificial intelligence-based salmon identification and automated long-term welfare assessment in aquaculture net-pens (cAIge)
properties.description: AI-based computer vision monitors individual salmon welfare in aquaculture farms. Tracks fish health, environmental factors, and farming practices to optimize holding conditions. Norway-led project 2023-2027.

properties.title: Klimaatlas - The Danish National Climate Atlas
properties.description: Extends Denmark's climate tool into marine domain. Provides ocean temperature, marine heatwave, salinity, sea ice projections for Danish coastal waters. Supports climate adaptation and ecosystem management 2022-2029.

properties.title: Advancing Big Data Technologies of Marine Life
properties.description: Japan-led project utilizing marine big data to understand ecosystems, promote conservation, and address ocean issues through data collaboration and citizen science. Focuses on North Pacific Ocean from 2021-2031.
properties.funder: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT) – Japan

properties.title: The Coastal Ocean Environment Summer School in Nigeria and Ghana
properties.description: Annual week-long summer school since 2015 training 1,000+ scientists in coastal ocean science. Alternates between Nigeria (even years) and Ghana (odd years). Multidisciplinary platform fostering international collaboration and capacity development.

properties.title: MetaZooGene: Metabarcoding Zooplankton Diversity
properties.description: Global DNA barcoding of marine zooplankton to monitor ecosystem health, climate impacts, food webs. Creates reference databases, best practices, capacity-building for early career scientists.

properties.title: FUTURO – Future West African Marine Ecosystem
properties.description: Studies West African Upwelling System through 2028 field campaign in Mauritania-Senegal region. Co-designs observations integrating stakeholders to enhance understanding and promote sustainable marine resource management.
properties.funder: GEOMAR Helmholtz Centre for Ocean Research Kiel, co-lead IOCAFRICA

properties.title: Deep Blue Voyager 2035 Global Ocean Expedition
properties.description: Ten-year global ocean expedition advancing frontier research, intelligent technologies, and ocean literacy. Provides vessel resources bridging science, industry, and public for sustainable ocean development across all ocean basins.
properties.funder: China Ocean Mineral Resources R&D Association (COMRA)

properties.title: OneArgo: An Integrated Global, Full Depth and Multidisciplinary Ocean Observing Array for Beyond 2020
properties.description: Global ocean observing array tracking physical & biogeochemical state from surface to full depth, including polar oceans. Real-time data sharing enables climate services, ocean productivity forecasting & carbon budget research.

properties.title: The Future West African Upwelling System
properties.description: Studies West African upwelling ecosystem dynamics, fisheries sustainability, and climate impacts. Focuses on oceanographic processes affecting coastal communities and marine resources in the region.

properties.title: BlueMissionAA
properties.description: EU Mission coordination hub for Atlantic & Arctic basins focusing on marine ecosystem restoration, climate resilience, governance framework, monitoring, innovation ecosystem, and citizen engagement through demonstration sites. Nov 2023-Oct 2025.

properties.title: SEAWARD Africa
properties.description: Coordinates Ocean Decade Africa Roadmap implementation across 4 themes: sustainable marine resources, climate/biodiversity, pollution, disaster risk. Includes capacity development, tech innovation, ocean literacy. Pan-African scope.

properties.title: Thinking Beyond The Tides
properties.description: 7-month hybrid fellowship empowering Caribbean youth (18-35) as marine conservation champions through nature-based solutions, ecosystem restoration, leadership training, and mentorship for climate resilience.

properties.title: Protecting Africa's Marine Ecosystems
properties.description: AFMESI promotes resilient Africa with healthy oceans sustaining livelihoods & biodiversity. Platform for global expert exchange to protect, restore & improve ocean quality across continent. Addresses pollution & sustainable economy.

properties.title: Seascape Alaska: A Regional Coastal and Ocean Mapping Campaign
properties.description: High-resolution seafloor mapping of Alaska waters (62% unmapped). Gov & non-gov collaboration for navigation, fisheries & Seabed 2030. Digital ocean representation for stakeholders.

properties.title: Coral Research & Development Accelerator Platform
properties.description: Global R&D platform funding coordinated programs to conserve warm/cold-water corals. Accelerates development of scalable solutions for coral restoration, connects international programs, trains scientists in developing countries.

properties.title: Navigating the New Arctic
properties.description: NSF convergence research addressing Arctic environmental, social & built system interactions. Studies rapid Arctic changes & local/global effects across disciplines. Arctic Ocean, N Atlantic & N Pacific focus.

properties.title: Using ocean science to stop IUU fishing
properties.description: Philippines-US project using science & data to combat illegal fishing through law enforcement, stakeholder compliance & progress tracking. Addresses 63B pesos annual losses from IUU fishing.

properties.title: The VLE Blueprint Accelerator
properties.description: Annual program identifying ocean innovators and transforming their visions into fundable Ocean Decade Actions through a 4-week strategic sprint. Builds investment-ready project architecture for marine conservation.

properties.title: Nature-based Solutions for Mitigation of Watershed pollution: Cross-habitat facilitation by coastal seagrass meadows (SOMWAT)
properties.description: Assessing tropical & temperate seagrass-reef ecotones in Tanzania & South Africa. Studies nutrient/pollutant removal by seagrass meadows to improve water quality for reefs & aquaculture, benefiting local communities' livelihoods.
properties.funder: MeerWissen – Helmholtz Institute for Functional Marine Biodiversity

properties.title: C&BI – Ocean & Coastal Ecosystems
properties.description: BNP Paribas Foundation call for projects (Jan-Apr 2025) to protect marine biodiversity, mitigate climate impacts, support sustainable practices across all ocean basins. Focuses on pollution, blue food, ocean-climate nexus.
properties.funder: BNP Paribas Foundation under the aegis of Fondation de France

properties.title: The Current III: The Mediterranean - Waves Come in Pairs
properties.description: Transdisciplinary examination of Mediterranean, Pacific & Caribbean through art, science, conservation & activism. Supports projects & collective pedagogies addressing regional challenges for UN Agenda 2030.

properties.title: Beyond One Ocean Health
properties.description: Integrates environmental justice, ecohealth, planetary & One Health concepts for ocean domain. Addresses ecosystem health, disease, human well-being, spiritual healing, planetary limits to safeguard modern civilization.

properties.title: 3D sensors for contaminants and marine toxins
properties.description: Developing 3D printed sensors for in-situ monitoring of emerging contaminants and marine toxins in coastal ecosystems. Protects shellfish/oyster farmers from harmful algae toxins, providing portable, economical solutions.

properties.title: eDNA Expeditions II
properties.description: Citizen-science initiative establishing repeated eDNA sampling across marine protected areas globally. Expands biodiversity knowledge in underrepresented regions, integrates data with OBIS, develops indicators, and builds local capacity.

properties.title: Collaborations for NWP Marine Ecosystem Prediction (COSMEC)
properties.description: Advances understanding of marine ecosystem dynamics in Northwest Pacific using BGC Argo floats, eDNA, AI methods. Supports policy, resource management through real-time data for ESMs. Builds capacity among WESTPAC states.

properties.title: Global Climate Impacts of Methane Seeps (CliMetS)
properties.description: Global collaboration studying seafloor methane seeps through observation, monitoring, and research. Develops distribution maps, assesses biodiversity, and evaluates environmental impacts of marine methane release across all ocean basins.
properties.funder: Southern Marine Science and Engineering Guangdong Laboratory (Guangzhou)

properties.title: Southern Ocean Flux Capability Working Group
properties.description: Reduces uncertainties in Southern Ocean air-sea exchanges by implementing observing systems for essential ocean variables, developing standardized methodologies, and supporting flux product development. Focuses on storm-related events.

properties.title: Quantifying Gases in the Ocean Using Acoustics
properties.description: Develops broadband acoustic tech to detect & quantify seafloor gas bubbles (methane, CO2). Creates numerical models for flux estimation to understand ocean-atmosphere gas exchange & climate impacts. Completed 2019-2025.

properties.title: Maré de Ciência (Tide of Science)
properties.description: Ocean literacy program bridging science, policy & society through dialogue and engagement. Co-designed with universities, authorities & civil society to integrate SDGs and UN Ocean Decade goals into sustainable behavior change.

properties.title: C-SCOPE in Action
properties.description: Enhances marine carbon observation using Ship-of-Opportunity lines to measure CO2 uptake, connecting BGC-Argo and surface measurements, and developing Open Ocean Science concepts. Contributes to GOA-ON and OARS.

properties.title: Building capacity to protect marine biodiversity (BAIT)
properties.description: Enhances capacity to observe and monitor marine ecosystems in Cabo Verde through training and practical observation programs. Delivers policy information for sustainable economic growth and poverty alleviation. 2023-2025.

properties.title: A probabilistic model for plastic clean-up techs
properties.description: Develops tool for selecting plastic clean-up mechanisms in inland waterways to efficiently collect debris before reaching ocean while minimizing environmental bycatch. Assists policymakers and companies in technology selection based on environmental

properties.title: Decade Collaborative Centre for Ocean Prediction (DCC-OP)
properties.description: Coordinates global ocean prediction community to achieve predicted ocean through UN Ocean Decade. Develops shared architecture, standards, training. Implements OPERA (sub-Saharan Africa) and OP4CR (Costa Rica) projects.

properties.title: Forecasting the Argentine Sea
properties.description: Operational oceanic forecasting system for sea level and waves in Southwestern Atlantic Continental Shelf. Web portal provides free access. Training and co-production with users. Part of Pampa Azul Initiative.

properties.title: Centers for Oceans and Human Health
properties.description: NSF & NIH program investigating connections between ocean environment, climate & human health. Studies marine plastics, toxins, harmful algal blooms through interdisciplinary collaborations with researchers & communities.
properties.funder: U.S. National Science Foundation, National Institutes of Health

properties.title: Blue University of the Brazilian Coast
properties.description: Multi-institutional ocean literacy network on Brazil's semi-arid coast. Targets public, teachers, students, agencies via social communication and environmental education. Runs Feb 2023-Dec 2026 in South Atlantic.
properties.funder: Institute of Marine Sciences (LABOMAR)/Federal University of Ceará (UFC)

properties.title: Building Forward Better by Safeguarding Natural Capital and Ecosystem Services
properties.description: Samoa project supporting policy, data collection & valuation of marine/coastal ecosystem services for SDGs 14-15, building investment case for ecosystem services' role in human wellbeing (SDGs 1-3).

properties.title: Recycling on the development of sensor for oceans
properties.description: Develops sensors from recycled plastic optical fibers to monitor microplastics and water quality in aquaculture systems. Measures ammonia, pH, nitrites, CO2, temperature in South Atlantic. 2023-2026, Brazil.

properties.title: Gulf of Naples Integrated Pelagic Observatory
properties.description: Long-term ecological monitoring of Gulf of Naples ecosystem since 1984. Tracks temperature, nutrients, plankton, bacteria using optical and omics tech. Supports understanding marine dynamics and sustainable resource management in NW Mediterranean.

properties.title: Bertarelli Foundation Marine Science Programme
properties.description: Advances understanding of large marine protected areas in the Indian Ocean for better management. Focuses on marine biodiversity protection, ocean health, and science-informed conservation through collaborative interdisciplinary projects.

properties.title: SMART Ocean-SMART Industries (SO-SI): Science/Industry Partnerships for Data Collection and Sharing
properties.description: Global multi-industry initiative creating partnerships between science and ocean private sector for data collection and sharing. Develops community of practice, clearinghouse, and matchmaking capacity connecting science priorities with industry.

properties.title: Italian Navy High North Program
properties.description: Arctic research program by Italian Navy focusing on 3D mapping from satellite to seabed. Three pillars: Exploration, Environment, Education. Supports digital ocean representation through collaboration and coordination.

properties.title: Healthcheck Activates Sustainability Reporting
properties.description: CSIRO's Healthcheck ESG system engages fishing/aquaculture industry to identify data gaps and collect environmental, social & governance indicators for comprehensive sustainability reporting and market verification.

properties.title: Ocean Decade Research Programme on the Maritime Acoustic Environment (OD-MAE)
properties.description: Measures and characterizes underwater acoustic environments globally. Develops technologies and data collection methods using sound to analyze ocean-life systems and support marine conservation.
properties.funder: Interagency Working Group for Ocean Sound and Marine Life

properties.title: Better Data for Marine Spatial Planning in the Med
properties.description: MEDSEAPLAN enhances Maritime Spatial Planning across Mediterranean with 16 EU partners. Develops ecosystem-based tools, addresses data gaps, engages stakeholders for sustainable blue economy. €2.2M budget, May 2024-Apr 2027.

properties.title: World Ocean Database Cloud
properties.description: Provides equitable, timely access to historic & recent subsurface oceanographic data via cloud-optimized format. Integrates Open-GTS for near-real-time delivery, enabling ocean time series monitoring from historical to current measurements.

properties.title: Sustainable Sea-Caring and Protection Technologies
properties.description: RAISE develops AI & Robotics innovation ecosystems in Liguria for marine/coastal monitoring, preservation & remediation. Transitions from point to widespread environmental monitoring using EcoRobotics systems for sea, air, energy & ecotoxicology.
properties.funder: Next Generation EU and Italian National Recovery and Resilience Plan

properties.title: Mediterranean Green Shipping Centre of Excellence
properties.description: Hub fostering Mediterranean green shipping community, connecting stakeholders, promoting sustainable maritime transport innovation, facilitating start-ups with investors. Addresses marine pollution and sustainable ocean economy. 2023-2030.

properties.title: An Ecosystem Approach to Quantifying Behavioural and Energetic Impacts of Anthropogenic Disturbance to Arctic Whales
properties.description: Quantifying vessel noise & sonar impacts on Arctic whales using drones, biologging tags, & oceanographic sampling. Assessing ship strike risk & developing mitigation strategies for Canadian Arctic whale populations (2022-2026).

properties.title: Periodic cyclone effects on Gangetic food web
properties.description: Assesses ecological impacts of cyclone-mediated disruptions on Ganges delta food web. Studies plankton, benthos, fish communities and biogeochemical changes. Supports coastal hazard preparedness for Kolkata and Sundarban communities.

properties.title: Centre of Excellence on Sustainable Blue Economy
properties.description: Euro-Mediterranean collaborative project building bridges among institutions to advance blue economy through interdisciplinary research, education, and stakeholder engagement across EU and South Mediterranean states.

properties.title: The Ocean Matter (TOM)
properties.description: Addresses land-based pollution creating dead zones in Liberian waters. Provides ocean literacy initiatives and develops Liberia Ocean Governance Strategy to prevent chemical compounds and plastic debris impacting marine life.

properties.title: Tara International Polar Station (TIPS)
properties.description: Floating polar station conducting drift expeditions from 2024 in Central Arctic Ocean to study climate change effects on Arctic region and global ocean through long-term scientific research and monitoring.

properties.title: Acoustics to Assess the Health Status of Reefs
properties.description: Uses passive acoustics to assess marine protected areas and mass bleaching events in South Pacific reefs. University of Liège studies reef health through underwater sound monitoring to protect and restore ecosystems.

properties.title: X-Oceans: Enhancing Ocean Literacy in Youth in Rural Northeastern Nova Scotia
properties.description: Why: Educate rural communities to value ocean. What: K-12 curriculum. How: Hands-on experiences. When: 2022-2026. Where: Northeastern Nova Scotia, Canada.

properties.title: The Current V: Ancestral Ocean
properties.description: Examines Indian Ocean kinships, cultural languages, ancestral memory through art-science collaboration. Focus on island geographies connecting Afrasian pasts/futures across South Asia, East Africa, Gulf. 2026-2028.

properties.title: MSP4MORE: MSP Tools for Integrating Multiple Sustainability Objectives under Expansion of Offshore Renewable Energy
properties.description: Optimizes offshore wind farm design across Baltic, North, Mediterranean & Barents Seas to balance renewable energy with marine protection, ecosystem restoration & sea use. Develops stakeholder tools for sustainable maritime spatial planning.

properties.title: Strategic Management of Ghost Gear in Coastal Land
properties.description: Retrieves abandoned fishing gear from oceans/shorelines. Establishes Ocean Plastic Depots for collection, processing, recycling. Trains coastal communities. Creates sustainable ghost gear management with industrial hub. 2020-2028.

properties.title: Aprender Explorando
properties.description: Educational program connecting sailboat expeditions across Atlantic & Southern Ocean with schools. Uses ocean & polar regions to teach students aged 9-17. Collects plankton data via Plankton Planet partnership for ocean conservation.

properties.title: Swiss Polar Institute
properties.description: Swiss national body linking land-locked countries to ocean science. Supports polar research via CASCADES Expedition (2026), educational modules, and global partnerships. Bridges ocean-polar nexus in Ocean Decade.

properties.title: Multi-use Infrastructure Spatial Concepts for the Blue Economy Leveraging on Sustainable Port Ecosystems through Living Labs (BluePortLab)
properties.description: Transforms European ports into sustainable energy hubs via Living Labs, integrating renewables, biodiversity, multi-use infrastructure for climate-neutral blue economy. 2025-2028.

properties.title: FAPESP Program on South Atlantic and Antarctica (FAPESP-PROASA)
properties.description: Brazilian research program advancing South Atlantic & Antarctic science to address planetary crises & sustainable development through partnerships, innovation & environmental justice (2024-2029)

properties.title: Cell-Cultured Octopus Production Through Sustainable Marine Biomass Valorization (SEANERGIES)
properties.description: Develops cultivated octopus meat using regenerative cell lines, algae-based media & seaweed scaffolds to address overfishing & food security. 2025-2028. Led by Wageningen University.

properties.title: Harmonised ocean data sets for blue sustainable eutrophication management of the North-East Atlantic Ocean and Baltic Sea (CodeBlue)
properties.description: Addresses eutrophication in NE Atlantic & Baltic Sea. Compiles harmonised river data for biogeochemical models to inform policy on nutrient inputs, water quality & sustainable blue food production. Digital Twin test case 2025-2028.

properties.title: Enhancing Algal Biomass Consumer Acceptance for Food Markets (AlgFlavor)
properties.description: Optimizes cultivation/processing of seaweeds & microalgae to enhance seafood flavor for European markets. Bridges algal producers & food industry, creating sustainable alternatives to reduce pressure on marine stocks. 2025-2028.

properties.title: Digital Twin of the Ocean for Offshore Wind Energy (DTO4OWE)
properties.description: Develops digital ocean twins for Baltic & North Sea to assess offshore wind farm impacts on marine ecosystems & support sustainable wind energy planning through AI-based forecasting & scenario tools (2025-2028).

properties.title: Digital Twin for Innovation in Oceanic Visualization and Exploration (DIVE)
properties.description: AI4Ocean paradigm creating digital twin ocean models with what-if/causal exploration tools and intuitive visualizers. Bridges oceanographers and AI scientists via Quadruple Helix framework for sustainable Blue Economy.

properties.title: EVOLVE - Economically Viable Integrated Floating Energy Islands
properties.description: Develops floating offshore wind energy islands across European sea basins, integrating renewable energy tech & hydrogen production while balancing marine conservation, fishery & tourism through optimized design & operations (2025-2028)

properties.title: Microalgal Biomass Valorization for Sustainable Production of Functional Food and Feed Ingredients (BioVal)
properties.description: Develops sustainable microalgae cultivation & extraction for food supplements & aquaculture feed. Uses innovative photobioreactors to produce bioactive lipids (MAGs) & proteins, creating zero-waste biorefinery model. 2025-2028.

properties.title: BLUESHORES - Developing Hybrid Multifunctional Foreshore Infrastructure
properties.description: Tests hybrid nature-based coastal infrastructure combining saltmarsh, wooden breakwalls & oyster reefs at Venice Lagoon, Cork Harbour & Scheldt Estuary to mitigate erosion & climate impacts on eroding shorelines 2025-2028

properties.title: Unlocking the Potential of Seaweeds and Halophytes through Biorefinery for Enhanced Resilience in the Aquaculture, Agri-Food, and Chemical Industries (ReSEAlience)
properties.description: Develops universal biorefinery model for seaweed/halophyte processing via HALOREFINE extraction. Creates sustainable feed, textiles, chemicals from marine biomass in Atlantic/Mediterranean IMTA systems. Zero-waste approach. 2025-2028.

properties.title: Source to Sea: Bartók 3.0 Connectivity
properties.description: Bridges freshwater-ocean systems via culturally grounded digital twins across 7 pilots: Danube-Black Sea, Baltic, Adriatic, E Africa, Yellow River, Bay of Bengal, Nile-Mediterranean. Strengthens resilience, heritage safeguarding 2026-2031.

properties.title: Long-term Deep Indian Ocean Observing Network
properties.description: Establishes sustained mooring program in western Indian Ocean for deep ocean time-series observation. Shares open datasets to advance understanding of deep ocean processes, climate prediction, and sustainable ocean management.

properties.title: Korea-Indonesia Coastal Ocean Env. Survey Training
properties.description: Enhances Indonesia's marine capacity through 2-3 week training on pollution, erosion & biodiversity using Korean tech. Hands-on sessions with advanced equipment at Korea-Indonesia center. 2023-2030.
properties.funder: Korea-Indonesia Marine Technology Cooperation Research Center (MTCRC)

properties.title: Global Ecosystem for Ocean Solutions (GEOS)
properties.description: Accelerates collaboration across sectors to build a global community advancing ocean-climate solutions through Innovation Hubs. Supports multidisciplinary projects developing equitable solutions to ocean-climate crisis across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Formulation of Seaweeds to High-Value Ingredients for Food and Nutraceuticals Markets (ForSea)
properties.description: Develops sustainable seaweed cultivation and processing in Atlantic and Baltic Sea to create nutritional food ingredients via fermentation. Addresses food security through marine biomass innovation. 2025-2028.

properties.title: Circular Model Coexisting with Coral Reefs
properties.description: Kikaijima Island project revalues marine heritage through citizen science, art dialogue, community conservation, education, and a Floating University to promote sustainable coexistence with coral reefs threatened by climate change.

properties.title: Demonstrating Ocean CDR with Hydrogen Production
properties.description: Equatic Process seawater electrolysis removes atmospheric CO₂ and produces carbon-negative hydrogen. Singapore demonstration validates performance, safety, and monitoring in tropical coastal waters for marine carbon removal.

properties.title: Mariculture Overview in the Caribbean
properties.description: Sailing expedition documenting Caribbean mariculture from Florida to Trinidad. Interviews farmers, collects water quality data, creates comprehensive report and documentary to support sustainable aquaculture, food security, and ecosystem restoration.

properties.title: Decade Coordination Office for the Tropical Americas and Caribbean
properties.description: Coordinates Ocean Decade actions across Caribbean & Tropical Americas. Addresses marine pollution, ecosystem restoration, sustainable fisheries, coastal resilience. Partners with SIDS, governments, NGOs. 2023-2030.

properties.title: Ocean Literacy Across Languages
properties.description: ECOP-led initiative bridging language barriers in ocean knowledge through a global youth-led database and multilingual publication series. Connects scientists, youth, NGOs, and policymakers across cultures for ocean stewardship.

properties.title: Marine Plastics Abatement Through Hopeful Youth (MPAthy)
properties.description: Experiential learning for coastal youth in Tamil Nadu, India to combat marine plastic pollution through ocean literacy and revival of cultural circular economy practices. Combines science and heritage to empower change agents.

properties.title: Novel Functional Textiles from Red and Brown Seaweed (SeaWeave)
properties.description: Develops sustainable textile fibers and dyes from Atlantic and Mediterranean seaweed to replace synthetic materials. Uses biorefinery processes to extract polysaccharides and pigments for fashion and furniture industries. 2025-2028.

properties.title: Offshore Clean Hydrogen Production for Multi-Use Purposes (OCEAN-H2)
properties.description: Pioneering large-scale green hydrogen from offshore renewables via seawater electrolysis. Tackles climate change while minimizing marine ecosystem impacts through rigorous assessments and sustainable practices. 2025-2028.

properties.title: Advance the production and market viability of red seaweeds in Europe
properties.description: Diversifying European seaweed farming by domesticating red seaweed species, developing cultivation techniques, and creating quality control tools to expand sustainable blue bioeconomy (2025-2028).

properties.title: Integrated Coastal Protection Service of RS
properties.description: Monitoring system for Rio Grande do Sul coast combining in situ data, modeling & education. Addresses climate impacts, erosion, flooding & water quality. Supports municipalities in resilience & sustainable development.

properties.title: SPEED - Simulation and Prediction of Environment and Engineering for Deep-sea
properties.description: Builds digital twin systems coupling hydrodynamic, sediment, ecosystem models with satellite/sensor data for deep-sea environmental forecasts. Focuses on Indian Ocean to balance resource extraction with conservation (2026-2030).

properties.title: Biocatalytic Refining of Seaweed Carbohydrates for Producing Higher Value Polymer Precursors (SEABIOCAT)
properties.description: Develops biorefinery tech to convert brown macroalgae into biopolymers/bioplastics using thermostable enzymes. Targets North Atlantic/Arctic regions. Aims to replace fossil-fuel feedstock, boost coastal economies, create jobs.

properties.title: VASEACAD - Valorising Seafood Side Streams for Bioactive Protein Hydrolysates
properties.description: Maximizes value from marine fish biomass waste in Mediterranean/Black Sea aquaculture. Extracts high-value biomolecules from tuna, seabass, seabream for nutraceuticals, feed. Mobile Sealab recovers oil, proteins from fishery waste.

properties.title: Coastal Corrosion Risk Management through Digital Twin Model for a Sustainable Blue Economy (CorrasBLUE)
properties.description: Digital twin platform integrating sensor data to manage coastal corrosion across Atlantic, Mediterranean & North Sea. Maximizes material sustainability, minimizes ecological risks for marine infrastructure (2025-2028).

properties.title: SMART Online Multisensory System for Microplastic Quantification and Water Quality Assessment - ROMEO
properties.description: Low-cost multi-sensor system monitoring aquatic ecosystems from inland to coastal waters. Tracks microplastics, diatoms, water quality. Open database for scientists, policymakers, citizens. EU Marine Strategy compliant.

properties.title: Development of Modular and Mobile By-product and Wastes Bio-refinery Valorisation Systems and Supporting Structures for Fisheries and Aquaculture SME Industrie (DORIS)
properties.description: Develops mobile biorefinery systems to convert fishery/aquaculture waste into high-value products for EU Blue SMEs. Tests finfish, crustacean, mollusc waste conversion across EU sea basins. Includes funding models & policy support.

properties.title: Preserving and Upscaling Sama Bajao Indigenous Ocean Heritage in the Visayas
properties.description: Safeguards Sama Bajao ancestral maritime knowledge through documenting traditional practices, upscaling sustainable fisheries/aquaculture, heritage eco-tourism, and community-led conservation in the Visayas, Philippines (2026-2029).

properties.title: Upcycling of Bilge Water into Biobased Solutions for Ghostfishing and Oil Spilling (BilgeUP)
properties.description: Converts ship bilge waste into biosurfactants for oil spill cleanup and biodegradable fishing gear. Samples from Mediterranean, Atlantic, Black Sea. Addresses ghost fishing and marine pollution through circular bioprocesses.

properties.title: The Asia Sea-Level Knowledge Hub
properties.description: Regional center at CityUHK addressing sea-level rise across Asia through research, monitoring, policy engagement. Fosters collaboration for adaptive coastal resilience strategies. Serves densely populated Asian coastlines.

properties.title: Global Offshore Aquaculture and Low-Carbon Energy
properties.description: Integrates offshore aquaculture with floating wind energy across Atlantic, Pacific, Indian Oceans. Designs modular platforms with low-carbon tech, builds capacity through training, co-design with Indigenous knowledge.

properties.title: Coastal Ocean Resilience Data Collaborative
properties.description: Enhances resilience in South & Southeast Asia via open digital platform integrating ocean, climate, socio-economic data. Co-created with communities for disaster risk reduction, climate adaptation & blue financing. 2025-2030.

properties.title: Autonomous samplers and sensors for marine 'omics
properties.description: TechOmics develops autonomous biomolecular sensors/samplers to map marine life, from deep sea biodiversity to microbiology. Targets waterborne health threats like harmful algae in Mediterranean & N Atlantic. 2025-2031.

properties.title: Indicators of Changing Lightscapes in Underwater Marine Ecosystems (ISOLUME)
properties.description: Assesses how marine lightscapes changed across European seas over decades/centuries. Combines historical trend analyses with modeling. Investigates intensity, location, timing, spectra. Covers 25-year changes, projects to 2050.

properties.title: Pampa Azul Bonaerense
properties.description: Provincial initiative fostering society-nature relationships through strategic planning, territorial management, environmental education. Integrates citizen science, artisanal fishing communities, tourism stakeholders for coastal governance.

properties.title: SARCE+ (Transformative Intertidal Decade for Rocky Shores Conservation)
properties.description: Latin America & Caribbean network monitoring & restoring rocky shore biodiversity via standardized protocols, eDNA, remote sensing, community engagement & policy integration for resilient coasts (2026-2028).

properties.title: Empowering MSMEs in Tanzania Blue Economy
properties.description: Empowers 250 women/youth-led coastal MSMEs in Tanzania through training, creating 750 direct jobs, establishing Blue Economy Centres in Dar es Salaam and Zanzibar, building capacity in business planning and investment readiness (2025-2028)

properties.title: MiningImpact
properties.description: Assesses environmental impacts of deep-seabed mining in Pacific (Clarion-Clipperton Zone, Peru Basin) & Atlantic. Studies ecosystem functioning, biodiversity, mining effects, resilience. Informs international regulations.

properties.title: Blue Economy Network for ECOPs in LAC
properties.description: Establishes VET network across Latin America & Caribbean to empower Early Career Ocean Professionals through capacity building, ocean entrepreneurship training, innovation events & policy dialogue for sustainable blue economy (2025-2030)

properties.title: Sea Too
properties.description: Restores Baltic Sea ecosystems & key species weakened by human stressors. Combines scientific research, local knowledge & citizen science. Workshops explore ecological/cultural sea knowledge. Artists & scientists strengthen human-sea bonds.

properties.title: GEAR-UP: Towards Sustainable Fisheries
properties.description: Co-designs climate-resilient fishing gears with stakeholders across Atlantic, Arctic & Mediterranean to reduce bycatch, protect species. Builds capacity for Early Career Professionals in Island States from Cyprus to Macaronesia.

properties.title: Padjadjaran Oceanographic Data Centre
properties.description: Open-access portal by Universitas Padjadjaran providing marine/climate data from ships, moorings, platforms. Supports Indonesian Throughflow, coral restoration studies. Democratizes ocean data for sustainable policy in Indonesia/ASEAN.

properties.title: Methodological Framework for Tsunami Risk in Ports (TSUPORT)
properties.description: Develops comprehensive methodology for assessing tsunami risk in port environments globally. Enhances preparedness for critical port infrastructure, communities & populations. Multidisciplinary approach adaptable to coastal hazards.

properties.title: Blue Ocean Credits Program
properties.description: Advances sustainable ocean development through blue carbon ecosystems, coral biodiversity monitoring, and aquaculture. Builds global capacity via workshops and research. Develops credit systems using AI and remote sensing for restoration.

properties.title: Governing Changing Oceans
properties.description: Develops marine governance frameworks for ocean-based climate interventions like seaweed-farming and carbon removal. Unites experts to guide governments and stakeholders on governing novel interventions in climate-impacted oceans globally.

properties.title: VOA – Oceanographic Sailing Vessel
properties.description: State-of-the-art oceanographic sailing vessel for long-term multidisciplinary ocean monitoring in South Atlantic. Gathers high-quality data while minimizing environmental impact. Focuses on ocean-climate nexus and ecosystem monitoring.

properties.title: Basin-scale Events and Coastal Impacts (BECI)
properties.description: North Pacific Ocean Knowledge Network collating ocean conditions data, marine ecosystem impacts, and transboundary fish populations. Provides interactive dashboards and synthesis tools for climate-informed decision-making across Pacific Rim.
properties.funder: The North Pacific Marine Science Organization (PICES)

properties.title: BlueCraft Africa: Ocean Waste into Coastal Wealth
properties.description: Empowers African coastal communities by transforming ocean waste into marketable arts and crafts. Provides alternative livelihoods through upcycling hubs, reducing fishing dependence while promoting ocean literacy.

properties.title: SubRacing Series
properties.description: Underwater sport racing submersibles to engage people with ocean exploration, collecting data for mapping and monitoring while fostering marine appreciation and blue-economy careers for next generation.

properties.title: Arctic Sea Ice Management
properties.description: Researching controlled ice thickening to preserve Arctic sea ice. Field trials since 2023 test autonomous zero-emission tech to slow ice loss, support ecosystems & Indigenous communities. Ice-free summers projected 2030s.

properties.title: Living Ocean Classroom: From Reefs to Communities
properties.description: Kuruwitu community trains 4 nearby Kenyan fishing communities in coral restoration and recycling to improve fish habitat, biodiversity, and livelihoods using peer-learning model blending traditional knowledge with best practices.

properties.title: Marine Data Exchange Heritage Accelerator
properties.description: Recaptures 20 years of heritage data from seabed surveys for offshore wind development in England's seas. Transfers geophysical/geotechnical survey data to Marine Data Exchange and National Marine Heritage Record databases.

properties.title: Projeto Cultura Oceânica - Conhecendo o Oceano
properties.description: Ocean literacy program in Florianópolis schools since 2021. Engages 4th-graders through interactive activities on biodiversity, climate, marine litter. Collected 32kg recyclables. Promotes SDG 14 awareness.

properties.title: Baltic Climate Resilient Coastal Planning Network
properties.description: Enhances climate resilience of Baltic Sea coastal municipalities through spatial planning tools, data repository, training & workshops. Integrates extreme weather risks into planning via Sea2Land Navigator & Beach-SOS pathways.

properties.title: ENDURE; Sustainable preservation of UCH
properties.description: Preserving 3M+ shipwrecks & submerged prehistoric sites by studying natural/anthropogenic decay, using remote sensing & GIS, determining decay rates, ranking threats via ecosystem modeling, proposing mitigation (2022-2028)

properties.title: Sustainable Aquaculture Under Climate Change
properties.description: Assessing climate impacts on aquaculture, developing resilient strains, refining models, and building capacity in vulnerable regions (SIDS/LDCs) to ensure food security through sustainable practices by 2030.

properties.title: Trilha Translagunar
properties.description: Trail connecting Blue Flag beaches in Araruama Lagoon (Rio de Janeiro) linking hypersaline lagoon to Atlantic Ocean. Promotes ecotourism, environmental education, Blue Economy through interpretive signage and community participation.

properties.title: ACCION SHOA Seabed 2030
properties.description: Chilean Navy's Hydrographic Service shares bathymetric data from surveys along Chilean coast with GEBCO to reduce southern hemisphere seafloor mapping gaps. Data released after 2-year retention. Runs 2025-2030.
properties.funder: Hydrographic and Oceanographic Service of the Chilean Navy (SHOA)

properties.title: Monitoring Coastal Resilience
properties.description: CREST monitors sandy coast erosion & resilience using satellite imagery & geomorphologic assessment to help coastal managers design climate adaptation strategies. Addresses fragmented monitoring data. 2023-2027.

properties.title: Coastal Heritage Resilience Network
properties.description: Safeguards cultural heritage of small-scale fishing communities while strengthening climate resilience. Integrates oral histories, traditional knowledge into digital platforms. Fishers document ecological changes, preserving heritage.

properties.title: AQUASPECT - Advancing Quality Assessment of Spatial Patterns and Ecosystem Characteristics through Technological Advancement
properties.description: AI-driven Digital Twin project assessing coastal ecosystems through phyto/zooplankton monitoring. Combines data collection, ecological modelling, and new sensors to improve ocean biological/biogeochemical knowledge at regional scale.

properties.title: Ocean Prediction for Costa Rica
properties.description: Strengthens Costa Rica's ocean prediction capacities for sustainable marine management. Develops digital tools for Cocos Island MPA monitoring and plans Ocean Prediction Service Center establishment. 2-year project.

properties.title: Coastal Resilience ECOPs Worldwide
properties.description: Global network of Early Career Ocean Professionals across 130+ coastal sites engaging communities in ocean literacy & citizen science. Toolkit covers social-environmental, morphological, seawater, biodiversity & atmospheric aspects.

properties.title: ICTs4SSF: Building Capacity for Coastal Resilience
properties.description: Empowers small-scale fishers in SIDS/LDCs as ocean science contributors via digital tools, training in environmental monitoring, sustainable co-management, and climate adaptation through ABALOBI platforms and KU Leuven partnership.

properties.title: Vox Maris – Zero Nets in the Sea
properties.description: Community initiative recovering abandoned fishing nets via citizen science, creative engagement. Partners with coastal communities, scientists, artists to regenerate ecosystems, prevent pollution through circular economy models.

properties.title: Regenerative Tides: Sailing for Solutions
properties.description: Grassroots citizen science mapping abandoned fiberglass boats in Brittany, testing environmental samples, co-creating advocacy tools. Blends science, art, storytelling to expose aquatic pollution and influence regenerative policies.

properties.title: RIVIERADE - Delivering Climate Services for European Seas
properties.description: Develops high-resolution climate predictions for Baltic, Black & Mediterranean Seas (2026-2029). Multi-model framework produces downscaled projections for ocean health, blue economy & coastal risk at basin to local scales.

properties.title: Guardians of Gaia – Mare Nostrum
properties.description: Transdisciplinary initiative bridging Indigenous knowledge, marine science & youth education to regenerate Mediterranean coastal ecosystems via sailing expeditions with eDNA research, traditional knowledge sharing & restoration projects.

properties.title: Climate Resilience for Sustainable Ocean Planning
properties.description: Develops open-source climate vulnerability assessment tool for MPAs globally. Pilots in 2 MPAs (Global North/South), focuses on marine biodiversity resilience, indigenous community participation, and 30% ocean protection by 2030.

properties.title: Shisiwani-Eco 2030
properties.description: Community-led marine conservation in Shisiwani National Park, Anjouan, Comoros. Ecological monitoring, capacity building, inclusive governance to protect coral reefs. Engages fishers, schools, women, youth for ocean stewardship.

properties.title: Sail for Impact – an action-based sailing initiative for ocean impact
properties.description: Global sailing platform for ocean research, restoration & education. Scientists, NGOs & communities co-create missions from Arctic kelp surveys to racing campaigns. Blends fieldwork with storytelling for systemic change.

properties.title: Postdoc Cohort: The Dilemma of the Southern Ocean
properties.description: Integrates natural & social sciences to balance competing interests in Southern Ocean. 4 subprojects: governance, krill fishery, marine protected areas, acoustic management. Addresses climate regulation & human pressures 2026-2028.

properties.title: AlFunFeed: Fungal Single-Cell Protein from Macroalgal Waste Fermentation
properties.description: Replaces plant protein in aquafeeds with fungal single-cell protein from macroalgae waste. Targets European seabass diets using 3 fungi strains. Promotes circular economy and sustainable aquaculture. Starts Aug 2025.

properties.title: Empowering Women for the United Nations Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development
properties.description: Enhances capacity for women's empowerment and gender equality in ocean science. Identifies barriers, develops strategy for equal participation in Ocean Decade. Global collaboration for transformative action.
properties.funder: Sasakawa Global Ocean Institute, World Maritime University

properties.title: Yachts for Science (YSF)
properties.description: Global platform matching marine scientists with private yacht owners to overcome vessel access bottleneck. Transforms underutilized yachts into cost-effective research platforms for scientific discovery and conservation across all ocean basins.

properties.title: Strengthening Tsunami Early Warning
properties.description: Enhances tsunami early warning in NW Indian Ocean through regional cooperation. Builds community capacities for UNESCO-IOC Tsunami Ready Programme in India, Iran, Maldives, Pakistan, Sri Lanka. Aims 100% preparedness by 2030.

properties.title: Branding of Research Vessels with Oceandecade Logo
properties.description: German research vessels SONNE, METEOR, ALKOR, MARIA S. MERIAN support marine research globally in biology, geology, geophysics, oceanography. Contribute to Ocean Decade challenges on ecosystem protection, ocean-climate, capacity development.
properties.funder: Bundesministerium für Forschung, Technologie und Raumfahrt – BMFTR (Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space) – Germany

properties.title: Strategies, technologies and social solutions to manage bycatch in tropical Large Marine Ecosystem Fisheries (REBYC-III CLME+)
properties.description: Manage bycatch and reduce discards in Caribbean and North Brazil Shelf LMEs, promoting sustainable fisheries with economic opportunities while conserving marine resources, supporting CLME+ SAP implementation.

properties.title: Mainstreaming Sustainable Marine Fisheries Value Chains into the Blue Economy of the Canary Current and the Pacific Central American Coastal Large Marine Ecosystems
properties.description: Mainstream ecological/social sustainability for fisheries production & coastal communities in Canary Current & Pacific Central American LMEs. Supports FIPs, value chains, Blue Economy across 6 countries via GEF funding.

properties.title: Managing and conserving marine, coastal and terrestrial ecosystem services in Seychelles through Ridge-to-Reef approach
properties.description: Conserves ecosystem services in Seychelles islands using Ridge-to-Reef approach, managing marine, coastal & terrestrial ecosystems for multiple benefits. GEF-funded integrated coastal management project.

properties.title: Pacific Tuna SAP Implementation
properties.description: Pacific tuna fisheries management across 14 island nations. Implements Strategic Action Programme for sustainable tuna stocks. Regional cooperation for oceanic resource conservation. 2020-ongoing.

properties.title: Pacific Central American Coastal Large Marine Ecosystem Project

properties.title: Improving Management of Priority Fisheries in Madagascar

properties.title: Charting the Blue
